papers.title: vLLM: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
papers.authors: Unknown
papers.abstract_en: High throughput serving of large language models (LLMs) requires batching sufficiently many requests at a time. However, existing systems struggle because the key-value cache (KV cache) memory for each request is huge and grows and shrinks dynamically. When managed inefficiently, this memory can be significantly wasted by fragmentation and redundant duplication, limiting the batch size. To address this problem, we propose PagedAttention, an attention algorithm inspired by the classical virtual memory and paging techniques in operating systems. On top of it, we build vLLM, an LLM serving system that achieves (1) near-zero waste in KV cache memory and (2) flexible sharing of KV cache within and across requests to further reduce memory usage. Our evaluations show that vLLM improves the throughput of popular LLMs by 2-4$\times$ with the same level of latency compared to the state-of-the-art systems, such as FasterTransformer and Orca. The improvement is more pronounced with longer sequences, larger models, and more complex decoding algorithms. vLLM's source code is publicly available at https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm
papers.abstract_cn:
## 摘要 (中文)
大型语言模型（LLM）的高吞吐量服务需要同时批处理足够多的请求。然而，现有系统面临挑战，因为每个请求的键值缓存（KV缓存）内存很大，且会动态增长和收缩。当管理不高效时，这些内存会因碎片化和冗余复制而严重浪费，限制了批处理大小。为解决这一问题，我们提出了PagedAttention，这是一种受操作系统中经典虚拟内存和分页技术启发的注意力算法。在此基础上，我们构建了vLLM，一个LLM服务系统，实现了（1）KV缓存内存近零浪费，（2）灵活共享KV缓存在请求内部和跨请求以进一步减少内存使用。我们的评估表明，vLLM与FasterTransformer和Orca等最新系统相比，在相同延迟水平下将流行LLM的吞吐量提高了2-4倍。这种改进在更长序列、更大模型和更复杂解码算法的情况下更为明显。

## 引言 (Introduction)
Large language models (LLMs) have become the backbone of many modern AI applications. Serving LLMs at scale requires high throughput to serve many concurrent users. A common technique to improve throughput is to batch multiple requests together and process them simultaneously. However, the memory consumption of LLM serving is dominated by the key-value (KV) cache, which stores intermediate activation for the attention mechanism. The KV cache is large and grows and shrinks dynamically as the model generates new tokens. Efficient management of the KV cache is critical for maximizing batch size and thus throughput.
papers.ai_summary_en: vLLM addresses inefficient KV-cache memory management in high-throughput LLM serving, where per-request caches are large, dynamically sized, and prone to fragmentation and redundant copying. Its key method, PagedAttention, applies OS-style virtual memory paging to partition KV caches into non-contiguous blocks, enabling near-zero memory waste and flexible intra-/inter-request cache sharing. Evaluations show vLLM improves serving throughput by 2–4× over FasterTransformer and Orca at comparable latency, with larger gains for long sequences, larger models, and more complex decoding algorithms.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大语言模型在线服务中 KV 缓存内存动态增长导致的碎片化、冗余复制和批处理受限问题。其核心洞见是借鉴操作系统虚拟内存与分页机制，提出 PagedAttention，将 KV 缓存分页管理并支持请求内/跨请求共享，从而构建 vLLM 系统以近乎消除内存浪费。实验显示，在相同延迟下，vLLM 相比 FasterTransformer 和 Orca 可将吞吐量提升 2–4 倍，且在长序列、大模型和复杂解码场景下收益更显著。

papers.title: PowerInfer-2: High-Speed LLM Inference for Smartphones
papers.authors: 来自上海交通大学IPADS实验室
papers.abstract_cn:
PowerInfer-2是一个专为智能手机设计的高度优化推理框架。

使用TurboSparse-Mixtral-47B ， PowerInfer-2在智能手机上实现了 * * 11.68令牌/秒* *的推理速度 ，比其他 SOTA框架快达 * * 22倍 * *。
papers.ai_summary_en: PowerInfer-2 addresses high-throughput LLM inference on resource-constrained smartphones, especially for large sparse mixture-of-experts models. It proposes a smartphone-optimized serving framework that leverages TurboSparse-Mixtral-47B and system-level optimizations to reduce memory and compute overhead during sparse activation. The system achieves 11.68 tokens/s on-device, up to 22× faster than prior state-of-the-art smartphone inference frameworks.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对智能手机资源受限导致的大模型推理慢、难以部署高参数LLM的问题，提出了面向移动端高度优化的推理框架 PowerInfer-2。其核心洞见是通过移动端推理系统优化并结合 TurboSparse-Mixtral-47B 等稀疏化模型，提高手机上的计算与内存利用效率。实验显示，该框架在智能手机上可达 11.68 tokens/s，较其他 SOTA 框架最高快 22 倍，显著推进了 47B 级 LLM 的端侧可用推理。

papers.title: Lookahead Decoding: Break the Sequential Dependency of LLM Inference
papers.authors: (待补充)
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) generate tokens auto-regressively, which creates sequential dependency that limits parallelization during inference. This paper presents Lookahead Decoding, a technique that breaks this sequential dependency to enable parallel token generation.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（ LLM ）自动回归生成令牌，这会创建顺序依赖关系，从而限制推理过程中的并行化。本文介绍了Lookahead解码，这是一种打破这种顺序依赖性以实现并行令牌生成的技术。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the autoregressive bottleneck in LLM serving, where token-by-token generation creates sequential dependencies that limit GPU parallelism and increase latency. It proposes Lookahead Decoding, a single-model speculative decoding method that maintains candidate future tokens and uses a modified parallel forward pass with verification/acceptance logic to generate multiple tokens per step without a separate draft model. The main impact is reduced inference latency and improved throughput, especially for sequences with reusable n-gram structure, while preserving standard greedy decoding behavior.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大语言模型自回归推理中逐 token 生成导致的强顺序依赖和并行度不足问题展开研究。其核心方法是提出 Lookahead Decoding，通过前瞻式地生成或验证后续 token，打破单步生成对前序结果的严格依赖，从而实现一定程度的并行 token 生成。该方法有望提升 LLM 推理吞吐并降低生成延迟，为高并发模型服务提供更高效的解码路径。

papers.title: Quest: Query-Aware Sparsity for Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.authors: (待补充)
papers.abstract_en: Long-context LLM inference requires significant memory and compute resources. Quest proposes a query-aware sparsity approach that selectively attends to relevant context, reducing computation while maintaining quality.
papers.abstract_cn: 长上下文LLM推理需要大量的内存和计算资源。Quest提出了一种查询感知稀疏性方法，可以选择性地关注相关上下文，在保持质量的同时减少计算量。
papers.ai_summary_en: Quest addresses the memory and compute bottleneck of long-context LLM inference, where full attention over all cached tokens is costly during serving. It introduces query-aware sparsity that dynamically selects only the context tokens or KV entries relevant to the current query, enabling sparse attention without static pruning. This reduces inference computation and memory pressure while preserving generation quality, improving long-context serving efficiency.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对长上下文 LLM 推理中注意力计算和内存开销过高的问题，提出查询感知的稀疏注意力方法 Quest。其核心洞见是根据当前查询动态选择最相关的上下文参与注意力计算，而非处理全部 token。实验表明，该方法可在保持生成质量的同时显著降低计算开销，提高长上下文服务效率。

papers.title: KIVI: A Tuning-Free Asymmetric 2bit Quantization for KV Cache
papers.authors: (待补充)
papers.abstract_en: KV cache quantization is crucial for reducing memory footprint in LLM inference. This paper presents KIVI, a tuning-free asymmetric 2bit quantization method for KV cache that achieves minimal accuracy loss.
papers.abstract_cn: KV缓存量化对于减少LLM推理中的内存占用至关重要。本文提出了KIVI ，一种实现最小精度损失的KV缓存无调谐非对称2位量化方法。
papers.ai_summary_en: KIVI addresses the large memory overhead of KV caches during LLM inference by compressing them to 2 bits without requiring tuning or fine-tuning. Its key insight is an asymmetric quantization scheme tailored to the differing statistics of keys and values, using separate granularity/zero-point handling to preserve accuracy under extreme low-bit compression. The method achieves near-full-precision performance with minimal accuracy loss, enabling more efficient long-context and high-throughput inference.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型推理中 KV cache 内存占用过高的问题，提出无需微调的 2bit 非对称量化方法 KIVI。其核心洞见是 Key 和 Value 的离群值分布不同，因此对 Key 采用按通道量化、对 Value 采用按 token 量化，以在极低比特下保持精度。实验表明，KIVI 能显著降低 KV cache 内存并提升长上下文推理吞吐，同时几乎不损失模型精度。

papers.title: ReSpec: Towards Optimizing Speculative Decoding in Reinforcement Learning Systems
papers.authors: Qiaoling Chen, Zijun Liu, Peng Sun, Shenggui Li, Guoteng Wang, Ziming Liu, Yonggang Wen, Siyuan Feng, Tianwei Zhang
papers.abstract_en:
Adapting large language models (LLMs) via reinforcement learning (RL) is often bottlenecked by the generation stage, which can consume over 75% of the training time. Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates autoregressive generation in serving systems, but its behavior under RL training remains largely unexplored. We identify three critical gaps that hinder the naive integration of SD into RL systems: diminishing speedups at large batch sizes, drafter staleness under continual actor updates, and drafter-induced policy degradation.

To address these gaps, we present ReSpec, a system that adapts SD to RL through three complementary mechanisms: dynamically tuning SD configurations, evolving the drafter via knowledge distillation, and weighting updates by rollout rewards. On Qwen models (3B--14B), ReSpec achieves up to 4.5x speedup while preserving reward convergence and training stability, providing a practical solution for efficient RL-based LLM adaptation.
papers.abstract_cn:
通过强化学习（ RL ）适应大型语言模型（ LLM ）通常会受到生成阶段的瓶颈，这可能会消耗超过75 ％的训练时间。推测解码（ SD ）加速了服务系统中的自回归生成，但其在RL训练下的行为在很大程度上仍未得到探索。 我们确定了阻碍将SD天真地集成到RL系统中的三个关键差距：在大批量情况下减少加速，在持续更新的情况下起草者停滞，以及起草者导致的策略退化。

为了弥补这些差距，我们提出了ReSpec ，这是一个通过三种互补机制使SD适应RL的系统：动态调整SD配置，通过知识蒸馏进化起草者，以及通过ROLL加权更新 在Qwen模型（ 3B--14B ）上， ReSpec在保持奖励收敛和训练稳定性的同时，实现了高达4.5倍的加速，为基于RL的LLM高效适应提供了实用的解决方案。
papers.ai_summary_en: ReSpec addresses the bottleneck of generation-heavy RL training for LLMs, where naive speculative decoding suffers from diminishing speedups at large batch sizes, drafter staleness under continual actor updates, and drafter-induced policy degradation. The system introduces RL-aware speculative decoding with dynamic SD configuration tuning, continual drafter evolution via knowledge distillation, and reward-weighted updates to preserve training fidelity. Experiments on Qwen models (3B–14B) show up to 4.5× speedup while maintaining reward convergence and training stability.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对强化学习训练大语言模型时生成阶段耗时过高、而投机解码直接引入会受大批量加速衰减、drafter随actor更新过时及策略退化影响的问题展开研究。核心方法是提出ReSpec，通过动态调整投机解码配置、用知识蒸馏持续演化drafter，并按rollout奖励加权更新来适配RL训练。实验在Qwen 3B–14B模型上取得最高4.5倍加速，同时保持奖励收敛与训练稳定。

papers.title: SpecForge: A Flexible and Efficient Open-Source Training Framework for Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Shenggui Li, Chao Wang, Yikai Zhu, Yubo Wang, Fan Yin, Shuai Shi, Yefei Chen, Xiaomin Dong, Qiaoling Chen, Jin Pan, Ji Li, Laixin Xie, Yineng Zhang, Lei Yu, Yonggang Wen, Ivor Tsang, Tianwei Zhang
papers.abstract_cn:
大型语言模型由于顺序自回归解码而产生高推理延迟。投机解码（投机解码 ）通过使用草案模型预测多个令牌，然后使用目标模型并行验证，是加速自回归 LLM推理的一种有前景的方法。

Draft 然而，现有的投机解码框架主要关注推理阶段草缺乏对稿，模型训练的支持草稿导致部署效率受限。

* * SpecForge * * 是一个灵活高效的* *开源训练框架 * * ，专门用于投机解码。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the limited practicality of speculative decoding caused by existing frameworks focusing mainly on inference while lacking systematic support for training draft models. SpecForge is an open-source, flexible training framework that streamlines draft-model training, optimization, and integration with target LLMs for parallel token verification. Its main impact is filling the training-side gap in speculative decoding systems, enabling more efficient and adaptable acceleration of autoregressive LLM inference.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对现有投机解码框架偏重推理、缺乏 draft 模型训练支持，从而限制部署效率的问题，提出了 SpecForge 这一灵活高效的开源训练框架。其核心洞见是将投机解码的 draft 模型训练纳入统一框架，支持更灵活、高效的训练与部署流程。该工作有望补齐投机解码从训练到推理的链路，提升大模型自回归推理加速的实际可用性。

papers.title: Accelerating OpenPangu Inference on NPU via Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Yuntao Dai, Jing Wu, Hang Gu, Teng Wang
papers.abstract_en: To mitigate the Memory Wall bottleneck encountered by Large Language Models (LLMs) during inference on NPU hardware, and addressing the scarcity of native support for mainstream speculative decoding algorithms on domestic infrastructure, this study presents an end-to-end speculative inference acceleration scheme for OpenPangu-7B.
papers.abstract_cn: 为了缓解大型语言模型（ LLM ）在NPU硬件上推理过程中遇到的Memory Wall瓶颈，并解决国内基础设施上主流推测解码算法原生支持的稀缺性，本研究提出了一种OpenPangu-7B的端到端推测推理加速方案。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the memory-wall bottleneck and inefficient autoregressive decoding of LLMs on NPU hardware, along with the lack of native speculative decoding support on domestic accelerator stacks. It proposes an end-to-end speculative inference acceleration scheme for OpenPangu-7B, adapting draft-verify speculative decoding to NPU execution so multiple candidate tokens can be generated and validated per step. The work provides a practical path to reduce inference latency and improve throughput on constrained NPU infrastructure while preserving output quality.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大语言模型在 NPU 上推理时受内存墙限制、且国产硬件缺乏主流投机解码原生支持的问题展开研究。其核心方法是面向 OpenPangu-7B 构建端到端的投机解码推理加速方案，以在国产 NPU 基础设施上实现高效推理。该工作有望降低推理延迟并提升吞吐，为国产硬件上的大模型部署提供可行加速路径。

papers.title: SJD-PAC: Accelerating Speculative Jacobi Decoding via Proactive Drafting and Adaptive Continuation
papers.authors: Jialiang Kang, Han Shu, Wenshuo Li, Yingjie Zhai, Xinghao Chen
papers.abstract_en: Speculative Jacobi Decoding (SJD) offers a draft-model-free approach to accelerate autoregressive text-to-image synthesis. However, the high-entropy nature of visual generation yields low draft-token acceptance rates in complex regions, creating a bottleneck that severely limits overall throughput. To overcome this, we introduce SJD-PAC, an enhanced SJD framework. First, SJD-PAC employs a proactive...
papers.abstract_cn: 推测雅可比解码（ SJD ）提供了一种无草稿模型的方法来加速自回归文本到图像的合成。然而，视觉生成的高熵性质在复杂区域产生了较低的草案代币接受率，造成了严重限制整体吞吐量的瓶颈。为了克服这一点，我们引入了SJD-PAC ，这是一个增强的SJD框架。首先， SJD-PAC采用主动...
papers.ai_summary_en: SJD-PAC addresses the throughput bottleneck in draft-model-free speculative Jacobi decoding for autoregressive text-to-image synthesis, where high-entropy visual regions cause low draft-token acceptance rates. The method introduces proactive drafting to generate better candidate tokens ahead of verification and adaptive continuation to dynamically adjust generation based on acceptance behavior. This improves decoding efficiency in complex image regions while preserving generation quality.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对无草稿模型的投机式 Jacobi 解码在自回归文本到图像生成中，因视觉 token 高熵导致复杂区域草稿接受率低、吞吐受限的问题。其提出 SJD-PAC，通过主动草稿生成与自适应续写机制，提前构造更可靠的候选 token 并根据生成状态动态调整解码流程。该方法提升了高熵区域的草稿接受率和整体解码吞吐，为加速图像生成提供了更有效的投机解码框架。

papers.title: Training-free Dropout Sampling for Semantic Token Acceptance in Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Jeongtae Lee, Minjung Jo, Hyunjoon Jeong, Gunho Park, Sunghyeon Woo, Joonghoon Kim, Se Jung Kwon, Dongsoo Lee
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by proposing tokens with a lightweight draft model and selectively accepting them using a target model. This work introduces DropMatch, a novel approach that matches draft tokens to the predictive distribution of the target model via Monte Carlo dropout applied exclusively to the LM head, enabling sampling-based acceptance decisions.
papers.abstract_cn: 推测解码通过提出具有轻量级草稿模型的代币并使用目标模型选择性地接受它们来加速大型语言模型推断。这项工作引入了DropMatch ，这是一种新颖的方法，通过蒙特卡洛丢弃将草稿代币与目标模型的预测分布相匹配，仅适用于LM头部，从而实现基于采样的验收决策。
papers.ai_summary_en: DropMatch addresses the acceptance-decision bottleneck in speculative decoding, where draft tokens must be validated against the target model’s predictive distribution without adding training overhead or excessive verification cost. Its key idea is to apply Monte Carlo dropout exclusively to the language-model head to generate stochastic target distributions, enabling training-free, sampling-based acceptance of draft tokens. This yields a lightweight, drop-in acceptance mechanism that can preserve target-model semantics while potentially improving speculative decoding efficiency.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对投机解码中草稿 token 的接受判定需要匹配目标模型预测分布、且常依赖额外训练或复杂校验的问题。其提出免训练方法 DropMatch，仅在目标模型 LM head 上施加 Monte Carlo dropout，以采样方式估计目标预测分布并据此决定草稿 token 是否接受。该方法为语义级 token 接受提供了轻量采样机制，有望在不增加训练成本的情况下提升投机解码的接受决策质量与推理加速效果。

papers.title: CXL-SpecKV: A Disaggregated FPGA Speculative KV-Cache for Datacenter LLM Serving
papers.authors: Dong Liu, Yanxuan Yu
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized natural language processing tasks, but their deployment in datacenter environments faces significant challenges due to the massive memory requirements of key-value (KV) caches. During the autoregressive decoding process, KV caches consume substantial GPU memory, limiting batch sizes and overall system throughput. To address these challenges, we propose **CXL-SpecKV**, a novel disaggregated KV-cache architecture that leverages Compute Express Link (CXL) interconnects and FPGA accelerators to enable efficient speculative execution and memory disaggregation. Our approach introduces three key innovations: (i) a CXL-based memory disaggregation framework that offloads KV-caches to remote FPGA memory with low latency, (ii) a speculative KV-cache prefetching mechanism that predicts and preloads future tokens' cache entries, and (iii) an FPGA-accelerated KV-cache compression and decompression engine that reduces memory bandwidth requirements by up to 4×. When evaluated on state-of-the-art LLM models, CXL-SpecKV achieves up to 3.2× higher throughput compared to GPU-only baselines, while reducing memory costs by 2.8× and maintaining accuracy. Our system demonstrates that intelligent memory disaggregation combined with speculative execution can effectively address the memory wall challenge in large-scale LLM serving. Our code implementation has been open-sourced at [this https URL](https://github.com/FastLM/CXL-SpecKV).
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（ LLM ）彻底改变了自然语言处理任务，但由于键值（ KV ）缓存的大量内存需求，它们在数据中心环境中的部署面临重大挑战。在自回归解码过程中， KV缓存占用大量GPU内存，限制了批处理大小和整体系统吞吐量。 为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了* * CXL-SpecKV * * ，这是一种新颖的分解式KV缓存架构，利用Compute Express Link （ CXL ）互连和FPGA加速器来实现高效的投机执行和内存分解。 我们的方法引入了三项关键创新： （ i ）基于CXL的内存分解框架，可将KV缓存以低延迟卸载到远程FPGA内存； （ ii ）推测性KV缓存预取机制，可预测和预加载未来令牌的缓存条目； （ iii ） FPGA加速的KV缓存压缩和解压缩引擎，可将内存带宽要求降低高达4倍。 在最先进的LLM模型上进行评估时， CXL-SpecKV的吞吐量比仅使用GPU的基线高出3.2倍，同时将内存成本降低了2.8倍，并保持了准确性。我们的系统证明，智能内存分解与推测执行相结合可以有效解决大规模LLM服务中的内存墙挑战。 我们的代码实现已在[此https URL] (https://github.com/FastLM/CXL-SpecKV)上开源。
papers.ai_summary_en: CXL-SpecKV addresses the GPU memory bottleneck caused by large KV caches in datacenter LLM serving, which limits batch size and throughput. It proposes a disaggregated KV-cache architecture using CXL-attached FPGA memory, speculative KV-cache prefetching, and FPGA-accelerated compression/decompression to reduce bandwidth and latency overheads. The system achieves up to 3.2× higher throughput than GPU-only baselines and 2.8× lower memory cost while preserving model accuracy.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对数据中心 LLM 推理中 KV-Cache 占用大量 GPU 内存、限制批处理规模和吞吐的问题。其核心方法是提出 CXL-SpecKV：利用 CXL 互联将 KV-Cache 卸载到远程 FPGA 内存，并结合投机式预取与 FPGA 加速的 KV-Cache 压缩/解压，以降低访存压力。实验显示，在主流 LLM 上吞吐最高可提升 3.2 倍，内存成本降低 2.8 倍，同时保持模型精度。

papers.title: Rocks, Pebbles and Sand: Modality-aware Scheduling for Multimodal Large Language Model Inference
papers.authors: Konstantinos Papaioannou, Thaleia Dimitra Doudali, et al.
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) power platforms like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Copilot, enabling richer interactions with text, images, and videos. These heterogeneous workloads introduce additional inference stages, such as vision preprocessing and encoding, that inflate latency and memory demand. Existing LLM serving systems, optimized for text-only workloads, fail under multimodality: large requests (e.g., videos) monopolize resources, causing severe head-of-line blocking and performance degradation. Our key insight is that multimodal requests differ by orders of magnitude in resource demands, which we capture through a simple abstraction: videos behave like rocks, images like pebbles, and text like sand. We design RPS-Serve, a modality-aware scheduler that lets sand flow quickly through pebbles and rocks, ensuring interactive responsiveness while avoiding starvation. RPS-Serve classifies requests, prioritizes them dynamically, and applies aging to avoid starvation. Evaluation across state-of-the-art MLLMs shows that RPS-Serve reduces, on average, time-to-first-token (TTFT) by 54% overall, and by 78.5% for latency-critical requests, compared to current systems.
papers.abstract_cn: ChatGPT、Gemini和Copilot等多模态大型语言模型（ MLLM ）电源平台，可与文本、图像和视频进行更丰富的交互。这些异构工作负载引入了额外的推理阶段，例如视觉预处理和编码，从而增加了延迟和内存需求。 针对纯文本工作负载进行优化的现有LLM服务系统在多模态下失败：大型请求（例如视频）垄断资源，导致严重的行头阻塞和性能下降。我们的关键见解是，多式联运请求在资源需求方面存在数量级的差异，我们通过一个简单的抽象来捕捉：视频表现得像岩石，图像像鹅卵石，文本像沙子。 我们设计了RPS-Serve ，这是一种模式感知调度器，可让沙子快速流过鹅卵石和岩石，确保交互式响应，同时避免饥饿。RPS-Serve对请求进行分类，对其进行动态优先级排序，并应用老化以避免饥饿。 对最先进的MLLM的评估显示，与当前系统相比， RPS-Serve平均减少了54%的首次令牌时间(TTFT) ，而延迟关键型请求减少了78.5%。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses inefficient MLLM serving, where heterogeneous text, image, and video requests cause head-of-line blocking, inflated latency, and memory pressure in schedulers designed for text-only LLMs. RPS-Serve introduces a modality-aware scheduling abstraction—videos as “rocks,” images as “pebbles,” and text as “sand”—with request classification, dynamic prioritization that lets small text requests flow around larger jobs, and aging to prevent starvation. Evaluations on state-of-the-art MLLMs show average TTFT reductions of 54%, including 78.5% for latency-critical requests, compared with existing systems.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态大模型推理服务中文本、图像、视频请求资源需求差异巨大，导致大请求垄断资源、队头阻塞和延迟升高的问题。核心洞见是将视频、图像、文本分别类比为“岩石、卵石、沙子”，并提出 RPS-Serve 通过模态感知分类、动态优先级调度和老化机制，让小请求快速穿过大请求且避免饥饿。实验显示，相比现有系统，其平均 TTFT 降低 54%，延迟敏感请求降低 78.5%。

papers.title: MemBoost: A Memory-Boosted Framework for Cost-Aware LLM Inference
papers.authors: Joris Köster, Zixuan Liu, Siavash Khajavi, Zizhan Zheng
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) deliver strong performance but incur high inference cost in real-world services, especially under workloads with repeated or near-duplicate queries across users and sessions. In this work, we propose MemBoost, a memory-boosted LLM serving framework that enables a lightweight model to reuse previously generated answers and retrieve relevant supporting information for cheap inference, while selectively escalating difficult or uncertain queries to a stronger model. Unlike standard retrieval-augmented generation, which primarily grounds a single response, MemBoost is designed for interactive settings by supporting answer reuse, continual memory growth, and cost-aware routing. Experiments across multiple models under simulated workloads show that MemBoost substantially reduces expensive large-model invocations and overall inference cost, while maintaining high answer quality comparable to the strong model baseline.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）提供了强大的性能，但在现实服务中带来了高推理成本，尤其是在涉及用户和会话之间重复或近似重复查询的工作负载下。在这项工作中，我们提出了MemBoost，一种内存增强的LLM服务框架，使轻量级模型能够重用先前生成的答案，并检索相关的支持信息以进行低成本推理，同时将困难或不确定的查询有选择地升级到更强大的模型。与主要用于单一响应的标准增强检索生成不同，MemBoost被设计用于交互式场景，通过支持答案重用、持续内存增长和成本意识路由。多模型在模拟工作负载下的实验表明，MemBoost显著减少了昂贵的大模型调用和整体推理成本，同时保持与强模型基线相当的高答案质量。
papers.ai_summary_en: MemBoost tackles the high cost of LLM inference in interactive serving workloads where many queries are repeated or near-duplicate, by enabling answer reuse rather than regenerating responses from scratch. The framework uses a lightweight model with a continually growing memory to retrieve and reuse prior answers and supporting evidence, while cost-aware routing escalates only difficult or uncertain queries to a stronger model. Experiments show that MemBoost substantially reduces expensive large-model invocations and overall inference cost while preserving answer quality comparable to the strong-model baseline.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM 在线服务中重复/近重复查询导致的高推理成本问题，提出 MemBoost 这一记忆增强的成本感知推理框架。其核心思路是让轻量模型复用历史答案并检索相关支撑信息，同时对困难或不确定查询选择性升级到更强模型，实现答案复用、记忆增长与路由决策的结合。实验表明，MemBoost 能显著减少大模型调用和总体推理成本，同时保持接近强模型基线的回答质量。

papers.title: TriForce: Lossless Acceleration of Long Sequence Generation with Hierarchical Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: (待补充)
papers.abstract_en: TriForce presents a hierarchical speculative decoding approach that uses multiple levels of draft models to achieve lossless acceleration of long sequence generation, addressing the verification bottleneck in tree-based methods.
papers.abstract_cn: TriForce 提出了一种分层的预测解码方法，使用多级草稿模型来实现长序列生成的无损加速，解决了基于树的方法中的验证瓶颈。
papers.ai_summary_en: TriForce tackles the verification bottleneck and scalability limitations of tree-based speculative decoding for long-sequence generation, where validating large candidate trees becomes increasingly expensive as context length grows. It introduces a hierarchical speculative decoding framework that uses multiple draft models at different levels to propose and verify tokens more efficiently while preserving the target model’s exact output distribution. The approach enables lossless acceleration of long-context LLM generation, improving throughput and latency over standard and tree-based speculative decoding baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长序列生成中树状推测解码的验证瓶颈：随着上下文和候选树增大，目标模型验证开销过高，限制加速效果。TriForce 提出分层推测解码，用多级草稿模型逐级生成并筛选候选 token，使昂贵的目标模型只需验证更少、更可靠的候选，从而保持输出分布不变。该方法在长上下文生成中提高了接受长度和吞吐量，实现了无损加速。

papers.title: LayerSkip: Enabling Early Exit Inference and Self-Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: (待补充)
papers.abstract_en: LayerSkip combines early exit inference with self-speculative decoding, allowing LLMs to dynamically skip layers during inference based on sample difficulty, while using the same model for both draft generation and verification.
papers.abstract_cn: LayerSkip将早期退出推理与自推测解码相结合，允许LLM在推理过程中根据样本难度动态跳过层，同时在草稿生成和验证中使用相同的模型。
papers.ai_summary_en: LayerSkip addresses the inference latency inefficiency of fixed-depth LLMs, where every token traverses all layers regardless of difficulty. It combines early-exit inference with self-speculative decoding, using the same model to generate draft tokens from shallow exits and verify them with deeper or full-depth computation. This yields a unified speculative decoding framework that can reduce serving cost while preserving the target model’s output quality.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型推理中逐层计算开销大、且不同样本难度不适配固定深度的问题，提出 LayerSkip，将早退推理与自推测解码结合。其核心洞见是让同一模型根据样本难度动态跳过部分层，既作为草稿生成器又作为验证器，从而避免额外草稿模型。该方法可在保持生成质量的同时降低推理成本并提升解码效率。

papers.title: KVQuant: Towards 10 Million Context Length LLM Inference with KV Cache Quantization
papers.authors: (待补充)
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents KVQuant, a KV cache quantization method that enables LLM inference with context lengths up to 10 million tokens. The method uses per-channel scaling and asymmetric quantization to preserve accuracy.
papers.abstract_cn: 本文提出了 KVQuant，一种 KV 缓存量化方法，使得 LLM 推理可以支持长达 1000 万个 token 的上下文长度。该方法使用每通道缩放和非对称量化来保持精度。
papers.ai_summary_en: KVQuant addresses the KV-cache memory bottleneck that prevents LLM inference at ultra-long context lengths. It applies per-channel scaling and asymmetric quantization to KV-cache tensors, preserving activation fidelity under low-precision storage. The method enables context lengths up to 10 million tokens while maintaining model accuracy, substantially improving the feasibility of extreme-context inference.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向超长上下文LLM推理中KV缓存显存占用过高的问题，提出KVQuant，通过逐通道缩放和非对称量化来压缩KV缓存并保持精度。其主要贡献是使LLM推理可扩展至约1000万token上下文长度，为超长上下文应用提供了低显存、可落地的推理方案。

papers.title: DeFT: Decoding with Flash Tree-attention for Efficient Tree-structured LLM Inference
papers.authors: (待补充)
papers.abstract_en: DeFT introduces Flash Tree-attention for efficient tree-structured speculative decoding, optimizing the attention computation over tree-shaped token sequences to accelerate LLM inference.
papers.abstract_cn: DeFT 引入了闪电树注意力（Flash Tree-attention）用于高效的树状结构推测解码，优化了树形令牌序列上的注意力计算，从而加速大语言模型推理。
papers.ai_summary_en: DeFT addresses the attention bottleneck in tree-structured speculative decoding, where verifying multiple candidate token paths creates irregular, shared-prefix KV access patterns that standard attention kernels handle inefficiently. It introduces Flash Tree-attention, a fused attention kernel that computes exact attention over tree-shaped token sequences by exploiting shared prefixes and compact tree-structured masking to reduce redundant computation and memory traffic. The method accelerates LLM inference for speculative decoding while preserving model accuracy, improving verification throughput and latency over conventional attention implementations.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对树结构投机解码中注意力计算冗余、内存访问开销大的问题，提出了 DeFT 的 Flash Tree-attention 推理内核。其核心洞见是针对树形 token 序列共享前缀和分支结构，优化注意力计算与访存路径，从而减少重复计算并提升 kernel 效率。主要结果是显著加速支持树结构候选的大模型推理，提高投机解码的整体吞吐与效率。

papers.title: DuoAttention: Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference with Retrieval and Streaming Heads
papers.authors: (待补充)
papers.abstract_en: DuoAttention introduces a dual-head attention mechanism that separates retrieval and streaming workloads, enabling efficient long-context LLM inference with reduced memory and compute requirements.
papers.abstract_cn: DuoAttention 引入了一种双头注意力机制，将检索和流式工作负载分开，实现高效的长上下文大语言模型推理，同时降低内存和计算需求。
papers.ai_summary_en: DuoAttention addresses the memory and compute bottleneck of long-context LLM inference caused by attending over an ever-growing KV cache. It introduces a dual-head attention design that partitions heads into retrieval heads, which selectively access relevant historical context, and streaming heads, which focus on recent tokens, enabling tiered KV-cache management. This separation reduces memory and computation requirements while preserving long-context capability, improving inference efficiency for large models.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文大模型推理中注意力计算与KV缓存开销过高的问题展开研究。其核心方法是提出 DuoAttention 双头注意力机制，将注意力头区分为负责长程检索的头和负责局部流式生成的头，从而对不同工作负载采用更高效的计算与内存策略。该方法可在长上下文推理中显著降低内存和计算需求，为高效 LLM 服务提供了新的注意力优化思路。

papers.title: SWIFT: On-the-Fly Self-Speculative Decoding for LLM Inference Acceleration
papers.authors: (待补充)
papers.abstract_en: SWIFT presents an on-the-fly self-speculative decoding approach that allows a single LLM to generate speculative drafts without requiring a separate draft model, reducing latency while maintaining output quality.
papers.abstract_cn: SWIFT 提出了一种即时自我推测解码方法，使单个大型语言模型能够生成推测性草稿，而无需单独的草稿模型，从而在保持输出质量的同时降低延迟。
papers.ai_summary_en: SWIFT tackles the latency overhead of speculative decoding by removing the need for a separate draft model, allowing a single LLM to both propose and verify candidate tokens. Its key idea is on-the-fly self-speculative drafting, where the target model generates draft tokens using a lightweight self-approximation and then verifies them with its full-capacity forward pass. This reduces autoregressive inference latency while preserving output quality.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对大模型推理中投机解码依赖独立草稿模型、增加部署复杂性和资源开销的问题。  
其核心方法是让同一个 LLM 在推理过程中“自投机”，即时生成草稿 token 并进行自我验证，从而无需额外草稿模型。  
结果表明，该方法可在保持输出质量不变的前提下降低生成延迟、提升推理吞吐。

papers.title: M2XFP: A Metadata-Augmented Microscaling Data Format for Efficient Low-bit Quantization
papers.authors: Weiming Hu, Zihan Zhang, Haoyan Zhang, Chen Zhang, Cong Guo, Yu Feng, Tianchi Hu, Guanglin Li, Guipeng Hu, Junsong Wang, Jingwen Leng
papers.abstract_en:
Existing low-bit Microscaling (MX) formats, such as MXFP4, often suffer from substantial accuracy degradation due to the use of a shared scaling factor with the Power-of-Two format. In this work, we explore strategies that introduce minimal metadata to recover accuracy lost during quantization while maintaining high bit efficiency across a wide range of large language models.

We propose a complete algorithm-hardware co-design based on flexible metadata, featuring an online quantization with simple encoding. To support the proposed method efficiently, we implement a lightweight hardware unit and integrate it into the accelerator.

Evaluation results demonstrate that our method substantially narrows the accuracy gap, achieving on average a 70.63% reduction in accuracy loss compared to MXFP4 and a 37.30% reduction relative to the latest NVFP4 on LLM benchmarks. Furthermore, our design delivers up to 1.91× speedup and 1.75× energy savings over state-of-the-art accelerators. Our code is available at this https URL.

papers.title: SNIP: An Adaptive Mixed Precision Framework for Subbyte Large Language Model Training
papers.authors: Yunjie Pan, Yao Fu, Ziheng Qiao, Chengmai Mao, Yining Qi, Tianchen Du, Hongxiang Li, Lanbo Li, Chen Liang, Yong Li, Dilin Wang, Wei Liu
papers.abstract_en:
Training large language models (LLMs) efficiently while preserving model quality poses significant challenges, particularly with subbyte precision supported by state-of-the-art GPUs. Current mixed-precision training approaches either apply uniform precision to all GEMM operations or rely on heuristic-based methods that fail to generalize during training, leading to suboptimal convergence and instability. To address these challenges, this paper introduces SNIP, a fine-grained adaptive mixed-precision training framework for LLM pretraining that supports subbyte precision.

SNIP periodically collects statistics on activations, gradients, and optimizer states to assess the precision loss impact on model quality. We define two key metrics:

- **Loss divergence in the forward pass**: Caused by quantization-induced increases in training loss
- **Weight divergence in the backward pass**: Measures error propagation through gradients affecting model updates

These metrics guide an Integer Linear Programming (ILP) problem that systematically optimizes layerwise precision to minimize overall quality loss while meeting efficiency targets.

Experiments on 1B, 3B, 7B and 70B Llama-like models demonstrate that SNIP consistently outperforms existing baselines, reducing FLOPs by up to 80% while preserving model quality across different model sizes and training phases with minimal computational overhead.

papers.ai_summary_en: SNIP addresses inefficient and unstable subbyte mixed-precision LLM pretraining, where uniform or heuristic precision assignment fails to generalize across layers and training phases. papers.title: RedFuser: An Automatic Operator Fusion Framework for Cascaded Reductions on AI Accelerators
papers.authors: Xinsheng Tang, Yuhui Zhao, Jintao Li, Jiaming Xu, Shuo Li, Jiansong Chen, Chen Zhang, Yong Li, Xiaoyong Liu, Ji Liu, Jin Wang, Wei Lin
papers.abstract_en:
Operator fusion, as a key performance optimization technique in the deployment of AI models, significantly improves execution efficiency and has been widely adopted in modern AI compilers. However, for cascaded reduction operations involving multiple loops with inter-loop data dependencies, such as the safe softmax followed by GEMM within attention mechanisms, existing compilers lack effective automated fusion and kernel generation capabilities. Although some works have addressed specific instances through hand-crafted fusion strategies, their solutions are limited in generality and difficult to extend to other similar structures. Given the prevalence of such computational patterns in deep learning models, there remains significant untapped potential in achieving general and automated fusion optimization.

In this paper, we present a formal theoretical methodology for analyzing cascaded reductions which can fuse them into a single loop and introduce an incremental computation form. Based on this methodology, we design Reduction Fuser (RedFuser), a framework that automatically identifies supported cascaded reduction patterns and generates optimized fused kernels. Experiments show that RedFuser successfully fuses diverse workloads, achieving up to 2× to 5× speedup over state-of-the-art AI compilers and matching the performance of highly optimized hand-written kernels. The code is available at this https URL.

papers.title: LAER-MoE: Load-Adaptive Expert Re-layout for Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Training
papers.authors: Xinyi Liu, Zijian Zhang, YongLi Zhu, Jiale Zhang, Peng Sun, XuanWang, Qi Qi, Jingren Zhou, Tong Yang, Bin Cui
papers.abstract_en:
Expert parallelism is vital for effectively training Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, enabling different devices to host distinct experts, with each device processing different input data. However, during expert parallel training, dynamic routing results in significant load imbalance among experts: a handful of overloaded experts hinder overall iteration, emerging as a training bottleneck.

In this paper, we introduce LAER-MoE, an efficient MoE training framework. The core of LAER-MoE is a novel parallel paradigm, Fully Sharded Expert Parallel (FSEP), which fully partitions each expert parameter by the number of devices and restores partial experts at expert granularity through All-to-All communication during training. This allows for flexible re-layout of expert parameters during training to enhance load balancing. In particular, we perform fine-grained scheduling of communication operations to minimize communication overhead. Additionally, we develop a load balancing planner to formulate re-layout strategies of experts and routing schemes for tokens during training. We perform experiments on an A100 cluster, and the results indicate that our system achieves up to 1.69x acceleration compared to the current state-of-the-art training systems. Source code available at this https URL.

papers.ai_summary_en: LAER-MoE addresses load imbalance in expert-parallel MoE training, where dynamic routing causes a few overloaded experts to become iteration bottlenecks. It introduces Fully Sharded Expert Parallel (FSEP), which shards expert parameters across devices and adaptively restores/re-layouts experts via fine-grained All-to-All scheduling, guided by a planner that jointly optimizes expert placement and token routing. papers.title: SpeContext: Enabling Efficient Long-context Reasoning with Speculative Context Sparsity in LLMs
papers.authors: Jiaming Xu, Hong Cao, Yuhan Lin, Jinyang Li, Zheng Liu, Jie Liu, Xingyu Li, Jin Wang, Jingyuan Jia, Ge Li
papers.abstract_en:
In this paper, we point out that the objective of the retrieval algorithms is to align with the LLM, which is similar to the objective of knowledge distillation in LLMs. We analyze the similarity in information focus between the distilled language model (DLM) and the original LLM from the perspective of information theory, and thus propose a novel paradigm that leverages a DLM as the retrieval algorithm. Based on the insight, we present SpeContext, an algorithm and system co-design for long-context reasoning.

1. **At the algorithm level**: SpeContext proposes lightweight retrieval head based on the head-level attention weights of DLM, achieving >90% parameters reduction by pruning the redundancy.

2. **At the system level**: SpeContext designs an asynchronous prefetch dataflow via the elastic loading strategy, effectively overlapping KV cache retrieval with the LLM computation.

3. **At the compilation level**: SpeContext constructs the theoretical memory model and implements an adaptive memory management system to achieve acceleration by maximizing GPU memory utilization.

We deploy and evaluate SpeContext in two resource-constrained environments, cloud and edge. Extensive experiments show that, compared with the Huggingface framework, SpeContext achieves up to 24.89x throughput improvement in cloud and 10.06x speedup in edge with negligible accuracy loss, pushing the Pareto frontier of accuracy and throughput.

papers.title: Ouroboros: Wafer-Scale SRAM CIM with Token-Grained Pipelining for Large Language Model Inference
papers.authors: Yiqi Liu, Cheng Liu, Zhen Gu, Tianchen Ding, Zongyue Zhao, Ziyu Yang, Yufei Ding, Yibo Lin, Mingjie Lin, Xiaowei Li, Zidong Du, Chen Liu, Yunji Chen
papers.abstract_en:
Conventional LLM inference architectures suffer from high energy and latency due to frequent data movement across memory hierarchies. We propose Ouroboros, a wafer-scale SRAM-based Computing-in-Memory (CIM) architecture that executes all operations in situ, eliminating off-chip migration. To maximize its limited first-level capacity, we introduce three innovations:

1. **Token-Grained Pipelining**: Replaces sequence-level pipelining to mitigate length variations, boosting utilization and reducing activation storage.

2. **Distributed Dynamic KV Cache Management**: Decouples memory from compute to leverage fragmented SRAM for efficient KV storage.

3. **Communication-Aware Mapping**: Optimizes core allocation for locality and fault tolerance across the wafer.

Experimental results show Ouroboros achieves average gains of 4.1× in throughput and 4.2× in energy efficiency, peaking at 9.1× and 17× for the 13B model.

The development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has revolutionized artificial intelligence, but their deployment faces significant challenges due to the massive computational and memory requirements. Conventional LLM inference architectures suffer from high energy consumption and latency because of frequent data movement across memory hierarchies.

To address these challenges, we propose Ouroboros, a wafer-scale SRAM-based Computing-in-Memory (CIM) architecture designed specifically for efficient LLM inference. papers.title: Serving Compound Inference Systems on Datacenter GPUs
papers.authors: Sriram Devata, Rahul Sukthankar, Saurabh Adya
papers.abstract_en: Applications in emerging domains such as XR are being built as compound inference systems, where multiple ML models are composed in the form of a task graph to service each request. Serving these compound systems efficiently raises two questions: how to apportion end-to-end latency and accuracy budgets between different tasks in a compound inference system, and how to allocate resources effectively for different models with varying resource requirements. We present JigsawServe, the first serving framework that jointly optimizes for latency, accuracy, and cost in terms of GPU resources by adaptively choosing model variants and performing fine-grained resource allocation by spatially partitioning the GPUs for each task of a compound inference system. Analytical evaluation of a system with a large number of GPUs shows that JigsawServe can increase the maximum serviceable demand (in requests per second) by 11.3x when compared to the closest prior work. Our empirical evaluation shows that for a large range of scenarios, JigsawServe consumes only 43.3% of the available GPU resources while meeting accuracy SLOs with less than 0.6% latency SLO violations. All of the features in JigsawServe contribute to this high efficiency -- sacrificing any one feature of accuracy scaling, GPU spatial partitioning, or task-graph-informed resource budgeting significantly reduces efficiency.

papers.intro_en:
As machine learning (ML) inference becomes a dominant workload for datacenter resources, there is growing emphasis on maximizing the efficiency of inference serving systems. Compound inference systems are becoming increasingly important in many emerging domains such as multi-agent systems and extended reality (XR). Such systems compose multiple ML models, each performing a specific task, to provide complex functionalities, and present new challenges and opportunities for increased efficiency. This work focuses on efficient serving of compound inference systems on datacenter GPUs, where each request requires invoking a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of ML inference tasks, which are potentially dynamically determined.

We focus on two aspects that are unique to compound inference systems. First, we expect that any latency and accuracy Service Level Objectives (SLOs) are provided for the end-to-end compound inference system and need to be apportioned among the individual tasks. This affords new sources of flexibility for the serving system to choose among multiple model variants (with different latencies and accuracies) and GPU resource allocation for each task, when compared to a single task system with a given SLO constraint. Second, the ML model variants across the various tasks in a compound inference system have different resource requirements, motivating finer-grained heterogeneity in the optimal resource choice for the different tasks. Recent GPU hardware provide spatial partitioning mechanisms that enable fine-grained allocation of GPU resources. For example, NVIDIA GPUs provide spatial partitioning mechanisms such as Multi-Process Service (MPS) and Multi-Instance GPU (MIG).

We present JigsawServe, the first work to jointly optimize for latency, accuracy, and fine-grained cost (in terms of GPU resources required) by adaptively choosing model variants and allocating fine-grained spatial partitions of GPUs for each task of a compound inference system, while preserving end-to-end accuracy and latency SLOs.

There is a plethora of literature on increasing the efficiency of serving systems for requests with a single model inference, including systems that perform accuracy scaling and spatial partitioning. Compound inference systems have received relatively less attention. Table 1 summarizes key prior works that consider resource budgeting for compound inference systems, accuracy scaling through different model variants of a task, and/or spatial partitioning of GPU resources.

Specifically, we make the following contributions:

- 1. We introduce JigsawServe, a novel framework to jointly optimize latency, accuracy, and fine-grained cost for compound inference systems on datacenter GPUs. JigsawServe uniquely combines: (1) per-task accuracy scaling via choosing model variants, (2) GPU spatial partitioning, and (3) task-graph-informed latency and accuracy SLO budgeting.

- 2. Our analytical evaluation compares the various combinations of the features. We find that spatial partitioning (S) delivers the highest standalone gain in serving capacity for the same GPU resources (5.25× over Unopt), compared to accuracy scaling (A: 1.6×) and task-graph-informed budgeting (T: 1.1×). JigsawServe's full integration of the three features (A+S+T) achieves 21.6× capacity, surpassing combinations of S with A or T in S+A (12.1×) and S+T (7.8×).

- 3. We emphasize that no prior work has evaluated GPU spatial partitioning for compound inference systems. Systems without S show significantly lower serving capacity than any system with S. A+T, in particular, is closest to (and explores a larger search space than) prior work of Loki. We find that JigsawServe allows 11.3× higher capacity than A+T.

- 4. Our empirical evaluation compares the four top performing systems under a wide range of compound inference systems and workload demand conditions. JigsawServe shows the best overall performance, using just 43.3% of the available GPU resources on average, re
papers.ai_summary_en: JigsawServe addresses the problem of efficiently serving compound inference systems, where multiple ML models form a per-request task graph and must jointly satisfy end-to-end latency, accuracy, and GPU-cost budgets. Its key insight is to co-optimize model-variant selection for accuracy scaling with task-graph-informed latency/resource budgeting and fine-grained spatial partitioning of datacenter GPUs across tasks. Analytical and empirical results show up to 11.3× higher maximum serviceable demand than prior work, while using only 43.3% of GPU resources, meeting accuracy SLOs, and incurring less than 0.6% latency SLO violations.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对由多个 ML 模型组成任务图的复合推理系统，解决如何在端到端延迟、精度 SLO 和 GPU 成本之间进行联合预算分配与资源调度的问题。其提出 JigsawServe，通过自适应选择模型变体、对 GPU 进行空间分区的细粒度资源分配，并基于任务图进行资源预算，实现延迟、精度与成本的联合优化。实验显示，相比最接近工作可服务吞吐最高提升 11.3 倍，且在满足精度 SLO 的同时仅消耗约 43.3% GPU 资源、延迟 SLO 违约低于 0.6%。

papers.title: FlashInfer: Kernel Library for LLM Serving
papers.authors: Unknown
papers.abstract_en: Transformers, driven by attention mechanisms, form the foundation of large language models (LLMs). As these models scale up, efficient GPU attention kernels become essential for high-throughput and low-latency inference. Diverse LLM applications demand flexible and high-performance attention solutions. We present FlashInfer: a customizable and efficient attention engine for LLM serving. FlashInfer tackles KV-cache storage heterogeneity using block-sparse format and composable formats to optimize memory access and reduce redundancy. It also offers a customizable attention template, enabling adaptation to various settings through Just-In-Time (JIT) compilation. Additionally, FlashInfer's load-balanced scheduling algorithm adjusts to dynamism of user requests while maintaining compatibility with CUDAGraph which requires static configuration. FlashInfer have been integrated into leading LLM serving frameworks like SGLang, vLLM and MLC-Engine. Comprehensive kernel-level and end-to-end evaluations demonstrate FlashInfer's ability to significantly boost kernel performance across diverse inference scenarios: compared to state-of-the-art LLM serving solutions, FlashInfer achieve 29-69% inter-token-latency reduction compared to compiler backends for LLM serving benchmark, 28-30% latency reduction for long-context inference, and 13-17% speedup for LLM serving with parallel generation.
papers.abstract_cn: 变压器由注意力机制驱动，构成大型语言模型 (LLM) 的基础。随着这些模型的规模扩大，高效的 GPU 注意力内核对于高吞吐量和低延迟推理变得至关重要。各种 LLM 应用需要灵活、高性能的注意力解决方案。我们介绍 FlashInfer:一种可定制且高效的 LLM 服务注意力引擎。FlashInfer 使用块稀疏格式和可组合格式来解决 KV 缓存存储异构性问题，以优化内存访问并减少冗余。它还提供了一个可定制的注意力模板，允许通过即时 (JIT) 编译适应各种设置。此外，FlashInfer 的负载均衡调度算法可以根据用户请求的动态性进行调整，同时保持与需要静态配置的 CUDAGraph 的兼容性。FlashInfer 已集成到领先的 LLM 服务框架中，如 SGLang、vLLM 和 MLC-Engine。全面的内核级和端到端评估证明了 FlashInfer 在不同推理场景中显著提升内核性能的能力：与最先进的 LLM 服务解决方案相比，FlashInfer 在 LLM 服务基准的编译器后端方面实现了 29-69% 的令牌间延迟减少，在长上下文推理方面实现了 28-30% 的延迟减少，在并行生成的 LLM 服务方面实现了 13-17% 的加速。
papers.ai_summary_en: FlashInfer addresses the need for efficient, flexible GPU attention kernels in LLM serving, where heterogeneous KV-cache layouts, diverse inference workloads, and dynamic request batching limit performance. It introduces a block-sparse/composable KV-cache design, JIT-compilable customizable attention templates, and a load-balanced scheduler that adapts to request dynamism while remaining compatible with static CUDAGraph execution. Integrated into SGLang, vLLM, and MLC-Engine, FlashInfer achieves 29–69% inter-token latency reduction versus compiler backends, 28–30% lower long-context latency, and 13–17% speedup for parallel-generation serving.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文面向 LLM 推理服务中高吞吐、低延迟注意力内核的需求，解决 KV-cache 存储异构、请求动态变化以及多样推理场景难以统一优化的问题。FlashInfer 采用块稀疏与可组合格式优化内存访问，并通过 JIT 可定制注意力模板和兼容 CUDAGraph 的负载均衡调度提升灵活性。它已集成到 SGLang、vLLM 等主流框架，相比现有方案可显著降低 29–69% 的 token 间延迟，并在长上下文和并行生成场景分别带来约 28–30% 与 13–17% 的性能提升。

papers.title: LLMLingua: Prompt Compression for LLM Inference
papers.authors: Unknown
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have been applied in various applications due to their astonishing capabilities. With advancements in technologies such as chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting and in-context learning (ICL), the prompts fed to LLMs are becoming increasingly lengthy, even exceeding tens of thousands of tokens. To accelerate model inference and reduce cost, this paper presents LLMLingua, a coarse-to-fine prompt compression method that involves a budget controller to maintain semantic integrity under high compression ratios, a token-level iterative compression algorithm to better model the interdependence between compressed contents, and an instruction tuning based method for distribution alignment between language models. We conduct experiments and analysis over four datasets from different scenarios, i.e., GSM8K, BBH, ShareGPT, and Arxiv-March23; showing that the proposed approach yields state-of-the-art performance and allows for up to 20x compression with little performance loss.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型 (LLMs) 因其惊人的能力已被应用于各种应用中。随着思维链 (CoT) 提示和上下文学习 (ICL) 等技术的进步，传递给 LLMs 的提示变得越来越长，甚至超过数万个标记。为了加速模型推理和降低成本，本文提出了 LLMLingua，这是一种粗到细的提示压缩方法，它包括一个预算控制器以在高压缩比下保持语义完整性，一种标记级迭代压缩算法以更好地建模压缩内容之间的相互依赖关系，以及一种基于指令调优的语言模型之间的分布对齐方法。我们对来自不同场景的四个数据集 (即 GSM8K、BBH、ShareGPT 和 Arxiv-March23) 进行了实验和分析;结果表明，所提出的方法能够产生最先进的性能，并且能够在性能损失很小的情况下进行高达 20 倍的压缩。
papers.ai_summary_en: LLMLingua addresses the inference latency, cost, and KV-cache pressure caused by very long LLM prompts in chain-of-thought and in-context learning settings. It introduces a coarse-to-fine prompt compression framework using a budget controller for semantic preservation, token-level iterative compression to capture inter-token dependencies, and instruction-tuning-based distribution alignment between compressor and target LLMs. Experiments on GSM8K, BBH, ShareGPT, and Arxiv-March23 show state-of-the-art compression performance, enabling up to 20× prompt compression with minimal task degradation.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长提示（如思维链、上下文学习）导致的大模型推理成本高、速度慢问题，提出 LLMLingua 提示压缩方法，通过粗到细的压缩流程在减少输入长度的同时尽量保持语义完整。其核心包括预算控制器、token 级迭代压缩算法以及基于指令微调的分布对齐，以更好地建模压缩后内容之间的依赖关系。实验在 GSM8K、BBH、ShareGPT 和 Arxiv-March23 上表明，该方法可实现最高 20 倍压缩且性能损失很小，达到领先水平。

papers.title: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Block Diffusion Draft Trees
papers.authors: Liran Ringel
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language models by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple future tokens, which the target model then verifies in parallel. DFlash shows that a block diffusion drafter can generate an entire draft block in a single forward pass and achieve state-of-the-art speculative decoding performance. We introduce DDTree (Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that constructs a draft tree directly from the per-position distributions of a block diffusion drafter. Under a fixed node budget, DDTree uses a simple best-first heap algorithm to select the continuations that are most likely to match the target model. The resulting tree is verified efficiently in a single target model forward pass using an ancestor-only attention mask.
papers.abstract_cn: 推测解码通过使用轻量级草稿模型提议多个未来token来加速自回归语言模型，然后由目标模型并行验证。DFlash表明块扩散草稿模型可以在单次前向传播中生成整个草稿块并达到最先进的推测解码性能。我们提出DDTree（扩散草稿树），一种直接从块扩散草稿模型的逐位置分布构建草稿树的方法。在固定节点预算下，DDTree使用简单的最佳优先堆算法选择最可能匹配目标模型的延续。结果树使用仅祖先注意力掩码在单次目标模型前向传播中高效验证。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses speculative decoding for LLM serving by improving how a lightweight block-diffusion drafter allocates a fixed draft-node budget to maximize target-model acceptance. DDTree builds a draft tree directly from the drafter’s per-position distributions using a best-first heap search over likely continuations, then verifies the tree in one target-model forward pass with an ancestor-only attention mask. This enables more efficient parallel verification and stronger speculative decoding performance under constrained draft budgets.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对推测解码中如何在固定草稿节点预算下更高效地生成可被目标模型接受的草稿，提出基于块扩散草稿树的 DDTree 方法。其核心洞见是直接从块扩散 drafter 的各位置分布构建树状草稿，并用 best-first 堆算法选择最可能匹配目标模型的候选路径，再通过祖先注意力掩码在目标模型一次前向中完成验证。该方法提升了草稿利用率和验证效率，从而进一步加速大模型推理服务。

papers.title: Adaptive Bounded Self-Speculation with Layer-wise Confidence Calibration
papers.authors: Zhuofan Wen
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding has emerged as a promising approach to accelerate autoregressive inference in LLMs. Self-draft methods leverage the base LLM itself for speculation, but shallow layers often produce overconfident yet incorrect token predictions. We propose a novel self-draft framework that suppresses spurious confidence via layer-wise temperature annealing in early-exit decision and adaptively bounds speculation length based on token-wise decoding difficulty. By reprocessing hidden states of draft tokens in a unified parallel pass through deep layers, our method maintains exact output equivalence while maximizing computational efficiency. It requires no modifications to base LLM parameters and achieves up to 2.33x wall-time speedup. (ACL 2026 Findings)
papers.abstract_cn: 推测解码已成为加速LLM自回归推理的有前途的方法。自草稿方法利用基础LLM本身进行推测，但浅层经常产生过度自信却不正确的token预测。我们提出一种新型自草稿框架，通过早期退出决策中的逐层温度退火来抑制虚假置信度，并根据逐token解码难度自适应限制推测长度。通过统一的并行传播重新处理草稿token的隐藏状态，在保持精确输出等价性的同时最大化计算效率。无需修改基础LLM参数，实现最高2.33倍加速。（ACL 2026 Findings）
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient self-draft speculative decoding in LLM serving, where shallow-layer predictions are often overconfident and incorrect, limiting acceleration. It introduces adaptive bounded self-speculation with layer-wise confidence calibration, using temperature-annealed early-exit decisions, token-wise difficulty-based draft-length bounds, and a unified parallel pass that reprocesses draft hidden states through deeper layers. Without modifying base model parameters, the method preserves exact output equivalence while achieving up to 2.33× wall-time speedup.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对自投机解码中浅层早退预测过度自信、导致草稿质量下降的问题，提出一种自适应受限的自我推测框架。其核心是通过层间温度退火校准早退置信度，并根据逐 token 解码难度动态限制投机长度，同时用深层统一并行重处理保证输出完全等价。该方法无需修改基础模型参数，在 LLM 服务中最高可实现 2.33 倍端到端加速。

papers.title: PipeLive: Efficient Live In-place Pipeline Parallelism Reconfiguration for Dynamic LLM Serving
papers.authors: Xu Bai
papers.abstract_en: Pipeline parallelism (PP) is widely used to partition LLM layers across GPUs. However, existing systems rely on static PP configurations that fail to adapt to dynamic settings. PipeLive enables live in-place PP reconfiguration with minimal disruption. It introduces a redesigned KV cache layout together with a co-designed extension to PageAttention, forming a unified mechanism for live KV resizing. It further adopts an incremental KV patching mechanism, inspired by live VM migration, to synchronize KV states between source and target configurations. PipeLive achieves 2.5X reduction in TTFT without KV cache overflow, reduces reconfiguration overhead from seconds to under 10ms, and improves TTFT and TPOT by up to 54.7% and 14.7%.
papers.abstract_cn: 流水线并行广泛用于将LLM层分区到多个GPU上。然而现有系统依赖静态配置，无法适应动态环境。PipeLive实现最小干扰的实时就地PP重配置。它引入重新设计的KV缓存布局和PageAttention扩展，形成统一的实时KV调整机制。进一步采用增量KV补丁机制（灵感来自实时虚拟机迁移），在源和目标配置之间同步KV状态并识别安全切换点。PipeLive实现TTFT降低2.5倍而无KV缓存溢出，重配置开销从秒级降至10ms以下，TTFT和TPOT改善分别高达54.7%和14.7%。
papers.ai_summary_en: PipeLive solves the problem that LLM serving systems using pipeline parallelism rely on static configurations, making runtime adaptation expensive and disruptive. Its key insight is to treat pipeline reconfiguration like live migration: a redesigned KV-cache layout with a PageAttention extension enables live KV resizing, while incremental KV patching synchronizes state between source and target pipeline configurations. The system reduces reconfiguration overhead from seconds to under 10 ms, achieves a 2.5× TTFT reduction without KV-cache overflow, and improves TTFT and TPOT by up to 54.7% and 14.7%, respectively.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM服务中流水线并行配置静态化、难以适应动态负载与资源变化的问题，提出PipeLive以最小中断实现在线就地PP重配置。其核心是重新设计KV缓存布局并扩展PageAttention以支持统一在线KV尺寸调整，同时借鉴虚拟机热迁移的增量KV补丁机制同步源/目标配置状态。实验显示，该方法将重配置开销从秒级降至10ms以内，在无KV缓存溢出前提下将TTFT降低2.5倍，并分别最高提升TTFT和TPOT达54.7%与14.7%。

papers.title: Valve: Production Online-Offline Inference Colocation with Jointly-Bounded Preemption Latency and Rate
papers.authors: Fangyue Liu, Hua Liu, Xinyuan Lyu, Shuo Ai, Hao Liang, Lingpeng Chen, Ziqian Hu, Chong Zha, Xin Jin, Hanmei Luo, Peng Chen
papers.abstract_en: LLM inference powers latency-critical production services. Valve is a production-friendly colocation system that jointly bounds preemption latency and preemption rate. It enables sub-millisecond compute preemption at most once per online request, and rate-limited sub-layer memory reclamation via a GPU runtime combining channel-controlled compute isolation, page-fault-free memory reclamation, and dynamic memory reservation. Deployed on 8,054 GPUs in production, Valve improves cluster utilization by 34.6% (2,170 GPU save) with minimal online interference (<5% TTFT increase, <2% TPOT increase).
papers.abstract_cn: LLM推理驱动延迟关键的生产服务。Valve是生产友好的共位系统，联合限制抢占延迟和抢占率。实现在线请求最多一次亚毫秒计算抢占和速率限制子层内存回收。通过结合通道控制计算隔离、无页面故障内存回收和动态内存预留的GPU运行时。在8,054个GPU生产部署中，集群利用率提高34.6%（节省2,170个GPU），在线干扰极小（TTFT增加<5%，TPOT增加<2%）。
papers.ai_summary_en: Valve addresses the problem of colocating latency-critical online LLM inference with offline batch workloads on shared production GPUs while strictly limiting preemption-induced interference. Its key method is a GPU runtime that jointly bounds preemption latency and rate via sub-millisecond compute preemption at most once per online request, channel-controlled compute isolation, page-fault-free sub-layer memory reclamation, and dynamic memory reservation. Deployed on 8,054 GPUs, Valve improves cluster utilization by 34.6%, saving 2,170 GPUs, with minimal online impact: less than 5% TTFT increase and less than 2% TPOT increase.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM在线推理与离线任务混部时抢占延迟和抢占频率难以同时约束、易影响线上SLO的问题，提出了生产级混部系统Valve。其核心方法是通过GPU运行时实现亚毫秒级计算抢占且每个在线请求最多被抢占一次，并结合通道化计算隔离、无缺页显存回收和动态显存预留来限制内存回收频率。生产部署于8054块GPU后，集群利用率提升34.6%、节省2170块GPU，同时线上TTFT增加小于5%、TPOT增加小于2%。

papers.title: AsyncTLS: Efficient Generative LLM Inference with Asynchronous Two-level Sparse Attention
papers.authors: Yuxuan Hu, Jianchao Tan, Jiaqi Zhang, Wen Zan, Pingwei Sun, Yifan Lu, Yerui Sun, Yuchen Xie, Xunliang Cai, Jing Zhang
papers.abstract_en: Long-context inference in LLMs faces quadratic attention complexity and prohibitive KV cache memory. AsyncTLS proposes a hierarchical sparse attention system combining coarse-grained block filtering with fine-grained token selection to balance accuracy and efficiency, coupled with an asynchronous offloading engine that overlaps KV cache transfers with computation via temporal locality exploitation. Evaluated on Qwen3 and GLM-4.7-Flash across GQA and MLA architectures, achieves accuracy comparable to full attention while delivering 1.2x-10.0x operator speedups and 1.3x-4.7x end-to-end throughput improvements on 48k-96k contexts.
papers.abstract_cn: LLM长上下文推理面临二次注意力复杂度和KV缓存内存挑战。AsyncTLS提出分层稀疏注意力系统，结合粗粒度块过滤与细粒度token选择平衡精度和效率，配备异步卸载引擎通过时间局部性将KV缓存传输与计算重叠。在Qwen3和GLM-4.7-Flash上评估，精度可比全注意力同时实现1.2x-10.0x算子加速和1.3x-4.7x端到端吞吐提升（48k-96k上下文）。
papers.ai_summary_en: AsyncTLS addresses quadratic attention complexity and KV-cache memory pressure in long-context generative LLM inference. It combines two-level sparse attention—coarse-grained block filtering plus fine-grained token selection—with an asynchronous KV-cache offloading engine that overlaps cache transfers and computation by exploiting temporal locality. On Qwen3 and GLM-4.7-Flash across GQA and MLA architectures, it preserves near-full-attention accuracy on 48k–96k contexts while achieving 1.2–10.0× operator speedups and 1.3–4.7× end-to-end throughput improvements.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文生成式LLM推理中注意力计算二次复杂度和KV缓存内存开销过高的问题，提出AsyncTLS系统。其核心是两级稀疏注意力（粗粒度块过滤+细粒度token选择）与异步KV缓存卸载引擎，通过利用时间局部性实现数据传输与计算重叠。实验表明，在Qwen3和GLM-4.7-Flash等GQA/MLA架构上，该方法在48k–96k长上下文中保持接近全注意力的精度，同时取得1.2–10.0倍算子加速和1.3–4.7倍端到端吞吐提升。

papers.title: Self-Distillation for Multi-Token Prediction
papers.authors: Guoliang Zhao, Ruobing Xie, An Wang, Shuaipeng Li, Huaibing Xie, Xingwu Sun
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs scale up, inference efficiency becomes a critical bottleneck. Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) could accelerate LLM inference by predicting multiple future tokens in parallel. MTP-D proposes a simple yet effective self-distillation method with minimal additional training cost, boosting MTP head acceptance rates (+7.5%) while maximumly preserving main-head performance. A looped extension strategy enables effective and economical MTP head extension and further significant inference speedup to 1-head MTP (+220.4%).
papers.abstract_cn: 随着LLM规模增大，推理效率成为关键瓶颈。多token预测（MTP）可通过并行预测多个未来token加速推理。MTP-D提出简单有效的自蒸馏方法，额外训练成本极小，提升MTP头接受率（+7.5%）同时最大限度保留主头性能。循环扩展策略实现有效经济的MTP头扩展，进一步推理加速至1头MTP（+220.4%）。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses LLM inference latency by improving multi-token prediction (MTP), where auxiliary heads predict several future tokens in parallel but often suffer from low acceptance rates. The proposed MTP-D method uses lightweight self-distillation to train MTP heads from the main model while preserving primary output quality, and introduces a looped extension strategy to add more heads economically. Experiments show a +7.5% improvement in MTP-head acceptance and up to +220.4% inference speedup over single-head MTP.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型推理效率瓶颈，研究多 token 预测（MTP）中如何提升辅助预测头被接受率并尽量不损害主模型性能。其核心方法是 MTP-D：以低成本自蒸馏训练 MTP 头，并用循环扩展策略经济地增加 MTP 头数量。实验显示，MTP 头接受率提升约 7.5%，且相比单头 MTP 可进一步带来约 220.4% 的推理加速。

papers.title: The Diminishing Returns of Early-Exit Decoding in Modern LLMs
papers.authors: Rui Wei, Rui Du, Hanfei Yu, Devesh Tiwari, Jian Li, Zhaozhuo Xu, Hao Wang
papers.abstract_en: In LLM inference, early-exit stops computation at an intermediate layer once prediction is sufficiently confident. Recent LLMs adopt improved pretraining recipes and architectures that reduce layer redundancy, potentially limiting early-exit opportunities. We re-evaluate layer-wise early-exit in modern LLMs. Results show a diminishing trend in early-exit effectiveness across newer model generations. Dense transformers generally offer greater early-exit potential than MoE and SSM. Larger models (>20B parameters) and base pretrained models without specialized tuning tend to exhibit higher early-exit potential.
papers.abstract_cn: 在LLM推理中，早期退出在中间层一旦预测足够自信就停止计算。最近LLM采用改进的预训练方案和架构，减少层冗余，可能限制早期退出机会。我们重新评估现代LLM中的逐层早期退出。结果显示较新模型代际中早期退出有效性呈递减趋势。密集Transformer通常比MoE和SSM提供更大早期退出潜力。更大模型（>20B参数）和未经专门调优的基础预训练模型倾向展现更高早期退出潜力。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper revisits layer-wise early-exit decoding for LLM inference, asking whether modern pretraining and architectures with reduced layer redundancy still allow confident predictions to be produced before the final layer. Through an empirical re-evaluation across model generations and architectures, it shows that early-exit effectiveness is diminishing in newer models, with dense Transformers offering more exit potential than MoE and SSM variants. The main finding is that early exit remains more viable for large (>20B-parameter) base models without specialized tuning, but provides limited gains for recent tuned or efficiency-oriented LLMs.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对现代 LLM 推理服务中“早退解码”是否仍有效的问题，重新评估了逐层早退在新一代模型中的适用性。其核心洞见是，随着预训练配方和架构改进降低了层间冗余，早退收益呈现递减趋势，且其潜力与模型类型、规模和训练状态密切相关。结果显示，Dense Transformer 比 MoE 和 SSM 更具早退潜力，大于 20B 的模型以及未经专门微调的基础模型更适合早退加速。

papers.title: Speculative Speculative Decoding (SSD)
papers.authors: Tanishq Kumar, Tri Dao, Avner May
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive inference by using a fast draft model to predict upcoming tokens, then verifying them in parallel. However, speculative decoding itself relies on a sequential dependence between speculation and verification. SSD (Speculative Speculative Decoding) parallelizes these operations: while verification is ongoing, the draft model predicts likely verification outcomes and prepares speculations pre-emptively. If the actual outcome matches, a speculation is returned immediately, eliminating drafting overhead entirely. Saguaro, an optimized SSD algorithm, is on average 30% faster than optimized speculative decoding baselines and up to 5x faster than autoregressive decoding with open-source inference engines. (ICLR 2026)
papers.abstract_cn: 推测解码通过使用快速草稿模型预测后续token再并行验证来加速推理。但推测解码本身依赖推测和验证之间的顺序依赖关系。SSD（推测推测解码）将这些操作并行化：在验证进行时，草稿模型预测可能的验证结果并提前准备推测。如果实际结果在预测集合中，可立即返回推测，完全消除草稿开销。Saguaro是最优化的SSD算法，平均比优化的推测解码基线快30%，比开源推理引擎的自回归解码最多快5倍。（ICLR 2026）
papers.ai_summary_en: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference but remains bottlenecked by sequential dependence between drafting and verification. SSD parallelizes these stages by letting the draft model predict likely verification outcomes and pre-compute candidate continuations during verification, enabling immediate token return when predictions match; Saguaro is an optimized SSD algorithm. It achieves ~30% average speedup over strong speculative decoding baselines and up to 5× over autoregressive decoding in open-source serving engines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对推测解码中“草稿生成”和“验证”仍存在串行依赖、限制推理加速的问题，提出 Speculative Speculative Decoding（SSD），在验证进行的同时预先预测验证结果并提前准备后续草稿。其优化算法 Saguaro 可在预测结果与实际验证匹配时立即返回草稿，从而消除额外 drafting 开销。实验显示，Saguaro 平均比优化后的推测解码基线快 30%，在开源推理引擎上最高可达自回归解码的 5 倍加速。

papers.title: MAC-Attention: a Match-Amend-Complete Scheme for Fast and Accurate Attention Computation
papers.authors: Jinghan Yao, Sam Adé Jacobs, Walid Krichene, Masahiro Tanaka, Dhabaleswar K Panda
papers.abstract_en: Long-context decoding in LLMs is IO-bound: each token re-reads an ever-growing KV cache. Prior accelerations cut bytes via compression (lower fidelity) or selection/eviction (restricting accessibility), both degrading delayed recall. MAC-Attention is a fidelity- and access-preserving alternative that accelerates decoding by reusing prior attention computations for semantically similar recent queries. Match stage performs pre-RoPE L2 matching over a short local window; amend stage rectifies reused attention by recomputing a small band near the match boundary; complete stage fuses rectified results with fresh attention on the KV tail through a numerically stable merge. On match hit, compute and bandwidth complexity is constant regardless of context length. Reduces KV accesses by up to 99%, cuts latency by over 60% at 128K, achieves over 14.3x attention-phase speedups and up to 2.6x end-to-end.
papers.abstract_cn: LLM长上下文解码是IO受限的：每个token重新读取不断增长的KV缓存。先前加速通过压缩（降低保真度）或选择/驱逐（限制可访问性）减少字节，两者都损害延迟召回。MAC-Attention是保真度和可访问性保持的替代方案，通过为语义相似的近期查询重用先前的注意力计算来加速解码。匹配阶段在短局部窗口上执行预RoPE L2匹配；修正阶段通过重新计算匹配边界附近的小带区来纠正重用的注意力；完成阶段通过数值稳定的合并将纠正结果与KV尾部的新鲜注意力融合。匹配命中时，计算和带宽复杂度与上下文长度无关。KV访问减少最多99%，128K时延迟降低超过60%，注意力阶段加速超过14.3倍，端到端最多2.6倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: MAC-Attention addresses the IO bottleneck of long-context LLM decoding, where each new token must repeatedly read an expanding KV cache, without relying on lossy compression or token selection that harms delayed recall. Its Match-Amend-Complete scheme reuses prior attention results for semantically similar recent queries by performing pre-RoPE L2 matching over a local window, correcting a small boundary band, and numerically merging rectified outputs with fresh attention on the KV tail. This fidelity- and access-preserving approach achieves constant compute/bandwidth on match hits, reducing KV accesses by up to 99%, cutting 128K-context latency by over 60%, and yielding up to 14.3× attention-phase and 2.6× end-to-end speedups.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 解码中因反复读取不断增长的 KV cache 而导致的 IO 瓶颈，提出一种不牺牲保真度和访问范围的注意力加速方案。MAC-Attention 通过“匹配-修正-补全”机制复用近期语义相似查询的历史注意力计算：先在 pre-RoPE 空间做局部 L2 匹配，再对匹配边界附近少量区域重算修正，最后与 KV 尾部的新注意力进行数值稳定融合。实验显示，在命中情况下注意力计算和带宽开销可近似与上下文长度无关，KV 访问最多降低 99%，128K 上下文延迟降低超过 60%，注意力阶段加速超过 14.3 倍、端到端加速最高 2.6 倍。

papers.title: Flow-Controlled Scheduling for LLM Inference with Provable Stability Guarantees
papers.authors: Zhuolun Dong, Junyu Cao
papers.abstract_en: LLM inference faces a key challenge: decode lengths are unknown, so memory usage per request grows with generated tokens, potentially causing overflow and instability. We propose a simple flow-control framework that controls the rate at which prompts join the active set. We derive a necessary condition that any stable system must satisfy and establish sufficient conditions under which our algorithm provably achieves stability. Experiments show that compared to common strategies, our approach achieves higher token and request throughput, lower average and tail latency, and more stable KV cache utilization.
papers.abstract_cn: LLM推理面临关键挑战：解码长度未知，每个请求的内存使用随生成token增长，可能导致溢出和系统不稳定。我们提出简单的流控制框架，控制提示加入活跃集的速率。推导出任何稳定系统必须满足的必要条件，并建立算法可证明实现稳定性的充分条件。实验表明相比常用策略，我们的方法实现更高的token和请求吞吐量、更低的平均和尾延迟以及更稳定的KV缓存利用率。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses instability and KV-cache overflow in LLM inference caused by unknown decode lengths, where per-request memory grows as tokens are generated. It proposes a flow-controlled scheduling framework that regulates the admission rate of prompts into the active set, derives a necessary condition for system stability, and proves sufficient conditions under which the algorithm is stable. Experiments show that, compared with common baselines, the method improves token and request throughput while reducing average and tail latency and stabilizing KV-cache utilization.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM 推理中解码长度未知导致 KV cache 内存增长不可控、易引发系统溢出和不稳定的问题。其核心方法是提出一种流控调度框架，通过控制 prompt 进入活跃集合的速率来约束内存占用，并给出系统稳定的必要条件与该算法可证明稳定的充分条件。实验表明，相比常见调度策略，该方法能同时提升 token 和请求吞吐、降低平均与尾延迟，并使 KV cache 利用更稳定。

papers.title: SpecMoE: A Fast and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Inference via Self-Assisted Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Jehyeon Bang, Eunyeong Cho, Ranggi Hwang, Jinha Chung, Minsoo Rhu
papers.abstract_en: The MoE architecture selectively activates parameters to mitigate computational costs, but high memory requirements and sub-optimal parameter efficiency pose challenges. Although CPU-offloaded MoE inference systems have been proposed, they offer limited efficiency for large batch sizes. SpecMoE is a memory-efficient MoE inference system based on self-assisted speculative decoding. It demonstrates effectiveness of applying speculative decoding to MoE inference without requiring additional model training or fine-tuning. Improves inference throughput by up to 4.30x while significantly reducing bandwidth requirements of both memory and interconnect on memory-constrained systems. (DAC 2026)
papers.abstract_cn: MoE架构通过选择性激活参数减轻计算成本，但高内存需求和参数效率低下带来挑战。虽然已有CPU卸载MoE推理系统，但对大批次效率有限。SpecMoE是基于自辅助推测解码的内存高效MoE推理系统。展示了将推测解码应用于MoE推理的有效性，无需额外模型训练或微调。推理吞吐量提升最多4.30倍，同时显著降低内存受限系统上内存和互连的带宽需求。（DAC 2026）
papers.ai_summary_en: SpecMoE tackles the memory capacity and bandwidth bottlenecks that limit efficient MoE LLM serving, particularly in CPU-offloaded or memory-constrained systems. It introduces self-assisted speculative decoding for MoE inference, using the target model itself to generate speculative tokens and reduce costly expert parameter transfers without additional training or fine-tuning. The approach improves inference throughput by up to 4.30× while lowering memory and interconnect bandwidth requirements.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对MoE大模型推理中内存占用高、CPU卸载在大 batch 下效率不足的问题，提出SpecMoE系统。其核心思路是将自辅助投机解码引入MoE推理，在无需额外训练或微调的情况下提升解码效率。实验表明，该方法在内存受限系统上可将推理吞吐提升最高4.30倍，并显著降低内存与互连带宽需求。

papers.title: StreamServe: Adaptive Speculative Flows for Low-Latency Disaggregated LLM Serving
papers.authors: Satyam Kumar, Arpit Singh Gautam, Kailash Talreja, Saurabh Jha
papers.abstract_en: Efficient LLM serving must balance throughput and latency across diverse, bursty workloads. StreamServe is a disaggregated prefill decode serving architecture that combines metric-aware routing across compute lanes with adaptive speculative decoding that tunes speculation depth online from runtime signals. It comprises four components: StreamScheduler for request orchestration, FlowGuard for multi-signal routing, PipeServe Engine for disaggregated prefill-decode execution on multi-GPU, and SpecuStream for runtime adaptive speculation. Reduces latency by 11-18x relative to tensor-parallel vLLM baselines, reaching throughput up to 2235 tokens/second on summarization tasks.
papers.abstract_cn: 高效LLM服务必须在多样突发工作负载中平衡吞吐和延迟。StreamServe是解耦预填充解码服务架构，结合跨计算通道的指标感知路由和从运行时信号在线调整推测深度的自适应推测解码。包含四个组件：StreamScheduler请求编排、FlowGuard多信号路由、PipeServe Engine多GPU解耦执行、SpecuStream运行时自适应推测。相比张量并行vLLM基线延迟降低11-18倍，摘要任务吞吐达2235 token/s。
papers.ai_summary_en: StreamServe addresses low-latency LLM serving under bursty, heterogeneous workloads by disaggregating prefill and decode phases and dynamically routing requests across compute lanes. Its key insight is to combine metric-aware scheduling with online adaptive speculative decoding, using runtime signals to tune speculation depth while executing on multi-GPU pipelines. Experiments show 11–18× latency reductions over tensor-parallel vLLM baselines and throughput up to 2235 tokens/s on summarization tasks.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM 服务在突发、多样负载下难以同时兼顾低延迟与高吞吐的问题，尤其是预填充/解码阶段资源竞争和固定投机解码难以适应动态运行状态的挑战。其核心方法是提出 StreamServe：采用解耦的预填充-解码多 GPU 服务架构，并结合指标感知路由与可根据运行时信号在线调整投机深度的自适应投机解码。实验显示，该方法相较张量并行 vLLM 基线将延迟降低 11–18 倍，在摘要任务上可达最高 2235 tokens/秒的吞吐。

papers.title: TALON: Confidence-Aware Speculative Decoding with Adaptive Token Trees
papers.authors: Tianyu Liu, Qitan Lv, Yuhao Shen, Xiao Sun, Xiaoyan Sun
papers.abstract_en: Recent speculative decoding shifted from sequential chain-based drafting to tree-structured generation, but existing tree-based methods build fixed-width, fixed-depth draft trees that fail to adapt to varying token difficulty. TALON is a training-free, budget-driven adaptive tree expansion framework that can be plugged into existing tree-based methods. It constructs the draft tree iteratively until a fixed token budget is met, using a hybrid expansion strategy that adaptively allocates the node budget to each layer. This naturally shapes the tree into deep-and-narrow for deterministic contexts and shallow-and-wide for uncertain branches. Across 5 models and 6 datasets, TALON consistently outperforms EAGLE-3, achieving up to 5.16x end-to-end speedup over autoregressive decoding.
papers.abstract_cn: 推测解码从顺序链式草稿转向树结构生成，但现有树方法构建固定宽深草稿树，无法适应token难度变化。TALON是免训练的预算驱动自适应树扩展框架，可插入现有树方法。迭代构建草稿树直到固定token预算，使用混合扩展策略自适应分配每层节点预算。自然形成确定性上下文的深窄树和不确定分支的浅宽树。5模型6数据集上一致超越EAGLE-3，自回归解码最高5.16倍端到端加速。
papers.ai_summary_en: TALON addresses the inefficiency of fixed-shape tree-based speculative decoding, which cannot adapt draft structure to varying token uncertainty. It introduces a training-free, budget-driven adaptive tree expansion that iteratively allocates node budget across layers, producing deep-narrow trees for deterministic contexts and shallow-wide trees for uncertain branches. Across 5 models and 6 datasets, it consistently outperforms EAGLE-3 and achieves up to 5.16× end-to-end speedup over autoregressive decoding.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对树结构投机解码中固定宽度/深度草稿树难以适应不同 token 难度的问题，提出 TALON：一种无需训练、按固定预算自适应扩展 token 树的框架。其核心洞见是根据生成不确定性动态分配各层节点预算，使确定性上下文形成“深而窄”的树、不确定分支形成“浅而宽”的树。实验显示，TALON 在 5 个模型和 6 个数据集上稳定优于 EAGLE-3，相对自回归解码最高实现 5.16 倍端到端加速。

papers.title: StructKV: Preserving the Structural Skeleton for Scalable Long-Context Inference
papers.authors: Zhirui Chen
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs scale to support context windows exceeding one million tokens, KV cache linear growth imposes severe memory and bandwidth bottlenecks. Existing compression approaches prioritize tokens based on local saliency metrics but rely on local saliency snapshots at a specific layer, systematically discarding tokens that act as global information hubs but appear temporarily dormant at the pruning layer. StructKV is a structure-aware KV cache compression framework introducing three innovations: Global In-Degree Centrality aggregates attention patterns across network depth to identify global information hubs; Dynamic Pivot Detection uses information-theoretic metrics to adaptively locate the optimal compression layer; Structural Propagation and Decoupling separates computational budget from memory storage budget. (ACL 2026 Findings)
papers.abstract_cn: LLM扩展到百万token上下文窗口时，KV缓存线性增长造成严重内存和带宽瓶颈。现有压缩方法基于局部显著性优先排序token，但在特定层依赖局部显著性快照，系统性丢弃作为全局信息枢纽但在修剪层暂时休眠的token。StructKV是结构感知KV缓存压缩框架：全局入度中心性跨网络深度聚合注意力模式识别全局信息枢纽；动态枢纽检测用信息论指标自适应定位最优压缩层；结构传播与解耦分离计算预算与内存存储预算。（ACL 2026 Findings）
papers.ai_summary_en: StructKV tackles the KV-cache memory and bandwidth bottleneck in million-token LLM inference, where local-saliency pruning can discard globally important but temporarily dormant hub tokens. It proposes a structure-aware compression framework using cross-layer global in-degree centrality, information-theoretic dynamic pivot detection for selecting the compression layer, and structural propagation decoupled from storage to separate compute and memory budgets. By preserving a structural skeleton of the cache, StructKV enables more scalable long-context serving with improved robustness over purely local pruning methods.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对超长上下文LLM推理中KV缓存线性增长导致的内存与带宽瓶颈，以及现有局部显著性压缩容易误删“全局信息枢纽”token的问题。StructKV提出结构感知KV缓存压缩，通过跨层注意力全局入度中心性识别关键token、用信息论指标动态选择压缩层，并将计算预算与存储预算解耦。该方法保留注意力结构骨架，为百万级上下文推理提供了更可扩展的KV缓存压缩思路。
