papers.title: EchoKV: Efficient KV Cache Compression via Similarity-Based Reconstruction
papers.authors: Yixuan Wang, Shiyu Ji, Yijun Liu, Qingfu Zhu, Wanxiang Che
papers.abstract_en: KV cache memory demand poses a significant bottleneck for LLMs in long-context applications. Existing low-rank compression methods rely on irreversible parameter transformations, sacrificing flexibility to switch back to full-precision inference when memory is abundant. EchoKV is a flexible KV cache compression scheme enabling on-demand transitions between standard and compressed inference. Unlike traditional compression-decompression paradigms, EchoKV utilizes a lightweight network to reconstruct residual KV components from a partial subset, leveraging intrinsic inter-layer and intra-layer similarities among attention heads. A two-stage fine-tuning strategy allows rapid low-cost training (~1 A100 GPU-hour for a 7B model). On LongBench and RULER, EchoKV consistently outperforms existing methods across various compression ratios while maintaining high throughput for short-context scenarios.
papers.abstract_cn: KV缓存内存需求是LLM长上下文应用的重要瓶颈。现有低秩压缩方法依赖不可逆参数变换，牺牲在内存充足时切换回全精度推理的灵活性。EchoKV是灵活的KV缓存压缩方案，实现标准和压缩推理之间的按需切换。利用轻量网络从部分子集重建残余KV分量，利用注意力头间层内和层间固有相似性。两阶段微调策略实现快速低成本训练（7B模型约1 A100 GPU小时）。在LongBench和RULER上，EchoKV在各种压缩比下一致超越现有方法，同时保持短上下文场景的高吞吐。
papers.ai_summary_en: EchoKV addresses the KV-cache memory bottleneck in long-context LLM serving, where prior low-rank compressors irreversibly transform parameters and cannot flexibly revert to full-precision inference. It stores only a subset of KV components and uses a lightweight network, trained with a cheap two-stage fine-tuning procedure, to reconstruct residual KV entries by exploiting inter-layer and intra-layer attention-head similarities. Experiments on LongBench and RULER show improved accuracy across compression ratios while preserving high short-context throughput and enabling on-demand switching between compressed and standard inference.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV cache 内存占用过高、且现有低秩压缩难以灵活恢复全精度推理的问题。EchoKV 利用注意力头在层间和层内的相似性，通过轻量网络从部分 KV 分量重建残差 KV，实现可按需切换的标准/压缩推理，并采用两阶段微调降低训练成本。实验表明，其在 LongBench 和 RULER 上多种压缩比下优于现有方法，同时在短上下文场景仍保持较高吞吐。

papers.title: RouterWise: Joint Resource Allocation and Routing for Latency-Aware Multi-Model LLM Serving
papers.authors: Hossein Hosseini Kasnavieh, Christopher Leckie, Adel N. Toosi
papers.abstract_en: Multi-model LLM routing has emerged as an effective approach for reducing serving cost and latency while maintaining output quality. However, prior routing methods typically assume each model has fixed latency. In real deployments, multiple models often share limited GPU resources, and a model's latency depends strongly on both its allocated resources and the request load induced by the routing policy. Consequently, routing and resource allocation are tightly coupled. RouterWise formalizes this as a constrained joint optimization over deployment setup and routing fractions, combining a dual-price formulation for score-maximizing routing with setup-specific latency models derived from system profiling. Results show that achievable output-quality score can vary by up to 87% across retained setups on the same GPU cluster.
papers.abstract_cn: 多模型LLM路由已成为降低服务成本和延迟同时保持输出质量的有效方法。但先前路由方法假设每个模型有固定延迟，这在实际部署中不准确：多个模型往往共享有限的GPU资源，模型的延迟很大程度上取决于其分配资源和路由策略引起的请求负载。路由和资源分配紧密耦合。RouterWise将此问题形式化为部署设置和路由比例的约束联合优化，结合双价格公式进行分数最大化路由和基于系统分析的设置特定延迟模型。结果显示，在同一GPU集群上，可实现的输出质量分数在不同设置间变化高达87%。
papers.ai_summary_en: RouterWise addresses latency-aware multi-model LLM serving, where routing decisions and GPU resource allocation are tightly coupled because model latency depends on allocated resources and routing-induced load. It formulates a constrained joint optimization over deployment configurations and routing fractions, combining dual-price score-maximizing routing with profiling-based latency models for each setup. Results show that achievable output-quality scores can vary by up to 87% across feasible setups on the same GPU cluster, demonstrating the need for co-optimizing routing and resource allocation.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多模型 LLM 服务中路由策略与 GPU 资源分配相互耦合、且模型延迟会随资源分配和请求负载变化的问题展开研究。其核心方法是提出 RouterWise，将部署配置与路由比例建模为带约束的联合优化问题，并结合双价格路由机制和基于系统剖析的设置相关延迟模型进行求解。实验表明，在同一 GPU 集群上，不同部署/路由方案可带来最高 87% 的输出质量差异，说明延迟感知的联合优化对多模型服务至关重要。

papers.title: StepCache: Step-Level Reuse with Lightweight Verification and Selective Patching for LLM Serving
papers.authors: Azam Nouri
papers.abstract_en: StepCache addresses LLM serving workloads where repeated requests share common solution structure but differ in localized constraints. Prior caching approaches reuse either full responses (semantic caching) or model-internal KV/prefix states, which are respectively brittle under partial changes or tightly coupled to specific backends. StepCache is a backend-agnostic step-level reuse layer that segments outputs into ordered steps, retrieves the best-matching cached request, verifies steps using lightweight task-aware checks, and regenerates only failing regions via selective patching. It supports strict structured-output enforcement for JSON, including single-step extraction and required-key constraints. In perturbation-heavy micro-benchmarks, StepCache reduces mean latency from 2.13s to 0.67s, median latency from 2.42s to 0.01s, and improves end-to-end correctness from 72.5% to 100%. 79.7% of requests take the reuse-only fast path.
papers.abstract_cn: StepCache处理LLM服务中重复请求共享解决方案结构但局部约束不同的场景。先前缓存方法要么重用完整响应（语义缓存），要么重用模型内部KV/前缀状态，前者在部分变更下脆弱，后者与特定后端紧密耦合。StepCache是后端无关的步骤级重用层，将输出分段为有序步骤，检索最佳匹配的缓存请求，使用轻量任务感知检查验证步骤，并通过选择性补丁仅重新生成失败区域。支持JSON的严格结构化输出强制执行。在扰动密集的微基准测试中，StepCache将平均延迟从2.13秒降至0.67秒，中位延迟从2.42秒降至0.01秒，端到端正确性从72.5%提升至100%。79.7%的请求走重用快速路径。
papers.ai_summary_en: StepCache targets LLM serving workloads where repeated requests share common solution structure but differ in localized constraints, a setting where full-response semantic caches are brittle and KV/prefix caches are backend-coupled. It introduces a backend-agnostic step-level reuse layer that segments outputs into ordered steps, retrieves the best-matching cached request, verifies steps with lightweight task-aware checks including JSON constraints, and selectively regenerates only failing regions. On perturbation-heavy micro-benchmarks, StepCache reduces mean latency from 2.13s to 0.67s and median latency to 0.01s while improving end-to-end correctness from 72.5% to 100%, with 79.7% of requests using the reuse-only fast path.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM 服务中重复请求结构相似但局部约束不同、而现有全响应缓存或 KV/prefix 复用易失效或强绑定后端的问题，提出 StepCache。其核心是后端无关的步骤级复用层：将输出拆为有序步骤，检索最匹配缓存，通过轻量任务感知校验，并仅对失败步骤进行选择性重生成，同时支持 JSON 等结构化约束。实验显示，在高扰动负载下平均延迟从 2.13s 降至 0.67s、中位延迟从 2.42s 降至 0.01s，端到端正确率从 72.5% 提升至 100%，且 79.7% 请求可走纯复用快路径。

papers.title: Chimera: Latency- and Performance-Aware Multi-agent Serving for Heterogeneous LLMs
papers.authors: Kangqi Ni, Wenyue Hua, Xiaoxiang Shi, Jiang Guo, Shiyu Chang, Tianlong Chen
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent applications execute complex tasks as multi-stage workflows where each stage is an LLM call. Existing LLM serving systems largely assume homogeneous clusters with identical model replicas, overlooking the potential of heterogeneous deployments where models of different sizes enable finer latency-performance trade-offs. Chimera is a predictive scheduling system for multi-agent workflow serving on heterogeneous LLM clusters. It applies semantic routing to estimate per-model confidence scores, predicts total remaining output length, and estimates per-model congestion using in-flight predicted token volumes for load balancing. Evaluated on code generation and math reasoning workflows, Chimera traces the best latency-performance frontier, reducing end-to-end latency by 1.2-2.4x and improving task performance by 8.0-9.5 percentage points over competitive baselines including vLLM.
papers.abstract_cn: 多智能体应用将复杂任务作为多阶段工作流执行，每个阶段是一个LLM调用。现有LLM服务系统大多假设同构集群（相同模型副本），忽略了异构部署的潜力——不同大小和能力模型可以实现更精细的延迟-性能权衡。Chimera是异构LLM集群上多智能体工作流服务的预测调度系统。应用语义路由估计每个模型的置信度分数，预测工作流总剩余输出长度，并使用在途预测token量估计每模型拥塞以进行负载均衡。在代码生成和数学推理工作流上评估，Chimera追踪最佳延迟-性能前沿，端到端延迟降低1.2-2.4倍，任务性能比vLLM等基线改善8.0-9.5个百分点。
papers.ai_summary_en: Chimera addresses latency–performance trade-offs in multi-agent LLM workflow serving on heterogeneous clusters, where existing systems typically assume identical model replicas. It introduces predictive scheduling that combines semantic routing with per-model confidence estimation, remaining output-length prediction, and congestion-aware load balancing based on in-flight predicted token volumes. Evaluations on code generation and math reasoning workflows show that Chimera traces a superior latency–performance frontier, reducing end-to-end latency by 1.2–2.4× and improving task performance by 8.0–9.5 percentage points over baselines such as vLLM.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多智能体LLM工作流服务中现有系统多假设同构模型副本、难以在异构集群下实现细粒度延迟—性能权衡的问题。Chimera提出预测式调度，通过语义路由估计各模型置信度、预测剩余输出长度，并利用在途预测token量估计拥塞以实现负载均衡。实验显示，其在代码生成与数学推理工作流上取得更优延迟—性能前沿，相比vLLM等基线将端到端延迟降低1.2–2.4倍，并提升任务性能8.0–9.5个百分点。

papers.title: SMART: When is it Actually Worth Expanding a Speculative Tree?
papers.authors: Lifu Wang, Pan Zhou
papers.abstract_en: Tree-based speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by verifying a branching tree of draft tokens in a single target-model forward pass. However, existing methods prioritize maximizing token-level likelihood or accepted tokens while ignoring a critical efficiency paradox: computational overhead of drafting and verifying big trees can grow super-linearly, leading to negative wall-clock speedup when batch sizes increase or hardware saturation limits are reached. SMART is a system-aware marginal analysis framework for runtime tree construction. It reformulates tree expansion as a hardware-aware optimization problem directly maximizing end-to-end speedup. By applying a principled marginal benefit-cost rule at inference time, SMART expands a node only when its marginal benefit-cost ratio exceeds the tree-level speedup. SMART is training-free and plug-and-play for existing frameworks like MSD and EAGLE. It delivers average additional speedup of 20.0% for MLLMs and 15.4% for LLMs across compute-bound batching regimes.
papers.abstract_cn: 基于树的投机解码通过在单次目标模型前向传播中验证分支草稿token树来加速自回归生成。但现有方法优先最大化token级似然或接受token数，忽略了关键的效率悖论：草拟和验证大树的计算开销可能超线性增长，导致批次增大或硬件饱和时出现负墙钟加速。SMART是运行时树构建的系统感知边际分析框架。将树扩展重新表述为直接最大化端到端加速的硬件感知优化问题。在推理时应用边际收益-成本规则，仅当边际收益-成本比超过树级加速时才扩展节点。SMART无需训练，可作为MSD和EAGLE等框架的即插即用控制器。在计算受限批次场景下，MLLM平均额外加速20.0%，LLM平均额外加速15.4%。
papers.ai_summary_en: SMART addresses the systems inefficiency in tree-based speculative decoding where expanding draft trees can incur super-linear drafting and verification overhead, causing negative wall-clock speedup under larger batches or hardware saturation. It formulates runtime tree construction as a training-free, hardware-aware marginal optimization that expands a node only when its marginal benefit-cost ratio exceeds the current tree-level speedup, making it plug-and-play for frameworks such as MSD and EAGLE. Experiments show average additional speedups of 20.0% for MLLMs and 15.4% for LLMs in compute-bound batching regimes.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对树式投机解码中盲目扩大草稿树会导致验证开销超线性增长、甚至降低实际墙钟加速的问题，SMART 提出一种系统感知的边际分析框架，将树扩展建模为硬件感知、直接优化端到端加速的运行时决策。其核心洞见是只有当节点扩展的边际收益-成本比超过当前树级加速比时才值得扩展，该方法无需训练并可即插即用于 MSD、EAGLE 等框架。实验显示，在计算受限的批处理场景下，SMART 可为多模态大模型和语言模型分别带来平均 20.0% 和 15.4% 的额外加速。

papers.title: CALVO: Improve Serving Efficiency for LLM Inferences with Intense Network Demands
papers.authors: Weiye Wang, Chen Chen, Junxue Zhang, Zhusheng Wang, Hui Yuan, Zixuan Guan, Xiaolong Zheng, Qizhen Weng, Yin Chen, Minyi Guo
papers.abstract_en: Distributed prefix caching has become a core technique for efficient LLM serving. However, for long-context requests with high cache hit ratios, retrieving reusable KVCache blocks from remote servers has emerged as a new performance bottleneck. Such network-intensive LLM inference is expected to become increasingly common as agentic AI workloads grow. Existing LLM inference engines remain compute-centric: they treat KVCache loading as a subordinate phase to GPU execution and fail to account for its delay explicitly during scheduling. CALVO is an LLM serving engine that treats KVCache loading as a first-class concern. It decouples KVCache loading and GPU computation into independently managed, asynchronously progressing stages, enabling better utilization of network, PCIe, and computation resources. CALVO incorporates KVCache loading delay as an explicit component of per-request service cost, achieving up to 61.67% higher SLO attainment than the baseline.
papers.abstract_cn: 分布式前缀缓存已成为高效LLM服务的核心技术。但对于长上下文请求的高缓存命中比，从远程服务器检索可重用KVCache块已成为新的性能瓶颈。随着智能体AI工作负载增长，这种网络密集型LLM推理将越来越常见。现有LLM推理引擎仍以计算为中心：将KVCache加载作为GPU执行的附属阶段，未在调度中显式考虑其延迟。CALVO是将KVCache加载作为首要关注的LLM服务引擎。将KVCache加载和GPU计算解耦为独立管理的异步推进阶段，更好利用网络、PCIe和计算资源。将KVCache加载延迟作为每请求服务成本的显式组成部分，SLO达成率比基线高61.67%。
papers.ai_summary_en: CALVO addresses the serving bottleneck in long-context, prefix-cache-heavy LLM inference, where retrieving reusable KV-cache blocks from remote servers becomes a network-intensive delay ignored by compute-centric schedulers. It treats KV-cache loading as a first-class stage by decoupling it from GPU computation, managing asynchronous loading and execution, and explicitly incorporating loading delay into per-request service cost to better utilize network, PCIe, and compute resources. This scheduling approach improves SLO attainment by up to 61.67% over baselines, particularly for agentic workloads with high cache reuse.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对长上下文、高缓存命中场景下分布式前缀缓存带来的远程 KVCache 加载网络瓶颈，指出传统以 GPU 计算为中心的推理调度忽视了 KVCache 加载延迟。  
CALVO 将 KVCache 加载提升为一等调度对象，将其与 GPU 计算解耦为可独立管理、异步执行的阶段，并把加载延迟显式纳入每请求服务成本。  
实验表明，该方法能更好利用网络、PCIe 和计算资源，使 SLO 达成率较基线最高提升 61.67%。

papers.title: Robust Length Prediction: A Perspective from Heavy-Tailed Prompt-Conditioned Distributions
papers.authors: Jing Wang, Yu-Yang Qian, Ke Xue, Chao Qian, Peng Zhao, Zhi-Hua Zhou
papers.abstract_en: Output-length prediction is important for efficient LLM serving, as it directly affects batching, memory reservation, and scheduling. Most existing methods use a one-shot sampled length as the label, implicitly treating each prompt as having one true target length. This is unreliable: even under a fixed model and decoding setup, the same prompt induces a prompt-conditioned output length distribution, not a deterministic scalar, and this distribution exhibits heavy-tailed behavior. Robust Length Prediction casts length prediction as robust estimation from heavy-tailed prompt-conditioned length distributions. It proposes ProD methods, which construct training targets from multiple independent generations of the same prompt. ProD-M uses a median-based target for robust point prediction; ProD-D uses a distributional target preserving prompt-conditioned uncertainty. Experiments across diverse scenarios show consistent gains in prediction quality.
papers.abstract_cn: 输出长度预测对高效LLM服务很重要，直接影响批处理、内存预留和调度。大多数现有方法使用一次性采样长度作为标签，隐含地将每个提示视为有一个真实目标长度。这是不可靠的：即使在固定模型和解码设置下，同一提示诱导的是提示条件输出长度分布，而非确定性标量，且该分布表现出重尾行为。鲁棒长度预测将长度预测重新表述为重尾提示条件长度分布的鲁棒估计。提出ProD方法，从同一提示的多次独立生成构建训练目标。ProD-M使用基于中位数的目标进行鲁棒点预测；ProD-D使用分布目标保留提示条件不确定性。在各种场景下实验显示预测质量的持续提升。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses unreliable output-length prediction for LLM serving, where fixed prompts induce heavy-tailed stochastic length distributions rather than deterministic labels. It proposes ProD, a robust estimation framework that builds training targets from multiple independent generations per prompt: ProD-M uses median targets for point prediction, while ProD-D learns distributional targets capturing prompt-conditioned uncertainty. Experiments across serving scenarios show consistent improvements in prediction quality, benefiting batching, memory reservation, and scheduling.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM 服务中输出长度预测将同一 prompt 的长度视为确定标量、忽视其重尾随机分布的问题。其核心方法 ProD 将长度预测建模为 prompt 条件下重尾分布的鲁棒估计，并通过同一 prompt 多次生成构造训练目标：ProD-M 用中位数做鲁棒点预测，ProD-D 保留分布不确定性。实验表明，该方法在多种场景下持续提升长度预测质量，有助于改进批处理、内存预留和调度效率。

papers.title: Calibrated Speculative Decoding: Frequency-Guided Candidate Selection for Efficient Inference
papers.authors: Xuwen Zhou, Fangxin Liu, Chao Wang, Xiao Zheng, Hao Zheng, Min He, Li Jiang, Haibing Guan
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by letting draft tokens bypass full verification, but conventional frameworks suffer from frequent false rejections, particularly when draft models produce semantically correct but lexically divergent outputs. In this paper, we present Calibrated Speculative Decoding (CSD), a training-free framework that recovers valid tokens discarded by standard verification. Guided by the principle of "Frequency-Guided Candidate Selection and Probability-Guarded Acceptance," CSD incorporates two lightweight modules: Online Correction Memory, which aggregates historical rejections to propose recurring divergence patterns as rescue candidates, and Semantic Consistency Gating, which verifies candidate admissibility using probability ratios instead of exact token matching. Our evaluation across diverse large language models demonstrates that CSD outperforms existing methods, achieving a peak throughput speedup of 2.33x. CSD preserves model accuracy across all tasks while further boosting performance on complex reasoning datasets. These results establish CSD as a highly effective, lightweight solution for practical LLM deployments.
papers.abstract_cn: 投机解码通过让草稿token绕过完整验证来加速自回归生成，但传统框架经常遭受假拒绝，尤其是当草稿模型产生语义正确但词汇不同的输出时。本文提出校准投机解码(CSD)，一个无需训练的框架，用于恢复被标准验证丢弃的有效token。遵循"频率引导候选选择与概率保护接受"原则，CSD包含两个轻量模块：在线校正记忆，聚合历史拒绝以提出重复分歧模式作为救援候选；语义一致性门控，使用概率比而非精确token匹配验证候选可接受性。跨多种大语言模型的评估表明CSD优于现有方法，峰值吞吐量加速2.33倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses false rejections in speculative decoding, especially when draft tokens are semantically valid but lexically divergent from the target model’s distribution. It proposes Calibrated Speculative Decoding, a training-free framework that uses an Online Correction Memory to recover recurring rejected candidates and Semantic Consistency Gating to accept them via probability-ratio checks rather than exact token matching. Experiments across LLMs show up to 2.33× throughput speedup while preserving accuracy and even improving performance on complex reasoning datasets.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对投机解码中草稿 token 语义正确但词汇不一致而被标准验证误拒、从而限制加速的问题，提出免训练框架 Calibrated Speculative Decoding。其核心洞见是“频率引导候选选择 + 概率保护接受”，通过在线纠偏记忆复用历史拒绝模式，并用概率比率而非精确匹配进行语义一致性门控。实验显示，该方法在多个大模型上实现最高 2.33 倍吞吐加速，同时保持模型精度，并在复杂推理任务上进一步提升表现。

papers.title: YOCO++: Enhancing YOCO with KV Residual Connections for Efficient LLM Inference
papers.authors: You Wu, Ziheng Chen, Yizhen Zhang, Haoyi Wu, Chengting Yu, Yuchi Xu, Wenbo Su, Bo Zheng, Kewei Tu
papers.abstract_en: Cross-layer key-value (KV) compression has been found to be effective in efficient inference of large language models (LLMs). Although they reduce the memory consumption of the KV cache, such methods usually introduce non-negligible performance degradation. In this work, we aim to enhance the performance of YOCO, a cross-layer KV compression method that shares the KVs of the middle layer with the top-half layers. We propose YOCO++, an enhanced YOCO that incorporates a weighted residual connection between the KVs of each bottom-half layer and the bottom layer. Compared to YOCO, YOCO++ increases model capacity while maintaining the same training and inference efficiency. Our experiments show that YOCO++ achieves state-of-the-art performance among the cross-layer KV compression methods at a 50% KV cache compression rate, outperforming the standard Transformer.
papers.abstract_cn: 跨层KV压缩已被证明在大语言模型高效推理中有效。虽然这些方法减少了KV缓存的内存消耗，但通常引入不可忽视的性能退化。本文旨在增强YOCO的性能——一种将中间层KV与上半层共享的跨层KV压缩方法。我们提出YOCO++，在每个下半层和底层KV之间引入加权残差连接的增强版YOCO。相比YOCO，YOCO++增加了模型容量同时保持相同的训练和推理效率。实验表明YOCO++在50%KV缓存压缩率下达到跨层KV压缩方法中最优性能，甚至超越标准Transformer。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses performance degradation in LLM inference caused by cross-layer KV-cache compression, focusing on YOCO, which shares middle-layer keys/values with upper layers to halve KV memory. YOCO++ improves this by adding weighted KV residual connections from each bottom-half layer to the bottom layer, increasing representational capacity while preserving YOCO’s training and inference efficiency. At a 50% KV-cache compression rate, it achieves state-of-the-art results among cross-layer KV compression methods and even outperforms a standard Transformer.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对跨层 KV 缓存压缩在降低显存占用时带来性能下降的问题，改进了 YOCO 这一中层 KV 共享方法。其核心做法是在每个下半层的 KV 与底层 KV 之间引入加权残差连接，形成 YOCO++，在保持训练和推理效率的同时提升模型容量。实验显示，在 50% KV 缓存压缩率下，YOCO++ 在跨层 KV 压缩方法中达到 SOTA，并优于标准 Transformer。

papers.title: ToolSpec: Accelerating Tool Calling via Schema-Aware and Retrieval-Augmented Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Heming Xia, Yongqi Li, Cunxiao Du, Mingbo Song, Wenjie Li
papers.abstract_en: Tool calling has greatly expanded the practical utility of large language models (LLMs) by enabling them to interact with external applications. As LLM capabilities advance, effective tool use increasingly involves multi-step, multi-turn interactions to solve complex tasks. However, the resulting growth in tool interactions incurs substantial latency, posing a key challenge for real-time LLM serving. Through empirical analysis, we find that tool-calling traces are highly structured, conform to constrained schemas, and often exhibit recurring invocation patterns. Motivated by this, we propose ToolSpec, a schema-aware, retrieval-augmented speculative decoding method for accelerating tool calling. ToolSpec exploits predefined tool schemas to generate accurate drafts, using a finite-state machine to alternate between deterministic schema token filling and speculative generation for variable fields. In addition, ToolSpec retrieves similar historical tool invocations and reuses them as drafts to further improve efficiency. ToolSpec presents a plug-and-play solution that can be seamlessly integrated into existing LLM workflows. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that ToolSpec achieves up to a 4.2x speedup, substantially outperforming existing training-free speculative decoding methods.
papers.abstract_cn: 工具调用极大扩展了大语言模型的实用价值，使其能与外部应用交互。随着LLM能力提升，有效的工具使用越来越涉及多步骤多轮交互。但工具交互增长带来显著延迟，成为实时LLM服务的关键挑战。通过实证分析，我们发现工具调用轨迹高度结构化，遵循受约束的schema，并常展现重复调用模式。据此提出ToolSpec，一种schema感知、检索增强的投机解码方法，用于加速工具调用。ToolSpec利用预定义工具schema生成准确草稿，使用有限状态机交替确定性schema token填充和变量字段投机生成，还检索相似历史工具调用作为草稿。实验表明ToolSpec实现最高4.2倍加速。
papers.ai_summary_en: ToolSpec tackles the high serving latency caused by increasingly multi-step, multi-turn LLM tool calling. It introduces a schema-aware, retrieval-augmented speculative decoding method that uses predefined tool schemas with a finite-state machine to deterministically fill structural tokens while speculatively generating variable fields, and further reuses similar historical tool invocations as drafts. Experiments show up to 4.2× speedup over existing training-free speculative decoding approaches, offering a plug-and-play acceleration mechanism for tool-augmented LLM workflows.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对多步、多轮工具调用导致 LLM 服务延迟高的难题，基于工具调用高度结构化、受 schema 约束且常重复的规律，提出 ToolSpec：用有限状态机在确定性 schema 填充与可变字段投机生成间切换，并检索相似历史调用作为草稿。  
实验表明，这一即插即用方法在多个基准上最高实现 4.2 倍加速，显著优于现有免训练投机解码方案。

papers.title: Event Tensor: A Unified Abstraction for Compiling Dynamic Megakernel
papers.authors: Hongyi Jin, Bohan Hou, Guanjie Wang, Ruihang Lai, Jinqi Chen, Zihao Ye, Yaxing Cai, Yixin Dong, Xinhao Cheng, Zhihao Zhang, Yilong Zhao, Yingyi Huang, Lijie Yang, Jinchen Jiang, Gabriele Oliaro, Jianan Ji, Xupeng Miao, Vinod Grover, Todd C. Mowry, Zhihao Jia, Tianqi Chen
papers.abstract_en: Modern GPU workloads, especially large language model (LLM) inference, suffer from kernel launch overheads and coarse synchronization that limit inter-kernel parallelism. Recent megakernel techniques fuse multiple operators into a single persistent kernel to eliminate launch gaps and expose inter-kernel parallelism, but struggle to handle dynamic shapes and data-dependent computation in real workloads. We present Event Tensor, a unified compiler abstraction for dynamic megakernels. Event Tensor encodes dependencies between tiled tasks, and enables first-class support for both shape and data-dependent dynamism. Built atop this abstraction, our Event Tensor Compiler (ETC) applies static and dynamic scheduling transformations to generate high-performance persistent kernels. Evaluations show that ETC achieves state-of-the-art LLM serving latency while significantly reducing system warmup overhead.
papers.abstract_cn: 现代GPU工作负载（尤其是LLM推理）受内核启动开销和粗粒度同步限制，制约了内核间并行性。最近的megakernel技术将多个算子融合到单个持久内核中以消除启动间隙，但难以处理真实工作负载中的动态形状和数据依赖计算。本文提出Event Tensor，一种用于动态megakernel的统一编译器抽象。Event Tensor编码分块任务间的依赖关系，实现对形状和数据依赖动态性的原生支持。基于此抽象，Event Tensor Compiler (ETC)应用静态和动态调度变换生成高性能持久内核。评估表明ETC实现了最先进的LLM服务延迟，同时显著降低系统预热开销。
papers.ai_summary_en: Event Tensor addresses kernel launch overhead and coarse synchronization in LLM inference, where dynamic shapes and data-dependent computation limit existing megakernel fusion approaches. It introduces a unified compiler abstraction that encodes dependencies among tiled tasks as event tensors, enabling first-class support for shape and data dynamism and allowing static/dynamic scheduling transformations to generate persistent megakernels. Evaluations show that the Event Tensor Compiler achieves state-of-the-art LLM serving latency while significantly reducing system warmup overhead.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM 推理等 GPU 负载中 kernel 启动开销和粗粒度同步限制算子间并行、且现有 megakernel 难以支持动态形状与数据依赖计算的问题，提出 Event Tensor 这一统一编译抽象。其核心洞见是用事件张量显式编码分块任务间依赖，并在此基础上通过静态/动态调度变换生成支持动态性的高性能持久化 megakernel。实验表明，该方法在 LLM 服务延迟上达到领先水平，同时显著降低系统预热开销。

papers.title: KV Packet: Recomputation-Free Context-Independent KV Caching for LLMs
papers.authors: Chuangtao Chen, Grace Li Zhang, Xunzhao Yin, Cheng Zhuo, Bing Li, Ulf Schlichtmann
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) rely heavily on Key-Value (KV) caching to minimize inference latency. However, standard KV caches are context-dependent: reusing a cached document in a new context requires recomputing KV states to account for shifts in attention distribution. Existing solutions such as CacheBlend, EPIC, and SAM-KV mitigate this issue by selectively recomputing a subset of tokens; however, they still incur non-negligible computational overhead (FLOPs) and increased Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) latency. In this paper, we propose KV Packet, a recomputation-free cache reuse framework that treats cached documents as immutable "packets" wrapped in light-weight trainable soft-token adapters, which are trained via self-supervised distillation to bridge context discontinuities. Experiments on Llama-3.1 and Qwen2.5 demonstrate that the proposed KV Packet method achieves near-zero FLOPs and lower TTFT than recomputation-based baselines, while retaining F1 scores comparable to those of the full recomputation baseline.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型严重依赖KV缓存来最小化推理延迟。但标准KV缓存是上下文依赖的：在新上下文中复用缓存文档需要重新计算KV状态以适应注意力分布变化。现有解决方案如CacheBlend、EPIC和SAM-KV通过选择性重计算部分token来缓解，但仍引入不可忽视的计算开销和增加的TTFT延迟。本文提出KV Packet，一种免重计算的缓存复用框架，将缓存文档视为不可变"包"，包裹在轻量可训练软token适配器中，通过自监督蒸馏训练来桥接上下文不连续性。Llama-3.1和Qwen2.5上的实验表明KV Packet实现近零FLOPs和更低的TTFT。
papers.ai_summary_en: KV Packet addresses the context-dependence of LLM KV caches, where reusing cached documents in new prompts normally requires recomputing KV states, adding FLOPs and Time-to-First-Token latency. It proposes treating cached documents as immutable “KV packets” wrapped with lightweight trainable soft-token adapters, learned via self-supervised distillation to bridge context discontinuities without recomputation. Experiments on Llama-3.1 and Qwen2.5 show near-zero reuse FLOPs and lower TTFT than recomputation-based baselines while preserving F1 scores comparable to full recomputation.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM 推理中 KV 缓存因上下文依赖而难以跨上下文复用、现有方法仍需部分重算并带来 FLOPs 与 TTFT 开销的问题展开研究。其核心方法是将已缓存文档视为不可变“KV Packet”，并用轻量可训练的软 token 适配器包裹，通过自监督蒸馏弥合上下文切换造成的注意力不连续。实验表明，该方法在 Llama-3.1 和 Qwen2.5 上实现近零额外 FLOPs 和更低 TTFT，同时保持接近完全重算的 F1 性能。

papers.title: Latent-Condensed Transformer for Efficient Long Context Modeling
papers.authors: Zeng You, Yaofo Chen, Qiuwu Chen, Ying Sun, Shuhai Zhang, Yingjian Li, Yaowei Wang, Mingkui Tan
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) face significant challenges in processing long contexts due to the linear growth of the key-value (KV) cache and quadratic complexity of self-attention. Existing approaches address these bottlenecks separately: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) reduces the KV cache by projecting tokens into a low-dimensional latent space, while sparse attention reduces computation. However, sparse methods cannot operate natively on MLA's compressed latent structure, missing opportunities for joint optimization. In this paper, we propose Latent-Condensed Attention (LCA), which directly condenses context within MLA's latent space, where the representation is disentangled into semantic latent vectors and positional keys. LCA separately aggregates semantic vectors via query-aware pooling and preserves positional keys via anchor selection. This approach jointly reduces both computational cost and KV cache without adding parameters. Beyond MLA, LCA's design is architecture-agnostic and readily extends to other attention mechanisms such as GQA. Theoretically, we prove a length-independent error bound. Experiments show LCA achieves up to 2.5× prefilling speedup and 90% KV cache reduction at 128K context while maintaining competitive performance.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型在处理长上下文时面临显著挑战，原因是KV缓存的线性增长和自注意力的二次复杂度。现有方法分别解决这些瓶颈：多头潜在注意力(MLA)通过将token投影到低维潜在空间减少KV缓存，稀疏注意力减少计算量。但稀疏方法无法原生操作MLA压缩的潜在结构，错过了联合优化机会。本文提出潜在压缩注意力(LCA)，直接在MLA潜在空间中压缩上下文。LCA通过查询感知池化聚合语义向量，通过锚点选择保留位置键，联合降低计算成本和KV缓存而不增加参数。实验显示LCA在128K上下文下实现2.5倍预填充加速和90%KV缓存减少。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses long-context LLM inefficiency caused by linearly growing KV caches and quadratic self-attention cost, where latent compression (e.g., MLA) and sparse attention are typically optimized separately. It proposes Latent-Condensed Attention (LCA), which condenses context directly in MLA’s latent space by disentangling semantic latent vectors from positional keys, using query-aware pooling for semantics and anchor selection to preserve positional information, with no added parameters and extension to GQA. The method provides a length-independent error bound and achieves up to 2.5× prefilling speedup and 90% KV-cache reduction at 128K context while maintaining competitive performance.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文大模型中 KV 缓存线性增长与自注意力计算二次复杂度的问题，指出现有 MLA 压缩与稀疏注意力难以联合优化。其核心方法是提出 Latent-Condensed Attention，在 MLA 的潜在空间中直接压缩上下文，将语义潜在向量做查询感知池化、位置键通过锚点选择保留，从而无新增参数地同时降低计算和缓存开销。实验表明，在 128K 上下文下可实现最高 2.5 倍预填充加速和 90% KV 缓存减少，并保持有竞争力的性能。

papers.title: Nemotron 3 Super: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning
papers.authors: NVIDIA Team
papers.abstract_en: We describe the pre-training, post-training, and quantization of Nemotron 3 Super, a 120 billion (active 12 billion) parameter hybrid Mamba-Attention Mixture-of-Experts model. Nemotron 3 Super is the first model in the Nemotron 3 family to 1) be pre-trained in NVFP4, 2) leverage LatentMoE, a new Mixture-of-Experts architecture that optimizes for both accuracy per FLOP and accuracy per parameter, and 3) include MTP layers for inference acceleration through native speculative decoding. We pre-trained Nemotron 3 Super on 25 trillion tokens followed by post-training using supervised fine tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). The final model supports up to 1M context length and achieves comparable accuracy on common benchmarks, while also achieving up to 2.2x and 7.5x higher inference throughput compared to GPT-OSS-120B and Qwen3.5-122B, respectively. Nemotron 3 Super datasets, along with the base, post-trained, and quantized checkpoints, are open-sourced on HuggingFace.
papers.abstract_cn: 本文描述了Nemotron 3 Super的预训练、后训练和量化——一个120亿(活跃12亿)参数的混合Mamba-Attention MoE模型。Nemotron 3 Super是Nemotron 3系列中首个1)以NVFP4预训练、2)利用LatentMoE新MoE架构优化每FLOP和每参数精度、3)包含MTP层通过原生投机解码加速推理的模型。在25万亿token上预训练后进行SFT和RL后训练。最终模型支持1M上下文长度，推理吞吐量相比GPT-OSS-120B和Qwen3.5-122B分别高达2.2倍和7.5倍提升。模型数据集和检查点已在HuggingFace开源。
papers.ai_summary_en: Nemotron 3 Super addresses the need for an open, high-throughput long-context model for agentic reasoning by training a 120B-parameter (12B active) hybrid Mamba-Attention mixture-of-experts system optimized for efficient inference. Its key innovations are LatentMoE for accuracy per FLOP and per parameter, NVFP4 pretraining, and multi-token prediction layers enabling native speculative decoding, followed by SFT/RL and quantization to support 1M-token contexts. The released model achieves comparable benchmark accuracy with up to 2.2× and 7.5× higher inference throughput than GPT-OSS-120B and Qwen3.5-122B, respectively, and is open-sourced with datasets and checkpoints.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向智能体推理中的高效率与长上下文需求，提出并开源 Nemotron 3 Super：一个 120B 总参数、12B 激活参数的 Mamba-Attention 混合 MoE 模型。其核心方法是结合 NVFP4 预训练、LatentMoE 架构以及用于原生投机解码的 MTP 层，以同时优化每 FLOP/每参数精度和推理吞吐。模型支持 1M 上下文，在常用基准上保持可比精度，并相较 GPT-OSS-120B 与 Qwen3.5-122B 分别实现最高 2.2× 和 7.5× 推理吞吐提升。

papers.title: A Full-Stack Performance Evaluation Infrastructure for 3D-DRAM-based LLM Accelerators
papers.authors: Cong Li, Chenhao Xue, Yi Ren, Xiping Dong, Yu Cheng, Yinbo Hu, Fujun Bai, Yixin Guo, Xiping Jiang, Qiang Wu, Zhi Yang, Zhe Cheng, Yuan Xie, Guangyu Sun
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit memory-intensive behavior during decoding, making it a key bottleneck in LLM inference. To accelerate decoding execution, hybrid-bonding-based 3D-DRAM has been adopted in LLM accelerators. While this emerging technology provides strong performance gains over existing hardware, current 3D-DRAM accelerators (3D-Accelerators) rely on closed-source evaluation tools, limiting access to publicly available performance analysis methods. Moreover, existing designs are highly customized for specific scenarios, lacking a general and reusable full-stack modeling for 3D-Accelerators across diverse use cases. To bridge this fundamental gap, we present ATLAS, the first silicon-proven Architectural Three-dimensional-DRAM-based LLM Accelerator Simulation framework. Built on commercially deployed multi-layer 3D-DRAM technology, ATLAS introduces unified abstractions for both 3D-Accelerator system architecture and programming primitives to support arbitrary LLM inference scenarios. Validation against real silicon shows that ATLAS achieves ≤8.57% simulation error and 97.26-99.96% correlation with measured performance. ATLAS will be open-sourced upon publication.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型在解码阶段表现出内存密集行为，成为LLM推理的关键瓶颈。为加速解码执行，混合键合3D-DRAM已被用于LLM加速器。虽然此新兴技术提供了强大的性能提升，但当前3D-DRAM加速器依赖闭源评估工具，缺乏公开的性能分析方法。现有设计高度定制特定场景，缺乏通用可复用的全栈建模。为填补这一差距，我们提出ATLAS——首个经过硅验证的3D-DRAM LLM加速器仿真框架。基于商用部署的多层3D-DRAM技术，ATLAS引入统一抽象支持任意LLM推理场景。真实硅片验证显示ATLAS仿真误差≤8.57%，相关性97.26-99.96%。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the lack of open, generalizable full-stack performance evaluation tools for 3D-DRAM-based LLM inference accelerators, where memory-bound decoding is a key bottleneck and existing accelerators rely on closed, scenario-specific modeling. It introduces ATLAS, a silicon-proven simulation framework built on commercial hybrid-bonded multi-layer 3D-DRAM that provides unified abstractions for accelerator architecture and programming primitives to support arbitrary LLM inference workloads. Validation against real silicon shows ≤8.57% simulation error and 97.26–99.96% correlation with measured performance, enabling an open reusable infrastructure for 3D-DRAM LLM accelerator research.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM解码阶段的内存瓶颈及现有3D-DRAM加速器评估工具闭源、缺乏通用全栈建模的问题，提出了ATLAS仿真框架。其核心洞见是基于商用多层3D-DRAM技术，建立统一的系统架构与编程原语抽象，以支持任意LLM推理场景的性能评估。实验显示，ATLAS与真实硅片性能误差≤8.57%、相关性达97.26–99.96%，并将开源，为3D-DRAM LLM加速器研究提供可复用基础设施。

papers.title: When Less Latent Leads to Better Relay: Information-Preserving Compression for Latent Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration
papers.authors: Yiping Li, Zhiyu An, Wan Du
papers.abstract_en: Communication in Large Language Model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems is moving beyond discrete tokens to preserve richer context. Recent work such as LatentMAS enables agents to exchange latent messages through full key-value (KV) caches. However, full KV relay incurs high memory and communication cost. We adapt eviction-style KV compression to this setting and introduce Orthogonal Backfill (OBF) to mitigate information loss from hard eviction. OBF injects a low-rank orthogonal residual from discarded KV states into the retained KV states. It achieves performance comparable to full KV relay while reducing communication cost by 79.8%--89.4%.
papers.abstract_cn: 基于LLM的多智能体系统通信正超越离散token以保留更丰富的上下文。最近的工作如LatentMAS使智能体能通过完整KV缓存交换潜在消息。但完整KV中继产生高内存和通信成本。我们在此场景中适配驱逐式KV压缩并引入正交回填(OBF)以缓解硬驱逐的信息损失。OBF将丢弃KV状态的低秩正交残差注入保留的KV状态。在9个标准基准上实现与完整KV中继相当的性能，同时降低通信成本79.8%-89.4%。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the high memory and communication overhead of relaying full KV caches in latent multi-agent LLM collaboration, where agents exchange latent messages rather than discrete tokens. It adapts eviction-style KV compression and proposes Orthogonal Backfill (OBF), which injects a low-rank orthogonal residual from discarded KV states into retained KV states to preserve otherwise lost information. Experiments show that OBF achieves performance comparable to full KV relay while reducing communication cost by 79.8%–89.4%.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对潜在多智能体LLM协作中通过完整KV Cache传递上下文导致的高内存与通信开销问题，研究如何在压缩KV中继的同时保留关键信息。其核心方法是引入Orthogonal Backfill（OBF），在驱逐式KV压缩下将被丢弃KV状态的低秩正交残差回填到保留的KV中，以缓解硬删除造成的信息损失。实验表明，该方法可在保持接近完整KV中继性能的同时，将通信成本降低约79.8%–89.4%。

papers.title: Multi-Drafter Speculative Decoding with Alignment Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by using a smaller model to draft future tokens, which are then verified by the target LLM. This preserves generation quality by accepting only aligned tokens. However, individual drafters, often trained for specific tasks or domains, exhibit limited effectiveness across diverse applications. To address this, we introduce \textsc{MetaSD}, a unified framework that integrates multiple drafters into the SD process. MetaSD dynamically allocates computational resources to heterogeneous drafters by leveraging alignment feedback and framing drafter selection as a multi-armed bandit problem. Extensive experiments show MetaSD consistently outperforms single-drafter approaches.
papers.abstract_cn: 推测解码（SD）通过使用较小的模型起草未来的标记，然后由目标大型语言模型（LLM）进行验证，从而加速大型语言模型的推理。这通过只接受对齐的标记来保持生成质量。然而，单个起草模型通常为特定任务或领域训练，其在不同应用中的效果有限。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了\textsc{MetaSD}，一个将多个起草模型整合到SD过程中的统一框架。MetaSD通过利用对齐反馈并将起草模型选择问题建模为多臂老虎机问题，动态分配计算资源给异质起草模型。大量实验表明，MetaSD始终优于单一起草模型的方法。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the limited robustness of single-drafter speculative decoding, where one small draft model often performs poorly across diverse tasks or domains. It proposes MetaSD, a unified multi-drafter framework that uses alignment feedback from target-model verification to dynamically select and allocate computation among heterogeneous drafters via a multi-armed bandit formulation. Experiments show that MetaSD consistently outperforms single-drafter baselines, improving inference speedup while preserving target LLM generation quality.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对投机解码中单一起草模型在多样任务和领域上泛化不足的问题，提出统一的多起草器框架 MetaSD。其核心洞见是利用目标模型验证产生的对齐反馈，将起草器选择建模为多臂老虎机问题，从而动态分配计算资源给异构起草器。实验表明，MetaSD 能持续优于单一起草器方法，在保持生成质量的同时提升 LLM 推理加速效果。

papers.title: CodeComp: Structural KV Cache Compression for Agentic Coding
papers.abstract_en: Agentic code tasks such as fault localization and patch generation require processing long codebases under tight memory constraints, where the Key-Value (KV) cache becomes the primary inference bottleneck. Existing compression methods rely exclusively on attention signals to estimate token importance, systematically discarding structurally critical tokens such as call sites, branch conditions, and assignments that are essential for code understanding. We present CodeComp, a training-free KV cache compression framework that incorporates static program analysis into LLM inference via Code Property Graph priors extracted by Joern. Across bug localization and code generation benchmarks, CodeComp consistently outperforms attention-only compression baselines under equal memory budgets, recovering the majority of full-context accuracy under aggressive KV cache compression, while matching the patch generation quality of uncompressed full-context inference and integrating seamlessly into SGLang-based agentic coding pipelines without model modification.
papers.abstract_cn: 代理代码任务，如故障定位和补丁生成，需要在严格的内存约束下处理长代码库，其中键值 (KV) 缓存成为主要的推理瓶颈。现有的压缩方法完全依赖于注意力信号来估计标记重要性，系统地丢弃了对代码理解至关重要的结构性关键标记，如调用站点、分支条件和分配。我们介绍了 CodeComp，一种无需训练的 KV 缓存压缩框架，它通过 Joern 提取的代码属性图先验，将静态程序序序列分析整合到 LLM 推理中。在错误定位和代码生成基准测试中，CodeComp 在相同内存预算下始终优于仅注意力压缩基准，在激进的 KV 缓存压缩下恢复了大部分全上下文准确性，同时匹配未压缩全上下文推理的补丁生成质量，并无缝集成到基于 SGLang 的代理编码管道中，无需模型修改。
papers.ai_summary_en: CodeComp addresses KV-cache memory bottlenecks in long-context agentic coding tasks, where attention-only compression methods often discard structurally critical code tokens such as call sites, branch conditions, and assignments. It introduces a training-free compression framework that injects static program-analysis priors from Joern-extracted Code Property Graphs into KV-cache eviction decisions during LLM inference. Across bug localization and code generation benchmarks, CodeComp outperforms attention-only baselines under equal memory budgets, recovers most full-context accuracy under aggressive compression, and integrates into SGLang pipelines without model modification.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对智能体编码任务中长代码库推理的 KV Cache 内存瓶颈，指出现有仅依赖注意力信号的压缩方法容易丢弃调用点、分支条件和赋值等结构关键 token。其核心方法是提出免训练框架 CodeComp，将 Joern 提取的代码属性图先验融入 KV Cache 压缩，以程序结构信息指导 token 重要性估计。实验表明，在相同内存预算下该方法优于仅注意力压缩，在激进压缩下仍能恢复大部分全上下文精度，并可无缝集成到 SGLang 编码智能体流程中。

papers.title: SHIELD: A Segmented Hierarchical Memory Architecture for Energy-Efficient LLM Inference on Edge NPUs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) inference on edge Neural Processing Units (NPUs) is fundamentally constrained by limited on-chip memory capacity. Although high-density embedded DRAM (eDRAM) is attractive for storing activation workspaces, its periodic refresh consumes substantial energy. Prior work has primarily focused on reducing off-chip traffic or optimizing refresh for persistent Key-Value (KV) caches, while transient and error-resilient Query and Attention Output (QO) activations are largely overlooked. We propose SHIELD, a lifecycle-aware segmented eDRAM architecture that jointly exploits temporal residency and bit-level sensitivity in bfloat16 (BF16) activations. SHIELD isolates the sign and exponent fields from the mantissa, disables refresh for transient QO mantissas, and applies relaxed refresh to persistent KV mantissas. Across multiple LLMs and inference scenarios, SHIELD reduces eDRAM refresh energy by 35% relative to a standard-refresh baseline while preserving accuracy on WikiText-2, PIQA, and ARC-Easy.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型 (LLM) 对边缘神经处理单元 (NPU) 的推理从根本上受到片上存储容量有限的限制。尽管高密度嵌入式 DRAM(eDRAM) 对于存储激活工作空间很有吸引力，但其周期性刷新会消耗大量能量。以前的工作主要集中在减少片外流量或优化持续密钥值 (KV) 缓存的刷新，而瞬时和容错查询和注意力输出 (QO) 激活在很大程度上被忽视。我们提出了 SHIELD，一种生命周期感知的分段 eDRAM 架构，它联合利用 bfloat16(BF16) 激活中的时间驻留和位级灵敏度。SHIELD 从螳螂中分离符号和指数字段，禁用瞬时 QO 螳螂的刷新，并将松弛刷新应用于持续的 KV 螳螂。在多个 LLM 和推理场景中，SHIELD 相对于标准刷新基线将 eDRAM 刷新能量降低了 35%，同时保持 WikiText-2、PIQA 和 ARC-Easy 的准确性。
papers.ai_summary_en: SHIELD tackles energy-efficient LLM inference on edge NPUs constrained by limited on-chip memory, specifically the high refresh energy of eDRAM used for activation workspaces. Its key insight is lifecycle-aware segmentation of BF16 activations: sign/exponent fields are protected while mantissas receive differentiated refresh policies, with refresh disabled for transient query/attention-output mantissas and relaxed refresh for persistent KV-cache mantissas. Across multiple models and tasks, SHIELD reduces eDRAM refresh energy by 35% versus standard refresh while preserving accuracy on WikiText-2, PIQA, and ARC-Easy.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘 NPU 上 LLM 推理受片上 eDRAM 容量与刷新能耗限制、且现有优化忽视瞬态 Query/Attention Output 激活的问题展开研究。其核心方法是提出 SHIELD 分段式、生命周期感知的 eDRAM 架构，利用 BF16 中符号/指数与尾数的不同敏感性，对瞬态 QO 尾数关闭刷新、对持久 KV 尾数采用宽松刷新。实验表明，该方法在多种模型和推理场景下将 eDRAM 刷新能耗降低约 35%，同时在 WikiText-2、PIQA 和 ARC-Easy 上保持精度。

papers.title: Comparative Characterization of KV Cache Management Strategies for LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Efficient inference with Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly relies on Key-Value (KV) caches to store previously computed key and value vectors at each layer. These caches are essential to minimize redundant computation during autoregressive token generation, lowering computational complexity from quadratic to linear. However, the growth of KV caches has posed significant system-level challenges, particularly as model sizes increase, context lengths grow, and concurrent requests compete for limited memory resources. Even though several recent frameworks for KV cache management have emerged, their comparative trade-offs in memory consumption and inference performance have not been fully understood, especially under varying request sizes and model configurations. In this work, we conduct an empirical study of three state-of-the-art KV cache management frameworks: vLLM, InfiniGen, and H2O. These frameworks employ techniques such as tensor offloading, token eviction heuristics, and speculative scheduling to balance memory usage and performance. We evaluate their performance in terms of a range of metrics such as latency, throughput, and memory usage across a spectrum of key parameters including request rates, model sizes, and sparsity levels. Our results pinpoint the conditions for each framework to perform the best, revealing the most suitable selection and configuration of KV cache strategies under memory and performance constraints.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型 (LLMs) 的高效推理越来越依赖于 Key-Value(KV) 缓存来存储先前计算过的键值向量。这些缓存对于最大限度地减少自回归令牌生成过程中的冗余计算至关重要，从而将计算复杂度从二次方降低到线性。然而，KV 缓存的增长已经带来了显著的系统级挑战，特别是随着模型尺寸的增长、上下文长度的增长以及并发请求对有限内存资源的竞争。尽管最近出现了几种 KV 缓存管理框架，但它们在内存消耗和推理性能方面的比较权衡尚未得到充分理解，特别是在不同请求尺寸和模型配置下。在本文中，我们对三种最先进的 KV 缓存管理框架进行了实证研究:vLLM、InfiniGen 和 H2O。这些框架采用张量卸载、令牌驱逐启发式和投机调度等技术来平衡内存使用和性能。我们根据一系列关键参数 (包括请求速率、模型大小和稀疏度水平) 评估它们的性能，如延迟、吞吐量和内存使用等一系列指标。我们的研究结果精确定义了每个框架达到最佳性能的条件，揭示了在内存和性能约束下 KV 缓存策略的最佳选择和配置。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses system-level bottlenecks in LLM inference caused by expanding KV caches under large models, long contexts, and concurrent requests. It empirically compares vLLM, InfiniGen, and H2O across latency, throughput, and memory usage while varying request rates, model sizes, and sparsity, analyzing trade-offs among tensor offloading, token eviction, and speculative scheduling. The results identify the regimes where each framework performs best and provide practical guidance for selecting and configuring KV-cache strategies under memory–performance constraints.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型推理中 KV 缓存随模型规模、上下文长度和并发请求增长带来的内存与性能瓶颈，系统比较了 vLLM、InfiniGen 和 H2O 三类 KV 缓存管理框架。研究通过在不同请求率、模型规模和稀疏度下评测延迟、吞吐与内存占用，分析了张量卸载、token 驱逐启发式和投机调度等策略的权衡。结果明确了各框架的最优适用条件，为在内存和性能约束下选择与配置 KV 缓存策略提供了实证依据。

papers.title: Don't Waste Bits! Adaptive KV-Cache Quantization for Lightweight On-Device LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across reasoning, generation, and decision-making tasks, yet deploying them on mobile, embedded, and edge devices remains particularly challenging. On-device LLM inference is heavily constrained by the memory and bandwidth overhead of the key-value (KV) cache, which grows linearly with context length and often dominates decoding cost. Existing KV-cache quantization schemes typically rely on fixed precision or hand-crafted heuristics, thereby wasting bits on low-impact tokens while over-compressing informative ones, leading to avoidable accuracy degradation. Inspired by Huffman coding's principle of variable-length allocation, we propose adaptive KV-cache quantization, a learned policy that assigns bit-width proportional to token importance, minimizing expected memory and latency without sacrificing competitive accuracy. Our framework extracts lightweight token-level features, including token frequency, quality score, attention variance, and entropy-based uncertainty, and feeds them into a compact data-driven controller that dynamically selects KV precision from {2-bit, 4-bit, 8-bit, FP16} during decoding. This adaptive precision policy reduces KV memory footprint and latency while improving accuracy compared to static KV quantization and rule-based baselines, and maintaining competitive accuracy close to FP16 inference across standard LLM benchmarks. Extensive experiments across multiple commonsense reasoning benchmarks using SmolLM-135M, SmolLM-360M, and SmolLM-1.7B demonstrate that our controller consistently improves the accuracy-latency trade-off. For instance, with SmolLM-360M on HellaSwag, our method reduces decoding latency (ms/token) by 17.75% relative to static KV quantization, improves accuracy by 7.60 points, and remains within only 0.30 points of FP16 inference.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型 (LLM) 在推理、生成和决策任务方面取得了显著进展，但在移动、嵌入式和边缘设备上部署它们仍然特别具有挑战性。设备上的 LLM 推理受到键值 (KV) 缓存的内存和带宽开销的严重限制，KV 缓存随上下文长度线性增长，通常主导解码成本。现有的 KV 缓存量化方案通常依赖于固定精度或手工启发式，因此在低影响标记上浪费比特，同时过度压缩信息性标记，导致可避免的精度下降。受霍夫曼编码变长度分配原则的启发，我们提出了自适应 KV 缓存量化，这是一种学习策略，它根据令牌重要性比例分配比特宽度，最大限度地减少预期内存和延迟，同时不牺牲竞争准确性。我们的框架提取轻量级标记级特征，包括标记频率、质量评分、注意力方差和基于熵的不确定性，并将这些特征输入到一个紧凑的数据驱动控制器中，该控制器在解码过程中动态地从{2 位、4 位、8 位、FP16}中选择 KV 精度。与静态 KV 量化和基于规则的基线相比，这种自适应的精度策略减少了 KV 内存占用和延迟，同时提高了准确性，并在标准 LLM 基准中保持接近 FP16 推理的竞争精度。使用 SmolLM-135M、SmolLM-360M 和 SmolLM-1.7B 在多个常识推理基准中进行的广泛实验表明，我们的控制器一致地提高了准确性 - 延迟权衡。例如，使用 HellaSwag 上的 SmolLM-360M，与静态 KV 量化相比，我们的方法将解码延迟 (ms/token) 降低了 17.75%，准确率提高了 7.60 个点，并且仍然保持在 FP16 推断的 0.30 个点范围内。
papers.comment: Accepted by the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles KV-cache memory and bandwidth bottlenecks in on-device LLM inference, where fixed-precision or heuristic quantization wastes bits on low-impact tokens and over-compresses informative ones. It proposes a learned adaptive KV-cache quantization policy that uses lightweight token-level features—frequency, quality score, attention variance, and entropy—to dynamically assign KV precision from {2-bit, 4-bit, 8-bit, FP16} during decoding. Experiments on SmolLM-135M/360M/1.7B show improved accuracy–latency trade-offs versus static baselines, e.g., 17.75% lower decoding latency and +7.60 accuracy on HellaSwag for SmolLM-360M while remaining within 0.30 points of FP16.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对端侧轻量LLM推理中KV缓存随上下文线性增长、受内存与带宽限制严重，且固定/启发式量化会浪费比特或过度压缩关键token的问题。提出受Huffman编码启发的自适应KV缓存量化策略，通过token频率、质量分、注意力方差和熵等轻量特征驱动数据控制器，在解码时动态选择2/4/8/FP16精度，将比特按token重要性分配。实验在SmolLM系列模型上显示，该方法显著改善准确率-延迟权衡，例如SmolLM-360M在HellaSwag上较静态量化降低17.75%解码延迟、提升7.60个准确率点，并仅比FP16低0.30点。

papers.title: QCFuse: Query-Centric Cache Fusion for Efficient RAG Inference
papers.abstract_en: Cache fusion accelerates generation process of LLMs equipped with RAG through KV caching and selective token recomputation, thereby reducing computational costs and improving efficiency. However, existing methods primarily rely on local perspectives for token selection and lack global awareness from the user query. Utilizing this global awareness is challenging due to the high cost of obtaining context-aware query representations and the strict pipeline constraints required for efficient attention analysis. Thus, this demonstration introduces QCFuse, an innovative KV cache fusion system centered on the user query. QCFuse leverages semantic summary anchors to enhance query representations and selectively recomputes query-related tokens to improve accuracy, updating tokens based on the attention distribution of the most critical Transformer layer to preserve the high efficiency of the pipeline structure. Evaluations on real-world datasets demonstrate that QCFuse significantly improves the response efficiency of LLMs by 40\% while maintaining equivalent accuracy compared to current methods. Additionally, in certain scenarios, QCFuse achieves an attention denoising effect that yields higher response accuracy, demonstrating substantial potential in the optimization of LLM inference.
papers.abstract_cn: 缓存融合通过 KV 缓存和选择性令牌重新计算加速了配备 RAG 的 LLM 的生成过程，从而降低了计算成本并提高了效率。然而，现有方法主要依赖于本地视角进行令牌选择，缺乏来自用户查询的全局意识。由于获取上下文感知查询表示的高成本和高效注意力分析所需的严格流水线约束，利用这种全局意识具有挑战性。因此，本演示介绍了 QCFuse，一种创新的、以用户查询为中心的 KV 缓存融合系统。QCFuse 利用语义总结锚来增强查询表示，并选择性地重新计算与查询相关的标记以提高准确性，根据最关键的 Transformer 层的注意力分布更新标记，以保持管道结构的高效性。在真实世界数据集上的评估表明，与当前方法相比，QCFuse 在保持等效准确性的同时，显著地将 LLM 的响应效率提高了 40%。此外，在某些情况下，QCFuse 实现了注意力去噪效果，产生了更高的响应准确度，表明其在 LLM 推理优化方面具有显著潜力。
papers.ai_summary_en: QCFuse addresses inefficient RAG-enabled LLM inference where existing KV cache fusion and selective recomputation methods select tokens using local cues and lack global query awareness. It introduces a query-centric cache fusion system that enhances query representations with semantic summary anchors, selectively recomputes query-relevant tokens, and updates cached tokens using attention distributions from the most critical Transformer layer to preserve pipeline efficiency. Evaluations on real-world datasets show about 40% faster LLM response with comparable accuracy, and in some cases improved accuracy via attention denoising.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对RAG推理中KV缓存融合过度依赖局部token选择、缺乏用户查询全局感知的问题。QCFuse以查询为中心，通过语义摘要锚点增强查询表示，选择性重计算查询相关token，并依据关键Transformer层的注意力分布更新缓存，以兼顾精度与流水线效率。实验表明，其在保持准确率相当的同时将响应效率提升约40%，并在部分场景通过注意力去噪进一步提高准确性。

papers.title: KVSculpt: KV Cache Compression as Distillation
papers.abstract_en: KV cache compression is critical for efficient long-context LLM inference. Approaches that reduce the per-pair footprint -- quantization and low-rank decomposition -- are orthogonal to those that reduce the sequence length of the cache. Along the sequence-length dimension, existing methods range from pure eviction -- selecting which KV pairs to keep -- to merging, which combines similar pairs into fewer ones. Both remain anchored to the original cache entries. We propose KVSculpt, which moves to the other end of this spectrum: instead of selecting or combining original pairs, we optimize a smaller set of unconstrained KV pairs in continuous embedding space to preserve each layer's attention behavior. Keys are optimized via L-BFGS and values are solved in closed form via least squares, alternating every few steps. On top of this, we introduce adaptive budget allocation, which uses a cheap pilot compression run to redistribute the compression budget across layers and KV heads based on per-component difficulty. On Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct with 2048-token contexts, KVSculpt reduces KL divergence by 3.5-4.1x compared to Select+Fit -- attention-score eviction with least-squares value fitting -- across compression ratios r in {0.3, 0.5, 0.7}. Adaptive allocation provides an additional 1.3x KL reduction at no extra inference cost. Analysis reveals that compression difficulty is highly non-uniform: per-layer pilot MSE varies by up to 100x across layers, and the two KV heads within a single layer can differ by up to 467x -- demonstrating that fine-grained budget allocation is essential.
papers.abstract_cn: KV 缓存压缩对于高效的长上下文 LLM 推理至关重要。减少每对足迹的方法——量化和低秩分解——与那些减少缓存序列长度的方法是正交的。在序列长度维度上，现有的方法范围从纯排除 (选择要保留的 KV 对) 到合并 (将相似的对合并成更少的对)。这两种方法都保持锚定在原始缓存条目上。我们提出了 KVculpt，它移动到了这个谱的另一端：我们不是选择或合并原始对，而是在连续嵌入空间中优化一小组不受约束的 KV 对，以保留每层的注意力行为。键通过 L-BFGS 进行优化，值通过最小二乘法以封闭形式求解，每隔几步交替进行。在此基础上，我们引入了自适应预算分配，它使用廉价的试点压缩运行，根据每个组件的难度在层和 KV 头之间重新分配压缩预算。在 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 的 2048 标记上下文中，KVSculpt 与 Select+Fit 相比，在{0.3、0.5、0.7}的压缩比 r 下，KL 散度降低了 3.5-4.1 倍——后者是一种使用最小二乘值拟合的注意力评分剔除方法。自适应预算分配提供了额外的 1.3 倍 KL 降低，而无需额外的推理成本。分析表明，压缩难度高度不均匀：每层试点 MSE 在不同层之间的差异高达 100 倍，而同一层内的两个 KV 头之间的差异高达 467 倍——这证明了细粒度预算分配的必要性。
papers.ai_summary_en: KVSculpt addresses KV-cache compression for efficient long-context LLM inference by treating sequence-length reduction as distillation rather than eviction or merging. It optimizes a smaller set of unconstrained KV pairs in continuous embedding space to preserve per-layer attention behavior, using L-BFGS for keys and closed-form least squares for values, with adaptive budget allocation across layers and heads based on pilot-run difficulty. On Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct with 2048-token contexts, it reduces KL divergence by 3.5–4.1× over Select+Fit across compression ratios, and adaptive allocation adds another 1.3× while exposing highly non-uniform per-layer/head compression difficulty.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对长上下文推理中KV缓存压缩多依赖保留或合并原始KV、难以最优逼近注意力行为的问题，KVSculpt将压缩视为蒸馏，在连续空间中优化少量自由KV对：用L-BFGS优化key、用最小二乘闭式求解value，并基于试压缩难度在层与KV头间自适应分配预算。实验显示，在Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct、2048上下文下，相较Select+Fit可将KL散度降低3.5–4.1倍，自适应分配再降1.3倍；分析还揭示层间/头间压缩难度高度不均，说明细粒度预算分配很关键。

papers.title: ScoutAttention: Efficient KV Cache Offloading via Layer-Ahead CPU Pre-computation for LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large language models encounter critical GPU memory capacity constraints during long-context inference, where KV cache memory consumption severely limits decode batch sizes. While existing research has explored offloading KV cache to DRAM, these approaches either demand frequent GPU-CPU data transfers or impose extensive CPU computation requirements, resulting in poor GPU utilization as the system waits for I/O operations or CPU processing to complete.We propose ScoutAttention, a novel KV cache offloading framework that accelerates LLM inference through collaborative GPU-CPU attention computation. To prevent CPU computation from bottlenecking the system, ScoutAttention introduces GPU-CPU collaborative block-wise sparse attention that significantly reduces CPU load. Unlike conventional parallel computing approaches, our framework features a novel layer-ahead CPU pre-computation algorithm, enabling the CPU to initiate attention computation one layer in advance, complemented by asynchronous periodic recall mechanisms to maintain minimal CPU compute load. Experimental results demonstrate that ScoutAttention maintains accuracy within 2.4% of baseline while achieving 2.1x speedup compared to existing offloading methods.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型在长上下文推理过程中会遇到关键的 GPU 内存容量限制，其中 KV 缓存内存消耗严重限制了解码批处理大小。尽管现有研究已经探索了将 KV 缓存卸载到 DRAM 的方法，但这些方法要么需要频繁的 GPU-CPU 数据传输，要么强加广泛的 CPU 计算要求，导致在系统等待 I/O 操作或 CPU 处理完成时 GPU 利用率较低。我们提出了 ScoutAttention，一种新的 KV 缓存卸载框架，它通过协作 GPU-CPU 注意力计算来加速 LLM 推理。为了防止 CPU 计算对系统造成瓶颈，ScoutAttention 引入了 GPU-CPU 协作的分块式稀疏注意力，显著降低了 CPU 负载。与传统的并行计算方法不同，我们的框架采用了一种新颖的分层 CPU 预计算算法，使 CPU 能够提前一层启动注意力计算，并辅以异步周期性召回机制，以维持最小的 CPU 计算负载。实验结果表明，ScoutAttention 将准确率保持在基线的 2.4% 以内，同时与现有的卸载方法相比，速度提高了 2.1 倍。
papers.comment: Accepted at the 63rd Design Automation Conference (DAC 2026)
papers.ai_summary_en: ScoutAttention addresses GPU memory bottlenecks in long-context LLM decoding caused by large KV caches and the I/O/CPU overheads of prior DRAM offloading. It introduces collaborative GPU-CPU block-wise sparse attention with a layer-ahead CPU pre-computation pipeline and asynchronous periodic KV recall, allowing CPU work to overlap with GPU execution while minimizing CPU load. Experiments show accuracy within 2.4% of baseline attention and a 2.1× speedup over existing KV-cache offloading methods.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV cache 占用大量 GPU 显存、现有 CPU/DRAM offloading 方法因频繁传输或 CPU 计算过重导致 GPU 利用率低的问题。其核心方法是 ScoutAttention，通过 GPU-CPU 协同的块稀疏注意力降低 CPU 负载，并采用“提前一层”的 CPU 预计算与异步周期性召回机制，使 CPU 计算与 GPU 推理更好重叠。实验显示，该方法在精度相对基线损失不超过 2.4% 的同时，相比现有 offloading 方法取得约 2.1 倍加速。

papers.title: PRISM: Breaking the O(n) Memory Wall in Long-Context LLM Inference via O(1) Photonic Block Selection
papers.abstract_en: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked not by compute but by the O(n) memory bandwidth cost of scanning the KV cache at every decode step -- a wall that no amount of arithmetic scaling can break. Recent photonic accelerators have demonstrated impressive throughput for dense attention computation; however, these approaches inherit the same O(n) memory scaling as electronic attention when applied to long contexts. We observe that the real leverage point is the coarse block-selection step: a memory-bound similarity search that determines which KV blocks to fetch. We identify, for the first time, that this task is structurally matched to the photonic broadcast-and-weight paradigm -- the query fans out to all candidates via passive splitting, signatures are quasi-static (matching electro-optic MRR programming), and only rank order matters (relaxing precision to 4-6 bits). Crucially, the photonic advantage grows with context length: as N increases, the electronic scan cost rises linearly while the photonic evaluation remains O(1). We instantiate this insight in PRISM (Photonic Ranking via Inner-product Similarity with Microring weights), a thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) similarity engine. Hardware-impaired needle-in-a-haystack evaluation on Qwen2.5-7B confirms 100% accuracy from 4K through 64K tokens at k=32, with 16x traffic reduction at 64K context. PRISM achieves a four-order-of-magnitude energy advantage over GPU baselines at practical context lengths (n >= 4K).
papers.abstract_cn: 长上下文 LLM 推理的瓶颈不是计算，而是在每个解码步骤中扫描 KV 缓存的 O(n) 内存带宽开销——这是一堵任何算法缩放都无法突破的墙。最近的光子加速器已经展示了令人印象深刻的密集注意力计算吞吐量;然而，当应用于长上下文时，这些方法继承了与电子注意力相同的 O(n) 内存缩放。我们观察到，真正的杠杆点是粗略的块选择步骤：一个内存绑定的最近邻搜索，它决定要获取哪些 KV 块。我们首次确定，这个任务在结构上与光子广播和权重范式相匹配——查询通过被动分裂向所有候选者传播，签名是准静态的 (匹配电光 MRR 编程)，并且只有等级顺序重要 (将精度放松到 4-6 位)。关键是，光子优势随着上下文长度的增加而增长：随着 N 的增加，电子扫描成本线性增加，而光子评估保持 O(1)。我们在 PRISM(通过内产品相似性对微环权重进行光子排名) 中实例化了这一见解，PRISM 是一个薄膜铌酸锂 (TFLN) 相似性引擎。在 Qwen2.5-7B 上进行的硬件损坏的干草堆中的针状评估证实，在 k=32 的情况下，从 4K 到 64K 令牌的准确率为 100%，在 64K 的上下文中流量减少了 16 倍。在实际上下文长度 (n>=4K) 下，PRISM 比 GPU 基线实现了四个数量级的能量优势。
papers.comment: 28 pages, 27 figures, 15 tables, including supplementary material. Code available at https://github.com/hyoseokp/PRISM
papers.ai_summary_en: PRISM addresses the O(n) KV-cache memory-bandwidth wall in long-context LLM decoding by targeting the coarse block-selection similarity search rather than full dense attention. It exploits the photonic broadcast-and-weight paradigm in a thin-film lithium niobate microring similarity engine, where queries are passively broadcast to quasi-static KV-block signatures and only low-precision ranking is needed, making selection cost O(1) as context grows. Hardware-impaired evaluations on Qwen2.5-7B show 100% needle-in-a-haystack accuracy from 4K to 64K tokens at k=32, with 16× KV traffic reduction at 64K and roughly four orders of magnitude energy advantage over GPU baselines for contexts ≥4K.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对长上下文 LLM 推理中每步扫描 KV Cache 带来的 O(n) 内存带宽瓶颈，提出关键洞见：真正适合光子加速的不是密集注意力计算，而是粗粒度 KV 块选择这一相似性搜索任务。  

其核心方法 PRISM 利用薄膜铌酸锂微环权重实现广播式内积排序，以 O(1) 光子并行评估替代电子线性扫描，并因仅需排序而可容忍 4–6 bit 低精度与硬件损伤。  

在 Qwen2.5-7B 的 needle-in-a-haystack 测试中，PRISM 在 4K–64K 上下文、k=32 下保持 100% 准确率，64K 时减少 16 倍访存量，并在 n≥4K 场景相较 GPU 取得约四个数量级能效优势。

papers.title: IEMAS: An Incentive-Efficiency Routing Framework for Open Agentic Web Ecosystems
papers.abstract_en: The transition to open, distributed Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) promises scalable intelligence but introduces a non-trivial tension: maximizing global efficiency requires cooperative, resource-aware scheduling, yet autonomous agents may be self-interested and cannot be managed by a centralized controller. Prior approaches fall short in two key areas: they typically focus on single-query routing, neglecting long-term resource reuse (e.g., KV-caching) and the complexities of system-level many-to-many matching; furthermore, they rely on generic incentive mechanisms that ignore the distinct characteristics of LLM inference. To bridge this gap, we propose IEMAS (Incentive-Efficiency Mechanism for Multi-Agent Systems), a distributed framework that aligns economic incentives with system performance. IEMAS integrates a probabilistic predictive model to estimate Quality of Service (QoS) under uncertainty, which feeds into a VCG-based bipartite matching mechanism. This design guarantees truthful capability reporting and social optimality while explicitly leveraging KV cache-affinity to minimize computational redundancy. We implement IEMAS on top of vLLM and evaluate it via extensive simulations. Results demonstrate that our incentive-efficiency co-design reducing average service cost by 35% and end-to-end latency by up to 2.9compared to baselines.
papers.abstract_cn: 向开放、分布式多智能体系统 (MAS) 的过渡承诺了可扩展的智能，但也带来了一个非同小可的压力：最大化全局效率需要协作、资源感知的调度，然而自主智能体可能会自利，无法由中央控制器管理。先前的方法在两个关键领域存在不足：它们通常专注于单查询路由，忽略了长期的资源重用 (例如 KV 缓存) 和系统级别的多对多匹配的复杂性;此外，它们依赖于通用激励机制，而忽略了 LLM 推理的独特特征。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了 IEMAS(多智能体系统激励效率机制)，这是一个将经济激励与系统绩效相结合的分布式框架。IEMAS 集成了一个概率预测模型，用于估计不确定情况下的服务质量 (QoS)，这将信息输入到基于 VCG 的双方匹配机制中。该设计确保了真实的能力报告和社会最优性，同时明确利用 KV 缓存亲和力来最小化计算冗余。我们在 vLLM 之上实施 IEMAS，并通过广泛的模拟对其进行评估。结果表明，与基准相比，我们的激励 - 效率联合设计将平均服务成本降低了 35%，端到端延迟降低了高达 2.9。
papers.ai_summary_en: IEMAS addresses decentralized LLM-serving routing in open multi-agent ecosystems where self-interested agents cannot be centrally controlled and existing routers ignore long-term KV-cache reuse and many-to-many matching. It combines probabilistic QoS estimation with a VCG-based bipartite matching mechanism that incentivizes truthful capability reporting, achieves socially optimal assignments, and explicitly exploits KV-cache affinity to reduce redundant computation. Implemented over vLLM, simulations show about 35% lower average service cost and up to 2.9× lower end-to-end latency versus baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对开放分布式多智能体 LLM 服务中自治节点自利、缺乏中心调度，且现有路由忽略 KV-cache 复用与多对多匹配的问题。其提出 IEMAS 框架，通过概率化 QoS 预测驱动基于 VCG 的双边匹配机制，在激励真实报告和社会最优的同时利用 KV-cache 亲和性降低重复计算。实验显示，该方法可将平均服务成本降低 35%，并将端到端延迟最高提升约 2.9 倍。

papers.title: The xPU-athalon: Quantifying the Competition of AI Acceleration
papers.abstract_en: The push for greater efficiency in AI computation has given rise to an array of accelerator architectures that increasingly challenge the GPU's long-standing dominance. In this work, we provide a quantitative view of this evolving landscape of AI accelerators, including the Cerebras CS-3, SambaNova SN-40, Groq, Gaudi, and TPUv5e platforms, and compare against both NVIDIA (A100, H100) and AMD (MI-300X) GPUs. We evaluate key trade-offs in latency, throughput, power consumption, and energy-efficiency across both (i) end-to-end workloads and (ii) benchmarks of individual computational primitives. Notably, we find the optimal hardware platform varies across batch size, sequence length, and model size, revealing a large underlying optimization space. Our analysis includes detailed power measurements across the prefill and decode phases of LLM inference, as well as quantification of the energy cost of communication. We additionally find that Cerebras, SambaNova, and Gaudi have 10-60% higher idle power than NVIDIA and AMD GPUs, emphasizing the importance of high utilization in order to realize promised efficiency gains. Finally, we assess programmability across platforms based on our experiments with real profiled workloads, comparing the compilation times and software stack maturity required to achieve promised performance.
papers.abstract_cn: 人工智能计算中追求更高效率的努力催生了一系列加速器架构，这些架构日益挑战 GPU 长期以来的主导地位。在本文中，我们提供了这种不断发展的人工智能加速器格局的定量视图，包括 Cerebras CS-3、SambaNova SN-40、Groq、Gaudi 和 TPUv5e 平台，并与 NVIDIA(A100、H100) 和 AMD(MI-300X) GPU 进行了比较。我们评估了 (i) 端到端工作负载和 (ii) 单个计算基元的基准测试在延迟、吞吐量、功耗和能效方面的关键权衡。值得注意的是，我们发现最佳硬件平台在批处理大小、序列长度和模型大小上存在差异，揭示了一个巨大的潜在优化空间。我们的分析包括 LLM 推理预填充和解码阶段的详细功耗测量，以及通信能耗成本的量化。我们还发现 Cerebras、SambaNova 和 Gaudi 的空闲功耗比 NVIDIA 和 AMD GPU 高出 10-60%，强调了高利用率的重要性，以实现承诺的效率提升。最后，我们根据实际工作负载的实验，评估跨平台的可编程性，比较编译时间和软件栈成熟度以实现承诺的性能。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the lack of systematic, workload-aware comparisons among emerging AI accelerators and GPUs for LLM inference, focusing on latency, throughput, power, and energy efficiency. It benchmarks Cerebras CS-3, SambaNova SN-40, Groq, Gaudi, TPUv5e, NVIDIA A100/H100, and AMD MI-300X using end-to-end LLM serving workloads and primitive-level tests, with detailed measurements across batch size, sequence length, model size, prefill/decode phases, and communication costs. The study finds that no single platform dominates universally, that efficiency depends strongly on workload configuration and utilization, and that higher idle power and software-stack maturity gaps can limit the practical gains of non-GPU accelerators.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理服务中多种AI加速器缺乏统一量化比较的问题，系统评测了Cerebras、SambaNova、Groq、Gaudi、TPUv5e以及NVIDIA/AMD GPU在延迟、吞吐、功耗和能效上的表现。其核心洞见是：最优硬件高度依赖批大小、序列长度和模型规模，并需区分prefill、decode及通信开销；同时部分专用加速器空闲功耗比GPU高10–60%，只有高利用率才能兑现能效优势。论文还进一步比较了编译时间与软件栈成熟度，为实际部署中的硬件选型和系统优化提供了实证依据。

papers.title: WaveTune: Wave-aware Bilinear Modeling for Efficient GPU Kernel Auto-tuning
papers.abstract_en: The rapid adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) has made GPU inference efficiency an increasingly critical system concern. The runtime of LLM workloads is largely dominated by tile-based kernels, particularly General Matrix Multiplications (GEMMs). Although these kernels are highly optimized, their performance remains sensitive to a large space of runtime parameters, such as tile sizes and pipeline stages. The interaction between these parameters and hardware resources leads to a non-convex optimization landscape. Existing approaches to parameter configuration -- including search-based auto-tuning, heuristic rules, and learned cost models -- face a fundamental trade-off between performance optimality and runtime efficiency.In this paper, we present WaveTune, a wave-aware framework for runtime kernel auto-tuning. First, we introduce a unified mapping method to handle input diversity and decompose the configuration space to manage high dimensionality. Second, we develop an analytical wave-aware bilinear model that accurately predicts kernel latency. Third, we design a sparse sampling scheme based on wave structures and a lightweight dual-table retrieval mechanism to minimize runtime overhead. As a result, WaveTune enables precise and efficient runtime configuration for GPU kernels. Across three representative kernels and five GPU architectures, WaveTune consistently achieves near-optimal kernel performance, delivering up to 1.83x kernel-level speedup and up to 1.33x end-to-end TTFT reduction, while reducing runtime decision overhead by five orders of magnitude compared to exhaustive search. These results demonstrate that WaveTune effectively eliminates the traditional trade-off between configuration latency and execution optimality, providing a practical and robust solution for high-performance LLM inference.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型 (LLMs) 的快速采用使得 GPU 推理效率成为越来越关键的系统问题。LLM 工作负载的运行时主要由基于瓦片的内核主导，特别是通用矩阵乘法 (GEMMs) 内核。尽管这些内核经过高度优化，但它们的性能仍然对大量运行时参数敏感，例如瓦片大小和管道阶段。这些参数与硬件资源之间的相互作用导致了非凸优化景观。现有的参数配置方法——包括基于搜索的自动调优、启发式规则和学习成本模型——面临着性能优化和运行时效率之间的根本权衡。在本文中，我们提出了 WaveTune，一种用于运行时内核自动调优的波感知框架。首先，我们引入了一种统一的映射方法来处理输入多样性并分解位形空间以管理高维度。其次，我们开发了一个分析性的波感知双线性模型，可以准确地预测内核延迟。第三，我们设计了一个基于波结构的稀疏采样方案和一个轻量级的双表检索机制，以最大限度地减少运行时开销。因此，WaveTune 为 GPU 内核提供了精确高效的运行时配置。在三个代表性内核和五种 GPU 架构中，WaveTune 始终实现近乎最优的内核性能，提供了高达 1.83 倍的内核级加速和高达 1.33 倍的端到端 TTFT 减少，同时与穷举搜索相比，减少了五个数量级的运行时决策开销。这些结果表明，WaveTune 有效地消除了传统的配置延迟与执行最优性之间的权衡，为高性能 LLM 推理提供了一种实用且稳健的解决方案。
papers.ai_summary_en: WaveTune addresses runtime auto-tuning of GPU tile-based kernels for LLM inference, where parameters such as tile sizes and pipeline stages interact with hardware resources to create a non-convex latency optimization problem. It introduces a wave-aware bilinear latency model with unified input mapping and configuration-space decomposition, combined with sparse wave-structure sampling and a lightweight dual-table retrieval mechanism for low-overhead configuration selection. Across three kernels and five GPU architectures, WaveTune achieves near-optimal kernel performance with up to 1.83× kernel speedup and 1.33× end-to-end TTFT reduction while reducing tuning overhead by five orders of magnitude versus exhaustive search.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对 LLM 推理中 GEMM 等 tile-based GPU kernel 因 tile size、pipeline stage 等参数与硬件资源复杂交互而难以高效调优的问题。  
提出 WaveTune，通过统一输入映射与配置空间分解、wave-aware 双线性延迟模型，以及基于 wave 结构的稀疏采样和轻量双表检索，实现低开销的运行时 kernel 自动调优。  
在三类 kernel 和五种 GPU 上，WaveTune 达到近最优性能，最高带来 1.83× kernel 加速和 1.33× 端到端 TTFT 降低，并将调优决策开销比穷举搜索降低五个数量级。

papers.title: Watt Counts: Energy-Aware Benchmark for Sustainable LLM Inference on Heterogeneous GPU Architectures
papers.abstract_en: While the large energy consumption of Large Language Models (LLMs) is recognized by the community, system operators lack guidance for energy-efficient LLM inference deployments that leverage energy trade-offs of heterogeneous hardware due to a lack of energy-aware benchmarks and data. In this work we address this gap with Watt Counts: the largest open-access dataset of energy consumption of LLMs, with over 5,000 experiments for 50 LLMs across 10 NVIDIA Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) in batch and server scenarios along with a reproducible, open-source benchmark that enables community submissions to expand this dataset. Leveraging this dataset, we conduct a system-level study of LLM inference across heterogeneous GPU architectures and show that GPU selection is crucial for energy efficiency outcomes and that optimal hardware choices vary significantly across models and deployment scenarios, demonstrating the critical importance of hardware-aware deployment in heterogeneous LLM systems. Guided by our data and insights, we show that practitioners can reduce energy consumption by up to 70% in server scenarios with negligible impact on user experience, and by up to 20% in batch scenarios.
papers.abstract_cn: 虽然大语言模型 (LLM) 的大能耗得到了社区的认可，但由于缺乏能量感知基准和数据，系统运营商缺乏关于能效大语言模型推理部署的指导，这些推理部署利用了异构硬件的能量权衡。在本文中，我们通过 Watt Counts 解决了这一差距：这是大语言模型能耗的最大开放访问数据集，在批处理和服务器场景中对 10 个 NVIDIA 图形处理单元 (GPU) 上的 50 个大语言模型进行了超过 5000 次实验，并提供了一个可重复的开源基准，使社区提交内容能够扩展这个数据集。利用这个数据集，我们对异构 GPU 架构中的 LLM 推理进行了系统级研究，并表明 GPU 选择对能效结果至关重要，最佳硬件选择在不同模型和部署场景中存在显著差异，证明了异构 LLM 系统中硬件感知部署的关键重要性。根据我们的数据和见解，我们表明，从业者在服务器场景中可以减少高达 70% 的能耗，而对用户体验的影响可以忽略不计，在批处理场景中可以减少高达 20%。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the lack of energy-aware benchmarks and deployment guidance for LLM inference across heterogeneous GPU architectures. It introduces Watt Counts, an open-source benchmark and large open-access energy dataset with over 5,000 runs of 50 LLMs on 10 NVIDIA GPUs in batch and server settings, enabling system-level analysis of hardware–model–scenario energy trade-offs. The study shows that GPU selection strongly affects efficiency and that hardware-aware serving can reduce energy consumption by up to 70% in server scenarios with negligible user impact and up to 20% in batch workloads.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对LLM推理缺乏能耗基准、难以在异构GPU上实现节能部署的问题，论文提出开源基准Watt Counts，构建了覆盖50个模型、10款NVIDIA GPU以及批处理/在线服务场景的5000余项能耗实验数据集。其核心洞见是LLM推理能效高度依赖“模型—GPU—部署场景”的组合，最优硬件选择差异显著，必须进行硬件感知部署。结果表明，在几乎不影响用户体验的前提下，在线服务场景最高可降低70%能耗，批处理场景最高可降低20%。

papers.title: Flux Attention: Context-Aware Hybrid Attention for Efficient LLMs Inference
papers.abstract_en: The quadratic computational complexity of standard attention mechanisms presents a severe scalability bottleneck for LLMs in long-context scenarios. While hybrid attention mechanisms combining Full Attention (FA) and Sparse Attention (SA) offer a potential solution, existing methods typically rely on static allocation ratios that fail to accommodate the variable retrieval demands of different tasks. Furthermore, head-level dynamic sparsity often introduces severe computational load imbalance and synchronization long-tails, which hinder hardware acceleration during autoregressive decoding. To bridge this gap, we introduce Flux Attention, a context-aware framework that dynamically optimizes attention computation at the layer level. By integrating a lightweight Layer Router into frozen pretrained LLMs, the proposed method adaptively routes each layer to FA or SA based on the input context. This layer-wise routing preserves high-fidelity information retrieval while ensuring contiguous memory access, translating theoretical computational reductions into practical wall-clock speedups. As a parameter-efficient approach, our framework requires only 12 hours of training on 8$\times$A800 GPUs. Extensive experiments across multiple long-context and mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that Flux Attention achieves a superior trade-off between performance and inference speed compared with baseline models, with speed improvements of up to $2.8\times$ and $2.0\times$ in the prefill and decode stages.
papers.abstract_cn: 标准注意力机制的二次计算复杂性为长上下文场景中的 LLM 提供了严重的可扩展性瓶颈。尽管混合注意力机制结合全注意力 (FA) 和稀疏注意力 (SA) 提供了一种潜在的解决方案，但现有方法通常依赖于静态分配比率，无法适应不同任务的可变检索需求。此外，头级动态稀疏性通常会引起严重的计算负载不平衡和同步长尾，这阻碍了自回归解码过程中的硬件加速。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了 Flux Attention，这是一种上下文感知框架，可以在层级动态优化注意力计算。该方法通过将轻量级层路由器集成到冷冻预训练 LLM 中，根据输入上下文自适应地将每层路由到 FA 或 SA。这种逐层路由方式在保证连续内存访问的同时保持了高保真度的信息检索，将理论计算量的减少转化为实际的墙钟加速。作为一种参数高效的方法，我们的框架只需要在 8××A800 GPU 上进行 12 小时的训练。跨多个长背景和数学推理基准的广泛实验表明，与基准模型相比，Flux Attention 在性能和推理速度之间实现了更优的权衡，在预填充和解码阶段速度提高了高达 2.8××和 2.0××。
papers.ai_summary_en: Flux Attention addresses the quadratic cost of standard attention in long-context LLM inference and the inefficiency of static full/sparse attention hybrids, as well as head-level dynamic sparsity that causes load imbalance and synchronization long-tails. It introduces a lightweight layer router added to frozen pretrained LLMs that adaptively selects full or sparse attention per layer based on input context, preserving retrieval fidelity while maintaining contiguous memory access for hardware-efficient decoding. Experiments on long-context and mathematical reasoning benchmarks show a strong accuracy–speed tradeoff, achieving up to 2.8× prefill and 2.0× decode speedups with only 12 hours of training on 8×A800 GPUs.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 推理中标准注意力二次复杂度过高、现有混合注意力静态分配且头级动态稀疏易造成负载不均的问题展开研究。其核心方法是提出 Flux Attention，在冻结预训练模型中加入轻量级 Layer Router，根据输入上下文在层级动态选择全注意力或稀疏注意力，从而兼顾检索精度与连续内存访问效率。实验显示，该方法在长上下文和数学推理任务上实现更优的性能-速度权衡，prefill 和 decode 阶段最高分别加速 2.8 倍和 2.0 倍。

papers.title: DAT: Dual-Aware Adaptive Transmission for Efficient Multimodal LLM Inference in Edge-Cloud Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong capability in semantic understanding and visual reasoning, yet their use on continuous video streams in bandwidth-constrained edge-cloud systems incurs prohibitive computation and communication overhead and hinders low-latency alerting and effective visual evidence delivery. To address this challenge, we propose DAT to achieve high-quality semantic generation, low-latency event alerting, and effective visual evidence supplementation. To reduce unnecessary deep reasoning costs, we propose a collaborative small-large model cascade. A lightweight edge-side small model acts as a gating module to filter non-target-event frames and perform object detection, triggering MLLM inference only for suspicious frames. Building on this, we introduce an efficient fine-tuning strategy with visual guidance and semantic prompting, which improves structured event understanding, object detection, and output consistency. To ensure low-latency semantic alerting and effective visual evidence supplementation under bandwidth constraints, we further devise a semantics and bandwidth-aware multi-stream adaptive transmission optimization method.
