Experimental results show that DAT achieves 98.83% recognition accuracy and 100% output consistency. Under severe congestion, it reduces weighted semantic alert delay by up to 77.5% and delivers 98.33% of visual evidence within 0.5 s, demonstrating the effectiveness of jointly optimizing cascade inference and elastic transmission.
papers.abstract_cn: 多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 在语义理解和视觉推理方面表现出强大的能力，然而，在带宽受限的边缘云系统中，它们在连续视频流上的应用带来了高昂的计算和通信开销，并阻碍了低延迟警报和有效的视觉证据传递。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 DAT 来实现高质量的语义生成、低延迟的事件警报和有效的视觉证据补充。为了降低不必要的深度推理成本，我们提出了一个协作的小型 - 大型模型级联。一个轻量级的边缘侧小型模型充当门模块，过滤非目标事件帧并执行目标检测，只对可疑帧触发 MLLM 推理。在此基础上，提出了一种具有视觉引导和语义提示的高效微调策略，提高了结构化事件理解、目标检测和输出一致性。为了在带宽约束下保证低延迟的语义警报和有效的视觉证据补充，进一步设计了一种语义和带宽感知的多流自适应传输优化方法。实验结果表明，DAT 达到了 98.83% 的识别准确率和 100% 的输出一致性。在严重拥塞情况下，该方法将加权语义警报延迟降低了 77.5%，在 0.5s 内提供了 98.33% 的视觉证据，证明了联合优化级联推理和弹性传输的有效性。
papers.comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to ACM Multimedia 2026
papers.ai_summary_en: DAT addresses the high computation and communication overhead of running multimodal LLMs on continuous video streams in bandwidth-constrained edge–cloud systems, where low-latency event alerting and timely visual evidence delivery are critical. It introduces a small–large edge-cloud model cascade that uses a lightweight edge model to filter frames and trigger MLLM inference only for suspicious events, combined with visual-guidance and semantic-prompt fine-tuning plus a semantics- and bandwidth-aware multi-stream adaptive transmission scheme. Experiments show 98.83% recognition accuracy and 100% output consistency, while reducing weighted semantic alert delay by up to 77.5% under severe congestion and delivering 98.33% of visual evidence within 0.5 seconds.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对带宽受限的边缘-云系统中，多模态大模型处理连续视频流时计算与通信开销过高、难以实现低延迟告警和视觉证据及时回传的问题。提出 DAT 方法，通过边缘小模型过滤非关键帧并按需触发云端大模型推理，并结合视觉引导与语义提示微调，以及语义和带宽感知的多流自适应传输优化，实现高效推理与弹性传输。实验表明，该方法达到 98.83% 识别准确率和 100% 输出一致性，在严重拥塞下可将加权语义告警延迟降低 77.5%，并在 0.5 秒内交付 98.33% 的视觉证据。

papers.title: GPU Acceleration of TFHE-Based High-Precision Nonlinear Layers for Encrypted LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Deploying large language models (LLMs) as cloud services raises privacy concerns as inference may leak sensitive data. Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) allows computation on encrypted data, but current FHE methods struggle with efficient and precise nonlinear function evaluation. Specifically, CKKS-based approaches require high-degree polynomial approximations, which are costly when target precision increases. Alternatively, TFHE's Programmable Bootstrapping (PBS) outperforms CKKS by offering exact lookup-table evaluation. But it lacks high-precision implementations of LLM nonlinear layers and underutilizes GPU resources.We propose \emph{TIGER}, the first GPU-accelerated framework for high-precision TFHE-based nonlinear LLM layer evaluation. TIGER offers: (1) GPU-optimized WoP-PBS method combined with numerical algorithms to surpass native lookup-table precision limits on nonlinear functions; (2) high-precision and efficient implementations of key nonlinear layers, enabling practical encrypted inference; (3) batch-driven design exploiting inter-input parallelism to boost GPU efficiency. TIGER achieves 7.17$\times$, 16.68$\times$, and 17.05$\times$ speedups over a CPU baseline for GELU, Softmax, and LayerNorm, respectively.
papers.abstract_cn: 将大语言模型 (LLM) 部署为云服务会引起隐私问题，因为推理可能会泄露敏感数据。完全同态加密 (FHE) 允许对加密数据进行计算，但目前的 FHE 方法在高效和精确的非线性函数评估方面存在挑战。具体而言，基于 CKKS 的方法需要高度多项式近似，当目标精度提高时，这种近似代价高昂。或者，TFHE 的可编程自助法 (PBS) 通过提供精确的查找表评估，性能优于 CKKS。但它缺乏 LLM 非线性层的高精度实现，并且未充分利用 GPU 资源。我们提出了\emph{TIGER}，这是第一个用于高精度 TFHE 基础非线性 LLM 层评估的 GPU 加速框架。TIGER 提供:(1) GPU 优化的 WoP-PBS 方法与数值算法相结合，超越了非线性函数的原生查找表精度限制;(2) 高精度和高效地实现关键非线性层，实现实用的加密推理;(3) 利用输入间并行性的批量驱动设计，提高 GPU 效率。TIGER 分别为 GELU、Softmax 和 LayerNorm 实现了 7.17 美元、16.68 美元和 17.05 美元的 CPU 基准加速。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses privacy-preserving LLM inference by making fully homomorphic encryption practical for high-precision nonlinear layers, where CKKS polynomial approximations are expensive and TFHE programmable bootstrapping lacks GPU-efficient high-precision kernels. TIGER introduces a GPU-accelerated TFHE framework that combines an optimized WoP-PBS pipeline with numerical algorithms to exceed native lookup-table precision and implements batch-parallel GELU, Softmax, and LayerNorm kernels. It achieves 7.17×, 16.68×, and 17.05× speedups over CPU baselines on these layers, improving the feasibility of encrypted LLM serving.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对加密大模型推理中全同态加密非线性层难以兼顾高精度与高效率的问题，提出首个 GPU 加速的 TFHE 框架 TIGER，通过 GPU 优化的 WoP-PBS 和数值算法突破查找表精度限制，并实现 GELU、Softmax、LayerNorm 等关键层。其批驱动并行设计显著提升 GPU 利用率，相较 CPU 基线分别取得 7.17×、16.68× 和 17.05× 加速，为高精度加密 LLM 推理提供了更实用的路径。

papers.title: Communication-Efficient Collaborative LLM Inference over LEO Satellite Networks
papers.abstract_en: Low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites play an essential role in intelligent Earth observation by leveraging artificial intelligence models. However, limited onboard memory and excessive inference delay prevent the practical deployment of large language models (LLMs) on a single satellite. In this paper, we propose a communication-efficient collaborative LLM inference scheme for LEO satellite networks. Specifically, the entire LLM is split into multiple sub-models, with each deployed on a satellite, thereby enabling collaborative LLM inference via exchanging intermediate activations between satellites. The proposed scheme also leverages the pipeline parallelism mechanism that overlaps sub-model inference with intermediate activation transmission, thereby reducing LLM inference delay. An adaptive activation compression scheme is designed to mitigate cumulative errors from multi-stage model splitting while preserving inference accuracy. Furthermore, we formulate the LLM inference delay minimization problem by jointly optimizing model splitting and compression ratios under onboard memory and inference accuracy constraints. The problem is transformed into a shortest-path search problem over a directed acyclic graph that edge weights explicitly quantify the inference delay induced by model splitting and compression strategies, which is solved via a modified A Star-based search algorithm. Extensive simulation results indicate that the proposed solution can reduce inference delay by up to 42% and communication overhead by up to 71% compared to state-of-the-art benchmarks, while maintaining the inference accuracy loss of less than 1%.
papers.abstract_cn: 低地球轨道 (LEO) 卫星通过利用人工智能模型在智能地球观测中发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，有限的机载内存和过度的推理延迟阻碍了大语言模型 (LLMs) 在单颗卫星上的实际部署。在本文中，我们提出了一种通信高效的低地球轨道卫星网络协同 LLM 推理方案。具体而言，整个 LLM 被划分为多个子模型，每个子模型部署在一颗卫星上，从而通过卫星之间交换中间激活来实现协同 LLM 推理。该方案还利用了管道并行机制，该机制将子模型推理与中间激活传输重叠，从而减少了 LLM 推理延迟。设计了一种自适应激活压缩方案，以减少多阶段模型分裂导致的累积误差，同时保持推理准确性。此外，我们通过在内存和推理准确度约束下联合优化模型分裂和压缩比，构造了 LLM 推理延迟最小化问题。该问题被转化为有向无环图上的最短路径搜索问题，边权明确量化了模型分裂和压缩策略引起的推理延迟，并通过改进的基于 A 星的搜索算法进行求解。广泛的仿真结果表明，与最先进的基准测试相比，所提出的解决方案可以将推理延迟降低高达 42%，通信开销降低高达 71%，同时保持推理准确度损失小于 1%。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper tackles the memory and latency limitations of running LLMs on individual LEO satellites by enabling collaborative inference across a satellite constellation. It proposes pipeline-parallel model splitting with overlapped computation and activation transmission, adaptive activation compression to control cumulative error, and a joint optimization of splitting and compression formulated as a DAG shortest-path problem solved by a modified A* search. Simulations show up to 42% lower inference delay and 71% less communication overhead than state-of-the-art baselines while keeping accuracy loss below 1%.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对低轨卫星因内存受限和推理延迟过高而难以单星部署大语言模型的问题，提出面向LEO卫星网络的通信高效协作LLM推理方案。其核心方法是将模型切分为多个子模型分布部署，并通过流水线并行重叠计算与激活传输，同时设计自适应激活压缩并联合优化切分与压缩策略，以在内存和精度约束下最小化延迟。仿真结果表明，该方案相比现有方法可将推理延迟降低最高42%、通信开销降低最高71%，且精度损失小于1%。

papers.title: Understand and Accelerate Memory Processing Pipeline for Disaggregated LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Modern large language models (LLMs) increasingly depends on efficient long-context processing and generation mechanisms, including sparse attention, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and compressed contextual memory, to support complex reasoning. We show that these optimizations can be unified into a four-step memory processing pipeline: Prepare Memory, Compute Relevancy, Retrieval, and Apply to Inference. Through systematic profiling, we identify a 22%-97% memory processing overhead in LLM inference and strong heterogeneity in its computational characteristics. Motivated by this insight, we argue that \textbf{heterogeneous systems} are well-suited to accelerate memory processing and thus end-to-end inference. We demonstrate this approach on a GPU-FPGA system by offloading sparse, irregular, and memory-bounded operations to FPGAs while retaining compute-intensive operations on GPUs. Evaluated on an AMD MI210 GPU and an Alveo U55C FPGA, our system is up to $2.2\times$ faster and achieves up to $4.7\times$ less energy across multiple LLM inference optimizations than the GPU baseline (similar results hold on NVIDIA A100). These results establish heterogeneous systems as a practical direction for efficient LLM memory processing and inform future heterogeneous hardware design.
papers.abstract_cn: 现代大语言模型 (LLMs) 越来越依赖于高效的长上下文处理和生成机制，包括稀疏注意力、检索增强生成 (RAG) 和压缩上下文记忆，以支持复杂的推理。我们表明，这些优化可以统一为四步记忆处理流水线：准备记忆、计算相关性、检索和应用于推理。通过系统分析，我们确定了 LLM 推理中 22%-97% 的记忆处理开销，以及其计算特征的强异质性。基于这一见解，我们认为\textbf{异质系统}非常适合加速记忆处理，从而实现端到端的推理。我们在 GPU-FPGA 系统上演示了这种方法，将稀疏、不规则和内存受限的操作卸载到 FPGA 中，同时保留 GPU 上的计算密集型操作。在 AMD MI210 GPU 和 Alveo U55C FPGA 上进行评估后，我们的系统速度提高了 2.2 倍，并在多个 LLM 推理优化中实现了比 GPU 基准低 4.7 倍的能耗 (类似的结果也适用于 NVIDIA A100)。这些结果建立了异构系统作为高效 LLM 内存处理的实际方向，并为未来的异构硬件设计提供了指导。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles the substantial memory-processing overhead in long-context LLM inference, showing that mechanisms such as sparse attention, RAG, and compressed contextual memory can consume 22%–97% of serving time and exhibit highly heterogeneous computational behavior. It proposes unifying these mechanisms into a four-stage pipeline—Prepare Memory, Compute Relevancy, Retrieval, and Apply to Inference—and accelerating it on a GPU–FPGA heterogeneous system by offloading sparse, irregular, memory-bound operations to the FPGA while keeping dense compute on the GPU. Evaluations on an AMD MI210 with an Alveo U55C, with comparable results on an NVIDIA A100, achieve up to 2.2× higher throughput and up to 4.7× lower energy than GPU-only baselines, establishing heterogeneous acceleration as a practical direction for efficient LLM serving.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对LLM推理中稀疏注意力、RAG和压缩记忆等长上下文机制造成的显著且异构的内存处理开销（22%–97%），将其统一为内存准备、相关性计算、检索和推理应用四阶段流水线。核心洞见是这些操作在稀疏性、规则性和计算/访存特征上高度异构，适合由GPU-FPGA异构系统分工：GPU处理密集计算，FPGA卸载稀疏、不规则且访存受限的步骤。实验在AMD MI210+Alveo U55C（以及A100）上最高实现2.2倍加速和4.7倍能效提升，表明确立了异构硬件作为高效LLM内存处理的可行方向。

papers.title: ITQ3_S: High-Fidelity 3-bit LLM Inference via Interleaved Ternary Quantization with Rotation-Domain Smoothing
papers.abstract_en: We present ITQ3_S (Interleaved Ternary Quantization -- Specialized), a novel 3-bit weight quantization format for LLMs integrating TurboQuant (TQ), a rotation-domain strategy based on the Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform (FWHT). Conventional 3-bit methods suffer precision loss from heavy-tailed weight distributions and inter-channel outliers. ITQ3_S pre-rotates the weight space via FWHT before quantization, spreading outlier energy across the vector and inducing a near-Gaussian distribution amenable to uniform ternary coding.We derive a rigorous dequantization procedure fusing a 256-point Inverse FWHT into the CUDA shared-memory loading stage, ensuring reconstruction error is bounded exclusively by the ternary quantization grid with no additional error from the transform inversion. For any weight vector $\mathbf{w} \in \mathbb{R}^{256}$, the reconstruction satisfies $\|\hat{\mathbf{w}} - \mathbf{w}\|_2 \leq \epsilon_q$, strictly smaller than uniform 3-bit baselines that do not exploit rotation-induced distribution normalization.TurboQuant lacks a native CUDA kernel, precluding direct deployment; naively composing TQ with existing weight quantizers introduces domain mismatch errors that accumulate across layers, degrading quality below standard 3-bit baselines. ITQ3_S resolves this by co-designing the FWHT rotation and quantization kernel as a unified pipeline grounded in the IQ3_S weight format, with the inverse transform fused into the CUDA MMQ kernel.Empirically, on the NVIDIA RTX 5090 (Blackwell), ITQ3_S achieves perplexity competitive with FP16 while delivering throughput exceeding 1.5x that of 4-bit alternatives via optimized DP4A and Tensor Core scheduling. Our results establish ITQ3_S as a practical, mathematically grounded solution for high-fidelity LLM deployment on consumer hardware.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们提出了 ITQ3_S(交织三元量化——Specialized)，这是一种新的 3 位权重量化格式，适用于集成 TurboQuant(TQ) 的 LLM，它是一种基于快速沃尔什 - 阿达马变换 (FWHT) 的旋转域策略。传统的 3 位方法受到重尾权重分布和通道间异常值的影响，导致精度损失。ITQ3_S 在量子化之前通过 FWHT 预旋转权重空间，在向量中传播离群值能量，并诱导出一个适用于均匀三元编码的近似正态分布。我们推导出一个严格的去量子化过程，将 256 点逆 FWHT 融合到 CUDA 共享内存加载阶段，确保重建误差仅限于三元量子化网格，而不会有来自变换逆的额外误差。对于任何权重向量$\mathbf{w}\in \mathbb{R}^{256}$，重建满足$\|\hat{\mathbf{w}}-\mathbf{w}\|_2 \leq\epsilon_q$，严格小于不利用旋转诱导的正态分布归一化的均匀 3 位基线。TurboQuant 缺乏原生的 CUDA 内核，排除了直接部署的可能性;天真地使用现有权重量化器组合 TQ 会引入域失配误差，这些误差会在各层之间积累，导致质量降低到标准 3 位基线以下。ITQ3_S 通过共同设计 FWHT 旋转和量化内核作为一个基于 IQ3_S 权重格式的统一管道来解决这个问题，并将逆变换融合到 CUDA MMQ 内核中。实验结果表明，在 NVIDIA RTX 5090(Blackwell) 上，ITQ3_S 实现了与 FP16 的复杂性竞争，同时通过优化的 DP4A 和 Tensor Core 调度，提供的吞吐量超过 4 位替代方案的 1.5 倍。我们的研究结果将 ITQ3_S 确立为一种实用的、基于数学的解决方案，用于在消费级硬件上实现高保真 LLM 部署。
papers.ai_summary_en: ITQ3_S addresses the accuracy degradation of 3-bit LLM weight quantization caused by heavy-tailed weight distributions, inter-channel outliers, and deployment gaps in rotation-based quantizers. It combines FWHT-based weight-space rotation with interleaved ternary quantization and fuses the inverse transform into a CUDA MMQ kernel, yielding a unified IQ3_S-compatible pipeline with reconstruction error bounded by the ternary grid. On an RTX 5090, the method achieves FP16-competitive perplexity while delivering over 1.5× the throughput of 4-bit inference baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对LLM 3-bit权重量化中离群值和长尾分布导致精度下降、且旋转量化方法难以高效部署的问题，提出ITQ3_S格式。其核心洞见是利用快速Walsh-Hadamard变换对权重进行旋转域平滑，使能量分布近高斯化以便三值均匀编码，并将反变换与量化内核融合以保证误差仅来自量化网格。实验显示，在RTX 5090上其困惑度可接近FP16，同时吞吐较4-bit方案提升超过1.5倍，为消费级硬件上的高保真LLM推理提供了可行路径。

papers.title: Probabilistic Language Tries: A Unified Framework for Compression, Decision Policies, and Execution Reuse
papers.abstract_en: We introduce probabilistic language tries (PLTs), a unified representation that makes explicit the prefix structure implicitly defined by any generative model over sequences. By assigning to each outgoing edge the conditional probability of the corresponding token or action, a PLT simultaneously serves as: (i) an optimal lossless compressor via frequency-weighted interval encoding, generalizing arithmetic coding to model-conditioned distributions; (ii) a policy representation for sequential decision problems including games, search, and robotic control; and (iii) a memoization index that lets repeated inference queries be answered by structured retrieval rather than full model execution.The central technical result is a prior-guided caching theorem: under a stationary generative distribution, a PLT-guided cache achieves strictly lower expected inference cost than any empirical-frequency cache for all query counts below a threshold that grows with the concentration of the prior. This converts O(n^2) transformer attention cost into an expected cost of p_r * O(log N) + (1 - p_r) * O(n^2), where p_r is the prior-estimated reuse probability and N is the artifact store size.We further introduce a hybrid compression architecture decomposing any dataset into a PLT-covered majority and a sparse residual store, connecting arithmetic coding with Kolmogorov-style program representations and rate-distortion theory. We instantiate the framework across chess, web search, robotics, organizational workflows, and LLM inference, demonstrating that compression, decision making, and computational reuse are all derived from a single probability measure on sequence space.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们引入了概率语言尝试 (PLT)，这是一种统一的表示，它显式地表示了任何生成模型在序列上隐式定义的前缀结构。通过将相应标记或动作的条件概率分配给每个出边，PLT 同时充当:(i) 通过频率加权区间编码的最优无损压缩机，将算术编码推广到模型条件分布;(ii) 序列决策问题 (包括游戏、搜索和机器人控制) 的策略表示;以及(iii) 一个记忆索引，它允许通过结构化检索而不是完全模型执行来回答重复的推理查询。核心技术结果是一个先验引导缓存定理：在稳态生成分布下，PLT 引导缓存对于阈值以下的所有查询计数，其预期推理成本严格低于任何经验频率缓存，该阈值随着先验集中度的增加而增加。这将 O(n^2) 变压器注意力成本转换为预期成本 p_r*O(log N)+(1-p_r)*O(n^2)，其中 p_r 是先验估计的重用概率，N 是伪影存储大小。我们进一步引入了一种混合压缩架构，将任何数据集分解为 PLT 覆盖的多数和稀疏的剩余存储，将算术编码与 Kolmogorov 风格的程序表示和速率失真理论联系起来。我们在国际象棋、网络搜索、机器人、组织工作流程和 LLM 推理中实例化了该框架，证明了压缩、决策和计算重用都源于序列空间上的单一机率量测。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles redundant inference cost and fragmented representations in generative sequence systems by making the prefix structure of a sequence model explicit. It proposes probabilistic language tries (PLTs), where edges store conditional token/action probabilities, enabling a single structure to serve as an optimal lossless compressor, a sequential decision policy, and a memoization index for reusing prior computations. The main result is a prior-guided caching theorem showing that PLT-guided reuse lowers expected inference cost versus empirical-frequency caching, reducing transformer attention cost from O(n²) to p_r·O(log N) + (1−p_r)·O(n²), with demonstrated applicability across LLM serving, games, search, robotics, and workflows.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对生成式序列系统中压缩、决策与推理复用相互割裂的问题，提出概率语言 Trie（PLT），用前缀树边上的条件概率显式表示任意生成模型的序列分布。其核心洞见是同一概率结构可同时实现模型条件算术编码的最优无损压缩、序列决策策略表示，以及先验引导的推理缓存与结构化复用。理论与实验表明，PLT 缓存可在重复查询场景中将 Transformer 的期望注意力成本从 O(n²) 降低为 p_r·O(log N)+(1-p_r)·O(n²)，并统一连接压缩、决策与计算复用。

papers.title: ScePsy: Serving Agentic Workflows Using Aggregate LLM Pipelines
papers.authors: Marcel Wagenländer, Otto White, Britannio Jarrett, Pedro Silvestre, Yanda Tao, Guo Li, Huanzhou Zhu, Llúis Vilanova, Peter Pietzuch
papers.abstract_en: Agentic workflows carry out complex tasks by orchestrating multiple large language models (LLMs) and tools. Serving such workflows at a target throughput with low latency is challenging because they can be defined using arbitrary agentic frameworks and exhibit unpredictable execution times: execution may branch, fan-out, or recur in data-dependent ways. Since LLMs in workflows often outnumber available GPUs, their execution also leads to GPU oversubscription. We describe ScePsy, a new agentic serving system that efficiently schedules arbitrary multi-LLM agentic workflows onto a GPU cluster. ScePsy exploits the insight that, while agentic workflows have unpredictable end-to-end latencies, the shares of each LLM's total execution times are comparatively stable across executions. ScePsy decides on GPU allocations based on these aggregate shares: first, it profiles the LLMs under different parallelism degrees. It then uses these statistics to construct an Aggregate LLM Pipeline, which is a lightweight latency/throughput predictor for allocations. To find a GPU allocation that minimizes latency while achieving a target throughput, ScePsy uses the Aggregate LLM Pipeline to explore a search space over fractional GPU shares, tensor parallelism degrees, and replica counts. It uses a hierarchical heuristic to place the best allocation onto the GPU cluster, minimizing fragmentation, while respecting network topology constraints. Our evaluation on realistic agentic workflows shows that ScePsy achieves up to 2.4x higher throughput and 27x lower latency compared to systems that optimize LLMs independently or rely on user-specified allocations.
papers.abstract_cn: Agentic workflows通过编排多个大语言模型(LLM)和工具来执行复杂任务。在目标吞吐量下以低延迟服务这些工作流具有挑战性，因为它们可以使用任意的agentic框架定义，并表现出不可预测的执行时间：执行可能分支、扇出或以数据依赖的方式递归。由于工作流中的LLM通常多于可用GPU，其执行也会导致GPU超额订阅。我们描述了ScePsy，一个新的agentic服务系统，可以高效地将任意多LLM agentic工作流调度到GPU集群上。ScePsy利用了一个洞察：虽然agentic工作流具有不可预测的端到端延迟，但每个LLM的总执行时间份额在不同执行中相对稳定。ScePsy基于这些聚合份额决定GPU分配：首先，在不同并行度下对LLM进行性能分析，然后使用这些统计数据构建Aggregate LLM Pipeline——一个轻量级的延迟/吞吐量预测器。为了找到最小化延迟同时实现目标吞吐量的GPU分配，ScePsy使用Aggregate LLM Pipeline探索分数GPU份额、张量并行度和副本计数的搜索空间，并使用分层启发式方法将最佳分配放置到GPU集群上，最小化碎片化同时尊重网络拓扑约束。在真实的agentic工作流上的评估显示，ScePsy比独立优化LLM或依赖用户指定分配的系统实现了高达2.4倍的吞吐量和27倍的更低延迟。
papers.ai_summary_en: ScePsy addresses the problem of serving arbitrary multi-LLM agentic workflows at target throughput and low latency, where data-dependent branching, fan-out, recursion, and GPU oversubscription make scheduling difficult. Its key insight is that although end-to-end workflow latency is unpredictable, the relative execution-time shares of individual LLMs are stable; ScePsy profiles models under different parallelism settings, builds an Aggregate LLM Pipeline predictor, and searches over fractional GPU shares, tensor parallelism degrees, and replicas with topology-aware placement. On realistic agentic workflows, it achieves up to 2.4× higher throughput and 27× lower latency than systems that optimize LLMs independently or use user-specified allocations.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对多LLM智能体工作流因分支、扇出、递归等数据依赖执行而导致延迟不可预测、GPU过载的服务难题。  
ScePsy 的关键洞见是各LLM在总执行时间中的占比相对稳定，因此通过剖析构建“聚合LLM流水线”预测器，并联合搜索分数GPU份额、张量并行度和副本数，再用层次化启发式完成集群放置。  
在真实智能体工作流上，它相比独立优化LLM或人工指定分配，可最高提升2.4倍吞吐并将延迟降低27倍。

papers.title: Prefill-as-a-Service: KVCache of Next-Generation Models Could Go Cross-Datacenter
papers.authors: Ruoyu Qin, Weiran He, Yaoyu Wang, Zheming Li, Xinran Xu, Yongwei Wu, Weimin Zheng, Mingxing Zhang
papers.abstract_en: Prefill-decode (PD) disaggregation has become the standard architecture for large-scale LLM serving, but in practice its deployment boundary is still determined by KVCache transfer. In conventional dense-attention models, prefill generates huge KVCache traffics that keep prefill and decode tightly coupled within a single high-bandwidth network domain, limiting heterogeneous deployment and resource elasticity. Recent hybrid-attention architectures substantially reduce KVCache size, making cross-cluster KVCache transport increasingly plausible. However, smaller KVCache alone does not make heterogeneous cross-datacenter PD serving practical: real workloads remain bursty, request lengths are highly skewed, prefix caches are unevenly distributed, and inter-cluster bandwidth fluctuates. A naive design that fully externalizes prefill can therefore still suffer from congestion, unstable queueing, and poor utilization. We present Prefill-as-a-Service (PrfaaS), a cross-datacenter serving architecture that selectively offloads long-context prefill to standalone, compute-dense prefill clusters and transfers the resulting KVCache over commodity Ethernet to local PD clusters for decode. Rather than treating reduced KVCache as sufficient, PrfaaS combines model-side KV efficiency with system-side selective offloading, bandwidth-aware scheduling, and cache-aware request placement. This design removes the requirement that heterogeneous accelerators share the same low-latency RDMA fabric, enabling independent scaling of prefill and decode capacity across loosely coupled clusters. In a case study using an internal 1T-parameter hybrid model, a PrfaaS-augmented heterogeneous deployment achieves 54% and 32% higher serving throughput than homogeneous PD and naive heterogeneous baselines, respectively, while consuming only modest cross-datacenter bandwidth.
papers.abstract_cn: Prefill-decode(PD)解耦已成为大规模LLM服务的标准架构，但在实践中其部署边界仍由KVCache传输决定。在传统的密集注意力模型中，prefill产生巨大的KVCache流量，使prefill和decode紧密耦合在单一高带宽网络域内，限制了异构部署和资源弹性。最近的混合注意力架构大幅减少了KVCache大小，使跨集群KVCache传输变得越来越可行。然而，仅靠较小的KVCache并不能使异构跨数据中心PD服务变得实用：真实工作负载仍然是突发性的，请求长度高度偏斜，前缀缓存分布不均，集群间带宽波动。我们提出Prefill-as-a-Service(PrfaaS)，一种跨数据中心服务架构，选择性地将长上下文prefill卸载到独立的、计算密集的prefill集群，并通过商品以太网将产生的KVCache传输到本地PD集群进行decode。PrfaaS将模型侧的KV效率与系统侧的选择性卸载、带宽感知调度和缓存感知请求放置相结合。这一设计消除了异构加速器共享相同低延迟RDMA fabric的要求，使prefill和decode容量能在松耦合集群间独立扩展。在内部1T参数混合模型的案例研究中，PrfaaS增强的异构部署比同构PD和朴素异构基线分别实现了54%和32%的更高服务吞吐量。
papers.ai_summary_en: Prefill-decode disaggregation is constrained by large KV-cache transfers in dense-attention LLMs, preventing cross-datacenter, heterogeneous deployment under bursty and skewed workloads. PrfaaS exploits hybrid-attention KV efficiency but adds system-level selective offloading of long-context prefills to compute-dense clusters, bandwidth-aware scheduling, and cache-aware placement to transfer KV caches over commodity Ethernet. On an internal 1T-parameter hybrid model, it improves serving throughput by 54% over homogeneous PD and 32% over naive heterogeneous cross-datacenter serving with modest bandwidth use.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型预填充-解码分离服务中，传统稠密注意力模型因 KVCache 传输量过大而难以跨数据中心异构部署和弹性扩展的问题，指出新一代混合注意力模型虽降低 KVCache 体积，但仍需解决突发负载、长请求倾斜和跨集群带宽波动。其提出 Prefill-as-a-Service（PrfaaS），通过选择性将长上下文预填充卸载到独立计算密集集群，并结合带宽感知调度、缓存感知请求放置和普通以太网 KVCache 传输，实现松耦合跨数据中心服务。实验表明，在 1T 参数混合模型上，该方法相较同质 PD 和朴素异构基线分别提升 54% 和 32% 吞吐，同时仅消耗适度跨数据中心带宽。

papers.title: Serving Chain-structured Jobs with Large Memory Footprints with Application to Large Foundation Model Serving
papers.authors: Tingyang Sun, Ting He, I-Hong Hou
papers.abstract_en: As a current trend in Artificial Intelligence (AI), large foundation models are increasingly employed as the core of AI services. However, even after training, serving such models at scale remains a challenging task due to their heavy resource footprints, particularly in terms of GPU memory. While recent works revealed unique characteristics of systems serving foundation models that distinguish them from traditional distributed computing systems, there is still a lack of fundamental understanding of the underlying system management problems. This work aims at addressing this gap by extracting a novel problem of "server chain composition" via block placement and cache allocation for serving chain-structured jobs with large memory footprints, which models a fundamental problem in serving large foundation models through pipeline parallelism. After showing the NP-hardness of the optimal solution, the focus is turned to developing scalable algorithms with guaranteed performance under state-of-the-art load balancing. Application of the proposed solution to a distributed large language model (LLM) serving system shows significant reduction of response times compared to state-of-the-art solutions.
papers.abstract_cn: 随着AI的发展趋势，大型基础模型越来越多地被用作AI服务的核心。然而，即使在训练之后，大规模服务这些模型仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为它们的资源占用庞大，特别是在GPU内存方面。虽然最近的工作揭示了服务基础模型的系统的独特特征，但仍然缺乏对底层系统管理问题的基础性理解。本工作旨在填补这一空白，通过提取一个新问题——「服务器链组合」——即通过块放置和缓存分配来服务具有大内存占用的链结构作业，这建模了通过流水线并行服务大型基础模型的基本问题。在证明最优解的NP硬度后，重点转向开发在最先进负载平衡下具有保证性能的可扩展算法。将所提出的解决方案应用于分布式大语言模型(LLM)服务系统，与最先进的解决方案相比，显示了显著的响应时间减少。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the resource-management problem in serving large foundation models with heavy GPU memory demands, specifically how to place model blocks and allocate caches for chain-structured jobs under pipeline parallelism. It formalizes this as a “server chain composition” problem, proves optimal solving is NP-hard, and proposes scalable algorithms with performance guarantees integrated with state-of-the-art load balancing. Evaluations in distributed LLM serving show significant response-time reductions over existing solutions.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大基础模型在线服务中 GPU 内存占用高、流水线并行下资源管理缺乏理论刻画的问题，抽象出面向链式大内存任务的“服务器链组合”问题，重点研究块放置与缓存分配。作者证明最优解为 NP-hard，并提出在先进负载均衡下具有性能保证的可扩展算法。用于分布式 LLM 服务系统后，相较现有方案可显著降低请求响应时间。

papers.title: RACER: Retrieval-Augmented Contextual Rapid Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Zihong Zhang, Zuchao Li, Lefei Zhang, Ping Wang, Hai Zhao
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive decoding in Large Language Models (LLMs) generates one token per step, causing high inference latency. Speculative decoding (SD) mitigates this through a guess-and-verify strategy, but existing training-free variants face trade-offs: retrieval-based drafts break when no exact match exists, while logits-based drafts lack structural guidance. We propose RACER (Retrieval-Augmented Contextual Rapid Speculative Decoding), a lightweight and training-free method that integrates retrieved exact patterns with logit-driven future cues. This unification supplies both reliable anchors and flexible extrapolation, yielding richer speculative drafts. Experiments on Spec-Bench, HumanEval, and MGSM-ZH demonstrate that RACER consistently accelerates inference, achieving more than 2x speedup over autoregressive decoding, and outperforms prior training-free methods, offering a scalable, plug-and-play solution for efficient LLM decoding.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型(LLM)中的自回归解码每步生成一个token，导致高推理延迟。投机解码(SD)通过猜测-验证策略缓解这一问题，但现有的免训练变体面临权衡：基于检索的草案在没有精确匹配时会失效，而基于logits的草案缺乏结构指导。我们提出RACER(检索增强上下文快速投机解码)，一种轻量级免训练方法，将检索到的精确模式与logit驱动的未来线索整合。这种统一既提供了可靠的锚点又提供了灵活的推断，产生更丰富的投机草案。在Spec-Bench、HumanEval和MGSM-ZH上的实验证明，RACER持续加速推理，实现超过2倍的加速比，优于之前的免训练方法，提供可扩展的即插即用解决方案。
papers.ai_summary_en: RACER addresses high LLM autoregressive decoding latency and the limitations of training-free speculative decoding, where retrieval-based drafts fail without exact matches and logit-based drafts lack structural guidance. It proposes a lightweight, training-free method that fuses retrieved exact contextual patterns with logit-driven future cues to generate more reliable and flexible speculative drafts for guess-and-verify decoding. Experiments on Spec-Bench, HumanEval, and MGSM-ZH show over 2× speedup versus autoregressive decoding and improved performance over prior training-free speculative decoding methods.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该文针对无训练投机解码中检索式草稿依赖精确匹配、logits式草稿缺乏结构指导的问题，提出 RACER，将检索到的精确上下文模式与模型 logits 提供的未来线索融合，以生成更可靠的投机草稿。实验表明，RACER 在 Spec-Bench、HumanEval 和 MGSM-ZH 上实现超过 2 倍自回归解码加速，并优于已有无训练方法，提供了一种即插即用的高效 LLM 推理方案。

papers.title: Acceptance Dynamics Across Cognitive Domains in Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Saif Mahmoud
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference. It uses a small draft model to propose a tree of future tokens. A larger target model then verifies these tokens in a single batched forward pass. Despite the growing body of work on speculative methods, the degree to which the cognitive characteristics of a task affect acceptance probability remains largely unexplored. We present an empirical study of tree-based speculative decoding acceptance dynamics. Our study spans four well-established NLP benchmark domains: code generation, mathematical reasoning, logical reasoning, and open-ended chat. For this, we use TinyLlama-1.1B as the draft model against Llama-2-7B-Chat-GPTQ as the target. Over 99,768 speculative nodes collected from 200 prompts, we derive per-domain acceptance rates, expected accepted lengths, depth-acceptance profiles, and entropy-acceptance correlations. We find that task type is a stronger predictor of acceptance than tree depth. Furthermore, only the chat domain consistently yields an expected accepted length exceeding 1.0 token per step. We also show that the entropy-acceptance correlation is consistently negative but weak across all domains. Counterintuitively, chat produces the highest entropy yet the highest acceptance rate. We attribute this divergence to the lexical predictability of RLHF-aligned register. These findings have direct implications for domain-aware speculation budgets and draft-model selection strategies.
papers.abstract_cn: 投机解码加速大语言模型(LLM)推理。它使用一个小型草案模型来提议未来token树，然后更大的目标模型在单次批量前向传播中验证这些token。尽管关于投机方法的研究越来越多，但任务的认知特征对接受概率的影响程度在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们对树基投机解码的接受动态进行了实证研究，跨越四个成熟的NLP基准领域：代码生成、数学推理、逻辑推理和开放式聊天。我们使用TinyLlama-1.1B作为草案模型，Llama-2-7B-Chat-GPTQ作为目标模型。从200个提示收集的99,768个投机节点中，我们推导出每个领域的接受率、预期接受长度、深度-接受率剖面和熵-接受率相关性。我们发现任务类型比树深度是更强的接受率预测因子。此外，只有聊天领域持续产生超过1.0 token/步的预期接受长度。反直觉地，聊天产生最高的熵但最高的接受率。我们将这种分歧归因于RLHF对齐寄存器的词汇可预测性。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper investigates how task domain affects token acceptance in tree-based speculative decoding, an underexplored factor in accelerating LLM inference. Using TinyLlama-1.1B as a draft model for Llama-2-7B-Chat-GPTQ across code, math, logic, and chat benchmarks, it analyzes acceptance rates, expected accepted lengths, depth profiles, and entropy correlations over ~100k speculative nodes. It finds that domain is a stronger predictor than tree depth, with only chat exceeding one accepted token per step despite high entropy, implying the need for domain-aware speculation budgets and draft-model selection.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文研究推测解码中不同认知任务域如何影响草稿 token 的接受率，弥补了任务特性与接受动态关系研究的不足。作者以 TinyLlama-1.1B 为草稿模型、Llama-2-7B-Chat-GPTQ 为目标模型，在代码、数学、逻辑和开放对话四类任务上分析近 10 万个推测节点的接受率、期望接受长度、深度曲线和熵相关性。结果显示任务类型比树深度更能预测接受率，且开放对话虽熵最高却因 RLHF 对齐语域的词汇可预测性而接受率最高，表明推测预算和草稿模型选择应面向领域优化。

papers.title: ELMoE-3D: Leveraging Intrinsic Elasticity of MoE for Hybrid-Bonding-Enabled Self-Speculative Decoding in On-Premises Serving
papers.authors: Yuseon Choi, Jingu Lee, Jungjun Oh, Sunjoo Whang, Byeongcheol Kim, Minsung Kim, Hoi-Jun Yoo, Sangjin Kim
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become the dominant architecture for large-scale language models, yet on-premises serving remains fundamentally memory-bound as batching turns sparse per-token compute into dense memory activation. Memory-centric architectures (PIM, NMP) improve bandwidth but leave compute underutilized under MoE's low arithmetic intensity at high batch sizes. Speculative decoding (SD) trades idle compute for fewer target invocations, yet verification must load experts even for rejected tokens, severely limiting its benefit in MoE especially at low batch sizes. We propose ELMoE-3D, a hybrid-bonding (HB)-based HW-SW co-designed framework that unifies cache-based acceleration and speculative decoding to offer overall speedup across batch sizes. We identify two intrinsic elasticity axes of MoE — expert and bit — and jointly scale them to construct Elastic Self-Speculative Decoding (Elastic-SD), which serves as both an expert cache and a strongly aligned self-draft model accelerated by high HB bandwidth. On our 3D-stacked hardware, ELMoE-3D achieves an average 6.6x speedup and 4.4x energy efficiency gain over naive MoE serving on xPU across batch sizes 1-16, and delivers 2.2x speedup and 1.4x energy efficiency gain over the best-performing prior accelerator baseline.
papers.abstract_cn: 混合专家(MoE)模型已成为大规模语言模型的主导架构，但在本地服务中仍然从根本上受内存限制，因为批处理将稀疏的每token计算转变为密集的内存激活。内存中心架构(PIM, NMP)改善了带宽，但在MoE的高批量低算术强度下使计算未充分利用。投机解码(SD)用空闲计算换取更少的目标调用，但验证必须为拒绝的token加载专家，严重限制了其在MoE中的收益，特别是在低批量下。我们提出ELMoE-3D，一个基于混合绑定(HB)的硬件-软件协同设计框架，统一缓存加速和投机解码以提供跨批量的整体加速。我们识别了MoE的两个内在弹性轴——专家和位——并联合缩放它们以构建弹性自投机解码(Elastic-SD)，它既作为专家缓存又作为强对齐的自草案模型。在我们的3D堆叠硬件上，ELMoE-3D在批量1-16范围内平均实现了6.6倍的加速和4.4倍的能效提升。
papers.ai_summary_en: ELMoE-3D tackles memory-bound on-premises MoE serving and the limited benefit of speculative decoding, where verification still loads experts for rejected tokens. It exploits MoE’s intrinsic expert- and bit-level elasticity to form Elastic Self-Speculative Decoding, combining an expert cache with a strongly aligned self-draft model accelerated by hybrid-bonding 3D-stacked hardware. The design achieves average 6.6× speedup and 4.4× energy-efficiency over naive xPU MoE serving at batch sizes 1–16, and 2.2×/1.4× over the best prior accelerator baseline.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对本地化 MoE 推理中内存带宽受限、且传统投机解码在验证阶段仍需加载专家导致收益不足的问题。提出 ELMoE-3D，通过混合键合 3D 堆叠硬件与软硬件协同设计，利用 MoE 的专家与比特弹性实现弹性自投机解码，使其同时作为专家缓存和高带宽加速的自草稿模型。实验在 batch 1–16 上相较朴素 xPU 服务平均实现 6.6 倍加速和 4.4 倍能效提升，并优于最佳已有加速器基线。

papers.title: ConfLayers: Adaptive Confidence-based Layer Skipping for Self-Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Walaa Amer, Uday Das, Fadi Kurdahi
papers.abstract_en: Self-speculative decoding is an inference technique for large language models designed to speed up generation without sacrificing output quality. It combines fast, approximate decoding using a compact version of the model as a draft model with selective re-evaluation by the full target model. Some existing methods form the draft model by dynamically learning which layers to skip during inference, effectively creating a smaller subnetwork to speed up computation. However, using heuristic-based approaches to select layers to skip can often be simpler and more effective. In this paper, we propose ConfLayers, a dynamic plug-and-play approach to forming the draft model in self-speculative decoding via confidence-based intermediate layer skipping. The process iteratively computes confidence scores for all layers, selects layers to skip based on an adaptive threshold, evaluates the performance of the resulting set, and updates the best selection until no further improvement is achieved or a maximum number of iterations is reached. This framework avoids the overhead and complexity of training a layer skipping policy and can provide more consistent speed-quality trade-offs while preserving the adaptivity of the draft model to diverse tasks and datasets. The performance evaluation of ConfLayers across different models and datasets shows that our novel approach offers up to 1.4x speedup over vanilla LLM generation.
papers.abstract_cn: 自投机解码是大语言模型的一种推理技术，旨在在不牺牲输出质量的情况下加速生成。它使用模型的紧凑版本作为草案模型进行快速近似解码，并与完整目标模型的选择性重新评估相结合。一些现有方法通过动态学习推理期间跳过哪些层来形成草案模型，有效地创建更小的子网络以加速计算。然而，使用启发式方法选择跳过层通常更简单且更有效。在本文中，我们提出ConfLayers，一种动态即插即用方法，通过基于置信度的中间层跳过来形成自投机解码的草案模型。该过程迭代计算所有层的置信度分数，基于自适应阈值选择跳过的层，评估结果集的性能，并更新最佳选择。此框架避免了训练层跳过策略的开销和复杂性，可以提供更一致的速度-质量权衡。性能评估显示ConfLayers提供高达1.4倍的加速。
papers.ai_summary_en: ConfLayers addresses efficient LLM inference in self-speculative decoding by adaptively constructing a draft subnetwork through intermediate-layer skipping, avoiding the need to train a separate skipping policy. It computes per-layer confidence scores, applies an adaptive threshold to select layers to skip, and iteratively refines the selection based on draft performance until no further improvement is observed. Experiments across models and datasets show up to 1.4× speedup over vanilla generation while preserving output quality and providing more consistent speed–quality trade-offs.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对自推测解码中草稿模型构建问题，指出训练式层跳过策略复杂且启发式方法往往更简单有效。ConfLayers 提出一种即插即用的自适应置信度层跳过方法，通过迭代计算各层置信度、按自适应阈值选择跳过层并评估更新，形成高质量子网络草稿模型。实验表明，该方法无需额外训练即可在多模型多数据集上实现最高 1.4 倍生成加速，并保持更稳定的速度-质量权衡。

papers.title: From Tokens to Steps: Verification-Aware Speculative Decoding for Efficient Multi-Step Reasoning (SpecGuard)
papers.authors: Authors from arXiv:2604.15244
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model inference by allowing a lightweight draft model to propose outputs that a stronger target model verifies. However, its token-centric nature allows erroneous steps to propagate. Prior approaches mitigate this using external reward models, but incur additional latency, computational overhead, and limit generalizability. We propose SpecGuard, a verification-aware speculative decoding framework that performs step-level verification using only model-internal signals. At each step, SpecGuard samples multiple draft candidates and selects the most consistent step, which is then validated using an ensemble of two lightweight model-internal signals: (i) an attention-based grounding score that measures attribution to the input and previously accepted steps, and (ii) a log-probability-based score that captures token-level confidence. These signals jointly determine whether a step is accepted or recomputed using the target, allocating compute selectively. Experiments across a range of reasoning benchmarks show that SpecGuard improves accuracy by 3.6% while reducing latency by ~11%, outperforming both SD and reward-guided SD.
papers.abstract_cn: 投机解码(SD)通过允许轻量级草案模型提议由更强的目标模型验证的输出，加速大语言模型推理。然而，其以token为中心的性质允许错误步骤传播。先前的方法使用外部奖励模型来缓解此问题，但会产生额外的延迟、计算开销并限制泛化性。我们提出SpecGuard，一个验证感知的投机解码框架，仅使用模型内部信号执行步骤级验证。在每个步骤中，SpecGuard采样多个草案候选并选择最一致的步骤，然后使用两个轻量级模型内部信号的集合进行验证：(i)基于注意力的基础分数，衡量对输入和先前接受步骤的归因；(ii)基于log概率的分数，捕获token级置信度。实验表明SpecGuard将准确性提高3.6%同时减少约11%的延迟。
papers.ai_summary_en: SpecGuard addresses speculative decoding’s token-level verification weakness in multi-step reasoning, where incorrect intermediate steps can propagate and external reward models add latency and compute overhead. It introduces a verification-aware framework that samples multiple draft steps, selects the most consistent candidate, and accepts or recomputes steps using lightweight model-internal signals: attention-based grounding to prior context and log-probability confidence. Across reasoning benchmarks, SpecGuard improves accuracy by 3.6% while reducing latency by about 11%, outperforming standard and reward-guided speculative decoding.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对投机解码在多步推理中以 token 为中心、易导致错误步骤传播，而外部奖励模型又增加延迟和计算开销的问题。其提出 SpecGuard，仅利用模型内部信号进行步骤级验证：先采样多个草稿步骤并选择最一致者，再结合注意力归因分数与 log-prob 置信度决定接受或由目标模型重算。实验表明，该方法在多个推理基准上将准确率提升 3.6%，同时降低约 11% 延迟，优于标准投机解码和奖励引导投机解码。

papers.title: MemoSight: Unifying Context Compression and Multi Token Prediction for Reasoning Acceleration
papers.authors: Xinyu Liu, Xin Liu, Bo Jin, Runsong Zhao, Pengcheng Huang, Junhao Ruan, Bei Li, Chunyang Xiao, Tong Xiao, Jingbo Zhu
papers.abstract_en: While Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning enables LLMs to solve challenging reasoning problems, as KV cache grows linearly with the number of generated tokens, CoT reasoning faces scaling issues in terms of speed and memory usage. In this work, we propose MemoSight (Memory-Foresight-based reasoning), a unified framework that integrates both context compression and multi-token prediction to mitigate the efficiency issues while maintaining CoT reasoning performance. Our framework adopts the same minimalist design for both context compression and multi-token prediction via special tokens and their corresponding position layout tailored to each token type. Comprehensive experiments on four reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that MemoSight reduces the KV cache footprint by up to 66% and accelerates inference by 1.56x, while outperforming existing CoT compression methods.
papers.abstract_cn: 虽然思维链(CoT)推理使LLM能够解决具有挑战性的推理问题，但随着KV缓存随生成的token数量线性增长，CoT推理在速度和内存使用方面面临扩展性问题。在这项工作中，我们提出MemoSight(基于记忆-预见推理)，一个统一框架，集成了上下文压缩和多token预测以缓解效率问题同时保持CoT推理性能。我们的框架对上下文压缩和多token预测采用了相同的最小化设计，通过特殊token及其相应的位置布局为每种token类型量身定制。在四个推理基准上的综合实验表明，MemoSight将KV缓存占用减少高达66%并将推理加速1.56倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: MemoSight addresses the linear KV-cache growth and autoregressive decoding bottleneck in chain-of-thought reasoning, which limit inference speed and memory scalability. It proposes a unified framework that combines context compression and multi-token prediction using special tokens with type-specific position layouts, enabling compact context representations and parallel generation of future reasoning tokens. Experiments on four reasoning benchmarks show up to 66% KV-cache reduction and 1.56× inference speedup while outperforming existing CoT compression methods.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对链式推理中 KV cache 随生成长度线性膨胀导致的显存与推理效率问题，提出 MemoSight，将上下文压缩与多 token 预测统一到一个框架中。其核心做法是通过特殊 token 及针对不同 token 类型设计的位置布局，以极简方式同时实现上下文精简和未来 token 预测。实验表明，该方法在四个推理基准上可将 KV cache 最多降低 66%、推理加速 1.56 倍，并保持优于现有 CoT 压缩方法的推理性能。

papers.title: P/D-Serve: Serving Disaggregated Large Language Model at Scale
papers.authors: Yibo Jin, Tao Wang, Huimin Lin, Mingyang Song, Peiyang Li, Yipeng Ma, Yicheng Shan, Zhengfan Yuan, Cailong Li, Yajing Sun, Tiandeng Wu, Xing Chu, Ruizhi Huan, Li Ma, Xiao You, Wenting Zhou, Yunpeng Ye, Wen Liu, Xiangkun Xu, Yongsheng Zhang, Tiantian Dong, Jiawei Zhu, Zhe Wang, Xijian Ju, Jianxun Song 等
papers.abstract_en: Serving disaggregated large language models (LLMs) over tens of thousands of xPU devices (GPUs or NPUs) with reliable performance faces multiple challenges. 1) Ignoring the diversity (various prefixes and tidal requests), treating all the prompts in a mixed pool is inadequate. To facilitate the similarity per scenario and minimize the inner mismatch on P/D (prefill and decoding) processing, fine-grained organization is required, dynamically adjusting P/D ratios for better performance. 2) Due to inaccurate estimation on workload (queue status or maintained connections), the global scheduler easily incurs unnecessary timeouts in prefill. 3) Block-fixed device-to-device (D2D) KVCache transfer over cluster-level RDMA (remote direct memory access) fails to achieve desired D2D utilization as expected. To overcome previous problems, this paper proposes an end-to-end system P/D-Serve, which models end-to-end (E2E) P/D performance and enables: 1) fine-grained P/D organization, mapping the service with RoCE as needed; 2) on-demand forwarding upon rejections for idle prefill; and 3) efficient KVCache transfer via optimized D2D access. P/D-Serve is implemented upon Ascend and MindSpore, has been deployed over tens of thousands of NPUs for more than eight months in commercial use, and further achieves 60%, 42% and 46% improvements on E2E throughput, TTFT SLO and D2D transfer time.
papers.abstract_cn: 在数万个xPU设备(GPU或NPU)上服务解耦的大语言模型(LLM)并保持可靠性能面临多重挑战。1)忽略多样性（各种前缀和潮汐请求），将所有提示放在混合池中是不充分的。为了促进每个场景的相似性并最小化P/D(prefill和decoding)处理的内部不匹配，需要细粒度组织，动态调整P/D比率以获得更好的性能。2)由于对工作负载的不准确估计，全局调度器容易在prefill中产生不必要的超时。3)块固定的设备到设备(D2D) KVCache传输通过集群级RDMA无法实现预期的D2D利用率。为了克服这些问题，本文提出端到端系统P/D-Serve，它建模端到端(E2E)P/D性能并启用：1)细粒度P/D组织；2)空闲prefill的按需转发；3)通过优化的D2D访问的高效KVCache传输。P/D-Serve在Ascend和MindSpore上实现，已在数万个NPU上商业部署超过八个月。
papers.ai_summary_en: P/D-Serve addresses large-scale serving of disaggregated LLM prefill/decode pools across tens of thousands of xPUs, where heterogeneous request patterns, inaccurate global load estimation, and inefficient RDMA KV-cache transfers degrade throughput and SLOs. The system introduces an end-to-end P/D performance model with fine-grained, scenario-aware P/D organization and dynamic ratio adjustment, rejection-triggered forwarding to idle prefill workers, and optimized device-to-device KV-cache access over RoCE/RDMA. Deployed commercially on Ascend NPUs with MindSpore for over eight months, it improves end-to-end throughput by 60%, TTFT SLO performance by 42%, and KV-cache transfer time by 46%.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文面向数万级 xPU 上解耦式 LLM 服务中请求多样性导致的 P/D 资源错配、全局调度超时以及 KVCache D2D 传输低效等问题。  
P/D-Serve 通过端到端 P/D 性能建模，实现细粒度 P/D 组织与动态比例调整、基于拒绝转发的空闲 prefill 利用，以及优化的 RDMA/D2D KVCache 传输。  
在 Ascend/MindSpore 上万 NPU 规模商用部署中，系统将端到端吞吐、TTFT SLO 和 D2D 传输时间分别提升 60%、42% 和 46%。

papers.title: Scheduling the Unschedulable: Taming Black-Box LLM Inference at Scale
papers.authors: Renzhong Yuan, Yijun Zeng, Xiaosong Gao, Linxi Yu, Haochun Liao, Han Wang
papers.abstract_en: When output token counts can be predicted at submission time, client-side scheduling against a black-box LLM API becomes semi-clairvoyant: decisions condition on coarse token priors even though the provider's internals remain hidden. We decompose this boundary problem into three separable concerns: allocation (inter-class share via adaptive DRR), ordering (intra-class sequencing via token-aware SJF), and execution (parallel dispatch via batch-coordinated GPU-fill).
papers.abstract_cn: 当输出的令牌数量可以在提交时预测时，对黑箱 LLM API 的客户端调度变得半具预见性：决策基于粗略的令牌先验，即使提供者的内部机制仍然是隐藏的。我们将这个边界问题分解为三个可分离的关注点：分配（通过自适应 DRR 进行类间份额分配）、排序（通过感知令牌的 SJF 进行类内排序）和执行（通过批次协调的 GPU 填充进行并行调度）。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses client-side scheduling for large-scale black-box LLM inference APIs, where server internals are hidden but output token counts can be predicted at submission time. It proposes a semi-clairvoyant scheduler that decomposes the problem into inter-class allocation via adaptive DRR, intra-class ordering via token-aware SJF, and parallel execution via batch-coordinated GPU-fill. This design enables scalable, fair, and latency-aware request dispatch without requiring provider-side visibility.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向内部状态不可见的黑盒 LLM API，利用提交时可预测的输出 token 数，解决大规模客户端请求调度难以优化的问题。其核心方法是将调度分解为三个可解耦环节：用自适应 DRR 控制类间资源分配、用 token 感知 SJF 优化类内请求排序、用批协调 GPU-fill 提升并行执行效率。该框架使客户端仅凭粗粒度长度先验即可增强调度可控性，为黑盒 LLM 推理服务的规模化请求治理提供了可行路径。

papers.title: SOLARIS: Speculative Offloading of Latent-bAsed Representation for Inference Scaling
papers.authors: Zikun Liu, Liang Luo, Qianru Li, Zhengyu Zhang, Wei Ling, Jingyi Shen 等
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in recommendation scaling laws have led to foundation models of unprecedented complexity. While these models offer superior performance, their computational demands make real-time serving impractical, often forcing practitioners to rely on knowledge distillation-compromising serving quality for efficiency. To address this challenge, we present SOLARIS (Speculative Offloading of Latent-bAsed Representation for Inference Scaling), a novel framework inspired by speculative decoding. SOLARIS proactively precomputes user-item interaction embeddings by predicting which user-item pairs are likely to appear in future requests, and asynchronously generating their foundation model representations ahead of time. This approach decouples the costly foundation model inference from the latency-critical serving path, enabling real-time knowledge transfer from models previously considered too expensive for online use. Deployed across Meta's advertising system serving billions of daily requests, SOLARIS achieves 0.67% revenue-driving top-line metrics gain, demonstrating its effectiveness at scale.
papers.abstract_cn: 最近推荐缩放定律的进展导致基础模型具有前所未有的复杂性。尽管这些模型提供了卓越的性能，但它们的计算需求使得实时服务变得不切实际，经常迫使从业者为了提高效率而依赖知识提炼——这往往会牺牲服务质量。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 SOLARIS(用于推理缩放的潜在 bAsed 表示的推测性卸载)，这是一个受推测性解码启发的新框架。SOLARIS 通过预测未来请求中可能出现的用户 - 项目对，主动预计用户 - 项目交互嵌入，并提前异步生成其基础模型表示。这种方法将昂贵的基础模型推理与延迟至关重要的服务路径解耦，实现了以前被认为过于昂贵而无法在线使用的模型的实时知识转移。通过部署在 Meta 的广告系统中，每天服务数十亿个请求，Solaris 实现了 0.67% 的收入驱动一线指标增长，证明了其在规模上的有效性。
papers.ai_summary_en: SOLARIS addresses the latency–quality tradeoff in serving large foundation recommendation models, whose computational cost makes direct online inference impractical. It introduces a speculative-decoding-inspired framework that predicts likely future user–item requests and asynchronously precomputes their latent foundation-model representations, decoupling expensive inference from the latency-critical serving path. Deployed in Meta’s advertising system at billions-of-requests scale, it enables real-time use of otherwise too-expensive models and yields a 0.67% gain in revenue-driving top-line metrics.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对推荐/广告等在线服务中基础模型推理成本过高、难以实时部署的问题，提出受投机解码启发的 SOLARIS 框架。其核心洞见是提前预测未来可能出现的用户-物品交互，并异步预计算其潜在表示，从而将昂贵的大模型推理从延迟敏感的服务路径中卸载。该方法在 Meta 广告系统的大规模线上部署中实现了 0.67% 的收入相关核心指标提升，证明其可在不牺牲模型质量的前提下扩展大模型在线服务能力。

papers.title: WWW.Serve: Interconnecting Global LLM Services through Decentralization
papers.authors: Huanyu Wang, Ziyu Xia, Zhuoming Chen, Beidi Chen
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) services are mostly centralized, leading to scalability bottlenecks and underutilization of substantial scattered GPU resources. While decentralization offers a promising alternative, existing frameworks primarily focus on cooperation among GPU providers while overlooking their inherent competitive dynamics, imposing substantial constraints such as excessive platform-level oversight or rigid requirements to execute all assigned requests using fixed software stacks on fixed hardware configurations. We argue that such assumptions are unrealistic in real-world decentralized environments. To this end, we propose WWW$.$Serve, a decentralized framework for interconnecting LLM services worldwide. It allows participants to flexibly determine their participation policies and resource commitments, and supports self-organizing request dispatch, enabling the network to autonomously allocate requests without centralized coordination. Empirically, we show that WWW$.$Serve improves global SLO (service-level-objective) attainment by up to 1.5x and lowers latency by 27.6%. Its performance approaches, and in some cases surpasses, centralized scheduling, while fully preserving the benefits of decentralization. These results highlight WWW$.$Serve as a promising foundation for real-world, decentralized LLM serving.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型 (LLM) 服务大多是集中式的，这导致了可扩展性瓶颈和大量分散的 GPU 资源未得到充分利用。虽然地方分权提供了一个有前景的替代方案，但现有框架主要关注 GPU 提供商之间的合作，而忽视了它们内在的竞争动态，施加了诸如过度的平台级监督或严格要求等实质性约束，要求使用固定硬件配置上的固定软件栈执行所有分配的请求。我们认为，在现实世界的地方分权环境中，这些假设是不切实际的。为此，我们提出了 WWW$.$Serve，一个用于在全球范围内相互连接 LLM 服务的地方分权框架。它允许参与者灵活地确定他们的参与政策和资源承诺，并支持自组织请求调度，使网络能够自主分配请求，而无需集中协调。实证结果表明，WWW$.$Serve 将全球服务水平目标 (SLO) 的实现提高了 1.5 倍，延迟降低了 27.6%。其性能接近甚至在某些情况下超越了地方分权调度，同时完全保留了地方分权的优势。这些结果突出了 WWW$.$Serve 作为现实世界中地方分权有限责任公司服务的有前景的基础。
papers.ai_summary_en: WWW.Serve addresses centralized LLM serving bottlenecks and underutilized geographically distributed GPU resources by enabling a decentralized interconnection of independent, potentially competing providers. Its key method is a self-organizing request dispatch framework that lets participants flexibly define participation policies and resource commitments while autonomously allocating requests without centralized coordination. Experiments show up to 1.5× higher global SLO attainment and 27.6% lower latency, approaching or sometimes surpassing centralized scheduling while preserving decentralization.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对集中式 LLM 服务的可扩展性瓶颈及现有去中心化框架忽视参与者竞争、约束过强的问题，提出 WWW.Serve，一个允许节点自主制定资源与参与策略、并通过自组织请求分发实现全球 LLM 服务互联的去中心化框架。实验表明，它可将全局 SLO 达成率最高提升 1.5 倍、延迟降低 27.6%，性能接近甚至部分超越集中式调度，同时保留去中心化优势。

papers.title: Multi-stage Flow Scheduling for LLM Serving
papers.authors: Yijun Sun, Xudong Liao, Songrun Xie, Hao Chen, Han Tian, Wenxue Li 等
papers.abstract_en: Meeting stringent Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) requirements is crucial for LLM applications. To improve efficiency, modern LLM serving systems adopt disaggregated architectures with diverse parallelisms, introducing complex multi-stage workflows involving reusable KV-block retrieval, collective communication, and P2D transfer. Flows from dependent stages overlap within and across requests on shared bottleneck links, making TTFT highly susceptible to network contention and necessitating stage-aware scheduling. Unfortunately, most existing works schedule flows in a stage-agnostic manner, leading to uncoordinated contention that constitutes a primary cause of SLO violations.   In this paper, we present MFS, a holistic multi-stage flow scheduling mechanism designed to maximize TTFT SLO attainment. At its core, MFS approximates the Least-Laxity-First (LLF) scheduling policy without requiring precise knowledge of a request's remaining slack. It achieves this through a Defer-and-Promote principle implemented through a Reverse Multi-Level Queue (RMLQ) structure. By dynamically promoting task precedence as effective laxity diminishes, MFS prioritizes flows with less laxity while preventing requests with loose SLOs from prematurely consuming network bandwidth. We implement MFS as a pluggable module integrated into vLLM, and evaluate it on a 8-server, 32-GPU testbed as well as through large-scale simulations. Our results demonstrate that MFS effectively outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, improving the TTFT SLO attainment by 1.2x--2.4x.
papers.abstract_cn: 满足严格的首次令牌时间 (TTFT) 要求对于 LLM 应用至关重要。为了提高效率，现代 LLM 服务系统采用了具有多种并行性的分离架构，引入了涉及可重用 KV 块检索、集体通信和 P2D 传输的复杂多阶段工作流。来自依赖阶段的流在共享瓶颈链路上的请求内部和跨请求之间重叠，使 TTFT 高度容易受到网络争用的影响，需要进行阶段感知调度。不幸的是，大多数现有工作以阶段无关的方式调度流，导致不协调的争用，这是违反 SLO 的主要原因。在本文中，我们提出了 MFS，一种旨在最大限度地实现 TTFT SLO 的全面多阶段流调度机制。在其核心，MFS 近似于最小松懈优先 (LLF) 调度策略，而不需要精确了解请求的剩余松懈。它通过一个通过反向多级队列 (RMLQ) 结构实现的延迟和促进原则来实现这一点。随着有效松懈程度的降低，MFS 通过动态提升任务优先级来优先处理松懈程度较低的流，同时防止请求过早消耗网络带宽。我们将 MFS 作为一个可插拔模块集成到 vLLM 中，并在 8 台服务器、32 个 GPU 的测试台上以及通过大规模仿真对其进行评估。我们的结果表明，MFS 的性能有效地优于最先进的基线，将 TTFT SLO 的达成率提高了 1.2 倍--2.4 倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses TTFT SLO violations in disaggregated LLM serving, where overlapping multi-stage flows such as KV-block retrieval, collective communication, and P2D transfer contend on shared network links under stage-agnostic scheduling. MFS approximates Least-Laxity-First without exact slack information using a Defer-and-Promote Reverse Multi-Level Queue that dynamically promotes flows as effective laxity decreases, preventing loose-SLO requests from prematurely consuming bandwidth. Implemented as a pluggable vLLM module and evaluated on an 8-server, 32-GPU testbed plus simulations, MFS improves TTFT SLO attainment by 1.2x–2.4x over state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对分离式 LLM 服务中多阶段流程（KV-block 复用、集合通信、P2D 传输）在共享链路上相互干扰、导致 TTFT SLO 易被违反的问题。  
核心方法是提出 MFS：一种阶段感知的多阶段流调度机制，通过“延迟-提升”原则和反向多级队列近似 Least-Laxity-First 策略，在无需精确剩余松弛时间的前提下优先调度更紧迫的请求。  
在 vLLM 集成、8 服务器 32 GPU 实测和大规模仿真中，MFS 相比现有基线将 TTFT SLO 达成率提升 1.2×–2.4×。

papers.title: Orla: A Library for Serving LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.authors: Rana Shahout, Hayder Tirmazi, Minlan Yu, Michael Mitzenmacher
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Orla, a library for constructing and running LLM-based agentic systems. Modern agentic applications consist of workflows that combine multiple LLM inference steps, tool calls, and heterogeneous infrastructure. Today, developers typically build these systems by manually composing orchestration code with LLM serving engines and tool execution logic. Orla provides a general abstraction that separates request execution from workflow-level policy. It acts as a serving layer above existing LLM inference engines: developers define workflows composed of stages, while Orla manages how those stages are mapped, executed, and coordinated across models and backends. It provides agent-level control through three mechanisms: a stage mapper, which assigns each stage to an appropriate model and backend; a workflow orchestrator, which schedules stages and manages their resources and context; and a memory manager, which manages inference state such as the KV cache across workflow boundaries. We demonstrate Orla with a customer support workflow that exercises many of its capabilities. We evaluate Orla on two datasets, showing that stage mapping improves latency and cost compared to a single-model vLLM baseline, while workflow-level cache management reduces time-to-first-token.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们介绍 Orla，一个用于构建和运行基于 LLM 的代理系统的库。现代代理应用由工作流组成，这些工作流结合了多个 LLM 推理步骤、工具调用和异构基础设施。如今，开发人员通常通过手动编写编排代码来构建这些系统，使用 LLM 服务引擎和工具执行逻辑。Orla 提供了一个通用的抽象，将请求执行与工作流级别的策略分开。它作为现有 LLM 推理引擎之上的服务层：开发人员定义由阶段组成的工作流，而 Orla 管理这些阶段如何在模型和后端之间进行映射、执行和协调。它通过三种机制提供代理级控制：阶段映射器，将每个阶段分配给适当的模型和后端;工作流协调器，调度阶段并管理其资源和上下文;以及内存管理器，管理跨工作流边界的推理状态，如 KV 缓存。我们使用客户支持工作流程演示了 Orla，该工作流程实现了 Orla 的许多功能。我们在两个数据集上对 Orla 进行了评估，结果表明，与单模型 vLLM 基线相比，阶段映射提高了延迟和成本，而工作流级别的缓存管理减少了到达先令牌的时间。
papers.ai_summary_en: Orla addresses the systems challenge of serving LLM-based multi-agent applications, where workflows combine heterogeneous inference steps, tool calls, and backend resources that are typically glued together manually. It introduces a serving-layer abstraction that separates workflow definition from execution policy, using a stage mapper to assign stages to models/backends, a workflow orchestrator to schedule and manage context/resources, and a memory manager to preserve inference state such as KV caches across workflow boundaries. Evaluations on a customer-support workflow and two datasets show that Orla’s stage mapping improves latency and cost versus a single-model vLLM baseline, while workflow-level cache management reduces time-to-first-token.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对基于 LLM 的多智能体系统中多步推理、工具调用和异构后端需手工编排、难以高效调度与复用的问题，提出了服务库 Orla。其核心洞见是将工作流级策略与请求执行解耦，并通过阶段映射、工作流编排和跨工作流边界的 KV 缓存管理，在现有推理引擎之上统一协调多模型与多后端。实验表明，相较单模型 vLLM 基线，Orla 能降低延迟与成本，并通过工作流级缓存减少首 token 时间。

papers.title: SUN: Shared Use of Next-token Prediction for Efficient Multi-LLM Disaggregated Serving
papers.authors: Sunghyeon Woo, Ahreum Seo, Jaegwang Lee, Jaeeun Kil, Hanbae Seo, Joonghoon Kim 等
papers.abstract_en: In multi-model LLM serving, decode execution remains inefficient due to model-specific resource partitioning: since cross-model batching is not possible, memory-bound decoding often suffers from severe GPU underutilization, especially under skewed workloads. We propose Shared Use of Next-token Prediction (SUN), the first approach that enables cross-model sharing of decode execution in disaggregated multi-LLM serving. SUN decomposes a decoder-only Transformer into a prefill module and a decode module, and fine-tunes only the task-specific prefill module, enabling a frozen decode module to be shared across models. This design enables a model-agnostic decode routing policy that balances decode requests across shared workers to maximize utilization. Across diverse tasks and model families, SUN achieves accuracy comparable to full fine-tuning while maintaining system throughput with fewer decode workers. In particular, SUN improves throughput per GPU by up to 2.0x over conventional disaggregation while keeping time-per-output-token (TPOT) within 5%. SUN inherently enables and facilitates low-bit decoding; with Quantized SUN (QSUN), it achieves a 45% speedup with comparable accuracy to SUN while preserving the benefits of shared decoding.
papers.abstract_cn: 在多模型 LLM 服务中，由于模型特定的资源划分，解码执行仍然低效：由于不可能进行跨模型批处理，内存绑定解码通常会遭受严重的 GPU 利用率不足，特别是在不平衡的工作负载下。我们提出了共享使用下一个令牌预测 (SUN)，这是第一种在分解的多模型 LLM 服务中实现跨模型共享解码执行的方法。SUN 将仅解码的 Transformer 分解为预填充模块和解码模块，并仅微调任务特定的预填充模块，使得冻结的解码模块能够在模型之间共享。这种设计实现了一种模型无关的解码路由策略，该策略平衡了共享工作程序之间的解码请求，以最大限度地提高利用率。在各种任务和模型系列中，SUN 实现了与全面微调相当的准确性，同时以更少的解码工作者保持系统吞吐量。特别是，SUN 将每个 GPU 的吞吐量提高了 2.0 倍，这是传统分解的 2.0 倍，同时将每个输出代币 (TPOT) 的时间保持在 5% 以内。SUN 天生能够并促进低位解码;使用量化 SUN(QSUN)，它实现了 45% 的加速，准确度与 SUN 相当，同时保留了共享解码的优势。
papers.ai_summary_en: SUN addresses inefficient decode-phase serving in multi-LLM systems, where model-specific resource partitioning prevents cross-model batching and causes GPU underutilization under skewed workloads. It decomposes decoder-only Transformers into task-specific fine-tuned prefill modules and a frozen, shared next-token-prediction decode module, enabling model-agnostic decode routing and low-bit quantized shared decoding (QSUN). Experiments show accuracy comparable to full fine-tuning with up to 2.0× throughput per GPU over conventional disaggregation within 5% TPOT, and QSUN adds a 45% speedup with similar accuracy.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对多LLM解耦服务中解码阶段因模型隔离无法跨模型批处理、导致GPU利用率低的问题，SUN将decoder-only Transformer拆分为可任务微调的prefill模块和冻结共享的decode模块，实现跨模型共享解码与模型无关的负载路由。该方法在保持接近全量微调精度的同时，用更少解码worker提升系统吞吐，每GPU吞吐最高提升2.0倍且TPOT增加控制在5%以内。结合低比特解码的QSUN还可再加速45%，为多模型高效服务提供了共享解码的新思路。

papers.title: LLMServingSim 2.0: A Unified Simulator for Heterogeneous and Disaggregated LLM Serving Infrastructure
papers.authors: Jaehong Cho, Hyunmin Choi, Guseul Heo, Jongse Park
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) serving infrastructures are undergoing a shift toward heterogeneity and disaggregation. Modern deployments increasingly integrate diverse accelerators and near-memory processing technologies, introducing significant hardware heterogeneity, while system software increasingly separates computation, memory, and model components across distributed resources to improve scalability and efficiency. As a result, LLM serving performance is no longer determined by hardware or software choices in isolation, but by their runtime interaction through scheduling, data movement, and interconnect behavior. However, understanding these interactions remains challenging, as existing simulators lack the ability to jointly model heterogeneous hardware and disaggregated serving techniques within a unified, runtime-driven framework. This paper presents LLMServingSim 2.0, a unified system-level simulator designed to make runtime-driven hardware-software interactions in heterogeneous and disaggregated LLM serving infrastructures explicit and analyzable. LLMServingSim 2.0 embeds serving decisions and hardware behavior into a single runtime loop, enabling interaction-aware modeling of batching, routing, offloading, memory, and power. The simulator supports extensible integration of emerging accelerators and memory systems through profile-based modeling, while capturing dynamic serving behavior and system-level effects. We validate LLMServingSim 2.0 against real deployments, showing that it reproduces key performance, memory, and power metrics with an average error of 0.95%, while maintaining simulation times of around 10 minutes even for complex configurations. These results demonstrate that LLMServingSim 2.0 provides a practical bridge between hardware innovation and serving-system design, enabling systematic exploration and co-design for next-generation LLM serving infrastructures.
papers.abstract_cn: 服务于基础设施的大语言模型 (LLM) 正在经历向异质性和分解的转变。现代部署越来越多地整合了各种加速器和近内存处理技术，引入了显著的硬件异质性，而系统软件则越来越多地在分布式资源中分离计算、内存和模型组件，以提高可扩展性和效率。因此，LLM 的服务性能不再由孤立的硬件或软件选择决定，而是由它们通过调度、数据移动和互连行为进行的运行时交互决定。然而，理解这些交互仍然具有挑战性，因为现有的模拟器缺乏在统一的、运行时驱动的框架内联合建模异构硬件和分解服务技术的能力。本文介绍了 LLMServingSim 2.0，这是一个统一的系统级模拟器，旨在在异构和分散的 LLM 服务基础设施中实现运行时驱动的硬件 - 软件交互，具有明确性和可分析性。LLMServingSim 2.0 将服务决策和硬件行为嵌入到单个运行时循环中，实现了批处理、路由、卸载、内存和功耗的交互感知建模。该模拟器通过基于配置文件的建模支持新兴加速器和内存系统的可扩展集成，同时捕获动态服务行为和系统级影响。我们在实际部署中验证了 LLMServingSim 2.0，结果表明，它以平均误差为 0 的方式重现了关键性能、内存和功耗指标。95%，即使对于复杂的配置，也能保持约 10 分钟的模拟时间。这些结果表明，LLMServingSim 2.0 在硬件创新和服务系统设计之间提供了一个实用的桥梁，使得下一代 LLM 服务基础设施的系统探索和共同设计成为可能。
papers.ai_summary_en: LLMServingSim 2.0 addresses the lack of simulators capable of jointly modeling heterogeneous accelerators, near-memory hardware, and disaggregated LLM serving software, where performance depends on runtime hardware–software interactions. It introduces a unified system-level simulator that embeds serving decisions such as batching, routing, offloading, memory management, and power behavior into a single runtime loop with profile-based, extensible hardware modeling. Validated against real deployments, it reproduces performance, memory, and power metrics with an average error of 0.95% while simulating complex configurations in about 10 minutes, enabling systematic exploration and co-design of next-generation LLM serving infrastructures.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对异构加速器与计算/内存/模型解耦的 LLM 服务系统中，硬件与软件运行时交互难以统一建模的问题。  
提出 LLMServingSim 2.0，将批处理、路由、卸载、内存和功耗等调度决策与硬件行为嵌入同一运行时仿真循环，实现交互感知的系统级建模。  
在真实部署验证中，其性能、内存和功耗指标平均误差仅 0.95%，且复杂配置仿真约 10 分钟，可支撑下一代 LLM 服务基础设施的协同设计与探索。

papers.title: Pancake: Hierarchical Memory System for Multi-Agent LLM Serving
papers.authors: Zhengding Hu, Zaifeng Pan, Prabhleen Kaur, Vibha Murthy, Zhongkai Yu, Yue Guan 等
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we identify and address the core challenges of agentic memory management in LLM serving, where large-scale storage, frequent updates, and multiple coexisting agents jointly introduce complex and high-cost approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) searching problems. We present Pancake, a multi-tier agentic memory system that unifies three key techniques: (i) multi-level index caching for single agents, (ii) coordinated index management across multiple agents, and (iii) collaborative GPU-CPU acceleration. Pancake exposes easy-to-use interface that can be integrated into memory-based agents like Mem-GPT, and is compatible with agentic frameworks such as LangChain and LlamaIndex. Experiments on realistic agent workloads show that Pancake substantially outperforms existing frameworks, achieving more than 4.29x end-to-end throughput improvement.
papers.abstract_cn: 在这项工作中，我们识别并解决了在大语言模型（LLM）服务中代理记忆管理的核心挑战，其中大规模存储、频繁更新以及多代理共存共同引入了复杂且高成本的近似最近邻（ANN）搜索问题。我们提出了Pancake，一种多层代理记忆系统，整合了三项关键技术：(i) 单代理的多级索引缓存，(ii) 多代理间的协调索引管理，以及 (iii) 协作的GPU-CPU加速。Pancake 提供了易于使用的接口，可集成到基于记忆的代理中，如 Mem-GPT，并与诸如 LangChain 和 LlamaIndex 的代理框架兼容。在现实的代理工作负载实验中，Pancake 显著优于现有框架，实现了端到端吞吐量提升超过4.29倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles memory management for multi-agent LLM serving, where large-scale, frequently updated agent memories make approximate nearest-neighbor retrieval expensive under many concurrent agents. Pancake introduces a hierarchical memory system with multi-level index caching per agent, coordinated cross-agent index management, and GPU–CPU collaborative acceleration, integrating with frameworks such as Mem-GPT, LangChain, and LlamaIndex. On realistic agent workloads, it achieves over 4.29× end-to-end throughput improvement compared with existing systems.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对多智能体 LLM 服务中记忆管理面临的大规模存储、频繁更新和多 agent 共存导致的高成本 ANN 检索问题。  
提出 Pancake 分层记忆系统，通过单 agent 多级索引缓存、多 agent 协同索引管理以及 GPU-CPU 协同加速来提升检索与服务效率。  
在真实 agent 工作负载上，Pancake 相比现有框架取得超过 4.29 倍的端到端吞吐提升，并可集成到 Mem-GPT、LangChain 等框架。

papers.title: DualScale: Energy-Efficient Disaggregated LLM Serving via Phase-Aware Placement and DVFS
papers.authors: Omar Basit, Yunzhao Liu, Z. Jonny Kong, Y. Charlie Hu
papers.abstract_en: Prefill/decode disaggregation is increasingly adopted in LLM serving to improve the latency-throughput tradeoff and meet strict TTFT and TPOT SLOs. However, LLM inference remains energy-hungry: autoscaling alone is too coarse-grained to track fast workload fluctuations, and applying fine-grained DVFS under disaggregation is complicated by phase-asymmetric dynamics and coupling between provisioning and frequency control.   We present DualScale, a two-tier energy optimization framework for disaggregated LLM serving. DualScale jointly optimizes placement and DVFS across prefill and decode using predictive latency and power models. At coarse timescales, DualScale computes phase-aware placement and baseline frequencies that minimize energy while satisfying SLO constraints. At fine timescales, DualScale dynamically adapts GPU frequency per iteration using stage-specific control: model predictive control (MPC) for prefill to account for queue evolution and future TTFT impact, and lightweight slack-aware adaptation for decode to exploit its smoother, memory-bound dynamics. This hierarchical design enables coordinated control across timescales while preserving strict serving SLOs.   Evaluation on a 16x H100 cluster serving Llama 3.3 70B with production-style traces shows that DualScale meets TTFT/TPOT SLOs while reducing energy by up to 39% in prefill and 48% in decode relative to DistServe.
papers.abstract_cn: LLM 服务中越来越多地采用预填充/解码分解，以改善延迟 - 吞吐量权衡并满足严格的 TTFT 和 TPOT SLO。然而，LLM 推理仍然能量密集型：仅自动缩放过于粗粒度，无法跟踪快速的工作负载波动，而在分解中应用细粒度 DVFS 则因相位不对称动态以及供应和频率控制之间的耦合而变得复杂。我们提出了 DualScale，一种用于分解 LLM 服务的双层能量优化框架。DualScale 使用预测延迟和功耗模型，在预填充和解码过程中联合优化布局和 DVFS。在粗粒度时间尺度上，DualScale 计算相位感知布局和基线频率，在满足 SLO 约束的同时最小化能量。在良好的时间尺度下，DualScale 使用阶段特定控制在每次迭代中动态调整 GPU 频率：用于预填充的模型预测计算控制 (MPC) 用于考虑队列演变和未来 TTFT 影响，以及用于解码的轻量级松弛感知适应，以利用其更平滑、内存绑定的动态。这种分层设计实现了跨时间尺度的协调控制，同时保持严格的服务 SLO。对 16 个 H100 集群的评估结果表明，与 DistServe 相比，DualScale 满足 TTFT/TPOT SLO，同时在预填充和解码方面降低了高达 39% 的能量和 48% 的能量。
papers.ai_summary_en: DualScale addresses energy inefficiency in prefill/decode disaggregated LLM serving, where coarse autoscaling cannot track rapid workload changes and fine-grained DVFS is complicated by asymmetric phase dynamics and placement coupling. It proposes a two-tier framework that jointly optimizes phase-aware placement and baseline frequencies at coarse timescales, then applies per-iteration GPU frequency control using MPC for prefill and lightweight slack-aware adaptation for decode to preserve TTFT/TPOT SLOs. Evaluations on a 16×H100 cluster serving Llama 3.3 70B show SLO compliance with up to 39% prefill and 48% decode energy reductions versus DistServe.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对预填充/解码分离式 LLM 服务中能耗高、粗粒度自动扩缩容难以跟踪负载波动，且细粒度 DVFS 受阶段动态差异和资源配置耦合影响的问题展开研究。核心方法是提出 DualScale 双层优化框架：在粗时间尺度上进行阶段感知的请求放置与基线频率优化，在细时间尺度上分别用 MPC 控制预填充频率、用轻量 slack 感知策略调节解码频率。实验显示，在 16×H100 集群服务 Llama 3.3 70B 时，可在满足 TTFT/TPOT SLO 的同时，相较 DistServe 分别降低预填充和解码阶段最高 39% 与 48% 的能耗。

papers.title: FlowPrefill: Decoupling Preemption from Prefill Scheduling Granularity to Mitigate Head-of-Line Blocking in LLM Serving
papers.authors: Chia-chi Hsieh, Zan Zong, Xinyang Chen, Jianjiang Li, Jidong Zhai, Lijie Wen
papers.abstract_en: The growing demand for large language models (LLMs) requires serving systems to handle many concurrent requests with diverse service level objectives (SLOs). This exacerbates head-of-line (HoL) blocking during the compute-intensive prefill phase, where long-running requests monopolize resources and delay higher-priority ones, leading to widespread time-to-first-token (TTFT) SLO violations. While chunked prefill enables interruptibility, it introduces an inherent trade-off between responsiveness and throughput: reducing chunk size improves response latency but degrades computational efficiency, whereas increasing chunk size maximizes throughput but exacerbates blocking. This necessitates an adaptive preemption mechanism. However, dynamically balancing execution granularity against scheduling overheads remains a key challenge.   In this paper, we propose FlowPrefill, a TTFT-goodput-optimized serving system that resolves this conflict by decoupling preemption granularity from scheduling frequency. To achieve adaptive prefill scheduling, FlowPrefill introduces two key innovations: 1) Operator-Level Preemption, which leverages operator boundaries to enable fine-grained execution interruption without the efficiency loss associated with fixed small chunking; and 2) Event-Driven Scheduling, which triggers scheduling decisions only upon request arrival or completion events, thereby supporting efficient preemption responsiveness while minimizing control-plane overhead. Evaluation on real-world production traces shows that FlowPrefill improves maximum goodput by up to 5.6$\times$ compared to state-of-the-art systems while satisfying heterogeneous SLOs.
papers.abstract_cn: 对大语言模型 (LLM) 的需求日益增长，需要服务系统处理具有不同服务级别目标 (SLO) 的许多并发请求。这加剧了计算密集型预填充阶段的行首 (HoL) 阻塞，在这个阶段，长时间运行的请求垄断资源并延迟更高优先级的请求，导致广泛的时间优先令牌 (TTFT) SLO 违规。虽然分块预填充实现了可中断性，但它引入了响应性和吞吐量之间的内在权衡：减小块大小提高了响应延迟，但降低了计算效率，而增加块大小最大化吞吐量，但加剧了阻塞。这需要一种自适应的抢占机制。然而，动态平衡执行粒度与调度开销仍然是一个关键挑战。在本文中，我们提出了 FlowPrefill，一种 TTFT 优化的服务系统，它通过将抢占粒度与调度频率解耦来解决这种冲突。为了实现自适应预填充调度，FlowPrefill 引入了两项关键创新:1) 操作员级抢占，它利用操作员边界实现细粒度的执行中断，而不会产生与固定小块化相关的效率损失;2) 事件驱动调度，它仅在请求到达或完成事件发生时触发调度决策，从而支持高效的抢占响应能力，同时最大限度地减少控制平面开销。对实际生产轨迹的评估表明，与最先进的系统相比，FlowPrefill 在满足异构 SLO 的同时，最大产量提高了 5.6 美元。
papers.ai_summary_en: FlowPrefill addresses head-of-line blocking in LLM serving, where compute-intensive prefill requests delay higher-priority workloads and cause TTFT SLO violations under chunked-prefill efficiency trade-offs. It decouples preemption granularity from scheduling frequency using operator-level preemption for fine-grained interruption and event-driven scheduling to reduce control-plane overhead. Evaluations on production traces show up to 5.6× higher maximum goodput than state-of-the-art systems while meeting heterogeneous SLOs.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理服务中预填充阶段的队头阻塞问题，指出长请求会占用计算资源并导致高优先级请求的TTFT SLO违约，而传统分块预填充难以兼顾响应性与吞吐。FlowPrefill通过将抢占粒度与调度频率解耦，提出算子级抢占和事件驱动调度，在不牺牲计算效率的前提下实现细粒度中断与低控制开销的自适应调度。基于真实生产负载的实验显示，其在满足异构SLO的同时可将最大goodput相对先进系统提升至多5.6倍。

papers.title: OServe: Accelerating LLM Serving via Spatial-Temporal Workload Orchestration
papers.authors: Youhe Jiang, Fangcheng Fu, Taiyi Wang, Guoliang He, Eiko Yoneki
papers.abstract_en: Serving Large Language Models (LLMs) can benefit immensely from parallelizing both the model and input requests across multiple devices, but incoming workloads exhibit substantial spatial and temporal heterogeneity. Spatially, workloads comprise heterogeneous requests with varying compute and memory demands. Temporally, workload composition varies over time. Nevertheless, existing systems typically assume spatially uniform and temporally stable workloads, employing a homogeneous, static model deployment. This mismatch between the assumption and real-world spatial-temporal heterogeneity results in suboptimal performance. We present OServe, an LLM serving system with heterogeneous and flexible model deployment that addresses both spatial and temporal heterogeneity. First, OServe introduces a novel workload-aware scheduling algorithm that optimizes heterogeneous model deployments according to real-time workload characteristics. Second, OServe proposes an efficient workload-adaptive switching method that migrates model deployments in response to predicted workload changes. Experiments on real-world traces show that OServe improves performance by up to 2$\times$ (average: 1.5$\times$) compared to state-of-the-art serving systems.
papers.abstract_cn: 服务大型语言模型 (LLM) 可以从跨多个设备的模型和输入请求并行化中获得巨大收益，但传入的工作负载表现出显著的空间和时间异质性。在空间上，工作负载包含具有不同计算和内存需求的异质请求。在时间上，工作负载组成随时间变化。然而，现有系统通常假设工作负载在空间上一致且时间上稳定，采用均匀、静态的模型部署。这种假设与现实世界空间 - 时间异质性之间的不匹配导致了次优的性能。我们介绍了 OServe，一个 LLM 服务系统，它具有异质性和灵活的模型部署，可以解决空间和时间异质性问题。首先，OServe 引入了一种新的工作负载感知调度算法，该算法根据实时工作负载特征优化异构模型部署。其次，OServe 提出了一种高效的工作负载自适应切换方法，该方法可以根据预测的工作负载变化迁移模型部署。对现实世界轨迹的实验表明，与最先进的服务系统相比，OServe 的性能提升高达 2 美元 (平均为 1.5 美元)。
papers.ai_summary_en: OServe addresses the mismatch between real LLM serving workloads, which are spatially heterogeneous in request compute/memory demands and temporally varying, and existing systems that rely on static, homogeneous model deployments. It introduces a workload-aware scheduler that selects heterogeneous model deployments based on real-time request characteristics, plus a workload-adaptive switching mechanism that migrates deployments in anticipation of predicted workload changes. Experiments on real-world traces show up to 2× (average 1.5×) throughput/performance improvements over state-of-the-art LLM serving systems.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM 服务中请求在空间上计算/内存需求异构、在时间上负载组成动态变化，而现有系统多采用静态同构部署导致性能不佳的问题。OServe 提出工作负载感知的异构模型部署调度算法，并结合负载预测的自适应部署切换/迁移机制，实现时空负载编排。实验表明，其在真实负载轨迹上相较先进服务系统最高可提升 2 倍、平均提升 1.5 倍性能。

papers.title: PrefillShare: A Shared Prefill Module for KV Reuse in Multi-LLM Disaggregated Serving
papers.authors: Sunghyeon Woo, Hoseung Kim, Sunghwan Shim, Minjung Jo, Hyunjoon Jeong, Jeongtae Lee 等
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems increasingly orchestrate multiple specialized language models to solve complex real-world problems, often invoking them over a shared context. This execution pattern repeatedly processes the same prompt prefix across models. Consequently, each model redundantly executes the prefill stage and maintains its own key-value (KV) cache, increasing aggregate prefill load and worsening tail latency by intensifying prefill-decode interference in existing LLM serving stacks. Disaggregated serving reduces such interference by placing prefill and decode on separate GPUs, but disaggregation does not fundamentally eliminate inter-model redundancy in computation and KV storage for the same prompt. To address this issue, we propose PrefillShare, a novel algorithm that enables sharing the prefill stage across multiple models in a disaggregated setting. PrefillShare factorizes the model into prefill and decode modules, freezes the prefill module, and fine-tunes only the decode module. This design allows multiple task-specific models to share a prefill module and the KV cache generated for the same prompt. We further introduce a routing mechanism that enables effective prefill sharing across heterogeneous models in a vLLM-based disaggregated system. PrefillShare not only matches full fine-tuning accuracy on a broad range of tasks and models, but also delivers 4.5x lower p95 latency and 3.9x higher throughput in multi-model agent workloads.
papers.abstract_cn: 多智能体系统越来越多地协调多个专用语言模型来解决复杂的现实世界问题，通常在共享上下文中调用这些模型。这种执行模式在模型之间反复处理相同的提示前缀。因此，每个模型都会冗余地执行预填充阶段并维护自己的键值 (KV) 缓存，通过加剧现有 LLM 服务堆栈中的预填充 - 解码干扰来增加聚合预填充负载并恶化尾部延迟。分解服务通过将预填充和解码放置在不同的 GPU 上来减少这种干扰，但分解并不能根本消除模型间冗余，无论是在计算还是 KV 存储方面。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 PrefillShare，这是一种新的算法，它能够在分解的环境中跨多个模型共享预填充阶段。PrefillShare 将模型分解为预填充和解码模块，冻结预填充模块，并仅对解码模块进行微调。该设计允许多个特定于任务的模型共享预填充模块和为相同提示生成的 KV 缓存。我们进一步介绍了一种路由机制，该机制能够在基于 vLLM 的分解系统中实现异构模型之间的有效预填充共享。预填充共享不仅能够满足广泛任务和模型的全面微调精度，而且在多模型代理工作负载中还能提供 4.5 倍的 p95 延迟和 3.9 倍的吞吐量。
papers.ai_summary_en: PrefillShare addresses redundant prefill computation and KV-cache storage when multiple specialized LLMs in multi-agent serving process the same prompt prefix, which increases aggregate load and tail latency even under prefill–decode disaggregation. It factorizes models into a frozen shared prefill module and task-specific fine-tuned decode modules, enabling heterogeneous models to reuse a common prefill computation and KV cache via a vLLM-based routing mechanism.
