The method matches full fine-tuning accuracy while achieving 4.5× lower p95 latency and 3.9× higher throughput on multi-model agent workloads.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多模型智能体服务中同一提示前缀被多个LLM重复prefill并各自存储KV缓存，导致计算冗余、KV浪费和尾延迟恶化的问题。其核心方法是提出PrefillShare，在预填充-解码分离架构下共享并冻结一个通用prefill模块，仅微调各模型的decode模块，并设计路由机制支持异构模型复用同一prefill结果与KV缓存。实验显示，该方法在保持与全量微调相当精度的同时，在多模型智能体负载下将p95延迟降低4.5倍、吞吐提升3.9倍。

papers.title: PASCAL: A Phase-Aware Scheduling Algorithm for Serving Reasoning-based Large Language Models
papers.authors: Eunyeong Cho, Jehyeon Bang, Ranggi Hwang, Minsoo Rhu
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of reasoning-based LLMs leveraging Chain-of-Thought (CoT) inference introduces new serving challenges, as their extended reasoning phases delay user-visible output and inflate Time-To-First-Token (TTFT). Existing LLM serving frameworks fail to distinguish between reasoning and answering phases, leading to performance degradation under GPU memory constraints. We present PASCAL, a phase-aware scheduling algorithm that prioritizes reasoning to reduce TTFT while using controlled preemption and token pacing during answering to preserve Quality-of-Experience (QoE). Our hierarchical scheduler combines instance-level placement with intrainstance execution and enables dynamic migration at phase boundaries to balance load and reduce interference. Across benchmarks using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, Pascal reduces tail TTFT by up to 72 % while maintaining answering phase SLO attainment, demonstrating the importance of phaseaware scheduling for reasoning-based LLM deployment.
papers.abstract_cn: 基于推理的 LLM（大语言模型）利用链式思维（CoT）推理的出现带来了新的服务挑战，因为它们延长的推理阶段会延迟用户可见的输出，并增加首个令牌生成时间（TTFT）。现有的 LLM 服务框架未能区分推理和回答阶段，导致在 GPU 内存受限情况下性能下降。我们提出了 PASCAL，一种阶段感知调度算法，它优先处理推理以减少 TTFT，同时在回答阶段通过受控抢占和令牌节奏控制来保持体验质量（QoE）。我们的分层调度器结合了实例级放置与实例内执行，并在阶段边界允许动态迁移以平衡负载和减少干扰。在使用 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 的基准测试中，Pascal 将尾部 TTFT 降低了多达 72%，同时保持了回答阶段的 SLO 达成率，展示了阶段感知调度在基于推理的 LLM 部署中的重要性。
papers.ai_summary_en: PASCAL addresses serving bottlenecks for reasoning-based LLMs whose long Chain-of-Thought phases inflate Time-To-First-Token and strain GPU memory under conventional phase-agnostic schedulers. It introduces a phase-aware hierarchical scheduler that prioritizes reasoning requests, applies controlled preemption and token pacing during answering, and migrates requests at phase boundaries to balance load and limit interference. Evaluations with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B show up to 72% lower tail TTFT while preserving answering-phase SLO attainment and user-facing QoE.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对推理型大模型因长链式思维推理导致首 token 延迟升高、且现有服务框架不区分推理与回答阶段而在显存受限下性能下降的问题。提出 PASCAL 阶段感知调度算法，通过优先处理推理阶段、在回答阶段进行受控抢占与 token 节奏控制，并结合实例级放置、实例内执行和阶段边界动态迁移来平衡负载。实验表明，在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 上可将尾部长 TTFT 最多降低 72%，同时保持回答阶段 SLO 达成率。

papers.title: Serving Hybrid LLM Loads with SLO Guarantees Using CPU-GPU Attention Piggybacking
papers.authors: Zizhao Mo, Junlin Chen, Huanle Xu, Chengzhong Xu
papers.abstract_en: Nowadays, service providers often deploy multiple types of LLM services within shared clusters. While the service colocation improves resource utilization, it introduces significant interference risks for latency-sensitive (LS) services-which have strict SLO requirements for inference latency-and severely constrain the service capacity of best-effort (BE) services due to limited available memory. To address interference, existing systems typically rely on reserving headroom to constrain BE resource usage. However, this approach's coarse granularity compromises the SLO compliance of the latency-sensitive service and unnecessarily restricts the generation potential of the best effort service. In this paper, we propose OmniServe, a novel LLM serving system that efficiently harnesses both CPU and GPU resources to mitigate interference and improve throughput. Central to OmniServe is the Attention Piggybacking mechanism, which effectively offloads the Attention computation of BE services to CPUs on the fly. This mechanism also facilitates asynchronous communication between CPU and GPU streams, preventing GPUs from being blocked while aggregating Attention results. Additionally, OmniServe incorporates a dynamic batching control policy to adapt to fluctuating request arrivals, facilitating Dense module computation using layer-wise batching. Experimental results show that OmniServe improves the SLO attainment rate for LS services by up to $1.48\times$ while enhancing BE serving throughput by up to $9.85\times$ compared to state-of-the-art systems.
papers.abstract_cn: 如今，服务提供商经常在共享集群中部署多种类型的 LLM 服务。虽然服务布局提高了资源利用率，但它为延迟敏感 (LS) 服务带来了显著的干扰风险——这些服务对推理延迟有严格的 SLO 要求，并且由于可用内存有限，严重限制了最优努力 (BE) 服务的服务容量。为了解决干扰，现有系统通常依赖预留闲置空间来限制 BE 资源使用。然而，这种方法的粗粒度损害了延迟敏感服务的 SLO 合规性，并不必要地限制了最优努力服务的生成潜力。在本文中，我们提出了 OmniServe，一种新的 LLM 服务系统，它能有效地利用 CPU 和 GPU 资源来减少干扰和提高吞吐量。OmniServe 的核心是注意力猪背机制，它能有效地将 BE 服务的注意力计算卸载到运行中的 CPU 上。这种机制还促进了 CPU 和 GPU 流之间的异步通信，防止 GPU 在汇总注意力结果时被阻塞。此外，OmniServe 集成了动态批处理控制策略，以适应波动的请求到达，通过分层批处理促进 Dense 模块计算。实验结果表明，与最先进的系统相比，OmniServe 将 LS 服务的 SLO 实现率提高了 1.48 倍，同时将 BE 服务吞吐量提高了 9.85 倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: OmniServe addresses SLO violations and underutilization in shared LLM serving clusters, where latency-sensitive services suffer interference from best-effort workloads and coarse resource headroom reservation limits throughput. Its key mechanism, Attention Piggybacking, offloads best-effort attention computation to CPUs asynchronously while GPU streams execute latency-sensitive work, complemented by dynamic layer-wise batching control for dense modules. Experiments show up to 1.48× higher SLO attainment for latency-sensitive services and up to 9.85× higher best-effort throughput versus state-of-the-art systems.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对共享集群中延迟敏感LLM服务与尽力而为服务共存导致的干扰和SLO保障难题，本文提出OmniServe，通过CPU-GPU注意力“搭便车”机制将BE请求的Attention计算动态卸载到CPU，并以异步通信避免GPU阻塞，同时配合动态层间批处理控制。该系统在保障LS服务SLO的同时显著提升BE吞吐，相比先进系统可将LS SLO达成率提高最高1.48倍、BE吞吐提高最高9.85倍。

papers.title: Multi-Layer Scheduling for MoE-Based LLM Reasoning
papers.authors: Yifan Sun, Gholamreza Haffari, Minxian Xu, Rajkumar Buyya, Adel N. Toosi
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success across a wide range of tasks, but serving them efficiently at scale remains a critical challenge due to their substantial computational and latency demands. While most existing inference frameworks rely on simple scheduling strategies such as First-Come-First-Serve (FCFS) at the engine level and Round-Robin (RR) at the scheduler or coordinator level, they often fail to fully utilize system resources and may suffer from issues such as head-of-line blocking and load imbalance. Recent advances in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have also introduced new challenges in scheduling arising from expert parallelism and routing complexity. This research proposes a multi-layer scheduling framework tailored for MoE-based LLM serving. It targets scheduling at three levels: request-level, enginelevel, and expert-level. At the request level, we explore algorithms such as Shortest-Job-First (SJF) and priority-aware aging to improve throughput and reduce latency. At the engine level, we design load-aware dispatching strategies that account for the current prefix token load, KV cache utilization, and user stickiness to achieve better resource matching. At the expert level, we focus on alleviating expert hotspots and strategically placing inter-layer expert dependencies to balance load and improve routing efficiency. Extensive experimental results from more than 100 experiments conducted under diverse workload distributions show that our approach consistently outperforms the state-of-theart inference framework vLLM, achieving up to 17.8% reduction in Time To First Token (TTFT) latency and 13.3% reduction in Time-Per-Output-Token (TPOT) latency.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型 (LLMs) 在广泛的任务中取得了显著的成功，但由于其巨大的计算和延迟需求，大规模高效地服务于这些任务仍然是一个关键挑战。尽管大多数现有的推理框架依赖于简单的调度策略，如引擎级别的先到先得 (FCFS) 和调度器或协调器级别的轮询 (RR)，但它们通常无法充分利用系统资源，并可能遭受队头阻塞和负载不平衡等问题。最近，专家混合 (MoE) 模型的进展也为调度带来了新的挑战，这些挑战源于专家并行性和路由复杂性。本研究提出了一个针对基于 MoE 的 LLM 服务的多层调度框架。它针对三个级别的调度：请求级、引擎级和专家级。在请求级，我们探索了最短任务优先 (SJF) 和优先级感知老化等算法，以提高吞吐量并减少延迟。在引擎层面，我们设计负载感知调度策略，考虑当前前缀令牌负载、KV 缓存利用率和用户粘性，以实现更好的资源匹配。在专家层面，我们专注于缓解专家热点，并策略性地放置层间专家依赖关系，以平衡负载并提高路由效率。在不同工作负载分配下进行的 100 多项实验的广泛实验结果表明，我们的方法始终优于核心状态推理框架 vLLM，实现了令牌首次使用时间 (TTFT) 延迟降低高达 17.8%，每个输出令牌使用时间 (TPOT) 延迟降低 13.3%。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses inefficient serving of MoE-based LLMs, where naive FCFS/round-robin scheduling causes head-of-line blocking, load imbalance, and underutilization under expert parallelism. It proposes a multi-layer scheduling framework that jointly optimizes request ordering (SJF with priority aging), engine dispatch (prefix token load, KV cache utilization, user stickiness), and expert placement/routing to mitigate hotspots and balance load. Across 100+ experiments, the system outperforms vLLM, reducing TTFT by up to 17.8% and TPOT by up to 13.3%.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 MoE 大模型推理服务中传统 FCFS/RR 调度导致的资源利用不足、头阻塞、负载不均以及专家并行路由复杂等问题，提出了面向请求、引擎和专家三层的调度框架。其核心方法是在请求层采用 SJF 与优先级老化，在引擎层基于前缀负载、KV cache 利用率和用户粘性进行负载感知分发，并在专家层缓解热点、优化层间专家依赖放置。实验表明，该方法在多种负载下优于 vLLM，最高可将 TTFT 降低 17.8%、TPOT 降低 13.3%。

papers.title: S-HPLB: Efficient LLM Attention Serving via Sparsity-Aware Head Parallelism Load Balance
papers.authors: Di Liu, Yifei Liu, Chen Chen, Zhibin Yu, Xiaoyi Fan, Quan Chen 等
papers.abstract_en: With the increasing volumes of Large Language Models (LLMs) and the expanding context lengths, attention computation has become a key performance bottleneck in LLM serving. For fast attention computation, recent practices often parallelize the attention heads on multiple GPUs, and also widely adopt attention sparsification to reduce the computation amount -- which selectively computes a subset of attention pairs under a preset sparsity budget. In this paper, we notice that attention heads of an LLM model often exhibit heterogeneous-yet-stable sparsity elasticities, which motivates us to enforce head-adaptive sparsity budgets to attain better efficiency while preserving high inference quality. Yet, from the system aspect, with heterogeneous sparsity levels, attention computation time on different heads would be inconsistent, yielding cross-GPU resource bubbles under head-parallel deployment. To further minimize such bubbles, we propose a novel attention deployment strategy called Sparsity-aware Head-Parallel Load Balance (S-HPLB). Experiments on long-context benchmark show that, S-HPLB can achieve a $2.88\times$ improvement in average attention computation latency without quality degradation.
papers.abstract_cn: 随着大语言模型 (LLM) 数量的增加和上下文长度的扩展，注意力计算已成为 LLM 服务中的关键性能瓶颈。为了实现快速注意力计算，最近的实践经常将注意力头并行于多个 GPU 上，并广泛采用注意力分散化来减少计算量——即在预设的稀疏预算下选择性地计算注意力对的子集。在本文中，我们注意到 LLM 模型的注意力头通常表现出异质但稳定的稀疏弹性，这促使我们强制执行头部自适应稀疏预算，以获得更好的效率，同时保持较高的推理质量。然而，从系统角度来看，在异构稀疏度水平下，不同头部的注意力计算时间将不一致，在头部并行部署下会产生跨 GPU 资源泡沫。为了进一步最小化这种泡沫，我们提出了一种新的注意力部署策略，称为稀疏感知头部并行负载均衡 (S-HPLB)。长背景基准测试的实验表明，S-HPLB 可以在不降低质量的情况下，将平均注意力计算延迟提高 2.88 倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles the attention bottleneck in multi-GPU LLM serving, where head-parallel execution combined with attention sparsification causes cross-GPU load imbalance because different heads have heterogeneous computation costs. It proposes S-HPLB, a sparsity-aware head-parallel load-balancing strategy that exploits stable per-head sparsity elasticity to assign adaptive sparsity budgets and schedule heads to minimize resource bubbles. Experiments on long-context benchmarks show a 2.88× reduction in average attention latency with no quality degradation.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 推理服务中注意力计算成为瓶颈、且在多 GPU 头并行下稀疏化导致负载不均的问题展开研究。其核心洞见是不同注意力头具有稳定但异构的稀疏弹性，因此提出 S-HPLB，通过头自适应稀疏预算与稀疏感知的头并行负载均衡来减少跨 GPU 计算气泡。实验表明，该方法在长上下文基准上可将平均注意力计算延迟提升 2.88 倍，同时不损失推理质量。

papers.title: MoE-SpAc: Efficient MoE Inference Based on Speculative Activation Utility in Heterogeneous Edge Scenarios
papers.authors: Shuhuai Li, Jianghao Lin, Dongdong Ge, Yinyu Ye
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable scalable performance but face severe memory constraints on edge devices. Existing offloading strategies struggle with I/O bottlenecks due to the dynamic, low-information nature of autoregressive expert activation. In this paper, we propose to repurpose Speculative Decoding (SD) not merely as a compute accelerator, but as an informative lookahead sensor for memory management, supported by our theoretical and empirical analyses. Hence, we introduce MoE-SpAc, an MoE inference framework that integrates a Speculative Utility Estimator to track expert demand, a Heterogeneous Workload Balancer to dynamically partition computation via online integer optimization, and an Asynchronous Execution Engine to unify the prefetching and eviction in the same utility space. Extensive experiments on seven benchmarks demonstrate that MoE-SpAc achieves a 42% improvement in TPS over the SOTA SD-based baseline, and an average 4.04x speedup over all standard baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/lshAlgorithm/MoE-SpAc .
papers.abstract_cn: 专家混合 (MoE) 模型能够实现可扩展的性能，但在边缘设备上面临严重的内存限制。现有的卸载策略由于自回归专家激活的动态、低信息量特性而面临 I/O 瓶颈。在本文中，我们建议重新利用推测性解码 (SD) 不仅作为计算加速器，而且作为内存管理的信息化前瞻性传感器，这得到了我们理论和实证分析的支持。因此，我们引入了 MoE-SpAc，这是一个 MoE 推理框架，它集成了用于跟踪专家需求的推测性效用估计器、通过在线整数优化动态划分计算的异构工作负载均衡器，以及用于在同一效用空间中统一预取和驱逐的异步执行引擎。在七个基准上进行的广泛实验表明，与基于 SOTA SD 的基准相比，MoE-SpAc 的 TPS 提高了 42%，并且与所有标准基准相比，平均速度提高了 4.04 倍。代码可以在 https://github.com/lshAlgorithm/MoE-SpAc 上获得。
papers.ai_summary_en: MoE-SpAc addresses memory-constrained, heterogeneous edge inference for Mixture-of-Experts LLMs, where dynamic autoregressive expert activation causes I/O bottlenecks in existing offloading systems. It repurposes speculative decoding as a lookahead utility signal and combines a speculative expert-utility estimator, online integer-optimization-based heterogeneous workload balancing, and an asynchronous engine that unifies prefetching and eviction. Experiments on seven benchmarks show a 42% TPS improvement over a state-of-the-art speculative-decoding baseline and an average 4.04× speedup over standard baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘设备上 MoE 模型因专家激活动态性强、内存受限和 offloading I/O 瓶颈导致推理低效的问题。其核心洞见是将投机解码用作内存管理的前瞻“传感器”，并通过投机效用估计、异构负载在线优化和异步预取/换出机制统一专家调度。实验显示，该方法在七个基准上相较最优 SD 基线提升 42% TPS，相对标准基线平均加速 4.04 倍。

papers.title: TAPS: Task Aware Proposal Distributions for Speculative Sampling
papers.authors: Mohamad Zbib, Mohamad Bazzi, Ammar Mohanna, Hasan Abed Al Kader Hammoud, Bernard Ghanem
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by letting a lightweight draft model propose future tokens that a larger target model then verifies in parallel. In practice, however, draft models are usually trained on broad generic corpora, which leaves it unclear how much speculative decoding quality depends on the draft training distribution. We study this question with lightweight HASS and EAGLE-2 drafters trained on MathInstruct, ShareGPT, and mixed-data variants, evaluated on MT-Bench, GSM8K, MATH-500, and SVAMP. Measured by acceptance length, task-specific training yields clear specialization: MathInstruct-trained drafts are strongest on reasoning benchmarks, while ShareGPT-trained drafts are strongest on MT-Bench. Mixed-data training improves robustness, but larger mixtures do not dominate across decoding temperatures. We also study how to combine specialized drafters at inference time. Naive checkpoint averaging performs poorly, whereas confidence-based routing improves over single-domain drafts and merged-tree verification yields the highest acceptance length overall for both backbones. Finally, confidence is a more useful routing signal than entropy: rejected tokens tend to have higher entropy, but confidence produces much clearer benchmark-level routing decisions. These results show that speculative decoding quality depends not only on draft architecture, but also on the match between draft training data and downstream workload, and that specialized drafters are better combined at inference time than in weight space.
papers.abstract_cn: 推测性解码通过让轻量级草稿模型提出未来标记，然后由更大的目标模型并行验证，从而加速自回归生成。然而，在实践中，草稿模型通常在广泛的通用语料库上进行训练，这使得不清楚推测性解码质量在多大程度上取决于草稿训练分布。我们研究了这个问题，使用在 MathInstruct、ShareGPT 和混合数据变体上训练的轻量级 HASS 和 EAGLE-2 草稿模型，并在 MT-Bench、GSM8K、MATH-500 和 SVAMP 上进行评估。以验收长度衡量，任务特定训练产生了明显的专业化:MathInstruct 训练的草稿在推理基准上最强，而 ShareGPT 训练的草稿在 MT-Bench 上最强。混合数据训练提高了鲁棒性，但较大的混合并不主导整个解码温度。我们还研究了如何在推理时间内组合专业的草图设计者。朴素检查点平均表现不佳，而基于置信度的路由在单域草稿中表现得更好，并且合并树验证为两个主干都产生了最高的整体接受长度。最后，置信度是一个比熵更有用的路由信号：被拒绝的令牌往往具有更高的熵，但置信度能够产生更清晰的基准级路由决策。这些结果表明，推测性解码质量不仅取决于草稿架构，还取决于草稿训练数据与下游工作负载之间的匹配，并且专业草稿人在推理时间上的组合比在权重空间上的组合更好。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper studies how the training distribution of draft models affects speculative decoding, addressing the mismatch between generic draft corpora and downstream workloads. It trains lightweight HASS and EAGLE-2 drafters on math, chat, and mixed data, evaluates acceptance length across reasoning and instruction benchmarks, and compares inference-time combination strategies such as checkpoint averaging, confidence-based routing, and merged-tree verification. The results show strong task specialization, with math-trained drafters best on reasoning tasks and chat-trained drafters best on MT-Bench, while confidence-based routing and merged-tree verification outperform weight averaging and indicate that workload-aligned proposal distributions are central to speculative decoding performance.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文研究投机解码中草稿模型的训练分布如何影响推理加速效果，核心问题是草稿数据与下游任务是否匹配。作者用 HASS 和 EAGLE-2 在数学、对话及混合数据上训练草稿模型，并比较权重平均、置信度路由和合并树验证等推理时组合策略。结果显示任务特化草稿在对应基准上接受长度更高，置信度路由优于熵且合并树验证整体最佳，说明投机解码质量高度依赖草稿训练数据与工作负载的匹配。

papers.title: ZoomR: Memory Efficient Reasoning through Multi-Granularity Key Value Retrieval
papers.authors: David H. Yang, Yuxuan Zhu, Mohammad Mohammadi Amiri, Keerthiram Murugesan, Tejaswini Pedapati, Subhajit Chaudhury, Pin-Yu Chen
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown great performance on complex reasoning tasks but often require generating long intermediate thoughts before reaching a final answer. During generation, LLMs rely on a key-value (KV) cache for autoregressive decoding. However, the memory footprint of the KV cache grows with output length. Prior work on KV cache optimization mostly focus on compressing the long input context, while retaining the full KV cache for decoding. For tasks requiring long output generation, this leads to increased computational and memory costs. In this paper, we introduce ZoomR, a novel approach that enables LLMs to adaptively compress verbose reasoning thoughts into summaries and uses a dynamic KV cache selection policy that leverages these summaries while also strategically zooming in on fine-grained details. By using summary keys as a coarse-grained index during decoding, ZoomR uses the query to retrieve details for only the most important thoughts. This hierarchical strategy significantly reduces memory usage by avoiding full-cache attention at each step. Experiments across math and reasoning tasks show that our approach achieves competitive performance compared to baselines, while reducing inference memory requirements by more than 4x.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型在复杂推理任务上表现出色，但通常需要生成冗长的中间思考过程。本文提出 ZoomR，使 LLMs 能自适应压缩冗长推理思考为摘要，并使用动态 KV cache 选择策略，利用摘要同时策略性地聚焦细粒度细节。通过摘要键作为粗粒度索引，仅检索最重要思考的细节，避免每步全缓存注意力，推理内存需求降低 4x+。
papers.ai_summary_en: ZoomR addresses the memory bottleneck of KV caches during long-chain reasoning generation, where autoregressive decoding must retain an increasingly large cache and prior compression methods mainly target input contexts. It introduces a hierarchical KV management scheme that compresses verbose reasoning steps into coarse summary keys and dynamically retrieves fine-grained KV details only for summaries most relevant to the current query, avoiding full-cache attention. Experiments on math and reasoning tasks show competitive accuracy while reducing inference memory requirements by over 4×.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长链推理中 KV cache 随生成长度膨胀、现有方法多只压缩输入上下文而忽略解码阶段内存开销的问题。ZoomR 将冗长推理内容自适应压缩为摘要，并以摘要键作为粗粒度索引，在解码时按需检索关键片段的细粒度 KV，形成多粒度分层缓存选择策略。实验显示，该方法在数学与推理任务上保持有竞争力的性能，同时将推理内存需求降低 4 倍以上。

papers.title: IceCache: Memory-efficient KV-cache Management for Long-Sequence LLMs
papers.authors: Yuzhen Mao et al.
papers.abstract_en: Key-Value (KV) cache plays a crucial role in accelerating inference in large language models (LLMs) by storing intermediate attention states and avoiding redundant computation during autoregressive generation. However, its memory footprint scales linearly with sequence length. We propose IceCache, which integrates semantic token clustering with PagedAttention. By organizing semantically related tokens into contiguous memory regions managed by a hierarchical, dynamically updatable data structure, our method enables more efficient token selection and better utilization of memory bandwidth during CPU-GPU transfers. Experimental results on LongBench show that, with a 256-token budget, IceCache maintains 99% of the original accuracy achieved by the full KV cache model.
papers.abstract_cn: KV cache 在加速 LLM 推理中起关键作用，但内存占用与序列长度线性增长。提出 IceCache，集成语义 token 聚类与 PagedAttention，将语义相关 token 组织到连续内存区域中。256-token 预算下保持完整 KV cache 模型 99% 精度，25% 预算下性能优越。
papers.ai_summary_en: IceCache addresses the linear memory growth of KV caches in long-sequence LLM inference, which limits serving efficiency under tight memory budgets. It combines semantic token clustering with PagedAttention, organizing related tokens into contiguous pages managed by a hierarchical, dynamically updatable structure to improve token selection and CPU–GPU transfer efficiency. On LongBench, IceCache retains 99% of full-cache accuracy using only a 256-token KV-cache budget.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长序列 LLM 推理中 KV cache 内存随长度线性增长、CPU-GPU 传输带宽利用不足的问题，提出 IceCache，将语义 token 聚类与 PagedAttention 结合，并用分层可动态更新的数据结构把语义相关 token 组织到连续内存区域，从而提升 token 选择效率和传输带宽利用率。实验表明，在 LongBench 上仅使用 256 个 token 的缓存预算，IceCache 仍可保持完整 KV cache 模型约 99% 的准确率，为长上下文 LLM 服务提供了低内存、高效率的缓存管理方案。

papers.title: ForkKV: Scaling Multi-LoRA Agent Serving via Copy-on-Write Disaggregated KV Cache
papers.authors: Shao Wang, Rui Ren, Lin Gui
papers.abstract_en: The serving paradigm of LLMs is rapidly shifting towards complex multi-agent workflows. While LoRA enables efficient co-hosting of specialized agents, it introduces a critical memory bottleneck — unique LoRA activations cause KV cache divergence, rendering traditional prefix caching ineffective. ForkKV introduces fork with copy-on-write (CoW) memory management. By exploiting LoRA's structural properties, ForkKV physically decouples KV cache into shared and agent-specific components. A DualRadixTree architecture allows forked agents to inherit shared cache with CoW semantics. ResidualAttention kernel reconstructs disaggregated KV cache within on-chip SRAM. ForkKV achieves up to 3.0x throughput of state-of-the-art multi-LoRA serving systems.
papers.abstract_cn: LLM 服务范式转向多 agent 工作流。LoRA 使专业化 agent 共存但引入内存瓶颈。ForkKV 借鉴 OS fork + CoW 内存管理范式，物理解耦 KV cache 为共享和 agent 特定组件。DualRadixTree 架构支持共享缓存继承与 CoW 语义，ResidualAttention 内核在 SRAM 中重建解耦 KV cache。吞吐量提升达 3.0x。
papers.ai_summary_en: ForkKV addresses the KV-cache memory bottleneck in multi-LoRA LLM agent serving, where adapter-specific activations cause cache divergence and invalidate conventional prefix caching. Its key insight is to disaggregate the KV cache into shared and LoRA-specific components using fork-based copy-on-write memory management, a DualRadixTree for cache inheritance, and a residual attention kernel that reconstructs the cache in on-chip SRAM. This design improves multi-LoRA serving throughput by up to 3.0× over state-of-the-art systems.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对多LoRA智能体服务中因各LoRA激活导致KV缓存分叉、传统前缀缓存失效和内存开销增大的问题。  
其核心方法是利用LoRA结构特性将KV缓存解耦为共享部分与智能体专属部分，并通过Copy-on-Write的DualRadixTree和片上SRAM中的残差注意力kernel实现高效共享与重建。  
实验显示，ForkKV相比现有多LoRA服务系统可将吞吐提升最高3.0倍。

papers.title: ReviveMoE: Fast Recovery for Hardware Failures in Large-Scale MoE LLM Inference Deployments
papers.authors: Haley Li, Xinglu Wang, Cong Feng, Chunxu Zuo, Yanan Wang, Hei Lo, Yufei Cui, Bingji Wang, Duo Cui, Shuming Jing, Yizhou Shan, Ying Xiong, Jiannan Wang, Yong Zhang, Zhenan Fan
papers.abstract_en: As LLM deployments scale over more hardware, the probability of a single failure increases significantly. A common recovery approach is to restart the LLM serving instance; however, this is costly in MaaS inference settings, where reloading model weights and recompiling computation graphs introduce significant delays. We propose ReviveMoE, a method for rapid failure recovery in large-scale LLM deployments without restarting the serving instance. ReviveMoE supports both traditional collocated MoE+attention architecture and disaggregated architectures. Integrated into Huawei Cloud's MaaS, built on xDeepServe and XCCL.
papers.abstract_cn: LLM 部署规模扩展后单点故障概率显著增加。重启服务实例成本高（重新加载权重和编译计算图延迟大）。提出 ReviveMoE，无需重启即可快速故障恢复，支持传统同位和解耦架构，已集成到华为云 MaaS。
papers.ai_summary_en: ReviveMoE addresses the high recovery cost of hardware failures in large-scale MoE LLM inference, where restarting serving instances requires expensive model-weight reloading and computation-graph recompilation. It enables rapid failure recovery without restarting the serving instance, supporting both collocated MoE+attention and disaggregated inference architectures. The system is integrated into Huawei Cloud’s MaaS stack on xDeepServe and XCCL, improving availability and reducing downtime in production LLM deployments.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大规模 MoE LLM 推理部署中硬件故障后重启实例代价高的难题，指出重新加载模型权重和重编译计算图会显著拖慢 MaaS 服务恢复。其提出 ReviveMoE，通过无需重启服务实例的快速故障恢复机制，支持传统共置式 MoE+Attention 架构以及分离式架构，并集成到华为云 MaaS 的 xDeepServe 与 XCCL 系统中。该工作有望显著降低故障恢复延迟，提升大规模 LLM 推理服务的可用性和连续性。

papers.title: Efficiently Aligning Draft Models via Parameter- and Data-Efficient Adaptation
papers.authors: Luxi Lin, Zhihang Lin, Zhanpeng Zeng, Yuhao Chen, Qingyu Zhang, Jixiang Luo, Xuelong Li, Rongrong Ji
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference but suffers from performance degradation when target models are fine-tuned for specific domains. We introduce EDA (Efficient Draft Adaptation), a parameter- and data-efficient framework for adapting draft models. EDA introduces: (1) a decoupled architecture with shared and private components; (2) a data regeneration strategy using the fine-tuned target model; (3) a sample selection mechanism prioritizing high-value data. EDA effectively restores speculative performance on fine-tuned models with significantly reduced training costs.
papers.abstract_cn: 推测解码在目标模型微调后性能下降。提出 EDA 框架：(1) 解耦架构分离共享和私有组件；(2) 利用目标模型再生训练数据；(3) 优先选择高价值数据。显著降低训练成本的同时恢复推测性能。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the degradation of speculative decoding when target LLMs are fine-tuned for specific domains, causing draft-target mismatch and reduced acceptance rates. EDA aligns draft models through parameter- and data-efficient adaptation, using a decoupled shared/private architecture, regenerated supervision from the fine-tuned target model, and high-value sample selection. It restores speculative decoding performance on adapted targets while substantially reducing training and adaptation costs.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对目标大模型经过领域微调后，投机解码中草稿模型与目标模型分布失配导致加速性能下降的问题。提出 EDA 框架，通过共享/私有组件解耦的草稿模型结构、利用微调后目标模型再生训练数据，以及优先选择高价值样本，实现参数与数据高效的草稿模型对齐。实验表明，EDA 能以显著更低的训练成本恢复微调模型上的投机解码性能，提高推理加速效果。

papers.title: Characterizing Performance-Energy Trade-offs of Large Language Models in Multi-Request Workflows
papers.authors: Md. Monzurul Amin Ifath, Israat Haque
papers.abstract_en: First systematic characterization of performance-energy trade-offs in multi-request LLM inference. We develop four representative workloads (sequential, interactive, agentic, composite). Using NVIDIA A100 with vLLM and Parrot, we analyze how key energy knobs affect latency, throughput, and energy use. Batch size is the most impactful lever but workload dependent. GPU power capping provides modest savings. vLLM maintains higher GPU utilization for decode-heavy workloads; Parrot's workflow-aware scheduling achieves lower energy under power constraints.
papers.abstract_cn: 首次系统化刻画多请求 LLM 推理的性能-能效权衡。四种工作负载（顺序/交互/agent/复合），vLLM/Parrot 对比分析。batch size 是最关键杠杆但效果依赖工作负载类型。vLLM decode-heavy 效率更高，Parrot 功率约束下能耗更低。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a systematic performance–energy characterization for multi-request LLM inference workflows. It evaluates four representative workloads on an NVIDIA A100 using vLLM and Parrot, analyzing how configuration knobs such as batch size and GPU power capping affect latency, throughput, and energy consumption. The study finds that batch size is the dominant but workload-dependent efficiency lever, power capping yields only modest savings, and workflow-aware scheduling in Parrot can achieve lower energy under power constraints while vLLM maintains higher GPU utilization for decode-heavy workloads.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作首次系统刻画了多请求 LLM 推理工作流中的性能—能耗权衡，覆盖顺序、交互、智能体和复合四类代表性负载。通过在 A100 上对比 vLLM 与 Parrot，并分析批大小、GPU 功率上限等关键能耗旋钮，发现批大小影响最大且依赖负载，功率上限节能有限，Parrot 的工作流感知调度在功率受限下更省电。该研究为 LLM 服务的负载感知调度与能效优化提供了实证依据和设计方向。

papers.title: Efficient Multi-round LLM Inference over Disaggregated Serving (AMPD)
papers.authors: Wenhao He, Youhe Jiang, Penghao Zhao, Quanqing Xu, Eiko Yoneki, Bin Cui, Fangcheng Fu
papers.abstract_en: Multi-round workflows raise hurdles for PD disaggregation — existing systems overlook interleaved prefill-decode workload patterns. AMPD adaptively coordinates prefill workloads based on real-time conditions, determining where to execute and how to schedule to maximize SLO attainment. A planning algorithm deduces optimal resource allocation and parallel strategies. AMPD substantially improves SLO attainment compared to baselines.
papers.abstract_cn: 多轮工作流对 PD 解耦带来挑战。AMPD 基于实时工作负载自适应协调 prefill，确定执行位置和调度方式以最大化 SLO 达成率。专用规划算法推导最优资源分配和并行策略，显著提升 SLO 达成率。
papers.ai_summary_en: AMPD addresses inefficient multi-round LLM serving under prefill-decode disaggregation, where interleaved prefill and decode phases in iterative workflows can degrade SLO attainment. It introduces an adaptive coordinator that decides where and how to schedule prefill workloads based on real-time system conditions, along with a planning algorithm that optimizes resource allocation and parallelism strategies. Evaluations show that AMPD substantially improves SLO attainment over baseline disaggregated serving systems.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多轮大模型工作流中预填充-解码（PD）解耦服务忽略交错负载模式、导致 SLO 难以保障的问题。AMPD 根据实时负载自适应决定预填充任务的执行位置与调度方式，并通过规划算法优化资源分配和并行策略。实验表明，相较基线方法，AMPD 显著提升了 SLO 达成率。

papers.title: Trinity: Disaggregating Vector Search from Prefill-Decode Disaggregation in LLM Serving
papers.authors: Yi Liu, Chen Qian
papers.abstract_en: Trinity consolidates all retrieval into a single shared vector-search GPU pool working with PD disaggregated LLM serving. Introduces: (1) novel architecture for GPU-based vector search in PD disaggregation; (2) continuous batching for vector search under heterogeneous queries; (3) stage-aware scheduling that preempts vector search requests between decode and prefill tasks.
papers.abstract_cn: Trinity 将所有检索整合到单一共享向量搜索 GPU 池，与 PD 解耦 LLM 服务协同。三层解耦架构（Prefill + Decode + Vector Search），向量搜索连续批处理，Stage-aware 调度抢占机制。
papers.ai_summary_en: Trinity addresses the problem of efficiently integrating GPU-based vector retrieval into prefill–decode (PD) disaggregated LLM serving, where co-locating retrieval with inference can cause contention and underutilization. It proposes a shared vector-search GPU pool with a disaggregated architecture, continuous batching for heterogeneous vector queries, and stage-aware scheduling that preempts retrieval work based on prefill and decode demands. The main impact is tighter coupling of retrieval and generation in serving pipelines, improving resource utilization and latency/throughput tradeoffs for retrieval-augmented LLM inference.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对预填充-解码（PD）分离的大模型服务中，向量检索与推理任务争用 GPU 资源、且查询负载异构导致效率下降的问题。其核心方法是提出 Trinity，将向量检索进一步解耦为共享 GPU 检索池，并通过连续批处理与阶段感知调度，使检索请求能在 prefill 和 decode 任务间被灵活抢占和编排。该工作提升了检索增强型 LLM 服务的资源利用率与端到端性能，为大规模向量搜索与推理协同提供了可扩展架构。

papers.title: From Inference Routing to Agent Orchestration: Declarative Policy Compilation with Cross-Layer Verification
papers.authors: Huamin Chen, Xunzhuo Liu, Bowei He, Xue Liu
papers.abstract_en: Extends the Semantic Router DSL from stateless per-request routing to multi-step agent workflows. The compiler emits verified decision nodes for orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, OpenClaw), Kubernetes artifacts, YANG/NETCONF payloads, and protocol-boundary gates (MCP, A2A) from a single source. Non-Turing-complete language guarantees exhaustive routing, conflict-free branching, and audit traces. Four pillars: auditability, cost efficiency, verifiability, tunability.
papers.abstract_cn: 将 Semantic Router DSL 从单请求路由扩展到多步 agent 工作流。编译器从单一源文件生成推理网关、agent 编排和基础设施多层制品。非 Turing 完备语言保证无冲突分支和引用完整性。四支柱：可审计性、成本效率、可验证性、可调性。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the need for auditable, verifiable policy control over LLM inference routing and multi-step agent orchestration across serving, infrastructure, and protocol layers. It extends a non-Turing-complete Semantic Router DSL into a compiler that emits verified decision nodes and deployment artifacts for orchestrators such as LangGraph/OpenClaw, Kubernetes, YANG/NETCONF, and MCP/A2A protocol gates from a single policy source. By enabling exhaustive routing analysis, conflict-free branching, and audit traces, the approach provides a cross-layer foundation for cost-efficient, tunable, and provably consistent agent workflows.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型服务从单请求推理路由扩展到多步智能体编排时，策略难以跨层一致、验证和审计的问题展开研究。其核心方法是将 Semantic Router DSL 扩展为声明式、非图灵完备的编排策略语言，从单一源编译出 LangGraph/OpenClaw 决策节点、Kubernetes 制品、YANG/NETCONF 配置以及 MCP/A2A 协议边界门，并通过跨层验证保证路由穷尽、分支无冲突和可审计。该工作为智能体系统提供了可审计、低成本、可验证且可调优的编排基础。

papers.title: Hardware-Software Co-design for 3D-DRAM-based LLM Serving Accelerator
papers.authors: Cong Li, Yihan Yin, Chenhao Xue, Zhao Wang, Fujun Bai, Yixin Guo, Xiping Jiang, Qiang Wu, Yuan Xie, Guangyu Sun
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have been widely deployed for online generative services, where numerous LLM instances jointly handle workloads with fluctuating request arrival rates and variable request lengths. To efficiently execute coexisting compute-intensive and memory-intensive operators, near-memory processing (NMP) based computing paradigm has been extensively proposed. However, existing NMP designs adopt coarse-grained KV cache management and inflexible attention execution flow. Such limitations hinder these proposals from efficiently handling highly dynamic LLM serving workloads, limiting their ability to accelerate LLM serving. We propose Helios, a Hybrid-bonding-based LLM Serving accelerator. Helios aims to bridge the fundamental gap between the dynamic nature of KV cache management in LLM serving and the distributed, non-uniform memory abstraction among NMP processing engines (PEs). To this end, we design both the intra-PE execution flow and the inter-PE communication primitives for distributed tiled attention execution. We further propose spatially-aware KV cache allocation mechanism to balance the attention workload distribution while minimizing the inter-PE data transfer overhead. Compared with existing GPU/NMP designs, Helios achieves 3.25 times (geomean) speedup and 3.36 times (geomean) better energy efficiency, along with up to 72%/76% P50/P99 time-between-tokens degradation.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型 (LLM) 已被广泛部署在在线生成服务中，其中许多 LLM 实例共同处理请求到达率波动和请求长度可变的工作负载。为了高效地执行并存的计算密集型和内存密集型运算符，已经广泛提出了基于近内存处理 (NMP) 的计算范式。然而，现有的 NMP 设计采用粗粒度 KV 缓存管理和不灵活的注意力执行流程。这些限制阻碍了这些方案有效地处理高度动态的 LLM 服务工作负载，限制了它们加速 LLM 服务的能力。我们提出了 Helios，一种基于混合绑定的 LLM 服务加速器。Helios 旨在弥合 LLM 服务中 KV 缓存管理的动态性质与 NMP 处理引擎 (PEs) 之间分布式、非均匀的内存抽象之间的根本差距。为此，我们设计了 PE 内执行流程和 PE 间通信基元，用于分布式平铺注意力执行。我们进一步提出了空间感知的 KV 缓存分配机制，以平衡注意力负载分配，同时最小化 PE 间数据传输开销。与现有的 GPU/NMP 设计相比，Helios 实现了 3.25 倍的 (几何) 加速和 3.36 倍的 (几何) 能量效率改善，并且令牌间时间退化率高达 72%/76%。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles inefficient near-memory-processing LLM serving caused by coarse-grained KV-cache management and inflexible attention execution under dynamic request rates and sequence lengths. Helios, a hybrid-bonding 3D-DRAM accelerator, introduces distributed tiled attention with customized intra-PE execution flows, inter-PE communication primitives, and spatially aware KV-cache allocation to balance workloads and reduce data movement. It achieves a geomean 3.25× speedup and 3.36× energy-efficiency gain over GPU/NMP baselines, with up to 72%/76% P50/P99 time-between-tokens improvement.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对近存计算加速LLM在线服务时KV缓存管理粗粒度、注意力执行流不灵活、难以适应动态请求的问题，论文提出基于3D-DRAM混合键合的软硬件协同加速器Helios。其核心是通过PE内分布式分块注意力执行流、PE间通信原语和空间感知KV缓存分配，在分布式非均匀内存抽象下平衡负载并减少数据搬运。相较GPU和现有NMP方案，Helios平均加速3.25倍、能效提升3.36倍，并显著降低P50/P99出token延迟。

papers.title: PAM: Processing Across Memory Hierarchy for Efficient KV-centric LLM Serving System
papers.authors: Lian Liu, Shixin Zhao, Yutian Zhou, Yutian Zhou, Yintao He, Mengdi Wang, Yinhe Han, Ying Wang
papers.abstract_en: The widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) has exponentially increased the demand for efficient serving systems. With growing requests and context lengths, key-value (KV)-related operations, including attention computation and KV cache storage, have emerged as critical bottlenecks. They require massive memory bandwidth and capacity. Unfortunately, existing LLM serving systems, optimized for compute-bound workloads, fail to handle these memory-intensive operations effectively. Even with Processing-In-Memory (PIM) technology, current single-level memory designs cannot simultaneously satisfy the bandwidth and capacity requirements. To address these challenges, we propose Processing Across Memory (PAM), a KV-centric LLM serving system that coordinates heterogeneous PIM-enabled memory devices within a hierarchical architecture. PAM introduces a novel computing paradigm to balance high memory bandwidth with scalable capacity. First, PAM exploits the inherent context locality in KV access patterns to intelligently distribute KV tokens across the memory hierarchy. Second, to further exploit context locality, it introduces the PAMattention algorithm, enabling fine-grained parallel attention computation across heterogeneous PIM devices. Finally, PAM incorporates an intra-device KV mapping, inter-device KV migration interface, and an inter-device online KV scheduling algorithm to dynamically balance computational workloads.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型 (LLM) 的广泛采用使得对高效服务系统的需求呈指数级增长。随着请求和上下文长度的增长，与键值 (KV) 相关的操作，包括注意力计算和 KV 缓存存储，已成为关键的瓶颈。这些操作需要大量的内存带宽和容量。不幸的是，现有的 LLM 服务系统虽然针对计算密集型工作负载进行了优化，但无法有效地处理这些内存密集型操作。即使采用内存处理 (PIM) 技术，目前的单级内存设计也无法同时满足带宽和容量需求。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了跨内存处理 (PAM)，这是一个以 KV 为中心的 LLM 服务系统，用于在内存层级架构中协调异构的支持 PIM 的内存设备。PAM 引入了一种新的计算范式，以平衡高内存带宽和可扩展容量。首先，PAM 利用 KV 访问模式中固有的上下文本地性，智能地在内存层级中分配 KV 令牌。其次，为了进一步利用上下文本地性，它引入了 PAMattention 算法，实现了异构 PIM 设备之间的细粒度并行注意力计算。最后，PAM 融合了设备内 KV 映射、设备间 KV 迁移接口和设备间在线 KV 调度算法，以动态平衡计算负载。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles memory-bandwidth and capacity bottlenecks in LLM serving caused by KV-cache storage and attention computation, which existing compute-optimized systems and single-level PIM designs cannot handle efficiently. PAM proposes a hierarchical, KV-centric serving system that coordinates heterogeneous PIM-enabled memories using context-locality-aware KV placement, a fine-grained parallel PAMattention algorithm, and online KV migration/scheduling. This design balances high bandwidth with scalable capacity, improving the efficiency and scalability of KV-intensive LLM inference.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 服务中 KV 缓存存储与注意力计算受限于内存带宽和容量的问题，指出现有计算优化型系统和单层 PIM 方案难以同时满足高带宽与大容量需求。其核心方法是提出 PAM，在异构 PIM 构成的分层内存体系中协同处理 KV 数据，利用上下文局部性分布 KV token，并通过 PAMattention、KV 迁移接口和在线调度实现跨设备细粒度并行注意力计算与负载均衡。该工作为 KV 中心的大模型推理提供了一种兼顾带宽与容量的内存层级协同服务范式，有望提升大规模 LLM 服务效率。

papers.title: Cost-Efficient Multimodal LLM Inference via Cross-Tier GPU Heterogeneity
papers.authors: Donglin Yu
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language model (MLLM) inference splits into two phases with opposing hardware demands: vision encoding is compute-bound, while language generation is memory-bandwidth-bound. We show that under standard transformer KV caching, the modality boundary minimizes cross-device transfer among all partition points. Partitioning here reduces transfer complexity from O(L*s_ctx) bytes (GB-scale KV caches under stage-level disaggregation) to O(N_v*d) bytes (MB-scale embeddings), an O(L) reduction. The result holds across attention mechanisms (MHA/GQA), dynamic vision resolutions, and model scales. A direct implication is that modality-level disaggregation enables cross-tier heterogeneous serving over commodity PCIe. A closed-form cost model shows that heterogeneous deployment is cost-optimal under phase-separable workloads (predicts 31.4% savings; observed 40.6%). We build HeteroServe, a phase-aware runtime with modality-level partitioning and cross-tier scheduling. On identical 4xA100 hardware, engine optimizations raise throughput by up to 54%. Under a fixed budget, a heterogeneous cluster ($38k) improves Tokens/$ by 37% over a homogeneous baseline ($64k) without degrading latency.
papers.abstract_cn: 多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 推理分为两个阶段，具有相反的硬件需求：视觉编码是计算有限的，而语言生成是内存带宽有限的。我们表明，在标准变压器 KV 缓存下，模态边界最小化所有分区点之间的跨设备传输。这里的分区将传输复杂度从 O(L*s_ctx) 字节 (阶段级解聚下的 GB 级 KV 缓存) 降低到 O(N_v*d) 字节 (MB 级嵌入)，实现了 O(L) 的降低。这一结果适用于注意力机制 (MHA/GQA)、动态视觉分辨率和模型尺度。一个直接的含义是，模态级解聚使得跨层异构服务能够覆盖商品 PCIe。一个封闭的成本模型表明，在阶段分离的工作负载下，异构部署是成本最优的 (预测节省 31.4%，实际观察到 40.6%)。我们构建了 HeteroServe，一个具有模态级划分和跨层调度的阶段感知运行时。在相同的 4xA100 硬件上，引擎优化将吞吐量提高了 54%。在固定预算下，异构集群 (38k) 可以在不降低延迟的情况下，比同质基线 (64k) 将 Tokens/$提高 37%。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles cost-efficient MLLM inference, where vision encoding is compute-bound but language generation is memory-bandwidth-bound, making homogeneous GPU deployments inefficient. It proves that partitioning at the modality boundary minimizes cross-device transfer under KV caching—reducing transfer from GB-scale KV caches to MB-scale embeddings—and uses this insight to enable modality-level disaggregated serving across heterogeneous GPU tiers over PCIe via the HeteroServe runtime and a closed-form cost model. Experiments show up to 54% throughput improvement on 4xA100 and 37% higher Tokens/$ for a $38k heterogeneous cluster versus a $64k homogeneous baseline without latency degradation.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态大模型推理中视觉编码计算密集、语言生成内存带宽密集导致的同构GPU服务成本效率低问题，提出按模态边界进行跨层级异构切分。其核心洞见是在视觉编码后传输MB级视觉嵌入而非GB级KV缓存，可显著降低跨设备通信并支持PCIe异构部署，并据此设计HeteroServe运行时与成本模型。实验显示相同4xA100吞吐最高提升54%，固定预算下异构集群相比更贵的同构方案Tokens/$提升37%且不牺牲延迟。

papers.title: Speculating Experts Accelerates Inference for Mixture-of-Experts
papers.authors: Vivan Madan, Prajwal Singhania, Abhinav Bhatele, Tom Goldstein, Ashwinee Panda
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have gained popularity as a means of scaling the capacity of large language models (LLMs) while maintaining sparse activations and reduced per-token compute. However, in memory-constrained inference settings, expert weights must be offloaded to CPU, creating a performance bottleneck from CPU-GPU transfers during decoding. We propose an expert prefetching scheme that leverages currently computed internal model representations to speculate future experts, enabling memory transfers to overlap with computation. Across multiple MoE architectures, we demonstrate that future experts can be reliably predicted by these internal representations. We also demonstrate that executing speculated experts generally maintains downstream task accuracy, thus preserving more effective compute-memory overlap by eliminating the need to re-fetch true router-selected experts. Integrated into an optimized inference engine, our approach achieves up to 14% reduction in time per output token (TPOT) over on-demand loading of experts from CPU memory. For MoEs where speculative execution alone yields suboptimal accuracy, we further examine lightweight estimators that improve expert prediction hit rates, thereby reducing performance degradation.
papers.abstract_cn: 专家混合 (MoE) 模型作为一种扩展大语言模型 (LLM) 容量的方法已经变得流行，同时保持稀疏的激活并减少每个令牌的计算。然而，在内存受限的推理设置中，专家权重必须下载到 CPU，这在解码过程中会由 CPU-GPU 传输造成性能瓶颈。我们提出了一种专家预取方案，该方案利用当前计算的内部模型表示来推测未来的专家，使内存传输能够与计算重叠。在多种 MoE 架构中，我们证明了可以通过这些内部表示可靠地预测未来的专家。我们还证明了执行推测的专家通常可以保持下游任务的准确性，从而通过消除重新获取真正路由器选择的专家的需求来保持更有效的计算 - 内存重叠。集成到一个优化的推理机中，我们的方法比按需从 CPU 内存中加载专家，每个输出令牌 (TPOT) 的时间减少了高达 14%。对于仅 Speculative_execution 就会产生次优准确率的 MoE，我们进一步研究了能够提高专家预测命中率的轻量级估计器，从而减少性能退化。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses memory-bound inference for MoE LLMs, where offloading expert weights to CPU creates costly CPU–GPU transfer bottlenecks during decoding. It proposes prefetching and speculatively executing future experts predicted from current internal representations, overlapping memory transfers with computation and using lightweight estimators when prediction quality is insufficient. Across multiple MoE architectures, the method reliably predicts future experts, largely preserves task accuracy, and reduces time per output token by up to 14% versus on-demand expert loading.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对内存受限的 MoE 推理中，专家权重需从 CPU 按需加载、CPU-GPU 传输成为解码瓶颈的问题。其核心方法是利用已计算的内部模型表示预测未来所需专家并提前预取，使内存传输与计算重叠，并在多数情况下直接执行推测专家以保持下游准确率。实验表明，该方法相比按需加载可将每输出 token 时延最高降低 14%，并可借助轻量估计器进一步提升专家命中率、减少精度损失。

papers.title: Benchmarking Compound AI Applications for Hardware-Software Co-Design
papers.authors: Paramuth Samuthrsindh, Angel Cervantes, Varun Gohil, Gohar Irfan Chaudhry, Christina Delimitrou, Adam Belay
papers.abstract_en: Compound AI applications, composed from interactions between Large Language Models (LLMs), Machine Learning (ML) models, external tools and data sources are quickly becoming an integral workload in datacenters. Their diverse sub-components and use-cases present a large configuration-space across the deployment stack -- ranging from applications and serving software down to hardware -- each of which may influence the application performance, deployment cost, and/or resource consumption. Despite their rapid adoption, however, the systems community lacks a standardized benchmark for analyzing this complicated design-space and guiding in system design. In this work, we present our benchmarking suite used for cross-stack analysis of Compound AI applications. Using this, we derive key takeaways and design principles spanning several layers of the stack for hardware-software co-design to unlock higher resource-efficiency.
papers.abstract_cn: 复合人工智能应用程序，由大型语言模型（LLM）、机器学习（ML）模型、外部工具和数据源之间的交互组成，正在迅速成为数据中心的核心工作负载。它们多样的子组件和使用场景在部署堆栈中呈现出庞大的配置空间——从应用程序和服务软件一直到硬件——每一个都可能影响应用程序性能、部署成本和/或资源消耗。然而，尽管采纳速度很快，系统社区仍缺乏用于分析这一复杂设计空间和指导系统设计的标准化基准。在本研究中，我们展示了用于复合人工智能应用跨堆栈分析的基准测试套件。借助该套件，我们得出了涵盖堆栈多个层次的关键结论和设计原则，以实现硬件与软件协同设计，从而释放更高的资源效率。
papers.ai_summary_en: This work addresses the absence of standardized benchmarks for analyzing compound AI applications—LLM-based workflows integrating ML models, tools, and external data—across the full hardware–software serving stack. It introduces a cross-stack benchmarking suite that systematically explores configuration choices spanning application logic, serving software, and hardware resources. The study derives design principles for hardware–software co-design, highlighting opportunities to improve performance, cost, and resource efficiency in datacenter deployments of compound AI workloads.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对复合式 AI 应用在应用、推理服务到硬件层面配置空间巨大、却缺乏标准化基准的问题，提出了一套用于跨栈分析的基准测试套件。其核心洞见是通过系统级 benchmarking 揭示 LLM、ML 模型、工具调用等组件在性能、成本和资源消耗上的权衡，并提炼跨层设计原则。该工作为硬件-软件协同设计提供了依据，有助于提升复合 AI 数据中心的资源效率。

papers.title: SpecMD: A Comprehensive Study On Speculative Expert Prefetching
papers.authors: Duc Hoang, Ajay Jaiswal, Mohammad Samragh, Minsik Cho
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable sparse expert activation, meaning that only a subset of the model's parameters is used during each inference. However, to translate this sparsity into practical performance, an expert caching mechanism is required. Previous works have proposed hardware-centric caching policies, but how these various caching policies interact with each other and different hardware specification remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we develop SpecMD, a standardized framework for benchmarking ad-hoc cache policies on various hardware configurations. Using SpecMD, we perform an exhaustive benchmarking of several MoE caching strategies, reproducing and extending prior approaches in controlled settings with realistic constraints. Our experiments reveal that MoE expert access is not consistent with temporal locality assumptions (e.g LRU, LFU). Motivated by this observation, we propose Least-Stale, a novel eviction policy that exploits MoE's predictable expert access patterns to reduce collision misses by up to 85x over LRU. With such gains, we achieve over 88% hit rates with up to 34.7% Time-to-first-token (TTFT) reduction on OLMoE at only 5% or 0.6GB of VRAM cache capacity.
papers.abstract_cn: 专家混合 (MoE) 模型实现了稀疏专家激活，这意味着在每次推理过程中只使用模型参数的一个子集。然而，为了将这种稀疏性转化为实际性能，需要一种专家缓存机制。以前的工作提出了以硬件为中心的缓存策略，但这些不同的缓存策略如何相互作用以及不同的硬件规范仍然知之甚少。为了解决这一差距，我们开发了 SpecMD，一个标准化的框架，用于对各种硬件配置上的临时缓存策略进行基准测试。使用 SpecMD，我们对几种 MoE 缓存策略进行了详尽的基准测试，在受控环境中复制和扩展先前的方法，并具有现实的约束。我们的实验表明，MoE 专家访问与时间局部性假设 (例如 LRU、LFU) 不一致。受这一观察结果的启发，我们提出了 Least-Stale，这是一种新颖的驱逐策略，它利用 MoE 的可预测专家访问模式，将碰撞误差降低了 85 倍于 LRU。通过这些改进，我们实现了超过 88% 的命中率，在仅有 5% 或 0.6GBVRAM 缓存容量的情况下，OLMoE 上的 TTFT 降低了 34.7%。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the problem of effective expert caching and prefetching for Mixture-of-Experts inference under limited VRAM, where existing hardware-centric policies are poorly understood. It introduces SpecMD, a standardized benchmarking framework, and proposes Least-Stale, an eviction policy that exploits predictable MoE expert-access patterns after showing that temporal-locality policies like LRU/LFU are ineffective. Experiments on OLMoE achieve over 88% cache hit rates, up to 85× fewer collision misses than LRU, and up to 34.7% TTFT reduction using only 0.6GB (5%) of VRAM cache.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 MoE 模型推理中专家缓存/预取策略与硬件配置缺乏系统比较、且传统 LRU/LFU 等基于时间局部性的策略不适用的问题。作者提出标准化基准框架 SpecMD，并基于“MoE 专家访问具有可预测模式”的洞见设计了 Least-Stale 驱逐策略，以减少缓存冲突缺失。实验显示，其相较 LRU 最多降低 85 倍冲突缺失，在仅约 0.6GB/5% VRAM 缓存下仍可实现 88%+ 命中率，并将 OLMoE 的 TTFT 最多降低 34.7%。

papers.title: MoEless: Efficient MoE LLM Serving via Serverless Computing
papers.authors: Hanfei Yu, Bei Ouyang, Shwai He, Ang Li, Hao Wang
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become a cornerstone of AI, driving progress across diverse domains such as content creation, search and recommendation systems, and AI-assisted workflows. To alleviate extreme training costs and advancing model scales, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become a popular backbone for modern LLMs, which are commonly served in distributed deployment using expert parallelism (EP). However, MoE's sparse activation mechanism leads to severe expert load imbalance, where a few experts become overloaded while others remain idle, resulting in expert stragglers that inflate inference latency and serving cost. Existing expert load balancing solutions assume static resource configurations on serverful infrastructures, limiting expert scalability and elasticity, and resulting in either costly real-time expert swapping or degraded generation quality. We present MoEless, the first serverless MoE serving framework that mitigates expert load imbalance and accelerates inference via serverless experts. MoEless employs lightweight, layer-aware predictors to accurately estimate incoming expert load distributions and proactively identify stragglers. We design optimized expert scaling and placement strategies to maximize function locality, improve GPU utilization, and balance loads across experts and GPUs. MoEless is prototyped on top of Megatron-LM and deployed on an eight-GPU testbed. Experiments with open-source MoE models and real-world workloads show that MoEless reduces inference latency by 43% and inference cost by 84% compared to state-of-the-art solutions.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型 (LLMs) 已成为人工智能的基石，推动了内容创建、搜索和推荐系统以及人工智能辅助工作流等多个领域的进步。为了缓解极端的训练成本和提高模型规模，专家混合 (MoE) 已成为现代 LLMs 的热门支柱，这些 LLMs 通常使用专家并行性 (EP) 进行分布式部署。然而，MoE 的稀疏激活机制导致严重的专家负载不平衡，一些专家变得超负荷，而其他专家保持闲置，导致专家落后，从而增加推理延迟和服务成本。现有的专家负载均衡解决方案假设服务器化基础设施上的资源配置是静态的，这限制了专家的可扩展性和弹性，并导致代价高昂的实时专家更换或发电质量下降。我们介绍了 MoEless，这是第一个无服务器 MoE 服务框架，它可以减轻专家负载不平衡，并通过无服务器专家加速推理。MoEless 使用轻量级、分层感知的预测器来准确估计传入的专家负载分布，并主动识别落后者。我们设计了优化的专家扩展和布局策略，以最大限度地提高功能本地性，提高 GPU 利用率，并平衡专家和 GPU 之间的负载。MoEless 是在 Megatron-LM 基础上构建的原型，并部署在一个 8GPU 测试台上。对开源 MoE 模型和现实世界工作负载的实验表明，与最先进的解决方案相比，MoEless 将推理延迟降低了 43%，推理成本降低了 84%。
papers.ai_summary_en: MoEless addresses expert load imbalance in MoE LLM inference under expert parallelism, where sparse routing creates overloaded expert stragglers that inflate latency and serving cost. It introduces a serverless MoE serving framework that uses lightweight, layer-aware predictors to forecast expert load and proactively scales/places experts to maximize locality, GPU utilization, and load balance. Experiments on a Megatron-LM-based eight-GPU testbed show 43% lower inference latency and 84% lower cost versus state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 MoE 大模型推理中因稀疏激活导致的专家负载不均衡和“专家拖尾”问题，指出传统静态专家并行部署难以弹性扩缩、会推高延迟与成本。其核心方法是提出首个 serverless MoE 推理框架 MoEless，通过轻量级、层级感知的负载预测器提前识别过载专家，并结合优化的专家扩缩容与放置策略提升函数局部性、GPU 利用率和负载均衡。实验显示，相比先进方案，MoEless 在八 GPU 测试床上可将推理延迟降低 43%、推理成本降低 84%。

papers.title: DualMap: Enabling Both Cache Affinity and Load Balancing for Distributed LLM Serving
papers.authors: Ying Yuan, Pengfei Zuo, Bo Wang, Zhangyu Chen, Zhipeng Tan, Zhou Yu
papers.abstract_en: In LLM serving, reusing the KV cache of prompts across requests is critical for reducing TTFT and serving costs. Cache-affinity scheduling, which co-locates requests with the same prompt prefix to maximize KV cache reuse, often conflicts with load-balancing scheduling that distributes requests evenly across compute instances. Existing schedulers fail to reconcile this trade-off as they operate within a single mapping space, typically applying cache-affinity routing to a subset of requests and load-balanced routing to the rest, without a unified solution to achieve both goals. To address this limitation, we propose DualMap, a dual-mapping scheduling strategy for distributed LLM serving that achieves both cache affinity and load balancing. Its key idea is to map each request to two candidate instances via two independent hash functions based on the request prompt, then intelligently select the better candidate based on current system states. This design increases the likelihood that requests with shared prefixes are co-located, while evenly dispersing distinct prefixes across the cluster via "the power of two choices". To make DualMap robust under dynamic and skewed real-world workloads, we incorporate three techniques: 1) SLO-aware request routing, which prioritizes cache affinity but switches to load-aware scheduling when TTFT exceeds the SLO, enhancing load balance without sacrificing cache reuse; 2) hotspot-aware rebalancing, which dynamically migrates requests from overloaded to underloaded instances, mitigating hotspots and rebalancing the system; 3) lightweight dual-hash-ring scaling, which leverages a dual-hash-ring mapping to support fast and low-overhead instance scaling without costly global remapping. Experiments on real-world workloads show that DualMap improves effective request capacity by up to 2.25x under the same TTFT SLO constraints compared with SOTA work.
papers.abstract_cn: 在 LLM 服务中，在请求之间重用 KV 缓存提示对于降低 TTFT 和服务成本至关重要。缓存亲和力调度将请求与相同的提示前缀共同放置，以最大限度地重用 KV 缓存，这往往与负载均衡调度相冲突，后者将请求均匀地分布在计算实例之间。现有的调度程序无法协调这种权衡，因为它们在单个映射空间内运行，通常将缓存亲和力路由应用于一部分请求，而将负载均衡路由应用于其余请求，而没有统一的解决方案来实现这两个目标。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了 DualMap，一种分布式 LLM 服务的双映射调度策略，它同时实现了缓存亲和力和负载均衡。其关键思想是根据请求提示符，通过两个独立的哈希函数将每个请求映射到两个候选实例，然后根据当前系统状态智能地选择更好的候选实例。这种设计增加了具有共享前缀的请求共同定位的可能性，同时通过 “两种选择的力量” 在集群中均匀分布不同的前缀。为了使 DualMap 在动态和不平衡的现实世界工作负载下具有鲁棒性，我们整合了三种技术:1) SLO 感知的请求路由，它优先考虑缓存亲和度，但在 TTFT 超过 SLO 时切换到负载感知的调度，在不牺牲缓存重用的情况下提高负载平衡;2) 热点感知的再平衡，它动态地将请求从过载实例迁移到负载不足的实例，从而减少热点并重新平衡系统;3) 轻量级的双哈希环扩展，它利用双哈希环映射来支持快速和低开销的实例扩展，而无需进行代价高昂的全局重映射。在现实世界工作负载上的实验表明，与 SOTA 工作相比，DualMap 在相同 TTFT SLO 约束下将有效请求容量提高了多达 2.25 倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: DualMap addresses the scheduling conflict in distributed LLM serving between KV-cache affinity, which co-locates shared-prefix requests to maximize cache reuse, and load balancing across instances. Its key idea is to map each request to two prompt-hash-selected candidate instances and dynamically choose the better one using runtime state, reinforced by SLO-aware routing, hotspot-aware rebalancing, and lightweight dual-hash-ring scaling. Experiments on real-world workloads show up to 2.25× higher effective request capacity under the same TTFT SLO compared with state-of-the-art schedulers.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对分布式 LLM 服务中 KV cache 复用所需的缓存亲和调度与负载均衡之间的冲突，指出现有单映射调度难以同时兼顾两者。核心方法是 DualMap：通过两个独立哈希函数将每个请求映射到两个候选实例，并结合 SLO 感知路由、热点请求迁移和轻量双哈希环扩缩容，动态选择更优实例。实验表明，在真实负载和相同 TTFT SLO 约束下，其有效请求容量相比最先进方法最高可提升 2.25 倍。

papers.title: PackInfer: Compute- and I/O-Efficient Attention for Batched LLM Inference
papers.authors: Authors from arxiv (see full paper)
papers.abstract_en: Attention efficiency is critical to large language model (LLM) inference. While prior advances optimize attention execution for individual requests (e.g., FlashAttention), production LLM serving relies on batching requests with highly heterogeneous sequence lengths for high serving throughput. This mismatch induces severe computation and I/O imbalance, exacerbates stragglers, and underutilizes GPU resources. We present PackInfer, a kernel-level attention framework that enables compute- and I/O-aware execution for heterogeneous batched inference. PackInfer orchestrates batched requests into load-balanced execution groups, effectively saturating GPU utilization by packing multiple requests into unified kernel launches. By constructing attention kernels directly over packed query-key regions, PackInfer eliminates redundant computation and balances thread-block execution. It then incorporates I/O-aware grouping that co-locates shared-prefix requests and reorganizes KV caches into group-coherent layouts to maximize DRAM bandwidth utilization via coalesced access.
papers.abstract_cn: 注意力效率对于大语言模型 (LLM) 推理至关重要。虽然先前的进展优化了单个请求 (如 FlashAttention) 的注意力执行，但生产 LLM 服务依赖于具有高度异构序列长度的批处理请求来实现高服务吞吐量。这种不匹配导致严重的计算和 I/O 不平衡，加剧掉队现象，并导致 GPU 资源利用不足。我们提出了 PackInfer，一种内核级注意力框架，它能够实现计算和 I/O 感知的执行，用于异构批处理推理。PackInfer 将批处理请求编排到负载均衡的执行组中，通过将多个请求打包到统一的内核启动中，有效地充分利用 GPU 利用率。通过直接在打包的查询密钥区域上构建注意力内核，PackInfer 消除了冗余计算并平衡了线程块执行。然后，它整合了 I/O 感知分组，共同定位共享前缀请求，并将 KV 缓存重组为组一致的布局，以通过联合访问最大限度地提高 DRAM 带宽利用率。
papers.ai_summary_en: PackInfer addresses inefficiencies in batched LLM inference attention, where heterogeneous sequence lengths cause compute and I/O imbalance, stragglers, and low GPU utilization. It introduces a kernel-level framework that packs multiple requests into load-balanced unified kernel launches and builds attention directly over packed query–key regions, while using I/O-aware grouping and group-coherent KV-cache layouts to coalesce DRAM accesses. The result is more balanced thread-block execution, reduced redundant work, and higher compute and memory efficiency for high-throughput LLM serving.
papers.ai_summary_cn: PackInfer针对批量LLM推理中请求序列长度异构导致的注意力计算与I/O不均衡、GPU利用率低和掉队问题。它在内核层将多个请求打包为负载均衡的执行组，并直接在打包的query-key区域上构造注意力内核，同时通过共享前缀共置和KV缓存组一致布局实现合并访问。该框架消除了冗余计算并提升DRAM带宽利用，从而显著提高批量推理的计算与I/O效率及服务吞吐。

papers.title: From Tokens to Layers: Redefining Stall-Free Scheduling for MoE Serving with Layered Prefill
papers.authors: Gunjun Lee, Jiwon Kim, Jaiyoung Park, Younjoo Lee, Jung Ho Ahn
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) inference in production must meet stringent service-level objectives for both time-to-first-token (TTFT) and time-between-token (TBT) while maximizing throughput under fixed compute, memory, and interconnect budgets. Modern serving systems adopt stall-free scheduling techniques such as chunked prefill, which splits the processing of long prompts along the token dimension and interleaves prefill with ongoing decode iterations. While effective at stabilizing TBT, chunked prefill incurs substantial overhead in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models: redundant expert weight loads increase memory traffic by up to 39% and inflate energy consumption. We propose layered prefill, a new scheduling paradigm that treats transformer layer groups as the primary scheduling unit, specifically targeting MoE serving. By vertically partitioning the model into contiguous layer groups and interleaving prefill and decode across the groups, layered prefill sustains stall-free decoding while eliminating chunk-induced MoE weight reloads. It reduces off-chip bandwidth demand, lowering TTFT by up to 70%, end-to-end latency by 41% and per-token energy by up to 22%. Accepted at MLSys 2026.
papers.abstract_cn: 生产中的大语言模型 (LLM) 推理必须满足首次令牌时间 (TTFT) 和令牌间时间 (TBT) 的严格服务级别目标，同时在固定的计算、内存和互连预算下最大化吞吐量。现代服务系统采用无延迟调度技术，如分块预填充，这种技术沿令牌维度分割长提示的处理，并将预填充与持续的解码迭代交错进行。虽然分块预填充有效地稳定了 TBT，但在专家混合 (MoE) 模型中会产生大量开销：冗余的专家权重负载会将内存流量增加高达 39%，并导致能耗上升。我们提出了分层预填充，这是一种新的调度范式，将变压器层组视为主要调度单元，特别针对 MoE 服务。通过将模型垂直划分为连续的层组，并在这些组之间交替进行预填充和解码，分层预填充在消除块引起的 MoE 重量重载的同时保持无延迟解码。它降低了片外带宽需求，将 TTFT 降低了高达 70%，端到端延迟降低了 41%，每个代币的能量降低了高达 22%。在 MLSys 2026 中接受。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses stall-free LLM serving for MoE models, where token-wise chunked prefill stabilizes decode latency but causes redundant expert weight reloads, increasing memory traffic and energy. It proposes layered prefill, which vertically partitions the transformer into contiguous layer groups and interleaves prefill and decode across these groups, making layer groups the scheduling unit to preserve stall-free decoding while eliminating chunk-induced expert weight reloading. Experiments show reduced off-chip bandwidth demand, with up to 70% lower TTFT, 41% lower end-to-end latency, and 22% lower per-token energy.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 MoE 大模型推理中 chunked prefill 为稳定 TBT 而按 token 分块导致的专家权重重复加载、内存带宽和能耗显著增加问题展开研究。其核心方法是提出 layered prefill，将连续 Transformer 层分组作为调度单元，并在不同层组间交错执行 prefill 与 decode，从而在保持无停顿解码的同时消除由分块引起的专家权重重载。实验显示该方法可降低片外带宽需求，使 TTFT 最高降低 70%、端到端延迟降低 41%、单 token 能耗最高降低 22%。

papers.title: DuoServe-MoE: Dual-Phase Expert Prefetch and Caching for LLM Inference QoS Assurance
papers.authors: Yuning Zhang, Grant Pinkert, Nan Yang, Yanli Li, Dong Yuan
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as Internet/Web services (LLM-as-a-Service) with strict latency Service-Level Objectives (SLOs) under tight GPU memory budgets. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models improve quality and throughput via sparse expert activation, but serving them efficiently is challenging because expert weights dominate memory footprint and incur costly host--device transfers when offloaded. Moreover, MoE serving exhibits a phase disparity: the prefill phase tends to activate experts densely across many tokens, while the decode phase activates only a few experts per step. A uniform expert loading/caching policy across phases leads to either peak-memory blowup (prefill) or tail-latency inflation (decode). We present DuoServe-MoE, a QoS-oriented MoE serving system that decouples prefill and decode and applies phase-specialized expert scheduling. For prefill, DuoServe-MoE uses a two-stream CUDA pipeline to overlap expert prefetching with non-MoE computation, reducing expert residency time and peak GPU memory. For decode, it employs a lightweight layer-level predictor trained offline from activation traces to prefetch only likely experts without model changes. Experiments on representative MoE LLMs show that DuoServe-MoE improves TTFT by up to 5.34x and end-to-end latency by up to 7.55x over representative baselines, while maintaining low runtime GPU memory usage under resource-constrained deployment.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地部署为互联网/Web 服务 (LLM-as-a-Service)，在 GPU 内存预算紧张的情况下，具有严格的延迟服务级别目标 (SLO)。专家混合 (MoE) 模型通过稀疏的专家激活来提高质量和吞吐量，但高效地服务于它们是具有挑战性的，因为专家权重主导内存占用，并在卸载时导致昂贵的主机 - 设备传输。此外，MoE 服务表现出阶段差异：预填充阶段倾向于在多个令牌中密集激活专家，而解码阶段每步只激活少数专家。跨阶段的统一专家加载/缓存策略会导致峰值内存爆炸 (预填充) 或尾延迟膨胀 (解码)。我们介绍了 DuoServe-MoE，一种面向 QoS 的 MoE 服务系统，它解耦预填充和解码，并应用相位专业化的专家调度。对于预填充，DuoServe-MoE 使用双流 CUDA 管道将专家预填充与非 MoE 计算重叠，从而减少专家驻留时间和 GPU 内存峰值。对于解码，它采用了一个轻量级的层级预测器，该预测器是从激活轨迹中离线训练的，可以在不改变模型的情况下仅预测可能的专家。在代表性 MoE LLM 上的实验表明，DuoServe-MoE 将 TTFT 提高了 5.34 倍，端到端延迟比代表性基线提高了 7.55 倍，同时在资源受限的部署下保持低运行时 GPU 内存使用率。
papers.ai_summary_en: DuoServe-MoE addresses QoS-constrained MoE LLM serving under tight GPU memory budgets, where expert-weight offloading and differing prefill/decode activation patterns make uniform caching policies cause either peak-memory blowup or tail-latency inflation. The system decouples prefill and decode with phase-specialized expert scheduling: a two-stream CUDA pipeline overlaps prefill expert prefetching with non-MoE computation, while decode uses an offline layer-level activation predictor to prefetch only likely experts. Experiments on representative MoE LLMs show up to 5.34× TTFT and 7.55× end-to-end latency improvements over baselines while maintaining low GPU memory usage.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对MoE大模型在线服务中专家权重占用高、主机-设备搬运开销大，以及prefill与decode阶段专家激活模式差异导致统一缓存策略难以兼顾峰值内存和尾延迟的问题。  
DuoServe-MoE提出按阶段解耦的专家调度：prefill阶段用双流CUDA流水线将专家预取与非MoE计算重叠以降低内存驻留和峰值占用，decode阶段用离线训练的层級预测器按需预取高概率专家。  
实验显示，在资源受限部署下，该方法可将TTFT提升至多5.34倍、端到端延迟提升至多7.55倍，同时保持较低GPU内存开销。

papers.title: Utility-Driven Speculative Decoding for Mixture-of-Experts
papers.authors: Anish Saxena, Po-An Tsai, Hritvik Taneja, Aamer Jaleel, Moinuddin Qureshi
papers.abstract_en: GPU memory bandwidth is the main bottleneck for low-latency Large Language Model (LLM) inference. Speculative decoding leverages idle GPU compute by using a lightweight drafter to propose K tokens, which the LLM verifies in parallel, boosting token throughput. In conventional dense LLMs, all model weights are fetched each iteration, so speculation adds no latency overhead. Emerging Mixture of Experts (MoE) models activate only a subset of weights per token, greatly reducing data movement. However, we show that speculation is ineffective for MoEs: draft tokens collectively activate more weights, increasing data movement and verification time by 2-3x. When token throughput gains fail to offset this overhead, speculation causes slowdowns up to 1.5x, making it infeasible. Even when useful, the optimal K varies by task, model, and even between requests and iterations. We present Cascade, a utility-driven framework that selectively enables speculation to avoid slowdowns and dynamically tunes K to accelerate MoE serving. Cascade uses a lightweight metric, speculation utility, the ratio of token gains to verification cost, which shows iteration-level locality, enabling periodic decisions via short test and longer set phases. Cascade limits slowdown to 5% (vs. 1.5x) and improves throughput by 7-14% over static K, making speculative decoding practical for MoEs.
papers.abstract_cn: GPU 内存带宽是低延迟大语言模型 (LLM) 推理的主要瓶颈。推测性解码通过使用轻量级绘图器提出 K 个令牌来利用空闲的 GPU 计算，LLM 对其进行并行验证，从而提高令牌吞吐量。在传统的密集 LLM 中，所有模型权重都在每次迭代中获取，因此推测不会增加延迟开销。新兴的专家组合 (MoE) 模型只激活每个令牌的一部分权重，大大减少了数据移动。然而，我们表明推测对于 MoE 来说是无效的：绘图令牌共同激活更多权重，将数据移动和验证时间增加了 2-3 倍。当令牌吞吐量增长无法抵消这种开销时，推测会导致速度降低高达 1.5 倍，使其不可行。即使在有用的情况下，最优 K 也会因任务、模型，甚至请求和迭代之间的差异而有所不同。我们提出了 Cascade，这是一个效用驱动的框架，它可以选择性地使投机行为避免减速，并动态调整 K 以加速 MoE 服务。Cascade 使用了一个轻量级指标——投机效用，即代币收益与验证成本的比率，该指标显示了迭代级的局部性，通过短测试和更长的设定阶段实现了周期性决策。Cascade 将速度限制在 5%(相对于 1.5 倍)，并将吞吐量提高了 7-14%，比静态 K 提高了 7-14%，使得投机解码对 MoEs 来说变得切实可行。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper identifies that speculative decoding can hurt Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference because draft tokens collectively activate more experts, increasing weight movement and verification latency by 2–3× and causing slowdowns up to 1.5× when speculation is not beneficial. It proposes Cascade, a utility-driven framework that selectively enables speculation and dynamically tunes the draft length K using a lightweight “speculation utility” metric—the ratio of accepted-token gains to verification cost—exploiting short-term iteration locality via test-and-set control phases. Cascade makes MoE speculative decoding practical by limiting worst-case slowdown to 5% and improving throughput by 7–14% over static-K speculation.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文指出，投机解码在 MoE 模型中会因多个草稿 token共同激活更多专家而显著增加权重读取和验证开销，甚至导致最高 1.5 倍减速。作者提出 Cascade，一个效用驱动的框架，通过“投机效用”指标衡量 token 收益与验证成本之比，并据此动态决定是否启用投机及调整草稿长度 K。实验表明，Cascade 能将减速控制在 5% 以内，并相较静态 K 提升 7–14% 吞吐，使投机解码在 MoE 推理中变得实用。

papers.title: Stratum: System-Hardware Co-Design with Tiered Monolithic 3D-Stackable DRAM for Efficient MoE Serving
papers.authors: Yue Pan, Zihan Xia, Po-Kai Hsu, Lanxiang Hu, Hyungyo Kim, Janak Sharda, Minxuan Zhou, Nam Sung Kim, Shimeng Yu, Tajana Rosing, Mingu Kang
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to evolve, Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture has emerged as a prevailing design for achieving state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of tasks. MoE models use sparse gating to activate only a handful of expert sub-networks per input, achieving billion-parameter capacity with inference costs akin to much smaller models. However, such models often pose challenges for hardware deployment due to the massive data volume introduced by the MoE layers. To address the challenges of serving MoE models, we propose Stratum, a system-hardware co-design approach that combines the novel memory technology Monolithic 3D-Stackable DRAM (Mono3D DRAM), near-memory processing (NMP), and GPU acceleration. The Stratum system achieves up to 8.29x improvement in decoding throughput and 7.66x better energy efficiency across various benchmarks compared to GPU baselines.
papers.abstract_cn: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）的不断发展，专家混合（MoE）架构已成为在广泛任务中实现最先进性能的主要设计。MoE 模型使用稀疏门控，仅针对每个输入激活少量专家子网络，从而在实现数十亿参数容量的同时，其推理成本类似于小型模型。然而，这类模型在硬件部署上经常带来挑战，因为 MoE 层引入了大量数据。为了解决 MoE 模型服务的挑战，我们提出了 Stratum，一种系统与硬件协同设计的方法，将新型存储技术单块三维堆叠 DRAM（Mono3D DRAM）、近存处理（NMP）和 GPU 加速相结合。Stratum 系统在各种基准测试中相比 GPU 基线实现了最高 8.29 倍的解码吞吐量提升和 7.66 倍的能效提升。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the memory capacity and bandwidth bottlenecks in serving MoE LLMs, where massive expert parameters and sparse activation patterns make GPU-based inference inefficient. Stratum proposes a system–hardware co-design that tiers monolithic 3D-stackable DRAM with near-memory processing and GPU acceleration to store and process expert data closer to memory, reducing data movement. It achieves up to 8.29× higher decoding throughput and 7.66× better energy efficiency than GPU baselines across benchmarks.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对MoE大模型推理中专家参数和数据规模巨大导致的内存容量与带宽瓶颈，提出面向服务场景的系统-硬件协同设计Stratum。其核心思路是结合分层单片3D可堆叠DRAM、近内存处理和GPU加速，将MoE专家数据的存储与部分计算更高效地放置在内存侧。实验显示，相比GPU基线，Stratum在解码吞吐和能效上分别最高提升8.29倍和7.66倍。

papers.title: Rethinking Latency Denial-of-Service: Attacking the LLM Serving Framework, Not the Model
papers.authors: Tianyi Wang, Huawei Fan, Yuanchao Shu, Peng Cheng, Cong Wang
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models face an emerging and critical threat known as latency attacks. Because LLM inference is inherently expensive, even modest slowdowns can translate into substantial operating costs and severe availability risks. Recently, a growing body of research has focused on algorithmic complexity attacks by crafting inputs to trigger worst-case output lengths. However, we report a counter-intuitive finding that these algorithmic latency attacks are largely ineffective against modern LLM serving systems. We reveal that system-level optimization such as continuous batching provides a logical isolation to mitigate contagious latency impact on co-located users. To this end, in this paper, we shift the focus from the algorithm to the system layer, and introduce a new Fill and Squeeze attack strategy targeting the state transition of the scheduler. "Fill" first exhausts the global KV cache to induce Head-of-Line blocking, while "Squeeze" forces the system into repetitive preemption. By manipulating output lengths using methods from simple plain-text prompts to more complex prompt engineering, and leveraging side-channel probing of memory status, we demonstrate that the attack can be orchestrated in a black-box setting with much less cost. Extensive evaluations indicate by up to 20-280x average slowdown on Time to First Token and 1.5-4x average slowdown on Time Per Output Token compared to existing attacks with 30-40% lower attack cost.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型面临着一个新出现的关键威胁，称为延迟攻击。由于 LLM 推理本质上昂贵，即使是温和的减速也可能转化为巨大的运营成本和严重的可用性风险。最近，越来越多的研究集中在算法复杂性攻击上，通过精心设计输入来触发最坏情况下的输出长度。然而，我们报告了一个违反直觉的发现，即这些算法延迟攻击对现代 LLM 服务系统基本无效。我们揭示了系统级优化 (如连续批处理) 提供了逻辑隔离，以减轻对共置用户的传染性延迟影响。为此，本文将重点从算法转移到系统层，并引入一种新的 Fill and Squeeze 攻击策略，针对调度器的状态转换。“填充” 首先耗尽全局 KV 缓存以诱发队头阻塞，而 “挤压” 则迫使系统进行重复抢占。通过使用从简单纯文本提示符到更复杂的提示符工程的方法操纵输出长度，以及利用内存状态的侧通道探测，我们证明了攻击可以在黑盒环境中以更低的成本进行编排。广泛的评估表明，与现有攻击相比，与第一个令牌相比，平均时间减慢了 20-280 倍，每个输出令牌的平均时间减慢了 1.5-4 倍，而攻击成本降低了 30-40%。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper shows that algorithmic worst-case-length latency attacks are often blunted by modern LLM serving optimizations such as continuous batching, which logically isolate co-located requests, and instead identifies scheduler-state vulnerabilities as the primary attack surface. It proposes Fill and Squeeze, a black-box system-layer attack that exhausts global KV cache to induce head-of-line blocking and then forces repeated preemption by manipulating output lengths and probing memory status via side channels. Evaluations report 20–280× average TTFT slowdown and 1.5–4× TPOT slowdown compared with prior attacks, at 30–40% lower attack cost.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM服务中的延迟拒绝服务攻击问题，指出现有通过构造长输出触发算法复杂度的攻击在连续批处理等现代服务框架下往往难以有效影响共置用户。作者提出面向调度器状态转换的“Fill and Squeeze”黑盒攻击：先耗尽全局KV缓存造成队头阻塞，再迫使系统反复抢占，并可通过输出长度操控与内存侧信道探测低成本实施。实验表明，该方法以低30%–40%的攻击成本，相比既有攻击实现TTFT平均20–280倍、TPOT平均1.5–4倍的减速，揭示关键威胁来自服务系统而非模型本身。

papers.title: Native LLM and MLLM Inference at Scale on Apple Silicon
papers.authors: Wayner Barrios
papers.abstract_en: The growing adoption of Apple Silicon for machine learning development has created demand for efficient inference solutions that leverage its unique unified memory architecture. However, existing tools either lack native optimization (PyTorch MPS) or focus solely on text models, leaving multimodal workloads underserved. We present vllm-mlx, a framework for efficient LLM and MLLM inference on Apple Silicon built natively on MLX. For text models, we achieve 21% to 87% higher throughput than llama-cpp across models ranging from Qwen3-0.6B to Nemotron-30B, while providing continuous batching that scales to 4.3x aggregate throughput at 16 concurrent requests. For multimodal models, we introduce content-based prefix caching that eliminates redundant vision encoding by identifying identical images through content hashing, regardless of input format. Our evaluation on Apple M4 Max demonstrates throughput of up to 525 tokens per second on text models and 28x speedup on repeated image queries, reducing multimodal latency from 21.7 seconds to under 1 second. Video analysis with up to 64 frames achieves 24.7x cache speedup. We release our implementation as open source to support efficient inference on consumer Apple hardware.
papers.abstract_cn: Apple 芯片在机器学习开发中的越来越广泛的应用创造了对高效推理解决方案的需求，这些解决方案利用了其独特的统一内存架构。然而，现有工具要么缺乏本机优化 (PyTorch MPS)，要么仅专注于文本模型，导致多模态工作负载服务不足。我们提出了 vllm-mlx，这是一个基于 MLX 原生构建的 Apple 芯片上的高效 LLM 和 MLM 推理框架。对于文本模型，我们在从 Qwen3-0.6B 到 Nemotron-30B 的模型中实现了比 lama-cpp 高 21% 至 87% 的吞吐量，同时提供连续批处理，在 16 个并发请求下可扩展到 4.3 倍的总吞吐量。对于多模态模型，我们引入了基于内容的前缀缓存，该缓存通过内容哈希识别相同的图像来消除冗余视觉编码，而不考虑输入格式。我们在 Apple M4 Max 上的评估表明，在文本模型上，吞吐量最高可达每秒 525 个标记，在重复图像查询时速度提高了 28 倍，将多模态延迟从 21.7 秒减少到不到 1 秒。高达 64 帧的视频分析可实现 24.7 倍的缓存加速。我们将我们的实现作为开源发布，以支持在消费级 Apple 硬件上的高效推理。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses efficient native inference for LLMs and multimodal LLMs on Apple Silicon, where existing tools are either not fully optimized for the unified memory architecture or underserve multimodal workloads. It introduces vllm-mlx, an MLX-native serving framework that combines continuous batching for text models with content-based prefix caching that reuses vision encodings by hashing identical images or video frames. On Apple M4 Max, it achieves 21–87% higher text throughput than llama-cpp, 4.3× aggregate batching throughput at 16 requests, up to 525 tokens/s, and up to 28× speedup on repeated image queries, reducing multimodal latency from 21.7s to under 1s.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 Apple Silicon 上缺乏原生高效 LLM/MLLM 推理、且多模态负载存在重复视觉编码开销的问题，提出了基于 MLX 的推理框架 vllm-mlx。其核心方法是结合连续批处理提升文本模型并发吞吐，并通过基于内容哈希的前缀缓存复用相同图像/视频帧的视觉编码结果。实验显示，文本吞吐较 llama-cpp 提升 21%–87%、最高达 525 tokens/s，重复图像查询可加速 28 倍并将延迟从 21.7 秒降至 1 秒以内。

papers.title: SnapStream: Efficient Long Sequence Decoding on Dataflow Accelerators
papers.authors: Authors from arxiv (see full paper)
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of 100B+ parameter Large Language Models (LLMs) with 100k+ context length support have resulted in increasing demands for on-chip memory to support large KV caches. Techniques such as StreamingLLM and SnapKV demonstrate how to control KV cache size while maintaining model accuracy. Yet, these techniques are not commonly used within industrial deployments using frameworks like vLLM or SGLang. In this paper, we explore these accuracy implications on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and DeepSeek-R1, and develop SnapStream, a KV cache compression method that can be deployed at scale. We demonstrate the efficacy of SnapStream in a 16-way tensor-parallel deployment of DeepSeek-671B on SambaNova SN40L accelerators running at 128k context length and up to 1832 tokens per second in a real production setting. SnapStream enables 4x improved on-chip memory usage and introduces minimal accuracy degradation on LongBench-v2, AIME24 and LiveCodeBench. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first implementation of sparse KV attention techniques deployed in a production inference system with static graphs and continuous batching.
papers.abstract_cn: 100B+ 参数大型语言模型 (LLM) 的激增以及 100k+ 上下文长度的支持，导致了对片上内存的需求增加，以支持大型 KV 缓存。StreamingLLM 和 SnapKV 等技术展示了如何在保持模型准确性的同时控制 KV 缓存大小。然而，这些技术在使用 vLLM 或 SGLang 等框架的工业部署中并不常用。在本文中，我们探讨了这些对 Lama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 DeepSeek-R1 的准确性影响，并开发了 SnapStream，一种可以大规模部署的 KV 缓存压缩方法。我们展示了 SnapStream 在 SambaNova SN40L 加速器上以 128k 上下文长度运行的 16 路张量并行部署 DeepSeek-671B 的有效性，在真实的生产环境中每秒高达 1832 个标记。SnapStream 实现了 4 倍的片上内存使用改进，并在 LongBench-v2、AIME24 和 LiveCodeBench 上引入了最小的准确性降低。据我们所知，这是首次在具有静态图和连续批处理的生产推理系统中实现稀疏 KV 注意力技术。
papers.ai_summary_en: SnapStream addresses the on-chip memory bottleneck of long-context LLM inference, where large KV caches make 100B+ parameter models with 100k+ tokens difficult to deploy efficiently in production systems. It proposes a deployable sparse KV-cache compression method that integrates with static-graph dataflow accelerators and continuous batching, enabling practical use of StreamingLLM/SnapKV-style attention sparsity at scale. In a 16-way tensor-parallel DeepSeek-671B deployment on SambaNova SN40L accelerators at 128k context length, SnapStream achieves 4× better on-chip memory usage and up to 1832 tokens/s with minimal accuracy loss on LongBench-v2, AIME24, and LiveCodeBench.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对超长上下文LLM推理中KV缓存占用过高、现有稀疏/流式KV方法难以在工业推理框架中落地的问题，提出可规模化部署的KV缓存压缩方法SnapStream，并在数据流加速器上结合静态图与连续批处理实现稀疏KV注意力。作者先在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和DeepSeek-R1上评估精度影响，随后在SambaNova SN40L上以16路张量并行运行DeepSeek-671B，支持128k上下文并达到最高1832 tokens/s。结果显示，SnapStream可将片上内存使用提升约4倍，同时在LongBench-v2、AIME24和LiveCodeBench上仅带来极小精度损失，是首个在生产推理系统中落地的稀疏KV注意力实现。
