papers.title: Zipage: Maintain High Request Concurrency for LLM Reasoning through Compressed PagedAttention
papers.authors: Authors from arxiv (see full paper)
papers.abstract_en: Zipage maintains high request concurrency for LLM reasoning through Compressed PagedAttention, enabling efficient serving of long-reasoning chains while preserving KV cache efficiency and reducing memory pressure.
papers.abstract_cn: Zipage 通过压缩分页注意力（Compressed PagedAttention）保持 LLM 推理的高请求并发性，实现长推理链的高效服务，同时保持 KV 缓存效率并降低内存压力。
papers.ai_summary_en: Zipage addresses the KV-cache memory bottleneck that limits high request concurrency when serving LLMs with long reasoning chains. It introduces Compressed PagedAttention, which retains PagedAttention’s memory-efficient paging while compressing cached key–value states to reduce per-request memory pressure. This enables higher concurrent throughput for reasoning-heavy workloads while preserving KV-cache efficiency and model quality.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长推理链 LLM 服务中 KV Cache 占用过高、导致请求并发受限和内存压力增大的问题。其核心方法是 Zipage，通过压缩版 PagedAttention 对 KV Cache 进行高效分页与压缩管理，在保持注意力计算效率的同时降低显存开销。结果表明，该方案可在长推理场景下维持更高请求并发，并提升整体推理服务效率。

papers.title: KV-CAR: KV Cache Compression using Autoencoders and KV Reuse in Large Language Models
papers.authors: Authors from arxiv (see full paper)
papers.abstract_en: KV-CAR proposes KV Cache Compression using Autoencoders and KV Reuse in Large Language Models, targeting efficient inference by reducing the memory footprint of KV caches through compression and reuse techniques.
papers.abstract_cn: KV-CAR 提出在大语言模型中使用自编码器进行 KV 缓存压缩和 KV 重用，旨在通过压缩和重用技术减少 KV 缓存的内存占用，从而实现高效推理。
papers.ai_summary_en: KV-CAR addresses the memory bottleneck of key–value (KV) caches during large language model inference, where storing per-token KV states limits throughput and context length. The method compresses KV caches using autoencoders and further improves efficiency by reusing compressed KV representations rather than recomputing or retaining full-precision caches. Its main impact is a reduced KV-cache memory footprint for more efficient LLM inference while aiming to preserve generation quality.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大语言模型推理中 KV 缓存内存占用过高的问题，提出 KV-CAR 方法以提升长上下文或高并发场景下的推理效率。其核心思路是利用自编码器对 KV 缓存进行压缩，并结合 KV 复用机制减少重复存储与计算。该方法有望显著降低 KV 缓存内存开销，在保持模型效果的同时提升推理吞吐。

papers.title: EdgeFlow: Fast Cold Starts for LLMs on Mobile Devices
papers.authors: Authors from arxiv (see full paper)
papers.abstract_en: EdgeFlow targets fast cold starts for LLMs on mobile devices, addressing the challenge of deploying large language models on resource-constrained edge devices by optimizing initialization and inference latency.
papers.abstract_cn: EdgeFlow 针对移动设备上的大语言模型实现快速冷启动，通过优化初始化和推理延迟，解决了在资源受限的边缘设备上部署大语言模型的挑战。
papers.ai_summary_en: EdgeFlow addresses the slow cold-start problem for LLM inference on mobile edge devices, where limited memory, compute, and I/O bandwidth delay model loading and first-token generation. The key idea is to optimize initialization and early inference execution, reducing the overhead of bringing a large model into a runnable state on resource-constrained hardware. This yields faster time-to-first-response and more practical on-device LLM deployment for latency-sensitive mobile applications.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对移动端大语言模型冷启动慢、资源受限导致部署困难的问题，提出 EdgeFlow 以加速边缘设备上的 LLM 初始化与推理启动。其核心思路是通过优化模型初始化流程和推理延迟路径，减少首次响应所需时间。该方法有助于提升移动端 LLM 的即时可用性，并降低在边缘设备上部署大模型的性能门槛。

papers.title: Adaptive Cache Pollution Control for Large Language Model Inference Workloads Using Temporal CNN-Based Prediction and Priority-Aware Replacement
papers.authors: Authors from arxiv (see full paper)
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive Cache Pollution Control for Large Language Model Inference Workloads Using Temporal CNN-Based Prediction and Priority-Aware Replacement, addressing KV cache management through intelligent prediction and priority-based eviction strategies.
papers.abstract_cn: 用于大型语言模型推理工作负载的自适应缓存污染控制，采用基于时序卷积神经网络的预测和优先级感知的替换策略，通过智能预测和基于优先级的清理策略解决键值缓存管理问题。
papers.ai_summary_en:
Here is a polished academic abstract for the paper:

**Abstract:**  
KV caches are essential for efficient autoregressive large language model inference, but under batched, multi-turn, and latency-sensitive serving workloads they are vulnerable to pollution by short-lived or low-reuse key/value blocks. This pollution reduces effective cache utilization, increases memory pressure, and triggers costly recomputation of evicted states. This paper proposes an adaptive cache pollution control framework for LLM inference that combines temporal CNN-based reuse prediction with priority-aware replacement. A lightweight temporal convolutional network learns short-horizon access patterns from runtime features such as request arrival dynamics, sequence progress, attention statistics, block age, and recomputation cost. These predictions drive an eviction and admission policy that ranks KV blocks by expected future utility, request-level priority, SLO slack, and token importance. By proactively retaining high-value cache entries and demoting likely one-touch blocks, the method improves cache efficiency under constrained memory budgets. Evaluations on representative inference workloads show that the proposed approach reduces cache misses and recomputation overhead while improving throughput and tail latency compared with conventional LRU, LFU, and attention-score-based eviction baselines.

**Keywords:** KV cache management, LLM inference, cache pollution control, temporal CNN, priority-aware replacement, memory-efficient serving.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大语言模型推理中 KV 缓存易被低价值块污染、导致显存浪费和延迟上升的问题展开研究。其核心方法是利用时间卷积网络预测 KV 缓存块的未来访问价值，并结合优先级感知的替换策略自适应淘汰低优先级块。该工作有望提升 KV 缓存命中率与显存利用效率，从而改善推理吞吐和请求响应延迟。

papers.title: LLM-CoOpt: A Co-Design and Optimization Framework for Efficient LLM Inference on Heterogeneous Platforms
papers.authors: Jie Kong, Wei Wang, Jiehan Zhou, Chen Yu
papers.abstract_en: Major challenges in LLMs inference remain frequent memory bandwidth bottlenecks, computational redundancy, and inefficiencies in long-sequence processing. To address these issues, we propose LLM-CoOpt, a comprehensive algorithm-hardware co-design framework aimed at improving both throughput and latency in LLM inference. LLM-CoOpt integrates three key strategies: (1) Key-Value Cache Optimization, termed Opt-KV, which improves memory access efficiency by optimizing both KV cache write and read paths, and introduces FP8 quantization to reduce memory footprint while maintaining accuracy; (2) Grouped-Query Attention for Computational Efficiency, termed Opt-GQA, which reduces the overall computational complexity by restructuring multi-head self-attention into grouped-query attention with shared key-value projections; (3) Paged Attention for Long-Sequence Processing, termed Opt-Pa, which adopts a two-step strategy to first segment long sequences into manageable chunks and then apply lazy memory mapping and computation. Experiments on the LLaMa-13B-GPTQ model demonstrate that LLM-CoOpt increases inference throughput by up to 13.43%, reduces latency by up to 16.79%, and maintains model accuracy.
papers.abstract_cn: LLM 推理面临的主要挑战仍然是频繁的内存带宽瓶颈、计算冗余和长序列处理效率低下。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 LLM-CoOpt，这是一个全面的算法 - 硬件联合设计框架，旨在提高 LLM 推理的吞吐量和延迟。LLM-CoOpt 整合了三种关键策略:(1) 键值缓存优化，称为 Opt-KV，该策略通过优化 KV 缓存写入和读取路径来提高内存访问效率，并引入 FP8 量化来减少内存占用，同时保持准确性;(2) 分组查询注意力计算效率，称为 Opt-GQA，该策略通过将多头自我注意力重构为具有共享键值投影的分组查询注意力来降低整体计算复杂性;(3) 分页注意力长序列处理，称为 Opt-Pa，该策略采用两步策略，首先将长序列分割成可管理的块，然后应用惰性内存映射和计算。LLaMa-13B-GPTQ 模型的实验表明，LLM-CoOpt 将推理吞吐量提高了 13.43%，延迟降低了 16.79%，并保持了模型的准确性。
papers.ai_summary_en: LLM-CoOpt targets LLM inference inefficiencies caused by memory-bandwidth bottlenecks, redundant attention computation, and poor long-sequence handling on heterogeneous platforms. The framework co-designs algorithm and hardware optimizations through FP8-quantized KV-cache path optimization, grouped-query attention with shared key-value projections, and paged attention using chunked sequences with lazy memory mapping. Experiments on LLaMa-13B-GPTQ show up to 13.43% higher throughput and 16.79% lower latency while preserving model accuracy.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型推理中的内存带宽瓶颈、注意力计算冗余和长序列处理低效问题，提出 LLM-CoOpt 算法-硬件协同优化框架。其核心方法包括优化 KV 缓存读写并引入 FP8 量化、将多头注意力重构为分组查询注意力以降低计算量，以及采用分页式注意力改进长序列内存管理。实验表明，在 LLaMa-13B-GPTQ 上可将吞吐提升最高 13.43%、延迟降低最高 16.79%，同时保持模型精度。

papers.title: Glinthawk: A Two-Tiered Architecture for Offline LLM Inference
papers.authors: Pouya Hamadanian, Sadjad Fouladi
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Glinthawk, an architecture for offline Large Language Model (LLM) inference. By leveraging a two-tiered structure, Glinthawk optimizes the utilization of the high-end accelerators ("Tier 1") by offloading the attention mechanism to lower-end compute tier ("Tier 2"). This separation allows the memory demand of the attention, known as the key-value cache, to scale independently from the model weights, enabling larger batch sizes and more efficient accelerator usage. Prototyped with NVIDIA T4 GPUs and standard CPU VMs, Glinthawk improves throughput by 5.9x and reduces cost of generation by 2.8x, compared to paged attention baselines. For long sequence lengths, it achieves 16.3x throughput improvement at 2.4x less cost. The prototype is publicly available at https://github.com/microsoft/glinthawk.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们介绍了 Glinthawk，一种用于离线大型语言模型（LLM）推理的架构。通过利用两层结构，Glinthawk 通过将注意力机制卸载到低端计算层（“第二层”），优化了高端加速器（“第一层”）的使用。这种分离允许注意力的内存需求（称为键值缓存）独立于模型权重进行扩展，从而实现更大的批处理大小和更高效的加速器使用。在 NVIDIA T4 GPU 和标准 CPU 虚拟机上进行原型测试，Glinthawk 的吞吐量提高了 5.9 倍，生成成本降低了 2.8 倍，相比分页注意力基线。在长序列长度下，它实现了 16.3 倍的吞吐量提升，同时成本降低 2.4 倍。该原型可在 https://github.com/microsoft/glinthawk 上公开获取。
papers.ai_summary_en: Glinthawk addresses inefficient offline LLM inference caused by attention KV-cache memory pressure on high-end accelerators. It uses a two-tiered architecture that keeps weight-heavy compute on Tier-1 accelerators while offloading attention and KV-cache management to lower-end Tier-2 resources, decoupling cache scaling from model weights to enable larger batch sizes. Prototypes on NVIDIA T4 GPUs and CPU VMs report 5.9× throughput and 2.8× cost improvement over paged-attention baselines, reaching 16.3× throughput at 2.4× lower cost for long sequences.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对离线 LLM 推理中注意力 KV cache 占用高端加速器内存、限制批大小和利用率的问题，提出 Glinthawk 两层架构，将模型权重计算保留在高端加速器，而把注意力机制及 KV cache 卸载到低端计算层，使内存需求可独立扩展。其核心洞见是通过分离计算与 KV 存储来释放高端加速器容量，从而支持更大批量和更高效的推理调度。实验显示，相比分页注意力基线，吞吐提升 5.9 倍、生成成本降低 2.8 倍；在长序列场景下吞吐提升 16.3 倍、成本降低 2.4 倍。

papers.title: vTensor: Flexible Virtual Tensor Management for Efficient LLM Serving
papers.authors: Jiale Xu, Rui Zhang, Cong Guo, Weiming Hu, Zihan Liu, Feiyang Wu, Yu Feng, Shixuan Sun, Changxu Shao, Yuhong Guo, Junping Zhao, Ke Zhang, Minyi Guo, Jingwen Leng
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely used across various domains, processing millions of daily requests. This surge in demand poses significant challenges in optimizing throughput and latency while keeping costs manageable. The Key-Value (KV) cache, a standard method for retaining previous computations, makes LLM inference highly bounded by memory. While batching strategies can enhance performance, they frequently lead to significant memory fragmentation. Even though cutting-edge systems like vLLM mitigate KV cache fragmentation using paged Attention mechanisms, they still suffer from inefficient memory and computational operations due to the tightly coupled page management and computation kernels. This study introduces the vTensor, an innovative tensor structure for LLM inference based on GPU virtual memory management (VMM). vTensor addresses existing limitations by decoupling computation from memory defragmentation and offering dynamic extensibility. Experimental results indicate that vTensor achieves an average speedup of 1.86x across different models, with up to 2.42x in multi-turn chat scenarios. Additionally, vTensor provides average speedups of 2.12x and 3.15x in kernel evaluation, and frees approximately 71.25% (57GB) of memory on the NVIDIA A100 GPU compared to vLLM.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型 (LLM) 在各个领域广泛使用，每天处理数百万个请求。这种需求的激增在优化吞吐量和延迟方面带来了重大挑战，同时保持成本可控。键值 (KV) 缓存是一种用于保留先前计算的标准方法，它使 LLM 推理高度受到内存的限制。虽然批处理策略可以提高性能，但它们经常导致显著的内存碎片。即使像 vLLM 这样的尖端系统使用分页注意力机制来减少 KV 缓存碎片，由于页面管理和计算内核紧密耦合，它们仍然面临着内存和计算操作效率低下的问题。本研究介绍了 vTensor，一种基于 GPU 虚拟内存管理 (VMM) 的 LLM 推理的创新张量结构。vTensor 通过解耦计算与内存去碎片化并提供动态可扩展性，克服了现有的局限性。实验结果表明，vTensor 在不同模型中的平均加速度达到 1.86 倍，在多轮聊天场景中达到 2.42 倍。此外，vTensor 在内核评估中提供了 2.12 倍和 3.15 倍的平均加速，并且与 vLLM 相比，在 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上释放了约 71.25%(57GB) 的内存。
papers.ai_summary_en: vTensor addresses memory fragmentation and inefficient KV-cache management in LLM serving, where paged-attention systems like vLLM still couple page management with computation kernels. It introduces a virtual tensor abstraction built on GPU virtual memory management, decoupling kernel computation from memory defragmentation and enabling dynamically extensible KV-cache tensors. Experiments show an average 1.86× end-to-end speedup (up to 2.42× in multi-turn chat), 2.12×/3.15× kernel-level speedups, and about 71.25% (57GB on an A100) memory reduction versus vLLM.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理服务中KV缓存导致的内存瓶颈与碎片问题，指出现有分页注意力系统因页管理与计算内核紧耦合而效率受限。其核心方法是提出基于GPU虚拟内存管理的vTensor虚拟张量结构，将计算与内存整理/管理解耦并支持动态扩展。实验显示，相较vLLM可平均加速1.86倍、多轮对话最高2.42倍，并在A100上释放约71.25%（57GB）内存。

papers.title: Paged Attention Meets FlexAttention: Unlocking Long-Context Efficiency in Deployed Inference
papers.authors: Thomas Joshi, Herman Saini, Neil Dhillon, Antoni Viros i Martin, Kaoutar El Maghraoui
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) encounter severe memory inefficiencies during long-context inference due to conventional handling of key-value (KV) caches. In this work, we introduce a novel integration of PagedAttention with PyTorch's FlexAttention, addressing internal fragmentation and inefficiencies associated with monolithic KV cache allocations. Implemented within IBM's Foundation Model Stack (FMS), our fused attention kernel efficiently gathers scattered KV data. Our benchmarks on an NVIDIA L4 GPU (24GB) demonstrate significantly reduced inference latency, growing only linearly (~2x) with sequence length from 128 to 2048 tokens when utilizing a global KV cache, compared to exponential latency increases without caching. We open-source the full implementation and discuss its implications for future long-context model deployment.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）在长上下文推理过程中，由于传统的键值（KV）缓存处理方式，会遇到严重的内存效率问题。在本工作中，我们提出了一种将分页注意力（PagedAttention）与 PyTorch 的 FlexAttention 相结合的新方法，解决了与整体 KV 缓存分配相关的内部碎片和低效问题。在 IBM 的基础模型堆栈（FMS）中实现后，我们的融合注意力内核可以高效地收集分散的 KV 数据。我们在 NVIDIA L4 GPU（24GB）上的基准测试显示，在使用全局 KV 缓存时，推理延迟显著降低，从序列长度 128 到 2048 个 token 时，延迟仅线性增长（约 2 倍），而没有缓存时延迟呈指数增加。我们开源了完整实现，并讨论了其对未来长上下文模型部署的影响。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses memory fragmentation and inefficient monolithic KV-cache allocation that cause high latency in long-context LLM inference. It integrates PagedAttention with PyTorch FlexAttention in IBM’s Foundation Model Stack, using a fused attention kernel that gathers scattered paged KV blocks to support efficient global KV-cache use. On an NVIDIA L4 GPU, the system achieves near-linear latency scaling—about 2× growth from 128 to 2048 tokens—versus sharply increasing latency without caching, and is released as open source.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV Cache 单体分配导致的内存碎片与低效问题，提出将 PagedAttention 与 PyTorch FlexAttention 融合，在 IBM FMS 中实现可高效聚合分散 KV 数据的注意力内核。其核心洞见是通过分页式 KV 管理与灵活注意力计算结合，提升已部署推理场景下的缓存利用率和内核执行效率。实验显示，在 NVIDIA L4 GPU 上使用全局 KV Cache 时，序列长度从 128 增至 2048 的延迟仅约线性增长 2 倍，并开源了完整实现。

papers.title: The Anatomy of a Triton Attention Kernel
papers.authors: Burkhard Ringlein, Jan van Lunteren, Radu Stoica, Thomas Parnell
papers.abstract_en: A long-standing goal in both industry and academia is to develop an LLM inference platform that is portable across hardware architectures, eliminates the need for low-level hand-tuning, and still delivers best-in-class efficiency. In this work, we demonstrate that portable, efficient cross-platform LLM inference is indeed possible and share our experience. We develop a state-of-the-art paged attention kernel, the core performance-critical component of many LLM deployments, that builds exclusively on the domain-specific just-in-time compiled language Triton to achieve state-of-the-art performance on both NVIDIA and AMD GPUs. We describe our high-level approach, the key algorithmic and system-level improvements, the parameter auto-tuning required to unlock efficiency, and the integrations into a popular inference server that are necessary to bring the performance of a generic Triton attention kernel from 19.7% of the state-of-the-art to 105.9%. Our results highlight how open-source domain-specific languages can be leveraged to unlock model portability across different GPU vendors.
papers.abstract_cn: 行业和学术界长期以来的目标是开发一个可跨硬件架构移植的 LLM 推理平台，消除了低级别手动调优的需求，同时仍然提供一流的效率。在这项工作中，我们证明了可移植、高效的跨平台 LLM 推理确实是可能的，并分享了我们的经验。我们开发了一个最先进的分页注意力内核，这是许多 LLM 部署的核心性能关键组件，它专门基于特定于领域的即时编译语言 Triton 构建，以在 NVIDIA 和 AMD GPU 上实现最先进的性能。我们描述了我们的高级方法，关键的算法和系统级改进，解锁效率所需的参数自动调优，以及与流行推理服务器的集成，这些集成对于将通用 Triton 注意力内核的性能从最先进的 19.7% 提升到 105.9% 是必要的。我们的研究结果突出了如何利用开源领域特定语言来解锁不同 GPU 供应商之间的模型可移植性。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the challenge of building efficient, portable LLM inference attention kernels that run across GPU vendors without relying on low-level, hand-tuned hardware-specific code. It presents a state-of-the-art paged attention kernel implemented entirely in Triton, combining algorithmic and system-level optimizations, extensive parameter autotuning, and integration into a production inference server. These techniques raise performance from 19.7% to 105.9% of the state of the art on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs, demonstrating that open-source DSLs can enable cross-platform LLM serving with competitive efficiency.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向LLM推理在NVIDIA/AMD等异构GPU上可移植且高效的问题，完全基于Triton构建分页注意力内核，并通过算法与系统级优化、自动参数调优及推理服务器集成消除底层手工调优。结果表明，该通用Triton注意力内核性能从SOTA的19.7%提升至105.9%，在两类GPU上达到或超过专用实现，证明开源DSL可支撑跨厂商高性能模型服务。

papers.title: Scheduling LLM Inference with Uncertainty-Aware Output Length Predictions
papers.authors: Haoyu Zheng, Yongqiang Zhang, Fangcheng Fu, Xiaokai Zhou, Hao Luo, Hongchao Zhu, Yuanyuan Zhu, Hao Wang, Xiao Yan, Jiawei Jiang
papers.abstract_en: To schedule LLM inference, the \textit{shortest job first} (SJF) principle is favorable by prioritizing requests with short output lengths to avoid head-of-line (HOL) blocking. Existing methods usually predict a single output length for each request to facilitate scheduling. We argue that such a \textit{point estimate} does not match the \textit{stochastic} decoding process of LLM inference, where output length is \textit{uncertain} by nature and determined by when the end-of-sequence (EOS) token is sampled. Hence, the output length of each request should be fitted with a distribution rather than a single value. With an in-depth analysis of empirical data and the stochastic decoding process, we observe that output length follows a heavy-tailed distribution and can be fitted with the log-t distribution. On this basis, we propose a simple metric called Tail Inflated Expectation (TIE) to replace the output length in SJF scheduling, which adjusts the expectation of a log-t distribution with its tail probabilities to account for the risk that a request generates long outputs. To evaluate our TIE scheduler, we compare it with three strong baselines, and the results show that TIE reduces the per-token latency by $2.31\times$ for online inference and improves throughput by $1.42\times$ for offline data generation.
papers.abstract_cn: 为了调度 LLM 推理，\textit{最短工作优先}(SJF) 原则通过优先考虑输出长度较短的请求来避免行首阻塞 (HOL)。现有方法通常为每个请求预测单个输出长度，以便于调度。我们认为，这种\textit{点估计}与 LLM 推理的\textit{随机}解码过程不匹配，其中输出长度本质上是\textit{不确定}，并由序列末端 (EOS) 标记的采样时间决定。因此，每个请求的输出长度应该用分布而不是单个值来拟合。通过对经验数据和随机译码过程的深入分析，我们观察到输出长度服从重尾分布，并且可以用 log-t 分布拟合。在此基础上，我们提出了一个简单的度量，称为尾部膨胀期望 (TIE)，用于替代 SJF 调度中的输出长度，该度量调整了 log-t 分布的期望及其尾部概率，以考虑请求产生长输出的风险。为了评估我们的 TIE 调度器，我们将其与三个强基线进行比较，结果表明，TIE 在线推理时每个令牌的延迟降低了 2.31\times$，在离线数据生成时吞吐量提高了 1.42\times$。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses LLM inference scheduling under uncertain output lengths, where point estimates for shortest-job-first scheduling can cause head-of-line blocking. It models output length as a heavy-tailed log-t distribution and proposes Tail Inflated Expectation (TIE), a scheduling metric that adjusts the expected length using tail probabilities to account for the risk of long generations. Experiments show that TIE reduces per-token latency by 2.31× for online inference and improves offline throughput by 1.42× over strong baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM 推理服务中 SJF 调度依赖单一输出长度预测、难以刻画随机解码不确定性的问题。作者发现输出长度呈重尾分布，可用 log-t 分布建模，并提出 Tail Inflated Expectation（TIE）指标，用尾部概率修正期望长度以调度请求。实验表明，TIE 在线推理中将每 token 延迟提升 2.31 倍，在离线生成中将吞吐提升 1.42 倍。

papers.title: Accuracy Is Speed: Towards Long-Context-Aware Routing for Distributed LLM Serving
papers.authors: Takeshi Yoshimura, Valentijn Dymphnus van de Beek, Tatsuhiro Chiba
papers.abstract_en: Distributed LLM serving systems optimize per-request latency and throughput. However, under long-context workloads, inference accuracy becomes more variable. When incorrect responses trigger retries, accuracy directly translates into cumulative user-visible delay that is not captured by single-shot latency metrics. In this work, we argue that under long-context serving, accuracy becomes speed through retry dynamics. We introduce Time-to-Correct-Answer (TTCA), a metric that measures the wall-clock time required to obtain the first correct response. Our measurement study shows that prompt characteristics such as length and language amplify accuracy variance, which inflates TTCA. We demonstrate Lightweight Accuracy-Aware Routing (LAAR), a capability-based routing design that reduces TTCA.
papers.abstract_cn: 分布式LLM服务系统优化单请求延迟和吞吐量。但在长上下文负载下，推理准确性变得更加不稳定。当错误响应触发重试时，准确性直接转化为用户可见的累积延迟。本文提出，在长上下文服务中，准确性通过重试动态成为速度。引入TTCA指标（获得首个正确响应的墙钟时间），提出LAAR路由设计降低TTCA。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses long-context LLM serving where variable inference accuracy induces retries, making accuracy a hidden component of user-perceived latency. It introduces Time-to-Correct-Answer (TTCA) to measure wall-clock time to the first correct response, shows that prompt length and language amplify accuracy variance, and proposes Lightweight Accuracy-Aware Routing (LAAR), a capability-based request router. Evaluations demonstrate that LAAR reduces TTCA, establishing accuracy-aware routing as a practical way to improve effective serving speed under long-context workloads.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对长上下文分布式 LLM 服务中错误响应触发重试、使准确率直接转化为用户可见延迟的问题，指出传统单次延迟指标无法反映真实完成时间。其核心洞见是“准确率即速度”，提出 Time-to-Correct-Answer（TTCA）度量，并设计基于模型能力与提示特征的轻量准确率感知路由 LAAR。测量与实验表明，提示长度、语言等因素会放大准确率方差并抬高 TTCA，而 LAAR 能有效降低获得首个正确回答的时间。

papers.title: MSAO: Adaptive Modality Sparsity-Aware Offloading with Edge-Cloud Collaboration for Efficient Multimodal LLM Inference
papers.authors: Zheming Yang et al.
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) enable powerful cross-modal reasoning capabilities but impose substantial computational and latency burdens, posing critical challenges for deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. We propose MSAO, an adaptive modality sparsity-aware offloading framework with edge-cloud collaboration for efficient MLLM Inference. First, a lightweight heterogeneous modality-aware via fine-grained sparsity module performs spatial-temporal-modal joint analysis to compute the Modality Activation Sparsity (MAS) metric. Second, an adaptive speculative edge-cloud collaborative offloading mechanism dynamically schedules workloads between edge and cloud based on derived MAS scores and real-time system states. Experiments demonstrate that MSAO achieves a 30% reduction in end-to-end latency and 30%-65% decrease in resource overhead, while delivering a throughput improvement of 1.5x to 2.3x.
papers.abstract_cn: 多模态LLM实现强大的跨模态推理但带来巨大的计算和延迟负担。提出MSAO，自适应模态稀疏感知卸载框架，通过边云协作实现高效多模态LLM推理。通过时空模态联合分析计算模态激活稀疏度指标，动态调度边云负载。端到端延迟降低30%，资源开销降低30%-65%，吞吐量提升1.5-2.3倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: MSAO addresses the high latency and resource overhead of deploying multimodal LLMs on resource-constrained edge devices by adaptively offloading computation to the cloud. Its key method is a lightweight Modality Activation Sparsity metric derived from spatial-temporal-modal sparsity analysis, used to drive speculative edge-cloud workload scheduling based on real-time system state. Experiments show a 30% reduction in end-to-end latency, 30%–65% lower resource overhead, and 1.5×–2.3× higher throughput.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态大模型在边缘设备上推理时计算开销大、延迟高的问题，提出 MSAO：一种基于模态稀疏感知的边云协同自适应卸载框架。其核心是通过细粒度空间-时间-模态联合分析计算模态激活稀疏度（MAS），并据此结合实时系统状态动态决定边缘与云端的负载调度。实验显示，该方法可将端到端延迟降低约30%、资源开销降低30%–65%，并将吞吐提升1.5–2.3倍。

papers.title: LLM Inference at the Edge: Mobile, NPU, and GPU Performance Efficiency Trade-offs Under Sustained Load
papers.authors: Pranay Tummalapalli et al.
papers.abstract_en: Deploying LLMs on-device for always-on personal agents demands sustained inference from hardware tightly constrained in power, thermal envelope, and memory. We benchmark Qwen 2.5 1.5B (4-bit quantised) across four platforms: a Raspberry Pi 5 with Hailo-10H NPU, a Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra, an iPhone 16 Pro, and a laptop NVIDIA RTX 4050 GPU. For mobile platforms, thermal management supersedes peak compute as the primary constraint: the iPhone 16 Pro loses nearly half its throughput within two iterations, and the S24 Ultra suffers a hard OS-enforced GPU frequency floor that terminates inference entirely. On dedicated hardware, distinct constraints dominate: the RTX 4050 is bounded by its battery power ceiling, while the Hailo-10H is limited by on-module memory bandwidth.
papers.abstract_cn: 在设备上部署LLM需要受功率、热封套和内存限制的硬件持续推理。在四种平台上基准测试Qwen 2.5 1.5B（4位量化）：带Hailo-10H NPU的树莓派5、三星Galaxy S24 Ultra、iPhone 16 Pro和RTX 4050笔记本。移动平台上热管理超过峰值计算成为主要约束。专用硬件上不同约束主导：RTX 4050受电池功率上限约束，Hailo-10H受片上内存带宽限制。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the problem of sustaining on-device LLM inference for always-on personal agents under tight power, thermal, and memory constraints. It benchmarks a 4-bit quantized Qwen 2.5 1.5B model across Raspberry Pi 5 with Hailo-10H NPU, Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra, iPhone 16 Pro, and an NVIDIA RTX 4050 laptop GPU, identifying the dominant efficiency bottleneck on each platform. The results show that mobile performance is limited primarily by thermal throttling and OS-enforced frequency controls—e.g., iPhone 16 Pro loses nearly half its throughput within two iterations—while the RTX 4050 is constrained by its battery power ceiling and the Hailo-10H by on-module memory bandwidth.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该文针对边缘设备上常驻LLM推理在功耗、散热和内存受限条件下的持续性能问题，对4-bit量化的Qwen 2.5-1.5B在树莓派+NPU、手机和笔记本GPU等平台进行了持续负载基准测试。核心洞见是移动端的主要瓶颈并非峰值算力，而是热管理：iPhone 16 Pro吞吐在两轮迭代内近乎减半，S24 Ultra还会因系统强制GPU频率下限而终止推理。结果显示，不同边缘平台的约束各异，边缘LLM服务需要围绕散热、功耗和内存带宽进行协同优化，而非只追求峰值性能。

papers.title: Faster LLM Inference via Sequential Monte Carlo
papers.authors: Yahya Emara et al.
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates language model inference by drafting tokens from a cheap proposal model and verifying them against an expensive target model via rejection sampling. Because rejection truncates the draft block at the first error, throughput degrades when draft and target diverge. We introduce sequential Monte Carlo speculative decoding (SMC-SD), which replaces token-level rejection with importance-weighted resampling over a population of draft particles. SMC-SD is a principled approximate inference scheme that trades exactness for additional speed, while preserving theoretical bounds on its per-step approximation error. Empirically, SMC-SD achieves 2.36x speed-up over speculative decoding and a 5.2x speed-up over autoregressive decoding, while remaining within 3% of the target model's accuracy.
papers.abstract_cn: 投机解码通过从廉价提议模型草拟token并用目标模型验证来加速推理。拒绝采样在首个错误处截断草拟块，吞吐量下降。引入SMC-SD，用重要性加权重采样替换token级拒绝采样。SMC-SD是原则性近似推理方案，以精确性换取速度，保持每步近似误差的理论界限。实测比投机解码快2.36倍，比自回归解码快5.2倍，精度偏差在3%以内。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses throughput loss in speculative decoding caused by token-level rejection sampling truncating draft blocks when the proposal and target models diverge. It proposes SMC-SD, which replaces rejection with importance-weighted resampling over multiple draft particles, yielding a principled approximate inference method with bounded per-step error. Empirically, SMC-SD achieves 2.36× speedup over standard speculative decoding and 5.2× over autoregressive decoding while staying within 3% of target-model accuracy.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对投机解码中因逐 token 拒绝采样在草稿与目标模型不一致时过早截断、导致吞吐下降的问题，提出序列化蒙特卡洛投机解码（SMC-SD）。其核心方法是用一组草稿粒子进行重要性加权与重采样，替代单条草稿的逐 token 拒绝，从而在可控的每步近似误差界内以近似换取更高推理速度。实验显示，SMC-SD 相比标准投机解码加速 2.36 倍、相比自回归解码加速 5.2 倍，且精度与目标模型相差在 3% 以内。

papers.title: DepCap: Adaptive Block-Wise Parallel Decoding for Efficient Diffusion LM Inference
papers.authors: Xiang Xia, Wuyang Zhang, Jiazheng Liu, Cheng Yan, Yanyong Zhang
papers.abstract_en: DepCap is a training-free framework for efficient block-wise DLM inference. DepCap uses cross-step signals for determining block boundaries and token-level conflict signals for parallel decoding. DepCap is a plug-and-play method applicable to various DLMs, and compatible with existing KV-cache strategies. Experimental results show that DepCap achieves favorable speed-quality trade-offs with up to 5.63x speedup without significant performance degradation.
papers.abstract_cn: DepCap是免训练框架用于高效块级DLM推理。使用跨步信号确定块边界，token级冲突信号实现安全并行解码。兼容现有KV缓存策略。实验显示5.63倍加速无显著性能退化。
papers.ai_summary_en: DepCap addresses the latency–quality trade-off in diffusion language model (DLM) serving by adaptively determining block-wise parallel decoding schedules. It is a training-free, plug-and-play framework that uses cross-step signals to set block boundaries and token-level conflict signals to guide safe parallel decoding, while remaining compatible with existing KV-cache strategies. Experiments show up to 5.63× inference speedup with minimal performance degradation across DLMs.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对扩散语言模型推理中块式并行解码效率与质量难以兼顾的问题，提出免训练框架 DepCap。其核心思路是利用跨步信号自适应确定块边界，并通过 token 级冲突信号指导并行解码，同时兼容多种模型与 KV-cache 策略。实验表明，DepCap 可在几乎不损失性能的情况下实现最高 5.63 倍加速，显著提升扩散语言模型的服务效率。

papers.title: Local-Splitter: A Measurement Study of Seven Tactics for Reducing Cloud LLM Token Usage on Coding-Agent Workloads
papers.authors: Justice Owusu Agyemang, Jerry John Kponyo, Elliot Amponsah, Godfred Manu Addo Boakye, Kwame Opuni-Boachie Obour Agyekum
papers.abstract_en: We present a systematic measurement study of seven tactics for reducing cloud LLM token usage when a small local model can act as a triage layer in front of a frontier cloud model. Local routing combined with prompt compression achieves 45-79% cloud token savings on edit-heavy and explanation-heavy workloads.
papers.abstract_cn: 系统测量研究七种降低云LLM token使用量的策略，当小本地模型可作为前沿云模型的前端分流层。本地路由加提示压缩在编辑密集和解释密集工作负载上实现45-79%云token节省。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses high cloud LLM token consumption in coding-agent workloads by using a small local model as a triage layer in front of a frontier cloud model. It systematically measures seven token-reduction tactics, with the key insight that local routing combined with prompt compression can selectively offload or shrink requests before cloud invocation. The study reports 45–79% cloud token savings on edit-heavy and explanation-heavy workloads, showing that local triage can substantially reduce cloud LLM usage.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该研究针对编码智能体工作负载中云 LLM token 消耗过高的问题，系统评测了以小型本地模型作为前置分诊层的七种优化策略。其核心洞见是将本地路由与提示压缩结合，可有效筛选并精简需交由前沿云模型处理的请求。实验表明，在编辑密集和解释密集任务上可节省 45–79% 的云 token，为混合本地-云 LLM 服务提供了成本优化依据。

papers.title: ENEC: A Lossless AI Model Compression Method Enabling Fast Inference on Ascend NPUs
papers.authors: Multiple authors
papers.abstract_en: ENEC proposes a lossless AI model compression method enabling fast inference on Ascend NPUs, addressing inference acceleration on heterogeneous hardware.
papers.abstract_cn: ENEC提出无损AI模型压缩方法，使昇腾NPU上实现快速推理。
papers.ai_summary_en: ENEC addresses the problem of accelerating LLM inference on heterogeneous Ascend NPUs while preserving model accuracy. It proposes a lossless model compression method that reduces storage and data movement overhead through hardware-aware compression compatible with Ascend execution. The main impact is faster NPU-based inference for LLM serving without quality degradation.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文面向大模型在异构硬件（尤其是 Ascend NPU）上的推理加速问题，提出了一种名为 ENEC 的无损模型压缩方法。其核心思路是在不损失模型精度的前提下，通过适配 Ascend NPU 的压缩与推理优化实现高效执行。该方法可提升大模型在 Ascend NPU 上的推理速度，为异构硬件上的低延迟模型服务提供了可行方案。

papers.title: DUET: Disaggregated Hybrid Mamba-Transformer LLMs with Prefill and Decode-Specific Packages
papers.authors: Alish Kanani, Sangwan Lee, Han Lyu, Jiahao Lin, Jaehyun Park, Umit Y. Ogras
papers.abstract_en: DUET introduces a disaggregated accelerator that assigns prefill and decode phases to specialized packages. The Prefill package utilizes systolic array chiplets with off-package memory. The Decode package utilizes vector-unit arrays with high-bandwidth in-package memory. Evaluations show DUET achieves 4x faster TTFT, 1.4x higher throughput, and 1.5x lower TPOT over the B200 GPU.
papers.abstract_cn: DUET引入解耦加速器，将prefill和decode阶段分配到专用包。Prefill包使用脉动阵列芯片，Decode包使用向量单元阵列和高带宽封装内存。比B200 GPU快4倍TTFT、1.4倍吞吐量、1.5倍更低TPOT。
papers.ai_summary_en: DUET addresses the hardware inefficiency of serving LLMs on monolithic accelerators, where compute-bound prefill and memory-bandwidth-bound decode have conflicting architectural requirements. It disaggregates prefill and decode into specialized packages: prefill uses systolic-array chiplets with off-package memory, while decode uses vector-unit arrays with high-bandwidth in-package memory. Evaluations show DUET achieves 4× faster TTFT, 1.4× higher throughput, and 1.5× lower TPOT than a B200 GPU.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对混合 Mamba-Transformer LLM 推理服务中 prefill 计算密集、decode 访存敏感导致通用 GPU 资源不匹配的问题，提出 DUET 解耦式加速器，将两阶段分别映射到专用封装：prefill 使用脉动阵列 chiplet 与封装外内存，decode 使用向量单元阵列与高带宽封装内内存。实验显示，相较 B200 GPU，DUET 将首 token 时延提升 4 倍，吞吐提高 1.4 倍，并将每 token 时延降低 1.5 倍。

papers.title: NCCL EP: Towards a Unified Expert Parallel Communication API for NCCL
papers.authors: Amos Goldman et al. (NVIDIA Corporation)
papers.abstract_en: NCCL EP provides unified ncclEpDispatch and ncclEpCombine primitives, supporting Low-Latency (LL) mode for inference decoding and High-Throughput (HT) mode for training and inference prefill. LL targets small batch sizes using direct all-to-all RDMA+NVLink mesh connectivity. HT targets large batches using hierarchical communication. Evaluated on H100-based cluster with vLLM integration.
papers.abstract_cn: NCCL EP提供统一的ncclEpDispatch和ncclEpCombine原语，支持推理解码的低延迟(LL)模式和训练/prefill的高吞吐量(HT)模式。LL模式针对小批量使用RDMA+NVLink，HT模式针对大批量使用层级通信。已集成vLLM，在H100集群上评估。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the need for a unified, high-performance communication API for expert-parallel MoE workloads across LLM inference decoding, prefill, and training. It introduces NCCL EP with `ncclEpDispatch` and `ncclEpCombine` primitives, using a low-latency RDMA+NVLink mesh for small-batch decoding and a hierarchical high-throughput path for large-batch prefill/training. Evaluations on an H100 cluster with vLLM integration show that NCCL EP provides a single API that can efficiently serve both latency-sensitive and throughput-oriented expert-parallel communication patterns.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文面向大模型专家并行中推理解码低延迟与训练/预填充高吞吐需求不一致的问题，提出统一的 NCCL 专家并行通信 API。其核心是提供 `ncclEpDispatch` 和 `ncclEpCombine` 原语，并设计面向小批量的低延迟 RDMA+NVLink 直接 all-to-all 模式，以及面向大批量的分层高吞吐模式。实验在 H100 集群上结合 vLLM 验证了该方案可统一支持推理与训练场景的专家并行通信。

papers.title: TaxBreak: Unmasking the Hidden Costs of LLM Inference Through Overhead Decomposition
papers.authors: Prabhu Vellaisamy, Shreesh Tripathi, Vignesh Natarajan, Surya Santhan Thenarasu, Shawn Blanton, John P. Shen
papers.abstract_en: TaxBreak presents a trace-driven methodology for decomposing host-visible orchestration overhead into three components: framework translation time, CUDA library translation time, and kernel launch-path time. TaxBreak distinguishes cases where optimization should reduce software-stack overhead from cases where the primary win comes from reducing device-side work. MoE models dispatch 8-11x more kernels per output token than dense models, and for such host-bound workloads, a faster host CPU reduces orchestration overhead by 10-29%.
papers.abstract_cn: TaxBreak提出追踪驱动方法分解主机可见编排开销为框架翻译时间、CUDA库翻译时间和内核启动路径时间。区分应优化软件栈还是设备端工作。MoE模型每输出token分派8-11倍更多内核，更快的主机CPU减少编排开销10-29%。
papers.ai_summary_en: TaxBreak addresses the problem of identifying whether LLM inference bottlenecks stem from host-side orchestration overhead or device-side computation. It introduces a trace-driven method that decomposes host-visible overhead into framework translation, CUDA library translation, and kernel launch-path time, clarifying when optimizations should target the software stack versus GPU work. The analysis shows MoE models dispatch 8–11× more kernels per token than dense models, making them host-bound in many cases, where a faster CPU reduces orchestration overhead by 10–29%.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理中常被忽视的主机侧编排开销问题，提出基于trace的开销分解方法，将开销拆解为框架转换、CUDA库转换和kernel启动路径三部分。其核心洞见是应区分优化软件栈开销与减少设备侧计算，从而判断瓶颈所在。实验表明MoE模型每token触发的kernel数量是dense模型的8–11倍，在主机受限场景下更快CPU可降低10–29%的编排开销。

papers.title: Cornserve: A Distributed Serving System for Any-to-Any Multimodal Models
papers.authors: Jae-Won Chung, Jeff J. Ma, Jisang Ahn, Yizhuo Liang, Akshay Jajoo, Myungjin Lee, Mosharaf Chowdhury
papers.abstract_en: Cornserve provides a flexible task abstraction for expressing Any-to-Any model computation graphs, enabling component disaggregation and independent scaling. The distributed runtime dispatches compute via an efficient record-and-replay execution model. Cornserve delivers up to 3.81x higher throughput and 5.79x lower tail latency. Open-source at github.com/cornserve-ai/cornserve.
papers.abstract_cn: Cornserve提供灵活任务抽象表达任意到任意模型计算图，实现组件解耦和独立扩展。吞吐量提升3.81倍，尾延迟降低5.79倍。开源于github.com/cornserve-ai/cornserve。
papers.ai_summary_en: Cornserve addresses the challenge of efficiently serving any-to-any multimodal models whose heterogeneous components have differing compute and scaling requirements. It introduces a flexible task abstraction for expressing model computation graphs, enabling component disaggregation and independent scaling through a distributed runtime that uses record-and-replay execution. The system achieves up to 3.81× higher throughput and 5.79× lower tail latency, and is released as open source.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文面向任意到任意多模态模型服务中计算图复杂、组件资源需求异构的问题，提出 Cornserve 分布式服务系统。其核心是通过灵活的任务抽象表达模型计算图，并支持组件解耦、独立扩展与基于记录-回放的高效分布式执行调度。实验显示，该系统最高可提升 3.81 倍吞吐，并将尾延迟降低 5.79 倍。

papers.title: AgentServe: Algorithm-System Co-Design for Efficient Agentic AI Serving on a Consumer-Grade GPU
papers.authors: Yuning Zhang et al.
papers.abstract_en: AgentServe presents a single-GPU serving system that ensures stable multi-agent execution by isolating prefills from decodes, applying dynamic budgeting to resume prefills, and allocating GPU resources through CUDA Green Context slots with adaptive control. AgentServe achieves up to 2.8x TTFT improvement and 2.7x TPOT improvement over state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.abstract_cn: AgentServe是单GPU服务系统，通过隔离prefill和decode、动态预算恢复prefill、CUDA Green Context槽自适应控制实现稳定多智能体执行。TTFT改善2.8倍，TPOT改善2.7倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: AgentServe addresses inefficient and unstable multi-agent LLM serving on a single consumer-grade GPU, where interleaved prefill and decode phases cause contention and latency variability. It introduces an algorithm–system co-design that isolates prefills from decodes, dynamically budgets prefill resumption, and allocates GPU resources using CUDA Green Context slots with adaptive control. The system achieves up to 2.8× TTFT improvement and 2.7× TPOT improvement over state-of-the-art baselines while enabling stable multi-agent execution.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对消费级单 GPU 上多智能体 LLM 服务中 prefill 与 decode 相互干扰、导致延迟不稳定的问题，提出 AgentServe 系统。其核心方法是通过算法-系统协同设计，隔离 prefill 与 decode、动态预算控制 prefill 恢复，并利用 CUDA Green Context slots 进行自适应 GPU 资源分配。实验显示，相较先进基线，AgentServe 可将首 token 延迟最高提升 2.8 倍、每 token 延迟最高提升 2.7 倍。

papers.title: Token Coherence: Adapting MESI Cache Protocols to Minimize Synchronization Overhead in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.authors: Vladyslav Parakhin
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM orchestration incurs synchronization costs scaling as O(n x S x |D|). This work maps synchronization cost explosion onto the cache coherence problem and adapts MESI-protocol invalidation. Token Coherence Theorem: lazy invalidation attenuates cost by at least S/(n + W(d_i)). Simulation yields token savings of 95.0% at V=0.05. Code at github.com/hipvlady/agent-coherence.
papers.abstract_cn: 多智能体LLM编排产生O(n×S×|D|)同步开销。将同步开销爆炸映射到缓存一致性问题，适配MESI协议无效化。Token一致性定理：惰性无效化至少衰减S/(n+W)开销。模拟显示token节省95%。代码在github.com/hipvlady/agent-coherence。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses synchronization overhead in multi-agent LLM orchestration, where coordination costs scale as O(n × S × |D|) with agents, state updates, and shared context size. It reframes the problem as cache coherence and adapts MESI-style invalidation, proving via a Token Coherence Theorem that lazy invalidation reduces synchronization cost by at least S/(n + W(d_i)). Simulations show 95.0% token savings at V=0.05, demonstrating a practical route to lower-overhead multi-agent LLM serving.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多智能体 LLM 系统中同步开销随智能体数、状态规模和上下文长度急剧增长的问题，将其类比为缓存一致性问题。核心方法是借鉴 MESI 缓存协议，提出 Token Coherence 机制并通过惰性失效减少不必要的 token 同步。理论与仿真表明，该方法可显著降低同步成本，在设定参数下实现约 95% 的 token 节省。

papers.title: Ragged Paged Attention: A High-Performance and Flexible LLM Inference Kernel for TPU
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) deployment is increasingly shifting to cost-efficient accelerators like Google's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), prioritizing both performance and total cost of ownership (TCO). However, existing LLM inference kernels and serving systems remain largely GPU-centric, and there is no well-established approach for efficiently mapping LLM workloads onto TPU architectures--particularly under the dynamic and ragged execution patterns common in modern serving. In this paper, we present Ragged Paged Attention (RPA), a high-performance and flexible attention kernel for TPUs, implemented using Pallas and Mosaic. RPA addresses these challenges through three key techniques: (1) fine-grained tiling to enable efficient dynamic slicing over ragged memory, (2) a custom software pipeline that fuses KV cache updates with attention computation, and (3) a distribution-aware compilation strategy that generates specialized kernels for decode, prefill, and mixed workloads. Evaluated on Llama 3 8B on TPU7x, RPA achieves up to 86% memory bandwidth utilization (MBU) in decode and 73% model FLOPs utilization (MFU) in prefill. Integrated as the primary TPU backend in vLLM and SGLang, RPA provides a production-grade foundation for efficient TPU inference and offers practical insights into kernel design.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型 (LLM) 部署正越来越多地转向成本效益高的加速器，如谷歌的张量处理单元 (TPU)，优先考虑性能和总拥有成本 (TCO)。然而，现有的 LLM 推理内核和服务系统在很大程度上仍然以 GPU 为中心，并且没有一种成熟的方法来有效地将 LLM 工作负载映射到 TPU 架构——特别是在现代服务中常见的动态和粗糙的执行模式下。在本文中，我们介绍了粗糙分页注意力 (RPA)，一种用于 TPU 的高性能和灵活的注意力内核，使用 Pallas 和 Mosaic 实现。RPA 通过三种关键技术解决这些挑战:(1) 细粒度平铺，以实现对不规则内存的高效动态切片;(2) 自定义软件管道，将 KV 缓存更新与注意力计算融合;(3) 分布感知编译策略，为解码、预填充和混合工作负载生成专用内核。在 Lama 3 8B 和 TPU 7x 上进行评估，RPA 在解码时实现了高达 86% 的内存带宽利用率 (MBU)，在预填充时实现了 73% 的模型 FLOPs 利用率 (MFU)。作为 vLLM 和 SGLang 中的主要 TPU 后端集成，RPA 为高效的 TPU 推理提供了生产级基础，并为内核设计提供了实用的见解。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles the lack of efficient, GPU-centric LLM inference kernels for TPUs, especially for dynamic ragged serving workloads with variable sequence lengths. It introduces Ragged Paged Attention (RPA), a Pallas/Mosaic-based TPU attention kernel using fine-grained tiling for ragged memory slicing, fused KV-cache updates with attention computation, and distribution-aware compilation specialized for decode, prefill, and mixed batches. On Llama 3 8B with TPU v7, RPA reaches up to 86% memory bandwidth utilization in decode and 73% model FLOPs utilization in prefill, and is integrated as the primary TPU backend in vLLM and SGLang.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对TPU上LLM推理缺乏高效处理动态ragged批处理与分页KV缓存的问题，提出Ragged Paged Attention（RPA）注意力内核，通过细粒度tiling、KV缓存更新与注意力计算融合流水，以及面向prefill/decode/混合负载的特化编译来适配TPU架构。实验显示，其在Llama 3 8B与TPU7x上可实现decode最高86%内存带宽利用率、prefill 73%模型FLOPs利用率。RPA已集成为vLLM和SGLang的主要TPU后端，为生产级高效TPU推理提供了可行方案。

papers.title: The Illusion of Equivalence: Systematic FP16 Divergence in KV-Cached Autoregressive Inference
papers.abstract_en: KV caching is a ubiquitous optimization in autoregressive transformer inference, long presumed to be numerically equivalent to cache-free computation. This assumption fails under standard FP16 precision: cache-ON and cache-OFF execution paths employ different floating-point accumulation orderings which, due to FP16 non-associativity, produce a deterministic divergence in decoded token sequences. Across three open-weight models (LLaMA-2-7B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, Gemma-2-2B) evaluated on GSM8K, we observe a 100\% token divergence rate across all sampling strategies, including greedy decoding, which rules out sampling randomness as a cause, and also with cache-ON yielding higher accuracy in 8 of 9 conditions, where the accuracy difference serves as an indicator that the divergence direction is systematic rather than random. Controlled FP32 falsification reduces divergence by eight orders of magnitude, eliminates token flips, and drops the flip rate to exactly 0.0\%, confirming FP16 non-associativity as the sole causal driver. Layer-wise drift profiling reveals architecturally predictable propagation patterns: models using Grouped-Query Attention exhibit sharp divergence at the first layer, while Gemma's larger head dimension and sliding window attention produce uniform accumulation across all layers. Finally, activation patching of the entire residual stream fails to recover the cache-free trajectory, localizing the causal variable to the stateful KV cache. These findings establish that FP16 KV cache inference is fundamentally non-equivalent to recomputation and provide a mechanistic framework for understanding numerical instability in modern LLM inference systems.
papers.abstract_cn: KV 缓存是自回归变压器推理中普遍存在的优化，长期以来被认为在数值上等效于无缓存计算。在标准 FP16 精度下，这一假设失效：缓存开和缓存关执行路径采用不同的浮点累积顺序，由于 FP16 的非关联性，这些顺序在解码的标记序列中产生了确定性发散。在三个开放权重模型 (LLaMA-2-7B、Mistral-7B-v0) 中，3、Gemma-2-2B) 在 GSM8K 上进行了评估，我们观察到所有采样策略 (包括贪婪解码) 的代币发散率均为 100%，这排除了采样随机性作为原因的可能性。此外，在 9 种条件中的 8 种情况下，cache-ON 产生了更高的准确率，其中准确率差异表明发散方向是系统性的而非随机的。受控的 FP32 伪造将发散率降低了 8 个数量级，消除了代币翻转，并将翻转率降低到 0.0%。这证实了 FP16 非关联性是唯一的因果驱动因素。逐层漂移分析揭示了架构上可预测的传播模式：使用分组查询注意力的模型在第一层表现出明显的发散性，而 Gemma 更大的头部维度和滑动窗口注意力在所有层中产生了均匀的积累。最后，对整个剩余流的激活修补未能恢复无缓存轨迹，将因果变量定位到有状态 KV 缓存。这些发现表明，FP16 KV 缓存推理从根本上不等同于重新计算，并为理解现代 LLM 推理系统中的数值不稳定性提供了一个机制框架。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper shows that KV-cached autoregressive inference is not numerically equivalent to cache-free recomputation under FP16, because cached and uncached paths use different floating-point accumulation orders and FP16 arithmetic is non-associative. Using greedy-decoding experiments on LLaMA-2, Mistral, and Gemma over GSM8K, together with FP32 controls, layer-wise drift profiling, and activation patching, it isolates the stateful KV cache as the causal source of deterministic token divergence. The study finds 100% token divergence in FP16, near-elimination of flips in FP32, and architecture-dependent drift patterns, demonstrating a systematic reproducibility and stability issue in modern LLM serving.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文指出，LLM自回归推理中KV缓存与无缓存计算在FP16下并不数值等价：不同累加顺序因FP16非结合性会引发确定性的解码偏差。作者通过FP32对照、逐层漂移分析和残差流激活补丁，在LLaMA-2、Mistral和Gemma上证明即使贪心解码也会出现100% token分歧，而FP32可将分歧大幅降至近乎消除。该发现表明KV缓存会带来系统性且架构依赖的数值不稳定，为推理服务的精度一致性提供了机制性解释。

papers.title: Fleet: Hierarchical Task-based Abstraction for Megakernels on Multi-Die GPUs
papers.abstract_en: Modern GPUs adopt chiplet-based designs with multiple private cache hierarchies, but current programming models (CUDA/HIP) expose a flat execution hierarchy that cannot express chiplet-level locality or synchronization. This mismatch leads to redundant memory traffic and poor cache utilization in memory-bound workloads such as LLM inference.We present Fleet, a multi-level task model that maps computation to memory scopes. Fleet introduces Chiplet-tasks, a new abstraction that binds work and data to a chiplet and enables coordination through its shared L2 cache. Wavefront-level, CU-level, and device-level tasks align with existing abstractions, while Chiplet-tasks expose a previously unaddressed level of the hierarchy. Fleet is implemented as a persistent kernel runtime with per-chiplet scheduling, allowing workers within a chiplet to cooperatively execute tasks with coordinated cache reuse. On AMD Instinct MI350 with Qwen3-8B, Fleet achieves 1.3-1.5x lower decode latency than vLLM at batch sizes 1-8 through persistent kernel execution and per-chiplet scheduling. At larger batch sizes, cooperative weight tiling increases L2 hit rate (from 12% to 54% at batch size 32 and from 39% to 61% at batch size 64), reducing HBM traffic by up to 37% and delivering 1.27-1.30x speedup over a chiplet-unaware megakernel baseline.
papers.abstract_cn: 现代 GPU 采用基于芯片的设计，具有多个私有缓存层次结构，但当前的编程模型 (CUDA/HIP) 暴露了一个扁平的执行层次结构，无法表达芯片级别的局部性或同步。这种不匹配导致内存流量冗余和内存绑定工作负载 (如 LLM 推理) 的缓存利用率低。我们介绍了 Fleet，一种将计算映射到内存范围的多级任务模型。Fleet 引入了 Chiplet 任务，这是一种新的抽象，它将工作和数据绑定到芯片，并通过其共享的 L2 缓存实现协调。波前级、CU 级和设备级任务与现有的抽象保持一致，而 Chiplet 任务暴露了层次结构中以前未处理的一个层次。Fleet 实现为具有每芯片调度的持久内核运行时，允许芯片内的工作程序通过协调缓存重用协同执行任务。在采用 Qwen3-8B 的 AMD Instinct MI350 上，通过持久内核执行和每芯片调度，Fleet 在批量大小为 1-8 的情况下实现了比 vLLM 低 1.3-1.5 倍的解码延迟。在较大批量尺寸下，协同重量平铺提高了 L2 命中率 (在批量尺寸为 32 时从 12% 提高到 54%，在批量尺寸为 64 时从 39% 提高到 61%)，将 HBM 流量减少了高达 37%，并在芯片未意识到的巨核基准上实现了 1.27-1.30 倍的加速。
papers.ai_summary_en: Fleet addresses the mismatch between multi-die/chiplet GPU architectures and flat CUDA/HIP execution models, which causes poor chiplet-level locality, low L2 reuse, and excess HBM traffic in memory-bound LLM inference megakernels. It introduces a hierarchical task model with chiplet-tasks that bind computation and data to a chiplet and coordinate through its shared L2, implemented as a persistent kernel runtime with per-chiplet scheduling and cooperative weight tiling. On AMD MI350 serving Qwen3-8B, Fleet achieves 1.3–1.5x lower decode latency than vLLM at batch sizes 1–8 and, at larger batches, improves L2 hit rate substantially, reduces HBM traffic by up to 37%, and speeds up chiplet-unaware megakernels by 1.27–1.30x.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对多die GPU中CUDA/HIP扁平执行模型无法表达chiplet级局部性与同步、导致LLM推理产生冗余HBM访问和低缓存利用的问题，论文提出Fleet分层任务抽象。其核心是Chiplet-task，将计算与数据绑定到单个chiplet并通过共享L2协同，配合持久内核运行时和按chiplet调度实现缓存复用。实验在MI350上服务Qwen3-8B，将小batch解码延迟较vLLM降低1.3–1.5倍，并通过协作权重切分显著提升L2命中率、减少最多37%HBM流量，较大内核基线加速约1.27–1.30倍。

papers.title: Fully Homomorphic Encryption on Llama 3 model for privacy preserving LLM inference
papers.abstract_en: The applications of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) and their intersections with data-driven fields, such as healthcare, finance, transportation, and information security, have led to significant improvements in service efficiency and low latency. However, this synergy raises serious concerns regarding the security of large language models (LLMs) and their potential impact on the privacy of companies and users' data. Many technology companies that incorporate LLMs in their services with a certain level of command and control bear a risk of data exposure and secret divulgence caused by insecure LLM pipelines, making them vulnerable to multiple attacks such as data poisoning, prompt injection, and model theft. Although several security techniques (input/output sanitization, decentralized learning, access control management, and encryption) were implemented to reduce this risk, there is still an imminent risk of quantum computing attacks, which are expected to break existing encryption algorithms, hence, retrieving secret keys, encrypted sensitive data, and decrypting encrypted models. In this extensive work, we integrate the Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) based Lattice-based Homomorphic Encryption (HE) main functions in the LLM's inference pipeline to secure some of its layers against data privacy attacks. We modify the inference pipeline of the transformer architecture for the LLAMA-3 model while injecting the main homomorphic encryption operations provided by the concrete-ml library. We demonstrate high text generation accuracies (up to 98%) with reasonable latencies (237 ms) on an i9 CPU, reaching up to 80 tokens per second, which proves the feasibility and validity of our work while running a FHE-secured LLAMA-3 inference model. Further experiments and analysis are discussed to justify models' text generation latencies and behaviours.
papers.abstract_cn: 生成式人工智能 (GenAI) 的应用及其与医疗保健、金融、交通运输和信息安全等数据驱动领域的交集，已经导致服务效率和低延迟的显著提高。然而，这种协同效应引发了人们对大语言模型 (LLMs) 安全性的严重担忧，以及它们对公司和用户数据隐私的潜在影响。许多科技公司在其服务中融入了 LLMs，并对其拥有一定程度的指挥和控制权，这些公司面临着由不安全的 LLM 管道引起的数据暴露和秘密泄露风险，使其容易受到数据中毒、提前注入和模型盗窃等多种攻击。尽管已经实施了多种安全技术 (输入/输出消毒、去中心化学习、访问控制管理和加密) 来降低这种风险，但仍然存在迫在眉睫的量子计算攻击风险，预计这些攻击将破坏现有的加密算法，从而检索秘密密钥、加密敏感数据和解密加密模型。在这项广泛的工作中，我们将基于后量子密码学 (PQC) 的基于格子的同态加密 (HE) 主要功能集成到 LLM 的推理管道中，以保护其某些层免受数据隐私攻击。我们修改了 LAMA-3 模型的变压器架构的推理管道，同时注入了具体 ml 库提供的主要同态加密操作。我们在 i9 CPU 上展示了高文本生成准确率 (高达 98%) 和合理的延迟 (237 ms)，达到每秒 80 个标记，证明了我们工作的可行性和有效性，同时运行了 FHE 保护的 LAMA-3 推理模型。进一步的实验和分析讨论了模型的文本生成延迟和行为的合理性。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses privacy-preserving LLM inference by protecting Llama 3 against data exposure and quantum-vulnerable encryption using fully homomorphic encryption. It modifies the transformer inference pipeline to run selected layers on encrypted data via lattice-based FHE operations from the concrete-ml library, avoiding decryption of sensitive inputs or activations. Experiments show up to 98% text-generation accuracy with roughly 237 ms latency and 80 tokens/s on an i9 CPU, demonstrating the feasibility of FHE-secured LLM inference.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理中的数据隐私泄露与后量子攻击风险，研究在Llama 3推理管道中引入全同态加密以实现隐私保护推理。其核心方法是修改Transformer推理流程，并利用concrete-ml提供的格基FHE操作对部分层进行密文计算。实验在i9 CPU上取得最高98%文本生成准确率、约237 ms延迟和80 tokens/s吞吐，初步验证了FHE保护LLM推理的可行性。

papers.title: DualDiffusion: A Speculative Decoding Strategy for Masked Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) offer a promising alternative to autoregressive language models by enabling parallel token generation and bidirectional context modeling. However, their inference speed is significantly limited by the inability to cache key-value pairs due to bidirectional attention, requiring $O(N^2)$ computations at each generation step. While recent methods like FastDLLM and DkvCache improve inference speed through attention approximations and caching strategies, they achieve speedups at the cost of generation quality. We propose DualDiffusion, a speculative decoding framework for MDMs that combines fast drafter models (using efficient approximations) with slower, more accurate verifier models. By running multiple steps of a lightweight drafter followed by a single verification step, DualDiffusion achieves a superior Pareto frontier between generation steps and accuracy compared to existing approaches. We evaluate our method on MMLU and GSM8K, demonstrating that DualDiffusion maintains high accuracy while reducing the number of generation steps required, effectively pushing the quality-efficiency trade-off curve for masked diffusion language models.
papers.abstract_cn: 掩蔽扩散模型 (MDM) 通过实现并行令牌生成和双向上下文建模，为自回归语言模型提供了一个有前景的替代方案。然而，由于双向注意力，它们的推理速度显著受限于无法缓存键值对，这需要在每个生成步骤中进行$O(N^2)$计算。尽管最近的方法如 FastDLLM 和 DkvCache 通过注意力近似和缓存策略提高了推理速度，但它们以牺牲生成质量为代价实现了速度提升。我们提出了 DualDiffusion，一种 MDM 的推测性解码框架，它将快速的绘图模型 (使用高效的近似) 与较慢、更准确的验证者模型相结合。通过运行轻量级绘图器的多个步骤，再加上一个验证步骤，DualDiffusion 与现有方法相比，在生成步骤和准确性之间达到了更高的 Pareto 前沿。我们在 MMLU 和 GSM8K 上评估了我们的方法，结果表明 DualDiffusion 在保持高准确性的同时减少了所需的生成步骤数，有效地推动了掩蔽式扩散语言模型的质量 - 效率权衡曲线。
papers.ai_summary_en: DualDiffusion addresses the inference bottleneck of masked diffusion language models, whose bidirectional attention prevents KV caching and forces \(O(N^2)\) recomputation at every decoding step. It introduces a speculative decoding framework in which a lightweight, approximate drafter proposes multiple diffusion steps that are then checked by a slower, higher-fidelity verifier, decoupling cheap proposal from accurate validation. On MMLU and GSM8K, the method reduces generation steps while preserving accuracy, yielding a better quality–efficiency Pareto frontier than prior approximation/caching methods such as FastDLLM and DkvCache.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对掩码扩散语言模型因双向注意力无法使用 KV 缓存、每步需 O(N²) 计算而导致推理慢，且现有近似缓存方法会牺牲质量的问题。提出 DualDiffusion 投机解码框架，用轻量快速草稿模型进行多步近似生成，再由更准确的验证模型一次性校验，从而在生成步数与精度之间取得更优平衡。实验在 MMLU 和 GSM8K 上表明，该方法能显著减少生成步数并保持较高准确率，改善了掩码扩散模型的质量-效率权衡。

papers.title: Copy-as-Decode: Grammar-Constrained Parallel Prefill for LLM Editing
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Copy-as-Decode, a kernel that reframes constrained text editing as parallel prefill: the target string becomes the 'draft' and grammar constraints enforce deterministic acceptance, sharing the parallel-forward kernel of speculative decoding but with input tokens as the draft and program-enforced acceptance replacing probabilistic verification.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们介绍了 Copy-as-Decode，这是一种将受约束文本编辑重新定义为并行预填充的内核：目标字符串成为“草稿”，语法约束强制执行确定性的接受，借用了推测解码的并行前向内核，但输入标记作为草稿，程序强制的接受取代了概率验证。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses low-latency grammar-constrained LLM text editing, avoiding slow autoregressive generation when the output must satisfy deterministic program or grammar rules. Copy-as-Decode reframes editing as parallel prefill by treating the target string as a speculative “draft” and replacing probabilistic verification with grammar-enforced deterministic acceptance. This reuses the parallel-forward kernel of speculative decoding to enable faster, constraint-guaranteed edits in a single prefill-style pass.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对 LLM 受约束文本编辑中因逐 token 生成/验证导致的 prefill 低效问题，提出将编辑过程重构为并行 prefill。其核心洞见是把目标字符串视为投机解码中的“草稿”，并由语法约束进行确定性接受，从而复用投机解码的并行前向内核但用程序化验证替代概率验证。该方法有望在 prefill/解耦场景下提升确定性编辑的吞吐并降低延迟。

papers.title: WISV: Wireless-Informed Semantic Verification for Distributed Speculative Decoding in Device-Edge LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: While distributed device-edge speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference, verification overhead on constrained devices remains significant. We propose WISV, a wireless-informed semantic verification framework that leverages channel state information to reduce verification complexity in distributed speculative decoding.
papers.abstract_cn: 虽然分布式设备边缘推测解码可以加速大语言模型的推理，但在受限设备上的验证开销仍然很大。我们提出了 WISV，一种无线信息语义验证框架，它利用信道状态信息来降低分布式推测解码中的验证复杂性。
papers.ai_summary_en: WISV addresses the high verification overhead of distributed device-edge speculative decoding, where constrained devices must validate draft tokens under limited compute and wireless communication constraints. It introduces a wireless-informed semantic verification framework that uses channel state information to adaptively guide or simplify semantic verification decisions, reducing device-side complexity. The proposed approach aims to preserve inference acceleration and output quality while lowering verification costs in wireless device-edge LLM deployment.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对设备-边缘分布式推测解码中，受限设备上的验证开销过高的问题展开研究。其核心思路是提出 WISV 框架，利用无线信道状态信息辅助语义验证，从而降低验证复杂度。该方法有望在无线环境下提升分布式 LLM 推理效率，减轻边缘/终端设备的计算与通信负担。

papers.title: HybridGen: Efficient LLM Generative Inference via CPU-GPU Hybrid Computing
papers.abstract_en: We propose HybridGen, an efficient LLM generative inference framework that leverages CPU-GPU hybrid computing to maximize resource utilization and reduce inference latency.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们提出了HybridGen，一种高效的LLM生成推理框架，它利用CPU-GPU混合计算来最大化资源利用率并减少推理延迟。
papers.ai_summary_en: HybridGen addresses the latency and resource-underutilization bottlenecks in LLM generative inference when relying on a single accelerator. It proposes a CPU–GPU hybrid inference framework that coordinates computation across both devices to exploit their complementary strengths and improve pipeline utilization during generation. The reported impact is reduced inference latency and more efficient use of available CPU and GPU resources.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对大模型生成式推理中单一 GPU 资源受限、利用率不足导致延迟较高的问题，提出了 HybridGen 框架。其核心思路是利用 CPU-GPU 混合计算协同执行推理，以最大化异构资源利用率；主要效果是降低生成式推理延迟并提升整体推理效率。

papers.title: MoE-nD: Per-Layer Mixture-of-Experts Routing for Multi-Axis KV Cache Compression
papers.abstract_en: KV cache memory is the dominant bottleneck for long-context LLM inference. Existing compression methods each act on a single axis of the four-dimensional KV tensor -- token eviction (sequence), quantization (precision), low-rank projection (head dimension), or cross-layer sharing -- but apply the same recipe to every layer. We show that this homogeneity leaves accuracy on the table: different layers prefer different compression strategies.
papers.abstract_cn: KV 缓存内存是长上下文大语言模型推理的主要瓶颈。现有的压缩方法各自作用于四维 KV 张量的单一轴——令牌剔除（序列）、量化（精度）、低秩投影（头维度）或跨层共享——但对每一层都采用相同的方式。我们显示，这种同质性会带来精度损失：不同的层更适合不同的压缩策略。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles the KV-cache memory bottleneck in long-context LLM inference, where existing compression methods typically apply a single uniform strategy—token eviction, quantization, low-rank projection, or cross-layer sharing—across all layers. It proposes MoE-nD, a per-layer mixture-of-experts routing framework that selects or combines compression operators across multiple KV-tensor axes based on layer-specific sensitivity and preference. This heterogeneous, learned routing yields a better accuracy–memory tradeoff than homogeneous compression pipelines by adapting the compression recipe to each layer.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV cache 内存瓶颈，指出现有压缩方法通常只在单一维度（token、精度、头维度或层间共享）上对所有层采用同一策略，忽略了不同层对压缩方式的偏好差异。其核心思路是提出 MoE-nD，通过逐层混合专家路由，在多轴 KV cache 压缩策略中为不同层选择更合适的压缩组合。主要贡献在于揭示并利用了“层间异构压缩需求”，从而在内存压缩与模型精度之间取得更好的权衡。

papers.title: How Much Cache Does Reasoning Need? Depth-Cache Tradeoffs in KV-Compressed Transformers
papers.abstract_en: We study the depth-cache tradeoffs in KV-compressed transformers, examining how much cache is needed for reasoning tasks and the implications for inference efficiency.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们研究了KV压缩Transformer中的深度与缓存权衡，考察了推理任务所需的缓存量以及对推理效率的影响。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses how much KV cache reasoning-capable transformers require when inference is constrained by KV-cache compression. It studies depth–cache tradeoffs in KV-compressed transformers, analyzing how model depth and cache budget interact to affect reasoning performance and inference efficiency. The main contribution is a characterization of the cache needed for reasoning tasks, providing guidance for designing efficient compressed-transformer inference systems.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对推理型 Transformer 中 KV 缓存占用过高的问题，研究模型深度与缓存预算之间的权衡，探讨推理任务究竟需要多少缓存才能保持性能。其核心洞见是推理能力并不一定依赖完整 KV 缓存，可通过 KV 压缩与深度配置在效率和推理质量之间取得平衡。该工作为高效推理系统的设计，尤其是缓存预算分配和推理加速提供了参考。

papers.title: River-LLM: Large Language Model Seamless Exit Based on KV Share
papers.abstract_en: We propose River-LLM, a seamless exit mechanism for LLM inference based on KV share, allowing early termination while maintaining output quality.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们提出了 River-LLM，一种基于 KV 共享的 LLM 推理无缝退出机制，允许在保持输出质量的同时提前终止。
papers.ai_summary_en: River-LLM addresses the inference efficiency problem in large language models by enabling early exit without degrading generation quality. Its key idea is a seamless exit mechanism based on KV sharing, which reuses key–value cache representations across layers to allow early termination while preserving compatibility with later decoding steps. The method demonstrates that LLM inference can be accelerated with maintained output quality, offering a practical trade-off between latency and performance.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对大模型逐层推理中存在计算冗余、提前退出易损害输出质量的问题。River-LLM 提出基于 KV 共享的无缝早期退出机制，通过复用键值状态使模型在中间层即可稳定终止推理。其主要意义是在保持生成质量的同时降低推理延迟与计算开销，为 LLM 高效推理提供低侵入式方案。

papers.title: AQPIM: Breaking the PIM Capacity Wall for LLMs with In-Memory Activation Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Processing-in-Memory (PIM) architectures improve bandwidth for LLM inference but face capacity limitations. We propose AQPIM, breaking the PIM capacity wall through in-memory activation quantization for efficient LLM inference.
papers.abstract_cn: 内存计算（PIM）架构提高了大型语言模型推理的带宽，但面临容量限制。我们提出了AQPIM，通过在内存中进行激活量化来突破PIM容量壁垒，实现高效的LLM推理。
papers.ai_summary_en: AQPIM addresses the capacity limitations of processing-in-memory architectures for LLM inference, where insufficient on-device memory restricts model size and batching. Its key idea is to perform activation quantization directly within the PIM datapath, reducing activation storage and movement overhead while preserving compute efficiency. This approach breaks the PIM capacity wall, enabling larger LLMs to be served with higher throughput and lower memory pressure.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对存内计算（PIM）加速 LLM 推理时因内存容量不足导致的“容量墙”问题。AQPIM 的核心思路是在存储器内部直接进行激活量化，以降低激活数据占用和搬运开销，从而在有限容量下支撑大模型推理。摘要表明该方法可突破 PIM 容量限制，实现更高效的 LLM 推理。

papers.title: Latent Phase-Shift Rollback: Inference-Time Error Correction via Residual Stream Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: We propose Latent Phase-Shift Rollback, an inference-time error correction mechanism via residual stream monitoring for LLM inference quality improvement.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们提出了潜在相位偏移回滚，这是一种通过残差流监控的推理时错误校正机制，用于提升大型语言模型推理质量。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses inference-time errors and quality degradation in LLM generation. It proposes Latent Phase-Shift Rollback, a method that monitors residual-stream activations during decoding to detect latent phase shifts indicative of erroneous continuations and triggers rollback-based correction. The approach is positioned as a training-free mechanism for improving generation reliability, though the abstract provides no quantitative results.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对大语言模型在推理过程中可能出现错误累积、输出质量不稳定的问题，提出了一种推理时错误纠正机制“Latent Phase-Shift Rollback”。其核心思路是通过监控残差流中的潜在状态变化，检测异常偏移并在推理过程中回滚到更早状态进行修正。该方法为无需重新训练即可提升推理可靠性提供了一种新途径，有望改善大模型推理质量。

papers.title: SLO-Guard: Crash-Aware, Budget-Consistent Autotuning for SLO-Constrained LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: Serving large language models under latency service-level objectives (SLOs) is a configuration-heavy systems problem with an unusually failure-prone search space. We present SLO-Guard, a crash-aware autotuner for vLLM serving that treats crashes as first-class observations. SLO-Guard combines a feasible-first Thermal Budget Annealing (TBA) exploration phase with a warm-started Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) exploitation phase; the handoff replays all exploration history, including crashes encoded as extreme constraint violations.
papers.abstract_cn: 在延迟服务级别目标（SLOs）下提供大型语言模型服务是一个配置密集型的系统问题，其搜索空间异常容易失败。我们提出了 SLO-Guard，一种面向 vLLM 服务的崩溃感知自动调优器，它将崩溃视为一等公民观测。SLO-Guard 将可行优先的热量预算退火（TBA）探索阶段与预热的树状 Parzen 估计器（TPE）开发阶段结合；这一交接会重放所有探索历史，包括作为极端约束违规编码的崩溃。
papers.ai_summary_en: SLO-Guard addresses the crash-prone autotuning problem for LLM serving configurations that must satisfy latency SLOs under budget constraints. Its key method is a crash-aware two-phase search: feasible-first Thermal Budget Annealing for safe exploration, followed by a warm-started Tree-structured Parzen Estimator that replays all history, encoding crashes as extreme constraint violations. This makes tuning more robust and budget-consistent while improving SLO attainment in failure-prone vLLM configuration spaces.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM 服务在延迟 SLO 约束下配置空间复杂且易崩溃的自动调参问题，提出面向 vLLM 的崩溃感知调优器 SLO-Guard。其核心方法是将崩溃视为一等观测，先用可行优先的 Thermal Budget Annealing 探索，再通过热启动 TPE 进行利用，并把崩溃编码为极端约束违反以重放历史。该工作提升了 SLO 约束下服务配置搜索的可靠性与预算一致性，为高失败率系统调优提供了更稳健的方案。

papers.title: Bit-Flip Vulnerability of Shared KV-Cache Blocks in LLM Serving Systems
papers.abstract_en: Rowhammer on GPU DRAM has enabled adversarial bit flips in model weights; shared KV-cache blocks in LLM serving systems present an analogous but previously unexamined target. In vLLM's Prefix Caching, these blocks exist as a single physical copy without integrity protection. Using software fault injection, we characterize worst-case severity and identify three properties: silent divergence, selective propagation, and persistent accumulation.
papers.abstract_cn: GPU DRAM 上的 Rowhammer 已经实现了模型权重的对抗性比特翻转；在 LLM 服务系统中，共享的 KV 缓存块呈现出类似但之前未被研究的攻击目标。在 vLLM 的 Prefix 缓存中，这些块以单一物理副本存在且没有完整性保护。通过软件故障注入，我们对最严重的情况进行了表征，并识别出三个特性：静默偏差、选择性传播和持久积累。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper investigates bit-flip vulnerabilities in LLM serving systems, focusing on shared KV-cache blocks in vLLM’s prefix caching, which are stored as single physical copies without integrity protection. Using software fault injection to model Rowhammer-style DRAM faults, it characterizes worst-case failure behavior and identifies silent divergence, selective propagation, and persistent accumulation. The findings show that corrupted shared KV blocks can silently and persistently affect multiple requests, exposing a new integrity and security risk in optimized LLM serving systems.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理服务中共享KV缓存块缺乏完整性保护、可能被位翻转攻击的问题，聚焦vLLM前缀缓存的单物理副本机制。作者通过软件故障注入刻画最坏情况，发现错误会静默偏离、选择性传播并在共享块中持续累积。结果表明共享KV缓存成为新的脆弱攻击面，提示需要在缓存共享与复用中引入校验或隔离保护。

papers.title: Graph-Guided Adaptive Channel Elimination for KV Cache Compression (GRACE)
papers.abstract_en: We introduce GRACE (Graph-guided Adaptive Channel Elimination), a novel framework that reframes KV cache compression as a graph-based optimization problem. GRACE models channels as nodes and their inter-dependencies as edges, enabling structured and informed pruning decisions.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们介绍了 GRACE（基于图的自适应通道消除），这是一个将 KV 缓存压缩重新构架为图优化问题的新框架。GRACE 将通道建模为节点，将它们的相互依赖建模为边，从而实现结构化且有依据的剪枝决策。
papers.ai_summary_en: GRACE addresses KV cache compression by deciding which key/value channels to eliminate so that attention representations remain effective under reduced memory and compute budgets. Its key insight is to formulate channel pruning as a graph optimization problem, modeling channels as nodes and inter-channel dependencies as edges to enable structured, dependency-aware elimination. This graph-guided approach supports more informed pruning than independent channel scoring, offering a principled path toward compact KV caches with potentially better preservation of model quality.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型推理中 KV Cache 压缩时通道剪枝缺乏结构化依据、容易忽略通道间依赖的问题。其核心方法 GRACE 将通道建模为图节点、通道依赖建模为边，通过图引导的自适应通道消除实现更有结构的 KV Cache 压缩。该思路有助于在降低缓存开销的同时提升剪枝决策的合理性，为 KV Cache 压缩提供了图优化视角。

papers.title: Open-TQ-Metal: Fused Compressed-Domain Attention for Long-Context LLM Inference on Apple Silicon
papers.abstract_en: We present Open-TQ-Metal, a fused compressed-domain attention kernel for long-context LLM inference on Apple Silicon Metal GPU, enabling efficient attention computation in the compressed domain.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们提出了 Open-TQ-Metal，这是一种用于 Apple Silicon Metal GPU 上长上下文大型语言模型推理的融合压缩域注意力内核，能够在压缩域中高效地计算注意力。
papers.ai_summary_en: Open-TQ-Metal addresses the memory-bandwidth and compute inefficiency of long-context LLM attention on Apple Silicon GPUs, where conventional kernels must materialize large decompressed activations. Its key contribution is a fused Metal attention kernel that performs attention directly in the compressed domain, reducing data movement and avoiding unnecessary decompression overhead. This enables more efficient long-context inference on Apple hardware, improving practical serving throughput and memory efficiency for compressed LLM representations.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向 Apple Silicon 上长上下文 LLM 推理的内存与计算瓶颈，重点解决注意力在长序列下效率不足的问题。其核心方法是提出 Open-TQ-Metal，一个在 Metal GPU 上融合的压缩域注意力内核，使注意力计算可直接在压缩表示中完成，减少解压与内存访问开销。该方案提升了长上下文推理的执行效率，为 Apple Silicon 平台上的高效 LLM 服务提供了系统级支持。

papers.title: SinkRouter: Sink-Aware Routing for Efficient Long-Context Decoding in Large Language and Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: We show that the attention sink phenomenon corresponds to a stable, reachable, and error-controllable fixed point constructed during training. Based on this insight, we propose SinkRouter, a training-free selective routing framework that detects the sink signal and skips computations that would otherwise produce near-zero output.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们展示了注意力汇现象对应于在训练过程中构建的一个稳定、可到达且可控误差的固定点。基于这一见解，我们提出了 SinkRouter，一种无需训练的选择性路由框架，它可以检测汇信号并跳过本来会产生接近零输出的计算。
papers.ai_summary_en: SinkRouter addresses inefficient long-context decoding in large language and multimodal models caused by redundant attention computation around attention sinks. It interprets the attention sink as a stable, reachable, error-controllable fixed point learned during training, and uses this insight to perform training-free selective routing that detects sink signals and skips computations yielding near-zero outputs. The result is a more efficient decoding framework that reduces unnecessary attention work while preserving model behavior.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文解码中由注意力“sink”现象导致的冗余计算问题，提出一种面向大语言和多模态模型的高效推理路由方法。其核心洞见是：attention sink 可视为训练形成的稳定、可达且误差可控的不动点，因此可用免训练的 SinkRouter 检测 sink 信号，并选择性跳过会产生近零输出的计算。该方法在保持模型效果的同时降低长上下文解码开销，为高效推理提供了新的路由优化思路。

papers.title: HieraSparse: Hierarchical Semi-Structured Sparse KV Attention
papers.abstract_en: We introduce HieraSparse, a hierarchical KV Cache compression framework with acceleration kernels that leverage GPU sparse tensor cores to speed up attention computation with semi-structured sparse patterns.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们介绍 HieraSparse，这是一种分层 KV 缓存压缩框架，配备加速内核，利用 GPU 稀疏张量核心加速具有半结构化稀疏模式的注意力计算。
papers.ai_summary_en: HieraSparse addresses the KV-cache memory and compute bottleneck in LLM attention by compressing key-value states while exploiting hardware-accelerated sparsity. Its key contribution is a hierarchical KV-cache compression framework paired with GPU kernels that use sparse tensor cores to execute semi-structured sparse attention patterns efficiently. The approach reduces KV-cache overhead and accelerates attention computation, enabling more efficient long-context or high-throughput inference.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文大模型中 KV Cache 显存占用高、注意力计算开销大的问题。提出 HieraSparse，一种分层半结构化稀疏 KV 压缩框架，并设计可充分利用 GPU 稀疏张量核心的加速 kernel。其主要贡献在于将稀疏注意力模式与硬件稀疏加速结合，从而提升注意力计算效率并降低显存压力。

papers.title: KAIROS: Stateful, Context-Aware Power-Efficient Agentic Inference Serving
papers.abstract_en: We propose KAIROS, a stateful, context-aware power-efficient agentic inference serving system that manages LLM inference for agentic workflows with awareness of multi-turn context and power constraints.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们提出了KAIROS，一个有状态的、上下文感知的节能型智能推理服务系统，它在多轮上下文和能耗约束的感知下管理Agentic工作流的LLM推理。
papers.ai_summary_en: KAIROS addresses power-constrained serving of LLM-based agentic workflows, where multi-turn interactions and tool-use dependencies make stateless inference inefficient and context-unaware. It proposes a stateful, context-aware inference scheduler that tracks agentic execution state and adapts serving decisions to both conversational context and power constraints. The expected impact is more energy-efficient agentic inference while preserving workflow continuity and responsiveness.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向多轮智能体工作流中 LLM 推理服务缺乏状态管理与功耗约束的问题，提出 KAIROS 系统。其核心思路是将有状态的多轮上下文感知与功率受限下的推理调度结合，实现面向智能体任务的高效服务。该设计旨在提升推理服务的上下文连续性和能效，为受限资源下的智能体部署提供系统支撑。

papers.title: POLAR: Online Learning for LoRA Adapter Caching and Routing in Edge LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: We propose POLAR, an online learning framework for LoRA adapter caching and routing in edge LLM serving systems, dynamically managing adapter placement for optimal performance.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们提出了 POLAR，一种用于边缘大型语言模型服务系统中 LoRA 适配器缓存和路由的在线学习框架，能够动态管理适配器的部署以实现最佳性能。
papers.ai_summary_en: POLAR addresses the problem of efficiently serving many LoRA adapters in edge LLM systems, where limited memory and dynamic request patterns make adapter caching and request routing difficult. The paper proposes an online learning framework that jointly decides which LoRA adapters to cache on edge devices and how to route incoming requests to minimize serving overhead. This dynamic adaptation reduces adapter loading latency and improves cache utilization, leading to more efficient edge LLM serving under changing workloads.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘大模型服务中 LoRA 适配器内存受限、请求路由与缓存决策难以适应动态负载的问题。提出 POLAR 在线学习框架，通过动态管理适配器放置、缓存与请求路由来优化边缘 LLM 服务性能。其意义在于为多 LoRA 边缘部署提供自适应调度机制，有望提升服务效率与响应质量。

papers.title: From Agent Loops to Structured Graphs: A Scheduler-Theoretic Framework for LLM Agent Execution
papers.abstract_en: We propose a scheduler-theoretic framework for LLM agent execution, transforming agent loops into structured graphs for more efficient scheduling and execution in LLM inference systems.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个基于调度器理论的框架用于大型语言模型（LLM）代理执行，将代理循环转换为结构化图，以在LLM推理系统中实现更高效的调度和执行。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses inefficiencies in LLM agent serving caused by unstructured, sequential agent loops that limit scheduling opportunities. It proposes a scheduler-theoretic framework that transforms agent loops into structured execution graphs, exposing control dependencies, parallelism, and reusable execution patterns for inference systems. This enables more efficient LLM agent scheduling and execution, with potential improvements in latency, throughput, and system-level resource utilization.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM智能体通常以循环方式执行、难以被推理系统高效调度的问题，提出了一种调度理论框架。其核心洞见是将原本线性的agent loop转化为结构化执行图，从而显式表达依赖关系并支持更优的调度与并行执行。该方法有望提升LLM推理系统中智能体任务的执行效率、吞吐量和资源利用率。

papers.title: Layer-wise MoE Routing Locality under Shared-Prefix Code Generation: Token-Identity Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: We study layer-wise MoE routing locality under shared-prefix code generation, proposing token-identity decomposition to improve MoE inference efficiency.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们在共享前缀代码生成下研究了基于层的MoE路由局部性，提出了令牌身份分解以提高MoE推理效率。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses MoE inference inefficiency in shared-prefix code generation, where common prompt prefixes induce redundant layer-wise expert routing across tokens. It proposes token-identity decomposition, a method that isolates routing behavior by token identity to expose and exploit routing locality across layers. The resulting locality-aware inference reduces redundant expert computation and improves MoE serving efficiency for code-generation workloads.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文聚焦共享前缀代码生成场景下 MoE 模型的逐层路由局部性问题，旨在降低专家选择与调度带来的推理开销。核心方法是提出 token-identity decomposition，以分解 token 身份相关信息的方式刻画并利用各层路由行为。该工作为优化专家缓存和路由调度提供了依据，有助于提升 MoE 推理效率。

papers.title: Sequential KV Cache Compression via Probabilistic Language Tries: Beyond the Per-Vector Shannon Limit
papers.abstract_en: Recent work on KV cache quantization has approached the Shannon entropy limit for per-vector compression. We observe that this limit applies to a strictly weaker problem: compressing the KV cache as a sequence. We propose sequential KV cache compression via probabilistic language tries.
papers.abstract_cn: 最近关于 KV 缓存量化的工作已经接近每向量压缩的香农熵极限。我们观察到，这一极限适用于一个严格较弱的问题：将 KV 缓存作为一个序列进行压缩。我们提出通过概率语言Trie进行顺序 KV 缓存压缩。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses KV cache compression for LLM inference, arguing that existing per-vector quantization methods are bounded by a Shannon limit that ignores statistical dependencies across the cache sequence.
