It proposes sequential KV cache compression using probabilistic language tries, which model and exploit cross-token structure in keys/values to enable entropy coding beyond independent per-vector limits. The main contribution is a reframing of KV cache compression as sequence-level source coding, opening a path to higher compression ratios than per-vector quantization alone.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对KV缓存压缩中“逐向量量化已逼近Shannon熵极限”的瓶颈，指出该极限只适用于把每个KV向量独立压缩的较弱问题。其核心洞见是将KV缓存视为具有序列结构的对象，并提出基于概率语言trie的序列式KV缓存压缩方法。该工作为突破单向量熵限、利用序列先验进一步降低KV缓存开销提供了新的技术路径。

papers.title: DuQuant++: Fine-grained Rotation Enhances Microscaling FP4 Quantization
papers.abstract_en: DuQuant++ enhances microscaling FP4 quantization with fine-grained rotation for more efficient LLM inference through improved low-bit quantization.
papers.abstract_cn: DuQuant 通过细粒度旋转增强微缩 FP4 量化，通过改进的低比特量化实现更高效的 LLM 推理。
papers.ai_summary_en: DuQuant++ addresses the accuracy degradation of large language models under aggressive microscaling FP4 quantization, where activation and weight outliers make ultra-low-bit inference difficult. Its key method is a fine-grained rotation scheme that redistributes outlier magnitudes across dimensions before FP4 microscaling, reducing quantization error while preserving hardware-efficient computation. The reported impact is improved low-bit quantization fidelity and more efficient LLM inference compared with standard microscaling FP4 approaches.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型在微缩放 FP4 极低比特量化中因离群值和有限动态范围导致精度下降的问题。其核心方法是 DuQuant++，通过更细粒度的旋转/变换重塑权重或激活分布，使数值更适合微缩放 FP4 的共享缩放与低比特表示。结果显示，该方法能在保持模型精度的同时提升低比特量化效果，从而实现更高效的大模型推理。

papers.title: Hive: A Multi-Agent Infrastructure for Algorithm- and Task-Level Scaling
papers.authors: Zizhang Luo, Yuhao Luo, Youwei Xiao, Yansong Xu, Runlin Guo, Yun Liang
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed as complex agentic systems that scale with task complexity. While prior work has extensively explored model- and system-level scaling, algorithm- and task-level scaling remain largely unaddressed, constraining the full potential of agentic systems. At the algorithm level, allocating additional inference-time computation can enhance workflow capacity but introduces cross-path redundancy: overlapping computations across multiple reasoning branches. At the task level, complex tasks can be decomposed into subproblems and delegated across multiple agents for improved scalability and parallelism. However, existing infrastructures' scheduling is unaware of the existence of multiple agents, missing opportunities to optimize resource allocation. We propose Hive, a multi-agent infrastructure that enables algorithm- and task-level scaling. Hive features a description frontend that captures per-agent behavior and supports test-time scaling algorithms. Leveraging this specification, our backend introduces two key mechanisms: Logits Cache that reuses intermediate logits across redundant sampling paths to mitigate cross-path redundancy at the algorithm level, and Agent-Aware Scheduling that efficiently allocates compute and KV-cache resources according to agent contributions at the task level. Experiments show that Logits Cache achieves an average speedup of 1.11x-1.76x for re-sampling, and Agent-Aware Scheduling reduces the hotspot miss rate by 33%-51%.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型越来越多地以复杂的智能体系统形式部署，随任务复杂度进行扩展。虽然先前工作已广泛探索了模型级和系统级扩展，但算法级和任务级扩展仍未得到充分关注，限制了智能体系统的全部潜力。在算法层面，分配额外的推理时计算可以增强工作流能力，但会引入跨路径冗余：多个推理分支间的重叠计算。在任务层面，复杂任务可分解为子问题并委托给多个智能体以提高可扩展性和并行性。然而，现有基础设施的调度未能感知多智能体的存在，错失了优化资源分配的机会。我们提出Hive，一个支持算法级和任务级扩展的多智能体基础设施。Hive具有描述前端，捕获每个智能体的行为并支持测试时缩放算法。基于此规范，我们的后端引入两个关键机制：Logits Cache跨冗余采样路径复用中间logits以缓解算法级跨路径冗余，以及Agent-Aware Scheduling根据智能体贡献高效分配计算和KV-cache资源。实验表明Logits Cache实现1.11x-1.76x重采样加速，Agent-Aware Scheduling将热点缺失率降低33%-51%。
papers.ai_summary_en: Hive addresses inference-serving inefficiencies in agentic LLM systems, where algorithm-level test-time scaling creates redundant computation across reasoning branches and task-level multi-agent decomposition is ignored by conventional schedulers. It introduces a per-agent behavior frontend plus a backend with Logits Cache to reuse intermediate logits across overlapping sampling paths and agent-aware scheduling to allocate compute and KV-cache resources based on agent contributions. Experiments show 1.11×–1.76× speedups for re-sampling and a 33%–51% reduction in hotspot miss rate.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对多智能体 LLM 系统在算法级扩展中多推理分支产生重复计算、以及任务级调度缺乏智能体感知导致资源分配低效的问题。  
Hive 提出一种多智能体推理基础设施，通过描述式前端刻画各智能体行为，并在后端引入 Logits Cache 复用中间 logits、以及按智能体贡献分配计算与 KV-cache 的 Agent-Aware Scheduling。  
实验显示，重采样平均加速 1.11–1.76 倍，热点缺失率降低 33%–51%，提升了测试时扩展与多智能体推理调度的效率。

papers.title: NI Sampling: Accelerating Discrete Diffusion Sampling by Token Order Optimization
papers.authors: Enshu Liu, Xuefei Ning, Yu Wang, Zinan Lin
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to traditional autoregressive approaches, offering the flexibility to generate tokens in arbitrary orders and the potential of parallel decoding. However, existing heuristic sampling strategies remain inefficient: they choose only a small part of tokens to sample at each step, leaving substantial room for improvement. In this work, we study the problem of token sampling order optimization and demonstrate its significant potential for acceleration. Specifically, we find that fully leveraging correct predictions at each step can reduce the number of sampling iterations by an order of magnitude without compromising accuracy. Based on this, we propose Neural Indicator Sampling (NI Sampling), a general sampling order optimization framework that utilizes a neural indicator to decide which tokens should be sampled at each step. We further propose a novel trajectory-preserving objective to train the indicator. Experiments on LLaDA and Dream models across multiple benchmarks show that our method achieves up to 14.3x acceleration over full-step sampling with negligible performance drop, and consistently outperforms confidence threshold sampling in the accuracy-step trade-off.
papers.abstract_cn: 离散扩散语言模型(dLLMs)近期作为传统自回归方法的替代方案出现，提供了以任意顺序生成token的灵活性和并行解码的潜力。然而，现有的启发式采样策略效率低下：每步仅选择少量token进行采样，还有很大改进空间。本文研究了token采样顺序优化问题，展示了其显著的加速潜力。具体而言，我们发现充分利用每步的正确预测可将采样迭代次数减少一个数量级而不损害准确性。基于此，我们提出神经指示采样(NI Sampling)，一个通用的采样顺序优化框架，利用神经指示器决定每步应采样哪些token。我们进一步提出轨迹保留目标来训练指示器。在LLaDA和Dream模型上的多个基准实验表明，该方法在全步采样上实现高达14.3x加速，性能下降可忽略，在准确率-步数权衡上持续优于置信度阈值采样。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper tackles inefficient sampling in discrete diffusion language models, where heuristic strategies update only a small subset of tokens per step and thus require many iterations. It proposes NI Sampling, a token-order optimization framework that uses a neural indicator trained with a trajectory-preserving objective to decide which positions to sample at each step, enabling fuller use of correct predictions. Experiments on LLaDA and Dream show up to 14.3× acceleration over full-step sampling with negligible accuracy loss and a better accuracy–step trade-off than confidence-threshold sampling.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对离散扩散语言模型采样效率低的问题，研究如何通过优化每步的 token 采样顺序来加速生成。其核心洞见是充分利用每步中的正确预测可大幅减少迭代次数，并据此提出 NI Sampling：用神经指示器决定每步采样哪些 token，并以轨迹保持目标进行训练。实验在 LLaDA 和 Dream 上显示，该方法最高可实现 14.3 倍加速且性能损失可忽略，在精度-步数权衡上优于置信度阈值采样。

papers.title: Speculative Decoding for Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.authors: Yuezhou Hu, Jintao Zhang
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive video diffusion is emerging as a promising paradigm for streaming video synthesis, with step distillation serving as the primary means of accelerating inference. Whether speculative decoding, the dominant acceleration strategy for large language models, can be effectively adapted to autoregressive video generation remains an open question, because video blocks are continuous spatiotemporal tensors with no token-level distribution for exact rejection sampling. We introduce SDVG, which brings speculative decoding to block-based autoregressive video diffusion by replacing token verification with an image-quality router. A 1.3B drafter proposes candidate blocks via four denoising steps; each block is VAE-decoded and scored by ImageReward using worst-frame aggregation. Blocks scoring above a fixed threshold tau are accepted into the 14B target's KV cache; the rest are regenerated by the target. On 1003 MovieGenVideoBench prompts (832x480), SDVG retains 98.1% of target-only VisionReward quality at a 1.59x speedup, and reaches 2.09x at 95.7% quality retention. The framework is training-free and requires no architectural changes.
papers.abstract_cn: 自回归视频扩散正成为流式视频合成的有前途范式，步蒸馏是加速推理的主要手段。推测解码——大语言模型的主流加速策略——能否有效适配自回归视频生成仍是开放问题，因为视频块是连续时空张量，没有token级分布供精确拒绝采样。我们提出SDVG，通过用图像质量路由器替代token验证，将推测解码引入块级自回归视频扩散。1.3B草稿模型通过四个去噪步骤提出候选块；每个块经VAE解码并用ImageReward评分，采用最差帧聚合。超过阈值tau的块被接受进入14B目标的KV缓存；其余由目标重新生成。在1003个MovieGenVideoBench提示词上，SDVG在1.59x加速下保持98.1%的目标质量，在95.7%质量保持下达到2.09x加速。框架无需训练，无需架构更改。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses accelerating block-based autoregressive video diffusion, where LLM-style speculative decoding is difficult because video blocks are continuous spatiotemporal tensors without token-level distributions for exact rejection sampling. SDVG introduces a training-free speculative framework in which a 1.3B drafter proposes candidate blocks via few-step denoising, then an ImageReward-based router with worst-frame aggregation accepts high-quality blocks into the 14B target model’s KV cache or rejects them for target regeneration. On MovieGenVideoBench, it retains 98.1% of target-only VisionReward quality at 1.59× speedup and reaches 2.09× with 95.7% quality retention, requiring no architectural changes.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对自回归视频扩散模型难以直接套用大语言模型投机解码的问题，核心挑战是视频块为连续时空张量、缺乏可用于精确拒绝采样的离散 token 分布。  
方法上，SDVG 用小模型快速生成候选视频块，并通过 VAE 解码后用 ImageReward 进行最差帧聚合评分，以质量路由替代 token 验证：高分块直接写入目标模型 KV cache，低分块由大模型重生成。  
在 MovieGenVideoBench 上，该免训练、免架构改造方案可在保持 98.1% 目标模型质量时实现 1.59× 加速，放宽至 95.7% 质量时可达 2.09×。

papers.title: Reducing Peak Memory Usage for Modern Multimodal Large Language Model Pipelines
papers.authors: Junwan Kim, Hyunkyung Bae
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have recently demonstrated strong capabilities in understanding and generating responses from diverse visual inputs, including high-resolution images and long video sequences. As these models scale to richer visual representations, inference increasingly relies on storing large numbers of vision tokens in the key-value (KV) cache, making memory consumption a central bottleneck. Existing methods address this issue by identifying redundancy in vision tokens and compressing the cache, but such compression is typically applied only after all inputs are processed, resulting in high peak memory usage during the prefill stage. In this work, we show that MLLMs exhibit inherent structural regularities and representational redundancy that can be exploited to control memory growth throughout inference. Based on this insight, we propose a sequential input-compression mechanism that enforces a fixed memory budget by performing structure-aware key-value cache compression during the prefill process. This approach substantially reduces peak memory usage while maintaining generative performance with only minimal degradation, enabling more practical and memory-efficient multimodal inference.
papers.abstract_cn: 多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)近期在理解多样视觉输入（包括高分辨率图像和长视频序列）并生成响应方面展示了强大能力。随着模型扩展到更丰富的视觉表示，推理越来越依赖于在键值(KV)缓存中存储大量视觉token，使内存消耗成为核心瓶颈。现有方法通过识别视觉token中的冗余并压缩缓存来解决此问题，但这种压缩通常仅在所有输入处理完后才应用，导致prefill阶段峰值内存使用量高。本文表明MLLMs具有内在的结构规律性和表示冗余，可被利用来控制推理过程中的内存增长。基于此洞察，我们提出顺序输入压缩机制，在prefill过程中执行结构感知的键值缓存压缩来强制固定内存预算。该方法大幅降低峰值内存使用，同时仅以最小性能退化维持生成性能，实现更实用和内存高效的多模态推理。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses the peak-memory bottleneck in multimodal LLM inference, where large numbers of vision tokens cause excessive KV-cache growth during prefill, especially for high-resolution images and long videos. It proposes a sequential, structure-aware KV-cache compression mechanism that enforces a fixed memory budget by compressing cache entries during prefill, exploiting inherent structural regularities and redundancy in multimodal representations. The method substantially lowers peak memory usage while preserving generation quality with minimal degradation, enabling more practical memory-efficient MLLM deployment.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态大模型在预填充阶段因大量视觉 token 写入 KV 缓存而导致峰值内存过高的问题。作者利用视觉 token 的结构性冗余，提出在预填充过程中按固定内存预算进行结构感知的顺序式 KV 缓存压缩，而非等全部输入处理后再压缩。结果表明，该方法可显著降低峰值内存占用，同时仅造成很小的生成性能损失，提高了多模态推理的内存效率。

papers.title: DASH-KV: Accelerating Long-Context LLM Inference via Asymmetric KV Cache Hashing
papers.authors: Jinyu Guo, Zhihan Zhang, Yutong Li, Jiehui Xie, Md. Tamim Iqbal, Dongshen Han, Lik-Hang Lee, Sung-Ho Bae, Jie Zou, Yang Yang, Chaoning Zhang
papers.abstract_en: The quadratic computational complexity of the standard attention mechanism constitutes a fundamental bottleneck for large language models in long-context scenarios. While KV cache compression methods alleviate memory pressure, they often sacrifice generation quality and fail to address the high overhead of floating-point arithmetic. This paper introduces DASH-KV, a system-aware asymmetric KV cache hashing framework that leverages the inherent anisotropy in token-level KV cache importance to accelerate inference while preserving generation quality. DASH-KV achieves substantial speedups across diverse long-context benchmarks while maintaining high accuracy.
papers.abstract_cn: 标准注意力机制的二次计算复杂度是长上下文场景下大语言模型的基本瓶颈。虽然KV缓存压缩方法减轻了内存压力，但往往会牺牲生成质量，并且无法解决浮点运算的高开销问题。本文提出DASH-KV，一种系统感知的非对称KV缓存哈希框架，利用token级KV缓存重要性的固有非对称性来加速推理，同时保持生成质量。DASH-KV在各种长上下文基准上实现了显著加速，同时保持高精度。
papers.ai_summary_en: DASH-KV targets the quadratic attention bottleneck and KV-cache memory/compute overhead in long-context LLM inference, where existing compression methods often degrade generation quality. It introduces a system-aware asymmetric KV-cache hashing framework that exploits anisotropic token-level importance to compress and manage keys/values more efficiently while preserving salient context. Experiments on diverse long-context benchmarks show substantial inference speedups with little accuracy loss.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 推理中注意力计算复杂度高、现有 KV cache 压缩易损失生成质量且难以降低浮点运算开销的问题展开研究。其核心方法是提出 DASH-KV，一个系统感知的非对称 KV cache 哈希框架，利用 token 级 KV 重要性的各向异性，对 Key 和 Value 采用差异化哈希与保留策略，从而在压缩缓存的同时保持生成质量。实验显示，该方法在多个长上下文基准上实现显著推理加速，并仍能保持较高准确率。

papers.title: SAW-INT4: System-Aware 4-Bit KV-Cache Quantization for Real-World LLM Serving
papers.authors: Jinda Jia, Jisen Li, Zhongzhu Zhou, Jung Hwan Heo, Jue Wang, Tri Dao, Shuaiwen Leon Song, Ben Athiwaratkun, Chenfeng Xu, Tianyi Zhang, Xiaoxia Wu
papers.abstract_en: KV-cache memory is a major bottleneck in real-world LLM serving, where systems must simultaneously support latency-sensitive small-batch requests and high-throughput concurrent workloads. Although many KV-cache compression methods improve offline accuracy or compression ratio, they often violate practical serving constraints such as paged memory layouts, regular memory access, and fused attention kernels. SAW-INT4 proposes system-aware 4-bit KV-cache quantization designed for real-world serving constraints, achieving efficient compression while maintaining serving compatibility.
papers.abstract_cn: KV缓存内存是真实世界LLM服务中的主要瓶颈，系统必须同时支持延迟敏感的小批量请求和高吞吐量的并发工作负载。虽然许多KV缓存压缩方法改善了离线精度或压缩比率，但它们往往违反实际服务约束，如分页内存布局、常规内存访问和融合注意力内核。SAW-INT4提出系统感知的4位KV缓存量化，专为真实世界服务约束设计，实现高效压缩同时保持服务兼容性。
papers.ai_summary_en: SAW-INT4 addresses the KV-cache memory bottleneck in real-world LLM serving, where systems must handle both latency-sensitive small batches and high-throughput concurrent workloads. It proposes a system-aware 4-bit KV-cache quantization method designed to remain compatible with practical serving constraints such as paged memory layouts, regular memory access patterns, and fused attention kernels. The key impact is achieving efficient KV-cache compression while preserving serving-system efficiency and deployability, unlike methods optimized only for offline accuracy or compression ratio.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对真实LLM服务中KV-Cache内存瓶颈问题，尤其关注延迟敏感小批量请求与高吞吐并发负载并存、且现有压缩方法难以兼容分页内存、规则访问和融合注意力内核等系统约束。其核心方法是提出系统感知的SAW-INT4 4-bit KV-Cache量化方案，在量化压缩设计中直接考虑实际服务栈的内存布局与算子执行约束。主要结果是在保持服务兼容性的同时实现高效KV-Cache压缩，为生产级LLM推理提供了更可部署的内存优化路径。

papers.title: Efficient Mixture-of-Experts LLM Inference with Apple Silicon NPUs
papers.authors: Afsara Benazir, Felix Xiaozhu Lin
papers.abstract_en: Apple Neural Engine (ANE) is a dedicated neural processing unit (NPU) present in every Apple Silicon chip. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs improve inference efficiency by activating only a sparse subset of experts per token. This paper presents an approach for efficient MoE LLM inference on Apple Silicon NPUs, leveraging the ANE architecture for optimal expert dispatch and execution.
papers.abstract_cn: Apple Neural Engine (ANE)是每颗Apple Silicon芯片中内置的专用神经处理单元(NPU)。混合专家(MoE)大语言模型通过每个token仅激活少量专家来提高推理效率。本文提出在Apple Silicon NPU上实现高效MoE LLM推理的方法，利用ANE架构实现最优专家调度和执行。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses efficient inference for Mixture-of-Experts LLMs on Apple Silicon NPUs, targeting the scheduling and execution overhead of sparse expert activation on the Apple Neural Engine. It proposes an ANE-aware MoE inference approach that optimizes expert dispatch and on-device execution to better match the NPU’s architecture. The result is improved MoE LLM inference efficiency on Apple devices, enabling more practical on-device serving of sparse large language models.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向 Apple Silicon NPU（ANE）上 MoE 大模型推理效率问题，重点解决稀疏专家选择、分发与执行在专用硬件上的适配难题。其核心思路是利用 ANE 架构特性设计优化的专家调度与执行流程，使仅被激活的专家能够高效运行。该方案提升了 MoE LLM 在 Apple 设备上的本地推理可行性与效率，为端侧稀疏大模型部署提供了硬件协同优化路径。

papers.title: Neural Garbage Collection: Learning to Forget while Learning to Reason
papers.authors: Michael Y. Li, Jubayer Ibn Hamid, Emily B. Fox
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought reasoning has driven striking advances in language model capability, yet every reasoning step grows the KV cache, creating a bottleneck. Neural Garbage Collection learns to forget intermediate reasoning states while preserving important ones, reducing KV cache memory pressure during inference. It applies ideas from garbage collection in programming languages to neural network context management.
papers.abstract_cn: 链式思维推理推动了语言模型能力的显著进步，但每个推理步骤都会增长KV缓存，造成瓶颈。神经垃圾回收学会了遗忘中间推理状态同时保留重要状态，减少推理期间的KV缓存内存压力。它将编程语言中的垃圾回收思想应用于神经网络上下文管理。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses KV-cache growth in chain-of-thought reasoning, where storing every intermediate step creates inference-time memory pressure. It proposes Neural Garbage Collection, a context-management method inspired by programming-language garbage collection that learns to discard nonessential intermediate reasoning states while preserving salient ones. The main impact is reduced KV-cache memory usage during inference without abandoning the benefits of explicit multi-step reasoning.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对链式思维推理中 KV 缓存随推理步数不断增长、导致推理内存瓶颈的问题。其核心思路是借鉴编程语言中的垃圾回收机制，让模型在学习推理的同时学习遗忘，选择性丢弃无用的中间推理状态并保留关键上下文。该方法可降低推理阶段的 KV 缓存内存压力，提升长链推理和大模型上下文管理的可扩展性。

papers.title: Unlocking the Edge Deployment and On-Device Acceleration of Multi-LoRA Enabled One-for-All Foundational LLM
papers.authors: Sravanth Kodavanti, Sowmya Vajrala, Srinivas Miriyala
papers.abstract_en: Deploying large language models (LLMs) on smartphones poses significant engineering challenges due to stringent constraints on memory, latency, and runtime. This paper explores edge deployment and on-device acceleration of multi-LoRA enabled foundational LLMs, proposing techniques for efficient multi-LoRA serving on resource-constrained edge devices.
papers.abstract_cn: 由于内存、延迟和运行时间的严格约束，在智能手机上部署大语言模型面临重大工程挑战。本文探索多LoRA启用的基础LLM的边缘部署和设备端加速，提出在资源受限的边缘设备上实现高效多LoRA服务的技术。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of serving large language models on smartphones under strict memory, latency, and runtime constraints, particularly when supporting multiple LoRA adapters for personalized or multi-task inference. Its key idea is to enable a single shared foundational LLM on the edge while efficiently managing, switching, and accelerating multiple LoRA modules to avoid duplicating full model weights. The proposed approach targets practical on-device multi-LoRA serving, reducing deployment overhead and enabling more flexible, low-resource edge LLM acceleration.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对智能手机等边缘设备在内存、延迟和运行时资源受限条件下部署基础大模型并支持多 LoRA 适配器的难题，研究“一个基础 LLM + 多个 LoRA”的边缘服务与设备端加速方案。其核心思路是通过高效的多 LoRA 服务机制和端侧加速技术，在共享基础模型的同时支持多任务或个性化适配。该工作有助于降低边缘 LLM 部署成本，提高移动端多适配器服务的可行性与响应效率。

papers.title: GRASPrune: Global Gating for Budgeted Structured Pruning of Large Language Models
papers.authors: Ziyang Wang, Jiangfeng Xiao, Chuan Xiao, Ruoxiang Li, Rui Mao, Jianbin Qin
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are expensive to serve because model parameters, attention computation, and KV caches impose substantial memory and latency costs. GRASPrune presents a structured pruning framework applied after pretraining that jointly prunes FFN channels and KV head groups under a single global budget. Instead of learning importance scores separately, it uses global gating to determine pruning decisions across the entire model.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型服务成本高昂，因为模型参数、注意力计算和KV缓存带来巨大的内存和延迟开销。GRASPrune提出一种后预训练结构化剪枝框架，在单一全局预算下联合剪枝FFN通道和KV头组。它不是分别学习重要性分数，而是使用全局门控来确定整个模型的剪枝决策。
papers.ai_summary_en: GRASPrune targets the high serving cost of LLMs by reducing parameter memory, attention computation, and KV-cache overhead through structured pruning. It introduces a post-pretraining framework that jointly prunes FFN channels and KV head groups under a single global budget using model-wide gating rather than separate layer- or component-wise importance scores. This enables globally budget-aware compression that better balances efficiency and model quality than independently pruning different structures.
papers.ai_summary_cn: GRASPrune 面向大语言模型推理服务中参数、注意力计算和 KV cache 带来的高内存与高延迟问题。其核心是在预训练后采用结构化剪枝框架，通过全局门控在统一预算下联合剪枝 FFN 通道和 KV head 组，而非分别估计各模块的重要性。该方法有助于实现更一致的模型压缩，从而降低 LLM 部署成本并提升推理效率。

papers.title: SimDiff: Depth Pruning via Similarity and Difference
papers.authors: Yuli Chen, Shuhao Zhang, Fanshen Meng, Bo Cheng, Jiale Han
papers.abstract_en: Depth pruning removes entire layers of LLMs to reduce inference cost. SimDiff proposes a novel depth pruning approach via similarity and difference analysis between adjacent layers, enabling more effective layer removal while preserving model quality. It jointly considers both similarity and difference to determine which layers can be safely removed.
papers.abstract_cn: 深度剪枝移除LLM的整层以降低推理成本。SimDiff通过相邻层之间的相似性和差异性分析提出一种新颖的深度剪枝方法，实现更有效的层移除同时保持模型质量。它联合考虑相似性和差异性来确定哪些层可以安全移除。
papers.ai_summary_en: SimDiff addresses depth pruning in large language models, where removing redundant layers reduces inference cost while preserving performance. The method scores layer removability by jointly analyzing similarity and difference between adjacent layer representations, identifying layers whose elimination minimally alters model behavior. This enables more effective layer removal than similarity-only criteria, improving the efficiency–quality trade-off for compressed LLM serving.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对大模型深度剪枝中如何删除整层以降低推理成本、同时尽量保持模型质量的问题。其核心洞见是结合相邻层之间的相似性与差异性来判断层冗余度，从而更安全地选择可移除层。该方法能在更有效压缩模型深度的同时，提升剪枝后模型质量的保持能力。

papers.title: HiveMind: OS-Inspired Scheduling for Concurrent LLM Agent Workloads
papers.authors: Justice Owusu Agyemang, Jerry John Kponyo, Obed Kwasi Somuah, Elliot Amponsah, Godfred Manu Addo Boakye, Kwame Opuni-Boachie Obour Agyekum
papers.abstract_en: When multiple LLM coding agents share a rate-limited API endpoint, they exhibit resource contention patterns analogous to unscheduled OS processes competing for CPU, memory, and I/O. HiveMind proposes OS-inspired scheduling for concurrent LLM agent workloads, reducing failure rates from 27% to near-zero by applying process scheduling concepts to LLM agent orchestration.
papers.abstract_cn: 当多个LLM编程代理共享速率受限的API端点时，它们表现出类似于未调度操作系统进程争用CPU、内存和I/O的资源争用模式。HiveMind提出操作系统启发的并发LLM代理工作负载调度，通过将进程调度概念应用于LLM代理编排，将失败率从27%降低到接近零。
papers.ai_summary_en: HiveMind addresses resource contention and rate-limit failures that arise when multiple concurrent LLM coding agents share a single API endpoint, drawing an analogy to unscheduled OS processes competing for CPU, memory, and I/O. It proposes an OS-inspired scheduling layer for agent orchestration that treats agent workloads as schedulable processes and coordinates API access using scheduling and admission-control principles. The approach reduces failure rates from 27% to near-zero, substantially improving the reliability of concurrent LLM serving workloads.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多个 LLM 编码代理共享限流 API 时产生的资源竞争与高失败率问题，将其类比为操作系统中无调度进程对 CPU、内存和 I/O 的争用。核心方法是借鉴 OS 进程调度思想，对并发 LLM agent 工作负载进行统一编排与调度。实验表明，该方案可将失败率从 27% 降至接近零，提升并发代理服务的稳定性。

papers.title: ReaLB: Real-Time Load Balancing for Multimodal MoE Inference
papers.authors: Yingping Wang, Yi Wu, Xiangyu Wu
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures are widely used in modern large language models and multimodal models. However, inference efficiency is often limited by load imbalance across experts. ReaLB proposes real-time load balancing for multimodal MoE inference, dynamically adjusting expert allocation to optimize throughput and reduce latency.
papers.abstract_cn: 混合专家(MoE)架构广泛用于现代大语言模型和多模态模型。然而，推理效率常常受限于专家间的负载不平衡。ReaLB提出多模态MoE推理的实时负载均衡，动态调整专家分配以优化吞吐量并降低延迟。
papers.ai_summary_en: ReaLB addresses the expert load-imbalance problem in multimodal Mixture-of-Experts inference, which causes underutilized experts, reduced throughput, and increased latency. It proposes a real-time load-balancing mechanism that dynamically adjusts expert allocation based on runtime demand to better match computation with available capacity. The approach improves inference efficiency by increasing throughput and lowering latency for multimodal MoE workloads.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态 MoE 推理中专家负载不均导致吞吐受限、延迟升高的问题展开研究。其核心方法是 ReaLB，一种实时负载均衡机制，可在推理过程中动态调整专家分配以适配负载变化。主要效果是提升推理吞吐并降低延迟，为多模态 MoE 模型的高效部署提供了优化路径。

papers.title: FluxMoE: Decoupling Expert Residency for High-Performance MoE Serving
papers.authors: Qingxiu Liu, Cyril Y. He, Hanser Jiang
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become a dominant paradigm for scaling large language models, but their rapidly growing parameter sizes introduce severe challenges for efficient serving. FluxMoE decouples expert residency for high-performance MoE serving, enabling flexible expert management that adapts to workload dynamics.
papers.abstract_cn: 混合专家(MoE)模型已成为扩展大语言模型的主导范式，但其快速增长参数量给高效服务带来了严峻挑战。FluxMoE通过解耦专家驻留实现高性能MoE服务，使灵活的专家管理能够适应工作负载动态变化。
papers.ai_summary_en: FluxMoE addresses the serving bottleneck in large Mixture-of-Experts models, where fixed expert residency strategies struggle to balance memory capacity, bandwidth, and dynamic token-routing demand. Its key idea is to decouple expert residency from static model placement, enabling flexible expert loading, caching, and scheduling that adapts to runtime workload patterns. This improves MoE serving efficiency and scalability, particularly for rapidly growing parameter-scale models.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大规模 MoE 模型推理服务中专家参数量巨大、固定驻留策略难以适应动态负载的问题。其核心方法是提出 FluxMoE，将专家驻留与推理服务解耦，实现按需加载、迁移和管理专家，以适配工作负载变化。该设计提升了 MoE 服务的性能与资源利用效率，为大规模 MoE 模型的高效部署提供了更灵活的方案。

papers.title: HadAgent: Harness-Aware Decentralized Agentic AI Serving with Proof-of-Inference Blockchain Consensus
papers.authors: Landy Jimenez, Mariah Weatherspoon, Bingyu Shen, Yi Sheng, Jianming Liu, Boyang Li
papers.abstract_en: Proof-of-Work blockchain consensus consumes vast computational resources without producing useful output, while the rapid growth of large language model (LLM) agents has created unprecedented demand for GPU computation. HadAgent presents harness-aware decentralized agentic AI serving with proof-of-inference blockchain consensus, combining LLM agent serving with blockchain verification.
papers.abstract_cn: 工作量证明区块链共识消耗大量计算资源却不产生有用输出，而大语言模型代理的快速增长创造了前所未有的GPU计算需求。HadAgent提出具有推理证明区块链共识的Harness感知去中心化代理AI服务，将LLM代理服务与区块链验证相结合。
papers.ai_summary_en: HadAgent addresses the mismatch between energy-intensive Proof-of-Work blockchain consensus and the growing demand for GPU resources in decentralized LLM agent serving. Its key idea is a harness-aware agentic serving system that replaces useless mining with a proof-of-inference consensus mechanism, where block production is tied to verifiable LLM inference work. This transforms blockchain consensus into useful AI computation, enabling decentralized agent serving with cryptographic verification and more efficient use of GPU resources.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对PoW区块链浪费算力、而LLM智能体服务面临高GPU需求与可信验证难题的问题，提出HadAgent，将去中心化智能体推理服务与“推理证明”区块链共识结合。其核心洞见是把LLM推理转化为有用的共识工作，并通过harness-aware机制感知任务/评测约束，使算力贡献可验证、激励相容。该方案有望提升GPU利用效率，为去中心化LLM智能体服务提供可信、可扩展的支撑。

papers.title: CASK: Core-Aware Selective KV Compression for Reasoning Traces
papers.authors: Buseong Kim, Heejun Gwon
papers.abstract_en: In large language models performing long-form reasoning, the KV cache grows rapidly with decode length, creating bottlenecks in memory and inference speed. CASK proposes core-aware selective KV compression for reasoning traces, identifying and preserving core reasoning tokens while compressing auxiliary ones.
papers.abstract_cn: 在执行长形式推理的大语言模型中，KV缓存随解码长度快速增长，造成内存和推理速度瓶颈。CASK提出推理轨迹的核心感知选择性KV压缩，识别并保留核心推理token同时压缩辅助token。
papers.ai_summary_en: CASK addresses the KV-cache memory and inference-latency bottleneck in long-form reasoning LLMs, where cache size grows rapidly with decoding length. Its key idea is core-aware selective KV compression: it identifies and preserves KV states for core reasoning tokens while compressing auxiliary tokens in the reasoning trace. This reduces cache footprint and speeds up generation while aiming to maintain reasoning quality.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长文本推理中 KV 缓存随解码长度快速膨胀、导致显存占用和推理延迟升高的瓶颈问题。其核心方法是提出 CASK，通过识别推理轨迹中的“核心推理 token”并选择性保留其 KV，同时压缩辅助性 token 的缓存。该思路强调推理链中 token 重要性不均，有望在保持推理质量的同时降低 KV 缓存开销并提升长序列推理效率。

papers.title: Transactional Attention: Semantic Sponsorship for KV-Cache Retention
papers.authors: Abhinaba Basu
papers.abstract_en: At K=16 tokens (0.4% of a 4K context), every existing KV-cache compression method achieves 0% on credential retrieval. The failure mode is dormant token eviction. Transactional Attention proposes semantic sponsorship for KV-cache retention, preventing critical tokens from being evicted during compression.
papers.abstract_cn: 在K=16个token（4K上下文的0.4%）时，每种现有的KV缓存压缩方法在凭证检索上的准确率为0%。失败模式是休眠token被驱逐。Transactional Attention提出KV缓存保留的语义赞助，防止关键token在压缩期间被驱逐。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper targets the failure of existing KV-cache compression methods to retain rare but essential “dormant” tokens, causing 0% credential retrieval when only 16 out of 4K context tokens are preserved. It proposes Transactional Attention, which uses semantic sponsorship to explicitly protect critical tokens from eviction during cache compression. The main contribution is a retention mechanism that prevents loss of low-attention but high-semantic-value KV entries, improving reliability of compressed long-context inference.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对现有 KV 缓存压缩在极低保留预算下（如 4K 上下文仅保留 16 个 token）无法完成凭证检索的问题，指出其根源是关键但短期不活跃的“休眠 token”被误驱逐。论文提出 Transactional Attention，通过“语义赞助”为关键 KV 项提供保留担保，使缓存压缩不再仅依赖局部注意力显著性。该机制可在超低缓存预算下保护长上下文中的关键信息，提高精确召回类任务的可靠性。

papers.title: MEMENTO: Teaching LLMs to Manage Their Own Context
papers.authors: Vasilis Kontonis, Yuchen Zeng, Shivam Garg
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning models think in long, unstructured streams with no mechanism for compressing or organizing their own intermediate state. MEMENTO introduces a framework for teaching LLMs to manage their own context during inference, reducing KV cache growth by enabling models to self-organize and compress their reasoning traces.
papers.abstract_cn: 推理模型以长而无结构的方式思考，没有压缩或组织自己中间状态的机制。MEMENTO引入一个框架，教导LLM在推理期间管理自己的上下文，通过使模型自组织和压缩推理轨迹来减少KV缓存增长。
papers.ai_summary_en: MEMENTO addresses KV cache growth in long-horizon reasoning LLMs, where unstructured intermediate thoughts accumulate without compression or explicit context management. The method teaches models to self-organize and compress their own reasoning traces during inference, effectively letting the model manage its internal context rather than retaining all tokens in the cache. This reduces KV cache expansion and improves inference efficiency for reasoning-heavy workloads.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对推理型大模型在长链思考中产生无结构、不可压缩的中间状态，从而导致 KV Cache 持续膨胀的问题。MEMENTO 提出让模型在推理过程中自主学习管理和组织上下文，通过自组织与压缩推理轨迹来控制缓存增长。其主要影响是为长推理场景提供了一种降低 KV Cache 开销、提升推理可扩展性的上下文管理思路。

papers.title: ARGUS: Agentic GPU Optimization Guided by Data-Flow Invariants
papers.authors: Haohui Mai, Xiaoyan Guo, Xiangyun Ding, Daifeng Li, Qiuchu Yu, Chenzhun Guo, Cong Wang, Jiacheng Zhao, Christos Kozyrakis, Binhang Yuan
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based coding agents can generate functionally correct GPU kernels, yet their performance remains far below hand-optimized libraries on critical computations such as matrix multiplication, attention, and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE). Peak GPU performance requires coordinated reasoning over tightly coupled optimizations, including tiling, shared-memory staging, software pipelining, and instruction scheduling, while existing agents rely on sparse pass/fail feedback, leaving them unable to diagnose
papers.abstract_cn: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的编码代理可以生成功能正确的 GPU 内核，但它们在关键计算（如矩阵乘法、注意力机制和专家混合（MoE））上的性能仍远低于手工优化的库。实现 GPU 的峰值性能需要对紧密耦合的优化进行协调推理，包括分块（tiling）、共享内存暂存、软件流水线和指令调度，而现有的代理依赖稀疏的通过/失败反馈，无法进行诊断
papers.ai_summary_en: ARGUS addresses the performance gap between LLM-generated GPU kernels and hand-optimized libraries for serving-critical primitives such as matrix multiplication, attention, and Mixture-of-Experts. Its key method is an agentic kernel-optimization loop guided by data-flow invariants, which provide dense diagnostic feedback for coordinating tightly coupled optimizations like tiling, shared-memory staging, software pipelining, and instruction scheduling. The main impact is shifting LLM coding agents from sparse pass/fail kernel search toward invariant-driven performance debugging, enabling more effective optimization of high-performance LLM kernels.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM 编码代理生成 GPU kernel 时性能远低于手工优化库的问题，聚焦矩阵乘、注意力和 MoE 等关键算子中难以协同优化 tiling、共享内存、软件流水与指令调度的瓶颈。其核心方法是提出 ARGUS，用数据流不变量引导代理进行密集、可诊断的性能反馈与优化搜索，而非仅依赖稀疏的通过/失败信号。结果表明，该机制有助于代理定位性能问题并改进 kernel，从而缩小自动生成 kernel 与高性能手写库之间的差距。

papers.title: B-PASTE: Beam-Aware Pattern-Guided Speculative Execution for Resource-Constrained LLM Agents
papers.authors: Yanfei Song
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents execute in an interleaved reasoning-and-action loop, where future tool calls cannot be launched until the current reasoning step completes. This serial dependency inflates end-to-end latency and leaves the model idle while waiting for tool execution. Prior work, Pattern-Aware Speculative Tool Execution (PASTE), mitigates this bottleneck by speculating likely future tool invocations from mined control-flow and data-flow regularities. However, PASTE is tool-centric and speculates only i
papers.abstract_cn: LLM 代理在交错的推理与操作循环中执行，其中在当前推理步骤完成之前，无法启动后续的工具调用。这种串行依赖增加了端到端的延迟，并使模型在等待工具执行时处于空闲状态。先前的工作——模式感知的预测性工具执行（PASTE）——通过从挖掘到的控制流和数据流规律中预测可能的未来工具调用来缓解这一瓶颈。然而，PASTE 以工具为中心，仅预测
papers.ai_summary_en: B-PASTE addresses the latency bottleneck in LLM agents caused by serial dependencies between reasoning steps and tool calls, which leave serving resources idle while awaiting tool execution. It extends pattern-guided speculative tool execution with beam-aware prediction and scheduling, using mined control-flow and data-flow regularities to speculate likely future tool invocations across candidate generation paths under resource constraints. The approach improves end-to-end agent latency and serving efficiency while reducing the wasted computation and memory overhead of naive speculation.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM 智能体在“推理—行动”循环中因工具调用串行依赖导致端到端延迟高、模型等待工具执行时资源闲置的问题。其核心方法 B-PASTE 在 PASTE 的控制流/数据流模式挖掘基础上引入 beam-aware 的投机执行机制，使系统能在资源受限条件下更早、更准确地预测并并行预执行高置信度的未来工具调用。该工作有助于降低智能体服务延迟、减少空闲等待，并提升受限资源环境中的整体执行效率。

papers.title: CoLLM: A Unified Framework for Co-execution of LLMs Federated Fine-tuning and Inference
papers.authors: Shaoyuan Huang, Xiaokai Wang, Na Yan, Xiaofei Wang, Wenyu Wang, Yansha Deng
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted in edge intelligence to power domain-specific applications and personalized services, the quality and efficiency of the LLM post-training phase-including fine-tuning and inference, have become critical due to constrained resources. Although recent advances in federated parameter-efficient fine-tuning (FL PEFT) and low-latency inference have improved individual task performance, fine-tuning and inference are still handled as isolated worklo
papers.abstract_cn: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）在边缘智能中越来越多地被采用，以支持特定领域的应用和个性化服务，由于资源有限，LLM后训练阶段的质量和效率——包括微调和推理——变得至关重要。尽管最近在联邦参数高效微调（FL PEFT）和低延迟推理方面的进展提高了单个任务的性能，微调和推理仍然被视为孤立的工作负载。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the inefficiency of treating LLM fine-tuning and inference as isolated workloads in resource-constrained edge intelligence settings. It proposes CoLLM, a unified framework that co-executes federated parameter-efficient fine-tuning and low-latency inference by jointly orchestrating local adapter updates, model state reuse, and serving resources. This approach improves post-training and inference efficiency, reducing overhead and latency while enabling personalized, domain-specific LLM services on edge devices.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘智能场景中大模型微调与推理常被割裂处理、导致受限资源下效率与服务质量不足的问题，提出统一框架 CoLLM。其核心思路是将联邦参数高效微调与低延迟推理协同执行，使模型个性化更新和在线服务能够共享资源与流程。该工作有助于在边缘环境中同时提升 LLM 后训练效率与推理服务性能。

papers.title: Cloud-native and Distributed Systems for Efficient and Scalable Large Language Models -- A Research Agenda
papers.authors: Minxian Xu, Jingfeng Wu, Shengye Song, Satish Narayana Srirama, Bahman Javad, Rajiv Ranjan, Devki Nandan Jha, Sa Wang, Wenhong Tian, Huanle Xu, Li Li, Zizhao Mo, Shuo Ren, Thomas Kunz, Petar Kochovski, Vlado Stankovski, Kejiang Ye, Chengzhong Xu, Rajkumar Buyya
papers.abstract_en: The rapid rise of Large Language Models (LLMs) has revolutionized various artificial intelligence (AI) applications, from natural language processing to code generation. However, the computational demands of these models, particularly in training and inference, present significant challenges. Traditional systems are often unable to meet these requirements, necessitating the integration of cloud-native and distributed architectures. This paper explores the role of cloud platforms and distributed
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）的快速崛起已经彻底改变了各种人工智能（AI）应用，从自然语言处理到代码生成。然而，这些模型的计算需求，特别是在训练和推理方面，带来了重大挑战。传统系统通常无法满足这些需求，因此需要整合云原生和分布式架构。本文探讨了云平台和分布式
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses the systems bottleneck of efficiently training and serving large language models under extreme compute, memory, and elasticity requirements that conventional monolithic infrastructures cannot satisfy. It proposes a cloud-native, distributed-systems research agenda centered on elastic resource orchestration, fault-tolerant parallel execution, and cost-aware scheduling across heterogeneous cloud environments. The work provides a roadmap of open challenges and design principles for building scalable, efficient LLM platforms, with particular relevance to high-throughput, low-latency LLM serving.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大语言模型在训练与推理中对高算力、高弹性和高可扩展性的需求，指出传统系统难以高效支撑 LLM 服务。其核心思路是提出面向 LLM 的云原生与分布式系统研究议程，强调通过容器化、弹性调度、分布式推理和云资源协同来提升效率与可扩展性。该工作主要为后续系统设计与研究提供路线图，推动低成本、高可用、可扩展的 LLM 云平台发展。

papers.title: CCCL: In-GPU Compression-Coupled Collective Communication
papers.authors: Chon Lam Lao, Zhiying Xu, Zhuang Wang, Ziming Mao, Delong Meng, Jia Zhen, Jun Wu, Ion Stoica, Yida Wang, Yang Zhou
papers.abstract_en: Collective communication incurs significant overhead in LLM workloads. Although overlapping communication with computation in application-level is a common strategy, it often requires substantial code modifications and is impractical for many workloads (e.g., tensor and expert parallelism). We present CCCL, a built-in compression-based collective communication library that supports operations such as allreduce, alltoall, and send/recv without requiring any user-side changes, thereby enabling sea
papers.abstract_cn: 集体通信在大型语言模型（LLM）工作负载中会产生显著的开销。尽管在应用层将通信与计算重叠是一种常见策略，但它通常需要大量代码修改，并且对于许多工作负载（例如张量并行和专家并行）不切实际。我们提出了 CCCL，这是一种内置的基于压缩的集体通信库，支持 allreduce、alltoall 和 send/recv 等操作，而无需任何用户端更改，从而实现了海
papers.ai_summary_en: CCCL addresses the high overhead of collective communication in distributed LLM serving, where application-level compute–communication overlap often requires invasive code changes and is impractical for tensor and expert parallelism. It introduces a built-in GPU collective communication library that couples compression with primitives such as allreduce, alltoall, and send/recv, requiring no user-side modifications. This enables transparent reduction of communication cost and improved serving efficiency for LLM workloads.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM 服务中集合通信开销过高的问题，指出应用层计算-通信重叠往往需要大量代码改造，且在张量并行和专家并行等场景难以适用。其核心方法是提出 CCCL：一个内置于 GPU 的压缩耦合集合通信库，支持 allreduce、alltoall、send/recv 等操作，在不修改用户代码的前提下将压缩与通信流程深度集成。结果表明，该方案能透明地降低通信量与通信延迟，从而提升大模型服务在分布式并行中的吞吐与扩展效率。

papers.title: DeInfer: Efficient Parallel Inferencing for Decomposed Large Language Models
papers.authors: You-Liang Huang, Xinhao Huang, Chengxi Liao, Zeyi Wen
papers.abstract_en: Existing works on large language model (LLM) decomposition mainly focus on improving performance on downstream tasks, but they ignore the poor parallel inference performance when trying to scale up the model size. To mitigate this important performance issue, this paper introduces DeInfer, a high-performance inference system dedicated to parallel inference of decomposed LLMs. It consists of multiple optimizations to maximize performance and be compatible with state-of-the-art optimization techni
papers.abstract_cn: 现有关于大型语言模型（LLM）分解的研究主要集中在提升下游任务的性能，但在尝试扩大模型规模时，它们忽视了并行推理性能低下的问题。为了解决这一重要的性能问题，本文提出了 DeInfer，一种专门用于分解 LLM 并行推理的高性能推理系统。它由多种优化组成，以最大化性能并与最先进的优化技术兼容。
papers.ai_summary_en: DeInfer addresses the poor parallel-inference scalability of decomposed LLMs, where decomposition strategies optimized for downstream accuracy can introduce serving bottlenecks as model size grows. It proposes a high-performance inference system that coordinates decomposed model components with parallel execution, system-level optimizations, and compatibility with existing LLM serving techniques. The main impact is improved throughput, latency, and scalability for serving large decomposed LLMs.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对分解式大语言模型在扩展规模时并行推理效率差的问题，提出了高性能推理系统 DeInfer。其核心思路是面向模型分解后的并行执行引入多项系统优化，并兼容现有先进推理优化技术，以提升整体服务性能。结果表明，该系统能够显著改善分解式 LLM 的并行推理效率，为大规模模型部署提供更可行的系统方案。

papers.title: A 28nm Speculative-Decoding LLM Processor Achieving 105-to-685µs/Token Latency for Billion-Parameter Models
papers.authors: Yang Wang, Huanyu Wang, Jiaxin Yang, Yutong Su, Ruiqi Guo, Zhiheng Yue, Jiangyuan Gu, Shaojun Wei, Yang Hu, Shouyi Yin
papers.abstract_en: LLMs face decoding bottlenecks. Speculative Decoding (SD) reduces latency via a small draft model for serial decoding and a large target model to verify in parallel. Despite this advantage, it still suffers from exponent redundancy, inefficient weights/KV, and hardware underutilization. We propose an SD LLM processor with three innovations: an exponent dual-reuse MAC, draft back-propagation target mixed-precision dataflow, and draft early start parallel compute, achieving $10.29 \times$ speed in
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型面临解码瓶颈。投机解码（SD）通过使用小型草稿模型进行串行解码，并使用大型目标模型进行并行验证，从而降低延迟。尽管具有这一优势，它仍然存在指数冗余、权重/KV 效率低以及硬件利用不足的问题。我们提出了一种具有三项创新的 SD 大型语言模型处理器：指数双重复用 MAC、草稿反向传播目标混合精度数据流，以及草稿提前启动并行计算，实现了 $10.29 	imes$ 的加速。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses the latency and hardware-efficiency bottleneck in LLM decoding, specifically inefficiencies in speculative decoding caused by exponent redundancy, underused weights/KV data, and poor overlap between draft and target computation. It proposes a 28nm speculative-decoding processor using an exponent dual-reuse MAC, a mixed-precision dataflow that back-propagates draft information into target verification, and an early-start parallel compute scheme to better overlap draft and target processing. The design achieves 105–685 µs/token latency for billion-parameter models and reports a 10.29× speed improvement, indicating substantial acceleration for low-latency LLM serving.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型推理中解码延迟高、推测解码存在指数冗余和权重/KV访问低效等问题，提出一种面向LLM服务的28nm专用处理器。其核心方法包括指数双复用MAC、草稿反向传播/目标模型混合精度数据流，以及草稿模型提前启动的并行计算机制，以提升硬件利用率和解码吞吐。实验在十亿参数模型上实现105–685µs/token的低延迟和约10.29倍加速，为低延迟大模型服务提供了硬件优化方案。

papers.title: SwiftSpec: Disaggregated Speculative Decoding and Fused Kernels for Low-Latency LLM Inference
papers.authors: Ziyi Zhang, Ziheng Jiang, Chengquan Jiang, Menghan Yu, Size Zheng, Haibin Lin, Xin Liu, Henry Hoffmann
papers.abstract_en: Low-latency, single-request decoding of large language models is critical for interactive systems with tight SLA demands. Prior work reduces latency through speculative decoding (combining a small draft model with a larger target model), but the draft model remains on the critical path, and communication overhead limits scaling across GPUs due to the small batch size associated with single-request decoding. To address these limitations, this paper introduces SwiftSpec: a system architecture that
papers.abstract_cn: 低延迟、单请求解码大型语言模型对于具有严格服务水平协议要求的交互式系统至关重要。以往的工作通过推测解码（将小型草稿模型与更大型目标模型相结合）来降低延迟，但草稿模型仍在关键路径上，而且由于单请求解码相关的小批量大小，通信开销限制了跨 GPU 的扩展。为了解决这些限制，本文提出了 SwiftSpec：一种系统架构，它
papers.ai_summary_en: SwiftSpec addresses low-latency single-request LLM inference, where speculative decoding is limited by the draft model remaining on the critical path and by GPU communication overhead at small batch sizes. The paper proposes a disaggregated system architecture that decouples draft and target execution and uses fused decoding kernels to reduce kernel-launch, memory, and communication costs. This design improves interactive serving latency and SLA compliance for large-model inference.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文面向交互式 LLM 服务中低延迟单请求解码的问题，指出传统投机解码仍受草稿模型处于关键路径和小批量跨 GPU 通信开销大的限制。SwiftSpec 通过解耦式投机解码架构与融合算子内核，将草稿生成与目标模型验证更高效地并行化，并减少通信和内核启动开销。其主要贡献在于提升单请求场景下的推理延迟与系统可扩展性，使 LLM 服务更能满足严格 SLA 需求。

papers.title: FlexSpec: Frozen Drafts Meet Evolving Targets in Edge-Cloud Collaborative LLM Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Yuchen Li, Rui Kong, Zhonghao Lyu, Qiyang Li, Xinran Chen, Hengyi Cai, Lingyong Yan, Shuaiqiang Wang, Jiashu Zhao, Guangxu Zhu, Linghe Kong, Guihai Chen, Haoyi Xiong, Dawei Yin
papers.abstract_en: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in mobile and edge computing environments is constrained by limited on-device resources, scarce wireless bandwidth, and frequent model evolution. Although edge-cloud collaborative inference with speculative decoding (SD) can reduce end-to-end latency by executing a lightweight draft model at the edge and verifying it with a cloud-side target model, existing frameworks fundamentally rely on tight coupling between the two models. Consequently, repeated model
papers.abstract_cn: 在移动和边缘计算环境中部署大型语言模型（LLM）受到设备上资源有限、无线带宽稀缺以及模型频繁更新的制约。虽然通过推测解码（SD）的边缘-云协同推理可以通过在边缘执行轻量级草稿模型并使用云端目标模型进行验证来减少端到端延迟，但现有框架在根本上依赖于两种模型之间的紧密耦合。因此，重复模型
papers.ai_summary_en: FlexSpec addresses edge-cloud LLM serving where lightweight edge draft models must stay tightly coupled to cloud target models, making frequent target updates costly due to repeated draft adaptation. It proposes a speculative decoding framework that keeps edge drafts frozen while using a drift-tolerant verification or alignment mechanism so evolving cloud targets can still accept edge-generated drafts. This reduces model-update overhead and end-to-end latency under limited bandwidth and device resources while preserving generation quality and acceptance rates.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘-云协同 LLM 推测解码中草稿模型与目标模型强耦合、目标模型更新后需反复重训/适配草稿模型的问题展开研究。其核心思路是“冻结边缘侧草稿模型、允许云端目标模型持续演化”，并通过适配/对齐机制使旧草稿仍能服务于新目标模型。方法可在模型频繁升级场景下降低维护与部署成本，同时保持较高的草稿接受率和低端到端推理延迟。

papers.title: Area- and Utilization-Efficient LLM Accelerator With Fused Speculative Decoding for Edge-Side Inference
papers.authors: Kaiqi Chen, Zikang Zhou, Yaqi Chen, Jun Han

papers.title: SMoLPU: 122.1µJ/Token Sparse MoE-Based Speculative Decoding Language Processing Unit with Adaptive-Offload NPU-CIM Core
papers.authors: Sangwoo Ha, Jingu Lee, Young-Hun Moon, Sunjoo Whang, Wooyoung Jo, Gwangtae Park, Sangjin Kim, Soyeon Um, Junha Ryu, Y. Jo, H.-J. Yoo
papers.abstract_en: SMoLPU is an energy-efficient MoE-based speculative decoding LLM processor with an NPU-CIM core. It has 3 features: 1) Token-adaptive expert refinement removes redundant expert activations and schedules expert load order, achieving $2.3 \times/4.2 \times$ energy efficiency improvement in prefill/decode; 2) An adaptive-offload NPU-CIM core and a top scheduling unit maintain HW utilization under dynamic INT–FP ratios, achieving $3.3 \times$ lower latency; 3) A reconfigurable DRAM-based LUT-CIM red
papers.abstract_cn: SMoLPU 是一种高能效的基于 MoE 的推测解码大型语言模型处理器，具有 NPU-CIM 核心。它有三个特点：1）令牌自适应专家优化通过去除冗余的专家激活并调度专家加载顺序，在预填充/解码阶段实现 $2.3 	imes/4.2 	imes$ 的能效提升；2）自适应卸载 NPU-CIM 核心和顶级调度单元在动态 INT–FP 比率下保持硬件利用率，实现 $3.3 	imes$ 低延迟；3）可重构基于 DRAM 的 LUT-CIM red
papers.ai_summary_en: SMoLPU targets the energy and latency inefficiencies of serving sparse Mixture-of-Experts LLMs with speculative decoding, where redundant expert activations and dynamic integer–floating-point workloads underutilize hardware. It introduces a token-adaptive expert refinement mechanism to prune and schedule expert loads, an adaptive-offload NPU-CIM core with a top scheduling unit to sustain utilization across mixed-precision phases, and a reconfigurable DRAM-based LUT-CIM path. The design achieves 122.1 µJ/token energy, 2.3×/4.2× prefill/decode energy-efficiency gains, and 3.3× lower latency.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文面向 MoE 大模型推理服务中专家激活冗余、投机解码开销和动态精度导致的硬件利用率下降问题，提出了能效型处理器 SMoLPU。其核心方法包括 token 自适应专家精炼以减少无效专家并优化加载顺序、自适应卸载的 NPU-CIM 核心与顶层调度单元以维持 INT–FP 混合计算下的利用率，以及可重构 DRAM LUT-CIM 降低访存开销。实验显示其达到 122.1 µJ/token，在 prefill/decode 阶段能效分别提升 2.3×/4.2×，并将延迟降低 3.3×。

papers.title: HIPPO: Accelerating Video Large Language Models Inference via Holistic-aware Parallel Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Qitan Lv, Tianyu Liu, Wen Wu, Xuenan Xu, Bowen Zhou, Feng Wu, Chao Zhang
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding (SD) has emerged as a promising approach to accelerate LLM inference without sacrificing output quality. Existing SD methods tailored for video-LLMs primarily focus on pruning redundant visual tokens to mitigate the computational burden of massive visual inputs. However, existing methods do not achieve inference acceleration comparable to text-only LLMs. We observe from extensive experiments that this phenomenon mainly stems from two limitations: (i) their pruning strategies
papers.abstract_cn: 推测解码（Speculative Decoding, SD）已成为一种有前景的方法，可以在不牺牲输出质量的情况下加速大型语言模型（LLM）的推理。现有为视频LLM定制的SD方法主要集中在剪枝冗余的视觉标记，以缓解海量视觉输入带来的计算负担。然而，现有方法的推理加速效果仍无法与仅文本的LLM相媲美。我们通过大量实验观察到，这一现象主要源于两个局限性：（i）它们的剪枝策略
papers.ai_summary_en: HIPPO addresses inefficient speculative decoding in video LLMs, where visual-token pruning yields limited speedups because it ignores holistic video context and underutilizes parallel decoding. It introduces holistic-aware parallel speculative decoding, which preserves global visual semantics while enabling parallel draft generation and verification to reduce inference latency. The method substantially accelerates video-LLM serving, approaching text-only LLM speedups, without sacrificing output quality.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对视频大语言模型推理中现有投机解码因视觉 token 剪枝策略局限而加速不足的问题，提出 HIPPO：一种整体感知的并行投机解码方法。其核心洞见是在减少冗余视觉输入的同时，从全局语义和并行验证角度协同优化草稿生成与接受过程，从而提升视频-LLM 的推理效率。实验表明，该方法在不牺牲输出质量的前提下显著加速视频大模型推理，并使其接近纯文本 LLM 的投机解码加速效果。

papers.title: DFVG: A Heterogeneous Architecture for Speculative Decoding with Draft-on-FPGA and Verify-on-GPU
papers.authors: Shaoqiang Lu, Yangbo Wei, Junhong Qian, Dongge Qin, Shiji Gao, Yizhi Ding, Qifan Wang, Chen Wu, Xiao Shi, Lei He
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding is a promising paradigm that accelerates LLM inference by generating drafts and performing verification. However, such systems still face three major challenges: (1) The imbalance in resource requirements between draft and verification models result in low utilization and energy inefficiency when deployed together. (2) Fixed-pattern token trees produce many candidates but few valid paths, resulting in redundant drafts due to the lack of full leverage of the inherent confiden
papers.abstract_cn: 推测解码是一种有前景的范式，通过生成草稿和执行验证来加速大语言模型的推理。然而，这类系统仍然面临三个主要挑战：（1）草稿模型和验证模型在资源需求上的不平衡导致它们一起部署时利用率低且能源效率低下。（2）固定模式的令牌树会产生许多候选项，但有效路径很少，由于未能充分利用固有的置信度，导致草稿冗余。
papers.ai_summary_en: DFVG addresses inefficient LLM speculative decoding caused by mismatched resource demands between draft and verification models and by static token-tree drafting that produces many low-yield candidates. It proposes a heterogeneous FPGA-draft/GPU-verify architecture, using energy-efficient draft generation on FPGA and confidence-aware adaptive drafting to reduce redundant candidates while keeping parallel verification on GPU. The approach improves LLM serving throughput and energy efficiency relative to homogeneous GPU-based speculative decoding systems.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型投机解码中草稿模型与验证模型资源需求不匹配、固定 token tree 造成大量无效候选以及置信度利用不足的问题，提出 DFVG 异构架构，将草稿生成放在 FPGA、验证放在 GPU，以发挥各自能效与并行优势。其核心洞见是通过异构分工和更自适应的草稿生成/筛选，减少冗余候选并提升整体流水线效率。结果表明，该方案可在 LLM 推理服务中提升吞吐与能效，为投机解码提供了更高效的系统级加速路径。

papers.title: 31.1 A 14.08-to-135.69Token/s ReRAM-on-Logic Stacked Outlier-Free Large-Language-Model Accelerator with Block-Clustered Weight-Compression and Adaptive Parallel-Speculative-Decoding
papers.authors: Pingcheng Dong, Yonghao Tan, Xuejiao Liu, Peng Luo, Yu Liu, Di Pang, Songchen Ma, Xijie Huang, Shih-Yang Liu, Dong Zhang, Zhichao Lu, Luhong Liang, Chi-Ying Tsui, Fengbin Tu, Liang Zhao, Kwang-Ting Cheng
papers.abstract_en: This work presents a 55nm speculative decoding-based LLM accelerator with bumpingbased face-to-face ReRAM-on-logic stacking technology. It features a local rotation unit for outlier-free low-bit quantization, a stacking-aware PNM architecture co-designed with blockwise vector quantization to reduce weight EMA overheads, and an adaptive parallel speculative decoding scheme with out-of-order scheduler for high resource and bandwidth utilization. Our chip achieves 14.08-to-135.69token/s and 4.46-to
papers.abstract_cn: 这项工作提出了一种基于推测解码的55nm大型语言模型加速器，采用基于凸点的正对面ReRAM在逻辑堆叠技术。它具有用于无异常值低比特量化的本地旋转单元，结合分块向量量化共同设计的堆叠感知PNM架构，以减少权重EMA开销，以及具有乱序调度器的自适应并行推测解码方案，以实现高资源和带宽利用率。我们的芯片实现了每秒14.08到135.69个token和4.46到
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper targets memory capacity/bandwidth and activation/weight outlier bottlenecks that limit ReRAM-based accelerators for low-bit LLM serving. It proposes a 55 nm face-to-face ReRAM-on-logic stacked accelerator with a local rotation unit for outlier-free quantization, block-clustered/blockwise vector weight compression co-designed with a stacking-aware processing-near-memory architecture, and adaptive parallel speculative decoding with out-of-order scheduling. The chip achieves 14.08–135.69 tokens/s while improving bandwidth/resource utilization and enabling efficient low-bit LLM inference.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向LLM推理服务中的权重存储带宽瓶颈、低比特量化离群值和解码吞吐受限问题，提出一种基于55nm工艺的ReRAM-on-logic三维堆叠近存计算加速器。其核心是通过局部旋转实现无离群低比特量化，并结合块簇/块向量权重压缩、堆叠感知PNM架构以及自适应并行推测解码与乱序调度，提高带宽和资源利用率。芯片实测达到14.08–135.69 token/s，展示了高吞吐、低开销的LLM加速效果。

papers.title: MARS: Unleashing the Power of Speculative Decoding via Margin-Aware Verification
papers.authors: Jingwei Song, Xinyu Wang, Hanbin Wang, Xiaoxuan Lei, Bill Shi, Shixin Han, Eric Yang, Xiao-Wen Chang, Lynn Ai
papers.abstract_en: Speculative Decoding (SD) accelerates autoregressive large language model (LLM) inference by decoupling generation and verification. While recent methods improve draft quality by tightly coupling the drafter with the target model, the verification mechanism itself remains largely unchanged, relying on strict token-level rejection sampling. In practice, modern LLMs frequently operate in low-margin regimes where the target model exhibits weak preference among top candidates. In such cases, rejecti
papers.abstract_cn: 投机解码（Speculative Decoding，SD）通过将生成和验证解耦来加速自回归大型语言模型（LLM）的推理。尽管近期方法通过将草稿生成器与目标模型紧密结合来提高草稿质量，但验证机制本身在很大程度上保持不变，仍然依赖严格的逐令牌拒绝采样。在实践中，现代大型语言模型经常在目标模型在顶级候选中表现出偏好较弱的低边际环境中运行。在这种情况下，拒绝
papers.ai_summary_en: MARS tackles the verification bottleneck in speculative decoding, where strict token-level rejection sampling over-rejects plausible draft tokens in low-margin settings where the target LLM has weak preference among top candidates. Its key idea is a margin-aware verification rule that adaptively accepts draft tokens based on the target model’s confidence margin rather than relying solely on conventional rejection sampling. This improves draft acceptance and end-to-end serving throughput without requiring a stronger drafter, while largely preserving generation quality.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对投机解码中传统逐 token 拒绝采样在目标模型低置信度/低边际场景下过于严格、导致草稿接受率和推理吞吐受限的问题。其核心方法是提出边际感知验证 MARS，根据目标模型对候选 token 的偏好强度或不确定性动态调整接受标准，从而在低边际时更宽容、在高边际时保持严格。主要影响是在保持生成质量的同时提升草稿接受率与服务吞吐，为投机解码从“草稿优化”扩展到“验证优化”提供了有效路径。

papers.title: AdaSpec: Adaptive Multilingual Speculative Decoding with Self-Synthesized Language-Aware Training and Vocabulary Simplification
papers.authors: Dinh-Truong Do, Nguyen-Khang Le, Le-Minh Nguyen
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple tokens, which are then verified in parallel by the base model. While effective in English, existing methods often struggle in multilingual scenarios due to static vocabularies and the lack of language-specific instruction data. To address these limitations, we present AdaSpec, a multilingual speculative decoding framework that dynamically adapts both the drafter and vocabulary
papers.abstract_cn: 推测解码通过使用轻量级起草器提出多个标记，然后由基础模型并行验证，从而加快大语言模型（LLM）的推理速度。虽然在英语中效果显著，但现有方法在多语言场景中往往表现不佳，这是由于静态词汇表和缺乏特定语言的指令数据造成的。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了AdaSpec，一种多语言推测解码框架，可以动态地适应起草器和词汇表。
papers.ai_summary_en: AdaSpec addresses the limited effectiveness of speculative decoding in multilingual LLM serving, where static vocabularies and insufficient language-specific instruction data reduce draft acceptance. The method dynamically adapts both the lightweight drafter and a simplified vocabulary using self-synthesized, language-aware training data to better match the target language and base model. This yields improved multilingual inference throughput and token-acceptance rates while preserving generation quality.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多语言大模型推理中推测解码受限于静态词表和缺乏语言特定训练数据的问题，提出了 AdaSpec 框架。其核心洞见是通过自合成的语言感知训练数据动态适配轻量草稿模型与词表，并结合词汇简化提升多语言场景下的草稿质量与验证效率。该方法有望在保持生成质量的同时，提高多语言 LLM 服务的推测解码接受率和推理加速效果。

papers.title: TABED: Test-Time Adaptive Ensemble Drafting for Robust Speculative Decoding in LVLMs
papers.authors: Minjae Lee, Wonjun Kang, Byeongkeun Ahn, Christian Classen, Kevin Galim, Seunghyuk Oh, Minghao Yan, Hyung Il Koo, Kangwook Lee
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding (SD) has proven effective for accelerating LLM inference by quickly generating draft tokens and verifying them in parallel. However, SD remains largely unexplored for Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), which extend LLMs to process both image and text prompts. To address this gap, we benchmark existing inference methods with small draft models on 11 datasets across diverse input scenarios and observe scenario-specific performance fluctuations. Motivated by these findings,
papers.abstract_cn: 推测解码（Speculative Decoding, SD）已被证明在通过快速生成草稿标记并并行验证它们来加速大型语言模型（LLM）推理方面非常有效。然而，对于大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）来说，SD仍 largely 未被探索，这类模型将LLM扩展到处理图像和文本提示。为了解决这一空白，我们在11个数据集上使用小型草稿模型对现有推理方法进行了基准测试，涵盖多种输入场景，并观察到特定场景下的性能波动。受这些发现的启发，
papers.ai_summary_en: TABED addresses the underexplored problem of making speculative decoding robust for Large Vision-Language Models, where small draft models show unstable acceptance performance across different image-text input scenarios. Its key idea is test-time adaptive ensemble drafting, which dynamically combines or selects draft models during inference to match the current input distribution and improve draft quality. This yields more reliable inference acceleration for LVLMs across diverse benchmarks, reducing scenario-specific performance fluctuations while preserving parallel verification benefits.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）中投机解码在不同输入场景下草稿模型性能波动大、加速不稳定的问题展开研究。其核心方法是提出 TABED，一种测试时自适应的集成草稿机制，通过动态组合或选择草稿策略来提升草稿 token 的鲁棒性和命中率。实验表明，该方法在多种数据集和输入场景下能更稳定地加速 LVLM 推理，提升投机解码的实用性。

papers.title: LLM-42: Enabling Determinism in LLM Inference with Verified Speculation
papers.authors: Raja Gond, Aditya K Kamath, Arkaprava Basu, R. Ramjee, Ashish Panwar
papers.abstract_en: In LLM inference, the same prompt may yield different outputs across different runs. At the system level, this non-determinism arises from floating-point non-associativity combined with dynamic batching and GPU kernels whose reduction orders vary with batch size. A straightforward way to eliminate non-determinism is to disable dynamic batching during inference, but doing so severely degrades throughput. Another approach is to make kernels batch-invariant; however, this tightly couples determinis
papers.abstract_cn: 在大型语言模型推理中，相同的提示在不同的运行中可能产生不同的输出。在系统层面，这种非确定性来源于浮点数的非结合性，结合动态批处理和 GPU 内核在批量大小变化时的归约顺序。消除非确定性的一个直接方法是在推理期间禁用动态批处理，但这样做会严重降低吞吐量。另一种方法是使内核对批量不变；然而，这会紧密耦合确定性
papers.ai_summary_en: LLM-42 addresses system-level nondeterminism in LLM serving, where dynamic batching and batch-size-dependent GPU reduction orders cause floating-point non-associativity to change logits and outputs for the same prompt. Its key idea is verified speculation: execute requests in high-throughput nondeterministic batches, then verify generated tokens or logits against a deterministic reference path and recover when mismatches occur. This enables exact deterministic inference without disabling dynamic batching or requiring all kernels to be batch-invariant, preserving serving throughput while providing reproducibility.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理服务中由浮点非结合性、动态批处理及批大小相关GPU归约顺序导致的输出非确定性问题。提出LLM-42，通过“可验证投机”在保留动态批处理和高性能非确定性kernel的同时生成并校验推理结果，以保证最终输出符合确定性语义。其意义在于无需禁用动态批处理或深度改造batch-invariant kernel，即可兼顾推理可复现性与服务吞吐。

papers.title: PRISM: Parametrically Refactoring Inference for Speculative Sampling Draft Models
papers.authors: Xuliang Wang, Yuetao Chen, Maochan Zhen, Fang Liu, Xin Zheng, Xing Liu, Hong Xu, Ming Li
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs), constrained by their auto-regressive nature, suffer from slow decoding. Speculative decoding methods have emerged as a promising solution to accelerate LLM decoding, attracting attention from both systems and AI research communities. Recently, the pursuit of better draft quality has driven a trend toward parametrically larger draft models, which inevitably introduces substantial computational overhead. While existing work attempts to balance the trade-off between pr
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）由于其自回归特性，面临解码速度缓慢的问题。投机解码方法已成为加速LLM解码的有前途的解决方案，吸引了系统和人工智能研究社区的关注。最近，对更高质量草稿的追求推动了向参数规模更大的草稿模型发展的趋势，这不可避免地带来了大量的计算开销。虽然现有工作试图在权衡 pr 之间找到平衡
papers.ai_summary_en: PRISM addresses the overhead introduced by increasingly large draft models in speculative LLM decoding, where better draft quality can negate speedups due to expensive draft inference. Its key idea is to parametrically refactor draft-model inference so that drafting computation can be reorganized and adaptively allocated, preserving acceptance quality while reducing per-step cost. The paper reports improved trade-offs between draft quality and overhead, yielding higher end-to-end decoding speedups than standard speculative-decoding draft baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对投机解码中草稿模型越大、草稿质量越高但推理开销越大的问题，研究如何在草稿质量与计算成本之间取得更好平衡。其核心思路是通过参数化重构（parametric refactoring）优化草稿模型的推理过程，以更高效的参数使用提升草稿生成效率。该方法有望在不显著牺牲接受率的前提下降低草稿模型开销，从而加速大模型在线服务。

papers.title: SLO-Aware Compute Resource Allocation for Prefill-Decode Disaggregated LLM Inference
papers.authors: Luchang Li, Dongfang Li, Bozhao Gong, Yu Zhang
papers.abstract_en: Prefill-Decode (P/D) disaggregation has emerged as a widely adopted optimization strategy for Large Language Model (LLM) inference. However, there currently exists no well-established methodology for determining the optimal number of P/D hardware resources, subject to constraints on total throughput, service level objectives (SLOs), and request characteristics - specifically input and output lengths. To address this gap, we propose a hybrid approach that combines theoretical modeling with empiri
papers.abstract_cn: 预填充解码（P/D）分解已成为大规模语言模型（LLM）推理中广泛采用的优化策略。然而，目前尚无成熟的方法来确定P/D硬件资源的最佳数量，同时需考虑总吞吐量、服务水平目标（SLO）和请求特性——特别是输入和输出长度。为了解决这一空白，我们提出了一种将理论建模与实证方法相结合的混合方法
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses SLO-aware provisioning of compute resources for prefill–decode disaggregated LLM inference, where the optimal split between prefill and decode hardware depends on throughput targets, latency SLOs, and input/output length distributions. It proposes a hybrid method that combines analytical performance modeling with empirical calibration to predict and select the number of prefill and decode resources needed for a given workload. The approach enables more accurate, SLO-compliant resource allocation than heuristic baselines, reducing overprovisioning while meeting throughput and latency constraints.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对预填充-解码（P/D）分离式 LLM 推理中，如何在总吞吐、延迟 SLO 和输入/输出长度约束下确定最优 P/D 资源数量的问题。其核心方法是提出一种 SLO 感知的混合资源分配框架，结合理论性能建模与经验校准，预测并优化 prefill 与 decode 实例配比。结果表明，该方法可在满足服务等级目标的同时提升资源利用效率，为分离式 LLM 推理的容量规划提供可行依据。

papers.title: LAPS: A Length-Aware-Prefill LLM Serving System
papers.authors: Jianshu She, Zonghang Li, Hongchao Du, Shangyuan Wu, Wenhao Zheng, Eric P. Xing, Zhengzhong Liu, Huaxiu Yao, Jason Xue, Qirong Ho
papers.abstract_en: LAPS identifies and disaggregates requests with different prompt lengths in LLM serving to reduce TTFT latency. While recent systems have decoupled the prefill and decode stages to improve throughput, they still rely on unified scheduling policies that fail to adapt to heterogeneous workload characteristics. We observe that prompt-length variations lead to distinct performance bottlenecks, motivating an adaptive scheduling strategy. LAPS disaggregates multi-turn long-prefill requests from short-
papers.abstract_cn: LAPS 在大语言模型服务中识别并拆分具有不同提示长度的请求，以减少 TTFT 延迟。尽管近期系统已经将预填充和解码阶段解耦以提高吞吐量，但它们仍依赖统一的调度策略，无法适应异构工作负载特性。我们观察到提示长度的变化会导致不同的性能瓶颈，从而激发了一种自适应调度策略。LAPS 将多轮长预填充请求与短
papers.ai_summary_en: LAPS addresses the problem that prefill–decode disaggregated LLM serving systems use uniform scheduling policies, which fail to handle heterogeneous prompt lengths and therefore increase time-to-first-token (TTFT). Its key insight is to identify prompt-length variation and disaggregate long-prefill, often multi-turn, requests from short-prefill requests so that each class can be scheduled with length-aware resource allocation. This reduces prefill interference and improves TTFT, throughput, and SLO attainment under mixed LLM serving workloads.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理服务中统一调度难以适配不同提示长度、导致首 token 延迟（TTFT）较高的瓶颈问题。其核心洞见是长/短预填充请求具有不同性能特征，LAPS 通过识别并解耦多轮长预填充与短请求，实现长度感知的预填充调度。主要效果是降低 TTFT，并提升异构工作负载下的服务效率。

papers.title: RAPID-Serve: Resource-efficient and Accelerated P/D Intra-GPU Disaggregation
papers.authors: Amna Masood, Pratishtha Gaur, N. Jayasena
papers.abstract_en: Two widely adopted techniques for LLM inference serving systems today are hybrid batching and disaggregated serving. A hybrid batch combines prefill and decode tokens of different requests in the same batch to improve resource utilization and throughput at the cost of increased latency per token. In contrast, disaggregated serving decouples compute-bound prefill and bandwidth-bound decode phases to optimize for service level objectives (SLOs) at the cost of resource under-utilization and KV-cach
papers.abstract_cn: 目前用于大型语言模型推理服务系统的两种广泛采用的技术是混合批处理和分离式服务。混合批处理将不同请求的预填充和解码令牌组合在同一批次中，以提高资源利用率和吞吐量，但代价是每个令牌的延迟增加。相比之下，分离式服务将计算密集型的预填充阶段与带宽限制的解码阶段分离，以优化服务级别目标（SLOs），但代价是资源未充分利用和KV缓存效率降低。
papers.ai_summary_en: RAPID-Serve tackles the serving tradeoff between hybrid batching, which improves GPU utilization but causes prefill/decode interference and token-latency inflation, and cluster-level P/D disaggregation, which optimizes SLOs but wastes resources and incurs KV-cache transfer overhead. It introduces intra-GPU prefill/decode disaggregation with resource-efficient partitioning and accelerated KV-cache/scheduling mechanisms that isolate compute-bound prefill from bandwidth-bound decode while allowing them to share the same GPU. The result is improved SLO attainment, lower per-token latency, and higher throughput per GPU than conventional hybrid or disaggregated baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理服务中混合批处理会推高每token延迟、而传统prefill/decode（P/D）分离又导致资源利用不足和KV cache开销的问题，提出RAPID-Serve，在单GPU内部实现资源高效且加速的P/D分离。其核心思路是将计算密集的prefill与带宽受限的decode在GPU内细粒度解耦和调度，从而在减少相互干扰的同时降低KV cache传输与内存开销。论文旨在同时提升吞吐、资源利用率和SLO达成率，为LLM服务提供比跨节点分离更低成本、更高效率的优化路径。

papers.title: GreenScheduler: Coordinated Two-Tier Energy Optimization for Disaggregated LLM Serving
papers.authors: Waled Milad Abulgasem Alashheb, Mabruka Khlifa Ali Karkeb, Sabria AbdulGader Ali Elmusrati, Sumia Abdussalam Milad Elagtel
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) inference has become a dominant consumer of en- ergy in modern AI data centers, often accounting for over 90% of total operational power [1].Recent architectural shifts toward prefill/decode disaggregation have improved perfor- mance but created complex energy optimization challenges. This paper introduces Green- Scheduler, a novel two-tier framework designed to jointly optimize GPU placement and Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS) in disaggregated environment
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）推理已成为现代人工智能数据中心的主要能源消耗者，通常占总运营功率的90%以上[1]。最近，向预填充/解码分离的架构转变提高了性能，但也带来了复杂的能量优化挑战。本文介绍了Green-Scheduler，这是一种新颖的两层框架，旨在在分离环境中联合优化GPU布局和动态电压频率调节（DVFS）。
papers.ai_summary_en: GreenScheduler addresses the energy-optimization problem in disaggregated LLM inference, where separating prefill and decode phases improves performance but complicates power management across GPUs. Its key idea is a two-tier coordination framework that jointly optimizes GPU placement and Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS) for prefill/decode workloads. The resulting system targets lower data-center energy consumption while preserving LLM serving efficiency under disaggregated execution constraints.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对预填充/解码解耦架构下 LLM 推理能耗高、GPU 调度与频率控制难以协同优化的问题，提出 GreenScheduler 两层能耗优化框架。其核心方法是联合优化 GPU 放置调度与 DVFS 频率调节，以适配 prefill 与 decode 阶段不同的计算和访存特性。该工作可在保障服务质量的同时提升能效，为大规模 LLM 推理的绿色部署提供了系统级优化路径。

papers.title: Context-Aware Autoscaling for Cost-Efficient Large Language Model Inference With Prefix Cache Integration
papers.authors: Seyed Hossein Ahmadpanah, A. Sahafi, S. H. Erfani
papers.abstract_en: Although granular resource management has been made possible by the architectural shift to Prefill-Decode (PD) disaggregation in Large Language Model (LLM) serving, it is still difficult to maintain strict Service Level Objectives (SLOs) under bursty traffic. Modern autoscaling frameworks, like TokenScale, balance resources using fine-grained “velocity” metrics, but they have a significant drawback: cache blindness. These systems over-provision during spikes in high-locality traffic because they
papers.abstract_cn: 尽管通过大型语言模型（LLM）服务中的预填充-解码（PD）解耦架构的转变，使得细粒度的资源管理成为可能，但在突发流量下仍然很难维持严格的服务水平目标（SLO）。现代的自动扩展框架，如 TokenScale，通过细粒度的“速度”指标来平衡资源，但它们有一个显著的缺点：缓存盲区。这些系统在高局部性流量激增时会过度分配资源，因为它们
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses SLO violations and over-provisioning in disaggregated prefill–decode LLM serving caused by cache-blind autoscaling under bursty, prefix-local traffic. It introduces a context-aware autoscaling controller that integrates prefix-cache state and request locality into scaling decisions, adjusting prefill and decode capacity according to expected cache reuse rather than raw token/request velocity alone. This reduces unnecessary scaling and inference cost while improving SLO attainment during high-locality traffic spikes.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理服务在突发流量下因自动扩缩框架“缓存盲区”而导致高局部性请求被过度配置的问题，研究如何在前缀缓存集成场景下实现成本高效且满足SLO的弹性扩缩。其核心思路是将上下文复用和前缀缓存命中纳入负载估计与扩缩决策，使系统按实际需要执行的prefill/decode工作量而非表面请求或token速率来配置资源。该方法可在高局部性流量高峰中减少不必要扩容、降低推理成本，同时提升严格SLO下的服务稳定性。

papers.title: Power Aware Dynamic Reallocation For Inference
papers.authors: Yiwei Jiang, Sangeeta Chowdhary, Nathaniel Morris, Rutwik Jain, Srilatha Manne, Samuel Bayliss
papers.abstract_en: Disaggregation has emerged as a powerful strategy for optimizing large language model (LLM) inference by separating compute-intensive prefill and memory-bound decode phases across specialized GPUs. This separation improves utilization and throughput under fixed hardware capacity. However, as model and cluster scales grow, power, rather than compute, has become the dominant limiter of overall performance and cost efficiency. In this paper, we propose RAPID, a power-aware disaggregated inference f
papers.abstract_cn: 通过将计算密集型的预填充阶段和受内存限制的解码阶段分别分配到专用 GPU 上，分解已经成为优化大型语言模型（LLM）推理的一种强大策略。这种分离在固定硬件容量下提高了利用率和吞吐量。然而，随着模型和集群规模的增长，功耗而非计算能力已成为整体性能和成本效率的主要限制因素。在本文中，我们提出了 RAPID，一种注重功耗的分解推理方法
papers.ai_summary_en: RAPID addresses LLM inference serving under power caps, where disaggregated prefill and decode phases have different power and resource demands and static allocation limits throughput. It introduces a power-aware dynamic reallocation framework that shifts GPUs or workload between prefill and decode based on real-time phase characteristics and power constraints. The approach improves throughput and power efficiency relative to fixed or power-unaware disaggregated inference systems.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型推理在prefill/decode分离部署中，随着模型与集群规模扩大，功耗而非算力成为吞吐和成本效率主要瓶颈的问题。其核心方法是提出功率感知的RAPID框架，在分离式推理中根据功率约束动态重分配prefill与decode资源，实现更优的负载调度与资源利用。该工作有助于在固定功率预算下提升LLM服务吞吐与整体性能成本比。

papers.title: Large-Scale LLM Inference with Heterogeneous Workloads: Prefill-Decode Contention and Asymptotically Optimal Control
papers.authors: Ruihan Lin, Zezhen Ding, Zean Han, Jiheng Zhang
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are rapidly becoming critical infrastructure for enterprise applications, driving unprecedented demand for GPU-based inference services. A key operational challenge arises from the two-phase nature of LLM inference: a compute-intensive \emph{prefill} phase that processes user input, followed by a memory-bound \emph{decode} phase that generates output tokens. When these phases share GPU resources, prefill tasks throttle the processing speed of concurrent decodes, crea
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）正在迅速成为企业应用的重要基础设施，推动对基于GPU的推理服务的前所未有的需求。LLM推理带来的一个关键运营挑战源自其双阶段特性：一个计算密集的\emph{预填充}阶段处理用户输入，随后是一个受内存限制的\emph{解码}阶段生成输出令牌。当这些阶段共享GPU资源时，预填充任务会限制并发解码的处理速度，产生
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses GPU-based LLM serving where compute-intensive prefill and memory-bound decode phases contend for shared resources, causing prefill jobs to slow concurrent token decoding and violate latency objectives. It develops a queueing-theoretic model of this heterogeneous two-phase workload and derives an asymptotically optimal control policy for admission, batching, and phase-aware scheduling in large-scale systems. The results show that explicitly accounting for prefill–decode interference enables near-optimal throughput–latency tradeoffs and improved SLO attainment under heavy inference load.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大规模LLM推理中prefill计算密集与decode内存受限共享GPU时相互争用、尤其prefill抑制并发decode导致尾延迟和吞吐下降的问题。核心方法是面向异构工作负载建立两阶段排队/控制模型，并设计考虑prefill-decode代价差异的调度与批处理控制策略，证明其在大规模极限下具有渐近最优性。结果表明，该控制可缓解阶段间阻塞、提升GPU利用率与SLO达成率，为高并发LLM服务提供理论依据和调度原则。

papers.title: TeLLMe: An Efficient End-to-End Ternary LLM Prefill and Decode Accelerator with Table-Lookup Matmul on Edge FPGAs
papers.authors: Ye Qiao, Zhiheng Chen, Yifan Zhang, Yian Wang, Sitao Huang
papers.abstract_en: With the emergence of wearable devices and other embedded systems, deploying large language models (LLMs) on edge platforms becomes an urgent need. However, it is challenging because of their high computational and memory demands. Although recent low-bitwidth quantization methods (e.g., BitNet, DeepSeek) compress weights to as low as 1.58 bits with minimal accuracy loss, edge deployment is still constrained by limited on-chip resources, power budgets, and the often-neglected long latency of the
papers.abstract_cn: 随着可穿戴设备和其他嵌入式系统的出现，在边缘平台上部署大型语言模型（LLM）变得迫在眉睫。然而，由于其高计算和内存需求，这一任务具有挑战性。尽管最近的低位宽量化方法（例如 BitNet、DeepSeek）将权重压缩到最低 1.58 位且几乎不损失精度，但边缘部署仍受到片上资源有限、功耗预算有限以及经常被忽视的长延迟的制约。
papers.ai_summary_en: TeLLMe targets edge LLM serving, where BitNet-style ternary/1.58-bit models remain bottlenecked by limited on-chip memory, scarce DSP resources, power budgets, and long prefill latency on embedded FPGAs. The paper proposes an end-to-end prefill-and-decode FPGA accelerator that uses table-lookup matrix multiplication to exploit ternary weights and low-bit activations, replacing conventional multiplier-heavy GEMMs with LUT/RAM-based computation and hardware-aware scheduling. This yields low-latency, energy-efficient LLM inference on edge FPGAs, improving throughput and efficiency over typical accelerator baselines while preserving the accuracy of ternary quantized models.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘端大模型推理中 prefill 与 decode 阶段计算/访存开销大、延迟高的问题，研究如何在资源受限 FPGA 上高效部署三值/极低比特 LLM。其核心方法是提出 TeLLMe 端到端加速器，通过表查找矩阵乘法将三值权重计算转化为查表与累加，并优化片上数据流以同时加速 prefill 和 decode。结果表明，该设计可在边缘 FPGA 上显著降低延迟与功耗，为 1.58-bit 级三值大模型的端侧实用化提供了高能效方案。

papers.title: POP: Prefill-Only Pruning for Efficient Large Model Inference
papers.authors: Junhui He, Zhihui Fu, Jun Wang, Qing'an Li
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities. However, their deployment is hindered by significant computational costs. Existing structured pruning methods, while hardware-efficient, often suffer from significant accuracy degradation. In this paper, we argue that this failure stems from a stage-agnostic pruning approach that overlooks the asymmetric roles between the prefill and decode stages. By introducing a virtual gate mechanism, ou
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）和视觉语言模型（VLM）展现出了卓越的能力。然而，其部署受制于显著的计算成本。现有的结构化剪枝方法虽然硬件效率高，但常常存在显著的精度下降。本文认为，这种失败源于一种阶段无关的剪枝方法，忽视了预填充和解码阶段之间的非对称角色。通过引入虚拟门机制，ou
papers.ai_summary_en: POP addresses the accuracy degradation of structured pruning in LLM/VLM serving by identifying that prefill and decode stages have asymmetric sensitivity to removed model structures. Its key idea is a virtual-gate, prefill-only pruning mechanism that disables selected components only during the compute-heavy prefill phase while preserving full model capacity during decoding to protect generation quality. This stage-aware approach improves hardware efficiency and reduces inference cost with less accuracy loss than conventional stage-agnostic pruning.
