papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型推理中结构化剪枝虽硬件友好但易显著掉点的问题，指出其根源在于忽视 prefill 与 decode 两阶段计算角色的不对称性。核心方法是提出 POP（Prefill-Only Pruning），通过虚拟门机制实现仅在 prefill 阶段进行结构化裁剪、在 decode 阶段保留完整计算路径，从而兼顾效率与生成质量。该工作为 LLM/VLM 服务提供了一种更高效的推理加速思路，有望在降低计算成本的同时改善精度-效率权衡。

papers.title: Lil: Less is Less When Applying Post-Training Sparse-Attention Algorithms in Long-Decode Stage
papers.authors: Junhao Hu, Fang Li, Mingtao Xu, Fei Meng, Shiju Zhao, Tiancheng Hu, Ting Peng, Anmin Liu, Wenrui Huang, Chenxu Liu, Ziyue Hua, Tao Xie
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong capabilities across a wide range of complex tasks and are increasingly deployed at scale, placing significant demands on inference efficiency. Prior work typically decomposes inference into prefill and decode stages, with the decode stage dominating total latency. To reduce time and memory complexity in the decode stage, a line of work introduces sparse-attention algorithms. In this paper, we show, both empirically and theoretically, that sparse at
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在广泛的复杂任务中表现出强大的能力，并且正在越来越大规模地部署，这对推理效率提出了重大要求。以往的工作通常将推理分解为预填充（prefill）和解码（decode）阶段，而解码阶段占据了总延迟的主要部分。为了减少解码阶段的时间和内存复杂度，一些工作引入了稀疏注意力算法。在本文中，我们通过实证和理论方法展示，稀疏
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the limited practical benefit of post-training sparse-attention and KV-cache pruning methods in the long decode stage of LLM serving, where decode latency dominates end-to-end inference time. Its key insight, supported by theoretical modeling and empirical evaluation, is that sparse attention reduces nominal computation but introduces irregular KV-cache accesses, selection overhead, and poor hardware utilization, which undermine memory-bandwidth savings on modern accelerators. Consequently, existing sparse-attention algorithms often provide little or no wall-clock speedup in long-generation serving, indicating the need for decode-aware, hardware-efficient sparsity designs.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文面向 LLM 服务中长解码阶段主导延迟的问题，审视后训练稀疏注意力算法在真实推理中的实际收益。其核心洞见是：长解码场景下，稀疏化虽降低了理论计算和缓存规模，但选择开销、非规则访存和误差累积会抵消甚至逆转收益，呈现“Less is Less”。该结果提示现有后训练稀疏注意力并不天然适配长序列在线推理，为后续稀疏注意力和 KV 缓存管理方法的设计提供了重要警示。

papers.title: Fast Forward: Accelerating LLM Prefill with Predictive FFN Sparsity
papers.authors: Aayush Gautam, Mukul Gagrani, Junyoung Park, Mingu Lee, Chiris Lott, Narasimha Reddy
papers.abstract_en: The prefill stage of large language model (LLM) inference is a key computational bottleneck for long-context workloads. At short-to-moderate context lengths (1K--16K tokens), Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs) dominate this cost, accounting for most of the total FLOPs. Existing FFN sparsification methods, designed for autoregressive decoding, fail to exploit the prefill stage's parallelism and often degrade accuracy. To address this, we introduce FastForward, a predictive sparsity framework that accel
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）推理的预填充阶段是长上下文工作负载的关键计算瓶颈。在短到中等上下文长度（1K--16K 令牌）下，前馈网络（FFN）主导了这一成本，占总浮点运算量的大部分。现有针对自回归解码设计的 FFN 稀疏化方法未能利用预填充阶段的并行性，并且通常会降低准确性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 FastForward，一种预测稀疏框架，可加速
papers.ai_summary_en: FastForward addresses the prefill bottleneck in LLM serving for short-to-moderate context lengths (1K–16K tokens), where FFNs dominate compute and decoding-oriented sparsity methods underutilize parallelism. It introduces a predictive FFN sparsification framework that forecasts which FFN computations can be safely skipped during prefill, enabling parallel, accuracy-preserving acceleration. The approach reduces prefill FLOPs and latency for long-context LLM inference while avoiding the accuracy degradation common in existing sparse inference methods.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型推理中 prefill 阶段在 1K–16K 上下文下由 FFN 主导造成的高计算开销问题，指出现有面向解码的 FFN 稀疏方法难以利用 prefill 的并行性并易损失精度。其核心方法是提出 FastForward，一个面向 prefill 的预测式 FFN 稀疏框架，通过预测可稀疏的 FFN 计算来实现并行加速。该工作有望在保持模型精度的同时显著降低 prefill 延迟、提升长上下文 LLM 服务吞吐。

papers.title: Low-Latency Edge LLM Handover via Joint KV Cache Transfer and Token Prefill
papers.authors: Seunghun Lee, Jihong Park, Ce Zheng, Hyuncheol Park
papers.abstract_en: Edge deployment of large language models (LLMs) can reduce latency for interactive services, but mobility introduces service interruptions when an user equipment (UE) hands over between base stations (BSs). To promptly resume decoding, the target-side edge server must recover the UE context state, which can be provisioned either by token forwarding followed by prefill computation or by direct key-value (KV) cache transmission over backhaul. This paper proposes a unified handover (HO) design that
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）的边缘部署可以降低交互式服务的延迟，但当用户设备（UE）在基站（BS）之间切换时，移动性会引入服务中断。为了迅速恢复解码，目标侧边缘服务器必须恢复UE上下文状态，这可以通过令牌转发随后进行预填计算，或者通过回程直接传输键值（KV）缓存来提供。本文提出了一种统一的切换（HO）设计，旨在
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses service interruption during mobile handovers in edge LLM serving, where the target edge server must quickly recover a user’s generation context to resume decoding. It proposes a unified handover framework that jointly coordinates token forwarding with prefill computation and direct KV-cache transfer over the backhaul, selecting the most efficient context-recovery path. The design reduces handover latency and context-recovery overhead, enabling more responsive interactive LLM services under edge mobility.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘LLM服务中用户设备在基站间切换时，目标边缘服务器需恢复会话上下文而导致解码中断和高延迟的问题。其核心思路是提出一种统一切换设计，联合调度 token 转发后的 prefill 重计算与直接 KV cache 传输，以在回传带宽和计算开销之间取得更低延迟的上下文恢复。该方案有望减少边缘移动场景下的 LLM 服务中断时间，提升交互式推理的连续性和响应速度。

papers.title: EdgeSD: Efficient Speculative Decoding with Vision-Decoding Disaggregation for MLLM Inference in Edge-Cloud Networks
papers.authors: Hualong Huang, Wenhan Zhan, Hancong Duan, Kai Peng, Geyong Min, Zijia Zhao, Zitian Zhao, Yalan Ye
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in edge-cloud networks faces critical challenges, including computational resource heterogeneity, memory bottlenecks, and bandwidth constraints. To address these issues, we propose EdgeSD, a novel framework that accelerates MLLM inference by integrating speculative decoding (SD) with edge-cloud collaboration. First, EdgeSD decouples the vision encoding and decoding processes of the draft MLLM across heterogeneous edge servers (ESs). This disaggregation architecture overcomes single-node memory constraints, enabling optimized resource utilization and high-resolution input processing. Second, to resolve the communication bottleneck and computational burden inherent in this distributed architecture, EdgeSD integrates a bandwidth-aware dynamic image token merging (ITM) method. Third, to optimize SD efficiency on consumer-grade ESs, EdgeSD employs an adaptive and scalable token tree structure solved using a parallel delta-stepping algorithm. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EdgeSD achieves 3.04-5.12x speedup compared to baseline methods.
papers.abstract_cn: 多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 在边缘云网络中的部署面临着关键挑战，包括计算资源异构性、内存瓶颈和带宽限制。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 EdgeSD，一种新的框架，通过将推测性解码 (SD) 与边缘云协作集成来加速 MLLM 推理。首先，EdgeSD 解耦了 MLLM 草案在异构边缘服务器 (ESs) 之间的视觉编码和解码过程。这种分离架构克服了单节点内存限制，实现了最优化的资源利用率和高分辨率的输入处理。其次，为了解决这种分布式架构固有的通信瓶颈和计算负担，EdgeSD 集成了一种带宽感知的动态图像标记合并 (ITM) 方法。第三，为了优化消费级 ESs 上的 SD 效率，EdgeSD 采用了一种自适应且可扩展的标记树结构，该结构使用并行增量步进算法进行解决。广泛的实验表明，与基准方法相比，EdgeSD 的速度提高了 3.04-5.12 倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: EdgeSD addresses efficient multimodal LLM inference in edge–cloud networks, where heterogeneous compute, limited memory, and constrained bandwidth hinder serving high-resolution vision-language inputs. It combines speculative decoding with disaggregated vision encoding and draft-model decoding across edge servers, using bandwidth-aware dynamic image token merging and an adaptive token-tree schedule optimized via a parallel delta-stepping algorithm. Experiments show 3.04–5.12× inference speedups over baseline methods.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘-云网络中多模态大模型推理面临的异构算力、内存瓶颈和带宽限制问题，提出了 EdgeSD 框架，通过投机解码与边云协同加速 MLLM 服务。其核心方法是将草稿模型的视觉编码与语言解码在异构边缘节点间解耦，并结合带宽感知的动态图像 token 合并、自适应可扩展 token 树及并行 delta-stepping 算法来提升分布式投机解码效率。实验表明，EdgeSD 相比基线方法可实现 3.04–5.12 倍推理加速。

papers.title: FlexLLM: Composable HLS Library for Flexible Hybrid LLM Accelerator Design
papers.authors: Jiahao Zhang, Zifan He, Nicholas Fraser, M. Blott, Yizhou Sun, Jason Cong
papers.abstract_en: We present FlexLLM, a composable High-Level Synthesis (HLS) library for rapid development of domain-specific LLM accelerators. FlexLLM exposes key architectural degrees of freedom for stage-customized inference, enabling hybrid designs that tailor temporal reuse and spatial dataflow differently for prefill and decode, and provides a comprehensive quantization suite to support accurate low-bit deployment. Using FlexLLM, we build a complete inference system for the Llama-3.2 1B model in under two
papers.abstract_cn: 我们提出了 FlexLLM，这是一个可组合的高层次综合（HLS）库，用于快速开发特定领域的 LLM 加速器。FlexLLM 揭示了关键的架构自由度，以便进行阶段自定义的推理，使混合设计成为可能，从而在预填充和解码阶段分别调整时间复用和空间数据流，并提供全面的量化套件以支持精确的低位部署。使用 FlexLLM，我们在不到两分钟的时间内构建了用于 Llama-3.2 1B 模型的完整推理系统
papers.ai_summary_en: FlexLLM addresses the difficulty of rapidly building domain-specific LLM inference accelerators that must handle prefill and decode phases with different compute and memory bottlenecks. Its key contribution is a composable High-Level Synthesis library exposing architectural degrees of freedom for stage-customized temporal reuse, spatial dataflow, and comprehensive low-bit quantization, enabling hybrid accelerator designs. The paper demonstrates a complete Llama-3.2-1B inference system built rapidly with FlexLLM, supporting accurate low-bit deployment and flexible accelerator exploration.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向LLM推理中prefill与decode阶段计算特性差异导致加速器设计不够灵活的问题，提出FlexLLM这一可组合的HLS库。其核心洞见是开放阶段级架构自由度，支持对时间复用、空间数据流和低比特量化策略进行混合定制，以快速构建领域专用LLM加速器。结果表明，该库可显著缩短开发周期，并成功支撑Llama-3.2 1B模型的完整推理系统与低比特部署。

papers.title: Dynamic Micro-Batch and Token-Budget Scheduling for IoT-Scale Pipeline-Parallel LLM Inference
papers.authors: Juncheol Ahn, Yubin Son, Daemin Kim, Sejin Park
papers.abstract_en: Large language models in IoT–edge–cloud settings face bursty, heterogeneous requests that make pipeline-parallel inference prone to micro-batch imbalance and communication stalls, causing GPU idle time and SLO violations. We propose a runtime-adaptive scheduler that jointly tunes token budgets and micro-batch counts to balance prefill/decode workloads and minimize pipeline bubbles under changing compute and network conditions. On a four-node pipeline-parallel cluster across Llama-2-13b and Qwen2
papers.abstract_cn: 在物联网–边缘–云环境中，大型语言模型面临突发且异构的请求，这使得流水线并行推理容易出现微批量不平衡和通信阻塞，导致 GPU 空闲时间增加和 SLO 违规。我们提出了一种运行时自适应调度器，可联合调整 token 预算和微批次数量，以在变化的计算和网络条件下平衡预填充/解码工作负载并最小化流水线冒泡。在一个跨 Llama-2-13b 和 Qwen2 的四节点流水线并行集群上
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles bursty, heterogeneous LLM serving in IoT–edge–cloud pipeline-parallel inference, where micro-batch imbalance and communication stalls create pipeline bubbles, GPU idle time, and SLO violations. It proposes a runtime-adaptive scheduler that jointly adjusts token budgets and micro-batch counts to balance prefill and decode workloads under varying compute and network conditions. Evaluations on a four-node pipeline cluster with Llama-2-13B and Qwen2 models show reduced pipeline idle time and improved SLO compliance for IoT-scale inference.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 IoT–边缘–云场景下 LLM 推理请求突发且异构，导致流水线并行中微批不均、通信停顿和 GPU 空闲的问题。其核心方法是提出运行时自适应调度器，联合动态调整 token 预算与微批数量，以平衡 prefill/decode 负载并减少流水线气泡。实验在四节点流水线集群上基于 Llama-2-13b 和 Qwen2 模型验证，表明该方法可降低空闲时间并提升 SLO 达成率。

papers.title: A Hybrid Online and Offline Requests Inference Serving System for LLM in Private Computer Environment
papers.authors: Yuchen Shen, Yuning Zhang, Dong Yuan
papers.abstract_en: While advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have broadened their applications, performing multitask LLM inference on a single GPU remains challenging due to insufficient GPU memory to load all model parameters. Existing methods that offload unneeded parameters to main memory and prefetch them back introduce high latency due to data transfer overhead. We propose FixGen, a single GPU LLM online-offline mixed inference serving system that supports multi-task inference. First, we develop FixP
papers.abstract_cn: 虽然大型语言模型（LLM）的进展拓宽了它们的应用，但在单个 GPU 上执行多任务 LLM 推理仍然具有挑战性，因为 GPU 内存不足以加载所有模型参数。现有将不需要的参数卸载到主内存并预取回来的方法，由于数据传输开销，会引入高延迟。我们提出了 FixGen，一种支持多任务推理的单 GPU LLM 在线-离线混合推理服务系统。首先，我们开发了 FixP
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses single-GPU LLM serving under tight memory constraints, where multi-task inference requires offloading parameters to host memory and suffers high latency from PCIe transfer overhead. It proposes FixGen, a hybrid online/offline inference serving system that combines latency-sensitive online requests with throughput-oriented offline workloads and uses a fixed prefetch/pipelining mechanism to overlap parameter transfers with GPU computation. This improves GPU utilization and reduces request latency, enabling more practical private single-GPU deployment of large multitask LLM services.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对单GPU私有环境下因显存不足难以同时服务多任务LLM推理、且参数卸载与预取带来高数据传输延迟的问题，提出FixGen这一在线/离线请求混合推理服务系统。其核心思路是通过混合调度在线与离线请求，并设计FixP等参数放置/预取机制来减少GPU与主存间的数据搬运开销。该方法可在单GPU上支持多任务LLM推理，降低延迟并提升整体服务效率。

papers.title: PIM-SHERPA: Software Method for On-device LLM Inference by Resolving PIM Memory Attribute and Layout Inconsistencies
papers.authors: Sunjung Lee, Sanghoon Cha, Hyeonsu Kim, Seung-Yeon Seo, Yuhwan Ro, Sukhan Lee, Byeongho Kim, Yongjun Park, Kyomin Sohn, Seungwon Lee, Jaehoon Yu
papers.abstract_en: On-device deployments of large language models (LLMs) are rapidly proliferating across mobile and edge platforms. LLM inference comprises a compute-intensive prefill phase and a memory bandwidth-intensive decode phase, and the decode phase has been widely recognized as well-suited to processing-in-memory (PIM) in both academia and industry. However, practical PIM-enabled systems face two obstacles between these phases, a memory attribute inconsistency in which prefill favors placing weights in a
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）在移动和边缘平台上的设备部署正在迅速增加。LLM 推理包括计算密集型的预填充阶段和内存带宽密集型的解码阶段，而解码阶段已被学术界和工业界广泛认为非常适合处理-内存（PIM）技术。然而，实际的 PIM 支持系统在这两个阶段之间面临两个障碍，其中之一是内存属性不一致问题，即预填充阶段倾向于将权重放置在
papers.ai_summary_en: PIM-SHERPA addresses practical on-device LLM inference by resolving the mismatch between the compute-intensive prefill phase and the memory-bandwidth-bound decode phase when using processing-in-memory. Its key contribution is a software method that reconciles inconsistent memory attributes and tensor layouts across phases, allowing prefill to use conventional execution paths while decode efficiently streams weights from PIM. This reduces phase-transition overhead and makes PIM-enabled on-device LLM serving more practical, improving decode performance on mobile and edge platforms.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对设备端大模型推理中预填充阶段与解码阶段对存储访问需求不同、导致 PIM 系统出现内存属性和数据布局不一致的问题。其核心方法是提出软件框架 PIM-SHERPA，通过协调权重在 PIM 内存中的属性设置与布局方式，使预填充和解码阶段能够高效衔接。该方法有助于提升设备端 LLM 推理的带宽利用率和端到端性能，推动 PIM 在移动/边缘平台上的实际落地。

papers.title: DisHelis: Optimizing Deployment of Disaggregated LLMs Inference Serving Over Heterogeneous Environments via Hierarchical Max-Flow
papers.authors: Tao Zhang, Huihuang Qin, Dong Jin, Shuangwu Chen, Huasen He, Xiaobin Tan, Shiyin Zhu, Jian Yang
papers.abstract_en: Disaggregated LLM inference service (DLIS), which decouples the compute-intensive prefill phase and the memory-intensive decode phase, enables more flexible and efficient resource usage. Existing solutions for deploying DLIS are typically designed for homogeneous environments. However, real-world production environments are becoming increasingly heterogeneous due to GPU shortages and rapid hardware evolution. Deploying DLIS in heterogeneous environments introduces three key challenges: 1) compli
papers.abstract_cn: 离散化大语言模型推理服务（DLIS），通过将计算密集型的预填充阶段与内存密集型的解码阶段解耦，实现了更灵活高效的资源使用。现有的DLIS部署方案通常是为同质环境设计的。然而，由于GPU短缺和硬件快速更新，现实生产环境正变得越来越异质。在异质环境中部署DLIS引入了三个关键挑战：1）合规性
papers.ai_summary_en: DisHelis addresses the deployment optimization problem for disaggregated LLM inference serving, where prefill and decode phases must be efficiently placed across heterogeneous GPU environments with differing compute, memory, and interconnect capabilities. Its key insight is to formulate the deployment as a hierarchical max-flow problem, jointly modeling phase-level instance placement, resource constraints, and request routing to balance prefill- and decode-heavy workloads across diverse hardware. The approach enables more scalable and resource-efficient DLIS deployment in heterogeneous clusters, improving serving throughput and utilization compared with solutions designed for homogeneous environments.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对分离式大模型推理服务在异构硬件环境中部署时，prefill 与 decode 阶段资源需求不匹配、调度与放置复杂的问题。核心方法是提出 DisHelis，用层次化最大流建模并联合优化异构设备上的角色分配、请求路由和资源部署。其主要影响是提升异构集群下的推理吞吐、资源利用率和 SLO 达成能力。

papers.title: Adelia: A 4-nm LLM Processing Unit With Streamlined Dataflow and Dual-Mode Parallelism for Maximizing Hardware Efficiency
papers.authors: Sukbin Lim, Jung-Hoon Kim, Seungjae Moon, Junseo Cha, Dongjin Seo, Jongho Kim, Hunjong Lee, Jinwon Lee, Joo-Young Kim
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of large language models (LLMs) as cross-domain foundation models is fueled by aggressive scaling in both parameter counts and inference-time computation. The emergence of sophisticated reasoning models further accelerates this trend, demanding longer context windows and escalating the computational and memory burdens of inference. A fundamental challenge arises from the bimodal nature of LLM inference, which consists of a compute-bound prefill phase and a memory-bound decode p
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）作为跨领域基础模型的普及，是由参数数量和推理时计算量的积极扩展推动的。复杂推理模型的出现进一步加速了这一趋势，需要更长的上下文窗口，并增加了推理的计算和内存负担。一个根本性的挑战源于LLM推理的双模态特性，其中包括计算受限的预填充阶段和内存受限的解码阶段。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the hardware inefficiency of LLM inference caused by its bimodal behavior: compute-bound prefill and memory-bound decode, especially under long-context and reasoning-heavy workloads. It proposes Adelia, a 4-nm LLM processing unit that combines a streamlined dataflow with dual-mode parallelism to optimize execution for both phases and improve compute/memory resource utilization. The main contribution is a hardware-efficient accelerator architecture for LLM serving that maximizes throughput and energy efficiency across the prefill–decode spectrum.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM 推理服务中 prefill 阶段计算受限、decode 阶段访存受限所导致的硬件利用率低问题，尤其面向长上下文和推理型模型带来的计算与内存压力。其核心方法是提出 4nm LLM 处理单元 Adelia，通过精简数据流降低数据搬移开销，并采用双模式并行分别适配 prefill 与 decode 阶段的不同瓶颈。主要结果是提升推理吞吐、能效和硬件利用率，为高效 LLM 推理加速器设计提供了可行路径。

papers.title: RAP: KV-Cache Compression via RoPE-Aligned Pruning
papers.authors: Jihao Xin, Tian Lyu, David E. Keyes, H. Ltaief, Marco Canini
papers.abstract_en: Long-context inference in large language models is increasingly bottlenecked by the memory and compute cost of the KV-Cache. Low-rank factorization compresses KV projections by writing $W \approx A * B$, where A produces latent KV states and B can be absorbed into downstream weights. In modern RoPE-based LLMs, this absorption fails: RoPE forces latent KV states to be reconstructed to full dimension, reintroducing substantial memory and compute overhead. We propose RoPE-Aligned Pruning (RAP), whi
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型中的长上下文推断越来越多地被KV缓存的内存和计算成本所限制。低秩分解通过写成 \ A * B$ $W 来压缩 KV 投影，其中 A 产生潜在 KV 态，B 可以被吸收到下游权重中。在现代基于RoPE的大型语言模型中，这种吸收失败：RoPE强制将潜在的KV状态重建为完整维度，重新引入大量内存和计算开销。我们提出采用RoPE对齐修剪（RAP），
papers.ai_summary_en: RAP targets the KV-cache memory and compute bottleneck in long-context RoPE-based LLM serving, where low-rank KV compression is limited because RoPE forces latent KV states to be reconstructed to full dimension. Its key idea is RoPE-aligned pruning, which removes KV-cache dimensions in a way compatible with RoPE’s rotational structure, avoiding costly full-dimensional reconstruction while preserving positional information. The method reduces KV-cache footprint and attention overhead during inference, improving long-context serving efficiency with minimal quality degradation.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 RoPE 架构大模型中低秩 KV 压缩必须先重建全维 KV 才能应用旋转位置编码、从而抵消内存与计算收益的问题。提出 RoPE 对齐剪枝 RAP，其核心洞见是按 RoPE 旋转维度进行结构化剪枝，使压缩后的 KV 状态可避免全维重建并直接服务于注意力计算。实验表明该方法在长上下文推理中显著降低 KV-Cache 开销，同时保持模型精度并提升服务吞吐。

papers.title: From Servers to Sites: Compositional Power Trace Generation of LLM Inference for Infrastructure Planning
papers.authors: Grant Wilkins, Fiodar Kazhamiaka, Ram Rajagopal
papers.abstract_en: Datacenter operators and electrical utilities rely on power traces at different spatiotemporal scales. Operators use fine-grained traces for provisioning, facility management, and scheduling, while utilities use site-level load profiles for capacity and interconnection planning. Existing datacenter power models do not capture LLM inference workloads, in which GPUs shift rapidly among compute-intensive prefill, lower-power decode, and idle states, and facility demand depends on how these states e
papers.abstract_cn: 数据中心运营商和电力公用事业依赖于不同时空尺度的电力轨迹。运营商使用细粒度轨迹进行配置、设施管理和调度，而公用事业则使用站点级负载曲线进行容量和互连规划。现有的数据中心电力模型无法捕捉大型语言模型推理工作负载，在这些负载中，GPU 在计算密集的预填充、低功耗解码和空闲状态之间快速切换，并且设施需求取决于这些状态的方式。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the lack of power models that capture LLM inference workloads, where GPUs rapidly switch between compute-intensive prefill, lower-power decode, and idle states, across server- and site-level timescales. It proposes a compositional power-trace generation framework that models request-level inference dynamics and GPU state transitions, then aggregates server power with facility overheads to produce scalable load profiles. This enables datacenter operators and utilities to perform more accurate provisioning, scheduling, and capacity planning for LLM serving infrastructure.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对现有数据中心功率模型难以刻画 LLM 推理中 GPU 在 prefill、decode 和 idle 状态间快速切换及其跨尺度聚合效应的问题。其核心方法是提出一种从服务器到站点的组合式功率轨迹生成框架，将微观推理状态与服务调度、批处理行为相结合，自底向上合成细粒度功率轨迹并聚合为站点级负荷曲线。该工作可为数据中心容量配置和电网互联规划提供更准确的 LLM 推理负载画像，有助于评估其峰值需求与波动性影响。

papers.title: Transformer-Based Resource and Stage-Aware Scheduling for Model-Parallel LLM Inference
papers.authors: Rami Naeem, Tengis Buyantogtokh, Hamada Rizk, Tatsuya Amano, Hirozumi Yamaguchi
papers.abstract_en: Current large language model (LLM) serving systems face three key limitations in distributed scheduling. First, most parallelization strategies are not stage-aware: they treat prefill and decode as uniform workloads despite their distinct compute and communication profiles. Second, many assume homogeneous hardware and ignore resource diversity in memory and bandwidth across nodes. Third, they overlook network congestion, as they are primarily designed for data-center environments with abundant i
papers.abstract_cn: 当前的大型语言模型（LLM）服务系统在分布式调度方面面临三个主要限制。首先，大多数并行化策略缺乏阶段感知：它们将预填充和解码视为均匀工作负载，尽管两者在计算和通信特性上存在差异。其次，许多策略假设硬件是同质的，并忽略节点之间内存和带宽的资源差异。第三，它们忽视网络拥塞，因为这些策略主要为拥有丰富网络资源的数据中心环境设计。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses distributed LLM inference scheduling, where existing systems inefficiently treat prefill and decode as uniform workloads and ignore heterogeneous node resources and network congestion. It proposes a transformer-based, resource- and stage-aware scheduler that models request and system state to coordinate model-parallel prefill/decode placement and execution across diverse hardware under congestion constraints. The approach enables more efficient LLM serving, improving latency/throughput or SLO attainment over stage-agnostic and homogeneous-hardware scheduling baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对模型并行 LLM 推理中 prefill 与 decode 阶段负载特性不同、异构节点资源差异以及网络拥塞被忽视的问题，提出一种基于 Transformer 的资源与阶段感知调度方法。其核心思路是利用 Transformer 建模请求阶段特征、节点内存/带宽资源状态和网络状况，从而动态优化模型并行推理的调度与放置。主要影响是在异构和网络受限环境下提升推理吞吐、降低延迟并改善服务稳定性。

papers.title: MemExplorer: Navigating the Heterogeneous Memory Design Space for Agentic Inference NPUs
papers.authors: Haoran Wu, Zeyu Cao, Yao Lai, Binglei Lou, Jiayi Nie, Can Xiao, T. Adeniran, Przemyslaw Forys, Kauser Johar, Catriona R Wright, Junyi Liu, Kai Shi, Nicholas D. Lane, R. Antonova, Jianyi Cheng, Timothy Jones, Aaron Zhao, Robert Mullins
papers.abstract_en: Emerging agentic LLM workloads are driving rapidly growing demand on both memory capacity and bandwidth, with different phases of inference (e.g., prefill and decode) imposing distinct requirements. Industry is responding by composing heterogeneous accelerators into single interconnected systems, as exemplified by NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform, where each device brings its own memory architecture. This heterogeneity is further compounded by a widening landscape of available memory technologies: h
papers.abstract_cn: 新兴的自主智能大语言模型（LLM）工作负载正在推动对内存容量和带宽的快速增长需求，不同的推理阶段（例如预填充和解码）对内存提出了不同的要求。业界正在通过将异构加速器组合成单一的互连系统来应对这一需求，这在 NVIDIA 的 Vera Rubin 平台中得到了体现，每个设备都带有自身的内存架构。随着可用内存技术种类的不断增加，这种异构性进一步加剧。
papers.ai_summary_en: MemExplorer addresses the memory-capacity and bandwidth bottlenecks in agentic LLM serving, where inference phases such as prefill and decode impose different demands across heterogeneous accelerator systems. It proposes a design-space exploration framework that models phase-specific workload behavior, diverse memory technologies, and device-level heterogeneity to evaluate NPU memory architectures. The work provides architectural guidance for multi-device inference platforms, exposing key tradeoffs among throughput, latency, efficiency, and cost.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 agentic LLM 推理中 prefill 与 decode 阶段对内存容量和带宽需求差异显著、且异构 NPU 平台与多种内存技术使设计空间复杂化的问题展开研究。其核心方法是提出 MemExplorer，对异构加速器及其内存架构进行统一建模与设计空间探索，以面向不同推理阶段权衡容量、带宽和系统效率。该工作可为 LLM serving 系统的内存配置与架构选择提供指导，缓解 agentic 推理中的内存瓶颈并提升整体服务效率。

papers.title: Scout Before You Attend: Sketch-and-Walk Sparse Attention for Efficient LLM Inference
papers.authors: Hoang Anh Le, Sahil Joshi, Zeyu Yang, Zhaozhuo Xu, Anshumali Shrivastava
papers.abstract_en: Self-attention dominates the computational and memory cost of long-context LLM inference across both prefill and decode phases. To address this challenge, we introduce Sketch&Walk Attention, a training-free sparse attention method that determines sparsity with lightweight sketches and deterministic walk. Sketch&Walk applies Hadamard sketching to get inexpensive approximations of attention scores, then aggregates these estimates across layers via a walk mechanism that captures attention influence
papers.abstract_cn: 自注意力在长上下文大语言模型推理的预填充和解码阶段都占据了计算和内存成本的主导地位。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了 Sketch&Walk 注意力，一种无需训练的稀疏注意力方法，通过轻量级的草图和确定性游走来确定稀疏性。Sketch&Walk 应用 Hadamard 草图来获得注意力分数的低成本近似，然后通过游走机制在各层汇总这些估计，以捕捉注意力的影响。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the high computational and memory cost of self-attention in long-context LLM inference, covering both prefill and decode phases. It proposes Sketch&Walk Attention, a training-free sparse attention method that uses Hadamard sketching to approximate attention scores cheaply and a deterministic cross-layer “walk” to propagate attention influence and select sparse patterns. The approach reduces inference cost while preserving model quality, offering a practical efficiency improvement for long-context LLM serving.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 推理中自注意力在预填充和解码阶段造成的计算与内存瓶颈，提出了一种训练免费的稀疏注意力方法 Sketch&Walk。其核心洞见是先用 Hadamard sketch 低成本近似注意力分数，再通过跨层的确定性 walk 聚合注意力影响，从而高效确定关键稀疏模式。该方法可在不重新训练的情况下减少注意力计算开销，提升长上下文 LLM 服务效率。

papers.title: InnerQ: Hardware-aware Tuning-free Quantization of KV Cache for Large Language Models
papers.authors: Sayed Mohammadreza Tayaranian Hosseini, Amir Ardakani, W. Gross
papers.abstract_en: Reducing the hardware footprint of large language models (LLMs) during decoding is critical for efficient long-sequence generation. A key bottleneck is the key-value (KV) cache, whose size scales with sequence length and easily dominates the memory footprint of the model. Previous work proposed quantization methods that are focused on compressing the KV cache while maintaining its information. We introduce InnerQ, a hardware-aware KV-cache quantization scheme that lowers decode latency without s
papers.abstract_cn: 在解码过程中减少大型语言模型（LLM）的硬件占用对于高效的长序列生成至关重要。一个关键的瓶颈是键值（KV）缓存，其大小随着序列长度增加而增加，很容易主导模型的内存占用。以往的工作提出了量化方法，专注于在保持信息的同时压缩KV缓存。我们引入了InnerQ，这是一种硬件感知的KV缓存量化方案，可以降低解码延迟而不影响
papers.ai_summary_en: InnerQ addresses the KV-cache memory and bandwidth bottleneck in long-context LLM decoding, where prior quantization methods often reduce cache size but do not translate into real hardware latency gains. It proposes a tuning-free, hardware-aware low-bit KV-cache quantization scheme whose scaling granularity, data layout, and dequantization path are co-designed for GPU execution while preserving attention inner-product fidelity. The method reduces KV-cache footprint and decode latency with negligible degradation in generation quality, improving efficient LLM serving.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大语言模型长序列解码中 KV Cache 内存占用高、制约推理延迟的问题，提出 InnerQ：一种面向硬件特性、无需微调的 KV Cache 量化方案。其核心洞见是在压缩 KV Cache 的同时兼顾硬件执行效率，从而在不引入额外调优成本的情况下降低解码开销。该方法有助于减少长文本生成中的内存压力并提升 LLM 服务吞吐与延迟表现。

papers.title: PICNIC: Silicon Photonic Interconnected Chiplets with Computational Network and In-memory Computing for LLM Inference Acceleration
papers.authors: Yue Jiet Chong, Yimin Wang, Zhen Wu, Xuanyao Fong
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a 3D-stacked chiplets based large language model (LLM) inference accelerator, consisting of non-volatile in-memory-computing processing elements (PEs) and Inter-PE Computational Network (IPCN), interconnected via silicon photonic to effectively address the communication bottlenecks. A LLM mapping scheme was developed to optimize hardware scheduling and workload mapping. Simulation results show it achieves $3.95\times$ speedup and $30\times$ efficiency improvement over the Nvidia A100 before chiplet clustering and power gating scheme (CCPG). Additionally, the system achieves further scalability and efficiency improvement with the implementation of CCPG to accommodate larger models, attaining $57\times$ efficiency improvement over Nvidia H100 at similar throughput.
papers.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种基于3D堆叠芯粒的大型语言模型（LLM）推理加速器，该加速器由非易失性内存计算处理单元（PEs）和PE间计算网络（IPCN）组成，通过硅光互连以有效解决通信瓶颈问题。开发了一种LLM映射方案，以优化硬件调度和工作负载映射。模拟结果显示，在芯粒聚类和功率门控方案（CCPG）之前，相较于Nvidia A100，其速度提升了$3.95	imes$，效率提高了$30	imes$。此外，通过实现CCPG以适应更大模型，系统实现了进一步的可扩展性和效率提升，在类似吞吐量下，相较于Nvidia H100，效率提高了$57	imes$。
papers.ai_summary_en:
PICNIC targets communication and memory bottlenecks in LLM inference by proposing a 3D-stacked chiplet accelerator that combines non-volatile in-memory-computing processing elements, an inter-PE computational network, and silicon-photonic interconnects.  
It introduces a hardware-aware LLM mapping and scheduling scheme, along with chiplet clustering and power gating, to improve scalability and efficiency for larger models.  
Simulations show 3.95× speedup and 30× efficiency over an NVIDIA A100 baseline, and up to 57× efficiency over an H100 at comparable throughput.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向大模型推理中的互连带宽与存储访问瓶颈，提出一种基于3D堆叠chiplet的LLM推理加速器，通过非易失性存内计算PE、PE间计算网络（IPCN）和硅光互连结合，并设计LLM映射与调度方案来提升计算效率。其进一步引入chiplet聚类与功耗门控（CCPG）以增强大模型可扩展性和能效。仿真显示，相较A100可获得3.95倍加速和30倍能效提升；在相近吞吐下，相较H100能效提升可达57倍。

papers.title: Optimizing LLM inference for FPGAs
papers.authors: J. R. de Freitas, J. G. Coutinho, Ce Guo, S. Demirsoy, Wayne Luk, Zhiqiang Que
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) deliver state-of-the-art performance but demand high computation and memory, making deployment in resource-limited settings challenging. Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) offer parallelism and efficiency, yet most prior FPGA accelerators rely on low-level, platform-specific flows that hinder portability. This work presents oneLLM, to our knowledge, the first FPGA-based LLM inference design using Intel’s oneAPI, enabling a unified high-level programming model across CPUs, GPUs, and FPGAs. Our deeply pipelined, multi-kernel hardware architecture connects specialized kernels via oneAPI pipes for on-chip streaming, reducing host–device communication. Implemented on an Intel Agilex 7 FPGA, it achieves 3 times faster than a CPU implementation, and 8.8 times faster than a non-pipelined baseline while meeting resource constraints, demonstrating the potential of portable FPGA development for LLM acceleration. Code available at https://github.com/custom-computin
papers.abstract_cn: 大规模语言模型（LLMs）提供了最先进的性能，但需要高计算能力和内存，使得在资源有限的环境中部署具有挑战性。现场可编程门阵列（FPGAs）提供并行性和效率，但大多数现有 FPGA 加速器依赖低级别、平台特定的流程，限制了可移植性。本工作提出了 oneLLM，据我们所知，这是第一个基于 FPGA 的 LLM 推理设计，使用英特尔的 oneAPI，实现了跨 CPU、GPU 和 FPGA 的统一高层编程模型。我们深度流水线、多核硬件架构通过 oneAPI 管道连接专用内核，实现片上流传输，减少主机与设备之间的通信。在 Intel Agilex 7 FPGA 上实现后，其速度比 CPU 实现快 3 倍，比非流水线基线快 8.8 倍，同时满足资源约束，展示了可移植 FPGA 开发加速 LLM 的潜力。代码可在 https://github.com/custom-computin 获取。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of deploying LLM inference on resource-constrained FPGAs, where prior accelerators often depend on low-level, platform-specific design flows that limit portability. It proposes oneLLM, an Intel oneAPI-based FPGA accelerator using a deeply pipelined multi-kernel architecture with on-chip streaming via oneAPI pipes to reduce host–device communication. Implemented on an Intel Agilex 7 FPGA, it achieves 3× higher throughput than a CPU implementation and 8.8× over a non-pipelined baseline while fitting resource constraints, demonstrating portable high-level FPGA development for LLM acceleration.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该工作面向资源受限场景下的大模型推理部署问题，重点解决现有 FPGA 加速器依赖底层、平台特定流程而导致可移植性差的挑战。  
论文提出 oneLLM，采用 Intel oneAPI 构建统一的高层 FPGA 推理设计，通过深度流水线的多内核架构和 oneAPI pipes 实现片上流式传输，减少主机与设备间通信开销。  
在 Intel Agilex 7 FPGA 上，其推理速度比 CPU 实现快 3 倍、比非流水线基线快 8.8 倍，并在资源约束下验证了可移植 FPGA 加速 LLM 推理的潜力。

papers.title: FastMTP: Accelerating LLM Inference with Enhanced Multi-Token Prediction
papers.authors: Yuxuan Cai, Xiaozhuan Liang, Xinghua Wang, Jin Ma, Haijin Liang, Jinwen Luo, Xinyu Zuo, Lisheng Duan, Yuyang Yin, Xi Chen
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly powerful, the sequential nature of autoregressive generation creates a fundamental throughput bottleneck that limits the practical deployment. While Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) has demonstrated remarkable benefits for model training efficiency and performance, its inherent potential for inference acceleration remains largely unexplored. This paper introduces FastMTP, a simple yet effective method that improves multi-step draft quality by aligning MTP training with its inference pattern, significantly enhancing speculative decoding performance. Our approach fine-tunes a single MTP head with position-shared weights on self-distilled data, enabling it to capture dependencies among consecutive future tokens and maintain high acceptance rates across multiple recursive draft steps. By integrating language-aware dynamic vocabulary compression into the MTP head, we further reduce computational overhead in the drafting process. Experimental r
papers.abstract_cn: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）变得越来越强大，自回归生成的序列特性造成了一个根本性的吞吐量瓶颈，限制了其实际部署。虽然多标记预测（MTP）在模型训练效率和性能方面已显示出显著的优势，但其在推理加速方面的潜在能力仍 largely 未被充分探索。本文提出了 FastMTP，一种简单而有效的方法，通过将 MTP 训练与其推理模式对齐来提高多步草稿质量，从而显著增强了推测解码性能。我们的方法在自蒸馏数据上对单个 MTP 头进行位置共享权重的微调，使其能够捕捉连续未来标记之间的依赖关系，并在多个递归草稿步骤中保持高接受率。通过将语言感知的动态词汇压缩集成到 MTP 头中，我们进一步降低了草稿过程中的计算开销。实验结果表明
papers.ai_summary_en: FastMTP addresses the autoregressive throughput bottleneck in LLM serving by improving multi-token prediction as a drafting mechanism for speculative decoding. It fine-tunes a single position-shared MTP head on self-distilled data to model dependencies among consecutive future tokens and adds language-aware dynamic vocabulary compression to reduce drafting overhead. This alignment between MTP training and recursive inference yields higher multi-step acceptance rates and more efficient LLM inference.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM自回归推理吞吐受限、且多token预测（MTP）在推测解码中多步草稿质量不足的问题。FastMTP通过自蒸馏数据微调一个位置共享权重的单一MTP头，使训练与递归多步推理模式对齐，并引入语言感知动态词表压缩来降低草稿计算开销。该方法能更好建模连续未来token依赖、保持较高接受率，从而提升推测解码的推理加速效果。

papers.title: P3-LLM: An Integrated NPU-PIM Accelerator for LLM Inference Using Hybrid Numerical Formats
papers.authors: Yuzong Chen, Chao Fang, Xilai Dai, Yuheng Wu, Thierry Tambe, Marian Verhelst, Mohamed S. Abdelfattah
papers.abstract_en: The substantial memory bandwidth and computational demands of large language models (LLMs) present critical challenges for efficient inference. To tackle this, the literature has explored heterogeneous systems that combine neural processing units (NPUs) with DRAM-based processing-in-memory (PIM) for LLM acceleration. However, existing high-precision (e.g., FP16) PIM compute units incur significant area and power overhead in DRAM technology, limiting the effective computation throughput. In this paper, we introduce P3-LLM, a novel NPU-PIM integrated accelerator for LLM inference using hybrid numerical formats. Our approach is threefold: First, we propose a flexible mixed-precision quantization scheme, which leverages hybrid numerical formats to quantize different LLM operands with high compression efficiency and minimal accuracy loss. Second, we architect an efficient PIM accelerator for P3-LLM, featuring enhanced compute units to support hybrid numerical formats. Our careful choice of
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）对内存带宽和计算能力的巨大需求，为高效推理带来了关键挑战。为应对这一问题，相关文献探索了将神经处理单元（NPU）与基于DRAM的计算-内存（PIM）结合的异构系统，以加速LLM。然而，现有的高精度（如FP16）PIM计算单元在DRAM技术中会产生显著的面积和功耗开销，从而限制有效计算吞吐量。本文中，我们提出了P3-LLM，一种新型的NPU-PIM集成加速器，利用混合数值格式进行LLM推理。我们的方法包括三方面：首先，我们提出了一种灵活的混合精度量化方案，该方案利用混合数值格式对不同LLM操作数进行量化，实现高压缩效率并将精度损失降到最低。其次，我们为P3-LLM设计了高效的PIM加速器，其增强的计算单元支持混合数值格式。我们精心选择的
papers.ai_summary_en: P3-LLM addresses the memory-bandwidth and compute bottlenecks of LLM inference, particularly the area and power overhead of high-precision DRAM-based PIM units. It proposes an NPU-PIM co-design that uses flexible mixed-precision quantization with hybrid numerical formats and enhanced PIM compute units to process different operands efficiently. The result is reduced data movement and hardware cost with minimal accuracy loss, improving LLM inference throughput and energy efficiency over conventional high-precision PIM approaches.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大语言模型推理中内存带宽和算力瓶颈，以及现有高精度 DRAM PIM 计算单元面积与功耗过高的问题，提出 NPU-PIM 协同加速器 P3-LLM。其核心思路是采用混合数值格式的灵活混合精度量化，并设计支持这些格式的 PIM 计算单元，以在压缩模型操作数的同时降低精度损失。该工作有望在保持推理精度的前提下提升有效计算吞吐并降低 PIM 硬件开销。

papers.title: UniCAIM: A Unified CAM/CIM Architecture with Static-Dynamic KV Cache Pruning for Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.authors: Weikai Xu, Wenxuan Zeng, Qianqian Huang, Meng Li, Ruei-Hao Huang
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) have achieved impressive performance in various natural language processing (NLP) applications. However, the high memory and computation cost induced by the KV cache limits the inference efficiency, especially for long input sequences. Compute-in-memory (CIM)-based accelerators have been proposed for LLM acceleration with KV cache pruning. However, as existing accelerators only support static pruning with a fixed pattern or dynamic pruning with primitive implementations, they suffer from either high accuracy degradation or low efficiency. In this paper, we propose a ferroelectric FET (FeFET)-based unified content addressable memory (CAM) and CIM architecture, dubbed as UniCAIM. UniCAIM features simultaneous support for static and dynamic pruning with 3 computation modes: 1) in the CAM mode, UniCAIM enables approximate similarity measurement in $\mathcal{O}(1)$ time for dynamic KV cache pruning with high energy efficiency; 2) in the charge-
papers.abstract_cn: 基于Transformer的大型语言模型（LLM）在各种自然语言处理（NLP）应用中取得了令人印象深刻的性能。然而，KV缓存带来的高内存和计算成本限制了推理效率，尤其是在长输入序列时。基于内存计算（CIM）的加速器已被提出用于通过KV缓存修剪实现LLM加速。然而，由于现有加速器仅支持固定模式的静态剪枝或原始实现的动态剪枝，因此它们要么存在高精度下降或效率低下的问题。本文提出了一种基于铁电场效应晶体（FeFET）的统一内容可寻址存储器（CAM）和CIM架构，称为UniCAIM。UniCAIM支持静态和动态剪枝，支持三种计算模式：1）在CAM模式下，UniCAIM能够在$\mathcal{O}（1）$时间内实现近似相似度测量，实现动态KV缓存剪枝，且能效高;2）在冲刺中——
papers.ai_summary_en: UniCAIM addresses the KV-cache memory and computation bottleneck in long-context LLM serving, where existing CIM accelerators either use fixed static pruning and lose accuracy or implement dynamic pruning inefficiently. It proposes a FeFET-based unified CAM/CIM architecture that supports static and dynamic KV-cache pruning across multiple computation modes, using CAM-mode approximate similarity search in O(1) time to select important tokens efficiently. The design enables more energy-efficient long-context inference by combining accurate dynamic cache selection with in-memory attention computation, reducing the efficiency/accuracy tradeoff of prior pruning accelerators.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV cache 带来的高内存与计算开销问题，指出现有 CIM 加速器难以同时兼顾静态剪枝的效率与动态剪枝的精度。其核心方法是提出基于 FeFET 的统一 CAM/CIM 架构 UniCAIM，通过 CAM 模式实现 O(1) 近似相似度度量以支持高能效动态 KV cache 剪枝，并结合多种计算模式统一支持静态与动态剪枝。该设计有望在降低长序列推理开销的同时减少精度损失，为高效 LLM serving 提供新的硬件加速路径。

papers.title: La RoSA: Enhancing LLM Efficiency via Layerwise Rotated Sparse Activation
papers.authors: Kai Liu, Bowen Xu, Shaoyu Wu, Xin Chen, Hao Zhou, Yongliang Tao, Lulu Hu
papers.abstract_en: Activation sparsity can reduce the computational overhead and memory transfers during the forward pass of Large Language Model (LLM) inference. Existing methods face limitations, either demanding time-consuming recovery training that hinders real-world adoption, or relying on empirical magnitude-based pruning, which causes fluctuating sparsity and unstable inference speed-up. This paper introduces LaRoSA (Layerwise Rotated Sparse Activation), a novel method for activation sparsification designed to improve LLM efficiency without requiring additional training or magnitude-based pruning. We leverage layerwise orthogonal rotations to transform input activations into rotated forms that are more suitable for sparsification. By employing a Top-K selection approach within the rotated activations, we achieve consistent model-level sparsity and reliable wall-clock time speed-up. LaRoSA is effective across various sizes and types of LLMs, demonstrating minimal performance degradation and robust
papers.abstract_cn: 激活稀疏性可以在大型语言模型（LLM）推理的前向传递过程中减少计算开销和内存传输。现有方法存在局限性，要么需要耗时的恢复训练，阻碍了实际应用，要么依赖经验性基于大小的剪枝，导致稀疏性波动和推理速度不稳定。本文提出了 LaRoSA（Layerwise Rotated Sparse Activation，逐层旋转稀疏激活），一种旨在提高 LLM 效率的激活稀疏化新方法，无需额外训练或基于大小的剪枝。我们利用逐层正交旋转，将输入激活转换为更适合稀疏化的旋转形式。通过在旋转激活中采用 Top-K 选择方法，我们实现了一致的模型级稀疏性和可靠的实际时间加速。LaRoSA 在各种规模和类型的 LLM 中均表现有效，性能降级极小且稳健。
papers.ai_summary_en: La RoSA addresses inefficient LLM inference caused by activation-sparsity methods that require costly recovery training or unstable magnitude-based pruning. It applies layerwise orthogonal rotations to activations to create a representation more amenable to sparsification, then uses Top-K selection to enforce consistent model-level sparsity without additional training. The method achieves reliable wall-clock speedups across diverse LLMs with minimal performance degradation.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM 推理中激活稀疏化方法要么需要额外恢复训练、要么因幅值剪枝导致稀疏率不稳定和加速不可靠的问题，提出 La RoSA。其核心洞见是通过逐层正交旋转重塑激活分布，再在旋转后的激活中做 Top-K 选择，从而无需训练即可实现稳定、一致的模型级稀疏。实验表明，该方法在多种规模和类型 LLM 上均能带来可靠墙钟加速，同时保持较小性能损失和较强鲁棒性。

papers.title: Efficient Kernel Mapping and Comprehensive System Evaluation of LLM Acceleration on a CGLA
papers.authors: Takuto Ando, Yu Eto, Ayumu Takeuchi, Yasuhiko Nakashima
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) demand substantial computational resources, resulting in high energy consumption on GPUs. To address this challenge, we focus on Coarse-Grained Reconfigurable Arrays (CGRAs) as an effective alternative that provides a trade-off between energy efficiency and programmability. This paper presents the first comprehensive, end-to-end evaluation of a non-AI-specialized Coarse-Grained Linear Array (CGLA) accelerator for the state-of-the-art Qwen3 LLM family. The architecture has a general-purpose, task-agnostic design, yet its flexible instruction set allows for domain-specific adaptations. This flexibility enables the architecture to achieve high efficiency for sustainable LLM inference. We assess the performance of our architecture on an FPGA prototype using the widely adopted llama.cpp framework. We then project its potential as a 28 nm ASIC and compare it against a high-performance GPU (NVIDIA RTX 4090) and an edge AI device (NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin). While GPU
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型 (LLMs) 需要大量的计算资源，导致 GPU 上的高能耗。为了解决这一挑战，我们关注粗粒度可重构阵列 (CGRAs) 作为一种有效的替代方案，它在能效和可编程性之间提供了折衷。本文首次对非人工智能专用的粗粒度线性阵列 (CGLA) 加速器在最先进的 Qwen3 LLM 系列上的端到端综合评估。该架构具有通用、与任务无关的设计，但其灵活的指令集允许进行特定领域的适配。这种灵活性使得该架构能够实现可持续 LLM 推理的高效能。我们使用广泛采用的 llama.cpp 框架在 FPGA 原型上评估了该架构的性能。然后，我们将其作为 28 nm ASIC 的潜力进行预测，并与高性能 GPU（NVIDIA RTX 4090）和边缘 AI 设备（NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin）进行比较。虽然 GPU
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles the high energy cost of GPU-based LLM serving by evaluating whether a general-purpose, non-AI-specialized Coarse-Grained Linear Array (CGLA) can efficiently run modern LLM inference. It presents an end-to-end kernel mapping and system study for the Qwen3 family on an FPGA-prototyped CGLA using llama.cpp, and projects a 28 nm ASIC implementation for comparison against an NVIDIA RTX 4090 and Jetson AGX Orin. The work demonstrates that a flexible, task-agnostic CGLA can provide a viable performance–efficiency trade-off for sustainable LLM acceleration, offering an alternative to domain-specific AI hardware.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大语言模型推理在GPU上能耗高的问题，研究通用、非AI专用的粗粒度线性阵列（CGLA）作为高能效加速替代方案。其核心方法是结合灵活指令集与高效算子映射，在FPGA原型上基于llama.cpp对Qwen3系列模型进行端到端评测，并进一步投射到28 nm ASIC。结果显示，该架构在与NVIDIA RTX 4090和Jetson AGX Orin的比较中展现出可持续LLM推理的能效潜力，为通用可重构加速器服务大模型提供了系统级依据。

papers.title: CompAir: Synergizing Complementary PIMs and In-Transit NoC Computation for Efficient LLM Acceleration
papers.authors: Hongyi Li, Songchen Ma, Huanyu Qu, Weihao Zhang, Jia Chen, Junfeng Lin, Fengbin Tu, Rong Zhao
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has revolutionized various aspects of human life, yet their immense computational and energy demands pose significant challenges for efficient inference. The memory wall, the growing processor-memory speed disparity, remains a critical bottleneck for LLM. Process-In-Memory (PIM) architectures overcome limitations by co-locating compute units with memory, leveraging 5-20$\times$ higher internal bandwidth and enabling greater energy efficiency than GPUs. However, existing PIMs struggle to balance flexibility, performance, and cost-efficiency for LLMs'dynamic memory-compute patterns and operator diversity. DRAM-PIM suffers from inter-bank communication overhead despite its vector parallelism. SRAM-PIM offers sub-10ns latency for matrix operation but is constrained by limited capacity. This work introduces CompAir, a novel PIM architecture that integrates DRAM-PIM and SRAM-PIM with hybrid bonding, enabling efficient linear computations
papers.abstract_cn: 大规模语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展已经彻底改变了人类生活的各个方面，然而其巨大的计算和能源需求对高效推理构成了重大挑战。存储墙——处理器与内存速度差距不断增大的问题——仍然是LLM的关键瓶颈。内存计算（PIM）架构通过将计算单元与内存共置来克服这一限制，利用5-20倍更高的内部带宽，并实现比GPU更高的能效。然而，现有的PIM在应对LLM动态内存-计算模式和算子多样性时，难以在灵活性、性能和成本效率之间取得平衡。DRAM-PIM尽管具备向量并行能力，但遭受跨Bank通信开销的影响。SRAM-PIM在矩阵运算中提供低于10纳秒的延迟，但受到容量有限的制约。本文提出了CompAir，一种新型PIM架构，它通过混合绑定集成了DRAM-PIM和SRAM-PIM，从而实现高效的线性计算。
papers.ai_summary_en: CompAir addresses the LLM inference memory-wall bottleneck and the difficulty of using homogeneous PIM architectures to simultaneously provide high capacity, low-latency matrix compute, and flexible data movement. It integrates DRAM-PIM and SRAM-PIM through hybrid bonding and adds in-transit NoC computation, allowing linear layers to exploit DRAM-side vector parallelism while using SRAM-side matrix units with reduced inter-bank traffic. The design improves LLM serving efficiency and performance by balancing capacity, compute density, and data locality better than conventional GPU or single-technology PIM approaches.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向大模型推理中的“内存墙”问题，以及现有 DRAM-PIM 与 SRAM-PIM 难以同时兼顾灵活性、性能和成本效率的挑战。CompAir 通过混合键合集成 DRAM-PIM 的大容量/向量并行能力与 SRAM-PIM 的低延迟矩阵计算能力，并结合 NoC 在途计算来协同加速 LLM 中的线性计算等关键操作。该架构利用近存/存内计算的高带宽与能效优势，为 LLM serving 提供了更均衡、高效的硬件加速方案。

papers.title: Acceleration Multiple Heads Decoding for LLM via Dynamic Tree Attention
papers.authors: Zhendong Zhang
papers.abstract_en: Multiple heads decoding accelerates the inference of Large Language Models (LLMs) by predicting next several tokens simultaneously. It generates and verifies multiple candidate sequences in parallel via tree attention with a fixed structure. In this paper, we replace the fixed tree attention with dynamic tree attention on multiple head decoding, specifically in the context of MEDUSA. We propose a simple and low complexity strategy to generate candidates and construct the dynamic tree structure. Preliminary experiments show that the proposed method improves the decoding efficiency of multiple head decoding for LLMs while maintaining the generation quality. This result demonstrates the potential for improvement of multiple head decoding in candidate generation.
papers.abstract_cn: 多头解码通过同时预测接下来的多个标记来加速大型语言模型（LLMs）的推理。它通过具有固定结构的树注意机制并行生成和验证多个候选序列。在本文中，我们在多头解码中用动态树注意机制替换固定的树注意，特别是在MEDUSA的背景下。我们提出了一种简单且低复杂度的策略来生成候选并构建动态树结构。初步实验表明，该方法在保持生成质量的同时，提高了LLMs多头解码的解码效率。这一结果展示了在候选生成方面改进多头解码的潜力。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses inefficiency in multi-head speculative LLM decoding methods such as MEDUSA, where fixed tree-attention structures can waste computation on low-quality candidate continuations. It proposes replacing the static candidate tree with a dynamically constructed tree generated by a low-complexity candidate-selection strategy, allowing verification attention to focus on more promising parallel token sequences. Preliminary results show improved decoding efficiency over fixed-tree multi-head decoding while preserving generation quality, indicating that adaptive candidate generation can better exploit speculative decoding.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM多头解码中固定树注意力结构导致候选生成与验证效率受限的问题。其核心方法是在MEDUSA框架下引入动态树注意力，并提出一种低复杂度策略来自适应生成候选token和构建树结构。初步实验表明，该方法在保持生成质量的同时提升了解码加速效果，展示了优化候选生成对LLM推理服务的潜力。

papers.title: Research on Low-Latency Inference and Training Efficiency Optimization for Graph Neural Network and Large Language Model-Based Recommendation Systems
papers.authors: Yushang Zhao, Haotian Lyu, Yike Peng, Aijia Sun, Feng Jiang, Xinyue Han
papers.abstract_en: The incessant advent of online services demands high speed and efficient recommender systems (ReS) that can maintain real-time performance along with processing very complex user-item interactions. The present study, therefore, considers computational bottlenecks involved in hybrid Graph Neural Network (GNN) and Large Language Model (LLM)-based ReS with the aim optimizing their inference latency and training efficiency. An extensive methodology was used: hybrid GNN-LLM integrated architecture-optimization strategies (quantization, LoRA, distillation)-hardware acceleration (FPGA, DeepSpeed)-all under R 4.4.2. Experimental improvements were significant, with the optimal Hybrid + FPGA + DeepSpeed configuration reaching 13.6 % more accuracy (NDCG@10: 0.75) at $40-60 ~\text{ms}$ of latency, while LoRA brought down training time by $66 \%(3.8 \text{hours})$ in comparison to the non-optimized baseline. Irrespective of domain, such as accuracy or efficiency, it can be established that hardware
papers.abstract_cn: 在线服务的不断涌现要求高速度和高效的推荐系统（ReS），能够在处理非常复杂的用户-项目交互的同时保持实时性能。因此，本研究考虑了基于混合图神经网络（GNN）和大语言模型（LLM）的推荐系统中涉及的计算瓶颈，目的是优化它们的推理延迟和训练效率。采用了广泛的方法：混合GNN-LLM集成架构优化策略（量化、LoRA、蒸馏）-硬件加速（FPGA，DeepSpeed）-所有操作均在R 4.4.2下进行。实验改进显著，其中最佳的混合FPGA-DeepSpeed配置在$40-60 ~\text{ms}$的延迟下，准确率提高了13.6%（NDCG@10: 0.75），而LoRA相比未优化的基线将训练时间缩短了66%（3.8小时）。无论是在准确性还是效率等领域，都可以确定硬件
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses computational bottlenecks in hybrid GNN–LLM recommender systems, focusing on reducing inference latency and training cost while preserving recommendation accuracy. It proposes an integrated optimization stack combining a hybrid GNN-LLM architecture with quantization, LoRA, knowledge distillation, and acceleration via FPGA and DeepSpeed. Experiments show that the best configuration achieves NDCG@10 = 0.75, a 13.6% accuracy gain, at 40–60 ms latency, while LoRA reduces training time by 66% to 3.8 hours.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对图神经网络与大语言模型混合推荐系统在复杂用户-物品交互场景下的推理延迟高、训练效率低问题，提出结合量化、LoRA、知识蒸馏以及 FPGA 和 DeepSpeed 加速的软硬件协同优化方法。实验表明，最优配置可将 NDCG@10 提升至 0.75、相对准确率提高 13.6%，推理延迟降至 40–60 ms，同时 LoRA 将训练时间缩短 66% 至 3.8 小时。

papers.title: SLED: A Speculative LLM Decoding Framework for Efficient Edge Serving
papers.authors: Xiangchen Li, Dimitrios Spatharakis, Saeid Ghafouri, Jiakun Fan, Hans Vandierendonck, Deepu John, Bo Ji, Dimitrios S. Nikolopoulos
papers.abstract_en: The growing gap between the increasing complexity of large language models (LLMs) and the limited computational budgets of edge devices poses a key challenge for efficient on-device inference, despite gradual improvements in hardware capabilities. Existing strategies, such as aggressive quantization, pruning, or remote inference, trade accuracy for efficiency or lead to substantial cost burdens. This position paper introduces a new framework that leverages speculative decoding, previously viewed primarily as a decoding acceleration technique for autoregressive generation of LLMs, as a promising approach specifically adapted for edge computing by orchestrating computation across heterogeneous devices. We propose SLED, a framework that allows lightweight edge devices to draft multiple candidate tokens locally using diverse draft models, while a single, shared edge server verifies the tokens utilizing a more precise target model. To further increase the efficiency of verification, the edg
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）日益增长的复杂性与边缘设备有限的计算预算之间的差距，尽管硬件能力逐渐提高，但仍然对高效的设备端推理构成了关键挑战。现有的策略，如激进量化、剪枝或远程推理，往往以牺牲准确性来换取效率，或者带来可观的成本负担。本立场论文提出了一种新框架，利用此前主要被视为LLM自回归生成解码加速技术的推测解码，作为一种有前景的方法，专门适配于通过跨异构设备协同计算的边缘计算。我们提出了SLED，一种框架，允许轻量级边缘设备使用多样化的草稿模型在本地起草多个候选令牌，而单个共享的边缘服务器则利用更精准的目标模型对这些令牌进行验证。为进一步提高验证效率，边缘
papers.ai_summary_en: SLED addresses the challenge of serving large language models on resource-constrained edge devices without relying on accuracy-degrading compression or costly remote inference. It proposes a speculative decoding framework in which lightweight edge devices generate candidate tokens using local draft models, while a shared edge server verifies them with the full target model to preserve output quality. The paper positions heterogeneous speculative decoding as an efficient edge-serving paradigm that can reduce latency and infrastructure cost while maintaining target-model accuracy.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型在边缘设备上推理受限、而量化/剪枝或远程推理又牺牲精度或增加成本的问题，提出面向边缘服务的投机解码框架 SLED。其核心思路是让多个轻量边缘设备用不同草稿模型本地生成候选 token，再由共享边缘服务器上的目标模型统一验证，从而在异构设备间协同分配计算。论文将投机解码从单纯加速技术提升为边缘推理的系统化服务方案，有望在保持模型精度的同时提升边缘 LLM 服务效率并降低成本。

papers.title: LightMamba: Efficient Mamba Acceleration on FPGA with Quantization and Hardware Co-design
papers.authors: Renjie Wei, Songqiang Xu, Linfeng Zhong, Zebin Yang, Qingyu Guo, Yuan Wang, Runsheng Wang, Meng Li
papers.abstract_en: State space models (SSMs) like Mamba have recently attracted much attention. Compared to Transformer-based large language models (LLMs), Mamba achieves linear computation complexity with the sequence length and demonstrates superior performance. However, Mamba is hard to accelerate due to the scattered activation outliers and the complex computation dependency, rendering existing LLM accelerators inefficient. In this paper, we propose LightMamba that co-designs the quantization algorithm and FPGA accelerator architecture for efficient Mamba inference. We first propose an FPGA-friendly post-training quantization algorithm that features rotation-assisted quantization and power-of-two SSM quantization to reduce the majority of computation to 4-bit. We further design an FPGA accelerator that partially unrolls the Mamba computation to balance the efficiency and hardware costs. Through computation reordering as well as fine-grained tiling and fusion, the hardware utilization and memory effic
papers.abstract_cn: 像 Mamba 这样的状态空间模型（SSM）近年来受到了广泛关注。与基于 Transformer 的大型语言模型（LLM）相比，Mamba 在序列长度上实现了线性计算复杂度，并展示了优越的性能。然而，由于激活值异常分散和计算依赖复杂，Mamba 很难加速，这使得现有的 LLM 加速器效率低下。在本文中，我们提出了 LightMamba，通过联合设计量化算法和 FPGA 加速器架构，实现高效的 Mamba 推理。我们首先提出了一种 FPGA 友好的训练后量化算法，该算法具有旋转辅助量化和 2 的幂次 SSM 量化特点，将大部分计算减少到 4 位。我们进一步设计了一种 FPGA 加速器，对 Mamba 计算进行部分展开，以在效率和硬件成本之间取得平衡。通过计算重排序以及精细的分块和融合，提高了硬件利用率和内存效率
papers.ai_summary_en: LightMamba addresses the difficulty of efficiently accelerating Mamba state-space model inference on FPGAs, where scattered activation outliers and complex computation dependencies limit existing LLM accelerators. The paper proposes an algorithm–hardware co-design combining FPGA-friendly post-training quantization—rotation-assisted quantization and power-of-two SSM quantization—with a partially unrolled accelerator using computation reordering, fine-grained tiling, and fusion. This reduces most computation to 4-bit precision while improving hardware utilization, memory efficiency, and overall Mamba serving performance.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 Mamba 等状态空间模型因激活离群点分散和计算依赖复杂而难以被现有 LLM 加速器高效支持的问题，提出了量化算法与 FPGA 架构协同设计的 LightMamba。其核心方法是采用旋转辅助量化和 power-of-two SSM 量化等 FPGA 友好的训练后量化策略，将大部分计算压缩到 4-bit，并通过部分展开、计算重排、细粒度分块与融合提升硬件利用率和访存效率。该工作实现了更高效的 Mamba FPGA 推理加速，为线性复杂度大模型的低成本部署提供了软硬件协同思路。

papers.title: FlexQ: Efficient Post-training INT6 Quantization for LLM Serving via Algorithm-System Co-Design
papers.authors: Hao Zhang, Aining Jia, Weifeng Bu, Yu Cai, Kai Sheng, Hao Chen, Xin He
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate exceptional performance but entail significant memory and computational costs, restricting their practical deployment. While existing INT4/INT8 quantization reduces these costs, they often degrade accuracy or lack optimal efficiency. INT6 quantization offers a superior trade-off between model accuracy and inference efficiency, but lacks hardware support in modern GPUs, forcing emulation via higher-precision arithmetic units that limit acceleration. In this paper, we propose FlexQ, a novel post-training INT6 quantization framework combining algorithmic innovation with system-level optimizations. FlexQ employs uniform 6-bit weight quantization across all layers, with adaptive retention of 8-bit activations in layers identified through layer-wise sensitivity analysis. To maximize hardware efficiency, we develop a specialized high-performance GPU kernel supporting matrix multiplication for W6A6 and W6A8 representations via Binary Tensor Core (BTC) e
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）表现出卓越的性能，但伴随显著的内存和计算成本，这限制了它们的实际部署。虽然现有的 INT4/INT8 量化可以降低这些成本，但它们往往会降低精度或缺乏最佳的效率。INT6 量化在模型精度与推理效率之间提供了更优的平衡，但现代 GPU 缺乏硬件支持，只能通过高精度算术单元进行模拟，从而限制了加速效果。在本文中，我们提出了 FlexQ，一种新的后训练 INT6 量化框架，结合了算法创新与系统层优化。FlexQ 在所有层采用统一的 6 位权重量化，并对通过层敏感性分析识别出的层自适应保留 8 位激活值。为了最大化硬件效率，我们开发了一个专用高性能 GPU 内核，通过二进制张量核心（BTC）支持 W6A6 和 W6A8 表示的矩阵乘法。
papers.ai_summary_en: FlexQ addresses the lack of native GPU support for INT6 LLM inference, which forces inefficient higher-precision emulation and limits the accuracy–efficiency benefits of 6-bit quantization. It proposes a post-training algorithm–system co-design that applies uniform 6-bit weight quantization, selectively retains 8-bit activations in sensitivity-critical layers, and introduces custom GPU kernels for W6A6/W6A8 matrix multiplication using binary tensor cores. The framework enables practical INT6 LLM serving with better accuracy preservation and hardware efficiency than conventional INT4/INT8 quantization approaches.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型推理中 INT4/INT8 量化在精度与效率上难以兼顾、而 INT6 缺乏现代 GPU 原生硬件支持的问题，提出算法-系统协同的后训练量化框架 FlexQ。其核心做法是对所有层采用均匀的 6-bit 权重量化，并通过逐层敏感度分析自适应保留部分层的 8-bit 激活，同时设计支持 W6A6/W6A8 矩阵乘法的高性能 GPU kernel，以利用 Binary Tensor Core 提升计算效率。结果表明，FlexQ 能在保持模型精度基本稳定的同时，提高 LLM 服务吞吐并降低推理开销。

papers.title: MaskPrune: Mask-based LLM Pruning for Layer-wise Uniform Structures
papers.authors: Jiayu Qin, Jianchao Tan, Kefeng Zhang, Xunliang Cai, Wei Wang
papers.abstract_en: The remarkable performance of large language models (LLMs) in various language tasks has attracted considerable attention. However, the ever-increasing size of these models presents growing challenges for deployment and inference. Structured pruning, an effective model compression technique, is gaining increasing attention due to its ability to enhance inference efficiency. Nevertheless, most previous optimization-based structured pruning methods sacrifice the uniform structure across layers for greater flexibility to maintain performance. The heterogeneous structure hinders the effective utilization of off-the-shelf inference acceleration techniques and impedes efficient configuration for continued training. To address this issue, we propose a novel masking learning paradigm based on minimax optimization to obtain the uniform pruned structure by optimizing the masks under sparsity regularization. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method can maintain high performance
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）在各种语言任务中表现出色，吸引了广泛关注。然而，这些模型规模的不断增加在部署和推理方面带来了越来越多的挑战。结构化剪枝作为一种有效的模型压缩技术，因其能够提升推理效率而受到越来越多的关注。然而，大多数以优化为基础的结构化剪枝方法为了保持性能，会牺牲各层之间的统一结构以获取更大的灵活性。异质结构阻碍了现成推理加速技术的有效利用，并妨碍了持续训练的高效配置。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于极小极大优化的新型掩码学习范式，通过在稀疏性正则化下优化掩码来获得统一的剪枝结构。大量实验结果表明，我们的方法能够保持高性能。
papers.ai_summary_en: MaskPrune addresses structured LLM pruning for efficient serving, targeting the problem that prior optimization-based methods often produce layer-heterogeneous architectures that limit hardware acceleration and continued-training configuration. It proposes a mask-learning paradigm formulated as minimax optimization with sparsity regularization to select pruned components while enforcing a uniform structure across layers. Experiments show that MaskPrune preserves high model performance while yielding deployment-friendly, layer-wise uniform pruned LLMs.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大语言模型结构化剪枝中常见“各层结构不统一”导致难以利用现有推理加速和继续训练配置的问题，提出 MaskPrune。其核心方法是在稀疏正则约束下，通过极小极大掩码学习优化各层剪枝掩码，从而得到层间统一的结构化剪枝模型。实验表明，该方法能在保持较高性能的同时提升部署友好性，有利于 LLM 服务推理加速。

papers.title: Efficient In-Memory Acceleration of Sparse Block Diagonal LLMs
papers.authors: J. Lima, Marc Dietrich, J. Castrillón, Asif Ali Khan
papers.abstract_en: Structured sparsity enables deploying large language models (LLMs) on resource-constrained systems. Approaches like dense-to-sparse fine-tuning are particularly compelling, achieving remarkable structured sparsity by reducing the model size by over 6.7×, while still maintaining acceptable accuracy. Despite this reduction, LLM inference, especially the decode stage being inherently memory-bound, is extremely expensive on conventional Von-Neumann architectures. Compute-in-memory (CIM) architectures mitigate this by performing computations directly in memory, and when paired with sparse LLMs, enable storing and computing the entire model in memory – eliminating the data movement on the off-chip bus and improving efficiency. Nonetheless, naively mapping sparse matrices onto CIM arrays leads to poor array utilization and diminished computational efficiency. In this paper, we present an automated framework with novel mapping and scheduling strategies to accelerate sparse LLM inference on CIM
papers.abstract_cn: 结构化稀疏性使在资源受限的系统上部署大型语言模型（LLM）成为可能。诸如从密集到稀疏的微调等方法尤其具有吸引力，通过将模型规模减少超过6.7倍，实现了显著的结构化稀疏性，同时仍保持可接受的准确性。尽管有这种缩减，在传统冯·诺依曼架构上，LLM 推理尤其是解码阶段因本质上受内存限制而成本极高。计算在存储（CIM）架构通过在内存中直接执行计算来缓解这一问题，并且当与稀疏 LLM 配合使用时，可以在内存中存储和计算整个模型——消除了芯片外总线上的数据移动，从而提高了效率。然而，将稀疏矩阵天真地映射到 CIM 阵列上会导致阵列利用率低和计算效率下降。在本文中，我们提出了一个自动化框架，结合新颖的映射和调度策略，以加速 CIM 上的稀疏 LLM 推理。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses memory-bound LLM decode inference for highly sparse block-diagonal models, where conventional von Neumann architectures incur costly off-chip data movement and naive compute-in-memory mappings waste array capacity. It proposes an automated CIM acceleration framework with sparse-aware mapping and scheduling strategies that store and compute the entire structured-sparse model in memory. This improves CIM array utilization and inference efficiency by eliminating off-chip transfers and exploiting block-diagonal sparsity.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对结构化块对角稀疏大模型在存内计算（CIM）架构上朴素映射导致阵列利用率低、解码阶段仍受内存瓶颈限制的问题展开研究。其核心方法是提出一套自动化的稀疏感知映射与调度框架，通过优化稀疏矩阵在 CIM 阵列上的部署和计算调度来提升阵列利用率与并行计算效率。该工作有助于在保持高压缩率的同时实现稀疏 LLM 的高能效存内推理，为资源受限场景下的 LLM 服务加速提供了可行路径。

papers.title: Variation-aware Vision Token Dropping for Faster Large Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Junjie Chen, Xuyang Liu, Zichen Wen, Yiyu Wang, Siteng Huang, Honggang Chen
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in multimodal understanding tasks. However, the increasing demand for high-resolution image and long-video understanding results in substantial token counts, consequently leading to reduced inference efficiency. Token compression offers a direct solution by reducing the number of tokens to be processed, thereby improving computational efficiency without architectural changes. Through extensive analysis, we identify two critical limitations in existing inner-LLM token compression methods: positional bias and incompatibility with efficient operators, which critically hinder their practical deployment for LVLM acceleration. This paper presents the first approach from a dynamic token variation perspective, revealing that visual token variations within LLMs exhibit task-agnostic properties. We propose Variation-aware Vision Token Dropping (\textit{i.e.}, \textbf{V$^2$Drop}), which progressively removes visual tok
papers.abstract_cn: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）在多模态理解任务中展示了卓越的能力。然而，对高分辨率图像和长视频理解的需求不断增加，导致了大量的 token，从而降低了推理效率。token 压缩提供了一种直接的解决方案，通过减少需要处理的 token 数量，从而在无需架构更改的情况下提高计算效率。通过广泛分析，我们发现现有的 LLM 内部 token 压缩方法存在两个关键限制：位置偏差和与高效算子不兼容，这严重阻碍了它们在 LVLM 加速中的实际应用。本文提出了从动态 token 变化的角度出发的首个方法，揭示了 LLM 中的视觉 token 变化具有任务无关性。我们提出了变化感知视觉 token 删除（	extit{i.e.}, 	extbf{V$^2$Drop}），该方法逐步移除视觉 token
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles inefficient inference in large vision-language models, where high-resolution images and long videos produce excessive visual tokens and existing inner-LLM token compression methods suffer from positional bias and incompatibility with efficient operators. It proposes V²Drop, a variation-aware dynamic token-dropping method that exploits task-agnostic visual-token variation patterns within the LLM to progressively remove redundant tokens in an operator-friendly manner. The approach provides architecture-free LVLM acceleration, improving serving efficiency while aiming to preserve multimodal understanding performance.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对大型视觉-语言模型在高分辨率图像和长视频理解中视觉 token 过多、推理效率低的问题，尤其是现有 LLM 内部 token 压缩方法存在位置偏差且难以兼容高效算子的局限。其核心洞见是视觉 token 在 LLM 内部的动态变化具有任务无关性，并据此提出 V²Drop，以变化感知的方式渐进式丢弃冗余视觉 token。该方法可在不改模型结构的前提下提升推理效率，并更有利于实际部署中的高效算子兼容与加速。

papers.title: Reward-Shifted Speculative Sampling Is An Efficient Test-Time Weak-to-Strong Aligner
papers.authors: Bolian Li, Yanran Wu, Xinyu Luo, Ruqi Zhang
papers.abstract_en: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences has become a critical step in their development. Recent research has increasingly focused on test-time alignment, where additional compute is allocated during inference to enhance LLM safety and reasoning capabilities. However, these test-time alignment techniques often incur substantial inference costs, limiting their practical application. We are inspired by the speculative sampling acceleration, which leverages a small draft model to efficiently predict future tokens, to address the efficiency bottleneck of test-time alignment. We introduce the reward-shifted speculative sampling (SSS) algorithm, in which the draft model is aligned with human preferences, while the target model remains unchanged. We theoretically demonstrate that the distributional shift between the aligned draft model and the unaligned target model can be exploited to recover the RLHF optimal solution without actually obtaining it, by modifying the accept
papers.abstract_cn: 将大型语言模型（LLM）与人类偏好对齐已成为其开发过程中一个关键步骤。近期研究越来越多地关注测试时对齐，其中在推理过程中分配额外计算资源以增强LLM的安全性和推理能力。然而，这些测试时对齐技术通常会产生大量推理成本，限制了其实际应用。我们受到推测采样加速的启发，该方法利用一个小型草稿模型高效预测未来的标记，以解决测试时对齐的效率瓶颈。我们提出了奖励偏移的推测采样（SSS）算法，其中草稿模型与人类偏好对齐，而目标模型保持不变。我们从理论上证明，通过修改接受机制，可以利用对齐的草稿模型与未对齐目标模型之间的分布偏移来恢复RLHF的最优解，而无需实际获得它。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the high inference cost of test-time alignment for LLMs, where extra computation at decoding time is used to improve preference alignment or safety. It proposes reward-shifted speculative sampling (SSS), a weak-to-strong decoding method that uses a preference-aligned small draft model to propose tokens for an unaligned large target model and modifies the speculative acceptance rule to exploit the draft–target distributional shift. The key result is a theoretical guarantee that SSS can recover the RLHF-optimal target distribution without explicitly training or querying the aligned strong model, enabling more efficient test-time alignment in LLM serving.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对测试时人类偏好对齐推理成本过高的问题，提出用投机采样思路实现高效的“弱到强”对齐。其核心方法是让已对齐的小草稿模型引导未对齐的大目标模型生成，并通过奖励偏移修正接受准则，从两者分布差异中恢复 RLHF 最优分布。理论上，该方法无需重新训练或显式求解大模型对齐目标，即可在推理阶段以更低成本提升对齐效果。

papers.title: EasySpec: Layer-Parallel Speculative Decoding for Efficient Multi-GPU Utilization
papers.authors: Yize Wu, Ke Gao, Yanjun Wu
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding is an effective and lossless method for Large Language Model (LLM) inference acceleration. It employs a smaller model to generate a draft token sequence, which is then verified by the original base model. In multi-GPU systems, inference latency can be further reduced through tensor parallelism (TP), while the optimal TP size of the draft model is typically smaller than that of the base model, leading to GPU idling during the drafting stage. We observe that such inefficiency stems from the sequential execution of layers, which is seemingly natural but actually unnecessary. Therefore, we propose EasySpec, a layer-parallel speculation strategy that optimizes the efficiency of multi-GPU utilization. EasySpec breaks the inter-layer data dependencies in the draft model, enabling multiple layers to run simultaneously across multiple devices as'fuzzy'speculation. After each drafting-and-verification iteration, the draft model's key-value cache is calibrated in a single for
papers.abstract_cn: 推测解码是一种有效且无损的大型语言模型（LLM）推理加速方法。它使用一个较小的模型生成草稿令牌序列，然后由原始基础模型进行验证。在多GPU系统中，可以通过张量并行（TP）进一步减少推理延迟，而草稿模型的最佳TP尺寸通常小于基础模型，这导致在草稿阶段GPU处于空闲状态。我们观察到，这种低效来源于层的顺序执行，看似自然，但实际上并非必要。因此，我们提出了EasySpec，一种层并行推测策略，用于优化多GPU的利用效率。EasySpec打破了草稿模型中的跨层数据依赖，使多个层能够在多个设备上同时运行，作为“模糊”推测。在每次草稿与验证迭代之后，草稿模型的键值缓存会在单次操作中进行校准
papers.ai_summary_en: EasySpec addresses GPU underutilization in multi-GPU speculative decoding, where the draft model’s smaller optimal tensor-parallel size leaves devices idle during sequential drafting. It breaks inter-layer dependencies in the draft model so multiple draft layers execute concurrently across GPUs as “fuzzy” speculation, then recalibrates the draft KV cache after verification. This improves multi-GPU utilization and reduces inference latency while preserving the lossless guarantees of speculative decoding.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多GPU投机解码中草稿模型张量并行度通常小于主模型、导致草稿阶段GPU闲置的问题展开研究。核心方法是提出 EasySpec，通过打破草稿模型的层间依赖，将多个层以“模糊投机”的方式在不同GPU上并行执行，并在每轮草稿-验证后校准KV缓存。该方法在保持无损解码的前提下提高了多GPU利用率，有望进一步降低LLM服务延迟。

papers.title: EfficientEdit: Accelerating Code Editing via Edit-Oriented Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Peiding Wang, Li Zhang, Fang Liu, Yinghao Zhu, Wang Xu, Lin Shi, Xiaoli Lian, Minxiao Li, Bo Shen, An Fu
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in code editing, substantially enhancing software development productivity. However, the inherent complexity of code editing tasks forces existing approaches to rely on LLMs’ autoregressive end-to-end generation, where decoding speed plays a critical role in efficiency. While inference acceleration techniques like speculative decoding are applied to improve the decoding efficiency, these methods fail to account for the unique characteristics of code editing tasks, where changes are typically localized and existing code segments are reused. To address this limitation, we propose EfficientEdit, a novel method that improves LLM-based code editing efficiency through two key mechanisms based on speculative decoding: (1) effective reuse of original code segments while identifying potential edit locations, and (2) efficient generation of edit content via high-quality drafts from edit-oriented draft models and a dynamic ver
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在代码编辑方面表现出了显著的能力，显著提升了软件开发的生产力。然而，代码编辑任务的固有复杂性迫使现有方法依赖于LLMs的自回归端到端生成，其中解码速度在效率中起着关键作用。尽管像推测性解码这样的推理加速技术被应用于提高解码效率，但这些方法未能考虑代码编辑任务的独特特性，即更改通常是局部的，并且现有的代码片段会被重复使用。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了EfficientEdit，这是一种新颖的方法，通过基于推测性解码的两个关键机制提升基于LLM的代码编辑效率：（1）在识别潜在编辑位置的同时，有效地重用原始代码片段；（2）通过面向编辑的草稿模型生成高质量草稿和动态验证，高效生成编辑内容。
papers.ai_summary_en: EfficientEdit addresses the inefficiency of serving LLMs for code editing, where standard autoregressive decoding and generic speculative decoding waste computation regenerating largely unchanged code. The method introduces an edit-oriented speculative decoding framework that reuses original code segments while locating likely edits, then generates modifications using specialized draft models and a dynamic verification mechanism. This improves decoding efficiency for code-editing workloads by reducing redundant token generation and increasing draft acceptance, yielding lower latency and higher serving throughput than general-purpose speculative decoding.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM 代码编辑中端到端自回归生成效率低、且现有推测解码未利用“编辑局部化和代码复用”特性的问题展开研究。其提出 EfficientEdit，通过复用原始代码片段并定位潜在编辑位置，再结合面向编辑的草稿模型与动态验证机制来加速编辑内容生成。该方法可提升代码编辑场景下的解码效率和服务吞吐，同时保持编辑质量。

papers.title: MoE-Gen: High-Throughput MoE Inference on a Single GPU with Module-Based Batching
papers.authors: Tairan Xu, Leyang Xue, Zhan Lu, Adrian Jackson, Luo Mai
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents MoE-Gen, a high-throughput MoE inference system optimized for single-GPU execution. Existing inference systems rely on model-based or continuous batching strategies, originally designed for interactive inference, which result in excessively small batches for MoE's key modules-attention and expert modules-leading to poor throughput. To address this, we introduce module-based batching, which accumulates tokens in host memory and dynamically launches large batches on GPUs to maximize utilization. Additionally, we optimize the choice of batch sizes for each module in an MoE to fully overlap GPU computation and communication, maximizing throughput. Evaluation demonstrates that MoE-Gen achieves 8-31x higher throughput compared to state-of-the-art systems employing model-based batching (FlexGen, MoE-Lightning, DeepSpeed), and offers even greater throughput improvements over continuous batching systems (e.g., vLLM and Ollama) on popular MoE models (DeepSeek and Mixtral) acr
papers.abstract_cn: 本文提出了 MoE-Gen，一种优化用于单 GPU 执行的高吞吐量 MoE 推理系统。现有的推理系统依赖于基于模型或连续批处理策略，这些策略最初是为交互式推理设计的，导致 MoE 的关键模块——注意力模块和专家模块——的批量过小，从而造成吞吐量低下。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了基于模块的批处理方法，该方法在主机内存中累积 token，并在 GPU 上动态启动大批量以最大化利用率。此外，我们优化了 MoE 中各模块的批量大小选择，以充分重叠 GPU 的计算与通信，从而最大化吞吐量。评估结果表明，与采用基于模型批处理的最先进系统（FlexGen、MoE-Lightning、DeepSpeed）相比，MoE-Gen 实现了 8-31 倍更高的吞吐量，并且在流式批处理系统（如 vLLM 和 Ollama）上，对于流行的 MoE 模型（DeepSeek 和 Mixtral）提供了更显著的吞吐量提升。
papers.ai_summary_en: MoE-Gen addresses low single-GPU MoE inference throughput caused by conventional model-based or continuous batching producing too-small batches for MoE attention and expert modules. It introduces module-based batching, which buffers tokens in host memory and dynamically launches large per-module GPU batches while tuning module batch sizes to overlap computation and communication. Evaluations on DeepSeek and Mixtral models show 8–31× higher throughput than FlexGen, MoE-Lightning, and DeepSpeed, with further gains over vLLM and Ollama.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对单GPU上MoE大模型推理吞吐低的问题，指出传统模型级/连续批处理会使注意力和专家模块形成过小批次，难以充分利用GPU。其核心方法是提出模块级批处理，在主机内存中累积token并按模块动态构造大批次，同时优化各模块批大小以重叠GPU计算与通信。实验显示，MoE-Gen在DeepSeek、Mixtral等MoE模型上相比FlexGen、MoE-Lightning、DeepSpeed等系统吞吐提升8–31倍，并优于vLLM、Ollama等连续批处理系统。

papers.title: FASER: Fine-Grained Phase Management for Speculative Decoding in Dynamic LLM Serving
papers.authors: Wenyan Chen, Chengzhi Lu, Yanying Lin, Dmitrii Ustiugov
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding (SD) is a widely used approach for accelerating decode-heavy LLM inference workloads. While online inference workloads are highly dynamic, existing SD systems are rigid and take a coarse-grained approach to SD management. They typically set the speculative token length for an entire batch and serialize the execution of the draft and verification phases. Consequently, these systems fall short at adapting to volatile online inference traffic. Under low load, they exhibit prolonged latency because the draft phase blocks the verification phase for the entire batch, leaving GPU computing resources underutilized. Conversely, under high load, they waste computation on rejected tokens during the verification phase, overloading GPU resources.   We introduce FASER, a novel system that features fine-grained SD phase management. First, FASER minimizes computational waste by dynamically adjusting the speculative length for each request within a continuous batch and by performing early pruning of rejected tokens inside the verification phase. Second, FASER breaks the verification phase into frontiers, or chunks, to overlap them with the draft phase. This overlap is achieved via fine-grained spatial multiplexing with minimal resource interference. Our FASER prototype in vLLM improves throughput by up to 53% and reduces latency by up to 1.92$\times$ compared to state-of-the-art systems.
papers.abstract_cn: 推测性解码 (SD) 是一种广泛使用的方法，用于加速解码繁重的 LLM 推理工作负载。尽管在线推理工作负载高度动态，但现有的 SD 系统是刚性的，并采用粗粒度的 SD 管理方法。它们通常为整个批次设置推测性令牌长度，并对草稿和验证阶段的执行进行序列化。因此，这些系统在适应不稳定的在线推理流量方面存在不足。在低负载情况下，它们表现出较长的延迟，因为草稿阶段阻塞了整个批次的验证阶段，导致 GPU 计算资源利用不足。相反，在高负载情况下，它们会在验证阶段对拒绝的令牌进行计算，从而导致 GPU 资源过载。我们介绍了 FASER，一个具有细粒度 SD 阶段管理特性的新系统。首先，FASER 通过在连续批次中动态调整每个请求的投机长度，以及在验证阶段对被拒绝的令牌进行早期修剪来最大限度地减少计算浪费。其次，FASER 将验证阶段划分为边界或块，以与草稿阶段重叠。这种重叠是通过细粒度空间复用实现的，资源干扰最小。与最先进的系统相比，我们在 vLLM 中的 FASER 原型将吞吐量提高了 53%，并将延迟降低了 1.92 美元。
papers.ai_summary_en: FASER addresses the rigidity of existing speculative decoding systems in dynamic online LLM serving, where batch-level speculative lengths and serialized draft/verification phases cause latency under low load and wasted computation under high load. It introduces fine-grained phase management with per-request dynamic speculative length, early pruning of rejected tokens during verification, and chunked verification “frontiers” overlapped with drafting via spatial multiplexing. Implemented in vLLM, FASER improves throughput by up to 53% and reduces latency by up to 1.92× over state-of-the-art systems.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对在线 LLM 推理中投机解码管理过于粗粒度、整批统一投机长度且草稿/验证串行导致低负载延迟高、高负载浪费算力的问题。FASER 提出细粒度阶段管理：按连续批处理中的每个请求动态调整投机长度、在验证阶段提前剪枝被拒 token，并将验证拆分为可与草稿阶段重叠执行的 chunk，通过低干扰的空间复用提升并行度。基于 vLLM 的原型相比先进系统最高提升 53% 吞吐，并将延迟降低最高 1.92 倍。

papers.title: Break the Optimization Barrier of LLM-Enhanced Recommenders: A Theoretical Analysis and Practical Framework
papers.authors: Zhangchi Zhu, Wei Zhang
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-enhanced recommendation models inject LLM representations into backbone recommenders to exploit rich item text without inference-time LLM cost. However, we find that existing LLM-enhanced methods significantly hinder the optimization of backbone models, resulting in high training losses that are difficult to reduce. To address it, we establish a comprehensive theoretical analysis of local optimization curvature and identify two key causes: 1) large norm disparity and 2) semantic-collaboration misaligned angular clustering of LLM representations.
