Guided by these insights, we propose Training-Friendly LLM-Enhanced Recommender (TF-LLMER), a lightweight framework with two key components. First, we highlight the necessity of item embedding normalization to eliminate norm-driven instability and achieve provable control over optimization conditioning. Second, we introduce Rec-PCA, a recommendation-aware dimensionality reduction method that injects collaborative structure into the representation transformation to resolve semantic-collaboration misaligned angular clustering. It jointly optimizes semantic information retention and alignment with an item-item co-occurrence graph constructed from interaction histories. The graph captures collaborative structure, and alignment is promoted by penalizing total variation over the graph. Both theory and extensive experiments demonstrate that TF-LLMER significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/woriazzc/TF-LLMER.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型 (LLM) 增强的推荐模型将 LLM 表示注入骨干推荐器中，以利用丰富的项目文本，而不会产生推理时间 LLM 成本。然而，我们发现现有的 LLM 增强方法显著阻碍了骨干模型的优化，导致难以降低的高训练损失。为了解决这个问题，我们建立了一个全面的局部优化曲率理论分析，并确定了两个关键原因:1) 大范数差异和 2) LLM 表示的语义协作不对称角度聚类。基于这些见解，我们提出了一个具有两个关键组件的轻量级框架——训练友好型 LLM 增强推荐器 (TF-LLMER)。首先，我们强调了项目嵌入规范化的必要性，以消除范数驱动的不稳定性，并实现对优化条件的可证明控制。其次，我们引入了 Rec-PCA，这是一种基于推荐的降维方法，它将协同结构注入到表示转换中，以解决语义 - 协同不对称角度聚类问题。它联合优化了语义信息的保留和对齐，并与由交互历史构建的项 - 项共现图进行对齐。该图捕捉协作结构，并通过惩罚图的总变异来促进对齐。理论和广泛的实验都表明，TF-LLMER 的性能显著优于最先进的方法。我们的代码可以在 https://github.com/woriazzc/TF-LLMER 上获得。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses optimization instability in LLM-enhanced recommender systems, where injecting LLM-derived item representations into backbone recommenders leads to high training loss caused by norm disparity and semantic–collaborative angular misalignment. Using a local curvature analysis, the authors propose TF-LLMER, a lightweight framework that normalizes item embeddings for stable optimization conditioning and applies Rec-PCA, a recommendation-aware dimensionality reduction method aligning LLM semantics with item–item co-occurrence structure via graph total-variation regularization. Theory and experiments show that TF-LLMER improves training dynamics and outperforms state-of-the-art LLM-enhanced recommendation methods without adding inference-time LLM cost.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM表示直接增强推荐模型时会恶化骨干模型优化、导致训练损失难以下降的问题，从局部优化曲率角度揭示其根源在于表示范数差异过大与语义—协作角度聚类不对齐。作者提出轻量框架TF-LLMER，通过物品嵌入归一化改善优化条件，并用推荐感知降维Rec-PCA结合物品共现图总变差正则，将协同过滤结构注入LLM表示变换。理论与实验均表明该方法能显著缓解优化障碍，效果优于现有LLM增强推荐方法。

papers.title: HaS: Accelerating RAG through Homology-Aware Speculative Retrieval
papers.authors: Peng Peng, Weiwei Lin, Wentai Wu, Xinyang Wang, Yongheng Liu
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) expands the knowledge boundary of large language models (LLMs) at inference by retrieving external documents as context. However, retrieval becomes increasingly time-consuming as the knowledge databases grow in size. Existing acceleration strategies either compromise accuracy through approximate retrieval, or achieve marginal gains by reusing results of strictly identical queries. We propose HaS, a homology-aware speculative retrieval framework that performs low-latency speculative retrieval over restricted scopes to obtain candidate documents, followed by validating whether they contain the required knowledge. The validation, grounded in the homology relation between queries, is formulated as a homologous query re-identification task: once a previously observed query is identified as a homologous re-encounter of the incoming query, the draft is deemed acceptable, allowing the system to bypass slow full-database retrieval. Benefiting from the prevalence of homologous queries under real-world popularity patterns, HaS achieves substantial efficiency gains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HaS reduces retrieval latency by 23.74% and 36.99% across datasets with only a 1-2% marginal accuracy drop. As a plug-and-play solution, HaS also significantly accelerates complex multi-hop queries in modern agentic RAG pipelines. Source code is available at: https://github.com/ErrEqualsNil/HaS.
papers.abstract_cn: 检索增强生成 (RAG) 通过将外部文档作为上下文进行检索，在推理中扩展了大语言模型 (LLMs) 的知识边界。然而，随着知识库规模的增长，检索变得越来越耗时。现有的加速策略要么通过近似检索损害准确性，要么通过重复使用严格相同查询的结果来实现边际收益。我们提出了 HaS，一种同源感知的推测性检索框架，它在有限范围内执行低延迟的推测性检索以获取候选文档，然后验证它们是否包含所需的知识。验证基于查询之间的同源关系，被构建为一个同源查询重新识别任务：一旦先前观察到的查询被识别为传入查询的同源重遇，草稿就被认为是可接受的，从而使系统能够绕过缓慢的全数据库检索。受益于现实世界流行模式下同源查询的普遍性，HaS 实现了显著的效率提升。广泛的实验表明，HaS 在跨数据集的检索延迟方面分别降低了 23.74% 和 36.99%，而边际准确率仅下降 1-2%。作为即插即用的解决方案，HaS 还显著加速了现代代理 RAG 流水线中的复杂多跳查询。源代码可在:https://github.com/errequalsnil/HaS 中获得。
papers.ai_summary_en: HaS addresses growing retrieval latency in RAG as knowledge bases scale, where approximate retrieval hurts accuracy and exact query reuse yields limited gains. It introduces homology-aware speculative retrieval that first fetches candidate documents from restricted low-latency scopes, then validates them by re-identifying the incoming query as homologous to a previously seen query, accepting drafts to bypass full-database retrieval. Experiments show 23.74% and 36.99% retrieval latency reductions across datasets with only 1–2% accuracy loss, and plug-and-play speedups for multi-hop agentic RAG.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对RAG中随着知识库规模增大、检索延迟升高，而现有近似检索或严格相同查询复用难以兼顾精度与加速的问题展开研究。核心方法是提出HaS同源感知推测检索框架：先在受限范围内快速生成候选文档，再通过“同源查询重识别”判断候选是否可复用，从而在命中时跳过慢速全库检索。实验显示，该方法在仅损失1–2%精度的情况下将检索延迟分别降低23.74%和36.99%，并可作为即插即用方案加速多跳智能体式RAG流程。

papers.title: Super Apriel: One Checkpoint, Many Speeds
papers.authors: SLAM Labs,  :, Oleksiy Ostapenko, Raymond Li, Torsten Scholak
papers.abstract_en: We release Super Apriel, a 15B-parameter supernet in which every decoder layer provides four trained mixer choices -- Full Attention (FA), Sliding Window Attention (SWA), Kimi Delta Attention (KDA), and Gated DeltaNet (GDN). A placement selects one mixer per layer; placements can be switched between requests at serving time without reloading weights, enabling multiple speed presets from a single checkpoint. The shared checkpoint also enables speculative decoding without a separate draft model. The all-FA preset matches the Apriel 1.6 teacher on all reported benchmarks; recommended hybrid presets span $2.9\times$ to $10.7\times$ decode throughput at 96% to 77% quality retention, with throughput advantages that compound at longer context lengths. With four mixer types across 48 layers, the configuration space is vast. A surrogate that predicts placement quality from the per-layer mixer assignment makes the speed-quality landscape tractable and identifies the best tradeoffs at each speed level. We investigate whether the best configurations at each speed level can be identified early in training or only after convergence. Rankings stabilize quickly at 0.5B scale, but the most efficient configurations exhibit higher instability at 15B, cautioning against extrapolation from smaller models. Super Apriel is trained by stochastic distillation from a frozen Apriel 1.6 teacher, followed by supervised fine-tuning. We release the supernet weights, Fast-LLM training code, vLLM serving code, and a placement optimization toolkit.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们发布了 Super April，一个 15B 参数的超网，其中每个解码层都提供四个经过训练的混频器选择——全注意力 (FA)、滑动窗口注意力 (SWA)、Kimi Delta 注意力 (KDA) 和 Gated DeltaNet(GDN)。一个布局可以为每层选择一个混频器;布局可以在服务时间的请求之间切换，无需重新加载权重，从而实现单个检查点的多个速度预设。共享检查点还实现了推测性解码，无需单独的草稿模型。全注意力预设在所有报告的基准测试中都与 April 1.6 中的老师相匹配;推荐的混合预设跨越 2.9 到 10.7 倍的解码吞吐量，质量保持率为 96% 到 77%，具有吞吐量优势，并在更长的上下文长度下相互叠加。48 层共有 4 种混音器类型，位形空间非常大。一个可以根据每层混音器分配预测位置质量的替代方案使得速度 - 质量的景观变得易于处理，并确定每个速度级别的最佳权衡。我们研究了在每个速度水平上是否可以在训练早期或收敛后确定最佳配置。排名在 0.5B 尺度上快速稳定，但最高效的配置在 15B 尺度上表现出更高的不稳定性，警告不要从较小的模型进行外推。Super April 是通过随机提取一个冻结的 April 1.6 教师来训练的，随后进行监督微调。我们发布了超网权重、Fast-LLM 训练代码、vLLM 服务代码和布局优化工具包。
papers.ai_summary_en: Super Apriel addresses the need for multiple model checkpoints or separate draft models to serve LLMs at different speed–quality points. It trains a 15B supernet with four selectable mixers per decoder layer—FA, SWA, KDA, and GDN—so a single checkpoint supports request-time mixer placements, self-speculative decoding, and surrogate-guided search over the large placement space. All-FA matches the teacher, while hybrid presets achieve 2.9×–10.7× throughput at 96%–77% quality retention, with larger gains at long contexts and open-sourced weights, code, and optimization tools.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对大模型推理中速度与质量难以灵活权衡、且多配置需多检查点的问题，提出 15B 超网“Super Apriel”：每个解码层可在 FA、SWA、KDA、GDN 四种混合器间选择，并可在服务时按请求切换层配置，从单一权重实现多档速度，甚至无需独立草稿模型即可做投机解码。其核心洞见是用代理模型预测“每层混合器布置”的质量，从而在 48 层×4 选项的巨大搜索空间中高效找到速度-质量帕累托前沿，并通过随机蒸馏与监督微调训练超网。结果显示，全 FA 配置可匹配教师模型，混合配置可在约 96%–77% 质量保持下实现 2.9×–10.7× 解码吞吐提升，且长上下文收益更显著；同时发现小规模排名可快速稳定，但 15B 高效配置仍不稳定，需谨慎外推。

papers.title: WebGen-R1: Incentivizing Large Language Models to Generate Functional and Aesthetic Websites with Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Juyong Jiang, Chenglin Cai, Chansung Park, Jiasi Shen, Sunghun Kim
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at function-level code generation, project-level tasks such as generating functional and visually aesthetic multi-page websites remain highly challenging. Existing works are often limited to single-page static websites, while agentic frameworks typically rely on multi-turn execution with proprietary models, leading to substantial token costs, high latency, and brittle integration. Training a small LLM end-to-end with reinforcement learning (RL) is a promising alternative, yet it faces a critical bottleneck in designing reliable and computationally feasible rewards for website generation. Unlike single-file coding tasks that can be verified by unit tests, website generation requires evaluating inherently subjective aesthetics, cross-page interactions, and functional correctness. To this end, we propose WebGen-R1, an end-to-end RL framework tailored for project-level website generation. We first introduce a scaffold-driven structured generation paradigm that constrains the large open-ended action space and preserves architectural integrity. We then design a novel cascaded multimodal reward that seamlessly couples structural guarantees with execution-grounded functional feedback and vision-based aesthetic supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our WebGen-R1 substantially transforms a 7B base model from generating nearly nonfunctional websites into producing deployable, aesthetically aligned multi-page websites. Remarkably, our WebGen-R1 not only consistently outperforms heavily scaled open-source models (up to 72B), but also rivals the state-of-the-art DeepSeek-R1 (671B) in functional success, while substantially exceeding it in valid rendering and aesthetic alignment. These results position WebGen-R1 as a viable path for scaling small open models from function-level code generation to project-level web application generation.
papers.abstract_cn: 尽管大语言模型 (LLMs) 在功能级代码生成方面表现出色，但生成功能性和视觉美学多页网站等项目级任务仍然具有高度挑战性。现有作品通常局限于单页静态网站，而代理框架通常依赖于使用专有模型进行多轮执行，这导致了巨大的代币成本、高延迟和脆弱的集成。使用强化学习 (RL) 训练小型端到端 LLM 是一个有前景的替代方案，但它在为网站生成设计可靠且计算可行的奖励方面面临着关键瓶颈。与可以通过单元测试验证的单文件编码任务不同，网站生成需要评估内在的主观审美、跨页交互和功能正确性。为此，我们提出了 WebGen-R1，这是一个为项目级网站生成量身定制的端到端 RL 框架。我们首先引入了一个由脚手架驱动的结构化生成范式，它限制了大型开放式行动空间，并保持了架构完整性。然后，我们设计了一种新颖的级联多模态奖励，将结构性保证与基于执行的功能反馈和基于视觉的审美监督无缝结合在一起。广泛的实验表明，我们的 WebGen-R1 实质上将 7B 基础模型从生成几乎无功能的网站转变为生成可部署的、审美对齐的多页网站。值得注意的是，我们的 WebGen-R1 不仅始终优于大规模开源模型 (高达 72B)，而且在功能成功方面可与最先进的 DeepSeek-R1(671B) 媲美，同时在有效渲染和审美对齐方面也大大超过了它。这些结果将 WebGen-R1 定位为一条可行的路径，用于将小型开放模型从函数级代码生成扩展到项目级 Web 应用程序生成。
papers.ai_summary_en: WebGen-R1 tackles project-level website generation, where LLMs must produce multi-page sites that are functional, render correctly, and satisfy subjective aesthetic criteria, a task difficult to supervise with reliable RL rewards. It introduces an end-to-end RL framework for small LLMs using scaffold-driven structured generation to constrain the action space, plus a cascaded multimodal reward combining structural validity, execution-grounded functionality, and vision-based aesthetic feedback. Experiments show that a 7B model trained with WebGen-R1 generates deployable multi-page websites, outperforms much larger open-source models up to 72B, and rivals DeepSeek-R1 (671B) in functional success while exceeding it in valid rendering and aesthetic alignment.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型在多页、项目级网站生成中难以同时保证功能正确、跨页交互和视觉美感的问题，提出端到端强化学习框架 WebGen-R1。其核心方法是用脚手架驱动的结构化生成约束开放动作空间，并设计级联多模态奖励，将结构约束、执行反馈和视觉审美评价结合起来。实验表明，该方法可将 7B 小模型提升到可部署多页网站生成水平，不仅超过多个更大规模开源模型，还在有效渲染和审美对齐上优于 DeepSeek-R1（671B）。

papers.title: EdgeLLM: Fast On-Device LLM Inference With Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Generative tasks, such as text generation and question answering, are essential for mobile applications. Given their inherent privacy sensitivity, executing them on devices is demanded. Nowadays, the execution of these generative tasks heavily relies on the Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the scarce device memory severely hinders the scalability of these models. We present EdgeLLM, an efficient on-device LLM inference system for models whose sizes exceed the device's memory capacity. EdgeLLM is built atop speculative decoding, which delegates most tokens to a smaller, memory-resident (draft) LLM. EdgeLLM integrates three novel techniques: (1) Instead of generating a fixed width and depth token tree, EdgeLLM proposes compute-efficient branch navigation and verification to pace the progress of different branches according to their accepted probability to prevent the wasteful allocation of computing resources to the wrong branch and to verify them all at once efficiently. (2) It uses a self-adaptive fallback strategy that promptly initiates the verification process when the smaller LLM generates an incorrect token. (3) To not block the generation, EdgeLLM proposes speculatively generating tokens during large LLM verification with the compute-IO pipeline. Through extensive experiments, EdgeLLM exhibits impressive token generation speed which is up to 9.3× faster than existing engines.
papers.abstract_cn: 生成任务，如文本生成和问题回答，对移动应用程序至关重要。鉴于其固有的隐私敏感性，需要在设备上执行它们。如今，这些生成任务的执行严重依赖于大语言模型 (LLM)。然而，稀缺的设备内存严重阻碍了这些模型的可扩展性。我们介绍了 EdgeLLM，一种高效的设备上 LLM 推理系统，适用于尺寸超过设备内存容量的模型。EdgeLLM 建立在投机解码之上，它将大多数令牌委托给一个更小的、内存驻留 (草稿) 的 LLM。EdgeLLM 集成了三种新技术:(1) EdgeLLM 不再生成固定宽度和深度的令牌树，而是提出了计算效率高的分支导航和验证方法，根据不同分支的可接受概率来调节其进度，以防止计算资源浪费地分配到错误的分支，并有效地同时验证所有分支。(2) 它使用了一种自适应的回退策略，当较小的 LLM 生成不正确的令牌时，该策略会立即启动验证过程。(3) 为了避免阻塞代币生成，EdgeLLM 提出在大型 LLM 验证过程中使用计算-IO 管道进行推测性代币生成。通过广泛的实验，EdgeLLM 展现出令人印象深刻的代币生成速度，比现有引擎快 9.3 倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: EdgeLLM addresses on-device generative inference for LLMs that exceed mobile memory capacity, enabling privacy-sensitive execution without fitting the full model in RAM. It builds on speculative decoding with a memory-resident draft LLM and introduces probability-aware branch navigation/verification, an adaptive fallback when draft tokens are likely wrong, and overlapped speculative generation during large-model verification via a compute–I/O pipeline. Experiments show up to 9.3× faster token generation than existing on-device inference engines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: EdgeLLM针对设备内存不足以容纳完整大语言模型的端侧推理问题，提出一种基于投机解码的推理系统，用常驻内存的小草稿模型生成多数 token，并通过按接受概率导航与集中验证分支、自适应回退触发验证，以及在大模型验证期间用计算-IO流水线继续推测生成来提升效率。实验表明，该方法可显著缓解端侧内存与计算瓶颈，token 生成速度较现有引擎最高提升 9.3 倍。

papers.title: Reward-Guided Speculative Decoding for Efficient LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Reward-Guided Speculative Decoding (RSD), a novel framework aimed at improving the efficiency of inference in large language models (LLMs). RSD synergistically combines a lightweight draft model with a more powerful target model, incorporating a controlled bias to prioritize high-reward outputs, in contrast to existing speculative decoding methods that enforce strict unbiasedness. RSD employs a process reward model to evaluate intermediate decoding steps and dynamically decide whether to invoke the target model, optimizing the trade-off between computational cost and output quality. We theoretically demonstrate that a threshold-based mixture strategy achieves an optimal balance between resource utilization and performance. Extensive evaluations on challenging reasoning benchmarks, including Olympiad-level tasks, show that RSD delivers significant efficiency gains against decoding with the target model only (up to 4.4x fewer FLOPs), while achieving significant better accuracy than parallel decoding method on average (up to +3.5). These results highlight RSD as a robust and cost-effective approach for deploying LLMs in resource-intensive scenarios. The code is available at https://github.com/BaohaoLiao/RSD.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们介绍了奖励导向的推测性解码 (RSD)，这是一个新的框架，旨在提高大语言模型 (LLMs) 的推理效率。RSD 协同地将轻量级草稿模型与更强大的目标模型相结合，纳入了一个受控偏差来优先考虑高奖励输出，这与现有强制严格无偏的推测性解码方法形成对比。RSD 采用过程奖励模型来评估中间解码步骤，并动态决定是否调用目标模型，优化计算成本和输出质量之间的权衡。我们理论上证明了基于阈值的混合策略能够在资源利用率和性能之间实现最佳平衡。对具有挑战性的推理基准 (包括奥林匹克级别的任务) 进行的广泛评估表明，RSD 仅在使用目标模型进行解码时提供了显著的效率提升 (最高可减少 4.4 倍的 FLOP)，同时平均比并行解码方法获得了显著的更高准确性 (最高可达 +3.5)。这些结果强调 RSD 是一种在资源密集型场景中部署 LLM 的稳健且经济高效的方法。代码可在 https://github.com/baohaolioo/RSD 上获得。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses inefficient LLM reasoning inference, where target-only decoding is computationally expensive and standard speculative decoding’s strict unbiasedness can waste compute on low-value draft tokens. Reward-Guided Speculative Decoding (RSD) combines a lightweight draft model with a stronger target model and uses a process reward model to introduce controlled bias, dynamically deciding when to invoke the target model via a theoretically justified threshold-based mixture strategy. On challenging reasoning benchmarks, RSD achieves up to 4.4× fewer FLOPs than target-only decoding while improving average accuracy over parallel decoding by up to +3.5.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大语言模型推理解码效率低、且现有投机解码过度强调无偏而难以兼顾质量与成本的问题，提出了奖励引导的投机解码框架 RSD。其核心洞见是引入受控偏差，用轻量草稿模型生成候选，并结合过程奖励模型评估中间步骤，按阈值动态决定是否调用目标模型，从而在算力消耗与输出质量之间取得更优平衡。实验显示，该方法在 Olympiad 级等高难推理任务上相比仅用目标模型最高可减少 4.4 倍 FLOPs，同时相比并行解码平均准确率最高可提升 3.5 个点。

papers.title: AdaServe: SLO-Customized LLM Serving with Fine-Grained Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Modern large language model (LLM) applications exhibit diverse service-level objectives (SLOs), from low-latency requirements in interactive coding assistants to more relaxed constraints in data wrangling tasks. Existing LLM serving systems, which rely on uniform batching and scheduling strategies, often fail to meet these heterogeneous SLOs concurrently. We present AdaServe, the first LLM serving system designed to support efficient multi-SLO serving through SLO-customized speculative decoding. AdaServe formulates multi-SLO serving as a constrained optimization problem and introduces a hardware-aware algorithm that constructs a speculation tree tailored to each request's latency target. It features a speculate-select-verify pipeline that enables fine-grained control over decoding speed while maximizing system throughput. AdaServe further adapts to workload variation by dynamically adjusting speculation parameters. Evaluations across diverse workloads show that AdaServe reduces SLO violations by up to 4.3$\times$ and improves goodput by up to 1.9$\times$ compared to the best performing baselines, highlighting its effectiveness in multi-SLO serving.
papers.abstract_cn: 现代大语言模型 (LLM) 应用程序表现出多样化的服务级别目标 (SLO)，从交互式编码助手中的低延迟要求到数据处理任务中更宽松的约束。现有的 LLM 服务系统依赖于统一的批处理和调度策略，通常无法同时满足这些异构 SLO。我们介绍了 AdaServe，这是第一个旨在通过 SLO 定制的投机性解码来支持高效多 SLO 服务的 LLM 服务系统。AdaServe 将多 SLO 服务表述为一个受约束的最佳化问题，并引入了一种硬件感知算法，该算法构建了一棵针对每个请求的延迟目标量身定制的投机树。它具有一个推测 - 选择 - 验证管道，可以对解码速度进行细粒度控制，同时最大限度地提高系统吞吐量。AdaServe 通过动态调整推测参数，进一步适应工作负载变化。跨不同工作负载的评估显示，与最佳表现基准相比，AdaServe 将违反 SLO 的情况减少了多达 4.3 美元，并将产出提高了多达 1.9 美元，突出了其在多 SLO 服务中的有效性。
papers.ai_summary_en: AdaServe addresses heterogeneous service-level objectives (SLOs) in LLM serving, where uniform batching and scheduling cannot simultaneously satisfy diverse latency requirements. It formulates multi-SLO serving as a constrained optimization problem and introduces hardware-aware, per-request speculative decoding with customized speculation trees and a speculate-select-verify pipeline that dynamically adapts to workload changes. Evaluations show up to 4.3× fewer SLO violations and 1.9× higher goodput than strong baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对现有 LLM 服务系统因统一批处理与调度难以同时满足多样延迟 SLO 的问题，提出了 AdaServe。其核心方法是将多 SLO 服务建模为约束优化，并通过硬件感知算法为每个请求定制投机树，配合 speculate-select-verify 流水线和动态参数调整，实现细粒度投机解码与吞吐优化。实验表明，AdaServe 相比最优基线可将 SLO 违约最多降低 4.3 倍，并将有效吞吐提升最多 1.9 倍。

papers.title: Accelerating LLM Inference with Lossless Speculative Decoding Algorithms for Heterogeneous Vocabularies
papers.abstract_en: Accelerating the inference of large language models (LLMs) is a critical challenge in generative AI. Speculative decoding (SD) methods offer substantial efficiency gains by generating multiple tokens using a single target forward pass. However, existing SD approaches require the drafter and target models to share the same vocabulary, thus limiting the pool of possible drafters, often necessitating the training of a drafter from scratch. We present three new SD methods that remove this shared-vocabulary constraint. All three methods preserve the target distribution (i.e., they are lossless) and work with off-the-shelf models without requiring additional training or modifications. Empirically, on summarization, programming, and long-context tasks, our algorithms demonstrate significant speedups of up to 2.8x over standard autoregressive decoding. By enabling any off-the-shelf model to serve as a drafter and requiring no retraining, this work substantially broadens the applicability of the SD framework in practice.
papers.abstract_cn: 加速大语言模型 (LLMs) 的推理是生成式人工智能中的一个关键挑战。推测性解码 (SD) 方法通过使用单个目标正向传递生成多个标记来提高效率。然而，现有的 SD 方法要求绘图员和目标模型共享相同的词汇量，从而限制了可能的绘图员池，通常需要从头开始训练绘图员。我们提出了三种新的 SD 方法来消除这种共享词汇量的约束。所有这三种方法都保留了目标分布 (即无损)，并且可以使用现成的模型，无需额外的训练或修改。实证结果表明，在总结、编程和长上下文任务方面，我们的算法比标准自回归解码显著加速了高达 2.8 倍。通过使任何现成的模型都能作为绘图员，且不需要再次训练，这项工作大大扩展了 SD 框架在实践中的适用性。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of speculative decoding that draft and target models must share the same vocabulary, which restricts drafter choice and often requires bespoke training. It proposes three lossless speculative decoding algorithms that support heterogeneous vocabularies by preserving the target model’s output distribution while using arbitrary off-the-shelf models as drafters without retraining or modification. Experiments on summarization, code generation, and long-context tasks show speedups of up to 2.8× over standard autoregressive decoding, substantially broadening the practical applicability of speculative decoding.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对推测解码通常要求草稿模型与目标模型共享词表、从而限制可用 drafter 的问题，提出三种无损推测解码算法，使异构词表的现成模型也能作为草稿模型并保持目标分布。其核心优势是无需额外训练或模型修改即可直接应用，在摘要、编程和长上下文任务上相较标准自回归解码最高实现 2.8 倍加速，显著扩展了推测解码的实际适用范围。

papers.title: AdaServe: Accelerating Multi-SLO LLM Serving with SLO-Customized Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Modern large language model (LLM) applications exhibit diverse service-level objectives (SLOs), from low-latency requirements in interactive coding assistants to more relaxed constraints in data wrangling tasks. Existing LLM serving systems, which rely on uniform batching and scheduling strategies, often fail to meet these heterogeneous SLOs concurrently. We present AdaServe, the first LLM serving system designed to support efficient multi-SLO serving through SLO-customized speculative decoding. AdaServe formulates multi-SLO serving as a constrained optimization problem and introduces a hardware-aware algorithm that constructs a speculation tree tailored to each request's latency target. It features a speculate-select-verify pipeline that enables fine-grained control over decoding speed while maximizing system throughput. AdaServe further adapts to workload variation by dynamically adjusting speculation parameters. Evaluations across diverse workloads show that AdaServe reduces SLO violations by up to 4.3$\times$ and improves goodput by up to 1.9$\times$ compared to the best performing baselines, highlighting its effectiveness in multi-SLO serving.
papers.abstract_cn: 现代大语言模型 (LLM) 应用程序表现出多样化的服务级别目标 (SLO)，从交互式编码助手中的低延迟要求到数据处理任务中更宽松的约束。现有的 LLM 服务系统依赖于统一的批处理和调度策略，通常无法同时满足这些异构 SLO。我们介绍了 AdaServe，这是第一个旨在通过 SLO 定制的投机性解码来支持高效多 SLO 服务的 LLM 服务系统。AdaServe 将多 SLO 服务表述为一个受约束的最佳化问题，并引入了一种硬件感知算法，该算法构建了一棵针对每个请求的延迟目标量身定制的投机树。它具有一个推测 - 选择 - 验证管道，可以对解码速度进行细粒度控制，同时最大限度地提高系统吞吐量。AdaServe 通过动态调整推测参数，进一步适应工作负载变化。跨不同工作负载的评估显示，与最佳表现基准相比，AdaServe 将违反 SLO 的情况减少了多达 4.3 美元，并将产出提高了多达 1.9 美元，突出了其在多 SLO 服务中的有效性。
papers.ai_summary_en: AdaServe addresses heterogeneous latency SLOs in LLM serving, where uniform batching and scheduling cannot simultaneously satisfy interactive low-latency and throughput-oriented workloads. It formulates multi-SLO serving as a constrained optimization problem and uses SLO-customized speculative decoding, with a hardware-aware algorithm that builds per-request speculation trees and a speculate-select-verify pipeline to dynamically trade off decoding speed and throughput. Evaluations show up to 4.3× fewer SLO violations and 1.9× higher goodput than strong baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM服务中不同应用具有异构延迟SLO、传统统一批处理与调度难以同时满足的问题，提出了AdaServe多SLO服务系统。其核心方法是将多SLO服务建模为约束优化，并通过硬件感知的SLO定制投机解码、为每个请求构造合适的投机树及“推测-选择-验证”流水线，在动态负载下细粒度控制延迟与吞吐。实验表明，AdaServe相较最佳基线可将SLO违约最多降低4.3倍，并将有效吞吐最多提升1.9倍。

papers.title: DSSD: Efficient Edge-Device LLM Deployment and Collaborative Inference via Distributed Split Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have transformed natural language processing but face critical deployment challenges in device-edge systems due to resource limitations and communication overhead. To address these issues, collaborative frameworks have emerged that combine small language models (SLMs) on devices with LLMs at the edge, using speculative decoding (SD) to improve efficiency. However, existing solutions often trade inference accuracy for latency or suffer from high uplink transmission costs when verifying candidate tokens. In this paper, we propose Distributed Split Speculative Decoding (DSSD), a novel architecture that not only preserves the SLM-LLM split but also partitions the verification phase between the device and edge. In this way, DSSD replaces the uplink transmission of multiple vocabulary distributions with a single downlink transmission, significantly reducing communication latency while maintaining inference quality. Experiments show that our solution outperforms current methods, and codes are at: https://github.com/JasonNing96/DSSD-Efficient-Edge-Computing
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型 (LLMs) 已经改变了自然语言处理，但由于资源限制和通信开销，在设备边缘系统中面临着关键的部署挑战。为了解决这些问题，协作框架已经出现，它们将设备上的小语言模型 (SLMs) 与边缘的 LLMs 相结合，使用推测性解码 (SD) 来提高效率。然而，现有的解决方案在验证候选令牌时往往会牺牲推理准确性来换取延迟，或者面临高昂的上行链路传输成本。在本文中，我们提出了分布式拆分推测性解码 (DSSD)，这是一种新颖的架构，它不仅保留了 SLM-LLM 拆分，还将验证阶段分割在设备和边缘之间。通过这种方式，DSSD 用单个下行链路传输取代了多个词汇表分配的上行链路传输，显著降低了通信延迟，同时保持了推理质量。实验表明，我们的解决方案性能优于当前方法，代码位于:https://github.com/jasonning96/DSSD-Efficient-Edge-computing
papers.ai_summary_en: DSSD addresses efficient LLM deployment in device–edge systems, where limited on-device resources and high communication overhead degrade collaborative speculative decoding. Its key insight is to split the verification phase between the device SLM and edge LLM, replacing costly uplink transmission of multiple vocabulary distributions with a single downlink transmission. Experiments show that DSSD reduces communication latency while preserving inference quality and outperforms existing collaborative speculative decoding methods.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对设备-边缘协同部署大模型时资源受限、投机解码验证阶段上行通信开销高且易牺牲精度的问题展开研究。核心方法是提出分布式拆分投机解码（DSSD），在保留设备端小模型草稿、边缘端大模型验证的同时，将验证阶段也拆分到设备与边缘之间，用单次下行传输替代多个词表分布的上行传输。实验表明，该方案在保持推理质量的同时显著降低通信延迟，并优于现有协同投机解码方法。

papers.title: SwiftSpec: Ultra-Low Latency LLM Decoding by Scaling Asynchronous Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Low-latency decoding for large language models (LLMs) is crucial for applications like chatbots and code assistants, yet generating long outputs remains slow in single-query settings. Prior work on speculative decoding (which combines a small draft model with a larger target model) and tensor parallelism has each accelerated decoding. However, conventional approaches fail to apply both simultaneously due to imbalanced compute requirements (between draft and target models), KV-cache inconsistencies, and communication overheads under small-batch tensor-parallelism. This paper introduces SwiftSpec, a system that targets ultra-low latency for LLM decoding. SwiftSpec redesigns the speculative decoding pipeline in an asynchronous and disaggregated manner, so that each component can be scaled flexibly and remove draft overhead from the critical path. To realize this design, SwiftSpec proposes parallel tree generation, tree-aware KV cache management, and fused, latency-optimized kernels to overcome the challenges listed above. Across 5 model families and 6 datasets, SwiftSpec achieves an average of 1.75x speedup over state-of-the-art speculative decoding systems and, as a highlight, serves Llama3-70B at 348 tokens/s on 8 Nvidia Hopper GPUs, making it the fastest known system for low-latency LLM serving at this scale.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型 (LLM) 的低延迟解码对于聊天机器人和代码助手等应用程序至关重要，但在单查询设置下生成长输出仍然缓慢。之前关于推测性解码 (将小草稿模型和较大的目标模型结合) 和张量并行化的研究都加快了解码速度。然而，由于计算需求 (草稿模型和目标模型之间) 不平衡、KV 缓存不一致以及小批量张量并行化下的通信开销，传统方法无法同时应用这两种方法。本文介绍了 SwiftSpec，一个针对 LLM 解码的超低延迟系统。SwiftSpec 以异步和分解的方式重新设计了投机解码管道，使每个组件都能灵活扩展，并从关键路径中消除草稿开销。为了实现这种设计，SwiftSpec 提出了并行树生成、树感知 KV 缓存管理和融合的延迟优化内核，以克服上述挑战。在 5 个模型系列和 6 个数据集中，SwiftSpec 与最先进的投机解码系统相比，平均速度提升了 1.75 倍。值得注意的是，SwiftSpec 在 8 个 Nvidia Hopper GPU 上以每秒 348 个标记的速度为 Llama3-70B 提供服务，使其成为已知最快的低延迟 LLM 服务系统。
papers.ai_summary_en: SwiftSpec addresses ultra-low-latency single-query LLM decoding, where combining speculative decoding with tensor parallelism is limited by draft–target compute imbalance, KV-cache inconsistencies, and communication overhead. It introduces an asynchronous, disaggregated speculative decoding pipeline that removes drafting from the critical path using parallel tree generation, tree-aware KV-cache management, and fused latency-optimized kernels. Across 5 model families and 6 datasets, SwiftSpec achieves an average 1.75× speedup over state-of-the-art speculative decoding systems and serves Llama3-70B at 348 tokens/s on 8 Nvidia Hopper GPUs.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对单查询场景下大模型长输出解码延迟高、且投机解码与张量并行难以同时应用的问题，重点解决草稿/目标模型计算不均衡、KV-cache 不一致和小批量张量并行通信开销。SwiftSpec 将投机解码重构为异步、解耦的流水线，使草稿生成与目标模型验证可独立扩展，并通过并行树生成、树感知 KV-cache 管理和融合低延迟算子把草稿开销移出关键路径。实验显示，其在 5 类模型和 6 个数据集上平均较最先进投机解码系统加速 1.75 倍，并可在 8 张 Hopper GPU 上以 348 tokens/s 服务 Llama3-70B。

papers.title: Tutorial Proposal: Speculative Decoding for Efficient LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: This tutorial presents a comprehensive introduction to Speculative Decoding (SD), an advanced technique for LLM inference acceleration that has garnered significant research interest in recent years. SD is introduced as an innovative decoding paradigm to mitigate the high inference latency stemming from autoregressive decoding in LLMs. At each decoding step, SD efficiently drafts several future tokens and then verifies them in parallel. This approach, unlike traditional autoregressive decoding, facilitates the simultaneous decoding of multiple tokens per step, thereby achieving promising 2x-4x speedups in LLM inference while maintaining original distributions. This tutorial delves into the latest techniques in SD, including draft model architectures and verification strategies. Additionally, it explores the acceleration potential and future research directions in this promising field. We aim for this tutorial to elucidate the current research landscape and offer insights for researchers interested in Speculative Decoding, ultimately contributing to more efficient LLM inference.
papers.abstract_cn: 本教程全面介绍了推测性解码 (SD)，这是一种用于 LLM 推理加速的先进技术，近年来引起了广泛的研究兴趣。SD 作为一种创新的解码范式被引入，旨在减少 LLM 中自回归解码导致的高推理延迟。在每个解码步骤中，SD 都会高效地绘制几个未来标记，然后并行验证它们。与传统的自回归解码不同，这种方法促进了每步骤同时解码多个标记，从而在保持原始分布的同时，实现了 LLM 推理的 2 倍-4 倍的加速。本教程深入探讨了 SD 中的最新技术，包括模型绘制架构和验证策略。此外，本教程探讨了这个前景广阔的领域的加速潜力和未来研究方向。我们的目标是通过本教程阐明当前的研究前景，并为对推测性解码感兴趣的研究人员提供见解，最终为更高效的 LLM 推理做出贡献。
papers.ai_summary_en: This tutorial addresses the high inference latency of autoregressive LLM decoding, where tokens are generated sequentially. It surveys speculative decoding, in which a draft model proposes multiple candidate tokens that the target LLM verifies in parallel, preserving the original output distribution while exploiting token-level parallelism. The tutorial highlights typical 2x–4x inference speedups and discusses key design axes such as draft architectures, verification strategies, and future research directions.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该教程面向大模型推理中自回归解码延迟高的问题，系统介绍投机解码这一加速范式。其核心思路是在每个解码步先生成多个候选未来 token，再通过并行验证实现“多 token 一步解码”，并在保持原始输出分布的前提下提升效率。教程梳理了草稿模型架构与验证策略等关键技术，指出该方法可带来约 2–4 倍推理加速，并展望了后续研究方向。

papers.title: Scaling Up, Speeding Up: A Benchmark of Speculative Decoding for Efficient LLM Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling has emerged as a powerful paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by allocating additional computational resources during inference. However, this paradigm is inherently inefficient due to the generation of redundant and repetitive reasoning traces, leading to significant computational overhead. Speculative decoding offers a promising avenue for mitigating this inefficiency, yet its efficacy in the structured, repetition-rich context of test-time scaling remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce the first comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate speculative decoding methods for accelerating LLM test-time scaling. Our benchmark provides consistent experimental protocols across representative test-time scaling paradigms (e.g., Best-of-N sampling and multi-round thinking), enabling a fair comparison of three major categories of speculative decoding: model-based, training-based, and n-gram-based methods. Extensive experiments reveal that simple n-gram-based methods effectively capture repetitive patterns, demonstrating unique potential in accelerating test-time scaling. This phenomenon demonstrates the value of integrating n-gram-based methods with model-based or training-based approaches to balance acceleration for both repetitive and diverse reasoning in test-time scaling. We hope this benchmark spurs further research on speculative decoding for test-time scaling, enabling faster and more practical reasoning in LLMs through better handling of repetitive and diverse reasoning paths.
papers.abstract_cn: 测试时间缩放已经成为一种强大的范式，通过在推理过程中分配额外的计算资源来提高大语言模型 (LLMs) 的推理能力。然而，由于产生冗余和重复的推理痕迹，这种范式本质上是低效的，导致了显著的计算开销。推测性解码为缓解这种低效率提供了一种有前景的途径，然而，它在测试时间缩放的结构化、富含重复的背景下的有效性在很大程度上仍未被探索。为了弥补这种差距，我们引入了第一个全面的基准测试，旨在评估用于加速 LLM 测试时间缩放的推测性解码方法。我们的基准提供了跨越代表性测试时间缩放范式 (例如，N 中最优抽样和多轮思维) 的一致实验方案，使我们能够公平地比较三大类推测性解码方法：基于模型的方法、基于训练的方法和基于 n-gram 的方法。广泛的实验表明，基于 n-gram 的简单方法能够有效捕获重复模式，展示了加速测试时间缩放的独特潜力。这种现象证明了将基于 n-gram 的方法与基于模型或基于训练的方法相结合的价值，以平衡测试时间缩放中重复和多样化推理的加速。我们希望这个基准能够促进对测试时间缩放的推测性解码的进一步研究，通过更好地处理重复和多样化的推理路径，使 LLM 中的推理更快、更实用。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper tackles the inference inefficiency of LLM test-time scaling, where methods such as Best-of-N sampling and multi-round reasoning incur high cost by generating redundant and repetitive reasoning traces. It introduces the first benchmark for evaluating speculative decoding in this setting, comparing model-based, training-based, and n-gram-based drafters under consistent protocols across representative test-time scaling paradigms. Experiments show that simple n-gram-based methods are especially effective at accelerating repetition-heavy reasoning, motivating hybrid approaches that combine them with model- or training-based speculation to handle both repetitive and diverse reasoning paths.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM测试时扩展（如Best-of-N、多轮思考）因生成重复冗余推理轨迹而导致推理效率低的问题，构建了首个系统评测投机解码加速效果的基准。它在统一实验协议下比较了基于模型、基于训练和基于n-gram的三类投机解码方法，并揭示测试时推理场景中存在高度可复用的重复模式。实验表明，简单的n-gram方法能有效捕获这些模式并展现独特加速潜力，为将其与模型或训练式方法结合、兼顾重复与多样推理的高效推理提供了依据。

papers.title: Towards Efficient LLM Inference via Collective and Adaptive Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have gained considerable attention for their remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks. However, efficient LLM inference remains challenging because of the autoregressive decoding process, which generates only one token at a time. Speculative decoding has been introduced to address the limitation by using small speculative models (SSMs) to speed up LLM inference. However, the low acceptance rate of SSMs and the high verification cost of LLM prohibit further performance improvement. In this paper, we present Smurfs, an LLM inference system designed to accelerate LLM inference through collective and adaptive speculative decoding. Smurfs adopts a majority-voted mechanism that harnesses multiple SSMs to collaboratively predict LLM outputs in multi-task scenarios, while avoiding high verification cost. It also decouples SSM speculation from LLM verification and uses a pipelined execution to hide the latency of SSM speculation. Additionally, Smurfs proposes a mechanism to dynamically determine the optimal speculation length of SSM at runtime, balancing the performance impact of accepted tokens and verification cost. The experimental results demonstrate the superiority of Smurfs in terms of inference throughput and latency compared to the state-of-the-art LLM inference systems.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型 (LLMs) 因其在广泛任务中的出色性能而受到相当多的关注。然而，由于自回归解码过程每次只生成一个标记，高效的 LLM 推理仍然具有挑战性。为了解决这一局限性，已经引入了推测性解码，通过使用小型推测模型 (SSMs) 来加速 LLM 推理。然而，SSMs 的接受率低和 LLM 的高验证成本阻碍了性能的进一步提高。在本文中，我们介绍了 Smurfs，一个 LLM 推理系统，旨在通过集体和自适应的推测性解码来加速 LLM 推理。Smurfs 采用多数表决机制，利用多个 SSM 在多任务场景中协同预测 LLM 输出，同时避免高验证成本。它还将 SSM 推测与 LLM 验证解耦，并使用流水线执行来隐藏 SSM 推测的延迟。此外，Smurfs 提出了一种机制，在运行时动态确定 SSM 的最佳推测长度，平衡已接受令牌的性能影响和验证成本。实验结果表明，与最先进的 LLM 推理系统相比，Smurfs 在推理吞吐量和延迟方面具有优越性。
papers.ai_summary_en: Smurfs addresses inefficient autoregressive LLM inference, particularly the low acceptance rate of small speculative models and the high verification overhead in standard speculative decoding. It introduces collective and adaptive speculative decoding, using multiple small speculative models with majority voting for multi-task drafting, pipelined decoupling of speculation and verification, and runtime selection of optimal speculation length. Experiments show improved inference throughput and latency over state-of-the-art LLM inference systems.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM自回归推理中推测解码接受率低、验证成本高的问题，提出Smurfs系统，通过多个小推测模型多数投票协作预测、推测与验证解耦的流水线执行，以及运行时动态选择最优推测长度来提升效率。实验表明，该方法在推理吞吐和延迟上均优于现有先进LLM推理系统。

papers.title: Speculative Decoding in Decentralized LLM Inference: Turning Communication Latency into Computation Throughput
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight draft model to propose tokens that are later verified by a stronger target model. While effective in centralized systems, its behavior in decentralized settings, where network latency often dominates compute, remains under-characterized. We present Decentralized Speculative Decoding (DSD), a plug-and-play framework for decentralized inference that turns communication delay into useful computation by verifying multiple candidate tokens in parallel across distributed nodes. We further introduce an adaptive speculative verification strategy that adjusts acceptance thresholds by token-level semantic importance, delivering an additional 15% to 20% end-to-end speedup without retraining. In theory, DSD reduces cross-node communication cost by approximately (N-1)t1(k-1)/k, where t1 is per-link latency and k is the average number of tokens accepted per round. In practice, DSD achieves up to 2.56x speedup on HumanEval and 2.59x on GSM8K, surpassing the Eagle3 baseline while preserving accuracy. These results show that adapting speculative decoding for decentralized execution provides a system-level optimization that converts network stalls into throughput, enabling faster distributed LLM inference with no model retraining or architectural changes.
papers.abstract_cn: 推测性解码通过使用轻量级草案模型来提出令牌，然后通过更强的目标模型进行验证，从而加速大语言模型 (LLM) 推理。尽管在集中式系统中有效，但在网络延迟通常主导计算的去中心化环境中，其行为仍然不够明显。我们提出了去中心化推测性解码 (DSD)，这是一种用于去中心化推理的即插即用框架，通过在分布式节点上并行验证多个候选令牌，将通信延迟转化为有用的计算。我们进一步引入了一种自适应的推测性验证策略，该策略根据令牌级语义重要性调整接受阈值，在不重新训练的情况下提供额外 15% 到 20% 的端到端加速。理论上，DSD 将跨节点通信成本降低了约 (N-1) t1(k-1)/k，其中 t1 是每条链路的延迟，k 是每轮接受的平均令牌数。在实践中，DSD 在 HumanEval 和 GSM8K 上分别实现了高达 2.56 倍和 2.59 倍的加速度，超过了 Eagle3 基准，同时保持了准确性。这些结果表明，为去中心化执行调整投机性解码提供了系统级优化，将网络停滞转化为吞吐量，实现更快的分布式 LLM 推理，无需模型重新训练或架构变更。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses speculative decoding in decentralized LLM inference, where cross-node communication latency often dominates compute and limits acceleration. It proposes Decentralized Speculative Decoding (DSD), a plug-and-play framework that converts communication stalls into useful work by verifying multiple draft tokens in parallel across distributed nodes and adaptively adjusting acceptance thresholds by token-level semantic importance. DSD reduces theoretical communication overhead and achieves up to 2.56× speedup on HumanEval and 2.59× on GSM8K over Eagle3 while preserving accuracy without retraining or architectural changes.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对去中心化 LLM 推理中网络通信延迟主导性能、传统投机解码难以有效利用等待时间的问题，提出即插即用的 Decentralized Speculative Decoding（DSD）框架。其核心洞见是将跨节点通信空窗转化为并行验证多个候选 token 的计算机会，并通过基于 token 语义重要性的自适应接受阈值策略进一步提升效率。实验显示，DSD 在 HumanEval 和 GSM8K 上分别最高实现 2.56× 和 2.59× 加速，优于 Eagle3 且保持精度，无需重训练或模型架构改动。

papers.title: Quantize-Sample-and-Verify: LLM Acceleration via Adaptive Edge-Cloud Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: In edge-cloud speculative decoding (SD), edge devices equipped with small language models (SLMs) generate draft tokens that are verified by large language models (LLMs) in the cloud. A key bottleneck in such systems is the limited communication bandwidth between edge and cloud, which necessitates quantization of the information transmitted about generated tokens. In this work, we introduce a novel quantize-sample (Q-S) strategy that provably preserves the output distribution of the cloud-based model, ensuring that the verified tokens match the distribution of those that would have been generated directly by the LLM. We develop a throughput model for edge-cloud SD that explicitly accounts for communication latency. Leveraging this model, we propose an adaptive mechanism that optimizes token throughput by dynamically adjusting the draft length and quantization precision in response to both semantic uncertainty and channel conditions. Simulations demonstrate that the proposed Q-S approach significantly improves decoding efficiency in realistic edge-cloud deployment scenarios.
papers.abstract_cn: 在边缘云投机解码 (SD) 中，配备小语言模型 (SLM) 的边缘设备生成草稿令牌，并由云中的大语言模型 (LLM) 进行验证。这些系统中的一个关键瓶颈是边缘和云之间有限的通信带宽，这需要对传输的关于生成令牌的信息进行量化。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种新的量化样本 (Q-S) 策略，可以证明保留了基于云的模型的输出分布，确保验证的令牌与直接由 LLM 生成的令牌的分布相匹配。我们为边缘云 SD 开发了一个吞吐量模型，明确考虑了通信延迟。利用这个模型，我们提出了一种自适应机制，该机制通过动态调整草稿长度和量化精度来优化令牌吞吐量，以响应语义不确定性和信道条件。仿真结果表明，所提出的 Q-S 方法在真实的边缘云部署场景中显著提高了解码效率。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses bandwidth-limited edge-cloud speculative decoding, where edge small-language-model drafts must be compressed for cloud LLM verification without distorting the target output distribution. It proposes a quantize-sample strategy with provable distribution preservation, a latency-aware throughput model, and an adaptive controller that jointly tunes draft length and quantization precision according to semantic uncertainty and channel conditions. Simulations show the approach substantially improves token throughput and decoding efficiency in realistic edge-cloud deployments.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘—云推测解码中通信带宽受限、草稿信息需量化传输的问题，提出 Quantize-Sample-and-Verify 策略，以在量化条件下可证明地保持云端大模型的输出分布。其核心方法是建立考虑通信延迟的吞吐模型，并根据语义不确定性和信道条件自适应调整草稿长度与量化精度。仿真结果表明，该方法在真实边缘—云部署场景中显著提升了解码吞吐效率。

papers.title: Efficient LLM Inference over Heterogeneous Edge Networks with Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) inference at the network edge is a promising serving paradigm that leverages distributed edge resources to run inference near users and enhance privacy. Existing edge-based LLM inference systems typically adopt autoregressive decoding (AD), which only generates one token per forward pass. This iterative process, compounded by the limited computational resources of edge nodes, results in high serving latency and constrains the system's ability to support multiple users under growing demands.To address these challenges, we propose a speculative decoding (SD)-based LLM serving framework that deploys small and large models across heterogeneous edge nodes to collaboratively deliver inference services. Specifically, the small model rapidly generates draft tokens that the large model verifies in parallel, enabling multi-token generation per forward pass and thus reducing serving latency. To improve resource utilization of edge nodes, we incorporate pipeline parallelism to overlap drafting and verification across multiple inference tasks. Based on this framework, we analyze and derive a comprehensive latency model incorporating both communication and inference latency. Then, we formulate a joint optimization problem for speculation length, task batching, and wireless communication resource allocation to minimize total serving latency. To address this problem, we derive the closed-form solutions for wireless communication resource allocation, and develop a dynamic programming algorithm for joint batching and speculation control strategies. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves lower serving latency compared to AD-based serving systems. In addition,the proposed joint optimization method delivers up to 44.9% latency reduction compared to benchmark schemes.
papers.abstract_cn: 网络边缘的大语言模型 (LLM) 推理是一种有前景的服务范式，它利用分布式边缘资源在用户附近运行推理并增强隐私。现有的基于边缘的 LLM 推理系统通常采用自回归解码 (AD)，即每次前向传递只生成一个令牌。这种迭代过程，加上边缘节点有限的计算资源，导致高服务延迟，并限制了系统在不断增长的 demands.to 下支持多个用户的能力。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种基于投机解码 (SD) 的 LLM 服务框架，该框架在异构边缘节点之间部署小型和大型模型，以协同提供推理服务。具体而言，小型模型快速生成草稿代币，大型模型并行验证，从而实现每次正向传递多个代币的生成，从而降低服务延迟。为了提高边节点的资源利用率，我们引入了流水线并行性，在多个推理任务之间进行重叠绘图和验证。基于这个框架，我们分析并推导了一个综合考虑通信和推理延迟的延迟模型。然后，我们提出了一个推测长度、任务批处理和无线通信资源分配的联合最佳化问题，以最小化总的服务延迟。为了解决这个问题，我们推导了无线通信资源分配的闭式解决方案，并开发了一个联合批处理和推测控制策略的动态规划算法。实验结果表明，与基于 AD 的服务系统相比，所提出的框架实现了更低的服务延迟。此外，所提出的联合优化方法与基准方案相比，延迟降低了 44.9%。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses high latency and limited multi-user scalability in edge-based LLM inference caused by autoregressive decoding on resource-constrained heterogeneous edge nodes. It proposes a speculative decoding framework that places small draft models and large verifier models across edge nodes, uses pipeline parallelism to overlap drafting and verification, and jointly optimizes speculation length, task batching, and wireless resource allocation via closed-form communication scheduling and dynamic programming. Experiments show lower serving latency than autoregressive edge serving, with up to 44.9% latency reduction over benchmark schemes.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对边缘网络中LLM自回归推理因单token生成和节点算力受限导致的高延迟、多用户服务瓶颈，论文提出在异构边缘节点间部署“小模型起草、大模型并行验证”的投机解码服务框架，并用流水线并行重叠多任务的起草与验证。其核心方法是建立通信与推理联合时延模型，并对投机长度、任务批处理及无线资源分配进行联合优化，通过闭式资源分配和动态规划算法最小化总服务时延。实验表明，该框架较自回归系统显著降低边缘LLM服务延迟，联合优化方案最多可减少44.9%时延。

papers.title: FlowSpec: Continuous Pipelined Speculative Decoding for Efficient Distributed LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Distributed inference serves as a promising approach to enabling the inference of large language models (LLMs) at the network edge. It distributes the inference process to multiple devices to ensure that the LLMs can fit into the device memory. Recent pipeline-based approaches have the potential to parallelize communication and computation, which helps reduce inference latency. However, the benefit diminishes when the inference request at the network edge is sparse, where pipeline is typically at low utilization. To enable efficient distributed LLM inference at the edge, we propose \textbf{FlowSpec}, a pipeline-parallel tree-based speculative decoding framework. FlowSpec incorporates three key mechanisms to improve decoding efficiency: 1) score-based step-wise verification prioritizes more important draft tokens to bring earlier accepted tokens; 2) efficient draft management to prune invalid tokens while maintaining correct causal relationship during verification; 3) dynamic draft expansion strategies to supply high-quality speculative inputs. These techniques work in concert to enhance both pipeline utilization and speculative efficiency. We evaluate FlowSpec on a real-world testbed with other baselines. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed framework significantly improves inference speed across diverse models and configurations, achieving speedup ratios 1.37$\times$-1.73$\times$ compared to baselines. Our code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/Leosang-lx/FlowSpec#}{https://github.com/Leosang-lx/FlowSpec\#}.
papers.abstract_cn: 分布式推理是一种有前景的方法，可以在网络边缘实现大语言模型 (LLMs) 的推理。它将推理过程分布在多个设备上，以确保 LLMs 能够适应设备内存。最近基于管道的方法具有并行化通信和计算的潜力，这有助于降低推理延迟。然而，当网络边缘的推理请求稀疏时，这种优势就会减弱，因为管道通常利用率低。为了在边缘实现高效的分布式 LLM 推理，我们提出了\textbf{FlowSpec}，一种基于管道并行树的推测性解码框架。FlowSpec 整合了三种关键机制来提高解码效率:1) 基于评分的逐步验证优先考虑更重要的代币草稿，以提供更早被接受的代币;2) 高效的草稿管理可以修剪无效代币，同时在验证过程中保持正确的因果关系;3) 动态的草稿扩展策略可以提供高质量的投机性输入。这些技术协同工作，以提高管道利用率和投机效率。我们在实际测试台上使用其他基准对 FlowSpec 进行评估。实验结果表明，我们提出的框架显著提高了不同模型和配置的推理速度，与基准相比，实现了 1.37$\times$-1.73$\times$的加速比。我们的代码可以在\href{https://github.com/leosang-lx/FlowSpec#}{https://github.com/leo Sang-lx/FlowSpec\#}公开获得。
papers.ai_summary_en: FlowSpec tackles inefficient distributed LLM inference at the network edge, where sparse requests cause pipeline-parallel systems to suffer low utilization. It proposes a pipeline-parallel tree-based speculative decoding framework that uses score-based step-wise verification, causal-aware draft pruning, and dynamic draft expansion to prioritize high-value draft tokens and keep pipeline stages continuously occupied. Experiments on a real-world testbed show 1.37×–1.73× inference speedups over baselines across diverse models and configurations.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对网络边缘分布式LLM推理中请求稀疏导致流水线利用率低、延迟收益下降的问题，提出 FlowSpec：一种流水线并行的树形投机解码框架。其核心洞见是通过基于分数的逐步验证、保持因果关系的草稿剪枝管理和动态草稿扩展，让高价值草稿 token 更早被接受并持续供给流水线。实验表明，该方法在真实测试床上显著提升分布式推理速度，相较基线实现 1.37×–1.73× 加速。

papers.title: Mirror Speculative Decoding: Breaking the Serial Barrier in LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by using a draft model to look ahead, but gains are capped by the cost of autoregressive draft generation: increasing draft size elevates acceptance rates but introduces additional latency overhead exacerbating the speed-accuracy tradeoff. Prior methods (Medusa, Hydra, EAGLE) partially reduce draft cost but either degrade acceptance or introduce overheads that limit scaling. We present Mirror Speculative Decoding (Mirror-SD), an inference algorithm that breaks the latency-acceptance tradeoff. Mirror-SD launches branch-complete rollouts from early-exit signals in parallel with the target model's suffix and explicitly maps computation across heterogeneous accelerators (GPU and NPU) to exploit cross-device parallelism. The draft speculates forward continuations for the target to verify, while the target simultaneously speculates correction paths for the draft, converting speculation into two complementary execution pipelines. To further cut draft latency without weakening acceptance semantics, we add speculative streaming so the draft emits multiple tokens per step. This dual strategy of parallel heterogeneous execution plus multi-token speculative streaming pushes speculative decoding toward its ideal regime of high acceptance with low overhead. On SpecBench with server-scale models from 14B to 66B parameters, Mirror-SD delivers consistent end-to-end gains, achieving 2.8x-5.8x wall-time speedups across diverse tasks and a 30% average relative improvement over the strongest baseline, EAGLE3.
papers.abstract_cn: 推测性解码通过使用草稿模型进行前瞻性推理来加速 LLM 推理，但收益受到自回归草稿生成成本的限制：草稿规模的增加提高了接受率，但引入了额外的延迟开销，加剧了速度 - 准确性的权衡。先前的方法 (Medusa、Hydra、EAGLE) 部分降低了草稿成本，但要么降低了接受率，要么引入了限制扩展的开销。我们提出了镜像推测性解码 (Mirror-SD)，这是一种打破延迟 - 接受权衡的推理算法。Mirror-SD 从早期出站信号启动分支完成部署，与目标模型的后缀并行，并显式地将计算映射到异构加速器 (GPU 和 NPU) 以利用跨设备并行性。草稿推测目标需要验证的前向延续，而目标同时推测草稿的修正路径，将推测转化为两个互补的执行流水线。为了进一步减少草稿延迟，同时不影响接受语义，我们添加了推测流，使草稿每步都发出多个令牌。这种并行异构执行和多令牌投机流的双重策略推动投机解码朝着理想的高接受度、低开销的方向发展。在 SpecBench 上，使用 14B 到 66B 参数的服务器级模型，Mirror-SD 提供了一致的端到端增益，在不同任务中实现了 2.8 倍至 5.8 倍的墙时间加速，并且比最强基准 EAGLE3 平均相对改进了 30%。
papers.ai_summary_en: Mirror Speculative Decoding addresses the serial draft-generation bottleneck in speculative LLM inference, where larger drafts improve acceptance but add latency and worsen the speed–accuracy tradeoff. It parallelizes branch-complete draft rollouts from early-exit signals with target-model suffix execution across heterogeneous GPU/NPU devices, lets the target speculatively prepare correction paths, and uses multi-token speculative streaming to reduce draft latency while preserving verification semantics. On SpecBench for 14B–66B models, it achieves 2.8×–5.8× end-to-end wall-time speedups and about 30% average relative improvement over EAGLE3.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对投机解码中草稿生成串行开销导致“高接受率—低延迟”难以兼顾的问题，指出现有方法在降低草稿成本时往往牺牲接受率或引入额外开销。核心方法是 Mirror Speculative Decoding：利用目标模型的早退信号并行生成完整草稿分支，并将计算显式分配到 GPU/NPU 等异构设备上，同时让草稿预测续写、目标模型并行预测纠正路径，再结合每步多 token 的投机流式生成来降低草稿延迟。实验在 SpecBench 上对 14B–66B 模型取得 2.8×–5.8× 端到端加速，相较最强基线 EAGLE3 平均相对提升 30%。

papers.title: Entropy-Aware Speculative Decoding Toward Improved LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model (LLM) reasoning by using a small draft model to generate candidate tokens, which the target LLM either accepts directly or regenerates upon rejection. However, excessive alignment between the draft and target models constrains SD to the performance of the target LLM. To address this limitation, we propose Entropy-Aware Speculative Decoding (EASD), a training-free enhancement. Building on standard SD, EASD incorporates a dynamic entropy-based penalty. At each decoding step, we employ the entropy of the sampling distribution to quantify model uncertainty. When both models exhibit high entropy with substantial overlap among their top-N predictions, the corresponding token is rejected and re-sampled by the target LLM. This penalty prevents low-confidence errors from propagating. By incorporating draft-model verification, EASD enables the possibility of surpassing the target model's inherent performance. Experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that EASD consistently outperforms existing SD methods and, in most cases, surpasses the target LLM itself. We further prove that the efficiency of EASD is comparable to that of SD. The code can be found in the Supplementary Materials.
papers.abstract_cn: 推测性解码 (SD) 通过使用小草图模型生成候选标记来加速大语言模型 (LLM) 的推理，目标 LLM 要么直接接受这些标记，要么在拒绝后重新生成。然而，草图模型和目标模型之间的过度对齐限制了 SD 对目标 LLM 性能的影响。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了熵感知推测性解码 (EASD)，一种无需训练的增强方法。在标准 SD 的基础上，EASD 包含了一个基于动态熵的惩罚。在每个解码步骤中，我们使用采样分布的熵来量化模型的不确定性。当两个模型都表现出高熵且其前 N 个预测之间存在显著重叠时，相应的标记将被目标 LLM 拒绝并重新采样。这种惩罚防止了低置信度误差的传播。通过结合草案模型验证，EASD 使得超越目标模型固有性能的可能性成为可能。跨多个推理基准的实验表明，EASD 始终优于现有的 SD 方法，在大多数情况下，甚至优于目标 LLM 本身。我们进一步证明 EASD 的效率与 SD 相当。代码可以在补充材料中找到。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that standard speculative decoding is bounded by the target LLM’s quality because excessive draft–target alignment can propagate low-confidence errors. It proposes Entropy-Aware Speculative Decoding (EASD), a training-free method that uses sampling entropy and top-N prediction overlap to dynamically reject uncertain tokens for target-model resampling, while incorporating draft-model verification. Experiments on reasoning benchmarks show that EASD consistently outperforms existing speculative decoding methods and often surpasses the target LLM’s accuracy while maintaining comparable efficiency.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对投机解码中草稿模型与目标模型过度对齐、导致推理质量受限于目标LLM且低置信错误易传播的问题，提出了训练免费的熵感知投机解码（EASD）。其核心洞见是利用采样分布熵动态衡量不确定性：当草稿模型和目标模型都高熵且 top-N 候选高度重叠时，拒绝当前 token 并由目标模型重采样，从而抑制低置信错误。实验表明，EASD 在多个推理基准上持续优于现有投机解码方法，且通常能超过目标 LLM 本身，同时保持与标准 SD 相当的效率。

papers.title: DILEMMA: Joint LLM Quantization and Distributed LLM Inference Over Edge Computing Systems
papers.abstract_en: With a recent trend of using Large Language Models (LLMs) for different applications within smart cities, there is a need for pushing these models toward the edge of network while still preserving their performance. Edge Computing (EC) as a physically closer computing resource to the end users can help to reduce the communication delay for serving end users' tasks for LLM-dependent services. However, EC servers have limited capacity in terms of communication, computation, and storage capacity. This paper introduces DILEMMA, a novel framework addressing the challenges of deploying LLMs in EC systems by jointly optimizing layer placement and layer quantization in EC systems. DILEMMA formulates an Integer Linear Programming problem to minimize total inference delay while ensuring acceptable LLM performance levels, leveraging layer-wise quantization and knowledge distillation for LLM performance control. Experimental evaluations on OPT-350 model using the SQuAD dataset demonstrate that DILEMMA achieves a quantization ratio of up to 12.75% while preserving model loss, highlighting its effectiveness in resource-constrained environments.
papers.abstract_cn: 随着近期智能城市中不同应用使用大语言模型 (LLMs) 的趋势，需要将这些模型推向网络边缘，同时保持其性能。边缘计算 (EC) 作为物理上更接近终端用户的计算资源，可以帮助减少通信延迟，为依赖 LLM 的服务提供终端用户任务。然而，EC 服务器在通信、计算和存储容量方面存在限制。本文介绍了 DILMA，这是一种新的框架，通过联合优化 EC 系统中的层放置和层量化来解决在 EC 系统中部署 LLMs 的挑战。DILEMMA 建立了一个整数线性规划问题，以最小化总推理延迟，同时确保可接受的 LLM 性能水平，利用分层量化和知识提取进行 LLM 性能控制。使用 SQuAD 数据集对 OPT-350 模型进行的实验评估表明，DILEMMA 在保持模型损耗的同时，量化率达到 12.75%，突出了其在资源受限环境中的有效性。
papers.ai_summary_en: DILEMMA addresses LLM deployment on resource-constrained edge computing systems, where limited communication, computation, and storage make low-latency inference difficult without unacceptable quality loss. It jointly optimizes layer placement and per-layer quantization via an integer linear program that minimizes total inference delay while enforcing acceptable model performance, using layer-wise quantization and knowledge distillation to control degradation. Experiments on OPT-350 with SQuAD show that DILEMMA can quantize up to 12.75% of the model while preserving loss, demonstrating practical delay–accuracy tradeoffs for edge LLM serving.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘计算系统中部署大语言模型时通信、计算和存储受限的问题，研究如何在降低推理延迟的同时保持模型性能。其核心方法是提出 DILEMMA 框架，将层级放置与层级量化联合建模为整数线性规划，并结合逐层量化和知识蒸馏来控制性能损失。实验在 OPT-350 和 SQuAD 上表明，该方法可实现最高 12.75% 的量化比例并保持模型损失可接受，为资源受限边缘环境下的大模型推理提供了有效方案。

papers.title: Efficient LLM Inference via Activation-Aware Weight Quantization: System Integration and Performance Analysis
papers.abstract_en: The rapid scaling of large language models (LLMs) has driven extraordinary gains in natural language understanding and generation, but at the cost of substantial compute and memory demands. Efficient deployment of such models remains a central challenge for both academic and industrial systems. This paper presents a comprehensive evaluation of activation-aware weight quantization (AWQ) applied to modern transformer architectures within the vLLM serving framework. We benchmark FP16 and 4-bit quantized inference for the OPT and Mistral model families, analyzing latency, throughput, and memory utilization under varying prompt lengths and batch sizes. Results demonstrate that AWQ achieves up to $\text{5 0 \%}$ GPU memory reduction and approximately 60% throughput improvement with minimal impact on output quality, validating AWQ as a practical compression strategy for real-world deployment. The integration of quantization with efficient serving engines like vLLM enables research-grade LLMs on mid-range GPUs without accuracy compromise, highlighting the potential for sustainable, accessible, and scalable LLM inference across hardware tiers.
papers.abstract_cn: 大语言模型 (LLMs) 的快速扩展在自然语言理解和生成方面取得了非凡的进展，但代价是大量的计算和内存需求。高效部署这些模型仍然是学术和工业系统的核心挑战。本文提出了一个全面的评估，将激活感知权重量化 (AWQ) 应用于 vLLM 服务框架下的现代变压器架构。我们对 OPT 和 Mistral 模型家族的 FP16 和 4 位量化推理进行了基准测试，分析了不同提示长度和批量大小下的延迟、吞吐量和内存利用率。结果表明，AWQ 实现了高达$\text{5 0 \%}$的 GPU 内存减少和约 60% 的吞吐量改进，对输出质量的影响最小，验证了 AWQ 作为实际部署的压缩策略的可行性。量化与 vLLM 等高效服务引擎的集成使得在中端 GPU 上实现研究级 LLM 成为可能，而不会影响准确性，突显了跨硬件层进行可持续、可访问和可扩展 LLM 推理的潜力。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the high memory and compute cost of LLM serving by evaluating activation-aware weight quantization (AWQ) for transformer models within the vLLM inference framework. It integrates 4-bit AWQ weight quantization with vLLM’s efficient serving pipeline and benchmarks OPT and Mistral models against FP16 across varying prompt lengths and batch sizes. Results show up to 50% GPU memory reduction and roughly 60% throughput improvement with minimal output-quality degradation, demonstrating practical low-resource deployment on mid-range GPUs.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 论文面向大语言模型推理中的高显存占用与低吞吐问题，在 vLLM 服务框架中集成激活感知权重量化（AWQ），通过对关键权重进行 4-bit 量化实现高效推理。实验表明，该方法在 OPT 和 Mistral 模型上可将 GPU 显存降低约 50%、吞吐提升约 60%，且对输出质量影响很小，为中端 GPU 上的高质量 LLM 部署提供了可行路径。

papers.title: Bench360: Benchmarking Local LLM Inference from 360°
papers.abstract_en: Running LLMs locally has become increasingly common, but users face a complex design space across models, quantization levels, inference engines, and serving scenarios. Existing inference benchmarks are fragmented and focus on isolated goals, offering little guidance for practical deployments. We present Bench360, a framework for evaluating local LLM inference across tasks, usage patterns, and system metrics in one place. Bench360 supports custom tasks, integrates multiple inference engines and quantization formats, and reports both task quality and system behavior (latency, throughput, energy, startup time). We demonstrate it on four NLP tasks across three GPUs and four engines, showing how design choices shape efficiency and output quality. Results confirm that tradeoffs are substantial and configuration choices depend on specific workloads and constraints. There is no universal best option, underscoring the need for comprehensive, deployment-oriented benchmarks.
papers.abstract_cn: 在本地运行大语言模型（LLM）变得越来越普遍，但用户在模型、量化级别、推理引擎和服务场景方面面临复杂的设计空间。现有的推理基准是分散的，并且侧重于孤立的目标，对实际部署几乎没有指导作用。我们提出 Bench360，这是一个在一个平台上评估本地 LLM 推理的框架，涵盖任务、使用模式和系统指标。Bench360 支持自定义任务，集成多种推理引擎和量化格式，并报告任务质量和系统行为（延迟、吞吐量、能耗、启动时间）。我们在三块 GPU、四种引擎上展示了四个 NLP 任务，展示了设计选择如何影响效率和输出质量。结果证实了权衡是显著的，配置选择取决于具体的工作负载和约束。没有通用的最佳选项，这凸显了全面的、面向部署的基准测试的必要性。
papers.ai_summary_en: Bench360 addresses the lack of unified, deployment-oriented benchmarks for local LLM inference, where choices of model, quantization level, inference engine, and serving scenario create complex quality–efficiency tradeoffs. The framework integrates multiple engines and quantization formats, supports custom tasks, and jointly measures task quality alongside system metrics such as latency, throughput, energy consumption, and startup time. Experiments across four NLP tasks, three GPUs, and four engines show substantial configuration-dependent tradeoffs and no universally optimal setup, highlighting the need for workload-specific benchmarking.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对本地 LLM 推理在模型、量化等级、推理引擎和部署场景上评测碎片化的问题，提出统一基准框架 Bench360，可同时衡量任务质量与延迟、吞吐、能耗、启动时间等系统指标。它集成多种引擎和量化格式，并在四类 NLP 任务、三种 GPU 和四个推理引擎上系统比较不同配置的影响。结果表明量化与引擎选择存在显著的质量—效率权衡，最优配置高度依赖具体负载，强调面向实际部署的综合评测必要性。

papers.title: Optimizing Attention for Efficient LLM Inference: A Review
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of deep learning has led to significant progress in large language models (LLMs), with the Attention mechanism serving as a core component of their success. However, the computational and memory demands of Attention mechanisms pose bottlenecks for efficient inference, especially in long-sequence and real-time tasks. This paper systematically reviews optimization strategies for Attention mechanisms, including sparse attention, low-rank decomposition, quantization techniques, block-based parallel computation, and memory management. These approaches have demonstrated notable improvements in reducing computational complexity, optimizing memory usage, and enhancing inference performance. This review highlights the key challenges of computational efficiency, long-sequence modeling, and cross-task generalization through an in-depth analysis of existing methods, their advantages, and limitations. Future research directions, including dynamic precision, hardware-aware optimization, and lightweight architectures offer insights for advancing LLM inference theory and practice.
papers.abstract_cn: 深度学习的快速进步导致大语言模型 (LLMs) 取得了重大进展，注意力机制是其成功的核心组成部分。然而，注意力机制的计算和内存需求对高效推理构成了瓶颈，特别是在长序列和实时任务中。本文系统地综述了注意力机制的优化策略，包括稀疏注意力、低秩分解、量化技术、基于块的并行计算和内存管理。这些方法在降低计算复杂度、优化内存使用和提高推理性能方面取得了显著进步。本综述通过深入分析现有方法及其优势和局限性，突出了计算效率、长序列建模和交叉任务泛化的关键挑战。未来的研究方向，包括动态精度、硬件感知优化和轻量化架构，为推进 LLM 推理理论和实践提供了见解。
papers.ai_summary_en: This review addresses the computational and memory bottlenecks of attention mechanisms in LLM inference, particularly for long-sequence and latency-sensitive workloads. It systematically analyzes optimization strategies such as sparse attention, low-rank decomposition, quantization, block-parallel computation, and memory management, while highlighting trade-offs in efficiency, long-context modeling, and generalization. The paper concludes that these methods substantially reduce inference cost and identifies dynamic precision, hardware-aware design, and lightweight architectures as key future directions.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该文针对大模型推理中注意力机制带来的计算与显存瓶颈，尤其是长序列和实时任务下的高效推理问题，系统综述了稀疏注意力、低秩分解、量化、块并行计算和内存管理等优化策略。其核心洞见是通过降低注意力复杂度、压缩计算精度与优化内存访问来提升推理效率，并强调动态精度、硬件感知优化和轻量架构的重要性。总结表明，这些方法可显著减少计算和内存开销、提升推理性能，但长序列建模与跨任务泛化仍是关键挑战。

papers.title: KV Cache Transform Coding for Compact Storage in LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Serving large language models (LLMs) at scale necessitates efficient key-value (KV) cache management. KV caches can be reused across conversation turns via shared-prefix prompts that are common in iterative code editing and chat. However, stale caches consume scarce GPU memory, require offloading, or force recomputation. We present KVTC, a lightweight transform coder that compresses KV caches for compact on-GPU and off-GPU storage. Drawing on classical media compression, KVTC combines PCA-based feature decorrelation, adaptive quantization, and entropy coding. It requires only a brief initial calibration and leaves model parameters unchanged. By exploiting redundancies in KV caches, KVTC achieves up to 20$\times$ compression while maintaining reasoning and long-context accuracy, and 40$\times$ or higher for specific use cases. We test KVTC with Llama 3, Mistral NeMo, and R1-Qwen 2.5 models across benchmarks including AIME25, GSM8K, LiveCodeBench, LongBench, MATH-500, MMLU, Qasper and RULER. It consistently outperforms inference-time baselines such as token eviction, quantization, and SVD-based methods, while achieving higher compression ratios. These results support KVTC as a practical building block for memory-efficient LLM serving with reusable KV caches.
papers.abstract_cn: 大规模服务大语言模型 (LLM) 需要高效的键值 (KV) 缓存管理。KV 缓存可以通过在迭代代码编辑和聊天中常见的共享前缀提示符在对话中重复使用。然而，过时的缓存会消耗稀缺的 GPU 内存，需要卸载或强制重新计算。我们介绍了 KVTC，一种轻量级变换编码器，它压缩 KV 缓存以实现紧凑的 GPU 上和 GPU 外存储。借鉴经典的媒体压缩，KVTC 结合了基于 PCA 的特征去相关、自适应量化和熵编码。它只需要简短的初始校准，并且保持模型参数不变。通过利用 KV 缓存中的冗余，KVTC 在保持推理和长上下文准确性的同时，实现了高达 20 美元/次的压缩，对于特定使用案例，压缩率可达 40 美元/次或更高。我们使用包括 AIME25、GSM8K、LiveCodeBench、LongBench、MATH-500、MMLU、Qasper 和 RULER 在内的多个基准测试了 KVTC，包括 Lama 3、Mistral NeMo 和 R1-Qwen 2.5 模型。它始终优于推理时间基准，如令牌驱逐、量化和基于 SVD 的方法，同时实现更高的压缩比。这些结果支持 KVTC 作为内存效率高的 LLM 的实用基础构件，提供可重用的 KV 缓存。
papers.ai_summary_en: KVTC addresses GPU memory pressure from reusable KV caches in LLM serving, where stale shared-prefix caches otherwise require offloading or recomputation. It introduces a lightweight transform-coding pipeline inspired by media compression—PCA-based decorrelation of key/value features, adaptive quantization, and entropy coding—requiring only brief calibration and no model parameter changes. Across Llama 3, Mistral NeMo, and R1-Qwen 2.5 on reasoning and long-context benchmarks, KVTC achieves up to 20× compression (40×+ in some cases) while preserving accuracy and outperforming token eviction, quantization, and SVD-based baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理中可复用KV缓存占用昂贵GPU内存、需卸载或重算的问题，提出面向紧凑存储的KVTC变换编码压缩方案。其借鉴经典媒体压缩，通过PCA去相关、自适应量化和熵编码压缩KV缓存，仅需短期校准且不修改模型参数。实验在Llama、Mistral、Qwen等模型与多类推理/长上下文基准上实现最高20倍、特定场景40倍以上压缩，并保持精度，优于token驱逐、量化和SVD等基线。

papers.title: Private LLM Inference on Consumer Blackwell GPUs: A Practical Guide for Cost-Effective Local Deployment in SMEs
papers.abstract_en: SMEs increasingly seek alternatives to cloud LLM APIs, which raise data privacy concerns. Dedicated cloud GPU instances offer improved privacy but with limited guarantees and ongoing costs, while professional on-premise hardware (A100, H100) remains prohibitively expensive. We present a systematic evaluation of NVIDIA's Blackwell consumer GPUs (RTX 5060 Ti, 5070 Ti, 5090) for production LLM inference, benchmarking four open-weight models (Qwen3-8B, Gemma3-12B, Gemma3-27B, GPT-OSS-20B) across 79 configurations spanning quantization formats (BF16, W4A16, NVFP4, MXFP4), context lengths (8k-64k), and three workloads: RAG, multi-LoRA agentic serving, and high-concurrency APIs. The RTX 5090 delivers 3.5-4.6x higher throughput than the 5060 Ti with 21x lower latency for RAG, but budget GPUs achieve the highest throughput-per-dollar for API workloads with sub-second latency. NVFP4 quantization provides 1.6x throughput over BF16 with 41% energy reduction and only 2-4% quality loss. Self-hosted inference costs $0.001-0.04 per million tokens (electricity only), which is 40-200x cheaper than budget-tier cloud APIs, with hardware breaking even in under four months at moderate volume (30M tokens/day). Our results show that consumer GPUs can reliably replace cloud inference for most SME workloads, except latency-critical long-context RAG, where high-end GPUs remain essential. We provide deployment guidance and release all benchmark data for reproducible SME-scale deployments.
papers.abstract_cn: 中小企业越来越多地寻求云LLM APIs的替代品，这引发了数据隐私问题。专用云GPU实例提供了更好的隐私保护，但担保和持续成本有限，而专业的内部硬件(A100、H100)仍然过于昂贵。我们对英伟达的Blackwell消费级GPU(RTX 5060 Ti、5070 Ti、5090)进行了系统评估，用于生产LLM推理，对四个开放权重模型(Qwen3-8B、Gemma3-12B、Gemma3-27B、GPT-OSS-20B)进行了基准测试，测试涵盖79种配置，包括量化格式(BF16、W4A16、NVFP4、MXFP4)、上下文长度(8k-64k)和三种工作负载:RAG、多LoRA代理服务和高并发APIRTX 5090的吞吐量比5060 Ti高3.5-4.6倍，RAG延迟低21倍，但预算GPU在亚秒延迟的API工作负载方面实现了最高的单位成本吞吐量。NVFP4量化提供1.6倍于BF16的吞吐量，能耗降低41%，质量损失仅为2-4%。自托管推理的成本为每百万令牌0.001-0.04美元(仅电力)，比预算层云API便宜40-200倍，即使在中等容量(3000万令牌/天)的情况下，硬件也能在不到四个月内实现收支平衡。我们的结果表明，对于大多数SME工作负载，消费级GPU可以可靠地取代云推理，但延迟关键型长上下文RAG除外，在这种情况下，高端GPU仍然必不可少。我们提供部署指导并发布所有基准数据，用于可重复的SME规模部署。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses privacy and cost barriers for SMEs using cloud LLM APIs by evaluating whether consumer-grade NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs can enable practical, private on-premise LLM inference. It systematically benchmarks RTX 5060 Ti, 5070 Ti, and 5090 GPUs across open-weight models, quantization formats, context lengths, and workloads such as RAG, multi-LoRA agentic serving, and high-concurrency APIs, identifying NVFP4 as a particularly efficient quantization scheme. The results show that self-hosted consumer GPUs can be 40–200× cheaper than budget cloud APIs, with NVFP4 delivering 1.6× BF16 throughput, 41% lower energy use, and only 2–4% quality loss, though high-end GPUs remain necessary for latency-critical long-context RAG.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该文面向中小企业私有化 LLM 推理的隐私与成本痛点，系统评测了 NVIDIA Blackwell 消费级 GPU 在多种量化格式、上下文长度以及 RAG、多 LoRA 智能体服务和高并发 API 负载下的性能、能耗与成本。其核心洞见是 NVFP4 等低比特量化可在仅 2–4% 质量损失下带来约 1.6 倍吞吐提升和 41% 能耗下降，且预算级 GPU 在 API 场景中具备最高性价比。结果表明，自托管推理可比经济型云 API 便宜 40–200 倍并在中等流量下数月回本，但长上下文、低延迟 RAG 仍依赖高端 GPU。

papers.title: On-Device-First Hybrid LLM Inference on AI-PCs: Closing the Enterprise GenAI Divide
papers.abstract_en: AI-PCs and modern PCs equipped with capable CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs now make on-device inference for small language models (SLMs) practical across many enterprise workloads. This enables assistants that are low-latency, privacy-preserving, and resilient to network conditions, while frontier cloud models still offer higher accuracy, richer tool use, and stronger multimodality than is practical to run on every endpoint. This paper surveys and organizes the design space for an on-device-first hybrid architecture in which an SLM on the AI-PC handles most requests by default, and escalation to cloud models is reserved for difficult, tool-heavy, or long-context tasks. We synthesize advances in compact local on-device optimized model design including architectures that mix self-attention with state-space models (SSMs), parameter-efficient adaptation, multimodal and structure-aware retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and long-horizon memory, and connect these to hardware and serving optimizations such as quantization, mixed precision, and KV-cache management. Building on this, we propose routing and reporting patterns that make latency, energy, cost, and privacy explicit design parameters, and outline a total-cost-of-ownership view that clarifies when AI-PC–centric deployments outperform all-cloud strategies. We argue that such edge-first hybrid designs offer a practical path to narrowing the "GenAI Divide," in which impressive pilots fail to translate into durable, production-grade business impact.
papers.abstract_cn: 人工智能电脑和配备了CPU、GPU和npu的现代电脑现在可以在设备上对小型语言模型(SLM)进行跨许多企业工作负载的推理。这使得助手能够实现低延迟、隐私保护和对网络条件的弹性，而前沿云模型仍然能够提供比在每个端点上运行更高的准确性、更丰富的工具使用和更强的多模态。本文调查并组织了基于设备优先的混合架构的设计空间，在该架构中，AI-PC上的SLM默认处理大多数请求，而升级到云模型则保留用于困难、工具繁重或长上下文任务。我们综合了紧凑型本地设备上优化模型设计的进展，包括将自我关注与状态空间模型(SSMs)相结合的架构、参数高效自适应、多模态和结构感知检索增强生成(RAG)以及长时间内存，并将这些与硬件和服务优化(如量化、混合精度和KV缓存管理)联系起来。在此基础上，我们提出了路由和报告模式，使延迟、能源、成本和隐私成为显式设计参数，并概述了总拥有成本视图，以阐明何时以AI-PC为中心的部署优于全云策略。我们认为，这种边缘优先的混合设计为缩小“GenAI鸿沟”提供了一条切实可行的道路，在这一鸿沟中，令人印象深刻的试点项目未能转化为持久的生产级业务影响。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the enterprise “GenAI divide” between practical on-device inference for small language models and the superior accuracy, tool use, and long-context capability of cloud frontier models. It organizes a design space for on-device-first hybrid inference on AI-PCs, combining compact model architectures, PEFT, multimodal/structure-aware RAG, long-horizon memory, and serving optimizations such as quantization, mixed precision, and KV-cache management with explicit routing policies. The result is a framework for making latency, energy, cost, and privacy first-class design parameters, showing when AI-PC-centric deployments can outperform all-cloud strategies in production enterprise workloads.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对企业生成式AI试点难以落地的问题，研究如何在AI-PC上以端侧小模型优先处理多数请求，并将困难、工具密集或长上下文任务升级到云端模型。其核心洞见是构建端云混合推理设计空间，结合自注意力/SSM混合架构、参数高效适配、RAG、长期记忆以及量化、混合精度和KV缓存管理等软硬件优化，并通过显式考虑延迟、能耗、成本和隐私的路由机制进行决策。论文提出以总拥有成本评估部署方案，认为端侧优先混合架构可提供低延迟、隐私保护且更经济的推理路径，有助于缩小企业GenAI从演示到生产的影响差距。

papers.title: Understanding Efficiency: Quantization, Batching, and Serving Strategies in LLM Energy Use
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in production, contributing towards shifting the burden in terms of computational resources and energy demands from training to inference. While prior work has examined the energy cost of inference per prompt or per token, we highlight how \emph{system-level design choices} - such as numerical precision, batching strategy, and request scheduling - can lead to orders-of-magnitude differences in energy consumption for the same model. We perform a detailed empirical study of LLM inference energy and latency on NVIDIA H100 GPUs, analyzing the impact of quantization, batch size, and serving configuration (e.g., with Hugging Face's Text Generation Inference server). Our results reveal that lower-precision formats only yield energy gains in compute-bound regimes; that batching improves energy efficiency, especially in memory-bound phases like decoding; and that structured request timing (arrival shaping) can reduce per-request energy by up to 100 times. We argue that sustainable LLM deployment depends not only on model internals, but also on the orchestration of the serving stack. Our findings motivate phase-aware energy profiling and system-level optimizations for greener AI services.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型(LLM)越来越多地部署在生产中，有助于将计算资源和能量需求方面的负担从训练转移到推理。虽然之前的工作已经检查了每个提示或每个令牌的推理能量成本，但我们强调了\ emph {系统级设计选择} -如数字精度、批处理策略和请求调度-如何导致同一模型的能量消耗的数量级差异。我们对NVIDIA H100 GPUs上的LLM推理能量和延迟进行了详细的实证研究，分析了量化、批量大小和服务配置(例如，使用Hugging Face的文本生成推理服务器)的影响。我们的结果显示，较低精度的格式仅在计算受限的情况下产生能量增益；这种批处理提高了能源效率，特别是在像解码这样的内存受限阶段；并且结构化请求定时(到达整形)可以将每个请求的能量减少多达100倍。我们认为可持续的LLM部署不仅依赖于模型内部，还依赖于服务栈的编排。我们的发现激发了阶段感知能量分析和系统级优化，以实现更绿色的人工智能服务。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that LLM inference energy consumption depends heavily on system-level serving choices—not only model architecture—such as quantization, batching, and request scheduling. Through an empirical study on NVIDIA H100 GPUs using Hugging Face Text Generation Inference, it shows that energy efficiency is phase-dependent: low-precision formats help mainly in compute-bound regimes, batching improves efficiency during memory-bound decoding, and request arrival shaping can reduce per-request energy by up to 100×. The findings motivate phase-aware energy profiling and serving-stack orchestration as central levers for sustainable LLM deployment.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理部署中的能耗问题，指出量化、批处理和请求调度等系统级选择会让同一模型能耗产生数量级差异。作者基于NVIDIA H100和TGI服务栈开展实证研究，发现低精度量化仅在计算受限场景显著节能，而批处理在解码等内存受限阶段更能提升能效。论文还表明通过请求到达整形可将单请求能耗降低最多100倍，强调绿色LLM服务需要面向推理阶段的系统级优化。

papers.title: D2MoE: Dual Routing and Dynamic Scheduling for Efficient On-Device MoE-based LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: The mixture of experts (MoE) model is a sparse variant of large language models (LLMs), designed to hold a better balance between intelligent capability and computational overhead. Despite its benefits, MoE is still too expensive to deploy on resource-constrained edge devices, especially with the demands of on-device inference services. Recent research efforts often apply model compression techniques, such as quantization, pruning and merging, to restrict MoE complexity. Unfortunately, due to their predefined static model optimization strategies, they cannot always achieve the desired quality-overhead trade-off when handling multiple requests, finally degrading the on-device quality of service. These limitations motivate us to propose the D2MoE, an algorithm-system co-design framework that matches diverse task requirements by dynamically allocating the most proper bit-width to each expert. Specifically, inspired by the nested structure of matryoshka dolls, we propose the matryoshka weight quantization (MWQ) to progressively compress expert weights in a bit-nested manner and reduce the required runtime memory. On top of it, we further optimize the I/O-computation pipeline and design a heuristic scheduling algorithm following our hottest-expert-bit-first (HEBF) principle, which maximizes the expert parallelism between I/O and computation queue under constrained memory budgets, thus significantly reducing the idle temporal bubbles waiting for the experts to load. Evaluations on real edge devices show that D2MoE improves the overall inference throughput by up to 1.39× and reduces the peak memory footprint by up to 53% over the latest on-device inference frameworks, while still preserving comparable serving accuracy as its INT8 counterparts.
