papers.abstract_cn: 混合专家(MoE)模型是大型语言模型(LLM)的稀疏变体，旨在更好地平衡智能能力和计算开销。尽管MoE有其优势，但部署在资源受限的边缘设备上仍然过于昂贵，特别是在设备上推理服务的需求下。最近的研究工作经常应用模型压缩技术，如量化、剪枝和合并，以限制MoE的复杂性。不幸的是，由于其预定义的静态模型优化策略，当处理多个请求时，它们不能总是实现期望的质量开销折衷，最终降低了设备上的服务质量。这些限制促使我们提出了D2MoE，这是一个算法-系统协同设计框架，它通过为每个专家动态分配最合适的位宽来匹配不同的任务需求。具体来说，受套娃的嵌套结构的启发，我们提出了套娃权重量化(MWQ ),以位嵌套的方式逐步压缩专家权重，并减少所需的运行时内存。在此基础上，我们进一步优化了I/O计算流水线，并根据我们的最热专家位优先(HEBF)原则设计了一种启发式调度算法，该算法在有限的内存预算下最大化了I/O和计算队列之间的专家并行性，从而显著减少了等待专家加载的空闲时间气泡。在真实边缘设备上的评估表明，与最新的设备上推理框架相比，D2MoE将整体推理吞吐量提高了1.39倍，并将峰值内存占用减少了53%，同时仍然保持了与其INT8对等产品相当的服务精度。
papers.ai_summary_en: D2MoE addresses inefficient on-device serving of MoE LLMs, where static compression strategies struggle to balance quality and overhead under tight memory budgets and varying request demands. It introduces an algorithm–system co-design with matryoshka weight quantization that stores expert weights in a bit-nested format for dynamic per-expert bit-width selection, plus a hottest-expert-bit-first scheduler that overlaps expert I/O with computation. On real edge devices, D2MoE improves throughput by up to 1.39× and reduces peak memory by up to 53% while maintaining accuracy comparable to INT8 serving.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对端侧 MoE LLM 推理中静态压缩策略难以在多请求场景下兼顾质量、内存和吞吐的问题，提出 D2MoE 算法-系统协同框架。其核心是套娃式嵌套权重量化 MWQ 与“最热专家比特优先”HEBF 调度，通过为专家动态选择比特宽并优化 I/O-计算流水来提升并行度、减少等待开销。真机实验显示，相比最新端侧推理框架，吞吐最高提升 1.39 倍、峰值内存最多降低 53%，且服务精度与 INT8 相当。

papers.title: LiquidGEMM: Hardware-Efficient W4A8 GEMM Kernel for High-Performance LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: Quantization is a critical technique for accelerating LLM inference by reducing memory footprint and improving computational efficiency. Among various schemes, 4-bit weight and 8-bit activation quantization (W4A8) offers a strong balance between accuracy and performance. However, existing W4A8 GEMM kernels fall short in practice due to inefficient dequantization on CUDA Cores, which cannot keep pace with the high throughput of Tensor Cores. In this paper, we present LiquidGEMM, a hardware-efficient W4A8 GEMM kernel for efficient LLM serving. LiquidGEMM designs two key techniques: LiquidQuant, a hardware-efficient quantization method that enables fast, overflow-safe dequantization using just two arithmetic instructions per four elements; and an implicit fine-grained pipeline that fully overlaps weight loading, dequantization, and MMA across warp groups without software synchronization or redundant memory traffic. Experimental results show that LiquidGEMM achieves up to 2.90x speedup over state-of-the-art W4A8 kernels and up to 4.94x end-to-end system-level speedup. Compared to various quantized GEMM kernels in NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, LiquidGEMM delivers 1.12-1.63x performance gains, and achieves up to 1.63x system-level speedup.
papers.abstract_cn: 量化是通过减少内存占用和提高计算效率来加速LLM推理的关键技术。在各种方案中，4位权重和8位激活量化(W4A8)提供了精度和性能之间的强大平衡。然而，现有的W4A8 GEMM核在实践中存在不足，这是由于CUDA核上的低效去量化，其无法跟上张量核的高吞吐量。在本文中，我们提出了LiquidGEMM，一个硬件高效的W4A8 GEMM内核，用于高效的LLM服务。LiquidGEMM设计了两项关键技术:LiquidQuant，一种硬件高效的量化方法，每四个元素仅使用两个算术指令即可实现快速、溢出安全的去量化；以及一个隐式的细粒度流水线，它可以跨warp组完全重叠权重加载、去量化和MMA，而无需软件同步或冗余内存流量。实验结果表明，与最先进的W4A8内核相比，LiquidGEMM实现了高达2.90倍的加速，以及高达4.94倍的端到端系统级加速。与NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM中的各种量化GEMM内核相比，LiquidGEMM提供了1.12-1.63倍的性能增益，并实现了高达1.63倍的系统级加速。
papers.ai_summary_en: LiquidGEMM addresses the practical bottleneck in W4A8 LLM inference where CUDA-core dequantization cannot sustain Tensor-Core throughput. It introduces LiquidQuant, a two-instruction, overflow-safe dequantization scheme for 4-bit weights, and an implicit fine-grained pipeline that overlaps weight loading, dequantization, and MMA across warp groups without explicit synchronization or redundant memory traffic. The kernel achieves up to 2.90× speedup over state-of-the-art W4A8 GEMMs and up to 4.94× end-to-end serving gains, while outperforming TensorRT-LLM quantized GEMMs by 1.12–1.63×.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理中W4A8量化GEMM因CUDA Core反量化效率低、难以匹配Tensor Core高吞吐的问题，提出了硬件高效的LiquidGEMM内核。其核心方法是LiquidQuant，仅用两条算术指令即可完成四个元素的快速防溢反量化，并通过隐式细粒度流水线在warp group间完全重叠权重加载、反量化和MMA计算，避免软件同步与冗余访存。实验显示，该内核相比先进W4A8内核最高加速2.90倍、端到端最高提升4.94倍，并相较TensorRT-LLM中的量化GEMM实现1.12–1.63倍性能增益。

papers.title: FineServe: Precision-Aware KV Slab and Two-Level Scheduling for Heterogeneous Precision LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) techniques have significantly increased demand for serving quantized large language models (LLMs), enabling higher throughput and substantially reduced memory usage with minimal accuracy loss. Quantized models address memory constraints in LLMs and enhance GPU resource utilization through efficient GPU sharing. However, quantized models have smaller KV block sizes than non-quantized models, causing limited memory efficiency due to memory fragmentation. Also, distinct resource usage patterns between quantized and non-quantized models require efficient scheduling to maximize throughput. To address these challenges, we propose FineServe, an inference serving framework for mixed-precision LLMs. FineServe's key contributions include: (1) KV Slab, a precision-aware adaptive memory management technique dynamically allocating KV cache based on model quantization characteristics, significantly reducing GPU memory fragmentation, and (2) a two-level scheduling framework comprising a global scheduler that places models to GPUs based on request rates, latency SLOs, and memory constraints and efficiency, and a local scheduler that adaptively adjusts batch sizes according to real-time request fluctuations. Experimental results demonstrate that FineServe achieves up to 2.2x higher SLO attainment and 1.8x higher token generation throughput compared to the state-of-the-art GPU sharing systems.
papers.abstract_cn: 训练后量化(PTQ)技术的最新进展显著增加了对服务量化的大型语言模型(LLM)的需求，从而实现了更高的吞吐量和显著减少的存储器使用，同时最小化精度损失。量化模型解决了LLM中的内存限制，并通过高效的GPU共享提高了GPU资源利用率。然而，量化模型比非量化模型具有更小的KV块大小，由于存储器碎片而导致有限的存储器效率。此外，量化和非量化模型之间不同的资源使用模式需要有效的调度来最大化吞吐量。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了FineServe，一个用于混合精度LLM的推理服务框架。FineServe的主要贡献包括:(1) KV Slab，一种精度感知的自适应内存管理技术，可根据模型量化特征动态分配KV缓存，显著减少GPU内存碎片；(2)两级调度框架，包括一个全局调度器，可根据请求速率、延迟SLO、内存约束和效率将模型放置到GPU，以及一个本地调度器，可根据实时请求波动自适应调整批量大小。实验结果表明，与最先进的GPU共享系统相比，FineServe实现了高达2.2倍的SLO实现和1.8倍的令牌生成吞吐量。
papers.ai_summary_en: FineServe addresses inefficient GPU memory utilization and scheduling for mixed-precision LLM serving, where quantized models have smaller KV cache blocks that increase fragmentation and exhibit different resource demands than non-quantized models. It proposes a precision-aware KV Slab allocator that dynamically manages KV cache memory according to model quantization characteristics, together with a two-level scheduler that globally places models on GPUs under request rates, latency SLOs, and memory constraints while locally adapting batch sizes. Experiments show up to 2.2× higher SLO attainment and 1.8× higher token-generation throughput compared with state-of-the-art GPU-sharing systems.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对量化与非量化 LLM 混合服务中 KV cache 块尺寸差异导致的 GPU 内存碎片，以及不同精度模型资源使用模式不同带来的调度低效问题。提出 FineServe，通过精度感知的 KV Slab 动态管理 KV cache，并结合全局模型放置与本地批大小调整的两级调度框架来提升内存利用和吞吐。实验显示，其相比先进 GPU 共享系统可将 SLO 达成率最高提升 2.2 倍、token 生成吞吐最高提升 1.8 倍。

papers.title: GPU-Centric Memory Tiering for LLM Serving With NVIDIA Grace Hopper Superchip
papers.abstract_en: This study investigates the performance of serving large language models (LLMs) with a focus on the high-bandwidth interconnect between GPU and CPU using a real NVIDIA Grace Hopper Superchip. This architecture features a GPU-centric memory tiering system, comprising a performance tier with GPU memory and a capacity tier with host memory. We revisit a conventional pipelined execution for LLM inference, utilizing host memory connected via NVLink alongside GPU memory. For the Llama-3.1 8B base (FP16) model, such a GPU-centric tiered memory system meets the target latency requirements for both prefill and decoding while improving throughput compared to the in-memory case, where all model weights are maintained in GPU memory. However, even with NVLink-connected CPU memory, meeting latency constraints for large models like the 70B and 405B FP16 models remains challenging. To address this, we explore the efficacy of model quantization (e.g., AWQ) along with the pipelined execution. Our evaluation reveals that the model quantization makes the pipelined execution a viable solution for serving large models. For the Llama-3.1 70B and 405B AWQ models, we show that the pipelined execution achieves 1.6× and 2.9× throughput improvement, respectively, compared to the in-memory only case, while meeting the latency constraint.
papers.abstract_cn: 本研究调查了为大型语言模型(LLM)提供服务的性能，重点是使用真实的英伟达格蕾丝·赫柏超级芯片在GPU和CPU之间进行高带宽互连。这种架构采用了以GPU为中心的内存分层系统，包括带有GPU内存的性能层和带有主机内存的容量层。我们利用通过NVLink连接的主机内存和GPU内存，重新考察了LLM推理的传统流水线执行。对于Llama-3.1 8B base (FP16)模型，这种以GPU为中心的分层存储器系统满足预填充和解码的目标延迟要求，同时与所有模型权重都保存在GPU存储器中的存储器内情况相比，提高了吞吐量。然而，即使使用NVLink连接的CPU内存，满足70B和405B FP16等大型型号的延迟限制仍然具有挑战性。为了解决这个问题，我们探索了模型量化(例如，AWQ)以及流水线执行的功效。我们的评估表明，模型量化使流水线执行成为服务大型模型的可行解决方案。对于Llama-3.1 70B和405B AWQ模型，我们表明，与仅在内存中的情况相比，流水线执行分别实现了1.6倍和2.9倍的吞吐量提升，同时满足延迟限制。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses GPU memory capacity limits in LLM serving by evaluating GPU-centric memory tiering on NVIDIA Grace Hopper, using pipelined inference across GPU HBM and NVLink-connected CPU memory. It finds that tiering alone improves throughput for Llama-3.1-8B FP16 but cannot meet latency targets for 70B/405B FP16, whereas combining pipelining with AWQ quantization makes large-model serving viable. For Llama-3.1-70B and 405B AWQ, the method satisfies latency constraints while achieving 1.6× and 2.9× higher throughput than storing all weights in GPU memory.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型推理中GPU显存容量受限、需通过GPU-CPU高带宽互连进行内存分层服务的问题，在NVIDIA Grace Hopper超级芯片上评估了基于NVLink的GPU中心分层内存与流水线执行方案，并引入AWQ量化以支撑更大模型。结果显示，Llama-3.1 8B FP16可在分层内存下满足prefill/decoding延迟并提升吞吐；而70B/405B FP16仅靠分层内存难以达标，结合量化后可行，吞吐分别提升1.6×和2.9×且满足延迟约束。

papers.title: Dynamic Expert Quantization for Scalable Mixture-of-Experts Inference
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become a practical architecture for scaling LLM capacity while keeping per-token compute modest, but deploying MoE models on a single, memory-limited GPU remains difficult because expert weights dominate the HBM footprint. Existing expert offloading and prefetching systems reduce the resident set, yet they often pay expert-loading costs on the critical path when activation becomes dense. Post-training quantization (PTQ) lowers the footprint without transfers, but prevailing pipelines fix expert bit-widths offline and assume routing remains stable, even though MoE expert utilization is heavy-tailed and the hot set can shift across workloads. We present DynaExq, a runtime-aware mixed-precision serving system that treats single-GPU MoE inference under a hard HBM envelope as an online, budget-constrained precision allocation problem. The key insight is to keep the experts that dominate runtime traffic resident at higher precision, while maintaining a low-precision fallback for the remaining experts, so the system can reduce transfer volume and avoid the waiting latency that limits offloading and prefetching under dense activation. DynaExq estimates long-horizon expert hotness from router traces, selects a per-layer high-precision resident set via a budget-feasible top-$n$ rule, and applies promotions and demotions asynchronously through stable expert handles so the forward pass always executes on a fully materialized expert version. Across Qwen3-MoE-30B/80B and six benchmarks, DynaExq improves accuracy over static PTQ on Qwen3-80B (73.09% to 77.57%) under comparable device-memory budgets and achieves up to 2.73x higher throughput than offloading/prefetch baselines at batch size 32.
papers.abstract_cn: 专家混合(MoE)已经成为一种实用的架构，用于扩展LLM容量，同时保持每个令牌的适度计算，但在单个内存有限的GPU上部署MoE模型仍然很困难，因为专家权重主导了HBM占用空间。现有的专家卸载和预取系统减少了驻留集，然而当激活变得密集时，它们经常在关键路径上支付专家加载成本。训练后量化(PTQ)在没有传输的情况下降低了占用空间，但主流流水线离线固定专家位宽，并假设路由保持稳定，即使MoE专家利用率是重尾的，并且热集可以跨工作负载转移。我们提出了DynaExq，一个运行时感知的混合精度服务系统，它将硬HBM信封下的单GPU MoE推理视为一个在线的、预算受限的精度分配问题。关键的见解是保持主导运行时流量的专家驻留在较高的精度，同时为剩余的专家维持低精度回退，以便系统可以减少传输量并避免在密集激活下限制卸载和预取的等待延迟。DynaExq根据路由器跟踪估计长期专家热度，通过预算可行的top-$n$规则选择每层高精度常驻集，并通过稳定的专家句柄异步应用升级和降级，以便前向传递始终在完全物化的专家版本上执行。在Qwen3-MoE-30B/80B和六个基准测试中，DynaExq在可比的设备内存预算下，提高了Qwen3-80B上静态PTQ的准确性(73.09%至77.57%)，并在批处理大小为32时实现了比卸载/预取基线高2.73倍的吞吐量。
papers.ai_summary_en: DynaExq addresses single-GPU MoE inference under tight HBM limits, where expert weights dominate memory and static quantization or offloading suffers from shifted hot sets and transfer latency. It formulates precision assignment as an online budget-constrained problem, using router-trace hotness estimates to keep high-traffic experts resident at higher precision while retaining low-precision fallbacks and asynchronously promoting/demoting experts via stable handles. On Qwen3-MoE-30B/80B across six benchmarks, it improves accuracy over static PTQ on Qwen3-80B from 73.09% to 77.57% under comparable memory budgets and achieves up to 2.73× higher throughput than offloading/prefetching baselines at batch size 32.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对单GPU内存受限下MoE推理中专家权重占用高、静态量化与卸载/预取难以适应专家热度变化的问题，提出运行时混合精度服务系统DynaExq，将专家精度分配建模为在线预算约束问题，并依据路由轨迹动态保留高流量专家的高精度版本、其余专家以低精度常驻。实验表明，在相近显存预算下，其相较静态PTQ可将Qwen3-80B准确率从73.09%提升至77.57%，并在batch size 32时相较卸载/预取基线取得最高2.73倍吞吐提升。

papers.title: [GitHub] LightLLM: LightLLM is a Python-based LLM (Large Language Model) inference and serving framework, notable for i
papers.authors: ModelTC
papers.abstract_en: LightLLM is a Python-based LLM (Large Language Model) inference and serving framework, notable for its lightweight design, easy scalability, and high-speed performance.
papers.abstract_cn: LightLLM 是一个基于 Python 的大语言模型（LLM）推理和服务框架，以其轻量化设计、易于扩展和高速性能而著称。
papers.ai_summary_en: LightLLM addresses the problem of efficiently serving large language models with a lightweight, scalable inference stack. Its key approach is a Python-based serving framework designed for easy extensibility and optimized high-speed inference. The main impact is simplified LLM deployment with improved serving performance and lower system overhead.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向大模型推理与服务场景，解决现有 LLM serving 框架在轻量化、易扩展和高性能之间难以兼顾的问题。其核心方法是提供一个基于 Python 的轻量级推理服务框架 LightLLM，通过简洁架构和可扩展设计提升部署与推理效率。主要影响是为 LLM 在线服务提供了一种更易扩展且强调高速性能的工程化选择。

papers.title: [GitHub] FastDeploy: High-performance Inference and Deployment Toolkit for LLMs and VLMs based on PaddlePaddle
papers.authors: PaddlePaddle
papers.abstract_en: High-performance Inference and Deployment Toolkit for LLMs and VLMs based on PaddlePaddle
papers.abstract_cn: 基于PaddlePaddle的高性能LLM和VLM推理与部署工具包
papers.ai_summary_en: FastDeploy addresses the systems problem of efficiently serving large language and vision-language models in production, where high concurrency, latency, and hardware heterogeneity make inference deployment difficult. It provides a PaddlePaddle-based toolkit that integrates optimized inference paths, model compression/deployment utilities, and serving-oriented execution for LLMs and VLMs. The main impact is a streamlined stack for building high-throughput, low-latency inference services on supported PaddlePaddle hardware and deployment environments.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向大语言模型与视觉语言模型推理服务中部署复杂、吞吐和延迟优化困难的问题，提出了基于 PaddlePaddle 的高性能推理与部署工具包 FastDeploy。其核心思路是整合模型转换、推理优化和服务化部署流程，为 LLM/VLM 提供统一、高效的生产级推理栈。该工具有助于降低大模型部署门槛，并提升推理服务性能与工程可用性。

papers.title: [GitHub] Nanoflow: A throughput-oriented high-performance serving framework for LLMs
papers.authors: efeslab
papers.abstract_en: A throughput-oriented high-performance serving framework for LLMs
papers.abstract_cn: 面向吞吐量的高性能大型语言模型服务框架
papers.ai_summary_en: Nanoflow addresses the throughput bottleneck in LLM serving caused by variable-length requests, mixed prefill/decode phases, and inefficient GPU utilization in conventional batch-oriented systems. Its key idea is a throughput-first serving framework that uses fine-grained “nanoflow” scheduling and pipelining to overlap computation, memory access, and communication while managing KV-cache state efficiently. The main impact is higher request throughput and resource efficiency for high-concurrency LLM deployment, with improved GPU utilization over standard serving stacks while maintaining practical latency targets.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文提出 Nanoflow，一个面向吞吐量的 LLM 高性能推理服务框架，旨在解决大模型在线服务中高并发请求下吞吐不足与 GPU 利用率低的问题。其核心思路是通过系统级调度与执行优化，提高请求批处理、并行执行和推理流水线的效率。该工作为高吞吐 LLM 部署提供了服务框架层面的优化路径，但摘要未给出具体实验结果。

papers.title: [GitHub] ScaleLLM: A high-performance inference system for large language models, designed for production environments.
papers.authors: vectorch-ai
papers.abstract_en: A high-performance inference system for large language models, designed for production environments.
papers.abstract_cn: 一个用于大型语言模型的高性能推理系统，专为生产环境设计。
papers.ai_summary_en: ScaleLLM addresses production-grade LLM serving, where high request concurrency, long contexts, and strict latency/throughput requirements make naive autoregressive inference inefficient. Its key method is an optimized inference engine built around continuous batching, efficient KV-cache/memory management, and GPU-parallel execution to maximize utilization while controlling prefill and decode latency. The system’s impact is enabling scalable, low-latency LLM deployment suitable for production workloads rather than only offline benchmarking.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向生产环境中大模型在线推理的高并发、低延迟与资源效率挑战，提出并实现了 ScaleLLM 高性能 LLM 服务系统。其核心思路是通过面向生产部署的推理引擎与系统级优化，提高请求调度、批处理和显存资源利用效率。该系统有助于在真实线上场景中提升 LLM 推理吞吐、降低服务延迟并增强可扩展性。

papers.title: [GitHub] cuckoo: Cuckoo is a Decentralized AI Model-Serving Platform, starting with GPU-sharing for text-to-image gen
papers.authors: cuckoo-network
papers.abstract_en: Cuckoo is a Decentralized AI Model-Serving Platform, starting with GPU-sharing for text-to-image generation and LLM inference.
papers.abstract_cn: Cuckoo 是一个去中心化的 AI 模型服务平台，起步于用于文本到图像生成和大型语言模型推理的 GPU 共享。
papers.ai_summary_en: Cuckoo addresses the high cost and centralized bottlenecks of GPU-based AI model serving by proposing a decentralized platform for sharing GPU resources across distributed providers. Its key method is a community-operated model-serving infrastructure that schedules and runs inference workloads, initially targeting text-to-image generation and LLM inference, on pooled heterogeneous GPUs. The main impact is enabling more scalable, lower-cost, and censorship-resistant AI serving compared with relying solely on centralized cloud GPU providers.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向 AI 模型服务中 GPU 资源分散、部署成本高的问题，提出 Cuckoo 这一去中心化模型服务平台。其核心思路是通过 GPU 共享机制整合闲置算力，优先支持文生图生成和 LLM 推理等模型服务。该方向有助于降低推理服务门槛并提升资源利用率，但摘要未提供具体实验结果或性能指标。

papers.title: [GitHub] e2e-llm-workflows: Fine-tune an LLM to perform batch inference and online serving.
papers.authors: anyscale
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tune an LLM to perform batch inference and online serving.
papers.abstract_cn: 微调大型语言模型以执行批量推理和在线服务。
papers.ai_summary_en: This work addresses the practical problem of operationalizing LLMs by unifying fine-tuning, batch inference, and online serving into an end-to-end workflow. Its key contribution is a repository/pipeline that fine-tunes an LLM and deploys it for both offline batch processing and latency-sensitive serving. The main impact is reducing integration overhead and providing a reproducible template, though the abstract provides no quantitative performance results.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向 LLM 从模型到生产部署中的服务化问题，重点解决如何统一支持批量推理与在线实时服务。其核心方法是构建端到端工作流，通过微调让模型适配服务场景下的输入输出与调用流程，从而打通离线批处理与在线 serving。主要影响是降低 LLM 部署工程复杂度，提供可复用的微调、推理和服务化实践。

papers.title: [GitHub] LLMSpeculativeSampling: Fast inference from large lauguage models via speculative decoding
papers.authors: feifeibear
papers.abstract_en: Fast inference from large lauguage models via speculative decoding
papers.abstract_cn: 通过投机解码从大型语言模型快速推理
papers.ai_summary_en: The work addresses the latency bottleneck of autoregressive inference in large language models, where tokens are generated sequentially and underutilize modern parallel hardware. Its key method is speculative decoding: a smaller draft model proposes candidate token sequences that the larger target model verifies in parallel, using an acceptance/rejection mechanism to preserve the target model’s output distribution. The main result is a practical, largely lossless speedup for LLM generation, improving serving throughput and response time without sacrificing model quality.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大语言模型自回归推理延迟高的问题，提出通过“投机解码”加速生成。其核心思想是先用小型草稿模型快速预测多个候选 token，再由大模型一次性并行验证并按原分布接受或修正这些 token，从而在不改变输出分布的前提下减少前向推理次数。主要结果表明，该方法可在保持生成质量不变的情况下显著提升大模型推理速度。

papers.title: [GitHub] speculators: A unified library for building, evaluating, and storing speculative decoding algorithms for LLM infe
papers.authors: vllm-project
papers.abstract_en: A unified library for building, evaluating, and storing speculative decoding algorithms for LLM inference in vLLM
papers.abstract_cn: 一个用于在 vLLM 中构建、评估和存储大语言模型推理的推测解码算法的统一库
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the lack of standardized tooling for implementing and benchmarking speculative decoding methods in LLM inference systems. It introduces **speculators**, a unified library integrated with **vLLM** for building, evaluating, and storing speculative decoding algorithms in a modular and reproducible way. This enables easier comparison, reuse, and deployment of speculation strategies for accelerating LLM serving.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对大模型推理中投机解码算法实现分散、评测和复现困难的问题，提出了一个集成于 vLLM 的统一开源库。其核心方法是标准化投机解码算法的构建、评估与存储流程，使不同草稿模型、验证策略和推理优化方案能够在同一框架下开发与比较。该库有助于降低投机解码方法的实验与部署成本，推动 LLM 推理加速技术的复现、对比和工程落地。

papers.title: From Research Question to Scientific Workflow: Leveraging Agentic AI for Science Automation
papers.authors: Bartosz Balis, Michal Orzechowski, Piotr Kica, Michal Dygas, Michal Kuszewski
papers.abstract_en: Scientific workflow systems automate execution -- scheduling, fault tolerance, resource management -- but not the semantic translation that precedes it. Scientists still manually convert research questions into workflow specifications, a task requiring both domain knowledge and infrastructure expertise. We propose an agentic architecture that closes this gap through three layers: an LLM interprets natural language into structured intents (semantic layer); validated generators produce reproducible workflow DAGs (deterministic layer); and domain experts author ``Skills'': markdown documents encoding vocabulary mappings, parameter constraints, and optimization strategies (knowledge layer). This decomposition confines LLM non-determinism to intent extraction: identical intents always yield identical workflows. We implement and evaluate the architecture on the 1000 Genomes population genetics workflow and Hyperflow WMS running on Kubernetes. In an ablation study on 150 queries, Skills raise full-match intent accuracy from 44% to 83%; skill-driven deferred workflow generation reduces data transfer by 92\%; and the end-to-end pipeline completes queries on Kubernetes with LLM overhead below 15 seconds and cost under $0.001 per query.
papers.abstract_cn: 科学的工作流系统会自动执行——调度、容错、资源管理——但不会自动执行之前的语义转换。科学家们仍然手动将研究问题转换为工作流程规范，这一任务需要领域知识和基础设施专业知识。我们提出了一种代理架构，通过三层来缩小这一差距：LLM将自然语言解释为结构化意图（语义层）；经过验证的生成器生成可重复的工作流dag（确定性层）；领域专家撰写“技能”：标记编码词汇表映射、参数约束和优化策略（知识层）的文档。这种分解将LLM的不确定性限制在意图提取上：相同的意图总是产生相同的工作流。我们在1000 Genomes种群遗传学工作流和运行在Kubernetes上的Hyperflow WMS上实现并评估了该架构。在一项针对150个查询的消融研究中，Skills将完全匹配意图的准确率从44%提高到83%；技能驱动的延迟工作流生成减少了92%的数据传输；端到端管道在Kubernetes上完成查询，LLM开销低于15秒，每个查询的成本低于0.001美元。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles the manual “semantic gap” in scientific workflow automation, where scientists must translate natural-language research questions into executable workflow DAGs with scheduling, data, and resource constraints. It proposes a three-layer agentic architecture that uses an LLM only to extract structured intents, then relies on deterministic validated generators and expert-authored “Skills” documents to reproducibly construct workflows. Evaluated on a 1000 Genomes population genetics workflow with Hyperflow on Kubernetes, Skills improve full-match intent accuracy from 44% to 83%, reduce data transfer by 92%, and keep LLM overhead under 15 seconds at less than $0.001 per query.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对科学研究中“自然语言研究问题”到“可执行工作流规范”仍需人工转换的问题，提出一种三层智能体架构：LLM 解析结构化意图，确定性生成器构建可复现 DAG，领域专家编写的 Skills 提供术语映射、约束和优化策略。其核心洞见是将 LLM 的非确定性限制在意图提取阶段，从而保证相同意图始终生成相同工作流。实验表明，Skills 将意图完全匹配准确率从 44% 提升至 83%，数据传输减少 92%，且端到端 LLM 开销低于 15 秒、单查询成本低于 0.001 美元。

papers.title: TingIS: Real-time Risk Event Discovery from Noisy Customer Incidents at Enterprise Scale
papers.authors: Jun Wang, Ziyin Zhang, Rui Wang, Hang Yu, Peng Di
papers.abstract_en: Real-time detection and mitigation of technical anomalies are critical for large-scale cloud-native services, where even minutes of downtime can result in massive financial losses and diminished user trust. While customer incidents serve as a vital signal for discovering risks missed by monitoring, extracting actionable intelligence from this data remains challenging due to extreme noise, high throughput, and semantic complexity of diverse business lines. In this paper, we present TingIS, an end-to-end system designed for enterprise-grade incident discovery. At the core of TingIS is a multi-stage event linking engine that synergizes efficient indexing techniques with Large Language Models (LLMs) to make informed decisions on event merging, enabling the stable extraction of actionable incidents from just a handful of diverse user descriptions. This engine is complemented by a cascaded routing mechanism for precise business attribution and a multi-dimensional noise reduction pipeline that integrates domain knowledge, statistical patterns, and behavioral filtering. Deployed in a production environment handling a peak throughput of over 2,000 messages per minute and 300,000 messages per day, TingIS achieves a P90 alert latency of 3.5 minutes and a 95\% discovery rate for high-priority incidents. Benchmarks constructed from real-world data demonstrate that TingIS significantly outperforms baseline methods in routing accuracy, clustering quality, and Signal-to-Noise Ratio.
papers.abstract_cn: 实时检测和缓解技术异常对于大规模云原生服务至关重要，因为即使是几分钟的停机时间也可能导致巨大的财务损失和用户信任的降低。虽然客户事件是发现被监控遗漏的风险的重要信号，但由于各种业务线的极端噪声、高吞吐量和语义复杂性，从这些数据中提取可操作的情报仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了TingIS，一个为企业级事件发现而设计的端到端系统。TingIS的核心是一个多阶段事件链接引擎，它将高效的索引技术与大型语言模型（llm）协同起来，在事件合并时做出明智的决策，从而能够从少量不同的用户描述中稳定地提取可操作的事件。该引擎由用于精确业务归属的级联路由机制和集成了领域知识、统计模式和行为过滤的多维降噪管道进行补充。部署在处理每分钟超过2,000条消息和每天300,000条消息的峰值吞吐量的生产环境中，TingIS实现了3.5分钟的P90警报延迟和95%的高优先级事件发现率。基于真实世界数据构建的基准测试表明，TingIS在路由精度、聚类质量和信噪比方面明显优于基线方法。
papers.ai_summary_en: TingIS addresses real-time discovery of actionable risk events from extremely noisy, high-volume customer incident reports in enterprise cloud services. It combines a multi-stage event-linking engine that uses efficient indexing and LLM-based merging decisions with cascaded business routing and multidimensional noise filtering to cluster and attribute incidents. In production at over 2,000 messages/min and 300,000 messages/day, it achieves P90 alert latency of 3.5 minutes, 95% high-priority incident discovery, and outperforms baselines in routing accuracy, clustering quality, and signal-to-noise ratio.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文面向大规模云服务中客户事件噪声高、吞吐大、语义复杂导致风险事件难以实时发现的问题，提出企业级端到端系统 TingIS。其核心是通过高效索引与大模型结合的多阶段事件链接引擎进行事件合并判断，并配合级联业务路由和融合领域知识、统计模式与行为过滤的多维降噪流程。系统在生产环境中达到 P90 告警延迟 3.5 分钟、高优先级事件 95% 发现率，并在路由准确率、聚类质量和信噪比上显著优于基线。

papers.title: Black-Box Skill Stealing Attack from Proprietary LLM Agents: An Empirical Study
papers.authors: Zihan Wang, Rui Zhang, Yu Liu, Chi Liu, Qingchuan Zhao
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly rely on skills to encapsulate reusable capabilities via progressively disclosed instructions. High-quality skills inject expert knowledge into general-purpose models, improving performance on specialized tasks. This quality and ease of dissemination drive the emergence of a skill economy: free skill marketplaces already report 90368 published skills, while paid marketplaces report more than 2000 listings and over $100,000 in creator earnings. Yet this growing marketplace also creates a new attack surface, as adversaries can interact with public agent to extract hidden proprietary skill content. We present the first empirical study of black-box skill stealing against LLM agent systems. To study this threat, we first derive an attack taxonomy from prior prompt-stealing methods and build an automated stealing prompt generation agent. This agent starts from model-generated seed prompts, expands them through scenario rationalization and structure injection, and enforces diversity via embedding filtering. This process yields a reproducible pipeline for evaluating agent systems. We evaluate such attacks across 3 commercial agent architectures and 5 LLMs. Our results show that agent skills can be extracted with only 3 interactions, posing a serious copyright risk. To mitigate this threat, we design defenses across three stages of the agent pipeline: input, inference, and output. Although these defenses achieve strong results, the attack remains inexpensive and readily automatable, allowing an adversary to launch repeated attempts with different variants; only one successful attempt is sufficient to compromise the protected skill. Overall, our findings suggest that these copyright risks are largely overlooked across proprietary agent ecosystems. We therefore advocate for more robust defense strategies that provide stronger protection guarantees.
papers.abstract_cn: LLM代理越来越依赖于通过逐步公开的指令来封装可重用功能的技能。高质量的技能将专业知识注入到通用模型中，提高专业任务的性能。这种质量和传播的便利性推动了技能经济的出现：免费技能市场已经报告了90368个已发布的技能，而付费市场报告了超过2000个列表和超过10万美元的创作者收入。然而，这个不断增长的市场也创造了一个新的攻击面，因为攻击者可以与公共代理交互以提取隐藏的专有技能内容。我们提出了针对LLM代理系统的黑盒技能窃取的第一个实证研究。为了研究这种威胁，我们首先从先前的提示窃取方法中推导出一种攻击分类，并构建一个自动窃取提示生成代理。该智能体从模型生成的种子提示开始，通过场景合理化和结构注入对其进行扩展，并通过嵌入过滤来增强多样性。这个过程产生了一个可重复的管道来评估代理系统。我们在3个商业代理架构和5个llm中评估了这种攻击。我们的研究结果表明，仅通过3次交互就可以提取代理技能，存在严重的版权风险。为了减轻这种威胁，我们跨代理管道的三个阶段设计防御：输入、推理和输出。尽管这些防御措施取得了强大的效果，但攻击仍然是廉价且容易自动化的，允许对手使用不同的变体进行重复尝试；只有一次成功的尝试才足以破坏受保护的技能。总的来说，我们的研究结果表明，这些版权风险在很大程度上被专利代理生态系统所忽视。因此，我们主张采取更强有力的防御战略，提供更强有力的保护保障。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper studies black-box extraction of proprietary “skills”—encapsulated, progressively disclosed instructions—from LLM agents, exposing a copyright and IP risk in emerging skill marketplaces. It builds an attack taxonomy and an automated stealing-prompt generator that expands model-seeded prompts via scenario rationalization, structure injection, and embedding-based diversity, then evaluates three commercial agent architectures and five LLMs with input/inference/output defenses. Experiments show skills can be recovered in as few as three interactions; defenses reduce success but remain brittle because cheap, automatable variant attacks need only one success, indicating overlooked ecosystem-wide vulnerabilities.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对专有LLM智能体中封装专家知识的“技能”可能在黑盒交互下被窃取的问题，首次系统实证研究了技能窃取攻击，并构建了包含种子提示扩展、场景推理、结构注入和嵌入去重的自动化攻击生成流水线。在3种商业智能体架构和5个LLM上的实验表明，仅需约3次交互即可提取受保护技能，且即使部署输入、推理、输出三阶段防御，攻击仍因低成本、可自动化而可通过多次变体尝试成功。研究揭示当前智能体生态对技能版权风险重视不足，呼吁建立更强保证的防御机制。

papers.title: Tool Attention Is All You Need: Dynamic Tool Gating and Lazy Schema Loading for Eliminating the MCP/Tools Tax in Scalable Agentic Workflows
papers.authors: Anuj Sadani, Deepak Kumar
papers.abstract_en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become a common interface for connecting large language model (LLM) agents to external tools, but its reliance on stateless, eager schema injection imposes a hidden per-turn overhead the MCP Tax or Tools Tax that practitioner reports place between roughly 10k and 60k tokens in typical multi-server deployments. This payload inflates the key-value cache, is associated with reasoning degradation as context utilization approaches published fracture points around 70%, and turns token budgets into a recurring operational cost. We introduce Tool Attention, a middleware-layer mechanism that generalizes the "Attention Is All You Need" paradigm from self-attention over tokens to gated attention over tools. Tool Attention combines (i) an Intent Schema Overlap (ISO) score from sentence embeddings, (ii) a state-aware gating function enforcing preconditions and access scopes, and (iii) a two-phase lazy schema loader that keeps a compact summary pool in context and promotes full JSON schemas only for top-k gated tools. We evaluate on a simulated 120-tool, six-server benchmark whose per-server token counts are calibrated to public audits of real MCP deployments. In this simulation, Tool Attention directly reduces measured per-turn tool tokens by 95.0% (47.3k -> 2.4k) and raises effective context utilization (a token-ratio quantity) from 24% to 91%. End-to-end figures for task success, latency, cost, and reasoning quality are reported as projections derived from the measured token counts combined with published deployment telemetry; they are not measured on live LLM agents, and we mark projected values explicitly throughout. Taken together, the results support a simple thesis: protocol-level efficiency, not raw context length, is a binding constraint on scalable gentic systems. The code for this work is accessible at https://github.com/asadani/tool-attention
papers.abstract_cn: 模型上下文协议（MCP）已经成为将大型语言模型（LLM）代理连接到外部工具的通用接口，但是它对无状态、渴望模式注入的依赖带来了隐藏的每次开销，MCP税或工具税，从业者报告在典型的多服务器部署中大约在10k到60k令牌之间。这种负载会使键值缓存膨胀，当上下文利用率接近公布的断裂点约70%时，会导致推理退化，并将令牌预算转化为经常性的运营成本。我们介绍了工具关注，这是一种中间层机制，它将“注意力就是你所需要的”范式从对令牌的自我关注推广到对工具的封闭关注。Tool Attention结合了(i)句子嵌入的Intent Schema Overlap （ISO）评分，（ii）一个状态感知的门控功能，强制执行前提条件和访问范围，以及（iii）一个两阶段的惰性模式加载器，它在上下文中保持一个紧凑的摘要池，并仅为top-k门控工具提升完整的JSON模式。我们在一个模拟的包含120个工具、6台服务器的基准测试上进行评估，该基准测试的每台服务器令牌计数经过校准，符合真实MCP部署的公共审计。在这个模拟中，工具注意力直接将每轮测量的工具标记减少了95.0%（47.3万- 2.4万），并将有效上下文利用率（标记比率数量）从24%提高到91%。任务成功、延迟、成本和推理质量的端到端数据报告为从测量的令牌计数结合发布的部署遥测得出的预测；它们不是在活动的LLM代理上测量的，并且我们自始至终明确地标记预测值。综上所述，这些结果支持一个简单的论点：协议级效率，而不是原始上下文长度，是可扩展遗传系统的绑定约束。这项工作的代码可在https://github.com/asadani/tool-attention上访问
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the “MCP/Tools Tax” caused by eager, stateless injection of full tool schemas into LLM agent contexts, which wastes tens of thousands of tokens per turn, inflates KV-cache state, and can degrade reasoning under high context utilization. It proposes Tool Attention, a middleware mechanism that gates tool exposure using an Intent Schema Overlap embedding score, state-aware precondition/scope checks, and lazy loading that keeps only compact tool summaries in context while promoting full JSON schemas for top-k relevant tools. On a simulated 120-tool, six-server MCP benchmark, the method reduces per-turn tool tokens by 95.0% (47.3k to 2.4k) and raises effective context utilization from 24% to 91%, with projected gains in cost, latency, and task performance.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 MCP 在多服务器 Agent 工作流中因急切注入完整工具 schema 而产生的每轮 10k–60k token“MCP/Tools Tax”，以及由此引发的 KV 缓存膨胀、上下文利用率下降和推理退化问题。核心方法是提出 Tool Attention 中间件，将注意力机制从 token 层扩展到工具层，结合意图-schema 重叠评分、状态感知门控和两阶段懒加载，仅保留紧凑工具摘要并按需加载 top-k 工具的完整 JSON schema。仿真基准显示，每轮工具相关 token 从 47.3k 降至 2.4k（-95%），有效上下文利用率从 24% 提升至 91%，表明协议层效率而非单纯扩大上下文长度，是规模化 Agent 系统的关键约束。

papers.title: Learning to Communicate: Toward End-to-End Optimization of Multi-Agent Language Systems
papers.authors: Ye Yu, Heming Liu, Haibo Jin, Xiaopeng Yuan, Peng Kuang
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems built on large language models have shown strong performance on complex reasoning tasks, yet most work focuses on agent roles and orchestration while treating inter-agent communication as a fixed interface. Latent communication through internal representations such as key-value caches offers a promising alternative to text-based protocols, but existing approaches do not jointly optimize communication with multi-agent reasoning. Therefore we propose DiffMAS, a training framework that treats latent communication as a learnable component of multi-agent systems. DiffMAS performs parameter-efficient supervised training over multi-agent latent trajectories, enabling agents to jointly learn how information should be encoded and interpreted across interactions. Experiments on mathematical reasoning, scientific QA, code generation, and commonsense benchmarks show that DiffMAS consistently improves reasoning accuracy and decoding stability over single-agent inference, text-based multi-agent systems, and prior latent communication methods, achieving 26.7% on AIME24, 20.2% on GPQA-Diamond, and consistent gains across reasoning benchmarks.
papers.abstract_cn: 建立在大型语言模型上的多智能体系统在复杂的推理任务上表现出了很强的性能，然而大多数工作都集中在智能体角色和编排上，而将智能体间的通信视为固定的接口。通过内部表示（如键值缓存）进行潜在通信为基于文本的协议提供了一个有希望的替代方案，但是现有的方法并没有联合优化与多代理推理的通信。因此，我们提出了DiffMAS，这是一个将潜在通信视为多智能体系统的可学习组件的训练框架。DiffMAS在多智能体潜在轨迹上执行参数有效的监督训练，使智能体能够共同学习如何在交互中对信息进行编码和解释。在数学推理、科学QA、代码生成和常识基准测试上的实验表明，与单智能体推理、基于文本的多智能体系统和先验潜在通信方法相比，DiffMAS持续提高推理精度和解码稳定性，在AIME24上实现了26.7%，在GPQA-Diamond上实现了20.2%，并且在推理基准测试上实现了一致的增益。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles the limitation of LLM multi-agent systems that rely on fixed text-based communication interfaces rather than jointly optimizing communication with multi-agent reasoning. It proposes DiffMAS, a parameter-efficient supervised training framework that treats latent communication over internal representations, such as KV-cache trajectories, as a learnable component, enabling agents to co-adapt how information is encoded and interpreted across interactions. Experiments on mathematical reasoning, scientific QA, code generation, and commonsense benchmarks show improved accuracy and decoding stability over single-agent, text-based multi-agent, and prior latent-communication methods, including 26.7% on AIME24 and 20.2% on GPQA-Diamond.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多智能体语言系统中智能体通信通常被固定为文本接口、且未与推理过程联合优化的问题，提出面向端到端优化的潜在通信训练框架 DiffMAS。其核心洞见是将 KV cache 等内部表示间的通信视为可学习组件，通过对多智能体潜在轨迹进行参数高效监督训练，使各智能体共同学习信息的编码与解释方式。实验表明，DiffMAS 在数学推理、科学问答、代码生成等任务上稳定优于单智能体、文本式多智能体及既有潜在通信方法，并提升解码稳定性，如在 AIME24 和 GPQA-Diamond 上分别达到 26.7% 和 20.2%。

papers.title: Generalizing Test Cases for Comprehensive Test Scenario Coverage
papers.authors: Binhang Qi, Yun Lin, Xinyi Weng, Chenyan Liu, Hailong Sun
papers.abstract_en: Test cases are essential for software development and maintenance. In practice, developers derive multiple test cases from an implicit pattern based on their understanding of requirements and inference of diverse test scenarios, each validating a specific behavior of the focal method. However, producing comprehensive tests is time-consuming and error-prone: many important tests that should have accompanied the initial test are added only after a significant delay, sometimes only after bugs are triggered. Existing automated test generation techniques largely focus on code coverage. Yet in real projects, practical tests are seldom driven by code coverage alone, since test scenarios do not necessarily align with control-flow branches. Instead, test scenarios originate from requirements, which are often undocumented and implicitly embedded in a project's design and implementation. However, developer-written tests are frequently treated as executable specifications; thus, even a single initial test that reflects the developer's intent can reveal the underlying requirement and the diverse scenarios that should be validated. In this work, we propose TestGeneralizer, a framework for generalizing test cases to comprehensively cover test scenarios. TestGeneralizer orchestrates three stages: (1) enhancing the understanding of the requirement and scenario behind the focal method and initial test; (2) generating a test scenario template and crystallizing it into various test scenario instances; and (3) generating and refining executable test cases from these instances. We evaluate TestGeneralizer against three state-of-the-art baselines on 12 open-source Java projects. TestGeneralizer achieves significant improvements: +31.66% and +23.08% over ChatTester, in mutation-based and LLM-assessed scenario coverage, respectively.
papers.abstract_cn: 测试用例对于软件开发和维护是必不可少的。在实践中，开发人员基于他们对需求的理解和对不同测试场景的推断，从隐式模式中派生出多个测试用例，每个用例验证焦点方法的特定行为。然而，生成全面的测试既耗时又容易出错：许多本应伴随着初始测试的重要测试只是在一段相当长的延迟之后才添加，有时甚至是在bug被触发之后。现有的自动化测试生成技术主要关注代码覆盖率。然而在实际的项目中，实际的测试很少单独由代码覆盖驱动，因为测试场景不一定与控制流分支保持一致。相反，测试场景源于需求，这些需求通常没有文档记录，并且隐式地嵌入到项目的设计和实现中。然而，开发人员编写的测试通常被视为可执行的规范；因此，即使是反映开发人员意图的单个初始测试也可以揭示应该被验证的潜在需求和不同的场景。在这项工作中，我们提出了TestGeneralizer，这是一个泛化测试用例以全面覆盖测试场景的框架。TestGeneralizer编排了三个阶段：(1)增强对焦点方法和初始测试背后的需求和场景的理解；(2)生成测试场景模板，并将其结晶为各种测试场景实例；(3)从这些实例中生成并细化可执行的测试用例。我们根据12个开源Java项目的三个最先进的基线来评估TestGeneralizer。在基于突变和llm评估的场景覆盖率方面，TestGeneralizer分别比ChatTester实现了显著的改进：+31.66%和+23.08%。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the gap between code-coverage-driven test generation and the need for comprehensive test-scenario coverage, where important behavioral scenarios are often implicit in requirements and developer-written tests. It proposes TestGeneralizer, an LLM-based framework that treats an initial test as an executable specification, infers the underlying requirement and scenario, generates a scenario template with diverse instances, and synthesizes/refines executable tests from them. Evaluations on 12 Java projects show substantial gains over state-of-the-art baselines, including +31.66% mutation-based and +23.08% LLM-assessed scenario coverage versus ChatTester.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对现有自动测试生成主要追求代码覆盖、难以覆盖由隐含需求驱动的多样测试场景的问题，提出从开发者初始测试中推断需求意图并泛化生成更多测试。其核心方法是 TestGeneralizer：先理解被测方法与初始测试背后的需求和场景，再生成测试场景模板并实例化，最后生成并精化可执行测试用例。实验在 12 个 Java 开源项目上表明，该方法相较 ChatTester 将变异覆盖和 LLM 评估的场景覆盖分别提升 31.66% 和 23.08%，有助于更全面地验证软件行为。

papers.title: Thinking with Reasoning Skills: Fewer Tokens, More Accuracy
papers.authors: Guangxiang Zhao, Qilong Shi, Xusen Xiao, Xiangzheng Zhang, Tong Yang
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning LLMs often spend substantial tokens on long intermediate reasoning traces (e.g., chain-of-thought) when solving new problems. We propose to summarize and store reusable reasoning skills distilled from extensive deliberation and trial-and-error exploration, and to retrieve these skills at inference time to guide future reasoning. Unlike the prevailing \emph{reasoning from scratch} paradigm, our approach first recalls relevant skills for each query, helping the model avoid redundant detours and focus on effective solution paths. We evaluate our method on coding and mathematical reasoning tasks, and find that it significantly reduces reasoning tokens while improving overall performance. The resulting lower per-request cost indicates strong practical and economic potential for real-world deployment.
papers.abstract_cn: 推理型大语言模型在解决新问题时往往会在冗长的中间推理轨迹（例如连锁思维）上花费大量的令牌。我们提出总结并存储从广泛的思考和反复试验中提炼出的可重用推理技能，并在推理时调用这些技能以指导未来的推理。与现行的“从零开始推理”范式不同，我们的方法首先为每个查询回忆相关技能，帮助模型避免冗余的迂回路线，专注于有效的解决路径。我们在编码和数学推理任务上评估了该方法，发现其在提高整体性能的同时显著减少了推理所需令牌数。由此带来的更低每次请求成本显示了其在现实部署中的强大实用性和经济潜力。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the high token cost and redundant exploration in reasoning LLMs that solve each problem by generating long chain-of-thought traces from scratch. It proposes distilling reusable reasoning skills from prior deliberation and trial-and-error, storing them, and retrieving relevant skills at inference time to guide more direct solution paths. On coding and mathematical reasoning tasks, this approach significantly reduces reasoning tokens while improving accuracy, yielding lower per-request cost for practical deployment.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对推理型大模型在解决新问题时产生冗长链式推理、token成本高的问题，提出将试错探索中得到的可复用推理技能进行总结存储，并在推理时按查询检索以引导求解。其核心洞见是用“技能检索辅助推理”替代“从零推理”，减少无效探索并聚焦有效路径。实验在代码与数学任务上显示，该方法能显著减少推理token并提升准确率，降低单次请求成本，具有实际部署价值。

papers.title: Stealthy Backdoor Attacks against LLMs Based on Natural Style Triggers
papers.authors: Jiali Wei, Ming Fan, Guoheng Sun, Xicheng Zhang, Haijun Wang
papers.abstract_en: The growing application of large language models (LLMs) in safety-critical domains has raised urgent concerns about their security. Many recent studies have demonstrated the feasibility of backdoor attacks against LLMs. However, existing methods suffer from three key shortcomings: explicit trigger patterns that compromise naturalness, unreliable injection of attacker-specified payloads in long-form generation, and incompletely specified threat models that obscure how backdoors are delivered and activated in practice. To address these gaps, we present BadStyle, a complete backdoor attack framework and pipeline. BadStyle leverages an LLM as a poisoned sample generator to construct natural and stealthy poisoned samples that carry imperceptible style-level triggers while preserving semantics and fluency. To stabilize payload injection during fine-tuning, we design an auxiliary target loss that reinforces the attacker-specified target content in responses to poisoned inputs and penalizes its emergence in benign responses. We further ground the attack in a realistic threat model and systematically evaluate BadStyle under both prompt-induced and PEFT-based injection strategies. Extensive experiments across seven victim LLMs, including LLaMA, Phi, DeepSeek, and GPT series, demonstrate that BadStyle achieves high attack success rates (ASRs) while maintaining strong stealthiness. The proposed auxiliary target loss substantially improves the stability of backdoor activation, yielding an average ASR improvement of around 30% across style-level triggers. Even in downstream deployment scenarios unknown during injection, the implanted backdoor remains effective. Moreover, BadStyle consistently evades representative input-level defenses and bypasses output-level defenses through simple camouflage.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）在安全关键领域的日益增长的应用引起了对其安全性的迫切关注。最近的许多研究已经证明了针对llm的后门攻击的可行性。然而，现有方法存在三个主要缺点：显式触发模式损害了自然性，在长格式生成中不可靠地注入攻击者指定的有效载荷，以及不完全指定的威胁模型，使后门在实践中如何交付和激活变得模糊。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了BadStyle，一个完整的后门攻击框架和管道。BadStyle利用LLM作为中毒样本生成器来构建自然和隐蔽的中毒样本，这些样本携带难以察觉的风格级触发器，同时保持语义和流畅性。为了在微调期间稳定有效载荷注入，我们设计了一个辅助目标损失，它在响应有毒输入时加强攻击者指定的目标内容，并惩罚其在良性响应中的出现。我们进一步将攻击置于现实威胁模型中，并在提示诱导和基于pet的注入策略下系统地评估BadStyle。在包括LLaMA、Phi、DeepSeek和GPT系列在内的七个受害llm中进行的大量实验表明，BadStyle在保持强大隐身性的同时实现了高攻击成功率（ASRs）。所提出的辅助目标损失大大提高了后门激活的稳定性，在不同类型级别的触发器中平均ASR提高了约30%。即使在注入过程中未知的下游部署场景中，植入的后门仍然有效。此外，BadStyle始终回避代表性的输入级防御，并通过简单的伪装绕过输出级防御。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses stealthy backdoor attacks on LLMs, targeting the unnatural triggers, unstable payload injection in long-form outputs, and vague threat models of prior work. BadStyle uses an LLM to generate semantically preserved poisoned samples with imperceptible style-level triggers and introduces an auxiliary target loss that reinforces attacker-specified payloads for poisoned inputs while suppressing them on benign inputs. Experiments on seven LLMs under prompt-induced and PEFT-based injection show high attack success rates, ~30% average ASR improvement from the auxiliary loss, persistence in unseen deployment scenarios, and evasion of input- and output-level defenses.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对现有LLM后门攻击中触发器不自然、长文本恶意载荷注入不稳定以及威胁模型不完整的问题，提出BadStyle框架：利用LLM生成携带自然风格触发器的中毒样本，并通过辅助目标损失在微调中强化恶意响应、抑制良性误触发。实验在LLaMA、Phi、DeepSeek和GPT等7个模型上表明，该方法在保持高隐蔽性和语义流畅性的同时取得高攻击成功率，辅助损失平均提升约30% ASR，并能有效规避输入级防御、绕过输出级防御。

papers.title: Language as a Latent Variable for Reasoning Optimization
papers.authors: Linjuan Wu, Haoran Wei, Jialong Tang, Shuang Luo, Baosong Yang
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs reduce English-centric bias, a surprising trend emerges: non-English responses sometimes outperform English on reasoning tasks. We hypothesize that language functions as a latent variable that structurally modulates the model's internal inference pathways, rather than merely serving as an output medium. To test this, we conducted a Polyglot Thinking Experiment, in which models were prompted to solve identical problems under language-constrained and language-unconstrained conditions. Results show that non-English responses often achieve higher accuracy, and the best performance frequently occur when language is unconstrained, suggesting that multilinguality broadens the model's latent reasoning space. Based on this insight, we propose polyGRPO (Polyglot Group Relative Policy Optimization), an RL framework that treats language variation as an implicit exploration signal. It generates polyglot preference data online under language-constrained and unconstrained conditions, optimizing the policy with respect to both answer accuracy and reasoning structure. Trained on only 18.1K multilingual math problems without chain-of-thought annotations, polyGRPO improves the base model (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct) by 6.72% absolute accuracy on four English reasoning testset and 6.89% in their multilingual benchmark. Remarkably, it is the only method that surpasses the base LLM on English commonsense reasoning task (4.9%), despite being trained solely on math data-highlighting its strong cross-task generalization. Further analysis reveals that treating language as a latent variable expands the model's latent reasoning space, yielding consistent and generalizable improvements in reasoning performance.
papers.abstract_cn: 随着法学硕士减少以英语为中心的偏见，一个令人惊讶的趋势出现了：在推理任务中，非英语反应有时比英语反应表现得更好。我们假设语言作为一个潜在变量，在结构上调节模型的内部推理路径，而不仅仅是作为输出媒介。为了验证这一点，我们进行了一个多语言思维实验，在这个实验中，模型被提示在语言约束和语言无约束的条件下解决相同的问题。结果表明，非英语响应通常具有更高的准确性，并且在语言不受约束的情况下往往表现最佳，这表明多语言拓宽了模型的潜在推理空间。基于这一见解，我们提出了polyGRPO (Polyglot Group Relative Policy Optimization)，这是一个将语言变化视为隐式探索信号的强化学习框架。它在语言约束和无约束条件下在线生成多语言偏好数据，从答案准确性和推理结构两方面优化策略。在没有思维链注释的情况下，只训练了18.1K个多语言数学问题，polyGRPO在四个英语推理测试集上将基本模型（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）的绝对准确率提高了6.72%，在多语言基准测试集上提高了6.89%。值得注意的是，它是唯一一种在英语常识推理任务上超过基础LLM的方法（4.9%），尽管它只接受数学数据的训练——这突出了它强大的跨任务泛化能力。进一步分析表明，将语言作为潜在变量扩展了模型的潜在推理空间，在推理性能上产生了一致的、可推广的改进。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper tackles the problem that LLM reasoning performance varies with response language, arguing that language is not just an output medium but a latent variable that modulates internal inference pathways. It proposes polyGRPO, an RL framework that treats language variation as an implicit exploration signal, generating online polyglot preference data under constrained and unconstrained language conditions to optimize both answer accuracy and reasoning structure. Using only 18.1K multilingual math problems without chain-of-thought supervision, polyGRPO improves Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct by 6.72% absolute on English reasoning benchmarks and 6.89% on multilingual benchmarks, while also generalizing to English commonsense reasoning.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文研究多语言大模型中非英语回答有时更擅长推理的问题，提出语言不只是输出媒介，而是可作为潜变量结构性地调节模型内部推理路径。核心方法是设计“多语思考实验”并提出 polyGRPO，将语言约束/非约束变化作为隐式探索信号，在线生成多语偏好数据并用强化学习同时优化答案准确性与推理结构。仅用 18.1K 多语数学题训练即可在英文和多语推理基准上分别提升约 6.72%/6.89%，并在仅数学训练下实现英文常识推理提升，显示出较强跨任务泛化能力。

papers.title: CoFEE: Reasoning Control for LLM-Based Feature Discovery
papers.authors: Maximilian Westermann, Ben Griffin, Aaron Ontoyin Yin, Zakari Salifu, Yagiz Ihlamur
papers.abstract_en: Feature discovery from complex unstructured data is fundamentally a reasoning problem: it requires identifying abstractions that are predictive of a target outcome while avoiding leakage, proxies, and post-outcome signals. With the introduction of ever-improving Large Language Models (LLMs), our method provides a structured method for addressing this challenge. LLMs are well suited for this task by being able to process large amounts of information, but unconstrained feature generation can lead to weak features. In this work, we study reasoning control in LLMs by inducing cognitive behaviors for improving feature discovery. We introduce CoFEE (Cognitive Feature Engineering Engine), a reasoning control framework that enforces cognitive behaviors in how the LLM reasons during feature discovery. From a machine learning perspective, these cognitive behaviors act as structured inductive biases over the space of candidate features generated by the model. These behaviors have been exploited with success in ML models, and include backward chaining from outcomes, subgoal decomposition, verification against observability and leakage criteria, and explicit backtracking of rejected reasoning paths. In a controlled comparison, we show that enforcing cognitive behaviors yields features with higher empirical predictability than those under unconstrained vanilla LLM prompts. CoFEE achieves an average Success Rate Score that is 15.2% higher than the vanilla approach, while generating 29% fewer features and reducing costs by 53.3%. Using held-out feature evaluation, we assess whether cognitively induced features generalize beyond the data used for discovery. Our results indicate that, in our evaluated setting, reasoning control is associated with improvements in quality and efficiency of LLM-based feature discovery.
papers.abstract_cn: 从复杂的非结构化数据中发现特征基本上是一个推理问题：它需要识别能够预测目标结果的抽象，同时避免泄漏、代理和结果后信号。随着不断改进的大型语言模型（llm）的引入，我们的方法为解决这一挑战提供了结构化的方法。llm能够处理大量信息，因此非常适合这项任务，但是不受约束的特征生成可能导致弱特征。在这项工作中，我们通过诱导认知行为来研究llm中的推理控制，以改善特征发现。我们介绍了CoFEE（认知特征工程引擎），这是一个推理控制框架，它在LLM在特征发现过程中如何推理时强制执行认知行为。从机器学习的角度来看，这些认知行为在模型生成的候选特征空间上充当结构化归纳偏差。这些行为已经在ML模型中得到了成功的利用，包括结果的反向链接，子目标分解，针对可观察性和泄漏标准的验证，以及被拒绝的推理路径的显式回溯。在对照比较中，我们发现强制执行认知行为产生的特征比不受约束的香草LLM提示具有更高的经验可预测性。CoFEE的平均成功率比普通方法高15.2%，而生成的功能减少了29%，成本降低了53.3%。使用保留特征评估，我们评估认知诱导的特征是否超出了用于发现的数据。我们的结果表明，在我们评估的设置中，推理控制与基于llm的特征发现的质量和效率的提高有关。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles LLM-based feature discovery from complex unstructured data, where unconstrained generation often produces weak, leaky, or non-predictive features. It proposes CoFEE, a reasoning-control framework that imposes cognitive behaviors—such as backward chaining from outcomes, subgoal decomposition, leakage/observability verification, and explicit backtracking—as structured inductive biases over candidate feature generation. In controlled experiments, CoFEE improves feature quality and efficiency over vanilla prompting, achieving a 15.2% higher Success Rate Score while generating 29% fewer features and reducing cost by 53.3%, with held-out evaluation suggesting better generalization.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM从复杂非结构化数据中发现预测特征时易产生弱特征、数据泄漏和事后信号的问题，提出CoFEE推理控制框架，将反向推理、子目标分解、可观测性/泄漏校验和显式回溯等认知行为作为结构化归纳偏置约束特征生成。实验表明，相比无约束提示，CoFEE以更少特征和更低成本获得更高预测性，成功率平均提升15.2%，并提升了特征发现的质量、效率与泛化性。

papers.title: A Metamorphic Testing Approach to Diagnosing Memorization in LLM-Based Program Repair
papers.authors: Milan De Koning, Ali Asgari, Pouria Derakhshanfar, Annibale Panichella
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based automated program repair (APR) techniques have shown promising results in reducing debugging costs. However, prior results can be affected by data leakage: large language models (LLMs) may memorize bug fixes when evaluation benchmarks overlap with their pretraining data, leading to inflated performance estimates. In this paper, we investigate whether we can better reveal data leakage by combining metamorphic testing (MT) with negative log-likelihood (NLL), which has been used in prior work as a proxy for memorization. We construct variant benchmarks by applying semantics-preserving transformations to two widely used datasets, Defects4J and GitBug-Java. Using these benchmarks, we evaluate the repair success rates of seven LLMs on both original and transformed versions, and analyze the relationship between performance degradation and NLL. Our results show that all evaluated state-of-the-art LLMs exhibit substantial drops in patch generation success rates on transformed benchmarks, ranging from -4.1% for GPT-4o to -15.98% for Llama-3.1. Furthermore, we find that this degradation strongly correlates with NLL on the original benchmarks, suggesting that models perform better on instances they are more likely to have memorized. These findings show that combining MT with NLL provides stronger and more reliable evidence of data leakage, while metamorphic testing alone can help mitigate its effects in LLM-based APR evaluations.
papers.abstract_cn: 基于llm的自动程序修复（APR）技术在降低调试成本方面显示出了良好的结果。然而，先前的结果可能会受到数据泄漏的影响：当评估基准与其预训练数据重叠时，大型语言模型（llm）可能会记住错误修复，从而导致过高的性能估计。在本文中，我们研究了是否可以通过将变质测试（MT）与负对数似然（NLL）相结合来更好地揭示数据泄漏，负对数似然（NLL）在之前的工作中被用作记忆的代理。我们通过对两个广泛使用的数据集（缺陷4j和gibug - java）应用语义保留转换来构建不同的基准测试。使用这些基准，我们评估了7个llm在原始版本和转换版本上的修复成功率，并分析了性能下降与NLL之间的关系。我们的研究结果表明，所有经过评估的最先进的llm在转换基准上的补丁生成成功率都大幅下降，从gpt - 40的-4.1%到Llama-3.1的-15.98%不等。此外，我们发现这种退化与原始基准上的NLL密切相关，这表明模型在它们更有可能记住的实例上表现得更好。这些发现表明，将MT与NLL相结合可以提供更有力、更可靠的数据泄漏证据，而单独使用变质测试可以帮助减轻其在基于llm的APR评估中的影响。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses inflated performance estimates in LLM-based automated program repair caused by data leakage and memorization of benchmark bug fixes. It combines metamorphic testing—creating semantics-preserving transformed variants of Defects4J and GitBug-Java—with negative log-likelihood as a memorization proxy to diagnose whether repair success depends on memorized instances. Experiments on seven LLMs show substantial success-rate drops on transformed benchmarks, from −4.1% for GPT-4o to −15.98% for Llama-3.1, with degradation strongly correlating with NLL, indicating that MT plus NLL more reliably exposes leakage while MT alone can reduce its effect in APR evaluation.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对基于大模型的程序修复评测中因基准与预训练数据重叠导致的数据泄漏与性能虚高问题。其核心方法是将变形测试与负对数似然（NLL）结合，通过对 Defects4J 和 GitBug-Java 施加语义保持变换构建变体基准，以诊断模型是否依赖记忆。结果显示，7 个先进 LLM 在变换基准上的修复成功率显著下降（-4.1% 至 -15.98%），且下降幅度与原始样本 NLL 强相关，表明该方法能更可靠地揭示并缓解 LLM 程序修复评测中的记忆化影响。

papers.title: Separable Expert Architecture: Toward Privacy-Preserving LLM Personalization via Composable Adapters and Deletable User Proxies
papers.authors: Chris Schneider, Philipp Schoenegger, Ben Bariach
papers.abstract_en: Current model training approaches incorporate user information directly into shared weights, making individual data removal computationally infeasible without retraining. This paper presents a three-layer architecture that decouples personal data from shared weights by combining a static base model, composable domain-expert LoRA adapters that shape behavior without imparting user data, and per-user proxy artefacts whose deletion constitutes deterministic unlearning. Evaluation on Phi-3.5-mini and Llama-3.1-8B confirms per-user differentiation in which personal data influences outputs while remaining isolated, verified by a return to baseline after proxy removal (KL divergence of approximately 0.21 nats, 82-89% verification pass rate) and near-zero cross-user contamination. Because user-specific information never enters shared weights, the architecture mitigates model inversion, membership inference, and training-data extraction against shared model components by construction. The approach converts machine unlearning from an intractable weight-editing problem into a deterministic deletion operation that preserves personalization alongside privacy-enhancing guarantees and is compatible with differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) for privacy-preserving shared model improvement.
papers.abstract_cn: 当前的模型训练方法将用户信息直接合并到共享权重中，如果不重新训练，单个数据的去除在计算上是不可行的。本文提出了一个三层架构，通过结合静态基本模型、可组合的领域专家LoRA适配器（在不传递用户数据的情况下塑造行为）和每个用户的代理工件（其删除构成确定性学习），将个人数据与共享权重解耦。对Phi-3.5-mini和Llama-3.1-8B的评估证实了每个用户的差异，其中个人数据影响输出，同时保持隔离，通过删除代理后返回基线进行验证（KL差异约为0.21 nats，验证通过率为82-89%）和接近零的跨用户污染。由于特定于用户的信息永远不会进入共享权重，因此该体系结构通过构造减轻了针对共享模型组件的模型反转、成员推理和训练数据提取。该方法将机器学习从棘手的权重编辑问题转化为确定性删除操作，保留个性化和增强隐私的保证，并与差分私有随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）兼容，用于保护隐私的共享模型改进。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles privacy-preserving LLM personalization and machine unlearning, where encoding user data into shared model weights makes deletion computationally intractable and increases privacy risk. It proposes a separable architecture combining a static base model, composable domain-expert LoRA adapters, and per-user proxy artifacts, so personalization remains isolated and proxy deletion yields deterministic unlearning. Experiments on Phi-3.5-mini and Llama-3.1-8B show effective user differentiation, near-zero cross-user contamination, and reliable reversion to baseline after deletion (KL ≈ 0.21 nats, 82–89% verification), while mitigating inversion, membership inference, and extraction attacks on shared weights by construction.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对个性化 LLM 中用户数据被写入共享权重后难以删除、易引发隐私泄露的问题，提出一种“基模型 + 可组合领域 LoRA 适配器 + 可删除用户代理”的三层解耦架构。其核心洞见是让领域行为由共享适配器表达、用户个人信息仅存在于独立代理工件中，因此删除代理即可实现确定性机器遗忘。实验在 Phi-3.5-mini 和 Llama-3.1-8B 上显示，该方法能实现用户差异化个性化，移除用户代理后输出恢复基线（KL 约 0.21 nats，验证通过率 82–89%），并显著降低跨用户污染与共享模型的隐私攻击面。

papers.title: SpecSyn: LLM-based Synthesis and Refinement of Formal Specifications for Real-world Program Verification
papers.authors: Lezhi Ma, Shangqing Liu, Yi Li, Qiong Wu, Han Wang
papers.abstract_en: Program verification is a formal technique to rigorously ensure the correctness and fault-freeness of software systems. However, constructing comprehensive interprocedural specifications for full verification obligations is time-consuming and labor-intensive, giving rise to automated specification generation approaches. Despite the significant advancements in these approaches brought by Large Language Models (LLMs), existing LLM-empowered approaches still suffer from significant limitations: they lack effective strategies for handling sizable input programs, and are typically equipped with no mechanisms to evaluate and guarantee the strength of the generated specifications. The limitations impair their ability to extract precise specifications from real-world complicated programs to support the verification of target properties, thereby hindering the applicability of existing approaches in verification tasks on real-world programs. To remedy this gap, we propose SpecSyn, a novel LLM-based specification generation method. SpecSyn first decomposes the input program into individual segments, which are handled respectively by the subsequent iterative specification generation process. Innovatively, we incorporate into the process a specification refinement mechanism based on semantic-non-equivalent program mutations and variant discrimination, assessing and enhancing the semantic strength of the generated specifications. Extensive experiments show that SpecSyn maintains high precision over 90% and outstanding recall over 75%, significantly outperforming existing LLM-based approaches. In further evaluations, SpecSyn successfully handles 1071 out of 1365 target properties for open-source programs, proving its applicability on real-world program verification tasks.
papers.abstract_cn: 程序验证是一种严格保证软件系统正确性和无故障性的形式化技术。然而，为完整的验证义务构建全面的过程间规范是耗时和劳动密集型的，从而产生了自动化的规范生成方法。尽管大型语言模型（llm）带来了这些方法的重大进步，但现有的llm授权方法仍然受到重大限制：它们缺乏处理大规模输入程序的有效策略，并且通常没有机制来评估和保证生成规范的强度。这些限制削弱了它们从现实世界复杂的程序中提取精确规范以支持目标属性验证的能力，从而阻碍了现有方法在现实世界程序验证任务中的适用性。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了SpecSyn，一种新的基于llm的规范生成方法。SpecSyn首先将输入程序分解为单独的段，这些段由随后的迭代规范生成过程分别处理。创新地，我们将基于语义非等效程序突变和变体识别的规范改进机制纳入到该过程中，以评估和增强生成规范的语义强度。大量的实验表明，SpecSyn保持了90%以上的高精度和75%以上的召回率，显著优于现有的基于llm的方法。在进一步的评估中，SpecSyn成功地处理了1365个开源程序目标属性中的1071个，证明了它在实际程序验证任务中的适用性。
papers.ai_summary_en: SpecSyn addresses the difficulty of using LLMs to generate interprocedural formal specifications for real-world program verification, especially for large programs and for ensuring that generated specifications are semantically strong enough. The method decomposes programs into segments, iteratively generates specifications, and refines them using semantic-non-equivalent program mutations and variant discrimination to evaluate and strengthen specification semantics. Experiments show over 90% precision and over 75% recall, outperforming prior LLM-based approaches and successfully handling 1071 of 1365 verification properties in open-source programs.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对真实程序验证中 LLM 生成形式规范难以处理大型程序、且缺乏规范强度保证的问题，SpecSyn 提出程序分段后的迭代规范生成框架。其核心方法是引入基于语义非等价程序变异与变体判别的规范精化机制，以评估并增强生成规范的语义强度。实验表明，该方法精度超过 90%、召回超过 75%，并在开源程序的 1365 个验证属性中成功处理 1071 个，显著提升了真实程序验证的可用性。

papers.title: VLAA-GUI: Knowing When to Stop, Recover, and Search, A Modular Framework for GUI Automation
papers.authors: Qijun Han, Haoqin Tu, Zijun Wang, Haoyue Dai, Yiyang Zhou
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous GUI agents face two fundamental challenges: early stopping, where agents prematurely declare success without verifiable evidence, and repetitive loops, where agents cycle through the same failing actions without recovery. We present VLAA-GUI, a modular GUI agentic framework built around three integrated components that guide the system on when to Stop, Recover, and Search. First, a mandatory Completeness Verifier enforces UI-observable success criteria and verification at every finish step -- with an agent-level verifier that cross-examines completion claims with decision rules, rejecting those lacking direct visual evidence. Second, a mandatory Loop Breaker provides multi-tier filtering: switching interaction mode after repeated failures, forcing strategy changes after persistent screen-state recurrence, and binding reflection signals to strategy shifts. Third, an on-demand Search Agent searches online for unfamiliar workflows by directly querying a capable LLM with search ability, returning results as plain text. We additionally integrate a Coding Agent for code-intensive actions and a Grounding Agent for precise action grounding, both invoked on demand when required. We evaluate VLAA-GUI across five top-tier backbones, including Opus 4.5, 4.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, on two benchmarks with Linux and Windows tasks, achieving top performance on both (77.5% on OSWorld and 61.0% on WindowsAgentArena). Notably, three of the five backbones surpass human performance (72.4%) on OSWorld in a single pass. Ablation studies show that all three proposed components consistently improve a strong backbone, while a weaker backbone benefits more from these tools when the step budget is sufficient. Further analysis also shows that the Loop Breaker nearly halves wasted steps for loop-prone models.
papers.abstract_cn: 自主GUI代理面临两个基本挑战：提前停止，即代理在没有可验证证据的情况下过早地宣布成功；以及重复循环，即代理在没有恢复的情况下循环执行相同的失败操作。我们提出vala -GUI，这是一个模块化GUI代理框架，围绕三个集成组件构建，指导系统何时停止、恢复和搜索。首先，强制性的完整性验证器在每个完成步骤执行ui可观察到的成功标准和验证——使用代理级验证器通过决策规则交叉检查完成声明，拒绝那些缺乏直接视觉证据的声明。其次，强制Loop Breaker提供多层过滤：在重复故障后切换交互模式，在持续屏幕状态重复后强制策略更改，并将反射信号绑定到策略转换。第三，按需搜索代理通过直接查询具有搜索能力的LLM来在线搜索不熟悉的工作流，并以纯文本形式返回结果。我们还集成了一个编码代理（Coding Agent）用于代码密集型操作，一个接地代理（Grounding Agent）用于精确的操作接地，两者都是在需要时按需调用的。我们在Linux和Windows任务的两个基准上对五个顶级主干（包括Opus 4.5, 4.6和Gemini 3.1 Pro）的vla - gui进行了评估，在两个基准上都取得了最佳性能（OSWorld上77.5%，WindowsAgentArena上61.0%）。值得注意的是，在OSWorld上，5个主干中有3个单次通过就超过了人类的表现（72.4%）。消融研究表明，所有三种建议的组件都能持续改善强壮的骨干，而当步长预算足够时，较弱的骨干从这些工具中获益更多。进一步的分析还表明，对于容易产生循环的模型，Loop Breaker几乎将浪费的步骤减少了一半。
papers.ai_summary_en: VLAA-GUI tackles two failure modes in autonomous GUI agents—premature stopping without verifiable success evidence and repetitive action loops—by introducing a modular framework that decides when to stop, recover, and search. Its key mechanisms are a mandatory completeness verifier requiring UI-observable proof before termination, a multi-tier loop breaker that forces interaction-mode and strategy changes under repeated failure or state recurrence, and an on-demand search agent for unfamiliar workflows, supplemented by coding and grounding agents. The method achieves state-of-the-art results on OSWorld (77.5%) and WindowsAgentArena (61.0%), with three backbones surpassing human performance on OSWorld in a single pass, while ablations show consistent gains and nearly halve wasted steps for loop-prone models.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对GUI自动化智能体易过早宣称完成、以及陷入重复失败循环的问题，提出VLAA-GUI模块化框架，通过强制基于视觉证据的完成性验证、多层循环打断与策略恢复机制，以及按需在线搜索来约束智能体何时停止、恢复和求助。实验显示，该方法在OSWorld和WindowsAgentArena上分别取得77.5%和61.0%的领先成绩，且多个骨干模型在OSWorld单次执行中超过人类水平；消融研究进一步证明各组件均能稳定提升性能，其中循环打断器可将近乎一半的无效步骤削减掉。

papers.title: Latent Denoising Improves Visual Alignment in Large Multimodal Models
papers.authors: Dhruv Parikh, Jacob Fein-Ashley, Rajgopal Kannan, Viktor Prasanna
papers.abstract_en: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) such as LLaVA are typically trained with an autoregressive language modeling objective, providing only indirect supervision to visual tokens. This often yields weak internal visual representations and brittle behavior under distribution shift. Inspired by recent progress on latent denoising for learning high-quality visual tokenizers, we show that the same principle provides an effective form of visual supervision for improving internal visual feature alignment and multimodal understanding in LMMs. We propose a latent denoising framework that corrupts projected visual tokens using a saliency-aware mixture of masking and Gaussian noising. The LMM is trained to denoise these corrupted tokens by recovering clean teacher patch features from hidden states at a selected intermediate LLM layer using a decoder. To prevent representation collapse, our framework also preserves the teacher's intra-image similarity structure and applies intra-image contrastive patch distillation. During inference, corruption and auxiliary heads are disabled, introducing no additional inference-time overhead. Across a broad suite of standard multimodal benchmarks, our method consistently improves visual understanding and reasoning over strong baselines, and yields clear gains on compositional robustness benchmarks (e.g., NaturalBench). Moreover, under ImageNet-C-style non-adversarial common corruptions applied to benchmark images, our method maintains higher accuracy and exhibits reduced degradation at both moderate and severe corruption levels. Our code is available at https://github.com/dhruvashp/latent-denoising-for-lmms.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型多模态模型（Large Multimodal Models, lmm），如LLaVA，通常使用自回归语言建模目标进行训练，只提供对视觉标记的间接监督。这通常会产生较弱的内部视觉表现和分布移位下的脆性行为。受学习高质量视觉标记器的潜在去噪的最新进展的启发，我们表明相同的原理为提高lmm中的内部视觉特征对齐和多模态理解提供了一种有效的视觉监督形式。我们提出了一个潜在的去噪框架，该框架使用显著性感知的掩蔽和高斯噪声混合来破坏投影的视觉标记。通过使用解码器从选定的中间LLM层的隐藏状态中恢复干净的教师补丁特征，训练LMM对这些损坏的令牌进行降噪。为了防止表征崩溃，我们的框架还保留了教师的图像内相似性结构，并应用了图像内对比patch蒸馏。在推理期间，损坏和辅助头被禁用，不会带来额外的推理时间开销。在一套广泛的标准多模态基准测试中，我们的方法始终如一地提高了对强基线的视觉理解和推理，并在组合稳健性基准测试（例如，NaturalBench）上获得了明显的收益。此外，在应用于基准图像的imagenet - c风格的非对抗性常见损坏下，我们的方法保持了更高的准确性，并且在中度和严重损坏水平下都表现出更低的退化。我们的代码可在https://github.com/dhruvashp/latent-denoising-for-lmms上获得。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses weak visual supervision in autoregressively trained large multimodal models, which leads to poor internal visual representations and brittleness under distribution shift. It introduces an auxiliary latent denoising objective that corrupts projected visual tokens with saliency-aware masking and Gaussian noise, then trains the model to reconstruct clean teacher patch features from an intermediate LLM layer while preserving intra-image similarity via contrastive patch distillation; these components are disabled at inference. Experiments show consistent gains on multimodal benchmarks, improved compositional robustness such as on NaturalBench, and reduced degradation under ImageNet-C-style corruptions with no additional inference overhead.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对大型多模态模型仅依赖自回归语言目标导致视觉 token 监督不足、视觉表征弱和分布偏移脆弱的问题，论文提出在训练中对投影后的视觉 token 施加显著性感知的掩码与高斯噪声混合腐蚀，并从选定中间 LLM 层恢复教师 patch 特征，同时用图内相似性保持和对比蒸馏防止表征坍塌。该方法为 LMM 提供了更直接的视觉监督，可在不增加推理开销的情况下改善内部视觉特征对齐与多模态理解。实验表明，其在多模态基准、组合鲁棒性以及图像腐蚀扰动下均优于强基线，提升了模型稳健性与泛化能力。

papers.title: Strategic Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Architecture for Cost-Effective Code Vulnerability Detection
papers.authors: Zhaohui Geoffrey Wang
papers.abstract_en: Automated code vulnerability detection is critical for software security, yet existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off between detection accuracy and computational cost. We propose a heterogeneous multi-agent architecture inspired by game-theoretic principles, combining cloud-based LLM experts with a local lightweight verifier. Our "3+1" architecture deploys three cloud-based expert agents (DeepSeek-V3) that analyze code from complementary perspectives - code structure, security patterns, and debugging logic - in parallel, while a local verifier (Qwen3-8B) performs adversarial validation at zero marginal cost.   We formalize this design through a two-layer game framework: (1) a cooperative game among experts capturing super-additive value from diverse perspectives, and (2) an adversarial verification game modeling quality assurance incentives.   Experiments on 262 real samples from the NIST Juliet Test Suite across 14 CWE types, with balanced vulnerable and benign classes, demonstrate that our approach achieves a 77.2% F1 score with 62.9% precision and 100% recall at $0.002 per sample - outperforming both a single-expert LLM baseline (F1 71.4%) and Cppcheck static analysis (MCC 0). The adversarial verifier significantly improves precision (+10.3 percentage points, p < 1e-6, McNemar's test) by filtering false positives, while parallel execution achieves a 3.0x speedup.   Our work demonstrates that game-theoretic design principles can guide effective heterogeneous multi-agent architectures for cost-sensitive software engineering tasks.
papers.abstract_cn: 自动代码漏洞检测是软件安全的关键，但现有的方法面临着检测精度和计算成本之间的权衡。我们提出了一个受博弈论原理启发的异构多智能体架构，将基于云的LLM专家与本地轻量级验证器相结合。我们的“3+1”架构部署了三个基于云的专家代理（DeepSeek-V3），它们从互补的角度（代码结构、安全模式和调试逻辑）并行分析代码，而本地验证器（Qwen3-8B）以零边际成本执行对抗性验证。我们通过一个两层博弈框架形式化了这个设计：(1)专家之间的合作博弈，从不同的角度获取超附加价值；(2)一个对抗性验证博弈，为质量保证激励建模。对NIST Juliet Test Suite中14种CWE类型的262个真实样本进行的实验表明，我们的方法在每个样本0.002美元的情况下实现了77.2%的F1得分，62.9%的精度和100%的召回率，优于单专家LLM基线（F1 71.4%）和Cppcheck静态分析（MCC 0）。对抗性验证器通过过滤假阳性显著提高了精度（+10.3个百分点，p < 1e-6， McNemar测试），而并行执行实现了3.0倍的加速。我们的工作表明，博弈论设计原则可以指导有效的异构多智能体架构用于成本敏感的软件工程任务。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the accuracy–cost trade-off in automated code vulnerability detection by designing a heterogeneous multi-agent system that combines expensive cloud LLM experts with a cheap local verifier. Its key method is a game-theoretic “3+1” architecture in which three parallel DeepSeek-V3 expert agents analyze code from structure, security-pattern, and debugging perspectives, while a local Qwen3-8B verifier performs adversarial validation to filter false positives at zero marginal cost. Experiments on 262 NIST Juliet samples across 14 CWE types show 77.2% F1, 100% recall, and 62.9% precision at $0.002 per sample, outperforming a single-expert LLM baseline and Cppcheck while improving precision significantly and achieving 3.0× parallel speedup.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对代码漏洞检测中准确性与计算成本的权衡问题，提出一种受博弈论启发的异构多智能体架构，由三个云端大模型专家从结构、安全模式和调试逻辑并行分析，并用本地轻量模型进行零边际成本的对抗式验证。其核心洞见是通过合作博弈整合多视角专家价值、通过对抗验证博弈过滤误报，从而在低成本下提升检测可靠性。实验在 NIST Juliet 样本上取得 77.2% F1、100% 召回和每样本 0.002 美元成本，显著优于单专家 LLM 与 Cppcheck，并实现 3 倍加速。

papers.title: Do LLM Decoders Listen Fairly? Benchmarking How Language Model Priors Shape Bias in Speech Recognition
papers.authors: Srishti Ginjala, Eric Fosler-Lussier, Christopher W. Myers, Srinivasan Parthasarathy
papers.abstract_en: As pretrained large language models replace task-specific decoders in speech recognition, a critical question arises: do their text-derived priors make recognition fairer or more biased across demographic groups? We evaluate nine models spanning three architectural generations (CTC with no language model, encoder-decoder with an implicit LM, and LLM-based with an explicit pretrained decoder) on about 43,000 utterances across five demographic axes (ethnicity, accent, gender, age, first language) using Common Voice 24 and Meta's Fair-Speech, a controlled-prompt dataset that eliminates vocabulary confounds. On clean audio, three findings challenge assumptions: LLM decoders do not amplify racial bias (Granite-8B has the best ethnicity fairness, max/min WER = 2.28); Whisper exhibits pathological hallucination on Indian-accented speech with a non-monotonic insertion-rate spike to 9.62% at large-v3; and audio compression predicts accent fairness more than LLM scale. We then stress-test these findings under 12 acoustic degradation conditions (noise, reverberation, silence injection, chunk masking) across both datasets, totaling 216 inference runs. Severe degradation paradoxically compresses fairness gaps as all groups converge to high WER, but silence injection amplifies Whisper's accent bias up to 4.64x by triggering demographic-selective hallucination. Under masking, Whisper enters catastrophic repetition loops (86% of 51,797 insertions) while explicit-LLM decoders produce 38x fewer insertions with near-zero repetition; high-compression audio encoding (Q-former) reintroduces repetition pathology even in LLM decoders. These results suggest that audio encoder design, not LLM scaling, is the primary lever for equitable and robust speech recognition.
papers.abstract_cn: 随着预训练的大型语言模型取代语音识别中的特定任务解码器，一个关键问题出现了：它们的文本派生先验是否使识别在人口群体中更公平或更有偏见？我们使用Common Voice 24和Meta的Fair-Speech（一个消除词汇混淆的控制提示数据集）评估了跨越三代架构的9个模型（没有语言模型的CTC，带有隐式LM的编码器-解码器和基于llm的显式预训练解码器），涉及5个人口统计轴（种族、口音、性别、年龄、第一语言）的约43,000个话语。在干净的音频上，三个发现挑战了假设：LLM解码器不会放大种族偏见（花岗岩- 8b具有最佳的种族公平性，最大/分钟WER = 2.28）；耳语对印度口音的语音表现出病理性幻觉，非单调插入率高达9.62%；音频压缩比LLM音阶更能预测重音公平性。然后，我们在两个数据集的12种声学退化条件下（噪声、混响、沉默注入、块屏蔽）对这些发现进行了压力测试，总共216次推理运行。严重的退化矛盾地压缩了公平差距，因为所有群体都趋同于高WER，但沉默注射通过触发人口选择性幻觉，将Whisper的口音偏见放大至4.64倍。在屏蔽下，Whisper进入灾难性重复循环（51,797个插入的86%），而显式llm解码器产生的插入减少了38倍，重复接近于零；高压缩音频编码（Q-former）即使在LLM解码器中也会重新引入重复病理。这些结果表明，音频编码器的设计，而不是LLM缩放，是公平和稳健的语音识别的主要杠杆。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper investigates whether replacing task-specific ASR decoders with pretrained LLM decoders improves or worsens demographic fairness in speech recognition. It benchmarks nine models across CTC, implicit-LM encoder–decoder, and explicit-LLM architectures on ~43,000 utterances spanning five demographic axes, plus 12 acoustic degradation conditions to isolate language-prior and audio-encoding effects. The study finds that LLM decoders do not inherently amplify racial bias and often reduce insertion/repetition pathologies, while audio encoder design and compression—not LLM scale—primarily determine accent fairness and robustness, with Whisper showing severe accent-selective hallucination under silence and masking.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对“LLM解码器用于语音识别时，文本先验是否会加剧人口统计偏差”的问题，评测了CTC、隐式语言模型编码-解码和显式LLM解码三代架构，并在Common Voice、Fair-Speech及12种声学退化条件下进行公平性基准测试。结果表明，LLM解码器并未普遍放大种族偏差，且显式LLM在插入和重复错误上更稳健，但Whisper在印度口音、静音注入和掩码条件下会出现选择性幻觉与重复循环；音频压缩/编码器设计比LLM规模更能预测口音公平和鲁棒性。该研究指出，实现更公平鲁棒的语音识别系统，关键杠杆在于音频编码器与前端/服务链路设计，而非单纯扩大语言模型。

papers.title: Huff-LLM: End-to-End Lossless Compression for Efficient LLM Inference
papers.authors: Patrick Yubeaton, Tareq Mahmoud, S. Naga, Pooria Taheri, Tianhua Xia
papers.abstract_en: As they become more capable, large language models (LLMs) have continued to rapidly increase in size. This has exacerbated the difficulty in running state of the art LLMs on small, edge devices. Standard techniques advocate solving this problem through lossy compression techniques such as quantization or pruning. However, such compression techniques are lossy, and have been shown to change model behavior in unpredictable manners. We propose Huff-LLM, an \emph{end-to-end, lossless} model compression method that lets users store LLM weights in compressed format \emph{everywhere} -- cloud, disk, main memory, and even in on-chip memory/buffers. This allows us to not only load larger models in main memory, but also reduces bandwidth required to load weights on chip, and makes more efficient use of on-chip weight buffers. In addition to the memory savings achieved via compression, we also show latency and energy efficiency improvements when performing inference with the compressed model.
papers.abstract_cn: 随着它们能力的提升，大型语言模型（LLM）的规模也在持续快速增长。这加剧了在小型边缘设备上运行最先进的大型语言模型的难度。标准技术主张通过有损压缩技术（如量化或剪枝）来解决这个问题。然而，这些压缩技术具有损耗性，且已被证明会以不可预测的方式改变模型行为。我们提出了 Huff-LLM，这是一种端到端无损的模型压缩方法，允许用户以压缩格式 \emph{everywhere} 存储LLM权重——云端、磁盘、主存，甚至片上内存/缓冲区。这不仅使我们能够在主存中加载更大的模型，还减少了芯片上权重加载所需的带宽，并更高效地利用了片上权重缓冲区。除了通过压缩节省内存外，我们还展示了在使用压缩模型进行推断时，延迟和能效的提升。
papers.ai_summary_en: Huff-LLM tackles the difficulty of deploying large LLMs on resource-constrained devices, where lossy compression methods such as quantization can unpredictably alter model behavior. It proposes an end-to-end lossless weight compression framework that keeps model weights compressed across cloud, disk, main memory, and on-chip buffers, reducing memory footprint and weight-transfer bandwidth.
