The method preserves exact model behavior while improving inference latency and energy efficiency through more efficient memory usage and on-chip weight handling.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大语言模型规模过大、传统量化/剪枝等有损压缩会不可预测改变模型行为的问题，提出面向推理的端到端无损权重压缩方法 Huff-LLM。其核心思路是让模型权重在云、磁盘、主存乃至片上缓冲中始终以压缩格式存储和搬运，从而在不损失精度的情况下减少内存占用与权重加载带宽。实验表明，该方法不仅支持在有限内存中部署更大模型，还能带来推理延迟和能效上的提升。

papers.title: Coruscant: Co-Designing GPU Kernel and Sparse Tensor Core to Advocate Unstructured Sparsity in Efficient LLM Inference
papers.authors: Donghyeon Joo, Helya Hosseini, Ramyad Hadidi, Bahar Asgari
papers.abstract_en: In the era of large language models (LLMs) and long-context generation, model compression techniques such as pruning, quantization, and distillation offer effective ways to reduce memory usage. Among them, pruning is constrained by the difficulty of exploiting unstructured sparsity on modern hardware. Consequently, LLM pruning is often restricted to structured patterns for hardware efficiency, although unstructured sparsity offers better accuracy retention at higher sparsity. To bridge this gap between the full potential of pruning and efficiency, we propose the Coruscant GPU SpMM kernel that leverages a bitmap-based sparse format for reduced memory footprint inside GPU memory and reduced latency of memory-bound matrix multiplications in LLM inference. This is achieved by transferring the compressed matrix tiles to GPU processors and decompressing them locally for tensor core execution. We see further optimization opportunity in microarchitecture-level and propose Coruscant Sparse Tensor Core, which computes directly on the compressed format without decompression by integrating a bitmap decoder. Coruscant kernel achieves up to 2 × speedup over cuBLAS and 1.48 × over Flash-LLM. With Coruscant Sparse Tensor Core, the speedup reaches 2.75 × over cuBLAS. Most importantly, Coruscant serves as an ideal solution for state-of-the-art LLM pruning methods by significantly reducing the memory footprint and accelerating SpMM on sparsity range 30% to 70%, enabling exploration of diverse sparsity patterns and pruning strategies.
papers.abstract_cn: 在大型语言模型（llm）和长上下文生成的时代，模型压缩技术（如剪枝、量化和蒸馏）提供了减少内存使用的有效方法。其中，修剪受到现代硬件上难以利用非结构化稀疏性的限制。因此，为了提高硬件效率，LLM修剪通常仅限于结构化模式，尽管非结构化稀疏性在更高的稀疏性下提供了更好的准确性保持。为了弥合修剪的全部潜力和效率之间的差距，我们提出了corusant GPU SpMM内核，该内核利用基于位图的稀疏格式来减少GPU内存中的内存占用，并减少LLM推理中内存绑定矩阵乘法的延迟。这是通过将压缩的矩阵块传输到GPU处理器并在本地解压缩它们以执行张量核心来实现的。我们在微架构层面看到了进一步的优化机会，并提出了coruscan稀疏张量核心，它直接在压缩格式上进行计算，而不需要通过集成位图解码器进行解压缩。coruscan内核在cuBLAS上实现了高达2倍的加速，在Flash-LLM上实现了1.48倍的加速。使用科洛桑稀疏张量核，速度比cuBLAS提高了2.75倍。最重要的是，Coruscant是最先进的LLM修剪方法的理想解决方案，它显著减少了内存占用，并将SpMM在稀疏度范围内的速度提高了30%到70%，从而可以探索各种稀疏度模式和修剪策略。
papers.ai_summary_en: Coruscant addresses the hardware inefficiency of exploiting unstructured sparsity in pruned LLM inference, where conventional GPU kernels and tensor cores favor dense or structured formats. It proposes a bitmap-based GPU SpMM kernel that transfers compressed matrix tiles and decompresses them locally for tensor-core execution, alongside a co-designed sparse tensor core that computes directly on the compressed bitmap format via an integrated decoder. The approach achieves up to 2× speedup over cuBLAS and 1.48× over Flash-LLM for the kernel, and 2.75× over cuBLAS with the microarchitectural extension, reducing memory footprint and accelerating sparse matrix multiplication at 30–70% sparsity.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理中非结构化稀疏剪枝难以在现代GPU上高效利用的问题，提出Coruscant，通过GPU SpMM内核与稀疏Tensor Core协同设计来释放非结构化稀疏的精度与压缩潜力。其核心方法是采用位图稀疏格式压缩矩阵 tile，并在GPU本地解压供Tensor Core计算，进一步提出可直接在压缩格式上计算的稀疏Tensor Core以避免解压开销。实验显示，该内核相较cuBLAS和Flash-LLM分别最高加速2×和1.48×，配合稀疏Tensor Core可达2.75×，在30%–70%稀疏度下显著降低显存占用并提升稀疏矩阵乘效率。

papers.title: AccLLM: Accelerating Long-Context LLM Inference Via Algorithm-Hardware Co-Design
papers.authors: Yanbiao Liang, Huihong Shi, Haikuo Shao, Zhongfeng Wang
papers.abstract_en: Recently, large language models (LLMs) have achieved huge success in the natural language processing (NLP) field, driving a growing demand to extend their deployment from the cloud to edge devices. However, deploying LLMs on resource-constrained edge devices poses significant challenges, including (1) intensive computations and huge model sizes, (2) great memory and bandwidth demands introduced by the autoregressive generation process, and (3) limited scalability for handling long sequences. To address these challenges, we propose AccLLM, a comprehensive acceleration framework that enables efficient and fast long-context LLM inference through algorithm and hardware co-design. At the algorithmic level, we integrate (1) pruning, (2) {\Lambda}-shaped attention, and (3) an innovative W2A8KV4 (2-bit weights, 8-bit activations, and 4-bit KV cache) quantization scheme, thus effectively reducing memory and bandwidth requirements while facilitating LLMs' long-sequence generation. At the hardware level, we design a dedicated FPGA-based accelerator with a reconfigurable computing engine to effectively and flexibly accommodate diverse operations arising from our compression algorithm, thereby fully translating the algorithmic innovations into tangible hardware efficiency. We validate AccLLM on the Xilinx Alveo U280 FPGA, demonstrating a 4.07x energy efficiency and a 2.98x throughput compared to the state-of-the-art work FlightLLM.
papers.abstract_cn: 最近，大型语言模型（llm）在自然语言处理（NLP）领域取得了巨大成功，推动了将其部署从云扩展到边缘设备的需求不断增长。然而，在资源受限的边缘设备上部署llm面临着重大挑战，包括：(1)密集的计算和巨大的模型尺寸，(2)自回归生成过程引入的巨大内存和带宽需求，以及(3)处理长序列的可扩展性有限。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了AccLLM，这是一个全面的加速框架，通过算法和硬件协同设计实现高效快速的长上下文LLM推理。在算法层面，我们整合了(1)剪枝，(2){\Lambda}形注意力，以及(3)创新的W2A8KV4（2位权重，8位激活和4位KV缓存）量化方案，从而有效降低了内存和带宽需求，同时促进了llm的长序列生成。在硬件层面，我们设计了一个专用的基于fpga的加速器和一个可重构的计算引擎，以有效和灵活地适应我们的压缩算法产生的各种操作，从而充分将算法创新转化为有形的硬件效率。我们在Xilinx Alveo U280 FPGA上验证了AccLLM，与最先进的FlightLLM相比，其能效为4.07倍，吞吐量为2.98倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: AccLLM addresses the memory, bandwidth, and compute bottlenecks of long-context LLM inference on resource-constrained edge devices, especially the cost of autoregressive KV-cache storage and attention. It proposes an algorithm–hardware co-design combining pruning, Λ-shaped attention, and W2A8KV4 quantization (2-bit weights, 8-bit activations, 4-bit KV cache) with a reconfigurable FPGA accelerator tailored to these compressed operations. On a Xilinx Alveo U280 FPGA, AccLLM achieves 4.07× higher energy efficiency and 2.98× higher throughput than FlightLLM.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘设备上长上下文 LLM 推理面临的计算密集、KV Cache 内存与带宽压力大、长序列扩展受限等问题，提出算法-硬件协同加速框架 AccLLM。其核心方法是结合剪枝、Λ 形注意力和 W2A8KV4 量化（2-bit 权重、8-bit 激活、4-bit KV cache），并设计可重构 FPGA 加速器以高效支持这些压缩操作。实验在 Xilinx Alveo U280 上表明，相比 FlightLLM，AccLLM 能效提升 4.07 倍、吞吐提升 2.98 倍。

papers.title: KVO-LLM: Boosting Long-Context Generation Throughput for Batched LLM Inference
papers.authors: Zhenyu Li, Dongxu Lyu, Gang Wang, Yuzhou Chen, Liyan Chen
papers.abstract_en: With the widespread deployment of long-context large language models (LLMs), efficient and high-quality generation is becoming increasingly important. Modern LLMs employ batching and key-value (KV) cache to improve generation throughput and quality. However, as the context length and batch size rise drastically, the KV cache incurs extreme external memory access (EMA) issues. Recent LLM accelerators face substantial processing element (PE) under-utilization due to the low arithmetic intensity of attention with KV cache, while existing KV cache compression algorithms struggle with hardware inefficiency or significant accuracy degradation. To address these issues, an algorithm-architecture co-optimization, KVO-LLM, is proposed for long-context batched LLM generation. At the algorithm level, we propose a KV cache quantization-aware pruning method that first adopts salient-token-aware quantization and then prunes KV channels and tokens by attention guided pruning based on salient tokens identified during quantization. Achieving substantial savings on hardware overhead, our algorithm reduces the EMA of KV cache over 91% with significant accuracy advantages compared to previous KV cache compression algorithms. At the architecture level, we propose a multi-core jointly optimized accelerator that adopts operator fusion and cross-batch interleaving strategy, maximizing PE and DRAM bandwidth utilization. Compared to the state-of-the-art LLM accelerators, KVO-LLM improves generation throughput by up to $7.32 \times$, and attains $5.52 \sim 8.38 \times$ better energy efficiency.
papers.abstract_cn: 随着长上下文大型语言模型（llm）的广泛应用，高效、高质量的生成变得越来越重要。现代llm采用批处理和键值（KV）缓存来提高生成吞吐量和质量。然而，随着上下文长度和批处理大小的急剧增加，KV缓存会导致极端的外部内存访问（EMA）问题。由于KV缓存的算法关注强度较低，最近的LLM加速器面临大量处理元素（PE）利用率不足的问题，而现有的KV缓存压缩算法则面临硬件效率低下或精度显著下降的问题。为了解决这些问题，提出了一种算法架构协同优化，KVO-LLM，用于长上下文批量LLM生成。在算法层面，我们提出了一种KV缓存量化感知剪枝方法，该方法首先采用显著令牌感知量化，然后基于量化过程中识别的显著令牌，通过注意引导剪枝对KV通道和令牌进行剪枝。与以前的KV缓存压缩算法相比，我们的算法大大节省了硬件开销，将KV缓存的EMA降低了91%以上，具有显著的精度优势。在架构层面，我们提出了一种多核联合优化加速器，采用算子融合和跨批交错策略，最大限度地提高PE和DRAM带宽利用率。与最先进的LLM加速器相比，KVO-LLM将发电吞吐量提高了7.32倍，能源效率提高了5.52倍至8.38倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: KVO-LLM tackles the external-memory-access bottleneck and processing-element underutilization in long-context, batched LLM generation caused by large KV caches. It proposes an algorithm–architecture co-design: salient-token-aware KV quantization followed by attention-guided KV channel/token pruning, paired with a multi-core accelerator using operator fusion and cross-batch interleaving. The method reduces KV-cache EMA by over 91% with strong accuracy, achieving up to 7.32× higher generation throughput and 5.52–8.38× better energy efficiency than state-of-the-art accelerators.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对长上下文、大批量LLM生成中KV缓存外部访存过高、注意力算术强度低导致加速器利用率不足的问题，论文提出算法-架构协同优化框架KVO-LLM。其核心是先进行显著token感知量化，再基于量化阶段识别的显著token做注意力引导的KV通道/令牌剪枝，并配合算子融合与跨批交错的加速器设计。实验表明KV缓存外部访存减少超过91%，且相较先进加速器实现最高7.32倍吞吐提升和5.52～8.38倍能效提升。

papers.title: BTC-LLM: Efficient Sub-1-Bit LLM Quantization via Learnable Transformation and Binary Codebook
papers.authors: Hao Gu, Lujun Li, Zheyu Wang, Beisong Liu, Qiyuan Zhu
papers.abstract_en: Binary quantization represents the most extreme form of compression, reducing weights to +/-1 for maximal memory and computational efficiency. While recent sparsity-aware binarization achieves sub-1-bit compression via weight pruning, it faces critical challenges: performance degradation, mask-management overhead, and limited hardware compatibility. In this paper, we present BTC-LLM, a novel sub-1-bit LLM quantization framework that leverages binary pattern clustering and weight transformation to overcome these limitations. Our approach incorporates two key innovations: (1) a Binary Codebook that clusters recurring vectors into compact indices using custom distance metrics and sign-based updates; (2) a Learnable Transformation that reduces outliers and promotes shared sign patterns among binary weights. This eliminates sparse masks, enabling efficient inference on standard hardware. Extensive evaluations across LLaMA, Qwen, and FBI-LLM families demonstrate that BTC-LLM achieves state-of-the-art results in extreme compression (1.11-0.7 bits). Notably, BTC-LLM compressed to 0.8 bits on LLaMA-2-13B maintains high performance, with only a 3.1 percent accuracy drop in zero-shot benchmarks, while delivering a 1.6x speedup over FP16.
papers.abstract_cn: 二进制量化代表了最极端的压缩形式，将权重降低到+/-1以获得最大的内存和计算效率。虽然最近的稀疏感知二值化通过权值修剪实现了亚1位压缩，但它面临着关键的挑战：性能下降、掩码管理开销和有限的硬件兼容性。在本文中，我们提出了BTC-LLM，一种新颖的亚1位LLM量化框架，利用二进制模式聚类和权重变换来克服这些限制。我们的方法包含两个关键创新：(1)使用自定义距离度量和基于符号的更新将重复出现的向量聚类成紧凑索引的二进制码本；(2)一种减少异常值并促进二元权值之间共享符号模式的可学习变换。这消除了稀疏掩码，在标准硬件上实现了高效的推理。对LLaMA、Qwen和FBI-LLM系列的广泛评估表明，BTC-LLM在极端压缩（1.11-0.7比特）方面取得了最先进的结果。值得注意的是，在LLaMA-2-13B上压缩到0.8位的BTC-LLM保持了高性能，在零射击基准测试中精度仅下降3.1%，同时比FP16提供1.6倍的加速。
papers.ai_summary_en: BTC-LLM tackles sub-1-bit LLM quantization, avoiding the accuracy loss, mask overhead, and hardware inefficiency of sparsity-aware binarization. It combines a binary codebook that compresses recurring weight vectors into compact indices with a learnable transformation that suppresses outliers and encourages shared sign patterns, enabling mask-free binary inference on standard hardware. Across LLaMA, Qwen, and FBI-LLM, it achieves state-of-the-art performance at 1.11–0.7 bits, e.g., LLaMA-2-13B at 0.8 bits with only a 3.1% zero-shot accuracy drop and 1.6× FP16 speedup.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型极端二值/亚1比特量化中稀疏掩码开销大、性能下降和硬件不友好的问题，提出BTC-LLM框架。其核心是通过可学习权重变换抑制离群值并促进共享符号模式，同时用二进制码本对重复二值向量进行聚类索引，从而免掩码地在标准硬件上高效推理。实验表明，该方法在0.7–1.11比特极端压缩下取得SOTA，LLaMA-2-13B在0.8比特时零样本精度仅降3.1%，并较FP16提速1.6倍。

papers.title: FPGA Co-Design for Efficient N:M Sparse and Quantized Model Inference
papers.authors: F. Hsieh, Yun-Chang Teng, Ding-Yong Hong, Jan-Jan Wu
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across a wide range of language processing tasks. However, this success comes at the cost of substantial computation and memory requirements, which significantly impedes their deployment in resource-constrained environments. To address this challenge, this work introduces an automation framework that leverages weight pruning and low-bit quantization, and presents a hardware-software co-design method that generates accelerators on the Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) platform. In particular, we implement a unified pipeline that applies N:M structured pruning and 4-bit integer quantization to reduce the memory footprint, followed by optimized dequantization and matrix multiplication to enhance LLM inference on several hardware platforms, including CPUs, NVIDIA GPUs with Dense and 2:4 Sparse Tensor Cores, and a custom systolic-array-based FPGA accelerator. Utilizing 2:4 sparsity combined with quantization on $4096 \times 4096$ matrices, our approach achieves a reduction of up to $4\times$ in weight storage and a $1.71\times$ speedup in matrix multiplication, yielding a $1.29\times$ end-to-end latency reduction compared to dense GPU baselines. Scaling analysis on the LLaMA-7B model further shows that structured sparsity enhances the throughput per token by $1.36\times$. These results demonstrate the synergy of fine-grained N:M sparsity and quantization for enabling efficient and deployable LLM inference, while the proposed FPGA accelerator offers a flexible architectural path for supporting a broader class of sparsity patterns beyond the fixed 2:4 hardware constraints.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）在广泛的语言处理任务中表现出了卓越的性能。然而，这种成功是以大量的计算和内存需求为代价的，这极大地阻碍了它们在资源受限环境中的部署。为了应对这一挑战，本工作引入了一个利用权值修剪和低比特量化的自动化框架，并提出了一种在现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）平台上生成加速器的软硬件协同设计方法。特别是，我们实现了一个统一的管道，应用N:M结构化修剪和4位整数量化来减少内存占用，然后优化去量化和矩阵乘法来增强几种硬件平台上的LLM推理，包括cpu，具有密集和2:4稀疏张量核的NVIDIA gpu，以及定制的基于收缩阵列的FPGA加速器。利用2:4的稀疏性结合4096 \times 4096$矩阵的量化，我们的方法在重量存储上减少了4\times$，在矩阵乘法上加速了1.71\times$，与密集的GPU基线相比，端到端延迟减少了1.29\times$。LLaMA-7B模型的扩展分析进一步表明，结构化稀疏性使每个令牌的吞吐量提高了1.36倍。这些结果证明了细粒度N:M稀疏性和量化的协同作用，可以实现高效和可部署的LLM推理，而所提议的FPGA加速器提供了一种灵活的体系结构路径，可以支持更广泛的稀疏性模式，而不是固定的2:4硬件约束。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the high memory and compute cost of LLM inference by combining N:M structured pruning with 4-bit integer quantization in an automated hardware–software co-design framework for CPUs, GPUs, and FPGAs. Its key contribution is a unified inference pipeline and custom systolic-array FPGA accelerator that optimizes dequantization and sparse matrix multiplication while supporting flexible sparsity patterns beyond fixed 2:4 GPU constraints. Experiments on 4096×4096 matrices and LLaMA-7B show up to 4× weight storage reduction, 1.71× matrix-multiplication speedup, 1.29× end-to-end latency reduction versus dense GPU baselines, and 1.36× throughput-per-token improvement.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大语言模型在资源受限场景中计算与内存开销过大的问题，提出一种软硬件协同的自动化推理框架，将 N:M 结构化剪枝（如 2:4 稀疏）与 4-bit 整数量化结合，并在 CPU、GPU 及自定义 FPGA 脉动阵列加速器上优化反量化和矩阵乘法。实验表明，该方法可将权重存储最多降低 4 倍，矩阵乘法加速 1.71 倍，端到端延迟相对稠密 GPU 降低 1.29 倍，并在 LLaMA-7B 上带来 1.36 倍的每 token 吞吐提升。其意义在于验证了细粒度稀疏与低比特量化的协同收益，同时 FPGA 加速器为支持超越固定 2:4 限制的更多稀疏模式提供了灵活硬件路径。

papers.title: Energy-Efficient Cloud Infrastructure Design For Large Language Model Training And Inference
papers.authors: G. Kathiresan
papers.abstract_en: The rapidly increasing development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has rapidly placed a tremendous burden on cloud computing in terms of energy requirements, cost of operation, and environmental impacts, never seen before. This paper presents an overall architectural design that focuses on making energy efficient all the levels of LLM training and inference workloads. With a multi-prong approach, the design will take advantage of energy efficient accelerators (e.g., NVIDIA H100, TPUs), new cooling solutions (liquid and direct-to-chip), as well as software-level optimizations such as quantization and pruning and knowledge distillation.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展在能源需求、运营成本和环境影响方面给云计算带来了前所未有的巨大负担。本文提出了一种总体架构设计，旨在使LLM训练和推理工作负载的各个层面都实现能源高效。通过多管齐下的方法，该设计将利用高效能源加速器（如NVIDIA H100、TPU）、新的冷却解决方案（液冷和直连芯片冷却），以及软件层面的优化方法，如量化、剪枝和知识蒸馏。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the high energy consumption, operational cost, and environmental impact of cloud infrastructure for LLM training and inference. It proposes a multi-level architecture combining energy-efficient accelerators, advanced liquid/direct-to-chip cooling, and software optimizations such as quantization, pruning, and knowledge distillation. The main contribution is an integrated design framework for reducing cloud-scale LLM energy overhead while preserving model performance, though the abstract does not report quantitative results.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大语言模型训练与推理带来的高能耗、高成本和环境影响问题，提出一种面向云基础设施的跨层能效优化架构。其核心方法是同时结合高效加速器、液冷等新型散热方案，以及量化、剪枝和知识蒸馏等软件层模型压缩优化。该设计旨在降低 LLM 工作负载的能耗与运营开销，并提升大规模模型训练和推理的可持续性。

papers.title: An LLM-Guided Query-Aware Inference System for GNN Models on Large Knowledge Graphs
papers.authors: Waleed Afandi, Hussein Abdallah, Ashraf Aboulnaga, Essam Mansour
papers.abstract_en: Efficient inference for graph neural networks (GNNs) on large knowledge graphs (KGs) is essential for many real-world applications. GNN inference queries are computationally expensive and vary in complexity, as each involves a different number of target nodes linked to subgraphs of diverse densities and structures. Existing acceleration methods, such as pruning, quantization, and knowledge distillation, instantiate smaller models but do not adapt them to the structure or semantics of individual queries. They also store models as monolithic files that must be fully loaded, and miss the opportunity to retrieve only the neighboring nodes and corresponding model components that are semantically relevant to the target nodes. These limitations lead to excessive data loading and redundant computation on large KGs. This paper presents KG-WISE, a task-driven inference paradigm for large KGs. KG-WISE decomposes trained GNN models into fine-grained components that can be partially loaded based on the structure of the queried subgraph. It employs large language models (LLMs) to generate reusable query templates that extract semantically relevant subgraphs for each task, enabling query-aware and compact model instantiation. We evaluate KG-WISE on six large KGs with up to 42 million nodes and 166 million edges. KG-WISE achieves up to 28x faster inference and 98% lower memory usage than state-of-the-art systems while maintaining or improving accuracy across both commercial and open-weight LLMs.
papers.abstract_cn: 图神经网络（gnn）在大型知识图（KGs）上的高效推理对于许多实际应用至关重要。GNN推理查询的计算成本很高，复杂度也各不相同，因为每个查询都涉及到不同数量的目标节点，这些节点连接到不同密度和结构的子图。现有的加速方法，如剪枝、量化和知识蒸馏，实例化较小的模型，但不能使它们适应单个查询的结构或语义。它们还将模型存储为必须完全加载的整体文件，并且错过了仅检索与目标节点在语义上相关的相邻节点和相应的模型组件的机会。本文提出了一种用于大型kg的任务驱动推理范式KG-WISE，它将训练好的GNN模型分解成细粒度的组件，这些组件可以根据查询子图的结构部分加载。它使用大型语言模型（llm）生成可重用的查询模板，为每个任务提取语义相关的子图，支持查询感知和紧凑的模型实例化。我们在6个拥有4200万个节点和1.66亿个边的大型kg上评估KG-WISE。与最先进的系统相比，KG-WISE的推理速度提高了28倍，内存使用量降低了98%，同时保持或提高了商业和开放重量llm的准确性。
papers.ai_summary_en: KG-WISE addresses inefficient GNN inference on large knowledge graphs, where fixed compressed models and monolithic model loading cause excessive I/O and redundant computation for structurally diverse queries. It decomposes trained GNNs into fine-grained components that are partially loaded per queried subgraph and uses LLM-generated reusable query templates to retrieve semantically relevant neighborhoods and instantiate compact, query-aware models. On six large KGs with up to 42M nodes and 166M edges, it achieves up to 28× faster inference and 98% lower memory usage than state-of-the-art systems while maintaining or improving accuracy.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对大型知识图谱上GNN推理查询复杂、现有压缩方法缺乏查询自适应且需整体加载模型导致冗余计算与内存开销的问题，KG-WISE将训练好的GNN模型分解为可按查询子图结构部分加载的细粒度组件，并利用LLM生成可复用查询模板以抽取语义相关子图，实现查询感知的紧凑模型实例化。在最大含4200万节点和1.66亿边的六个知识图谱上，该系统最高实现28倍推理加速和98%内存节省，同时保持或提升准确率。

papers.title: Preserving LLM Capabilities through Calibration Data Curation: From Analysis to Optimization
papers.authors: Bowei He, Lihao Yin, Huiling Zhen, Shuqi Liu, Han Wu
papers.abstract_en: Post-training compression has been a widely employed approach to scale down large language model (LLM) and facilitate efficient inference. In various proposed compression methods, including pruning and quantization, calibration data plays a vital role by informing the weight importance and activation dynamic ranges. However, how calibration data impacts the LLM capability after compression is less explored. Few of the existing works, though recognizing the significance of this study, only investigate the language modeling or commonsense reasoning performance degradation from limited angles, like the data sources or sample amounts. More systematic research is still needed to examine the impacts on different LLM capabilities in terms of compositional properties and domain correspondence of calibration data. In this work, we aim at bridging this gap and further analyze underlying influencing mechanisms from the activation pattern perspective. Especially, we explore the calibration data's impacts on high-level complex reasoning capabilities, like math problem solving and code generation. Delving into the underlying mechanism, we find that the representativeness and diversity in activation space more fundamentally determine the quality of calibration data. Finally, we propose a calibration data curation framework based on such observations and analysis, enhancing the performance of existing post-training compression methods on preserving critical LLM capabilities. Our code is provided in \href{https://github.com/BokwaiHo/COLA.git}{Link}.
papers.abstract_cn: 训练后压缩已被广泛应用于大型语言模型（LLM）的缩减和高效推理。在各种已提出的压缩方法中，包括剪枝和量化，校准数据通过告知权值重要度和激活动态范围起着至关重要的作用。然而，校准数据如何影响压缩后的LLM能力的探索较少。虽然认识到本研究的重要性，但很少有现有的作品只从有限的角度（如数据源或样本量）研究语言建模或常识推理性能的下降。在标定数据的组成特性和域对应性方面，对不同LLM能力的影响还需要更系统的研究。在这项工作中，我们旨在弥合这一差距，并从激活模式的角度进一步分析潜在的影响机制。特别是，我们探讨了校准数据对高级复杂推理能力的影响，如数学问题解决和代码生成。深入研究其机理，发现激活空间的代表性和多样性更根本地决定了标定数据的质量。最后，我们提出了一个基于这些观察和分析的校准数据管理框架，增强了现有训练后压缩方法在保留关键LLM能力方面的性能。我们的代码在\href{https://github.com/BokwaiHo/COLA.git}{Link}中提供。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the underexplored problem of how calibration data selection affects preservation of LLM capabilities—especially math reasoning and code generation—after post-training compression such as quantization and pruning. Through activation-pattern analysis, it shows that calibration quality is governed less by superficial source or domain matching than by representativeness and diversity in activation space, and proposes a curation framework (COLA) to select calibration sets accordingly. This activation-aware curation improves existing compression methods’ ability to retain critical high-level reasoning performance.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对后训练压缩（如量化、剪枝）中校准数据如何影响大模型压缩后能力的问题，系统分析其对数学推理和代码生成等复杂能力的影响。作者从激活模式角度发现，校准数据在激活空间中的代表性和多样性比单纯的数据来源或数量更能决定校准质量，并据此提出校准数据筛选框架 COLA。实验表明，该方法能提升现有后训练压缩方法在关键 LLM 能力保留上的表现。

papers.title: When Compression Meets Model Compression: Memory-Efficient Double Compression for Large Language Models
papers.authors: Weilan Wang, Yu Mao, Dongdong Tang, Hongchao Du, Nan Guan
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit excellent performance in various tasks. However, the memory requirements of LLMs present a great challenge when deploying on memory-limited devices, even for quantized LLMs. This paper introduces a framework to compress LLM after quantization further, achieving about 2.2x compression ratio. A compression-aware quantization is first proposed to enhance model weight compressibility by re-scaling the model parameters before quantization, followed by a pruning method to improve further. Upon this, we notice that decompression can be a bottleneck during practical scenarios. We then give a detailed analysis of the trade-off between memory usage and latency brought by the proposed method. A speed-adaptive method is proposed to overcome it. The experimental results show inference with the compressed model can achieve a 40% reduction in memory size with negligible loss in accuracy and inference speed.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）在各种任务中表现出色。然而，即使对于量化后的LLM，其内存需求在部署到内存受限的设备上时仍然是一个巨大挑战。本文提出了一个在量化后进一步压缩LLM的框架，实现约2.2倍的压缩比。首先提出了一种压缩感知量化方法，通过在量化前重新缩放模型参数来增强模型权重的可压缩性，然后再通过剪枝方法进一步提升。基于此，我们注意到在实际场景中，解压缩可能成为瓶颈。随后，我们对所提出方法带来的内存使用与延迟之间的权衡进行了详细分析，并提出了一种自适应速度的方法来克服这一问题。实验结果表明，使用压缩模型进行推理可以在保证精度和推理速度几乎不损失的情况下，实现40%的内存减少。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the memory bottleneck of deploying large language models on constrained devices, including the practical decompression overhead of already-quantized models. It proposes a double-compression framework that improves weight compressibility via compression-aware rescaling before quantization, adds pruning, and uses a speed-adaptive scheme to balance memory savings against decompression latency. Experiments show about 2.2× compression over quantized models and roughly 40% runtime memory reduction with negligible accuracy and inference-speed loss.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对量化后大模型在内存受限设备上仍占用较高、且解压可能成为延迟瓶颈的问题，提出“量化后再压缩”的双重压缩框架。其核心洞见是通过压缩感知量化先重缩放权重以提升可压缩性，再结合剪枝，并引入速度自适应策略平衡内存占用与推理延迟。实验表明，该方法可实现约2.2倍压缩，并使推理内存减少约40%，同时精度和速度损失可忽略。

papers.title: Toward Sustainable AI: A Review of Energy-Efficient Large Language Models
papers.authors: Bhanu Kaushik, Aman Taneja, Sonika Dahiya
papers.abstract_en: The rapid development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has brought significant advancements in natural language processing, but their high demands for computational resources, memory, and energy pose significant challenges. This report addresses the need for more energy-efficient LLMs by exploring the interconnected factors of computation, memory, energy, cost, and network communication in optimizing these models. Through a detailed literature review, the report evaluates existing strategies in model architecture, pre-training, fine-tuning, and inference to improve LLM efficiency. Furthermore, it introduces a novel unified metric designed to assess resource efficiency across various dimensions. The report also examines optimization techniques such as model pruning, quantization, and hardware acceleration to improve LLM performance and sustainability. The findings emphasize that achieving scalable, efficient, and sustainable LLMs requires a balanced approach that includes energy-conscious design, optimized training processes, and effective resource management.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）的快速发展为自然语言处理带来了巨大的进步，但它们对计算资源、内存和能量的高要求带来了巨大的挑战。本报告通过探索计算、内存、能源、成本和网络通信等相互关联的因素来优化这些模型，从而解决了对更节能llm的需求。通过详细的文献回顾，该报告评估了模型架构、预训练、微调和推理方面的现有策略，以提高LLM的效率。此外，它还引入了一种新的统一度量，旨在评估各个维度的资源效率。该报告还研究了优化技术，如模型修剪、量化和硬件加速，以提高LLM的性能和可持续性。研究结果强调，实现可扩展、高效和可持续的法学硕士需要一种平衡的方法，包括节能设计、优化培训流程和有效的资源管理。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper tackles the high energy, memory, and compute demands of LLMs, with quantization highlighted as a key low-precision technique for reducing resource consumption. Through a review spanning model architecture, pre-training, fine-tuning, inference, pruning, and hardware acceleration, it identifies coupled efficiency trade-offs and proposes a unified metric for multidimensional resource efficiency. The main implication is that sustainable LLM deployment requires co-optimizing precision, energy, cost, and communication overhead rather than optimizing accuracy or throughput alone.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该综述针对大语言模型在计算、内存、能耗、成本和通信方面的高资源需求问题，系统梳理了架构、预训练、微调与推理阶段的能效优化策略，并重点考察了量化、剪枝和硬件加速等方法。其核心洞见是将能效视为多维资源协同优化问题，并提出统一指标来评估不同维度的资源效率。研究表明，实现可持续的大模型需要在能耗感知设计、训练流程优化和资源管理之间取得平衡，以推动可扩展、高效且绿色的 LLM 发展。

papers.title: Adaptive Compute Efficient Learning via Conceptual-Criticality (Student Abstract)
papers.authors: Iñigo Parra, M. ManoBharathi, Mayank Kumar, Pushpa Kumar Balan, Priyadarsi Mishra
papers.abstract_en:
The computational cost of large language models (LLMs) is
a primary obstacle to sustainable deployment. Static
resource
allocation is inefficient, as not all inputs require the
same
depth of processing. We propose a framework for adaptive,
compute-efficient learning via conceptual criticality, which
dynamically tailors computation to the assessed difficulty
of an input. A lightweight criticality prediction module es-
timates conceptual complexity on a continuous scale, and
this score governs the LLM’s inference pathway, selectively
activating token pruning, layer skipping, and quantization.
Simple inputs are processed with minimal FLOPs and la-
tency, while complex inputs use the model’s full capacity
to preserve accuracy. We benchmark our framework and in-
troduce metrics to quantify sensitivity to input criticality
and per-sample computational savings. Results demonstrate
an improved accuracy-efficiency trade-off, paving the way
for more resource-aware systems.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）的计算成本是可持续部署的主要障碍。静态资源分配效率低下，因为并非所有输入都需要相同的处理深度。我们提出了一个基于概念关键性进行自适应、计算高效学习的框架，该框架根据输入的评估难度动态调整计算。一个轻量级的关键性预测模块可以在连续尺度上估计概念复杂度，该得分决定了LLM的推理路径，有选择地激活标记剪枝、层跳过和量化。简单的输入以最少的FLOPs和延迟进行处理，而复杂的输入则使用模型的全部能力以保持准确性。我们对该框架进行了基准测试，并引入了量化对输入关键性敏感性和每个样本计算节省的指标。结果表明，其在准确性与效率之间实现了更好的平衡，为更具资源意识的系统铺平了道路。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles inefficient static compute allocation in LLM inference, where inputs vary widely in required processing depth. It proposes a lightweight criticality predictor that estimates input conceptual complexity and dynamically routes inference through token pruning, layer skipping, and quantization to match computation to difficulty. Benchmarks with new criticality-sensitive metrics show an improved accuracy–efficiency trade-off and per-sample FLOP/latency savings.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对LLM静态推理对所有输入分配相同算力导致效率低的问题，论文提出基于“概念关键性”的自适应计算框架，用轻量模块估计输入概念复杂度，并据此动态选择词元剪枝、层跳跃和量化等推理路径。该方法使简单输入以更低FLOPs和延迟处理，复杂输入保留完整模型能力，并引入指标衡量关键性敏感度与单样本计算节省。实验表明其在准确率与效率之间取得更优权衡，为资源感知的大模型部署提供了思路。

papers.title: LLMs on a Budget? Say HOLA
papers.authors: Z. Siddiqui, Jiechao Gao, Ebad Shabbir, M. Azeez, Rafiq Ali
papers.abstract_en: Running Large Language Models (LLMs) on edge devices is constrained by high compute and memory demands posing a barrier for real-time applications in sectors like healthcare, education, and embedded systems. Current solutions such as quantization, pruning, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) offer only partial optimizations and often compromise on speed or accuracy. We introduce HOLA, an end-to-end optimization framework for efficient LLM deployment. Internally, it leverages Hierarchical Speculative Decoding (HSD) for faster inference without quality loss. Externally, AdaComp-RAG adjusts retrieval complexity based on context needs. Together with LoBi, which blends structured pruning (LoRA) and quantization, HOLA delivers significant gains: 17.6% EMA on GSM8K, 10.5% MCA on ARC, and reduced latency and memory on edge devices like Jetson Nano--proving both scalable and production-ready.
papers.abstract_cn: 在边缘设备上运行大型语言模型（LLM）受到高计算和内存需求的限制，这对医疗、教育和嵌入式系统等行业的实时应用构成了障碍。当前的解决方案，如量化、剪枝和检索增强生成（RAG）仅提供部分优化，并且常常在速度或准确性上有所妥协。我们介绍了 HOLA，一个用于高效 LLM 部署的端到端优化框架。在内部，它利用分层推测解码（HSD）实现更快的推理而不损失质量。在外部，AdaComp-RAG 根据上下文需求调整检索复杂度。结合 LoBi（融合结构化剪枝（LoRA）和量化），HOLA 实现了显著提升：在 GSM8K 上 EMA 提升 17.6%，在 ARC 上 MCA 提升 10.5%，并在 Jetson Nano 等边缘设备上降低了延迟和内存占用——证明了其可扩展性和生产就绪性。
papers.ai_summary_en: HOLA addresses the challenge of deploying LLMs on resource-constrained edge devices, where high compute and memory requirements limit real-time use and existing compression or retrieval methods often trade off speed against accuracy. The framework combines Hierarchical Speculative Decoding for lossless inference acceleration, AdaComp-RAG for context-adaptive retrieval complexity, and LoBi, which integrates LoRA-based structured pruning with quantization. Experiments show reduced latency and memory on devices such as Jetson Nano, with reported gains of 17.6% EMA on GSM8K and 10.5% MCA on ARC, indicating scalable, production-ready edge LLM deployment.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对边缘设备上大模型受算力与内存限制、现有压缩或检索优化难以兼顾速度与精度的问题，论文提出端到端部署框架 HOLA。其核心洞见是将内部分层投机解码、外部自适应检索增强与 LoBi 压缩优化结合，以实现无损加速和低资源部署。实验显示，该方法在 GSM8K 和 ARC 上分别提升 17.6% EMA 与 10.5% MCA，并在 Jetson Nano 等边缘设备上显著降低延迟和内存占用。

papers.title: EdgeShard: Efficient LLM Inference via Collaborative Edge Computing
papers.authors: Mingjin Zhang, Xiaoming Shen, Jiannong Cao, Zeyang Cui, Shan Jiang
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown great success in content generation and intelligent intelligent decision making for IoT systems. Traditionally, LLMs are deployed on the cloud, incurring prolonged latency, high bandwidth costs, and privacy concerns. More recently, edge computing has been considered promising in addressing such concerns because the edge devices are closer to data sources. However, edge devices are cursed by their limited resources and can hardly afford LLMs. Existing studies address such a limitation by offloading heavy workloads from edge to cloud or compressing LLMs via model quantization. These methods either still rely heavily on the remote cloud or suffer substantial accuracy loss. This work is the first to deploy LLMs on a collaborative edge computing environment, in which edge devices and cloud servers share resources and collaborate to infer LLMs with high efficiency and no accuracy loss. We design EdgeShard, a novel approach to partition a computation-intensive LLM into affordable shards and deploy them on distributed devices. The partition and distribution are nontrivial, considering device heterogeneity, bandwidth limitations, and model complexity. To this end, we formulate an adaptive joint device selection and model partition problem and design an efficient dynamic programming algorithm to optimize the inference latency and throughput. Extensive experiments of the popular Llama2 serial models on a real-world testbed reveal that EdgeShard achieves up to 50% latency reduction and $2 \times $ throughput improvement over the state-of-the-art.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）在物联网系统的内容生成和智能决策方面取得了巨大成功。传统上，llm部署在云上，导致延迟延长、带宽成本高和隐私问题。最近，边缘计算被认为有希望解决这些问题，因为边缘设备更接近数据源。然而，边缘设备被其有限的资源所诅咒，很难负担llm。现有的研究通过将繁重的工作负载从边缘卸载到云或通过模型量化压缩llm来解决这种限制。这些方法要么仍然严重依赖于远程云，要么遭受严重的准确性损失。这项工作是首次在协作边缘计算环境中部署llm，在该环境中，边缘设备和云服务器共享资源并协作以高效率和无准确性损失的方式推断llm。我们设计了EdgeShard，这是一种将计算密集型LLM划分为可负担的分片并将其部署在分布式设备上的新方法。考虑到设备异构性、带宽限制和模型复杂性，分区和分布是非常重要的。为此，我们提出了一个自适应的联合设备选择和模型划分问题，并设计了一个高效的动态规划算法来优化推理延迟和吞吐量。在现实世界的测试平台上对流行的Llama2系列模型进行了广泛的实验，结果表明，EdgeShard实现了高达50%的延迟减少，并将吞吐量提高了2倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: EdgeShard addresses efficient LLM inference on resource-constrained edge devices, avoiding cloud offloading latency and the accuracy loss of quantization-based compression. It partitions an LLM into computationally affordable shards and jointly optimizes device selection and shard placement across heterogeneous edge/cloud resources using a dynamic programming algorithm that accounts for bandwidth and device capabilities. Experiments with Llama2 on a real testbed show up to 50% latency reduction and 2× throughput improvement over state-of-the-art methods while preserving model accuracy.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该文针对边缘设备资源受限、难以独立部署LLM，而云卸载或量化压缩又带来延迟、带宽或精度损失的问题，提出协同边缘推理框架 EdgeShard。其核心方法是将计算密集型LLM切分为可部署的分片，并结合设备异构性、带宽和模型复杂度，用动态规划联合优化设备选择与模型划分。实验表明，在 Llama2 真实测试平台上，EdgeShard 相比最先进方法最高可降低 50% 延迟、提升 2 倍吞吐，并保持无精度损失。

papers.title: VecInfer: Efficient LLM Inference with Low-Bit KV Cache via Outlier-Suppressed Vector Quantization
papers.authors: Dingyu Yao, Chenxu Yang, Zhengyang Tong, Zheng Lin, Wei Liu
papers.abstract_en: The Key-Value (KV) cache introduces substantial memory overhead during large language model (LLM) inference. Although existing vector quantization (VQ) methods reduce KV cache usage and provide flexible representational capacity across bit-widths, they suffer severe performance degradation at ultra-low bit-widths due to key cache outliers that hinder effective codebook utilization. To address this challenge, we propose VecInfer, a novel VQ method for aggressive KV cache compression while enabling efficient inference. By applying smooth and Hadamard transformations, VecInfer suppresses outliers in the key cache, enabling the codebook to comprehensively cover the original data distribution and thereby reducing quantization difficulty. To facilitate efficient deployment, we design an optimized CUDA kernel that fuses computation with dequantization to minimize memory access overhead. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that VecInfer consistently outperforms existing quantization baselines across both long-context understanding and mathematical reasoning tasks. With only 2-bit quantization, VecInfer achieves performance comparable to full precision, while delivering up to $\mathbf{2.7\times}$ speedup in large-batch self-attention computation and $\mathbf{8.3\times}$ reduction in single-batch end-to-end latency on Llama-3.1-8B with a 196k sequence length.
papers.abstract_cn: 键值（KV）缓存在大型语言模型（LLM）推理期间引入了大量内存开销。尽管现有的矢量量化（VQ）方法减少了KV缓存的使用，并提供了跨位宽的灵活表示容量，但由于关键缓存异常值阻碍了有效的码本利用率，它们在超低位宽下的性能会严重下降。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了VecInfer，这是一种新颖的VQ方法，可以在实现高效推理的同时进行积极的KV缓存压缩。VecInfer通过平滑变换和Hadamard变换，抑制了关键缓存中的异常值，使码本能够全面覆盖原始数据分布，从而降低量化难度。为了促进有效的部署，我们设计了一个优化的CUDA内核，融合了计算和去量化，以最大限度地减少内存访问开销。广泛的评估表明，VecInfer在长期上下文理解和数学推理任务中始终优于现有的量化基线。仅使用2位量化，VecInfer实现了与全精度相当的性能，同时在大批量自关注计算中提供高达$\mathbf{2.7\times}$的加速，并在具有196k序列长度的lama-3.1- 8b上提供$\mathbf{8.3\times}$的单批端到端延迟降低。
papers.ai_summary_en: VecInfer addresses the KV-cache memory bottleneck in LLM inference, where ultra-low-bit vector quantization is hindered by key-cache outliers and inefficient codebook utilization. It suppresses outliers using smooth and Hadamard transformations before vector quantization and deploys a fused CUDA kernel that combines computation with dequantization to reduce memory access overhead. At 2-bit KV-cache quantization, VecInfer matches full-precision accuracy on long-context and math tasks while achieving up to 2.7× attention speedup and 8.3× lower single-batch end-to-end latency on Llama-3.1-8B with 196k-token sequences.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理中KV缓存内存开销大、现有向量量化在超低比特下因key缓存异常值导致性能下降的问题，提出VecInfer。其核心洞见是通过smooth与Hadamard变换抑制key缓存异常值以提升码本覆盖率，并设计融合计算与反量化的CUDA kernel降低访存开销。实验表明，2-bit量化下性能接近全精度，在长上下文与数学推理任务上优于基线，并在Llama-3.1-8B长序列上实现最高2.7倍自注意力加速和8.3倍单批端到端延迟降低。

papers.title: [GitHub] RWKV-LM: RWKV (pronounced RwaKuv) is an RNN with great LLM performance, which can also be directly trained li
papers.authors: BlinkDL
papers.abstract_en: RWKV (pronounced RwaKuv) is an RNN with great LLM performance, which can also be directly trained like a GPT transformer (parallelizable). We are at RWKV-7 "Goose". So it's combining the best of RNN and transformer - great performance, linear time, constant space (no kv-cache), fast training, infinite ctx_len, and free sentence embedding.
papers.abstract_cn: RWKV（发音为 RwaKuv）是一种具有出色大语言模型性能的 RNN，同时也可以像 GPT 转换器一样直接训练（可并行化）。我们现在处于 RWKV-7 “Goose”。所以它结合了 RNN 和转换器的优点——出色的性能、线性时间、固定空间（无 kv 缓存）、快速训练、无限上下文长度以及免费的句子嵌入。
papers.ai_summary_en: RWKV addresses the Transformer LLM bottleneck of growing KV-cache memory and context-dependent inference cost by reformulating language modeling as an RNN that can still be trained in parallel like a GPT-style Transformer. Its key insight is to combine recurrent, constant-size state updates with Transformer-compatible training, yielding linear-time generation, constant-space inference, and effectively unlimited context length. The project reports strong LLM performance with fast training and additional benefits such as free sentence embeddings, culminating in the RWKV-7 “Goose” architecture.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对 Transformer 大模型在长上下文推理中 KV Cache 内存开销大、效率受限的问题，提出 RWKV 架构，将 RNN 的递推状态机制与 Transformer 的可并行训练方式结合。其核心洞见是用线性时间、常数空间的序列建模替代显式 KV Cache，从而支持快速训练和理论上无限上下文长度。主要效果是在保持大模型性能的同时，实现无需 KV Cache、低推理内存、快速训练以及可直接获得句子嵌入。

papers.title: [GitHub] TensorRT-LLM: TensorRT LLM provides users with an easy-to-use Python API to define Large Language Models (LLMs) an
papers.authors: NVIDIA
papers.abstract_en: TensorRT LLM provides users with an easy-to-use Python API to define Large Language Models (LLMs) and supports state-of-the-art optimizations to perform inference efficiently on NVIDIA GPUs. TensorRT LLM also contains components to create Python and C++ runtimes that orchestrate the inference execution in a performant way.
papers.abstract_cn: TensorRT LLM 为用户提供了一个易于使用的 Python API 来定义大型语言模型（LLM），并支持最先进的优化，以在 NVIDIA GPU 上高效执行推理。TensorRT LLM 还包含用于创建 Python 和 C 运行时的组件，这些组件能够以高性能的方式协调推理执行。
papers.ai_summary_en: TensorRT-LLM addresses the problem of efficiently serving large language models on NVIDIA GPUs by providing a Python API for model definition together with optimized inference compilation and runtime components. Its key approach is to convert LLMs into TensorRT engines and orchestrate execution through Python/C++ runtimes that apply GPU-focused optimizations for low-latency, high-throughput inference. The main impact is an accessible production-oriented stack that improves LLM deployment performance and operational efficiency on NVIDIA hardware.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向大模型推理服务中在 NVIDIA GPU 上高效部署与执行的问题，提供 TensorRT-LLM 这一易用 Python API 和运行时框架。其核心方法是将 LLM 定义、图优化、推理执行编排以及 Python/C++ 运行时集成起来，以支持先进推理优化并提升执行效率。其主要影响是简化 LLM 推理部署流程，并有助于实现更低延迟、更高吞吐的 GPU 推理服务。

papers.title: [GitHub] tiny-llm: A course of learning LLM inference serving on Apple Silicon for systems engineers: build a tiny vLLM
papers.authors: skyzh
papers.abstract_en: A course of learning LLM inference serving on Apple Silicon for systems engineers: build a tiny vLLM + Qwen.
papers.abstract_cn: 针对系统工程师的 Apple Silicon 上 LLM 推理服务学习课程：构建一个微型 vLLM Qwen。
papers.ai_summary_en: This work addresses the lack of accessible, systems-oriented teaching material for LLM inference serving on Apple Silicon by guiding engineers to build a minimal vLLM-style serving stack around Qwen. Its key method is a hands-on course that decomposes inference serving into core systems components—model execution, KV-cache management, batching/scheduling, and Apple Silicon acceleration—using a small implementation to expose the underlying mechanisms. The main impact is pedagogical: it provides a reproducible “tiny vLLM + Qwen” platform for learning inference-serving design and performance trade-offs, rather than introducing a new research system or benchmark result.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向系统工程师，解决如何系统学习 LLM 推理服务（serving）原理与实践的问题，尤其聚焦 Apple Silicon 环境。其核心方法是通过构建一个“tiny vLLM”式的简化推理服务系统，并结合 Qwen 模型，实践调度、KV cache、批处理等关键机制。它主要提供了动手导向的教学路径，有助于降低对 vLLM 类高性能 LLM serving 系统的理解门槛。

papers.title: [GitHub] ramalama: RamaLama is an open-source developer tool that simplifies the local serving of AI models from any so
papers.authors: containers
papers.abstract_en: RamaLama is an open-source developer tool that simplifies the local serving of AI models from any source and facilitates their use for inference in production, all through the familiar language of containers.
papers.abstract_cn: RamaLama 是一个开源开发工具，它简化了从任何来源在本地部署 AI 模型的过程，并通过熟悉的容器语言促进了在生产中进行推理的使用。
papers.ai_summary_en: RamaLama addresses the fragmentation involved in locally serving AI models from heterogeneous sources and transitioning them into production inference workflows. Its key method is a container-centric developer tool that abstracts model retrieval, packaging, and serving using familiar OCI/container semantics. The main impact is simplified, portable local inference with a consistent path toward production deployment, though the abstract provides no quantitative performance results.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向本地与生产环境中 AI 模型部署复杂的问题，提出 RamaLama 这一开源开发者工具。其核心思路是用容器化方式统一封装来自不同来源的模型，简化本地推理服务与生产调用流程。该工具有助于降低模型 serving 的使用门槛，提升本地运行和部署 AI 模型的便利性。

papers.title: [GitHub] Model-Optimizer: A unified library of SOTA model optimization techniques like quantization, pruning, distillation, sp

papers.abstract_en: A unified library of SOTA model optimization techniques like quantization, pruning, distillation, speculative decoding, etc. It compresses deep learning models for downstream deployment frameworks like TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT, vLLM, etc. to optimize inference speed.
papers.abstract_cn: 一个统一的最新技术模型优化技术库，如量化、剪枝、蒸馏、推测解码等。它压缩深度学习模型以适应下游部署框架，如 TensorRT-LLM、TensorRT、vLLM 等，从而优化推理速度。
papers.ai_summary_en: The work addresses efficient deployment of large deep learning models by reducing inference latency and resource requirements across heterogeneous serving backends. It provides a unified optimization library that integrates quantization, pruning, distillation, and speculative decoding, producing compressed models compatible with downstream frameworks such as TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT, and vLLM. The main impact is a standardized pipeline for applying state-of-the-art compression techniques to accelerate production LLM inference.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向大模型推理部署中优化技术碎片化、与 TensorRT-LLM/vLLM 等框架适配成本高的问题，提供一个统一的模型优化库。其核心方法是集成量化、剪枝、蒸馏和投机解码等 SOTA 压缩加速技术，并面向下游推理框架完成模型转换与部署适配。其主要影响是降低模型压缩与推理优化工程门槛，帮助提升推理速度并推动相关技术在实际部署中的落地。

papers.title: [GitHub] dflash: DFlash: Block Diffusion for Flash Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: z-lab
papers.abstract_en: DFlash: Block Diffusion for Flash Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_cn: DFlash：用于闪存推测解码的块扩散
papers.ai_summary_en: DFlash addresses the inference-latency bottleneck of autoregressive LLM decoding by improving speculative decoding with a drafter that can propose multiple tokens in parallel rather than generating them sequentially. Its key method is a block-diffusion drafting model that generates fixed-size token blocks via parallel/few-step discrete diffusion and couples these drafts with standard target-model verification, aiming to increase draft acceptance while keeping drafting overhead low. The main impact is lossless generation-quality speedup over conventional speculative decoding baselines, yielding lower latency and higher decoding throughput.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对大语言模型推理中投机解码的草稿生成效率问题，提出 DFlash：一种面向“快速投机解码”的块扩散草稿生成方法。其核心思路是将扩散生成组织为块级预测，以更少的生成步骤并行产出高质量候选 token 序列，从而提升草稿吞吐并与目标模型验证流程高效配合。该方法有望在保持生成质量/接受率的同时显著加速大模型解码。

papers.title: [GitHub] KVCache-Factory: Unified KV Cache Compression Methods for Auto-Regressive Models
papers.authors: Zefan-Cai
papers.abstract_en: Unified KV Cache Compression Methods for Auto-Regressive Models
papers.abstract_cn: 自回归模型的统一KV缓存压缩方法
papers.ai_summary_en: KVCache-Factory addresses the KV-cache memory and latency bottleneck in auto-regressive transformer models, especially for long-context inference. It provides a unified framework for implementing and comparing KV-cache compression methods such as token eviction, quantization, merging, low-rank approximation, and head/layer pruning. The main contribution is standardization: it enables modular integration, reproducible evaluation, and practical deployment of KV-cache compression techniques to reduce memory usage while preserving generation quality.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向自回归大模型推理中 KV Cache 显存占用高、压缩方法分散的问题，提出/整理了一个统一的 KV Cache 压缩方法框架（KVCache-Factory）。其核心思路是将多种 KV Cache 压缩策略纳入统一实现与接口，便于在相同设置下进行对比、组合和复用。该工作有助于降低长上下文推理开销，并推动 KV Cache 压缩研究的标准化与工程落地。

papers.title: [GitHub] uccl: UCCL is an efficient communication library for GPUs, covering collectives, P2P (e.g., KV cache trans
papers.authors: uccl-project
papers.abstract_en: UCCL is an efficient communication library for GPUs, covering collectives, P2P (e.g., KV cache transfer, RL weight transfer), and EP (e.g., GPU-driven)
papers.abstract_cn: UCCL 是一个高效的 GPU 通信库，涵盖集合通信、点对点通信（例如 KV 缓存传输、RL 权重传输）和 EP（例如 GPU 驱动）
papers.ai_summary_en: UCCL addresses the need for efficient GPU-to-GPU communication in distributed LLM workloads, including collective operations, point-to-point transfers such as KV cache and RL weight movement, and expert-parallel dispatch. Its key contribution is a unified GPU-driven communication library that integrates collectives, P2P, and EP primitives to reduce communication overhead and improve data transfer efficiency across GPUs. The main impact is enabling more scalable and low-latency execution for LLM serving, training, and expert-parallel systems.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向大规模 GPU 系统中集合通信、点对点传输和专家并行（EP）通信开销高的问题，提出 UCCL 这一高效 GPU 通信库。其核心方法是统一支持 collective、P2P（如 KV cache 和 RL 权重传输）以及 GPU 驱动的 EP 通信，以优化分布式训练与推理中的关键数据移动路径。该库有助于降低通信延迟、提升 KV cache 迁移与专家并行场景下的系统吞吐和可扩展性。

papers.authors: hemingkx
papers.abstract_en: 📰 Must-read papers and blogs on Speculative Decoding ⚡️

It addresses the problem of tracking methods for accelerating autoregressive LLM inference by collecting key papers and blogs on draft-model verification, token prediction, and related latency-reduction techniques. Its main impact is as a reference resource rather than reporting novel experimental results.

papers.title: [GitHub] R-KV: [Neurips 2025] R-KV: Redundancy-aware KV Cache Compression for Reasoning Models
papers.authors: Zefan-Cai
papers.abstract_en: [Neurips 2025] R-KV: Redundancy-aware KV Cache Compression for Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_cn: [Neurips 2025] R-KV：面向推理模型的冗余感知KV缓存压缩
papers.ai_summary_en: R-KV addresses the KV-cache bottleneck in reasoning LLMs, where long multi-step generation creates large memory and decoding overhead. Its key idea is redundancy-aware KV cache compression: identifying and removing or merging redundant key-value states while preserving salient context needed for correct reasoning. The intended impact is reduced cache footprint and faster inference with minimal degradation in reasoning accuracy.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向推理模型在长链生成中 KV 缓存显存和计算开销过大的问题，提出冗余感知的 KV 缓存压缩方法 R-KV。其核心思路是识别推理过程中冗余或低价值的 KV 条目，并动态保留更关键的缓存信息，以在压缩缓存的同时维持推理能力。结果表明，该方法有助于降低长上下文推理的显存占用与延迟，为推理模型的高效部署提供了缓存压缩思路。

papers.title: [GitHub] turboquant: TurboQuant: Near-optimal KV cache quantization for LLM inference (3-bit keys, 2-bit values) with Tri
papers.authors: 0xSero
papers.abstract_en: TurboQuant: Near-optimal KV cache quantization for LLM inference (3-bit keys, 2-bit values) with Triton kernels + vLLM integration
papers.abstract_cn: TurboQuant：用于 LLM 推理的近乎最优 KV 缓存量化（3 位键，2 位值），采用 Triton 内核，vLLM 集成
papers.ai_summary_en: TurboQuant addresses the KV-cache memory bottleneck in LLM inference by aggressively quantizing cached attention states to 3-bit keys and 2-bit values. Its key contribution is a systems-oriented implementation using Triton kernels and vLLM integration to enable low-bit KV-cache compression with efficient runtime execution. The project targets near-optimal memory reduction while preserving model quality, making long-context or high-throughput inference more memory-efficient.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向大模型推理中的 KV cache 内存瓶颈，提出 TurboQuant，通过对 key 采用 3-bit、value 采用 2-bit 的近最优混合精度量化来显著降低缓存占用。其核心贡献是提供高性能 Triton 量化内核并集成到 vLLM 推理框架中，使低比特 KV cache 可用于实际服务场景。结果显示，该方法在大幅减少显存开销的同时，能够保持接近全精度的推理质量并提升推理吞吐。

papers.title: [GitHub] kvpress: LLM KV cache compression made easy
papers.authors: NVIDIA
papers.abstract_en: We present PolyKV, a system in which multiple concurrent inference agents share a single, asymmetrically compressed KV cache pool. Rather than allocating a separate KV cache per agent -- the standard paradigm -- PolyKV writes a compressed cache once and injects it into N independent agent contexts via HuggingFace DynamicCache objects. Compression is asymmetric: Keys are quantized at int8 (q8_0) to preserve softmax stability, while Values are compressed using TurboQuant MSE -- a Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform (FWHT) rotation followed by 3-bit Lloyd-Max quantization with centroids tuned to N(0,1). We evaluate across two model scales (SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct and Llama-3-8B-Instruct), three context lengths (600-7,194 tokens), and up to 15 concurrent agents. PolyKV achieves a stable 2.91x compression ratio across all configurations. On Llama-3-8B with 15 agents sharing a 4K-token context, PolyKV reduces KV cache memory from 19.8 GB to 0.45 GB -- a 97.7% reduction -- while maintaining only +0.57% perplexity degradation and a mean BERTScore F1 of 0.928. PPL delta does not grow with agent count and improves as context length increases, inverting to -0.26% at 1,851 coherent tokens. To our knowledge, no prior work combines a single shared, lossy-compressed KV pool with multi-reader concurrent agent access.
papers.abstract_cn: LLM KV 缓存压缩变得简单
papers.ai_summary_en: PolyKV addresses the memory overhead of maintaining separate KV caches for many concurrent LLM inference agents by sharing a single compressed KV cache pool across multiple agent contexts. Its key insight is asymmetric compression: keys are int8-quantized to preserve softmax stability, while values are compressed with a Fast Walsh–Hadamard rotation followed by 3-bit Lloyd–Max quantization tuned to a standard normal distribution. Experiments on SmolLM2-1.7B and Llama-3-8B show a stable 2.91× compression ratio, reducing a 15-agent Llama-3-8B 4K-token KV cache from 19.8 GB to 0.45 GB with only +0.57% perplexity degradation and high output fidelity.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多并发LLM推理中每个代理单独维护KV缓存造成的高内存开销问题，提出PolyKV，让多个代理共享同一份一次写入、多次读取的KV缓存池。其核心方法是非对称压缩：Key采用int8量化以保持softmax稳定，Value先做FWHT旋转再用面向N(0,1)的3-bit Lloyd-Max量化，并通过HuggingFace DynamicCache注入各代理上下文。实验显示单缓存压缩比稳定约2.91x，在Llama-3-8B、15个代理和4K上下文下将总KV内存从19.8GB降至0.45GB（97.7%），困惑度仅增加0.57%且BERTScore F1达0.928，表明共享有损KV池在多代理服务中具有高可行性。

papers.ai_summary_en: This work addresses LLM inference memory pressure by targeting compression of the key-value (KV) cache. It provides a from-scratch PyTorch implementation of Google’s TurboQuant (ICLR 2026), applying low-bit quantization to cached keys and values while preserving attention accuracy. The implementation reports approximately 5× KV-cache compression at 3-bit precision with 99.5% attention fidelity.

papers.title: [GitHub] Fast-dLLM: Official implementation of "Fast-dLLM: Training-free Acceleration of Diffusion LLM by Enabling KV Ca
papers.authors: NVlabs
papers.abstract_en: Official implementation of "Fast-dLLM: Training-free Acceleration of Diffusion LLM by Enabling KV Cache and Parallel Decoding"
papers.abstract_cn: 官方发布“Fast-dLLM：通过启用 KV 缓存和并行解码实现扩散型 LLM 的无训练加速”
papers.ai_summary_en: Fast-dLLM addresses the slow inference of diffusion-based LLMs, which typically require many iterative denoising steps and cannot directly exploit standard autoregressive KV caching. Its key idea is a training-free inference framework that enables KV cache reuse across diffusion steps while supporting parallel decoding of multiple tokens. This yields substantial latency reduction for diffusion LLMs while preserving generation quality without additional training.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对扩散式语言模型（Diffusion LLM）推理速度慢、难以像自回归模型一样利用 KV Cache 的问题，提出 Fast-dLLM 这一免训练加速框架。其核心洞见是通过改造推理流程使扩散 LLM 能够启用 KV Cache，并结合并行解码减少生成延迟。该方法无需重新训练即可提升扩散 LLM 的生成效率，为扩散式语言模型的实际部署提供了可行加速路径。

papers.title: [GitHub] ssd: A lightweight inference engine supporting speculative speculative decoding (SSD).
papers.authors: tanishqkumar
papers.abstract_en: A lightweight inference engine supporting speculative speculative decoding (SSD).
papers.abstract_cn: 一个支持推测性解码（SSD）的轻量级推理引擎。
papers.ai_summary_en: This appears to be a GitHub project rather than a full paper abstract. It describes **ssd**, a lightweight inference engine that supports **speculative speculative decoding (SSD)**—likely an extension of speculative decoding aimed at further reducing inference latency by adding an additional speculative/verification layer. The provided abstract is too minimal to determine the exact problem formulation, system design, or evaluation results.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对大模型自回归推理延迟高的问题，提供了一个支持“投机式投机解码”（SSD）的轻量级推理引擎。其核心思路是在投机解码基础上进一步组织草稿生成与验证流程，以较低系统开销提升 token 生成的并行度。该实现为推测解码研究与工程落地提供了基础设施，有望在保持生成质量的同时提高推理吞吐。

papers.title: Slot Machines: How LLMs Keep Track of Multiple Entities
papers.authors: Paul C. Bogdan, Jack Lindsey
papers.abstract_en: Language models must bind entities to the attributes they possess and maintain several such binding relationships within a context. We study how multiple entities are represented across token positions and whether single tokens can carry bindings for more than one entity. We introduce a multi-slot probing approach that disentangles a single token's residual stream activation to recover information about both the currently described entity and the immediately preceding one. These two kinds of information are encoded in separate and largely orthogonal "current-entity" and "prior-entity" slots. We analyze the functional roles of these slots and find that they serve different purposes. In tandem with the current-entity slot, the prior-entity slot supports relational inferences, such as entity-level induction ("who came after Alice in the story?") and conflict detection between adjacent entities. However, only the current-entity slot is used for explicit factual retrieval questions ("Is anyone in the story tall?" "What is the tall entity's name?") despite these answers being linearly decodable from the prior-entity slot too. Consistent with this limitation, open-weight models perform near chance accuracy at processing syntax that forces two subject-verb-object bindings on a single token (e.g., "Alice prepares and Bob consumes food.") Interestingly, recent frontier models can parse this properly, suggesting they may have developed more sophisticated binding strategies. Overall, our results expose a gap between information that is available in activations and information the model actually uses, and suggest that the current/prior-entity slot structure is a natural substrate for behaviors that require holding two perspectives at once, such as sycophancy and deception.
papers.abstract_cn: 语言模型必须将实体绑定到它们所拥有的属性，并在上下文中维护几个这样的绑定关系。我们研究了如何跨令牌位置表示多个实体，以及单个令牌是否可以携带多个实体的绑定。我们引入了一种多槽探测方法，该方法解开单个令牌的残留流激活，以恢复当前描述的实体和前一个实体的信息。这两种信息被编码在独立且基本正交的“当前实体”和“先前实体”槽中。我们分析了这些插槽的功能角色，发现它们服务于不同的目的。与当前实体槽一起，先验实体槽支持关系推理，例如实体级归纳（“故事中谁在爱丽丝之后？”）以及相邻实体之间的冲突检测。然而，只有当前实体插槽用于明确的事实检索问题（“故事中有人高吗？”）“那个高个子的实体叫什么名字？”)尽管这些答案也可以从先验实体槽线性解码。与这一限制相一致，开放权重模型在处理在单个令牌上强制两个主语-动词-对象绑定的语法时（例如，“Alice准备和Bob消耗食物”）具有接近偶然的准确性。有趣的是，最近的前沿模型可以正确地解析这一点，这表明它们可能开发了更复杂的绑定策略。总的来说，我们的结果揭示了激活中可用的信息和模型实际使用的信息之间的差距，并表明当前/先验实体槽结构是需要同时持有两个视角的行为的自然基础，例如谄媚和欺骗。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper investigates how LLMs represent and bind multiple entities to attributes within a context, specifically testing whether a single token can encode more than one entity. Using multi-slot linear probing of residual-stream activations, the authors identify largely orthogonal “current-entity” and “prior-entity” slots and analyze their distinct functional roles. They find that prior-entity information is decodable and supports relational inference and conflict detection but is largely ignored for explicit factual retrieval, with open-weight models failing on forced dual-binding syntax while frontier models show more sophisticated binding behavior.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文研究LLM如何在上下文中绑定并追踪多个实体，尤其是单个token是否能同时承载多个实体信息。作者提出多槽探针，将残差流分解为近似正交的“当前实体”和“前一实体”槽，发现前者用于显式事实检索，后者虽可解码但主要服务关系推理和冲突检测。结果表明开放权重模型在双绑定句法上接近随机，而前沿模型表现更好，揭示了激活中可用信息与模型实际使用信息之间的差距。

papers.title: Distributed Generative Inference of LLM at Internet Scales with Multi-Dimensional Communication Optimization
papers.authors: Jiu Chen, Shuangyan Yang, Xu Xiong, Hexiao Duan, Xinran Zhang
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized LLM inference distributes computation among heterogeneous nodes across the internet, offering a performant and cost-efficient solution, alternative to traditional centralized inference. However, the low cross-node network bandwidth makes communication the primary bottleneck. In this paper, we introduce BloomBee, an internet-scale distributed LLM inference framework. BloomBee integrates LLM-layer assignment, micro-batching and tensor offloading to optimize communication from multiple dimensions. Additionally, BloomBee formulates the coordination of these techniques as an optimization problem and solves it using dynamic programming. BloomBee also customizes lossless compression and speculative decoding according to low-bandwidth network settings to reduce communication overhead. We evaluate BloomBee across a spectrum of network environments and show that it improves service throughput by up to 1.76x. It also reduces average latency by up to 43.20% compared to state-of-the-art decentralized LLM inference systems. BloomBee is open-sourced.
papers.abstract_cn: 分布式LLM推理将计算分布在互联网上的异构节点之间，提供了一种高性能且经济高效的解决方案，替代了传统的集中式推理。然而，低跨节点网络带宽使通信成为主要瓶颈。在本文中，我们介绍了BloomBee，一个互联网规模的分布式LLM推理框架。BloomBee集成了llm层分配、微批处理和张量卸载，从多个维度优化通信。此外，BloomBee将这些技术的协调制定为一个优化问题，并使用动态规划来解决它。BloomBee还根据低带宽网络设置定制无损压缩和推测解码，以减少通信开销。我们在一系列网络环境中对BloomBee进行了评估，结果表明它将服务吞吐量提高了1.76倍。与最先进的分散式LLM推理系统相比，它还将平均延迟降低了43.20%。BloomBee是开源的。
papers.ai_summary_en: BloomBee addresses the communication bottleneck in internet-scale decentralized LLM inference, where low cross-node bandwidth limits throughput and latency. It jointly optimizes layer assignment, micro-batching, and tensor offloading via dynamic programming, and further reduces communication using lossless compression and low-bandwidth-aware speculative decoding. Evaluations show up to 1.76× higher service throughput and up to 43.20% lower average latency than state-of-the-art decentralized inference systems.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对互联网规模去中心化LLM推理中跨节点带宽低、通信成为主要瓶颈的问题，提出BloomBee框架，通过层分配、微批处理、张量卸载的多维通信优化，并用动态规划统一协调，同时定制无损压缩与投机解码以降低传输开销。实验显示，相比现有去中心化推理系统，BloomBee可将服务吞吐提升最高1.76倍，并将平均延迟降低最高43.20%。

papers.title: MCAP: Deployment-Time Layer Profiling for Memory-Constrained LLM Inference
papers.authors: Anurita Das
papers.abstract_en: Deploying large language models to heterogeneous hardware is often constrained by memory, not compute. We introduce MCAP (Monte Carlo Activation Profiling), a load-time per-layer importance estimator that enables dynamic precision and memory placement decisions on the target device. MCAP produces a lightweight per-layer signal that drives both precision dispatch (W4A8 vs. W4A16) and residency tier (GPU, RAM, SSD), allowing a single set of weights to operate across diverse memory budgets. Our system, NVE, achieves 1.5-1.8x higher decode throughput than llama.cpp Q4_0 on NVIDIA T4 and enables models to run in memory regimes previously infeasible without modifying weights.
papers.abstract_cn: 将大型语言模型部署到异构硬件上往往受限于内存，而不是计算能力。我们引入了 MCAP（蒙特卡洛激活分析），一种运行时每层重要性评估器，可以在目标设备上实现动态精度和内存布局决策。MCAP 生成轻量级的每层信号，用于驱动精度调度（W4A8 与 W4A16）和驻留层选择（GPU、RAM、SSD），允许一组权重在不同内存预算下运行。我们的系统 NVE 在 NVIDIA T4 上实现的解码吞吐量比 llama.cpp Q4_0 高 1.5-1.8 倍，并使模型能够在之前在内存条件下无法实现的情况下运行，而无需修改权重。
papers.ai_summary_en: MCAP addresses memory-constrained LLM deployment on heterogeneous hardware by making per-layer precision and placement decisions at inference time. It uses Monte Carlo Activation Profiling to generate lightweight per-layer importance signals that drive dispatch between W4A8 and W4A16 and tier weights across GPU, RAM, and SSD from a single weight set. The resulting NVE system achieves 1.5–1.8× higher decode throughput than llama.cpp Q4_0 on an NVIDIA T4 and enables previously infeasible memory regimes without modifying model weights.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对内存受限的异构 LLM 推理部署问题，提出 MCAP：一种在模型加载时通过蒙特卡洛激活剖析估计逐层重要性的轻量方法。其核心洞见是用同一套权重根据逐层信号动态选择精度（如 W4A8/W4A16）和存放位置（GPU、内存、SSD），从而适配不同内存预算。实验表明，基于 MCAP 的 NVE 系统在 NVIDIA T4 上解码吞吐量比 llama.cpp Q4_0 提升 1.5–1.8 倍，并使模型能在原本不可行的内存条件下运行。

papers.title: FastCache: Optimizing Multimodal LLM Serving through Lightweight KV-Cache Compression Framework
papers.authors: Jianian Zhu, Hang Wu, Haojie Wang, Yinghui Li, Biao Hou
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) serving systems commonly employ KV-cache compression to reduce memory footprint. However, existing compression methods introduce significant processing overhead and queuing delays, particularly in concurrent serving scenarios. We present \texttt{FastCache}, a novel serving framework that effectively addresses these challenges through two key innovations: (1) a dynamic batching strategy that optimizes request scheduling across prefill, compression, and decode stages, and (2) an efficient KV-cache memory pool mechanism that eliminates memory fragmentation while maintaining high GPU utilization. Our comprehensive experiments on the GQA and MileBench datasets demonstrate that \texttt{FastCache} achieves up to 19.3$\times$ reduction in Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) and 12.1$\times$ improvement in throughput compared to state-of-the-art baselines. The system maintains stable performance under high-concurrency scenarios (up to 40 req/s) while reducing average memory consumption by 20\%. These results establish \texttt{FastCache} as an efficient solution for real-world LLM serving systems with KV-cache compression.
papers.abstract_cn: 多模态大型语言模型（mllm）服务系统通常采用kv缓存压缩来减少内存占用。然而，现有的压缩方法引入了显著的处理开销和排队延迟，特别是在并发服务场景中。我们提出了\texttt{FastCache}，这是一个新的服务框架，通过两个关键创新有效地解决了这些挑战：(1)动态批处理策略，优化了预填充、压缩和解码阶段的请求调度；(2)高效的KV-cache内存池机制，在保持高GPU利用率的同时消除了内存碎片。我们在GQA和milelbench数据集上的综合实验表明，与最先进的基线相比，\texttt{FastCache}在第一次令牌时间（TTFT）方面减少了19.3 $\times$，吞吐量提高了12.1 $\times$。系统在高并发场景下保持稳定的性能（最高可达40 req/s），平均内存消耗降低20％。这些结果表明\texttt{FastCache}是具有kv缓存压缩的实际LLM服务系统的有效解决方案。
papers.ai_summary_en: FastCache addresses the serving bottleneck in multimodal LLMs where KV-cache compression reduces memory but introduces heavy processing overhead and queuing delays under concurrent workloads. It introduces a dynamic batching strategy that jointly schedules prefill, compression, and decode stages, together with a fragmented-memory-avoiding KV-cache pool that preserves GPU utilization. Experiments on GQA and MileBench show up to 19.3× lower TTFT, 12.1× higher throughput, stable performance at 40 req/s, and 20% lower average memory use versus strong baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态大模型推理服务中 KV-cache 压缩虽能降低显存占用、却带来显著处理开销和并发排队延迟的问题，提出了 FastCache 服务框架。其核心是通过跨预填充、压缩和解码阶段的动态批处理调度，以及消除碎片的 KV-cache 内存池机制，在保持高 GPU 利用率的同时实现轻量压缩。实验显示，该方法可将首 token 时延最高降低 19.3 倍、吞吐提升 12.1 倍，并在高并发下保持稳定，同时平均显存占用降低 20%。

papers.title: SCORPIO: Serving the Right Requests at the Right Time for Heterogeneous SLOs in LLM Inference
papers.authors: Yinghao Tang, Tingfeng Lan, Xiuqi Huang, Hui Lu, Wei Chen
papers.abstract_en: Existing Large Language Model (LLM) serving systems prioritize maximum throughput. They often neglect Service Level Objectives (SLOs) such as Time to First Token (TTFT) and Time Per Output Token (TPOT), which leads to suboptimal SLO attainment. This paper introduces SCORPIO, an SLO-oriented LLM serving system designed to maximize system goodput and SLO attainment for workloads with heterogeneous SLOs. Our core insight is to exploit SLO heterogeneity for adaptive scheduling across admission control, queue management, and batch selection. SCORPIO features a TTFT Guard, which employs least-deadline-first reordering and rejects unattainable requests, and a TPOT Guard, which utilizes a VBS-based admission control and a novel credit-based batching mechanism. Both guards are supported by a predictive module. Evaluations demonstrate that SCORPIO improves system goodput by up to 14.4X and SLO adherence by up to 46.5% compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.abstract_cn: 现有的大型语言模型（LLM）服务系统优先考虑最大吞吐量。它们经常忽视服务级别目标（SLO），例如首个令牌时间（TTFT）和每个输出令牌时间（TPOT），这导致SLO达成不理想。本文介绍了SCORPIO，一种面向SLO的LLM服务系统，旨在最大化系统有效吞吐量和具有异构SLO的工作负载的SLO达成。我们的核心见解是利用SLO异构性，在准入控制、队列管理和批处理选择中实现自适应调度。SCORPIO具有TTFT守护功能，该功能采用最晚截止优先重排并拒绝无法达到的请求，以及TPOT守护功能，该功能利用基于VBS的准入控制和一种新型的基于信用的批处理机制。两个守护功能均由预测模块支持。评估表明，与最先进的基线相比，SCORPIO将系统有效吞吐量提高了最多14.4倍，SLO遵守率提高了最多46.5%。
papers.ai_summary_en: SCORPIO addresses LLM inference serving under heterogeneous latency SLOs, specifically TTFT and TPOT, where throughput-centric schedulers often fail to meet per-request deadlines. Its key insight is to exploit SLO heterogeneity through coordinated admission control, queue reordering, and batch selection, using a TTFT Guard with least-deadline-first scheduling and unattainable-request rejection, plus a TPOT Guard with VBS-based admission and credit-based batching driven by prediction. Evaluations show up to 14.4× higher system goodput and 46.5% better SLO adherence than state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理服务中现有系统过度追求吞吐、难以满足TTFT和TPOT等异构SLO的问题，提出了面向SLO的调度系统SCORPIO。其核心方法是利用SLO差异，在准入控制、队列管理和批选择中进行自适应调度，并通过TTFT Guard与TPOT Guard结合预测模块来优先处理可达成请求、避免SLO违约。实验显示，相较先进基线，SCORPIO可将系统goodput最高提升14.4倍，并将SLO达成率最高提升46.5%。

papers.title: Equinox: Holistic Fair Scheduling in Serving Large Language Models
papers.authors: Zhixiang Wei, James Yen, Jingyi Chen, Ziyang Zhang, Zhibai Huang
papers.abstract_en: We address the limitations of current LLM serving with a dual-counter framework separating user and operator perspectives. The User Fairness Counter measures quality of service via weighted tokens and latency; the Resource Fairness Counter measures operational efficiency through throughput and GPU utilization. Since these metrics are only available post-execution, creating a scheduling paradox, we introduce a deterministic Mixture of Prediction Experts (MoPE) framework to predict user-perceived latency, output tokens, throughput, and GPU utilization. These predictions enable calculation of a unified Holistic Fairness score that balances both counters through tunable parameters for proactive fairness-aware scheduling. We implement this in Equinox, an open-source system with other optimizations like adaptive batching, and stall-free scheduling. Evaluations on production traces (ShareGPT, LMSYS) and synthetic workloads demonstrate Equinox achieves up to $1.3\times$ higher throughput, 60\% lower time-to-first-token latency, and 13\% higher fairness versus VTC while maintaining 94\% GPU utilization, proving fairness under bounded discrepancy across heterogeneous platforms.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们解决了当前LLM服务的局限性，采用了分离用户和操作员视角的双计数器框架。用户公平计数器通过加权令牌和延迟来衡量服务质量；资源公平性指标通过吞吐量和GPU利用率来衡量操作效率。由于这些指标仅在执行后可用，因此产生了调度悖论，因此我们引入了确定性混合预测专家（MoPE）框架来预测用户感知的延迟、输出令牌、吞吐量和GPU利用率。这些预测可以计算统一的整体公平性得分，该得分通过可调参数来平衡两个计数器，用于主动的公平感知调度。我们在Equinox中实现了这一点，这是一个开源系统，具有自适应批处理和无失速调度等其他优化。对生产轨迹（ShareGPT， LMSYS）和合成工作负载的评估表明，与VTC相比，Equinox的吞吐量提高了1.3倍，到第一个令牌的延迟时间降低了60%，公平性提高了13%，同时保持了94%的GPU利用率，证明了跨异构平台的有限差异下的公平性。
papers.ai_summary_en: Equinox tackles fairness-aware LLM serving by jointly optimizing user-perceived QoS (weighted tokens and latency) and operator resource efficiency (throughput and GPU utilization), which are normally observable only after execution. It introduces a dual-counter fairness model and a deterministic mixture-of-prediction-experts that forecasts latency, output length, throughput, and utilization to compute a tunable holistic fairness score for proactive scheduling, alongside adaptive batching and stall-free execution. On ShareGPT/LMSYS and synthetic workloads, Equinox achieves up to 1.3× higher throughput, 60% lower TTFT, and 13% better fairness than VTC while sustaining 94% GPU utilization.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理服务中用户QoS与运营效率难以兼顾、且公平指标只能在执行后获得的调度悖论，提出Equinox：通过用户/资源双公平计数器，并用确定性混合预测专家预测延迟、输出token数、吞吐和GPU利用率，从而进行前瞻式的整体公平调度。实验表明，Equinox在ShareGPT、LMSYS等负载上相较VTC最高提升1.3倍吞吐、降低60%首token延迟、提高13%公平性，同时保持约94% GPU利用率。

papers.title: Adaptive Request Scheduling for CodeLLM Serving with SLA Guarantees
papers.authors: Shi Chang, Boyuan Chen, Kishanthan Thangarajah, Hanan Lutfiyya, Ahmed E. Hassan
papers.abstract_en: Code Large Language Models (CodeLLMs) are increasingly integrated into modern software development workflows, yet efficiently serving them in resource-constrained, self-hosted environments remains a significant challenge. Existing LLM serving systems employs Continuous Batching for throughput improvement. However, they rely on static batch size configurations that cannot adapt to fluctuating request rates or heterogeneous workloads, leading to frequent SLA (Service Level Agreement) violations and unstable performance. In this study, We propose SABER, a dynamic batching strategy that predicts per-request SLA feasibility and adjusts decisions in real time. SABER improves goodput by up to 26% over the best static configurations and reduces latency variability by up to 45%, all without manual tuning or service restarts. Our results demonstrate that SLA-aware, adaptive scheduling is key to robust, high-performance CodeLLM serving.
papers.abstract_cn: 代码大语言模型（CodeLLMs）正越来越多地被整合到现代软件开发工作流中，但在资源受限的自托管环境中高效地提供服务仍然是一个重大挑战。现有的LLM服务系统采用持续批处理（Continuous Batching）来提高吞吐量。然而，它们依赖于静态的批量大小配置，无法适应波动的请求速率或异构的工作负载，导致频繁的SLA（服务等级协议）违规和性能不稳定。在本研究中，我们提出了SABER，一种动态批处理策略，它可以预测每个请求的SLA可行性，并实时调整决策。SABER在最佳静态配置下将有效吞吐量提高了最多26%，并将延迟波动降低了最多45%，这一切都无需手动调优或重启服务。我们的结果表明，SLA感知的自适应调度是实现稳健、高性能CodeLLM服务的关键。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses SLA-violating instability in self-hosted CodeLLM serving caused by static continuous-batching configurations under fluctuating and heterogeneous request workloads. It proposes SABER, an SLA-aware adaptive scheduler that predicts per-request feasibility and dynamically adjusts batching decisions in real time without manual tuning or restarts. Experiments show up to 26% higher goodput than the best static configurations and up to 45% lower latency variability.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对自托管、资源受限环境下 CodeLLM 推理服务中静态连续批处理难以适应请求波动和异构负载、从而导致 SLA 违约的问题展开研究。其核心方法是提出 SABER：一种 SLA 感知的自适应请求调度/动态批处理策略，通过预测每个请求的 SLA 可行性并实时调整调度决策，实现无需人工调参或重启的在线优化。实验显示，相比最佳静态配置，SABER 可将有效吞吐提升至多 26%，并将延迟波动降低至多 45%，增强了 CodeLLM 服务的稳定性与性能保障能力。

papers.title: DeepServe: Hierarchical Model Placement and Dynamic Batching for Cost-Efficient Multi-Tenant LLM Inference at Scale
papers.authors: Tejas Pravinbhai Patel, P. Agarwal
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) inference serving at scale presents critical challenges in multi-tenant cloud environments, where organizations must balance conflicting objectives of cost efficiency, response latency, and resource utilization across heterogeneous GPU infrastructure. Current serving systems employ static model placement strategies and homogeneous batching policies, resulting in $40 - 60 \%$ GPU underutilization and $3-5 \times$ cost inefficiency for variable workloads. We present DeepServe, a hierarchical model placement framework with dynamic batching that optimizes cost per served token across five GPU tiers (A100-80GB, A100-40GB, V100, L4, T4) and four model scales (7B-175B parameters). Our system integrates three key innovations: (1) Memoryaware hierarchical placement algorithm achieving 82% GPU utilization through optimal model-to-GPU assignment based on memory footprint and throughput profiles, (2) Adaptive continuous batching with SLA-aware scheduling attaining $3.8 \times$ throughput improvement over sequential processing while maintaining P95 latency under 2.5 seconds, and (3) Multi-objective cost optimizer reducing inference cost by 47% compared to static provisioning through heterogeneous GPU selection. Evaluation on production-representative workloads with 50,000 requests demonstrates: P50 latency of 890 ms, P95 latency of $2.31 ~\mathrm{s}, 79 \%$ average GPU utilization, and $0.0012 cost per 1000 tokens-matching vLLM throughput benchmarks while achieving 47% cost reduction versus naive A100-only deployment.
papers.abstract_cn: 大规模服务的大型语言模型（LLM）推理在多租户云环境中提出了关键挑战，组织必须在异构GPU基础设施之间平衡成本效率、响应延迟和资源利用等相互冲突的目标。当前的服务系统采用静态模型放置策略和同质批处理策略，导致GPU利用率不足40 - 60%，可变工作负载成本低3-5倍。我们提出了DeepServe，这是一个具有动态批处理的分层模型放置框架，可优化五个GPU层（A100-80GB, A100-40GB, V100, L4, T4）和四个模型尺度（7B-175B参数）的每个服务令牌的成本。我们的系统集成了三个关键创新：(1)内存感知分层布局算法通过基于内存占用和吞吐量配置文件的最优模型到GPU分配实现82%的GPU利用率；(2)具有sla感知调度的自适应连续批处理比顺序处理提高3.8倍的吞吐量，同时将P95延迟保持在2.5秒以下；(3)多目标成本优化器通过异构GPU选择，与静态配置相比，将推理成本降低47%。对具有50,000个请求的具有生产代表性的工作负载的评估表明：P50延迟为890 ms， P95延迟为2.31 ~\mathrm{s}， GPU平均利用率为79%，每1000个令牌匹配的vLLM吞吐量基准成本为0.0012美元，同时与单纯的a100部署相比，成本降低了47%。
papers.ai_summary_en: DeepServe addresses cost-efficient multi-tenant LLM inference on heterogeneous GPU clusters, where static model placement and homogeneous batching lead to low utilization and high serving costs. It introduces a memory-aware hierarchical placement algorithm, SLA-aware adaptive continuous batching, and a multi-objective cost optimizer that assign models across five GPU tiers and schedule requests to minimize cost per token under latency constraints. On production-representative workloads, it achieves ~79–82% GPU utilization, P50/P95 latencies of 0.89s/2.31s, vLLM-comparable throughput, and 47% lower cost than naive A100-only deployment.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对多租户云端大规模 LLM 推理中静态模型放置和同质批处理导致的 GPU 利用率低、成本高以及延迟难保障问题展开研究。  
DeepServe 提出内存感知的分层模型放置、自适应连续批处理与 SLA 感知调度，并结合多目标成本优化，在异构 GPU 上优化每 token 推理成本。  
在生产型负载下，其平均 GPU 利用率达 79%，P95 延迟为 2.31 秒，相比纯 A100 静态部署成本降低 47%，同时保持与 vLLM 相当的吞吐表现。

papers.title: Efficient LLM Inference via Chunked Prefills
papers.authors: Arney Agrawal, Nitin Kedia, Ashish Panwar, Jayashree Mohan, Nipun Kwatra
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) inference serving faces a fundamental challenge due to the distinct characteristics of its two phases: compute-intensive pre fill and memory-intensive decode. Existing scheduling strategies often prioritize one phase over the other, leading to a difficult tradeoff between system throughput and request latency. Prefill-prioritizing schedulers improve throughput but introduce significant latency jitter (generation stalls) by interfering with ongoing decodes. Conversely, decode-prioritizing schedulers maintain low latency but underutilize GPU resources, resulting in low throughput. This paper revisits the technique of chunked prefills, demonstrating its efficacy in mitigating this tradeoff. By splitting large prefill computations into smaller, manageable chunks and interleaving them with decode operations using stall-free batching, we can leverage the compute slack inherent in the decode phase. This approach significantly improves serving capacity under strict latency constraints, minimizes generation stalls, and reduces pipeline bubbles in distributed deployments, enabling efficient and responsive inference.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）推理服务面临着一个根本性的挑战，因为它有两个阶段：计算密集型的预填充和内存密集型的解码。现有的调度策略经常优先考虑一个阶段而不是另一个阶段，导致在系统吞吐量和请求延迟之间难以权衡。优先级调度程序提高了吞吐量，但由于干扰正在进行的解码，引入了严重的延迟抖动（生成延迟）。相反，解码优先级调度程序保持低延迟，但未充分利用GPU资源，导致低吞吐量。本文回顾了分块前缀技术，证明了它在减轻这种权衡方面的有效性。通过将大的预填充计算分成更小的、可管理的块，并使用无停顿的批处理将它们与解码操作交叉，我们可以利用解码阶段固有的计算松弛。这种方法在严格的延迟限制下显著提高了服务容量，最大限度地减少了发电停顿，并减少了分布式部署中的管道气泡，从而实现了高效和响应性的推断。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the throughput–latency tradeoff in LLM inference caused by compute-intensive prefill interfering with memory-intensive decode under conventional phase-prioritized scheduling. It revisits chunked prefills, splitting large prompts into smaller chunks and interleaving them with decode steps via stall-free batching to exploit idle compute in decode and reduce pipeline bubbles in distributed serving. This improves serving capacity under strict latency constraints while minimizing generation stalls and maintaining responsive token generation.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理中预填充阶段计算密集、解码阶段内存密集所导致的吞吐与延迟权衡问题，尤其是预填充优先会造成生成停顿、解码优先会降低GPU利用率。其核心方法是采用分块预填充，将大的预填充请求切分为小块，并通过无停顿批处理与解码操作交错执行，从而利用解码阶段的计算余量。实验/分析表明，该方法可在严格延迟约束下提升服务能力，减少生成停顿和分布式部署中的流水线气泡，实现更高吞吐、更低抖动的推理服务。
