papers.title: Oaken: Fast and Efficient LLM Serving with Online-Offline Hybrid KV Cache Quantization
papers.authors: Minsu Kim, Seongmin Hong, Ryeowook Ko, Soongyu Choi, Hunjong Lee
papers.abstract_en: Modern Large Language Model (LLM) serving system batches multiple requests to achieve high throughput, while batching attention operations is challenging, rendering memory bandwidth a critical bottleneck. Today, to mitigate this issue, the community relies on high-end GPUs with multiple high-bandwidth memory (HBM) channels. Unfortunately, HBM’s high bandwidth often comes at the expense of limited memory capacity, necessitating systems to scale, which reduces core utilization and increases costs. Moreover, recent advancements enabling longer contexts for LLMs have substantially increased the key-value (KV) cache size, further intensifying the pressures on memory capacity. To lower the pressure, the literature has explored KV cache quantization techniques, which commonly use low bitwidth (e.g., INT4) for most values, selectively using higher bitwidth (e.g., FP16) for outlier values. While this approach helps achieve high accuracy and low bitwidth simultaneously, it comes with the limitation that the cost for online outlier detection is excessively high, negating the advantages of quantization. Inspired by these insights, we propose Oaken, an acceleration solution that achieves high accuracy and high performance simultaneously through co-designing algorithm and hardware. To effectively find a sweet spot in the accuracy-performance trade-off space of KV cache quantization, Oaken employs an online-offline hybrid approach, setting outlier thresholds offline, which are then used to determine the quantization scale online. To translate the proposed algorithmic technique into tangible performance gains, Oaken also comes with custom quantization/dequantization engines and memory management units that can be integrated with any LLM accelerators. We built an Oaken accelerator on top of an LLM accelerator, LPU, and conducted a comprehensive evaluation. Our experiments show that for a batch size of 256, Oaken achieves up to 1.58 × throughput improvement over NVIDIA A100 GPU, incurring a minimal accuracy loss of only 0.54% on average, compared to state-of-the-art KV cache quantization techniques.
papers.abstract_cn: 现代大型语言模型（LLM）为系统批量处理多个请求以实现高吞吐量，而批量关注操作具有挑战性，使内存带宽成为关键瓶颈。今天，为了缓解这个问题，社区依赖于具有多个高带宽内存（HBM）通道的高端gpu。不幸的是，HBM的高带宽通常是以有限的内存容量为代价的，需要系统进行扩展，这降低了核心利用率并增加了成本。此外，最近的进展使llm能够使用更长的上下文，这大大增加了键值（KV）缓存大小，进一步加剧了对内存容量的压力。为了降低压力，文献已经探索了KV缓存量化技术，该技术通常对大多数值使用低位宽（例如INT4），有选择地使用高位宽（例如FP16）来处理异常值。虽然这种方法有助于同时实现高精度和低位宽，但它的局限性是在线异常值检测的成本过高，从而抵消了量化的优势。受这些见解的启发，我们提出了Oaken，这是一种通过共同设计算法和硬件同时实现高精度和高性能的加速解决方案。为了有效地在KV缓存量化的精度-性能权衡空间中找到最佳点，Oaken采用了在线-离线混合方法，离线设置离群值阈值，然后在线使用该阈值确定量化尺度。为了将提出的算法技术转化为切实的性能提升，Oaken还提供了定制的量化/去量化引擎和内存管理单元，可以与任何LLM加速器集成。我们在LLM加速器LPU之上构建了Oaken加速器，并进行了全面的评估。我们的实验表明，对于256个批处理，Oaken比NVIDIA A100 GPU的吞吐量提高了1.58倍，与最先进的KV缓存量化技术相比，平均精度损失仅为0.54%。
papers.ai_summary_en: Oaken addresses the memory-capacity and bandwidth bottleneck in high-throughput LLM serving, where large KV caches and expensive online outlier detection limit mixed-precision KV cache quantization. It introduces an online–offline hybrid quantization method that determines outlier thresholds offline and uses them to set quantization scales online, together with custom quantization/dequantization engines and memory-management hardware for LLM accelerators. Implemented on an LPU-based accelerator, Oaken achieves up to 1.58× throughput over an NVIDIA A100 at batch size 256 with only 0.54% average accuracy loss versus state-of-the-art KV cache quantization.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM服务中长上下文KV缓存占用大、内存带宽受限，且现有低比特量化依赖高成本在线异常检测的问题展开研究。其核心方法是Oaken算法-硬件协同设计，通过离线确定异常阈值、在线确定量化尺度的混合KV缓存量化，并配套定制量化/反量化引擎与内存管理单元。实验显示，在批大小256下相较NVIDIA A100最高可提升1.58倍吞吐，同时平均精度损失仅约0.54%。

papers.title: Past-Future Scheduler for LLM Serving under SLA Guarantees
papers.authors: Ruihao Gong, Shihao Bai, Siyu Wu, Yunqian Fan, Zaijun Wang
papers.abstract_en: The exploration and application of Large Language Models (LLMs) is thriving. To reduce deployment costs, continuous batching has become an essential feature in current service frameworks. The effectiveness of continuous batching relies on an accurate estimate of the memory requirements of requests. However, due to the diversity in request output lengths, existing frameworks tend to adopt aggressive or conservative schedulers, which often result in significant overestimation or underestimation of memory consumption. Consequently, they suffer from harmful request evictions or prolonged queuing times, failing to achieve satisfactory throughput under strict Service Level Agreement (SLA) guarantees (a.k.a. goodput), across various LLM application scenarios with differing input-output length distributions. To address this issue, we propose a novel Past-Future scheduler that precisely estimates the peak memory resources required by the running batch via considering the historical distribution of request output lengths and calculating memory occupancy at each future time point. It adapts to applications with all types of input-output length distributions, balancing the trade-off between request queuing and harmful evictions, thereby consistently achieving better goodput. Furthermore, to validate the effectiveness of the proposed scheduler, we developed a high-performance LLM serving framework, LightLLM, that implements the Past-Future scheduler. Compared to existing aggressive or conservative schedulers, LightLLM demonstrates superior goodput, achieving up to 2-3× higher goodput than other schedulers under heavy loads. LightLLM is open source to boost the research in such direction (https://github.com/ModelTC/lightllm).
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）的探索和应用正在蓬勃发展。为了降低部署成本，连续批处理已成为当前服务框架的基本特性。连续批处理的有效性依赖于对请求的内存需求的准确估计。然而，由于请求输出长度的多样性，现有框架倾向于采用激进或保守的调度器，这通常会导致对内存消耗的严重高估或低估。因此，在具有不同输入输出长度分布的各种LLM应用程序场景中，它们遭受有害的请求驱逐或延长的排队时间，无法在严格的服务水平协议（SLA）保证（又称goodput）下实现令人满意的吞吐量。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新的过去-未来调度器，它通过考虑请求输出长度的历史分布和计算每个未来时间点的内存占用来精确估计运行批处理所需的峰值内存资源。它适用于具有所有类型的输入-输出长度分布的应用程序，平衡了请求排队和有害驱逐之间的权衡，从而始终实现更好的good - put。此外，为了验证所建议的调度器的有效性，我们开发了一个高性能的LLM服务框架LightLLM，它实现了过去-未来调度器。与现有的主动调度器或保守调度器相比，LightLLM表现出了卓越的good - put，在高负载下实现的good - put是其他调度器的2-3倍。LightLLM是开源的，旨在推动这方面的研究（https://github.com/ModelTC/lightllm）。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses LLM serving under continuous batching and SLA guarantees, where inaccurate memory estimation for variable output lengths causes either harmful request evictions or excessive queuing, reducing goodput. It proposes a Past-Future scheduler that estimates the peak memory required by the running batch using historical output-length distributions and explicit memory-occupancy projections at future time points, enabling adaptation to diverse input-output length patterns. Implemented in the open-source LightLLM framework, the method balances queuing and eviction trade-offs and achieves up to 2–3× higher goodput than aggressive or conservative schedulers under heavy load.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对 LLM 服务中连续批处理因输出长度不确定导致内存估计偏差，从而引发请求驱逐或排队、难以在 SLA 约束下保持高 goodput 的问题。  
其核心方法是提出 Past-Future 调度器：结合历史输出长度分布与未来各时间点的内存占用预测，精确估计运行批次的峰值内存需求，从而在排队延迟和有害驱逐之间取得平衡。  
基于该调度器实现的 LightLLM 在重负载下相较激进或保守调度器可将 goodput 提升最高 2–3 倍，并已开源。

papers.title: ADOR: A Design Exploration Framework for LLM Serving with Enhanced Latency and Throughput
papers.authors: Junsoo Kim, Hunjong Lee, Geonwoo Ko, Gyubin Choi, Seri Ham
papers.abstract_en: The growing adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) across various domains has driven the demand for efficient and scalable AI-serving solutions. Deploying LLMs requires optimizations to manage their significant computational and data demands. The prefill stage processes large numbers of input tokens in parallel, increasing computational load, while the decoding stage relies heavily on memory bandwidth due to the auto-regressive nature of LLMs. Current hardware, such as GPUs, often fails to balance these demands, leading to inefficient utilization. While batching improves hardware efficiency, it delays response times, degrading Quality-of-Service (QoS). This disconnect between vendors, who aim to maximize resource efficiency, and users, who prioritize low latency, highlights the need for a better solution. To address this, we propose ADOR, a framework that automatically identifies and recommends hardware architectures tailored to LLM serving. By lever-aging predefined architecture templates specialized for heterogeneous dataflows, ADOR optimally balances throughput and latency. It efficiently explores design spaces to suggest architectures that meet the requirements of both vendors and users. ADOR demonstrates substantial performance improvements, achieving $2.51 \times$ higher QoS and $4.01 \times$ better area efficiency compared to the A100 at high batch sizes, making it a robust solution for scalable and cost-effective LLM serving.
papers.abstract_cn: 越来越多的大型语言模型（llm）在各个领域的采用推动了对高效和可扩展的人工智能服务解决方案的需求。部署llm需要进行优化，以管理其大量的计算和数据需求。预填充阶段并行处理大量输入令牌，增加了计算负荷，而解码阶段由于llm的自回归特性严重依赖内存带宽。当前的硬件，如gpu，经常无法平衡这些需求，导致低效的利用。虽然批处理提高了硬件效率，但它延迟了响应时间，降低了服务质量（QoS）。以最大化资源效率为目标的供应商和优先考虑低延迟的用户之间的这种脱节突出了对更好的解决方案的需求。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了ADOR，这是一个自动识别并推荐为LLM服务量身定制的硬件架构的框架。通过利用专门用于异构数据流的预定义体系结构模板，ADOR可以最佳地平衡吞吐量和延迟。它有效地探索设计空间，以提出满足供应商和用户需求的体系结构。与A100相比，ADOR表现出了显著的性能改进，在高批量规模下实现了2.51倍的QoS和4.01倍的区域效率，使其成为可扩展且具有成本效益的LLM服务的强大解决方案。
papers.ai_summary_en: ADOR addresses the latency–throughput tradeoff in LLM serving caused by compute-intensive prefill and memory-bandwidth-bound autoregressive decoding, where batching improves utilization but harms QoS. It automatically explores heterogeneous accelerator design spaces using predefined architecture templates specialized for LLM dataflows to recommend configurations that balance throughput and latency. The framework achieves up to 2.51× higher QoS and 4.01× better area efficiency than an A100 at high batch sizes.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM 服务中 prefill 计算密集、decode 访存密集导致 GPU 难以兼顾吞吐与延迟/QoS 的问题，提出 ADOR 设计探索框架。它通过面向异构数据流的预定义架构模板，自动搜索并推荐能平衡吞吐和延迟的 LLM 服务硬件架构。实验显示，在高 batch size 下相较 A100 可提升 2.51× QoS 和 4.01× 面积效率，为低成本、可扩展 LLM 推理硬件设计提供了有效方案。

papers.title: Prompt-Aware Scheduling for Low-Latency LLM Serving
papers.authors: Yiheng Tao, Yihe Zhang, M. Dearing, Xin Wang, Yuping Fan
papers.abstract_en: Efficient scheduling of LLM inference tasks is essential for achieving low latency and high throughput, particularly with the growing use of reasoning-capable LLMs. Traditional strategies like First-Come-First-Serve (FCFS) often suffer from Head-of-Line (HOL) blocking, where long-running tasks delay shorter ones queued behind them. In this paper, we introduce PARS, a prompt-aware LLM task scheduler that improves serving efficiency by approximating shortest-job-first (SJF) scheduling through pairwise ranking with margin ranking loss. PARS focuses on impactful scheduling decisions and is seamlessly integrated into the state-of-the-art LLM serving system vLLM. It effectively predicts response-length-based task ordering, reducing latency with minimal overhead. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and real-world inference datasets show that PARS significantly improves performance, including for reasoning workloads. Furthermore, our cross-model evaluations demonstrate that the design generalizes well, enabling effective scheduling even when predictors are trained on different LLMs.
papers.abstract_cn: LLM推理任务的有效调度对于实现低延迟和高吞吐量至关重要，特别是随着推理能力LLM的使用越来越多。像先到先服务（FCFS）这样的传统策略经常会遇到排队排队（HOL）阻塞，即长时间运行的任务会延迟排在它们后面的较短的任务。本文介绍了一个具有提示意识的LLM任务调度程序PARS，它通过带边际排序损失的两两排序近似于最短作业优先（SJF）调度来提高服务效率。PARS专注于有效的调度决策，并无缝集成到最先进的LLM服务系统vLLM中。它有效地预测基于响应长度的任务排序，以最小的开销减少延迟。跨多个llm和真实推理数据集的广泛实验表明，PARS显著提高了性能，包括推理工作负载。此外，我们的跨模型评估表明，该设计具有良好的泛化性，即使预测器在不同的llm上训练，也能实现有效的调度。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles head-of-line blocking and tail latency in LLM inference serving, where FCFS scheduling lets long-running requests delay shorter queued requests. PARS is a prompt-aware scheduler integrated into vLLM that approximates shortest-job-first by learning pairwise response-length rankings with a margin ranking loss to prioritize likely shorter jobs. Experiments across multiple LLMs and real-world datasets show significant latency reductions with minimal overhead and strong cross-model generalization, including for reasoning workloads.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM 推理服务中 FCFS 调度导致的头阻塞问题，即长请求拖延短请求、增大延迟。其核心方法是提出 PARS：一个提示感知调度器，通过带 margin ranking loss 的成对排序来近似最短作业优先调度，并低开销地集成到 vLLM 中。实验表明，PARS 在多种模型和真实数据集上显著降低服务延迟，且对推理型负载和跨模型场景具有良好泛化性。

papers.title: FastTree: Optimizing Attention Kernel and Runtime for Tree-Structured LLM Inference
papers.authors: Zaifeng Pan, Yitong Ding, Yue Guan, Zheng Wang, Zhongkai Yu
papers.abstract_en: Tree-structured prefix sharing is prevalent in recent large language model (LLM) applications. Existing LLM serving systems use a radix tree to organize the global key-value (KV) cache, facilitating cache reuse across different queries and thus reducing unnecessary memory use. Despite this, these systems still rely on conventional computation patterns for attention operations, resulting in redundant memory loads and GPU tensor core underutilization. To address these limitations, we present FastTree, which introduces GPU kernels tailored for efficiently processing queries that share contexts through the radix tree. To effectively employ the FastTree kernels, a significant challenge arises in finding optimal context-queries groups with a given KV cache tree, as the varying shared prefixes between queries create a giant decision space. To tackle this, we propose tree structure-adaptive runtime optimization within FastTree, applying a greedy heuristic to partition the tree to minimize overhead and splitting lengthy contexts to mitigate the tail effect. FastTree is built upon SGLang, and extensive experiments demonstrate that it improves the throughput of SGLang by up to 2.2×.
papers.abstract_cn: 树结构化前缀共享在最近的大语言模型 (LLM) 应用中非常普遍。现有的 LLM 服务系统使用基数树来组织全局键值 (KV) 缓存，促进缓存在不同查询之间的重用，从而减少不必要的内存使用。尽管如此，这些系统仍然依赖于传统的注意力操作计算模式，导致冗余的内存负载和 GPU 张量核心利用不足。为了解决这些限制，我们引入了 FastTree，它引入了 GPU 内核，专门用于高效处理通过基数树共享上下文的查询。为了有效地使用 FastTree 内核，在寻找具有给定 KV 缓存树的最优上下文查询组时面临着一个重大挑战，因为查询之间不同的共享前缀创造了巨大的决策空间。为了解决这个问题，我们提出在 FastTree 内进行树结构自适应运行时优化，应用贪婪启发式来划分树以最小化开销，并分割冗长的上下文以减轻尾部效应。FastTree 基于 SGLang 构建，广泛的实验表明，它可以将 SGLang 的吞吐量提高多达 2.2 倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: FastTree addresses inefficient attention execution in tree-structured LLM inference, where radix-tree KV cache reuse is common but conventional attention kernels still incur redundant memory loads and underutilize GPU tensor cores. It introduces GPU kernels optimized for attention over queries sharing prefixes in a radix KV cache, together with a tree-adaptive runtime that greedily partitions the cache tree into context–query groups and splits long contexts to reduce overhead and tail effects. Implemented atop SGLang, FastTree improves serving throughput by up to 2.2×.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对树状前缀共享的 LLM 推理中，现有系统虽用 radix tree 复用 KV cache 但 attention 计算仍存在冗余显存读取和 tensor core 利用不足的问题。  
FastTree 设计了面向共享上下文的定制 GPU attention kernel，并提出树结构自适应的运行时优化，通过贪心分区 KV cache 树和拆分长上下文来降低调度开销与尾延迟。  
在 SGLang 上实验显示，该方法可将推理吞吐提升最高 2.2 倍。

papers.title: FireQ: Fast INT4-FP8 Kernel and RoPE-aware Quantization for LLM Inference Acceleration
papers.authors: Daehyeon Baek, Jieun Choi, Jimyoung Son, Kyungmin Bin, Seungbeom Choi
papers.abstract_en: As large language models become increasingly prevalent, memory bandwidth constraints significantly limit inference throughput, motivating post-training quantization (PTQ). In this paper, we propose FireQ, a co-designed PTQ framework and an INT4-FP8 matrix multiplication kernel that accelerates LLM inference across all linear layers. Specifically, FireQ quantizes linear layer weights and key-values to INT4, and activations and queries to FP8, significantly enhancing throughput. Additionally, we introduce a three-stage pipelining for the prefill phase, which modifies the FlashAttention-3 kernel, effectively reducing time-to-first-token in the prefill phase. To minimize accuracy loss from quantization, we develop novel outlier smoothing techniques tailored separately for linear and attention layers. In linear layers, we explicitly use per-tensor scaling to prevent underflow caused by the FP8 quantization scaling factor of INT4 quantization, and channel-wise scaling to compensate for coarse granularity of INT4. In attention layers, we address quantization challenges posed by rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) by combining pre-RoPE and post-RoPE scaling strategies. FireQ significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving 1.68x faster inference in feed-forward network layers on Llama2-7B and 1.26x faster prefill phase performance on Llama3-8B compared to QServe, with negligible accuracy loss.
papers.abstract_cn: 随着大型语言模型的日益普及，内存带宽限制极大地限制了推理吞吐量，从而激发了训练后量化（PTQ）。在本文中，我们提出了FireQ，一个共同设计的PTQ框架和一个INT4-FP8矩阵乘法内核，可以加速所有线性层的LLM推理。具体来说，FireQ将线性层权重和键值量化为INT4，将激活和查询量化为FP8，从而显著提高了吞吐量。此外，我们为预填充阶段引入了一个三阶段的流水线，它修改了FlashAttention-3内核，有效地减少了预填充阶段到第一个令牌的时间。为了最大限度地减少量化的精度损失，我们开发了新的离群平滑技术，分别为线性层和注意层量身定制。在线性层中，我们明确地使用每个张量缩放来防止由INT4量化的FP8缩放因子引起的下溢，并使用通道缩放来补偿INT4的粗粒度。在注意层，我们通过结合RoPE前和RoPE后缩放策略来解决旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）带来的量化挑战。FireQ明显优于最先进的方法，与QServe相比，在Llama2-7B的前馈网络层中实现了1.68倍的推理速度，在Llama3-8B上实现了1.26倍的预填充阶段性能，而精度损失可以忽略不计。
papers.ai_summary_en: FireQ addresses memory-bandwidth-bound LLM inference by introducing a post-training quantization framework and INT4-FP8 matrix multiplication kernel that quantizes weights and key-values to INT4 while keeping activations and queries in FP8. Its key contributions are outlier-aware scaling for linear layers, RoPE-aware pre-/post-scaling for attention quantization, and a FlashAttention-3-based three-stage prefill pipeline that reduces time-to-first-token. Experiments show negligible accuracy loss, with 1.68× faster feed-forward inference on Llama2-7B and 1.26× faster prefill on Llama3-8B compared to QServe.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型推理受内存带宽限制的问题，提出 FireQ：一种训练后量化框架与 INT4-FP8 矩阵乘内核协同设计，通过将权重/KV 量化为 INT4、激活/Query 量化为 FP8，并引入三阶段流水线优化 prefill 阶段。其核心洞见是面向线性层与注意力层分别设计异常值平滑策略，尤其是用 per-tensor/channel-wise scaling 缓解 FP8/INT4 量化误差，并结合 pre-/post-RoPE scaling 处理 RoPE 带来的量化难题。实验显示，FireQ 在 Llama2-7B 前馈层推理加速 1.68×、Llama3-8B prefill 相比 QServe 加速 1.26×，且精度损失可忽略。

papers.title: Online Pseudo-average Shifting Attention(PASA) for Robust Low-precision LLM Inference: Algorithms and Numerical Analysis
papers.authors: Long Cheng, Qichen Liao, Fan Wu, Junlin Mu, Tengfei Han
papers.abstract_en: Attention calculation is extremely time-consuming for long-sequence inference tasks, such as text or image/video generation, in large models. To accelerate this process, we developed a low-precision, mathematically-equivalent algorithm called PASA, based on Flash Attention. PASA introduces two novel techniques: online pseudo-average shifting and global recovering. These techniques enable the use of half-precision computation throughout the Flash Attention process without incurring overflow instability or unacceptable numerical accuracy loss. This algorithm enhances performance on memory-restricted AI hardware architectures, such as the Ascend Neural-network Processing Unit(NPU), by reducing data movement and increasing computational FLOPs. The algorithm is validated using both designed random benchmarks and real large models. We find that the large bias and amplitude of attention input data are critical factors contributing to numerical overflow ($>65504$ for half precision) in two different categories of large models (Qwen2-7B language models and Stable-Video-Diffusion multi-modal models). Specifically, overflow arises due to the large bias in the sequence dimension and the resonance mechanism between the query and key in the head dimension of the Stable-Video-Diffusion models. The resonance mechanism is defined as phase coincidence or 180-degree phase shift between query and key matrices. It will remarkably amplify the element values of attention score matrix. This issue also applies to the Qwen models. Additionally, numerical accuracy is assessed through root mean square error (RMSE) and by comparing the final generated texts and videos to those produced using high-precision attention.
papers.abstract_cn: 在大型模型中，对于长序列推理任务（如文本或图像/视频生成），注意力计算非常耗时。为了加速这一过程，我们开发了一种低精度，数学等效的算法，称为PASA，基于闪光注意。PASA引入了两种新技术：在线伪平均移位和全局恢复。这些技术可以在整个闪光注意过程中使用半精度计算，而不会引起溢出不稳定或不可接受的数值精度损失。该算法通过减少数据移动和增加计算FLOPs来提高内存受限的AI硬件架构（如Ascend神经网络处理单元（NPU））的性能。该算法通过设计的随机基准和实际的大型模型进行了验证。我们发现，在两种不同类型的大型模型（Qwen2-7B语言模型和Stable-Video-Diffusion多模态模型）中，注意输入数据的大偏差和振幅是导致数值溢出（$>65504$为半精度）的关键因素。具体来说，溢流是由于稳定视频扩散模型中序列维的较大偏置和头部维查询与键之间的共振机制造成的。共振机制定义为查询矩阵和键矩阵之间的相位重合或180度相移。它将显著放大注意力得分矩阵的元素值。这个问题同样适用于Qwen模型。此外，数值精度通过均方根误差（RMSE）进行评估，并通过将最终生成的文本和视频与使用高精度注意力生成的文本和视频进行比较。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses overflow and accuracy loss in half-precision FlashAttention for long-sequence LLM and multimodal inference, where large attention biases and query–key resonance can exceed FP16 range. It proposes PASA, a mathematically equivalent attention kernel that uses online pseudo-average shifting to remove large biases during tiled computation and global recovering to restore the correct outputs, enabling end-to-end FP16 attention. Experiments and numerical analysis on Qwen2-7B and Stable Video Diffusion show stable low-precision inference with RMSE and generated outputs close to high-precision baselines, while improving efficiency on memory-bound hardware such as Ascend NPUs.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长序列大模型推理中 FlashAttention 半精度计算易因输入大偏置、大幅值以及 query/key 共振导致溢出的问题，提出了 PASA：一种基于 FlashAttention 的数学等价低精度注意力算法。其核心方法是在线伪平均移位与全局恢复，使注意力全流程可在半精度下稳定运行，同时减少数据搬运、提升计算密度。实验在 Qwen2-7B、Stable Video Diffusion 和随机基准上验证了该方法能有效避免溢出并保持 RMSE 与生成质量接近高精度注意力，适用于 Ascend NPU 等内存受限硬件。

papers.title: VQ-LLM: High-performance Code Generation for Vector Quantization Augmented LLM Inference
papers.authors: Zihan Liu, Xinhao Luo, Junxian Guo, Wentao Ni, Yangjie Zhou
papers.abstract_en: Vector quantization (VQ), which treats a vector as a compression unit, gains increasing research interests for its potential to accelerate large language models (LLMs). Compared to conventional element-wise quantization methods, VQ algorithms can compress weight and KV cache tensors in LLMs with a greater ratio while maintaining the high model accuracy. However, translating a VQ algorithm’s memory reduction into the actual latency improvement is challenging. We profile and analyze the current approach of integrating VQ into computation kernels and show that its major inefficiency lies in the poor access efficiency of codebooks in VQ algorithms and uncoordinated computation dataflow. Meanwhile, the diversity of VQ algorithms (e.g., different vector sizes and entry counts) and LLMs, computation kernels (e.g matrix-matrix/vector multiplication and attention computation) makes it impractical to manually craft efficient kernel implementations for each specific case. In this work, we design and implement VQ-LLM, an efficient fused VQ kernel generation framework. We first introduce a software abstraction called codebook cache to optimize codebook access efficiency and support the integration of VQ with various computations. The codebook cache adaptively stores different entries across the GPU’s memory hierarchy, including off-chip global memory, on-chip shared memory, and registers. Centered around the codebook cache, we design an efficient computation engine that optimizes memory traffic during computations involving codebooks. This compute engine adopts the codebook-centric dataflow and fusion optimizations. Additionally, we provide adaptive heuristics to tailor parameter selection in our optimizations to diverse VQ configurations. Our optimizations achieve the latency reduction of $\mathbf{6 4. 3 6 \%}$ to $\mathbf{9 9. 1 \%}$ compared to existing open-source implementations. A final comparison with state-of-the-art element-wise quantization methods like AWQ and QoQ shows that our VQ-LLM is practically viable, achieving latencies close or even better latencies to those at equivalent bit-widths, potentially offering greater accuracy.
papers.abstract_cn: 向量量化（VQ）将向量作为压缩单元，因其加速大型语言模型（llm）的潜力而获得越来越多的研究兴趣。与传统的元素量化方法相比，VQ算法可以在保持较高模型精度的同时，以更高的比例压缩llm中的权重和KV缓存张量。然而，将VQ算法的内存减少转化为实际的延迟改善是具有挑战性的。本文分析了目前将VQ集成到计算核中的方法，指出其主要的低效率在于VQ算法中码本的访问效率低和计算数据流不协调。同时，VQ算法的多样性（例如，不同的向量大小和入口计数）和llm，计算内核（例如矩阵-矩阵/向量乘法和注意力计算）使得为每个特定情况手工制作高效的内核实现变得不切实际。在这项工作中，我们设计并实现了一个高效的融合VQ内核生成框架VQ- llm。我们首先引入一种称为码本缓存的软件抽象来优化码本访问效率，并支持VQ与各种计算的集成。码本缓存自适应地存储GPU内存层次结构中的不同条目，包括片外全局内存、片上共享内存和寄存器。围绕码本缓存，我们设计了一个高效的计算引擎，在涉及码本的计算过程中优化内存流量。该计算引擎采用以码本为中心的数据流和融合优化。此外，我们还提供了自适应启发式方法，以便在优化中根据不同的VQ配置定制参数选择。我们的优化实现了$\mathbf{6.4的延迟减少。3 6 \%}$到$\mathbf{91 \%}$与现有的开源实现相比。与最先进的元素量化方法（如AWQ和QoQ）的最后比较表明，我们的VQ-LLM实际上是可行的，其延迟接近甚至优于同等位宽的延迟，可能提供更高的准确性。
papers.ai_summary_en: VQ-LLM addresses the difficulty of converting vector quantization’s high compression ratios for LLM weights and KV caches into real inference latency gains, since existing kernels suffer from inefficient codebook accesses, poor dataflow coordination, and impractical manual specialization across VQ configurations and operators. It introduces a fused VQ kernel generation framework built around a codebook-cache abstraction that adaptively places codebook entries across global memory, shared memory, and registers, combined with a codebook-centric compute engine, fusion optimizations, and adaptive heuristics. The system reduces latency by 64.36%–99.1% over open-source VQ implementations and achieves performance close to or better than state-of-the-art element-wise quantization methods such as AWQ and QoQ at comparable bit-widths, with potential accuracy advantages.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对LLM推理中向量量化虽能高比率压缩权重/KV缓存，却因码本访问低效和数据流不协调难以转化为实际加速的问题，本文提出VQ-LLM。其核心是引入“码本缓存”抽象，将码本自适应地放置于全局内存、共享内存和寄存器中，并围绕它设计以码本为中心的融合内核生成与数据流优化，同时用启发式适配不同VQ配置和计算内核。实验表明，相较开源VQ实现延迟降低64.36%–99.1%，在相同比特宽度下可达到或优于AWQ、QoQ等逐元素量化方法的延迟，并可能带来更高精度。

papers.title: 98$\times$ Faster LLM Routing Without a Dedicated GPU: Flash Attention, Prompt Compression, and Near-Streaming for the vLLM Semantic Router
papers.authors: Xunzhuo Liu, Bowei He, Xue Liu, Andy Luo, Haichen Zhang
papers.abstract_en: System-level routers that intercept LLM requests for safety classification, domain routing, and PII detection must be both fast and operationally lightweight: they should add minimal latency to every request, yet not require a dedicated GPU -- an expensive resource better used for LLM inference itself. When the router co-locates on the same GPU as vLLM serving instances, standard attention's $O(n^2)$ memory makes long-context classification (8K--32K tokens) impossible: at 8K tokens, three concurrent classifiers need ${\sim}$4.5\,GB for attention masks alone, far exceeding the memory left by vLLM. We present three staged optimizations for the vLLM Semantic Router, benchmarked on AMD Instinct MI300X, that solve both the latency and the memory problem. \emph{Stage~1}: a custom CK Flash Attention operator for ONNX Runtime on ROCm reduces attention memory from $O(n^2)$ to $O(n)$ and end-to-end (E2E) latency from 4{,}918\,ms to 127\,ms (\textbf{38.7$\times$}), enabling 8K--32K tokens where SDPA OOMs. \emph{Stage~2}: classical NLP prompt compression (TextRank, position weighting, TF-IDF, and novelty scoring) reduces all inputs to ${\sim}$512 tokens without neural inference, capping both latency and GPU memory at a constant regardless of original prompt length (E2E 127$\to$62\,ms, \textbf{2.0$\times$}). \emph{Stage~3}: near-streaming body processing with adaptive chunking and zero-copy JSON eliminates serialization overhead (E2E 62$\to$50\,ms, \textbf{1.2$\times$}). Cumulatively: \textbf{98$\times$} improvement (4{,}918\,ms to 50\,ms), 16K-token routing in 108\,ms, and a total router GPU footprint under 800\,MB -- small enough to share a GPU with LLM serving and removing the need for a dedicated accelerator. Stage~1 targets AMD ROCm (NVIDIA GPUs already have FlashAttention via cuDNN); Stages~2 and~3 are hardware-agnostic.
papers.abstract_cn: 拦截LLM请求进行安全分类、域路由和PII检测的系统级路由器必须既快速又操作轻量级：它们应该为每个请求添加最小的延迟，但不需要专用GPU——这是一种昂贵的资源，最好用于LLM推理本身。当路由器与vLLM服务实例位于同一GPU上时，标准注意力的$O(n^2)$内存使得长上下文分类（8K—32K令牌）不可能实现：在8K令牌时，三个并发分类器仅用于注意力掩码就需要${\sim}$ 4.5\，GB，远远超过vLLM留下的内存。我们对vLLM语义路由器进行了三个阶段的优化，以AMD Instinct MI300X为基准，解决了延迟和内存问题。\emph{第一阶段}：用于ROCm上ONNX运行时的自定义CK Flash注意力操作符，将注意力内存从$O(n^2)$减少到$O(n)$，端到端（E2E）延迟从4,918\，ms减少到127\，ms ({}\textbf{38.7$\times$})，在SDPA OOMs中启用8K—32K令牌。\emph{第二阶段}：经典的NLP提示压缩（TextRank，位置加权，TF-IDF和新颖性评分）将所有输入减少到${\sim}$ 512个令牌，没有神经推理，将延迟和GPU内存限制在一个常量，而不管原始提示长度（E2E 127 $\to$ 62\,ms, \textbf{2.0$\times$}）。\emph{第三阶段}：使用自适应分块和零拷贝JSON的近流体处理消除了序列化开销（E2E 62 $\to$ 50\,ms, \textbf{1.2$\times$}）。累积：\textbf{98$\times$}改进（4,918\，ms至50\，ms）， 16k令牌路由在108\，ms内，以及路由器GPU总占用空间低于800\，MB -小到足以与LLM服务共享GPU，并且无需专用加速器。第一阶段的目标是AMD ROCm (NVIDIA gpu已经通过cuDNN实现FlashAttention)；第二和第三阶段与硬件无关。{}
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the latency and memory bottleneck of co-locating LLM semantic routers for safety, routing, and PII detection on the same GPU as vLLM, where standard quadratic attention makes long-context classification infeasible without a dedicated accelerator. It proposes a three-stage system: a ROCm/CK Flash Attention operator for ONNX Runtime to reduce attention memory to linear, classical NLP prompt compression to cap inputs at ~512 tokens, and near-streaming request processing with adaptive chunking and zero-copy JSON. The combined optimizations achieve a 98× end-to-end latency reduction (4,918 ms to 50 ms), route 16K-token prompts in 108 ms, and keep GPU memory under 800 MB, enabling lightweight CPU/GPU-shared inference routing.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对与 vLLM 共置 GPU 的语义路由器在长上下文安全分类/路由中因标准注意力 O(n²) 内存和高延迟而难以轻量运行的问题。核心方法是分阶段优化：在 ROCm 上为 ONNX Runtime 定制 CK Flash Attention 将注意力内存降为 O(n)，再用无神经提示压缩把输入压到约 512 token，并通过近流式零拷贝 JSON 处理消除序列化开销。结果显示，在 MI300X 上端到端延迟从 4.9 秒降至 50 毫秒（98×），16K token 路由仅需 108 毫秒，GPU 占用低于 800MB，可与 LLM 推理共享 GPU 而无需专用加速器。

papers.title: Accelerating LLM Inference Throughput via Asynchronous KV Cache Prefetching
papers.authors: Yanhao Dong, Yubo Miao, Weinan Li, Xiaoyu Zheng, Chao Wang
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit pronounced memory-bound characteristics during inference due to High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) bandwidth constraints. In this paper, we propose an L2 Cache-oriented asynchronous KV Cache prefetching method to break through the memory bandwidth bottleneck in LLM inference through computation-load overlap. By strategically scheduling idle memory bandwidth during active computation windows, our method proactively prefetches required KV Cache into GPU L2 cache, enabling high-speed L2 cache hits for subsequent accesses and effectively hiding HBM access latency within computational cycles. Extensive experiments on NVIDIA H20 GPUs demonstrate that the proposed method achieves 2.15× improvement in attention kernel efficiency and up to 1.97× end-to-end throughput enhancement, surpassing state-of-the-art baseline FlashAttention-3. Notably, our solution maintains orthogonality to existing optimization techniques and can be integrated with current inference frameworks, providing a scalable latency-hiding solution for next-generation LLM inference engines.
papers.abstract_cn: 由于高带宽内存（HBM）带宽限制，大型语言模型（llm）在推理过程中表现出明显的内存约束特征。本文提出了一种面向L2缓存的异步KV缓存预取方法，通过计算负载重叠来突破LLM推理中的内存带宽瓶颈。通过在活动计算窗口期间战略性地调度空闲内存带宽，我们的方法主动将所需的KV缓存预取到GPU L2缓存中，为后续访问提供高速L2缓存命中，并在计算周期内有效地隐藏HBM访问延迟。在NVIDIA H20 gpu上的大量实验表明，该方法实现了2.15倍的注意力核效率提高和高达1.97倍的端到端吞吐量提高，超过了最先进的基线FlashAttention-3。值得注意的是，我们的解决方案与现有的优化技术保持正交性，并且可以与当前的推理框架集成，为下一代LLM推理引擎提供可扩展的延迟隐藏解决方案。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses memory-bandwidth-bound LLM inference, where KV-cache accesses from HBM limit attention throughput. It proposes an asynchronous, L2-cache-oriented KV-cache prefetching scheme that schedules prefetches during compute-active windows to hide HBM latency and make subsequent attention reads hit in GPU L2 cache. On NVIDIA H20 GPUs, it reports a 2.15× attention-kernel speedup and up to 1.97× end-to-end throughput improvement over FlashAttention-3, while remaining orthogonal to existing inference optimizations.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型推理中由HBM带宽限制导致的KV Cache访问瓶颈，重点解决注意力计算受内存带宽约束的问题。其核心方法是面向GPU L2 Cache进行异步KV Cache预取，在计算执行期间利用空闲内存带宽提前加载所需KV，从而用计算掩盖HBM访问延迟。实验显示，在NVIDIA H20上注意力核效率提升2.15倍、端到端吞吐最高提升1.97倍，并可与现有优化技术正交集成。

papers.title: Mustafar: Promoting Unstructured Sparsity for KV Cache Pruning in LLM Inference
papers.authors: Donghyeon Joo, Helya Hosseini, Ramyad Hadidi, Bahar Asgari
papers.abstract_en: We demonstrate that unstructured sparsity significantly improves KV cache compression for LLMs, enabling sparsity levels up to 70% without compromising accuracy or requiring fine-tuning. We conduct a systematic exploration of pruning strategies and find per-token magnitude-based pruning as highly effective for both Key and Value caches under unstructured sparsity, surpassing prior structured pruning schemes. The Key cache benefits from prominent outlier elements, while the Value cache surprisingly benefits from a simple magnitude-based pruning despite its uniform distribution. KV cache size is the major bottleneck in decode performance due to high memory overhead for large context lengths. To address this, we use a bitmap-based sparse format and a custom attention kernel capable of compressing and directly computing over compressed caches pruned to arbitrary sparsity patterns, significantly accelerating memory-bound operations in decode computations and thereby compensating for the overhead of runtime pruning and compression. Our custom attention kernel coupled with the bitmap-based format delivers substantial compression of KV cache upto 45% of dense inference and thereby enables longer context length and increased tokens/sec throughput of upto 2.23x compared to dense inference. Our pruning mechanism and sparse attention kernel is available at https://github.com/dhjoo98/mustafar.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们证明了非结构化稀疏性显著提高了llm的KV缓存压缩，在不影响精度或需要微调的情况下，使稀疏性水平达到70%。我们对修剪策略进行了系统的探索，并发现基于每个令牌大小的修剪对于非结构化稀疏性下的键和值缓存都非常有效，超过了先前的结构化修剪方案。Key缓存受益于显著的离群元素，而Value缓存令人惊讶地受益于简单的基于大小的修剪，尽管它的分布是均匀的。KV缓存大小是解码性能的主要瓶颈，因为大上下文长度的高内存开销。为了解决这个问题，我们使用了一个基于位图的稀疏格式和一个定制的注意力内核，它能够压缩和直接计算压缩后的缓存，这些缓存被修剪为任意稀疏模式，这大大加快了解码计算中的内存绑定操作，从而补偿了运行时修剪和压缩的开销。我们的自定义注意力内核与基于位图的格式相结合，提供了大量压缩KV缓存，压缩率高达密集推理的45%，从而实现了更长的上下文长度，与密集推理相比，令牌/秒吞吐量提高了2.23倍。我们的修剪机制和稀疏关注核可以在https://github.com/dhjoo98/mustafar上获得。
papers.ai_summary_en: Mustafar tackles the memory-bound KV-cache bottleneck in long-context LLM decoding by promoting unstructured sparsity instead of structured KV-cache pruning. Its key insight is that simple per-token magnitude pruning is highly effective for both Key and Value caches under unstructured sparsity—Keys benefit from outlier elements while Values remain compressible despite near-uniform distributions—and it implements this with a bitmap-based sparse format plus a custom attention kernel that computes directly over arbitrarily pruned caches. The system achieves up to 70% KV-cache sparsity without fine-tuning or accuracy loss, compresses cache memory to roughly 45% of dense inference, and improves decode throughput by up to 2.23×.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理中KV Cache内存开销过大、限制长上下文解码吞吐的问题，提出采用非结构化稀疏进行KV Cache剪枝，并发现按token的幅值剪枝对Key和Value缓存都很有效，可在无需微调下达到约70%稀疏且基本不损精度。其核心系统贡献是基于bitmap稀疏格式和自定义注意力内核，在解码时直接对任意稀疏模式的压缩KV Cache进行计算，以抵消运行时剪枝与压缩开销。实验表明，该方法可将KV Cache压缩至稠密推理的45%，支持更长上下文，并将tokens/sec吞吐提升至最高2.23倍。

papers.title: MILLION: MasterIng Long-Context LLM Inference Via Outlier-Immunized KV Product QuaNtization
papers.authors: Zongwu Wang, Peng Xu, Fangxin Liu, Yiwei Hu, Qingxiao Sun
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly utilized for complex tasks requiring longer context lengths, with some models supporting up to 128 K or 1 M tokens. This trend, however, presents significant challenges in inference speed and memory management. The primary bottleneck in long-context LLM inference is the quadratic computational complexity of attention mechanisms, causing substantial slowdowns as sequence length increases. KV cache mechanism alleviates this issue by storing pre-computed data, but introduces memory requirements that scale linearly with context length, hindering efficient LLM deployment. Quantization emerges as a promising approach to address the widening gap between LLM size and memory capacity. However, traditional quantization schemes often yield suboptimal compression results for KV caches due to two key factors: i) On-the-fly quantization and de-quantization, causing significant performance overhead; ii) Prevalence of outliers in KV values, challenging low-bitwidth uniform quantization. To this end, we propose MILLION, a novel quantization framework achieving low-bitwidth KV cache through product quantization. First, we conduct a thorough analysis of KV cache distribution, revealing the limitations of existing quantization schemes. Second, we introduce a non-uniform quantization algorithm based on product quantization, which efficiently compresses data while preserving accuracy. Third, we develop a high-performance GPU inference framework with efficient attention kernel and pipeline design for MILLION that leverages sparse computation and asynchronous quantization, significantly enhancing inference speed. Comprehensive evaluation results demonstrate that MILLION can achieve 4 bits quantization with trivial perplexity and accuracy loss, and achieve 2.09 x end-to-end performance gains at 32 K context length. Code is released at https://github.com/ZongwuWang/MILLION.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）越来越多地用于需要更长的上下文长度的复杂任务，一些模型支持多达128 K或1m的令牌。然而，这种趋势在推理速度和内存管理方面提出了重大挑战。长上下文LLM推理的主要瓶颈是注意机制的二次计算复杂性，随着序列长度的增加，会导致显著的减速。KV缓存机制通过存储预先计算的数据缓解了这个问题，但引入的内存需求会随着上下文长度线性扩展，阻碍了LLM的有效部署。量化是解决LLM大小和内存容量之间日益扩大的差距的一种有前途的方法。然而，由于两个关键因素，传统的量化方案通常会对KV缓存产生次优压缩结果：1)动态量化和去量化，导致显著的性能开销；ii) KV值异常值的流行，挑战低比特宽均匀量化。为此，我们提出了一种新的量化框架MILLION，通过产品量化实现低比特宽KV缓存。首先，我们对KV缓存分布进行了深入的分析，揭示了现有量化方案的局限性。其次，我们引入了一种基于积量化的非均匀量化算法，在保证数据精度的同时有效地压缩了数据。第三，我们开发了一个高性能GPU推理框架，该框架采用高效的关注内核和流水线设计，利用稀疏计算和异步量化，显著提高了推理速度。综合评估结果表明，MILLION可以实现4位量化，且困惑和精度损失很小，在32 K上下文长度下实现2.09倍的端到端性能提升。代码发布在https://github.com/ZongwuWang/MILLION。
papers.ai_summary_en: MILLION addresses the memory and speed bottleneck of long-context LLM inference, where KV caches grow linearly with sequence length and outliers make low-bit uniform quantization inaccurate and costly. It proposes an outlier-robust, non-uniform KV cache compression framework based on product quantization, paired with a GPU attention kernel and pipeline that uses sparse computation and asynchronous quantization to reduce on-the-fly overhead. Evaluations show that MILLION achieves 4-bit KV cache quantization with negligible perplexity/accuracy loss and delivers 2.09× end-to-end speedup at 32K context length.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV cache 内存占用高、传统低比特量化易受离群点和在线量反量化开销影响的问题，提出 MILLION 框架。其核心洞见是通过面向 KV cache 分布的乘积量化实现抗离群点的非均匀低比特压缩，并配套设计稀疏注意力核、异步量化和流水线优化的 GPU 推理系统。实验表明，该方法可在 4-bit KV cache 量化下保持几乎无损的困惑度与精度，并在 32K 上下文长度下取得 2.09 倍端到端推理加速。

papers.title: [GitHub] kvcached: Virtualized Elastic KV Cache for Dynamic GPU Sharing and Beyond
papers.authors: ovg-project
papers.abstract_en: Virtualized Elastic KV Cache for Dynamic GPU Sharing and Beyond
papers.abstract_cn: 用于动态 GPU 共享及其他的虚拟化弹性 KV 缓存
papers.ai_summary_en: kvcached addresses inefficient and rigid KV-cache memory management in LLM inference, where static per-request allocation limits GPU sharing, memory oversubscription, and multi-tenant elasticity. It introduces a virtualized elastic KV-cache layer that decouples logical KV-cache objects from physical GPU memory, using paging, eviction, and dynamic placement to resize, share, and migrate caches at runtime. This enables more flexible GPU sharing and improves memory efficiency and serving throughput for dynamic LLM workloads.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型推理中 KV 缓存静态绑定 GPU 显存、难以共享和弹性扩展，从而限制多模型/多租户动态 GPU 共享效率的问题。提出 kvcached，将 KV 缓存抽象为虚拟化、可弹性伸缩的缓存层，支持跨请求、跨实例的动态分配、共享与迁移。其核心收益是降低显存压力，提升动态 GPU 共享场景下的资源利用率、推理吞吐和部署灵活性。

It provides a streamlined framework for training speculative decoding models and exporting/porting them into SGLang serving with minimal engineering effort. The main impact is to make speculative decoding more accessible in production LLM systems by simplifying draft-model development and enabling smoother integration with an optimized serving stack.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向推测解码中草稿模型训练复杂、与推理服务框架集成困难的问题，提出 SpecForge 工具/框架。其核心思路是提供便捷的草稿模型训练流程，并支持与 SGLang 推理服务的平滑迁移和部署。该工作有望降低推测解码模型的工程门槛，提升大模型推理服务的加速效果与可用性。

papers.abstract_en: An optimized quantization and inference library for running LLMs locally on modern consumer-class GPUs
papers.abstract_cn: 一个用于在现代消费级 GPU 上本地运行大型语言模型的优化量化和推理库

papers.authors: SharpAI

papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向 Apple Silicon 上的本地大模型推理，重点解决 100B+ MoE 模型内存受限和 KV Cache 开销过高的问题。其核心方法是构建基于 MLX 的原生 Swift 推理服务器，结合 SSD 流式加载/卸载与 TurboQuant KV Cache 压缩，并提供 OpenAI 兼容 API。主要影响是提升 macOS/iOS 设备上超大模型的本地可部署性与推理效率。

papers.title: [GitHub] Awesome-LLM-KV-Cache: Awesome-LLM-KV-Cache: A curated list of 📙Awesome LLM KV Cache Papers with Codes.

papers.abstract_en: Awesome-LLM-KV-Cache: A curated list of 📙Awesome LLM KV Cache Papers with Codes.

Its key contribution is a taxonomy of techniques such as KV-cache compression, quantization, eviction, paging, sharing, and offloading, organized for researchers and practitioners. As a curated repository rather than an empirical study, its impact is primarily as a reference and discovery tool rather than a source of new experimental results.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该资源面向大模型推理中 KV Cache 显存占用高、优化研究分散的问题，系统整理了相关论文与代码。其核心方式是按 KV Cache 压缩、量化、驱逐、复用与系统优化等方向构建分类文献列表。它为研究者提供了清晰的入门与追踪索引，有助于推动长上下文推理加速和显存效率提升。
