papers.ai_summary_en: JetStream addresses the problem of high-throughput, memory-efficient LLM inference serving on XLA accelerators, initially targeting TPUs. The key contribution is an inference engine designed to optimize memory utilization and throughput for LLM workloads within the XLA execution stack. Its main impact is providing an open-source serving system that improves scalability and efficiency of LLM deployment on TPUs, with planned extensibility to GPUs.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向 XLA 设备上的大模型推理服务，重点解决 LLM 推理中的吞吐与内存效率问题。其核心思路是构建 JetStream 推理引擎，通过面向 TPU 等 XLA 后端的内存与执行优化来提升服务性能。该引擎为高吞吐、低内存占用的 LLM 部署提供了基础，并预留了对 GPU 等更多设备的扩展支持。

papers.title: [GitHub] InfiniStore: KV cache store for distributed LLM inference
papers.authors: bytedance
papers.abstract_en: We present PolyKV, a system in which multiple concurrent inference agents share a single, asymmetrically compressed KV cache pool. Rather than allocating a separate KV cache per agent -- the standard paradigm -- PolyKV writes a compressed cache once and injects it into N independent agent contexts via HuggingFace DynamicCache objects. Compression is asymmetric: Keys are quantized at int8 (q8_0) to preserve softmax stability, while Values are compressed using TurboQuant MSE -- a Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform (FWHT) rotation followed by 3-bit Lloyd-Max quantization with centroids tuned to N(0,1). We evaluate across two model scales (SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct and Llama-3-8B-Instruct), three context lengths (600-7,194 tokens), and up to 15 concurrent agents. PolyKV achieves a stable 2.91x compression ratio across all configurations. On Llama-3-8B with 15 agents sharing a 4K-token context, PolyKV reduces KV cache memory from 19.8 GB to 0.45 GB -- a 97.7% reduction -- while maintaining only +0.57% perplexity degradation and a mean BERTScore F1 of 0.928. PPL delta does not grow with agent count and improves as context length increases, inverting to -0.26% at 1,851 coherent tokens. To our knowledge, no prior work combines a single shared, lossy-compressed KV pool with multi-reader concurrent agent access.
papers.abstract_cn: 用于分布式大语言模型推理的 KV 缓存存储
papers.ai_summary_en: PolyKV addresses the memory bottleneck of per-agent KV-cache allocation in concurrent distributed LLM inference by enabling multiple inference agents to share a single compressed KV-cache pool. Its key insight is asymmetric compression: int8-quantized keys preserve softmax stability, while values are compressed via FWHT rotation and 3-bit Lloyd-Max quantization tuned to unit-variance activations, then injected into independent DynamicCache contexts. Experiments on SmolLM2-1.7B and Llama-3-8B show a stable 2.91x compression ratio and up to 97.7% memory reduction for 15 agents sharing 4K tokens, with minimal perplexity degradation (+0.57%) and high output fidelity (BERTScore F1 0.928).
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多并发 LLM 推理中每个代理单独维护 KV cache 导致显存开销过大的问题。其核心方法是 PolyKV：多个推理代理共享同一个经非对称压缩的 KV cache 池，其中 Key 采用 int8 量化以保持 softmax 稳定，Value 通过 FWHT 旋转加 3-bit Lloyd-Max 量化进行压缩，并借助 HuggingFace DynamicCache 注入多个上下文。实验显示，该方法在最多 15 个并发代理下可将 Llama-3-8B 的共享 KV 显存从 19.8GB 降至 0.45GB，同时仅带来 +0.57% 的困惑度退化并保持较高生成质量。

papers.title: [GitHub] Spec-Bench: Spec-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark and Unified Evaluation Platform for Speculative Decoding (ACL
papers.authors: hemingkx
papers.abstract_en: Spec-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark and Unified Evaluation Platform for Speculative Decoding (ACL 2024 Findings)
papers.abstract_cn: Spec-Bench：用于推测解码的综合基准和统一评估平台（ACL 2024 研究成果）
papers.ai_summary_en: Spec-Bench addresses the lack of a standardized, fair evaluation framework for speculative decoding, where reported speedups and quality trade-offs are often measured under inconsistent settings. It introduces a unified benchmark and platform that compares speculative decoding methods across diverse models, tasks, and metrics such as acceptance rate, wall-clock speedup, generation quality, and resource overhead. The paper’s large-scale analysis reveals that performance gains are highly dependent on task domain, draft-model alignment, and system configuration, providing practical guidelines and a reproducible foundation for future speculative decoding research.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对推测解码研究评测碎片化、实验设置不一致导致难以公平比较的问题，提出了 Spec-Bench 这一综合基准与统一评估平台。它系统整合多类推测解码方法、模型规模、任务场景和评价指标，在一致环境下衡量加速比、接受率、生成质量及资源开销。实验揭示了不同方法在速度、质量与成本之间的权衡，并强调标准化评测对推动推测解码公平比较与实际部署的重要性。

papers.title: [GitHub] Sequoia: scalable and robust tree-based speculative decoding algorithm
papers.authors: Infini-AI-Lab
papers.abstract_en: scalable and robust tree-based speculative decoding algorithm
papers.abstract_cn: 可扩展且稳健的基于树的推测解码算法
papers.ai_summary_en: Sequoia addresses the inefficiency of standard speculative decoding for LLM inference, where single-chain drafts and hardware-unaware verification limit speedups. Its key idea is to construct scalable, robust draft-token trees by optimizing tree topology under estimated acceptance probabilities and device-dependent verification costs. The method achieves lossless, wall-clock inference speedups and improves over prior speculative decoding approaches across models and datasets.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型推理中投机解码的树形草稿扩展在规模增大时效率与稳定性不足的问题，提出 Sequoia，一种可扩展且鲁棒的树式投机解码算法。其核心思路是通过更有效的候选 token 树组织与验证机制，在扩大草稿搜索空间的同时控制开销并保持输出质量。该方法有望在不同场景下提升推理吞吐，并增强树式投机解码的实用性与鲁棒性。

papers.title: [GitHub] dflash-mlx: Exact speculative decoding on Apple Silicon, powered by MLX.
papers.authors: Aryagm
papers.abstract_en: Exact speculative decoding on Apple Silicon, powered by MLX.
papers.abstract_cn: 在 Apple Silicon 上进行精确推测性解码，由 MLX 提供支持。
papers.ai_summary_en: dflash-mlx addresses the high latency of autoregressive LLM decoding on Apple Silicon by providing an MLX-based implementation of exact speculative decoding. Its key method is to use a smaller draft model to propose candidate token sequences that are then verified in parallel by the target model, preserving the target model’s output distribution exactly. The main impact is lossless inference speedup for local LLM serving on Apple hardware, improving throughput without sacrificing generation fidelity.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向 Apple Silicon 上的大模型推理加速，提供基于 MLX 的“精确”投机解码实现，解决自回归生成延迟高且常见近似加速可能改变输出分布的问题。其核心方法是用草稿模型并行生成候选 token，再由目标模型进行验证与接受/拒绝，从而在不损失目标模型输出精确性的前提下提升解码效率。主要影响是为 MLX 生态和本地 Apple 设备提供了无损精度的投机解码能力，有助于降低推理延迟、提高吞吐。

papers.title: MoA-Off: Adaptive Heterogeneous Modality-Aware Offloading with Edge-Cloud Collaboration for Efficient Multimodal LLM Inference
papers.authors: Zheming Yang, Qi Guo, Yunqing Hu, Chang Zhao, Chang Zhang
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) enable powerful cross-modal inference but impose significant computational and latency burdens, posing severe challenges for deployment in resource-constrained environments. In this paper, we propose MoA-Off, an adaptive heterogeneous modality-aware offloading framework with edge-cloud collaboration for efficient MLLM inference. MoA-Off introduces a lightweight heterogeneous modality-aware module that estimates the complexity of heterogeneous inputs through multi-dimensional feature analysis. Then, an adaptive edge-cloud collaborative offloading strategy is proposed that dynamically schedules workloads between edge and cloud based on modality-aware complexity scores and real-time system states. The experimental results demonstrate that MoA-Off can achieve over 30% reduction in latency and 30%-65% decrease in resource overhead while maintaining competitive accuracy compared to traditional approaches.
papers.abstract_cn: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）能够实现强大的跨模态推理，但带来显著的计算和延迟负担，在资源受限的环境中部署面临严重挑战。本文提出了 MoA-Off，一种具有边-云协作的自适应异构模态感知卸载框架，用于高效的 MLLM 推理。MoA-Off 引入了一个轻量级的异构模态感知模块，通过多维特征分析来估计异构输入的复杂性。随后，提出了一种自适应边-云协作卸载策略，根据模态感知复杂性评分和实时系统状态动态调度边缘与云端之间的工作负载。实验结果表明，与传统方法相比，MoA-Off 在保持竞争性准确率的同时，可实现超过 30% 的延迟降低和 30%-65% 的资源开销下降。
papers.ai_summary_en: MoA-Off addresses the latency and resource bottlenecks of running multimodal large language models in resource-constrained edge environments. It introduces a lightweight modality-aware complexity estimator and an adaptive edge–cloud offloading scheduler that dynamically partitions inference workloads based on input modality characteristics and real-time system state. Experiments show over 30% latency reduction and 30–65% lower resource overhead while maintaining competitive accuracy.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态大模型在资源受限边缘环境下推理延迟高、计算开销大的部署难题，提出了 MoA-Off 这一自适应、异构模态感知的边云协同卸载框架。其核心方法是通过轻量级模态感知模块评估不同输入的复杂度，并结合实时系统状态在边缘与云之间动态调度推理负载。实验表明，该方法在保持竞争力精度的同时，可将延迟降低 30% 以上，并将资源开销减少 30%–65%。

papers.title: Dynamic Offloading Optimization for Multi-Pim LLM Inference
papers.authors: Jeonghoon Kang, Jae Hyung Ko, Taeho Hwang, Kyu Hyun Choi
papers.abstract_en: The growing demand for energy-efficient on-device AI in consumer appliances is drawing significant attention to Processing-In-Memory (PIM) architectures. This trend is largely driven by the proliferation of Large Language Models (LLMs). While these models have enabled remarkable advances in reasoning and generative tasks, they increasingly face the memory wall problem, where data movement between processors and memory dominates both latency and energy consumption. Processing-In-Memory (PIM) architectures have emerged as a promising solution by executing memory-intensive workloads directly within memory, thereby reducing data transfer overhead. However, efficient integration of PIM into existing heterogeneous systems requires careful management of data transfers between host processors and PIM devices, as well as scheduling policies for inference graph execution. This paper introduces a Node-Aware tensor offloading method that leverages topological analysis of the model computational graph to capture tensor layout relationships across consumer nodes. An Affinity-Based device scheduling algorithm is also proposed, which uses a shared hash table to align operand tensors with their execution device for each operation kernel, eliminating redundant inter-device communication. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method extends a GDDR6-based PIM emulation framework integrated with ONNX Runtime to support 4D matrix multiplication. The optimizations achieve up to 15.63× and 29.3× latency reduction for QK and SV multiplications in the prefill stage, resulting in 93.6% and 94.0% energy savings, respectively. Additionally, in the decoding stage, execution time is reduced by 1.09× and 2.01×, resulting in 8.3% and 50.4% energy savings, respectively.
papers.abstract_cn: 消费电器对节能设备上人工智能的需求日益增长，这引起了人们对内存中处理（PIM）架构的极大关注。这种趋势很大程度上是由大型语言模型（llm）的扩散所驱动的。虽然这些模型在推理和生成任务方面取得了显著进展，但它们越来越多地面临内存墙问题，即处理器和内存之间的数据移动在延迟和能耗方面占主导地位。内存中处理（PIM）体系结构已经成为一种很有前途的解决方案，它直接在内存中执行内存密集型工作负载，从而减少数据传输开销。然而，将PIM有效地集成到现有的异构系统中需要仔细管理主机处理器和PIM设备之间的数据传输，以及用于推理图执行的调度策略。本文介绍了一种节点感知张量卸载方法，该方法利用模型计算图的拓扑分析来捕获跨消费者节点的张量布局关系。提出了一种基于亲和性的设备调度算法，该算法使用共享哈希表对每个操作内核的操作数张量与其执行设备进行对齐，从而消除了冗余的设备间通信。实验结果表明，该方法扩展了基于gddr6的PIM仿真框架，并集成了ONNX Runtime来支持4D矩阵乘法。在预填充阶段，QK和SV乘法的延迟分别减少了15.63倍和29.3倍，分别节省了93.6%和94.0%的能源。此外，在解码阶段，执行时间减少1.09倍和2.01倍，分别节省8.3%和50.4%的能源。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles the memory-wall and data-movement bottleneck in heterogeneous multi-PIM LLM inference, where inefficient tensor placement and device scheduling inflate latency and energy. It proposes node-aware tensor offloading based on computational-graph topology, plus affinity-based scheduling using a shared hash table to keep operand tensors aligned with their execution device and avoid redundant transfers. Experiments on a GDDR6-based PIM emulation integrated with ONNX Runtime show large prefill gains—up to 29.3× latency reduction and 94% energy savings for attention matmuls—and smaller but notable decoding improvements.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多PIM异构系统中LLM推理的数据搬运与调度开销问题，优化张量卸载与设备调度以提升prefill/decoding阶段效率。其核心是通过节点感知的张量卸载利用计算图拓扑关系，并结合基于亲和性的设备调度用共享哈希表对齐操作数与执行设备，减少冗余通信。实验显示，在GDDR6 PIM仿真与ONNX Runtime框架中，prefill阶段QK/SV乘法延迟最高降低29.3倍、能耗节省约94%，decoding阶段也分别实现最高2.01倍加速和50.4%节能。

papers.title: Prima.cpp: Fast 30-70B LLM Inference on Heterogeneous and Low-Resource Home Clusters
papers.authors: Zonghang Li, Tao Li, Wenjiao Feng, Rongxing Xiao, Jianshu She
papers.abstract_en: On-device inference offers privacy, offline use, and instant response, but consumer hardware restricts large language models (LLMs) to low throughput and capability. To overcome this challenge, we present prima.cpp, a distributed on-device inference system that runs 30-70B LLMs on consumer home clusters with mixed CPUs/GPUs, insufficient RAM/VRAM, slow disks, Wi-Fi links, and heterogeneous OSs. We introduce pipelined-ring parallelism (PRP) to overlap disk I/O with compute and communication, and address the prefetch-release conflict in mmap-based offloading. We further propose Halda, a heterogeneity-aware scheduler that co-optimizes per-device CPU/GPU workloads and device selection under RAM/VRAM constraints. On four consumer home devices, a 70B model reaches 674 ms/token TPOT with<6% memory pressure, and a 32B model with speculative decoding achieves 26 tokens/s. Compared with llama.cpp, exo, and dllama, our proposed prima.cpp achieves 5-17x lower TPOT, supports fine-grained model sizes from 8B to 70B, ensures broader cross-OS and quantization compatibility, and remains OOM-free, while also being Wi-Fi tolerant, privacy-preserving, and hardware-independent. The code is available at https://gitee.com/zonghang-li/prima.cpp.
papers.abstract_cn: 设备上推理提供了隐私、离线使用和即时响应，但消费者硬件将大型语言模型（llm）限制在低吞吐量和低能力。为了克服这一挑战，我们提出了prima.cpp，这是一个分布式设备上推理系统，可以在具有混合cpu / gpu， RAM/VRAM不足，磁盘速度慢，Wi-Fi链路和异构操作系统的消费者家庭集群上运行30-70B llm。我们引入了管道环并行（PRP）来重叠磁盘I/O与计算和通信，并解决了基于映射的卸载中的预取-释放冲突。我们进一步提出了Halda，这是一个异构感知调度程序，可在RAM/VRAM约束下协同优化每个设备的CPU/GPU工作负载和设备选择。在四种家用消费类设备上，70B型号在内存压力<6%的情况下达到674 ms/token TPOT，而具有推测解码的32B型号达到26 token /s。与llama.cpp、exo和dllama相比，我们提出的prima.cpp实现了5-17倍的低TPOT，支持从8B到70B的细粒度模型大小，确保更广泛的跨操作系统和量化兼容性，并且保持无om，同时还具有Wi-Fi容忍、隐私保护和硬件无关性。代码可在https://gitee.com/zonghang-li/prima.cpp上获得。
papers.ai_summary_en: Prima.cpp addresses efficient on-device inference of 30–70B LLMs on heterogeneous consumer home clusters constrained by limited RAM/VRAM, slow storage, Wi-Fi links, and mixed operating systems. It introduces pipelined-ring parallelism to overlap disk I/O with computation and communication while resolving mmap prefetch-release conflicts, and uses Halda, a heterogeneity-aware scheduler that jointly optimizes CPU/GPU workloads and device selection under memory constraints. On four consumer devices, it runs a 70B model at 674 ms/token with <6% memory pressure and a 32B model with speculative decoding at 26 tokens/s, achieving 5–17× lower TPOT than llama.cpp, exo, and dllama while remaining OOM-free and broadly compatible.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对消费级家庭集群在 CPU/GPU 异构、内存/显存不足、慢盘和 Wi-Fi 等低资源条件下难以高效推理 30–70B 大模型的问题，提出了分布式推理系统 prima.cpp。其核心方法是通过流水线环并行（PRP）重叠磁盘 I/O、计算与通信并缓解 mmap 卸载冲突，同时用异构感知调度器 Halda 在内存约束下协同优化设备选择与 CPU/GPU 负载，并结合推测解码提升吞吐。实验显示，70B 模型可达 674 ms/token 的 TPOT 且内存压力低于 6%，32B 模型推测解码可达 26 tokens/s，相较 llama.cpp 等基线 TPOT 降低 5–17 倍，并具备更强兼容性与稳定性。

papers.title: HPU: High-Bandwidth Processing Unit for Scalable, Cost-effective LLM Inference via GPU Co-processing
papers.authors: Myunghyun Rhee, Joonseop Sim, Taeyoung Ahn, Seungyong Lee, Daegun Yoon
papers.abstract_en: The attention layer, a core component of Transformer-based LLMs, brings out inefficiencies in current GPU systems due to its low operational intensity and the substantial memory requirements of KV caches. We propose a High-bandwidth Processing Unit (HPU), a memoryintensive co-processor that enhances GPU resource utilization during large-batched LLM inference. By offloading memory-bound operations, the HPU allows the GPU to focus on compute-intensive tasks, increasing overall efficiency. Also, the HPU, as an add-on card, scales out to accommodate surging memory demands driven by large batch sizes and extended sequence lengths. In this paper, we show the HPU prototype implemented with PCIe-based FPGA cards mounted on a GPU system. Our novel GPU-HPU heterogeneous system demonstrates up to 4.1x performance gains and 4.6x energy efficiency improvements over a GPUonly system, providing scalability without increasing the number of GPUs.
papers.abstract_cn: 注意力层，作为基于Transformer的大型语言模型（LLM）的核心组件，由于其低操作强度和KV缓存的大量内存需求，暴露了当前GPU系统的低效问题。我们提出了一种高带宽处理单元（HPU），这是一种内存密集型协处理器，可以在大批量LLM推理过程中提升GPU资源的利用率。通过卸载内存受限的操作，HPU使GPU能够专注于计算密集型任务，从而提高整体效率。此外，HPU作为一个扩展卡，可以扩展以满足大批量和长序列长度所带来的内存需求增长。在本文中，我们展示了使用基于PCIe的FPGA卡并安装在GPU系统上的HPU原型。我们新颖的GPU-HPU异构系统在性能上实现了最高4.1倍的提升，在能效上实现了4.6倍的提升，相比仅GPU系统提供了更高的可扩展性，而无需增加GPU数量。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses GPU inefficiency in Transformer-based LLM inference caused by attention’s low operational intensity and the large memory footprint of KV caches. It proposes a High-bandwidth Processing Unit (HPU), a PCIe/FPGA-based memory-intensive co-processor that offloads memory-bound attention/KV-cache operations so GPUs can focus on compute-intensive workloads while scaling cache capacity as an add-on. A prototype heterogeneous GPU-HPU system achieves up to 4.1× performance and 4.6× energy-efficiency gains over GPU-only inference for large batches and long sequences without adding GPUs.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对Transformer推理中注意力层因KV缓存容量大、访存密集导致GPU利用率低的问题，论文提出一种高带宽内存协处理器HPU，与GPU异构协同，将访存受限操作卸载到HPU，让GPU专注计算密集任务，并通过附加卡形式扩展内存容量。基于PCIe FPGA的原型表明，相比纯GPU系统，该方案在大批量LLM推理中可实现最高4.1倍性能和4.6倍能效提升，在不增加GPU数量的情况下支持更大批量与更长序列。

papers.title: APEX: Asynchronous Parallel CPU-GPU Execution for Online LLM Inference on Constrained GPUs
papers.authors: Jiakun Fan, Yanglin Zhang, Xiangchen Li, Dimitrios S. Nikolopoulos
papers.abstract_en: Deploying large language models (LLMs) for online inference is often constrained by limited GPU memory, particularly due to the growing KV cache during auto-regressive decoding. Hybrid GPU-CPU execution has emerged as a promising solution by offloading KV cache management and parts of attention computation to the CPU. However, a key bottleneck remains: existing schedulers fail to effectively overlap CPU-offloaded tasks with GPU execution during the latency-critical, bandwidth-bound decode phase. This particularly penalizes real-time, decode-heavy applications (e.g., chat, Chain-of-Thought reasoning) which are currently underserved by existing systems, especially under memory pressure typical of edge or low-cost deployments. We present APEX, a novel, profiling-informed scheduling strategy that maximizes CPU-GPU parallelism during hybrid LLM inference. Unlike systems relying on static rules or purely heuristic approaches, APEX dynamically dispatches compute across heterogeneous resources by predicting execution times of CPU and GPU subtasks to maximize overlap while avoiding scheduling overheads. We evaluate APEX on diverse workloads and GPU architectures (NVIDIA T4, A10), using LLaMa-2-7B and LLaMa-3.1-8B models. Compared to GPU-only schedulers like vLLM, APEX improves throughput by 84% - 96% on T4 and 11% - 89% on A10 GPUs, while preserving latency. Against the best existing hybrid schedulers, it delivers up to 72% (T4) and 37% (A10) higher throughput in long-output settings. APEX significantly advances hybrid LLM inference efficiency on such memory-constrained hardware and provides a blueprint for scheduling in heterogeneous AI systems, filling a critical gap for efficient real-time LLM applications.
papers.abstract_cn: 为在线推理部署大型语言模型（llm）通常受到有限的GPU内存的限制，特别是由于自动回归解码期间KV缓存的增长。混合GPU-CPU执行已经成为一种很有前途的解决方案，它将KV缓存管理和部分注意力计算卸载到CPU上。然而，一个关键的瓶颈仍然存在：现有的调度器无法有效地在延迟关键的带宽限制解码阶段将cpu卸载的任务与GPU执行重叠。这尤其不利于实时、解码量大的应用程序（例如，聊天、思维链推理），这些应用程序目前在现有系统中服务不足，特别是在边缘部署或低成本部署的典型内存压力下。我们提出了APEX，一种新颖的，分析通知调度策略，在混合LLM推理期间最大化CPU-GPU并行性。与依赖静态规则或纯粹启发式方法的系统不同，APEX通过预测CPU和GPU子任务的执行时间来动态地分配跨异构资源的计算，从而最大化重叠，同时避免调度开销。我们在不同的工作负载和GPU架构（NVIDIA T4, A10）上评估APEX，使用LLaMa-2-7B和LLaMa-3.1-8B模型。与vLLM等仅使用gpu的调度器相比，APEX在T4上提高了84% - 96%的吞吐量，在A10 gpu上提高了11% - 89%，同时保留了延迟。与现有最好的混合调度器相比，它在长输出设置中提供了高达72% （T4）和37% （A10）的高吞吐量。APEX在这种内存受限的硬件上显著提高了混合LLM推理效率，并为异构AI系统中的调度提供了蓝图，填补了高效实时LLM应用的关键空白。
papers.ai_summary_en: APEX addresses online LLM inference on memory-constrained GPUs, where KV-cache growth and bandwidth-bound autoregressive decoding make CPU-offloaded hybrid execution inefficient due to poor CPU-GPU overlap. It introduces a profiling-informed scheduler that predicts CPU/GPU subtask execution times and dynamically dispatches attention/KV-cache work to maximize parallelism while keeping scheduling overhead low. On NVIDIA T4 and A10 with LLaMA-2/3 models, APEX preserves latency while improving throughput over vLLM by 84–96% and 11–89%, and over strong hybrid schedulers by up to 72% and 37% in long-output workloads.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对受限 GPU 上在线 LLM 解码因 KV 缓存增长而导致 CPU-GPU 混合推理难以有效重叠、实时吞吐受限的问题，APEX 提出一种基于性能剖析的异步并行调度策略，通过预测 CPU/GPU 子任务耗时动态分发计算以最大化异构资源重叠并降低调度开销。实验表明，在 T4/A10 及 LLaMA-2/3.1 上，APEX 相比 vLLM 可显著提升吞吐并保持延迟，相比现有混合调度器在长输出场景最高提升 72%/37%，为内存受限边缘部署提供了高效的异构推理方案。

papers.title: Argus: Token Aware Distributed LLM Inference Optimization
papers.authors: Panlong Wu, Yifei Zhong, Danyang Chen, Ting Wang, Fangxin Wang
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are rapidly being integrated into real-world applications, yet their autoregressive architectures introduce significant inference time variability, especially when deployed across heterogeneous edge-cloud systems. Existing solutions largely neglect the dynamic, stochastic, and heterogeneous nature of such environments, often ignoring the impact of variable output token lengths and device diversity. In this work, we present Argus, the first token-aware distributed edge-cloud LLM inference framework that conducts efficient task offloading. Argus features a Length-Aware Semantics (LAS) module, which predicts output token lengths for incoming prompts using a fine-tuned language model with token-length-sensitive feature modulation, enabling precise estimation. Building on this, our Lyapunov-guided Offloading Optimization (LOO) module formulates long-term Quality-of-Experience optimization that explicitly considers both LLM prefilling and decoding costs. We introduce a novel Iterative Offloading Algorithm with Damping and Congestion Control (IODCC) to effectively solve the resulting integer nonlinear programming problem under time-varying constraints. Extensive theoretical and empirical evaluations demonstrate that Argus achieves robust performance and superior efficiency in highly dynamic, heterogeneous settings.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）正在迅速集成到现实世界的应用程序中，但是它们的自回归架构引入了显著的推理时间可变性，特别是在跨异构边缘云系统部署时。现有的解决方案在很大程度上忽略了这种环境的动态性、随机性和异构性，通常忽略了可变输出令牌长度和设备多样性的影响。在这项工作中，我们提出了Argus，这是第一个进行高效任务卸载的令牌感知分布式边缘云LLM推理框架。Argus具有一个长度感知语义（Length-Aware Semantics， LAS）模块，该模块使用具有对符号长度敏感的特征调制的微调语言模型来预测输入提示的输出符号长度，从而实现精确的估计。在此基础上，我们的lyapunov指导下的卸载优化（LOO）模块制定了长期的体验质量优化，明确考虑了LLM预填充和解码成本。为了有效地解决时变约束下的整数非线性规划问题，提出了一种具有阻尼和拥塞控制的迭代卸载算法（IODCC）。广泛的理论和经验评估表明，Argus在高动态、异构环境中具有强大的性能和卓越的效率。
papers.ai_summary_en: Argus addresses variable LLM inference latency in heterogeneous edge-cloud systems, where stochastic output token lengths and device diversity make offloading decisions difficult. It introduces a token-aware framework that predicts output lengths with a fine-tuned Length-Aware Semantics module and uses Lyapunov-guided optimization, solved via an iterative damping and congestion-control algorithm, to jointly account for prefilling and decoding costs. Theoretical and empirical results show that Argus achieves robust, superior efficiency for long-term quality-of-experience optimization in dynamic distributed inference settings.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对异构边云环境中 LLM 推理因输出 token 长度随机性和设备差异导致的高时延与不稳定问题，提出面向 token 的分布式推理优化框架 Argus。其核心是通过长度感知语义模块预测输出 token 长度，并用 Lyapunov 引导的卸载优化联合建模 prefill 与 decoding 成本，再以带阻尼和拥塞控制的迭代算法求解动态约束下的整数非线性规划问题。实验与理论分析表明，Argus 在高度动态、异构的边云场景下能显著提升长期用户体验和推理效率。

papers.title: A Task Decomposition and Planning Framework for Efficient LLM Inference in AI-Enabled WiFi-Offload Networks
papers.authors: Mingqi Han, Xing Sun
papers.abstract_en: AI WiFi offload is emerging as a promising approach for providing large language model (LLM) services to resource-constrained wireless devices. However, unlike conventional edge computing, LLM inference over WiFi must jointly address heterogeneous model capabilities, wireless contention, uncertain task complexity, and semantic correlation among reasoning tasks. In this paper, we investigate LLM inference offloading in a multi-user multi-edge WiFi network, where each task can be executed locally, directly offloaded to a nearby edge access point (AP), or decomposed into multiple subtasks for collaborative execution across local and edge nodes. To this end, we propose a user-edge collaborative framework with an LLM-based planner that not only performs task decomposition but also infers subtask difficulty and expected output token length, enabling more accurate estimation of execution quality and latency on heterogeneous nodes. Based on these estimates, we further design a decomposition-aware scheduling strategy that jointly optimizes subtask assignment, execution, and aggregation under communication, queuing, and computation constraints. Simulation results show that the proposed framework achieves a better latency-accuracy tradeoff than local-only and nearest-edge baselines, reducing the average latency by $20\%$ and improving the overall reward by $80\%$. Moreover, the distilled lightweight planner approaches the performance of the large teacher model while remaining more suitable for practical edge deployment.
papers.abstract_cn: 人工智能WiFi卸载正在成为一种有前途的方法，为资源受限的无线设备提供大型语言模型（LLM）服务。然而，与传统的边缘计算不同，基于WiFi的LLM推理必须共同解决异构模型能力、无线争用、不确定任务复杂性和推理任务之间的语义相关性。在本文中，我们研究了多用户多边缘WiFi网络中的LLM推理卸载，其中每个任务可以在本地执行，直接卸载到附近的边缘接入点（AP），或者分解为多个子任务以跨本地和边缘节点协作执行。为此，我们提出了一个基于llm的规划器的用户边缘协作框架，该框架不仅可以执行任务分解，还可以推断子任务难度和预期输出令牌长度，从而更准确地估计异构节点上的执行质量和延迟。基于这些估计，我们进一步设计了一种分解感知调度策略，该策略在通信、排队和计算约束下联合优化子任务分配、执行和聚合。仿真结果表明，与本地基线和最近邻基线相比，该框架实现了更好的延迟-精度权衡，平均延迟降低了20%，总体奖励提高了80%。此外，经过提炼的轻量级规划器接近大型教师模型的性能，同时更适合实际的边缘部署。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses efficient LLM inference offloading in multi-user WiFi edge networks, where heterogeneous node capabilities, wireless contention, uncertain task complexity, and semantic dependencies complicate latency-accuracy optimization. It proposes a user-edge collaborative framework with an LLM planner that decomposes tasks and predicts subtask difficulty and output token length, driving a decomposition-aware scheduler that jointly assigns, executes, and aggregates subtasks under communication, queueing, and computation constraints. Simulations show 20% lower average latency and 80% higher reward versus local-only and nearest-edge baselines, while a distilled lightweight planner approaches large-teacher performance for practical edge deployment.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文面向多用户多边缘AP的WiFi网络中LLM推理卸载问题，重点解决异构模型能力、无线竞争、任务复杂度不确定及子任务语义关联带来的时延与精度权衡难题。其核心方法是引入LLM规划器进行任务分解，并预测子任务难度与输出token长度，从而实现更准确的质量/时延估计，再设计分解感知调度策略联合优化子任务分配、执行与聚合。仿真表明，该框架相比本地执行和就近卸载基线可将平均时延降低20%、综合奖励提升80%，且蒸馏后的轻量规划器可接近大模型性能并适合边缘部署。

papers.title: Recursive Offloading for LLM Serving in Multi-tier Networks
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Wu, Sheng Sun, Yuwei Wang, Min Liu, Bo Gao
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneous device-edge-cloud computing infrastructures have become widely adopted in telecommunication operators and Wide Area Networks (WANs), offering multi-tier computational support for emerging intelligent services. With the rapid proliferation of Large Language Model (LLM) services, efficiently coordinating inference tasks and reducing communication overhead within these multi-tier network architectures becomes a critical deployment challenge. Existing LLM serving paradigms exhibit significant limitations: on-device deployment supports only lightweight LLMs due to hardware constraints, while cloud-centric deployment suffers from resource congestion and considerable prompt communication overhead caused by frequent service requests during peak periods. Although the model-cascading-based inference strategy adapts better to multi-tier networks, its reliance on fine-grained, manually adjusted thresholds makes it less responsive to dynamic network conditions and varying task complexities. To address these challenges, we propose RecServe, a recursive offloading framework tailored for LLM serving in multi-tier networks. RecServe integrates a task-specific hierarchical confidence evaluation mechanism that guides offloading decisions based on inferred task complexity in progressively scaled LLMs across device, edge, and cloud tiers. To further enable intelligent task routing across tiers, RecServe employs a sliding-window-based dynamic offloading strategy with quantile interpolation, enabling real-time tracking of historical confidence distributions and adaptive offloading threshold adjustments. Experiments on eight datasets demonstrate that RecServe outperforms CasServe in both service quality and communication efficiency, and reduces the communication burden by over 50\% compared to centralized cloud-based serving.
papers.abstract_cn: 异构设备边缘云计算基础设施已被电信运营商和广域网广泛采用，为新兴的智能业务提供多层计算支持。随着大型语言模型（LLM）服务的快速发展，在这些多层网络体系结构中有效地协调推理任务并减少通信开销成为一个关键的部署挑战。现有的LLM服务范式表现出明显的局限性：由于硬件限制，设备上部署仅支持轻量级LLM，而以云为中心的部署则受到资源拥塞和高峰期间频繁服务请求导致的大量即时通信开销的困扰。尽管基于模型级联的推理策略更适合多层网络，但它依赖于细粒度的手动调整阈值，这使得它对动态网络条件和变化的任务复杂性的响应能力较差。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了RecServe，这是一个为LLM在多层网络中服务量身定制的递归卸载框架。RecServe集成了一个特定于任务的分层置信度评估机制，该机制可以根据推断出的跨设备、边缘和云层逐步扩展的llm的任务复杂性来指导卸载决策。为了进一步实现跨层的智能任务路由，RecServe采用了基于滑动窗口的动态卸载策略和分位数插值，可以实时跟踪历史置信度分布和自适应卸载阈值调整。在8个数据集上的实验表明，RecServe在服务质量和通信效率上都优于CasServe，与集中式云服务相比，通信负担降低了50%以上。
papers.ai_summary_en: RecServe addresses LLM serving in heterogeneous device–edge–cloud networks, where on-device models are capacity-limited and cloud-centric inference incurs congestion and high prompt transmission overhead. It introduces a recursive offloading framework that uses hierarchical confidence estimation over progressively larger LLMs, plus a sliding-window dynamic threshold with quantile interpolation, to adaptively route requests according to task complexity and network conditions. Experiments on eight datasets show improved service quality and communication efficiency over cascade baselines, reducing communication burden by more than 50% relative to centralized cloud serving.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对设备-边缘-云多层网络中 LLM 推理协同困难、云端拥塞与提示通信开销大的问题，提出 RecServe 递归卸载框架。其核心是通过分层置信度评估推断任务复杂度，并结合滑动窗口分位数插值动态调整卸载阈值，实现跨层自适应路由。实验表明，该方法在 8 个数据集上优于 CasServe，并将通信负担相比集中式云服务降低 50% 以上。

papers.title: HCAttention: Extreme KV Cache Compression via Heterogeneous Attention Computing for LLMs
papers.authors: Dongquan Yang, Yifan Yang, Xiaotian Yu, Xianbiao Qi, Rong Xiao
papers.abstract_en: Processing long-context inputs with large language models presents a significant challenge due to the enormous memory requirements of the Key-Value (KV) cache during inference. Existing KV cache compression methods exhibit noticeable performance degradation when memory is reduced by more than 85%. Additionally, strategies that leverage GPU-CPU collaboration for approximate attention remain underexplored in this setting. We propose HCAttention, a heterogeneous attention computation framework that integrates key quantization, value offloading, and dynamic KV eviction to enable efficient inference under extreme memory constraints. The method is compatible with existing transformer architectures and does not require model fine-tuning. Experimental results on the LongBench benchmark demonstrate that our approach preserves the accuracy of full-attention model while shrinking the KV cache memory footprint to 25% of its original size. Remarkably, it stays competitive with only 12.5% of the cache, setting a new state-of-the-art in LLM KV cache compression. To the best of our knowledge, HCAttention is the first to extend the Llama-3-8B model to process 4 million tokens on a single A100 GPU with 80GB memory.
papers.abstract_cn: 由于在推理过程中对键值（KV）缓存的巨大内存需求，使用大型语言模型处理长上下文输入提出了一个重大挑战。现有的KV缓存压缩方法在内存减少85%以上时表现出明显的性能下降。此外，在这种情况下，利用GPU-CPU协作来获得近似注意力的策略仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了一种异构注意力计算框架hc - attention，它集成了关键量化、值卸载和动态KV驱逐，以实现在极端内存约束下的高效推理。该方法与现有的变压器结构兼容，不需要模型微调。在LongBench基准测试上的实验结果表明，我们的方法在将KV缓存内存占用减少到原始大小的25%的同时保持了全注意力模型的准确性。值得注意的是，它仅以12.5%的缓存保持竞争力，创造了LLM KV缓存压缩的新技术。据我们所知，hc - attention是第一个扩展Llama-3-8B模型，在一个具有80GB内存的A100 GPU上处理400万个令牌。
papers.ai_summary_en: HCAttention addresses extreme KV-cache memory pressure in long-context LLM inference, where existing compression methods degrade sharply beyond ~85% memory reduction and GPU-CPU heterogeneous attention remains underexplored. It proposes a training-free framework that combines key quantization, value offloading, and dynamic KV eviction to approximate full attention while keeping only critical state in GPU memory. On LongBench, it preserves full-attention accuracy at 25% cache size and remains competitive at 12.5%, enabling Llama-3-8B to process 4M tokens on a single 80GB A100.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文大模型推理中 KV 缓存内存开销过大的问题，尤其关注在极端压缩（超过 85%）下现有方法性能显著下降、且 GPU-CPU 异构注意力利用不足的瓶颈。其核心方法是提出 HCAttention，一个免微调的异构注意力计算框架，融合 key 量化、value 卸载和动态 KV 驱逐，以在极低显存预算下近似全注意力计算。实验显示，该方法在 LongBench 上将 KV 缓存压缩至 25% 仍可保持全注意力精度，压缩至 12.5% 仍具竞争力，并首次使 Llama-3-8B 在单张 80GB A100 上处理 400 万 token。

papers.title: Adaptive Multi-Objective Tiered Storage Configuration for KV Cache in LLM Service
papers.authors: Xianzhe Zheng, Zhengheng Wang, Ruiyang Ma, Rui Wang, Xiyu Wang
papers.abstract_en: The memory-for-computation paradigm of KV caching is essential for accelerating large language model (LLM) inference service, but limited GPU high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity motivates offloading the KV cache to cheaper external storage tiers. While this expands capacity, it introduces the challenge of dynamically managing heterogeneous storage resources to balance cost, throughput, and latency under varying workloads. We formulate this as a multi-objective optimization problem: identifying the Pareto frontier across these metrics within the storage configuration space. Using a high-fidelity end-to-end simulator, we observe that the objective functions are non-analytic and exhibit complex variable coupling, making the Pareto frontier difficult to approximate analytically. To obtain the frontier, we introduce Kareto, a KV-cache Adaptive REsource managemenT Optimizer. Kareto leverages a diminishing-return-guided pruning method to efficiently navigate the large configuration space and approximate the Pareto frontier. Additionally, it incorporates a fine-grained adaptive tuner that uses eviction policies in tier storage and KV block access patterns for group-specific cache management, improving cache efficiency. Experiments on real-world traces show that Kareto adapts to workload and can identify configurations of better cost efficiency, covering static strategies. Compared to the fixed setup with 1024 GB DRAM, Kareto can improve throughput by up to 9.3%, or reduce latency by up to 58.3%, or lower cost by up to 20.2% under respective optimization objectives.
papers.abstract_cn: KV缓存的内存换计算范式对于加速大型语言模型（LLM）推理服务至关重要，但有限的GPU高带宽内存（HBM）容量促使将KV缓存卸载到更便宜的外部存储层。虽然这扩展了容量，但它带来了动态管理异构存储资源以平衡不同工作负载下的成本、吞吐量和延迟的挑战。我们将其表述为一个多目标优化问题：在存储配置空间中确定这些指标的帕累托边界。利用高保真度的端到端模拟器，我们观察到目标函数是非解析的，并且表现出复杂的变量耦合，使得Pareto边界难以解析近似。为了获得边界，我们引入了Kareto，一个KV-cache自适应资源管理优化器。Kareto利用一种递减回归导向的剪枝方法来有效地导航大构型空间并近似帕累托边界。此外，它还集成了一个细粒度的自适应调谐器，该调谐器在层存储和KV块访问模式中使用驱逐策略，用于特定于组的缓存管理，从而提高了缓存效率。在真实世界的跟踪实验表明，Kareto能够适应工作负载，并能够识别更好的成本效率配置，涵盖静态策略。与使用1024 GB DRAM的固定设置相比，在各自的优化目标下，Kareto可以将吞吐量提高9.3%，或将延迟降低58.3%，或将成本降低20.2%。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses dynamic management of KV caches across GPU HBM and external storage tiers in LLM serving, where limited memory capacity forces offloading and creates a multi-objective tradeoff among cost, throughput, and latency under varying workloads. It proposes Kareto, an optimizer that approximates the Pareto frontier of storage configurations using a diminishing-return-guided pruning search over a high-fidelity simulator, plus a fine-grained adaptive tuner that applies group-specific eviction and cache management based on KV block access patterns. Experiments on real traces show Kareto adapts to workload changes and outperforms static configurations, improving throughput by up to 9.3%, reducing latency by up to 58.3%, or lowering cost by up to 20.2% relative to a fixed 1024 GB DRAM setup.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理中KV缓存受GPU HBM容量限制、需分层存储并在成本、吞吐和延迟间动态权衡的问题，将分层存储配置建模为多目标优化并寻找Pareto前沿。作者提出Kareto，通过收益递减引导的配置空间剪枝高效逼近Pareto前沿，并结合基于驱逐策略与KV块访问模式的细粒度自适应缓存管理提升缓存效率。真实负载实验表明，相较固定1024GB DRAM配置，Kareto可分别提升吞吐9.3%、降低延迟58.3%或降低成本20.2%，实现更优的成本效率。

papers.title: Nova: Real-Time Agentic Vision-Language Model Serving With Adaptive Cross-Stage Parallelization
papers.authors: Yuhang Xu, Shengzhong Liu, Dong Zhang, Bingheng Yan, Fan Wu
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents Nova, a real-time scheduling framework for serving agentic vision-language models (VLMs) on a single GPU with balanced per-request latency and overall request process throughput. Our design begins by enabling effective pipelining across vision encode, LLM prefill, and LLM decode stages of VLMs, by exploiting their heterogeneous resource demands during execution and incorporating elastic GPU spatial partitioning among stages to maximally utilize the compute and memory resources. Building on this, we introduce a realtime scheduling algorithm that adaptively calibrates resource allocation among stages based on a Pareto-optimal analysis of the latency-throughput trade-off, allowing the system to sustain responsiveness and resource efficiency under dynamic request loads. To further alleviate GPU memory pressure, we design a lightweight weight offloading strategy for vision encoders that preserves inference efficiency with minimized memory overhead. Extensive evaluations on both synthetic and real-world agent workloads demonstrate that Nova consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines, improving the maximum latency by up to 23.3 %, while keeping competitive throughput.
papers.abstract_cn: Nova是一个实时调度框架，用于在单个GPU上提供代理视觉语言模型（vlm），具有均衡的单请求延迟和总体请求处理吞吐量。我们的设计首先在vlm的视觉编码、LLM预填充和LLM解码阶段实现有效的流水线，在执行过程中利用它们的异构资源需求，并在阶段之间结合弹性GPU空间分区，以最大限度地利用计算和内存资源。在此基础上，我们引入了一种实时调度算法，该算法基于延迟-吞吐量权衡的帕累托最优分析，自适应地校准各阶段之间的资源分配，允许系统在动态请求负载下保持响应性和资源效率。为了进一步减轻GPU内存压力，我们为视觉编码器设计了一种轻量级的权重卸载策略，以最小化内存开销来保持推理效率。对合成和实际代理工作负载的广泛评估表明，Nova的性能始终优于最先进的基线，将最大延迟提高了23.3%，同时保持了具有竞争力的吞吐量。
papers.ai_summary_en: Nova addresses real-time serving of agentic vision-language models on a single GPU, targeting the latency–throughput tradeoff caused by heterogeneous vision-encode, LLM-prefill, and LLM-decode stages under dynamic request loads. Its key method is adaptive cross-stage parallelization: elastic GPU spatial partitioning across stages, a Pareto-optimal scheduler that recalibrates resource allocation, and lightweight vision-encoder weight offloading to reduce memory pressure. Evaluations on synthetic and real-world agent workloads show Nova reduces maximum latency by up to 23.3% over state-of-the-art baselines while maintaining competitive throughput.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对单GPU上智能体式视觉语言模型服务中视觉编码、LLM prefill与decode阶段资源需求异构、导致延迟与吞吐难以兼顾的问题。提出 Nova，通过跨阶段流水线、弹性GPU空间分区和基于Pareto最优的实时资源调度，并配合视觉编码器轻量权重卸载来降低显存压力。实验表明，其在合成与真实agent负载上较先进基线将最大延迟最多降低23.3%，同时保持有竞争力的吞吐。

papers.title: [GitHub] transformers: 🤗 Transformers: the model-definition framework for state-of-the-art machine learning models in text,
papers.authors: huggingface
papers.abstract_en: 🤗 Transformers: the model-definition framework for state-of-the-art machine learning models in text, vision, audio, and multimodal models, for both inference and training.
papers.abstract_cn: 🤗 Transformers：用于文本、视觉、音频和多模态模型的最先进机器学习模型的模型定义框架，适用于推理和训练。
papers.ai_summary_en: The work addresses the practical problem of defining, training, and serving state-of-the-art transformer-based models across text, vision, audio, and multimodal modalities within a unified ecosystem. Its key contribution is the Hugging Face Transformers framework, which provides standardized model architectures, tokenizers/processors, pretrained checkpoints, and interoperable APIs for inference, fine-tuning, and integration with serving-oriented backends. The main impact is broad adoption as a de facto open-source stack for deploying and experimenting with LLMs and multimodal models, lowering engineering barriers for research and production serving.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向文本、视觉、音频和多模态等先进模型的统一建模与服务问题，提供了以 Transformer 为核心的模型定义、训练和推理框架。其核心洞见是通过统一 API、可复用预训练权重和生态集成，降低多模态大模型开发、部署与复现门槛。作为 Hugging Face 生态的基础组件，它显著促进了大模型研究、工程实践和生产化服务的普及。

papers.title: [GitHub] BitNet: Official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs
papers.authors: microsoft
papers.abstract_en: Recent research on the 1-bit Large Language Models (LLMs), such as BitNet b1.58, presents a promising direction for reducing the inference cost of LLMs while maintaining their performance. In this work, we introduce BitNet a4.8, enabling 4-bit activations for 1-bit LLMs. BitNet a4.8 employs a hybrid quantization and sparsification strategy to mitigate the quantization errors introduced by the outlier channels. Specifically, we utilize 4-bit activations for inputs to the attention and feed-forward network layers, while sparsifying intermediate states followed with 8-bit quantization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BitNet a4.8 achieves performance comparable to BitNet b1.58 with equivalent training costs, while being faster in inference with enabling 4-bit (INT4/FP4) kernels. Additionally, BitNet a4.8 activates only 55% of parameters and supports 3-bit KV cache, further enhancing the efficiency of large-scale LLM deployment and inference.
papers.abstract_cn: 1 位大语言模型的官方推理框架
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses high inference cost in 1-bit LLMs by reducing activation precision while preserving model quality. It proposes BitNet a4.8, a hybrid quantization–sparsification scheme that uses 4-bit activations for attention and FFN inputs, sparsifies intermediate states, and applies 8-bit quantization to mitigate outlier-channel errors. Experiments show performance comparable to BitNet b1.58 with equivalent training cost, faster inference via INT4/FP4 kernels, 55% parameter activation, and support for 3-bit KV cache.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向 1-bit LLM 的低成本推理问题，提出 BitNet a4.8，在保持 BitNet b1.58 性能的同时引入 4-bit 激活以降低推理开销。其核心洞见是采用“混合量化+稀疏化”来缓解异常通道带来的量化误差：注意力和 FFN 输入使用 4-bit 激活，中间状态先稀疏化再做 8-bit 量化。实验表明，该方法在同等训练成本下可达到相近性能，并支持 INT4/FP4 内核、仅激活 55% 参数和 3-bit KV cache，从而显著提升大规模部署与推理效率。

papers.title: [GitHub] ktransformers: A Flexible Framework for Experiencing Heterogeneous LLM Inference/Fine-tune Optimizations
papers.authors: kvcache-ai
papers.abstract_en: A Flexible Framework for Experiencing Heterogeneous LLM Inference/Fine-tune Optimizations
papers.abstract_cn: 一个用于体验异构大语言模型推理/微调优化的灵活框架
papers.ai_summary_en: ktransformers addresses memory and compute bottlenecks in LLM inference and fine-tuning on constrained or heterogeneous hardware by enabling execution across devices such as GPUs and CPUs. Its key contribution is a flexible framework that exposes offloading, tensor placement, and optimization knobs for transformer models, allowing users to compose and evaluate heterogeneous acceleration strategies. The main impact is providing a practical testbed and runtime for deploying large models where monolithic device execution is infeasible, emphasizing extensibility over a single fixed performance result.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向大模型推理与微调中的显存受限问题，提出 KTransformers 这一灵活框架，用于体验和集成异构计算、卸载等优化策略。其核心洞见是通过可扩展的框架设计，将 GPU/CPU 等异构资源与模型计算调度结合，降低部署和实验门槛。主要影响是为大模型在资源受限环境下进行推理/微调优化提供了可实践的系统基础。

papers.title: [GitHub] chitu: High-performance inference framework for large language models, focusing on efficiency, flexibility,
papers.authors: thu-pacman
papers.abstract_en: High-performance inference framework for large language models, focusing on efficiency, flexibility, and availability.
papers.abstract_cn: 用于大型语言模型的高性能推理框架，专注于效率、灵活性和可用性。
papers.ai_summary_en: Chitu addresses the problem of high-performance LLM inference serving, targeting efficiency, flexibility, and availability in production deployments. Its key contribution is an inference framework designed to optimize request handling and model execution while supporting adaptable deployment configurations. The main impact is improved serving performance and system robustness for large language models, although the provided abstract lacks quantitative evaluation details.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向大模型推理服务（LLM Serving）场景，重点解决在线推理中对高效率、灵活部署和高可用性的系统需求。其核心是提出 chitu 高性能推理框架，通过面向效率、灵活性与可用性的系统设计来提升大模型推理服务能力。该框架有助于构建更快、更易扩展且更可靠的大模型推理基础设施。

The main impact is enabling faster, lower-resource OpenVINO inference for production deployment, especially on CPU and Intel accelerators.
papers.ai_summary_cn: NNCF 面向大模型推理服务中的计算与内存开销问题，提供与 OpenVINO 深度集成的神经网络压缩能力。其核心方法是通过训练后量化、量化感知训练及结构化压缩等手段，在尽量保持精度的前提下降低模型部署成本。该框架可提升推理吞吐、降低延迟和硬件需求，增强 LLM 在边缘或服务器端的高效服务能力。

papers.title: [GitHub] InferLLM: a lightweight LLM model inference framework
papers.authors: MegEngine
papers.abstract_en: A joint measurement is presented of the branching fractions $B^0_s\toμ^+μ^-$ and $B^0\toμ^+μ^-$ in proton-proton collisions at the LHC by the CMS and LHCb experiments. The data samples were collected in 2011 at a centre-of-mass energy of 7 TeV, and in 2012 at 8 TeV. The combined analysis produces the first observation of the $B^0_s\toμ^+μ^-$ decay, with a statistical significance exceeding six standard deviations, and the best measurement of its branching fraction so far. Furthermore, evidence for the $B^0\toμ^+μ^-$ decay is obtained with a statistical significance of three standard deviations. The branching fraction measurements are statistically compatible with SM predictions and impose stringent constraints on several theories beyond the SM.
papers.abstract_cn: 一个轻量级的 LLM 模型推理框架
papers.ai_summary_en: The title/topic appears mismatched: the abstract describes a CMS/LHCb joint measurement rather than an LLM inference framework. It addresses the problem of measuring the rare decays \(B_s^0\to\mu^+\mu^-\) and \(B^0\to\mu^+\mu^-\) using 7 and 8 TeV proton–proton collision data. By combining CMS and LHCb datasets, it achieves the first observation of \(B_s^0\to\mu^+\mu^-\) with >6σ significance, evidence for \(B^0\to\mu^+\mu^-\) at 3σ, and SM-compatible branching fractions that strongly constrain beyond-SM theories.

The main impact is a more scalable and engineering-efficient pipeline for developing, training, and deploying cooperative or competitive LLM agents.

papers.title: [GitHub] Awesome-KV-Cache-Optimization: [ACL 2026] Towards Efficient Large Language Model Serving: A Survey on System-Aware KV Cache Optimiz
papers.authors: jjiantong
papers.abstract_en: [ACL 2026] Towards Efficient Large Language Model Serving: A Survey on System-Aware KV Cache Optimization
papers.abstract_cn: [ACL 2026] 面向高效大语言模型服务：关于系统感知 KV 缓存优化的调研
papers.ai_summary_en: This survey addresses the KV-cache memory and I/O bottleneck in large language model serving, where large per-request caches limit throughput, latency, and GPU memory efficiency. It provides a system-aware taxonomy of KV-cache optimization techniques, including cache placement, paging/offloading, compression, scheduling, and hardware-software co-design. The paper synthesizes trade-offs across these methods and outlines open challenges for scalable, low-latency LLM inference systems.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该综述面向大模型推理服务中 KV Cache 内存占用高、带宽压力大、影响吞吐与延迟的问题，系统梳理了“系统感知”的 KV Cache 优化方法。其核心洞见是将缓存压缩、驱逐、分页、共享、调度与硬件/系统协同设计结合起来，而非仅在模型算法层面局部优化。该工作为高效 LLM serving 提供了分类框架与技术路线，有助于推动低延迟、高吞吐的部署实践。

papers.title: [GitHub] nano-PEARL: Draft-Target Disaggregation LLM Serving System via Parallel Speculative Decoding.

papers.abstract_en: Draft-Target Disaggregation LLM Serving System via Parallel Speculative Decoding.

papers.ai_summary_en: nano-PEARL addresses inefficiencies in LLM serving caused by autoregressive decoding and by resource contention when draft and target models in speculative decoding are colocated. It proposes a draft–target disaggregated serving system that runs draft proposal and target verification on separate resources and overlaps them through parallel speculative decoding pipelines. This improves serving throughput and latency by reducing idle GPU time and enabling more efficient batching and scheduling of speculative workloads.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型推理服务中投机解码的草稿模型与目标模型资源耦合、调度受限的问题，提出了 nano-PEARL 这一草稿-目标解耦的服务系统。其核心思路是将草稿生成与目标验证分离部署，并通过并行投机解码提升请求处理效率。该方法有助于降低推理时延、提高吞吐与资源利用率，为投机解码在在线 LLM 服务中的规模化应用提供了系统设计参考。

papers.title: Serving Heterogeneous LoRA Adapters in Distributed LLM Inference Systems
papers.authors: Shashwat Jaiswal, Shrikara Arun, Anjaly Parayil, Ankur Mallick, Spyros Mastorakis
papers.abstract_en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become the de facto method for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs), enabling rapid adaptation to diverse domains. In production, LoRA-based models are served at scale, creating multi-tenant environments with hundreds of adapters sharing a base model. However, state-of-the-art serving systems co-batch heterogeneous adapters without accounting for rank (size) variability, leading to severe performance skew, which ultimately requires adding more GPUs to satisfy service-level objectives (SLOs). Existing optimizations, focused on loading, caching, and kernel execution, ignore this heterogeneity, leaving GPU resources underutilized. We present LoRAServe, a workload-aware dynamic adapter placement and routing framework designed to tame rank diversity in LoRA serving. By dynamically rebalancing adapters across GPUs and leveraging GPU Direct RDMA for remote access, LoRAServe maximizes throughput and minimizes tail latency under real-world workload drift. Evaluations on production traces from Company X show that LoRAServe elicits up to 2$\times$ higher throughput, up to 9$\times$ lower TTFT, while using up to 50% fewer GPUs under SLO constraints compared to state-of-the-art systems.
papers.abstract_cn: 低秩自适应（Low-Rank Adaptation, LoRA）已经成为大型语言模型（llm）的参数高效微调方法，能够快速适应不同的领域。在生产中，大规模地提供基于lora的模型，从而创建具有数百个适配器共享基本模型的多租户环境。然而，最先进的服务系统在不考虑等级（大小）可变性的情况下共同批处理异构适配器，导致严重的性能倾斜，最终需要添加更多gpu来满足服务级别目标（slo）。现有的优化专注于加载、缓存和内核执行，忽略了这种异质性，导致GPU资源未得到充分利用。我们提出了LoRAServe，一个工作负载感知的动态适配器放置和路由框架，旨在驯服LoRA服务中的等级多样性。通过动态地重新平衡GPU之间的适配器并利用GPU Direct RDMA进行远程访问，LoRAServe最大限度地提高了吞吐量，并最大限度地减少了实际工作负载漂移下的尾部延迟。X公司对生产轨迹的评估表明，与最先进的系统相比，LoRAServe的吞吐量提高了2倍，TTFT降低了9倍，同时在SLO限制下使用的gpu减少了50%。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses multi-tenant LLM inference serving where heterogeneous LoRA adapter ranks cause co-batching imbalance, tail-latency skew, and GPU overprovisioning. LoRAServe introduces a workload-aware framework that dynamically places and routes adapters across GPUs, using GPU Direct RDMA for remote adapter access to balance rank-dependent load. Evaluations on production traces show up to 2× higher throughput, 9× lower TTFT, and 50% fewer GPUs while meeting SLO constraints.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对分布式 LLM 推理中多租户 LoRA 服务因适配器 rank 异构而导致批处理性能倾斜、GPU 利用率低和 SLO 成本高的问题展开研究。其核心方法是提出 LoRAServe，一个负载感知的动态适配器放置与路由框架，通过跨 GPU 动态再平衡适配器并利用 GPU Direct RDMA 远程访问来缓解 rank 差异带来的开销。实验显示，在生产负载下相比先进系统可提升最高 2 倍吞吐、降低最高 9 倍首 token 延迟，并在满足 SLO 的同时减少最多 50% 的 GPU 使用。

papers.title: SIMPLE: Disaggregating Sampling from GPU Inference into a Decision Plane for Faster Distributed LLM Serving
papers.authors: Bohan Zhao, Zane Cao, Yongchao He
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) scale out with tensor parallelism (TP) and pipeline parallelism (PP) and production stacks have aggressively optimized the data plane (attention/GEMM and KV cache), sampling, the decision plane that turns logits into tokens, becomes a new bottleneck. This creates a structural holdout: sampling neither expands with TP nor balances across PP stages, so its share of iteration time grows as GPUs get faster and it caps pipeline frequency at the last stage. We present SIMPLE, a stage-agnostic, sequence-parallel, overlappable decision plane that disaggregates sampling into a CPU-side service and shrinks its runtime footprint back to a minor, hidden role. SIMPLE combines: (1) sequence-parallel sampling, which shards work along the batch dimension and removes vocabulary-axis collectives; (2) a CPU-based algorithm with column-wise penalties and truncation-first filtering to realize single-pass, linear-time kernels; and (3) speculative hot-vocab sampling (SHVS), which samples on a small hot set with rejection-correctness and uses a simple sizing model to choose the hot-vocab size that maximizes throughput. In evaluation, SIMPLE improves end-to-end throughput by up to 96% and reduces P95 latency by 20-65%. Crucially, SIMPLE requires no user-side code changes and composes with existing data-plane optimizations, unlocking scaling benefits that compound with future GPU generations.
papers.abstract_cn: 随着大型语言模型（llm）通过张量并行（TP）和管道并行（PP）向外扩展，以及生产堆栈积极优化数据平面（注意力/GEMM和KV缓存），将logits转换为令牌的决策平面采样成为一个新的瓶颈。这创造了一个结构性的阻力：采样既不会随着TP扩展，也不会在PP阶段之间保持平衡，所以它所占的迭代时间份额会随着gpu变得更快而增长，并在最后阶段限制流水线频率。我们提出SIMPLE，这是一个阶段不可知的、序列并行的、可重叠的决策平面，它将采样分解为cpu端服务，并将其运行时占用空间缩小到一个次要的、隐藏的角色。SIMPLE组合：(1)序列并行采样，该采样沿着批处理维度进行分片并删除词汇轴集合；(2)基于cpu的基于列惩罚和截断优先滤波的算法，实现单遍线性时间核；(3)推测热词汇采样（speculative hot-vocab sampling， SHVS），即在具有拒绝正确性的小热集上进行采样，并使用简单的分级模型选择吞吐量最大的热词汇大小。在评估中，SIMPLE将端到端吞吐量提高了96%，并将P95延迟降低了20-65%。最重要的是，SIMPLE不需要修改用户端代码，并与现有的数据平面优化相结合，从而释放出与未来几代GPU相结合的扩展优势。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the sampling bottleneck in distributed LLM inference, where token selection does not scale with tensor/pipeline parallelism and serializes the final pipeline stage. SIMPLE disaggregates sampling into an overlappable CPU-side decision plane using batch-sharded sequence-parallel sampling, linear-time penalty/filtering kernels, and rejection-correct speculative hot-vocabulary sampling. It achieves up to 96% end-to-end throughput improvement and 20–65% P95 latency reduction without user-side code changes while composing with existing GPU data-plane optimizations.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对分布式LLM推理中采样环节无法随张量/流水线并行扩展、并成为末级流水线瓶颈的问题，提出将“决策平面”从GPU推理中解耦到CPU侧服务。核心方法是阶段无关的序列并行采样、线性单遍CPU采样核，以及带拒绝校正的投机式热词表采样（SHVS），从而隐藏采样开销并保持正确性。实验显示端到端吞吐最高提升96%，P95时延降低20–65%，且无需修改用户代码即可与现有数据平面优化叠加。

papers.title: PRESERVE: Prefetching Model Weights and KV-Cache in Distributed LLM Serving
papers.authors: A. C. Yuzuguler, Jiawei Zhuang, Lukas Cavigelli
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are typically served from clusters of GPUs/NPUs that consist of large number of devices. Unfortunately, communication between these devices incurs significant overhead, increasing the inference latency and cost while limiting the scalability. Prior work addressed this issue by overlapping communication with compute, but has severe limitations due to the data dependencies between these operations. In this paper, we propose PRESERVE, a novel framework that prefetches model weights and KV-cache from off-chip HBM memory to the on-chip cache of AI accelerators during the communication operations, which offers various advantages and performance improvements compared to prior methods. Through extensive experiments conducted on commercial AI accelerators, we demonstrate up to 1.6x end-to-end speedup on state-of-the-art, open-source LLMs. Additionally, we perform a design space exploration that identifies the optimal hardware configuration for the proposed method, showing a further 1.25x improvement in performance per cost by selecting the optimal L2 cache size. Our results show that PRESERVE has the potential to mitigate the memory bottlenecks and communication overheads, offering a solution to improve the performance and scalability of the LLM inference systems.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）通常由由大量设备组成的gpu / npu集群提供。不幸的是，这些设备之间的通信产生了巨大的开销，增加了推理延迟和成本，同时限制了可伸缩性。先前的工作通过与计算的重叠通信解决了这个问题，但由于这些操作之间的数据依赖关系，存在严重的局限性。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的框架PRESERVE，它可以在通信操作期间将模型权重和kv缓存从片外HBM存储器预取到AI加速器的片上缓存，与之前的方法相比，它具有各种优势和性能改进。通过在商业人工智能加速器上进行的大量实验，我们展示了在最先进的开源法学硕士上高达1.6倍的端到端加速。此外，我们进行了设计空间探索，确定了所提议方法的最佳硬件配置，通过选择最佳二级缓存大小，显示了每成本性能进一步提高1.25倍。我们的研究结果表明，PRESERVE具有缓解内存瓶颈和通信开销的潜力，为提高LLM推理系统的性能和可扩展性提供了一个解决方案。
papers.ai_summary_en: PRESERVE tackles inter-device communication overhead and memory bottlenecks in distributed LLM serving, where prior compute–communication overlap is constrained by data dependencies. Its key idea is to prefetch model weights and KV-cache data from off-chip HBM into accelerator on-chip caches during communication phases, converting otherwise idle communication time into useful memory movement. Experiments on commercial accelerators show up to 1.6× end-to-end inference speedup, with a further 1.25× performance-per-cost gain from an optimized L2 cache configuration.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对分布式LLM推理中设备间通信开销大、且通信与计算重叠受数据依赖限制的问题，提出PRESERVE框架，在通信期间将模型权重和KV缓存从片外HBM预取到加速器片上缓存。其核心洞见是利用通信空窗提前搬运关键数据，从而隐藏访存延迟并减少通信阻塞。实验显示，该方法在商用加速器上对开源LLM实现最高1.6倍端到端加速，并通过L2缓存配置优化带来1.25倍性能/成本提升，有助于提升分布式推理的效率与可扩展性。

papers.title: Optimizing Distributed LLM Serving through Request Scheduling and Key-Value Cache Sharing
papers.authors: Hongye Jiang, Mu Wang, Su Yao, Cui Ting, Ziwei Li
papers.abstract_en: The widespread deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) is often constrained by the significant computational and memory demands of the inference process. A critical bottleneck in distributed serving systems arises from the redundant processing of requests that share common prefixes, such as system prompts or few-shot examples. Traditional contentagnostic load balancers fail to exploit these redundancies, leading to inefficient resource utilization and increased latency. This paper introduces a dynamic, prefix-aware request scheduling system designed to optimize distributed LLM serving. Our approach intelligently routes incoming requests to specific GPU workers by analyzing prompt content and matching it with the resident Key-Value (KV) caches across the cluster. By colocating requests with shared prefixes, our system maximizes KV cache reuse, minimizes expensive prefill computations, and enables more efficient batched attention operations at the worker level. We implemented and evaluated this scheduler on a 12 -node GPU cluster using a real-world chatbot workload. The results demonstrate the profound impact of content-aware scheduling: our system increased the aggregate prefill throughput by over 144 % and reduced the median Time-to-First-Token by over 40 % compared to a conventional Round-Robin policy. These performance gains are a direct result of an 82 % relative increase in the prefix cache hit rate, validating our approach as a highly effective and cost-efficient strategy for enhancing the throughput and responsiveness of large-scale LLM services.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）的广泛部署经常受到推理过程的大量计算和内存需求的限制。分布式服务系统中的一个关键瓶颈来自对共享公共前缀的请求的冗余处理，例如系统提示或少量示例。传统的与内容无关的负载平衡器无法利用这些冗余，从而导致资源利用效率低下和延迟增加。本文介绍了一种动态的、前缀感知的请求调度系统，用于优化分布式LLM服务。我们的方法通过分析提示内容并将其与集群中的常驻键值（KV）缓存进行匹配，智能地将传入请求路由到特定的GPU工作人员。通过将请求与共享前缀并列，我们的系统最大限度地提高了KV缓存重用，最大限度地减少了昂贵的预填充计算，并在工作层实现了更有效的批处理关注操作。我们使用一个真实的聊天机器人工作负载在一个12节点GPU集群上实现并评估了这个调度器。结果证明了内容感知调度的深远影响：与传统的轮循策略相比，我们的系统将总预填充吞吐量提高了144%以上，并将第一个令牌的中位数时间减少了40%以上。这些性能提升是前缀缓存命中率相对提高82%的直接结果，验证了我们的方法是一种非常有效且经济高效的策略，可以增强大规模LLM服务的吞吐量和响应能力。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses inefficient distributed LLM inference caused by content-agnostic load balancing that ignores shared prompt prefixes, leading to redundant prefill computation and underutilized KV caches. It proposes a dynamic prefix-aware request scheduler that routes prompts to GPU workers based on content similarity and resident KV caches, colocating shared-prefix requests to maximize cache reuse and improve batched attention efficiency. On a 12-node GPU cluster with real chatbot traffic, the system increases aggregate prefill throughput by over 144% and reduces median Time-to-First-Token by over 40% versus round-robin, driven by an 82% relative gain in prefix cache hit rate.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对分布式LLM推理中共享前缀请求被重复预填充、导致KV缓存复用不足和延迟升高的瓶颈。其核心方法是提出前缀感知的动态请求调度器，通过匹配集群中各GPU worker上的驻留KV缓存，将具有相同系统提示或少样本前缀的请求路由到同一节点，以最大化缓存复用并减少昂贵的prefill计算。在12节点GPU集群上的真实聊天负载中，相比轮询策略，该方法将预填充吞吐提升超过144%，中位首token延迟降低超过40%，前缀缓存命中率相对提升82%。

papers.title: MCaM : Efficient LLM Inference with Multi-tier KV Cache Management
papers.authors: Kexin Chu, Zixu Shen, Shengxun Cheng, Dawei Xiang, Ziqin Liu
papers.abstract_en: The KV cache in current LLM serving system is primarily used to accelerate processing within a single request and is aggressively deleted once the response is generated. However, in scenarios like virtual assistants and multi-turn conversations, the KV cache can be reused across requests, which can dramatically reduce computation costs and improve serving latency. Caching historical tokens, however, significantly increases memory requirements. Furthermore, existing serving systems treat the request scheduler and KV cache separately, despite their tight coupling.MCaM is a multi-tier cache system that enables the KV cache reuse and sharing across requests. It leverages DRAM as slow- tier memory for storing the KV cache of historical prompts. To efficiently utilize fast-tier Hign Bandwidth Memory(HBM) on GPU, we co-designed the KV cache manager and scheduler to coordinate request scheduling and token placement across tiers. To hide the reload time, MCaM employs a pipeline prefetcher that overlaps communication and computation. Additionally, MCaM incorporates a quality-aware sparsification algorithm to heterogeneously compress the KV cache in each layer. This approach not only reduces data transfer size but also decreases the overall KV cache size. To remove data offloading from a request’s critical path, we designed an asynchronous offload engine that swaps data from HBM to DRAM in the background. Our experiments show that MCaM can reduce TTFT by up to 69% and improve prompt prefilling throughput by 3.3X. It can also reduce the end-to-end latency of LLM inference by up to 58% when request length increase to 4096 tokens.
papers.abstract_cn: 当前LLM服务系统中的KV缓存主要用于加速单个请求的处理，并在生成响应后立即删除。然而，在虚拟助手和多回合对话等场景中，KV缓存可以跨请求重用，这可以显着降低计算成本并改善服务延迟。但是，缓存历史令牌会显著增加内存需求。此外，现有的服务系统将请求调度器和KV缓存分开处理，尽管它们是紧密耦合的。MCaM是一个多层缓存系统，可以实现千伏缓存的重用和跨请求共享。它利用DRAM作为慢层存储器来存储历史提示的KV缓存。为了有效地利用GPU上的快速层高带宽内存（HBM），我们共同设计了KV缓存管理器和调度程序，以协调请求调度和跨层令牌放置。为了隐藏重新加载时间，MCaM使用了一个管道预取器，它重叠了通信和计算。此外，MCaM还采用了一种质量敏感的稀疏化算法来异构压缩每层的KV缓存。这种方法不仅减少了数据传输大小，而且还减少了KV缓存的总体大小。为了消除请求关键路径上的数据卸载，我们设计了一个异步卸载引擎，在后台将数据从HBM交换到DRAM。我们的实验表明，MCaM可以减少高达69%的TTFT，并将快速预填充吞吐量提高3.3倍。当请求长度增加到4096个令牌时，它还可以将LLM推理的端到端延迟减少58%。
papers.ai_summary_en: MCaM addresses the high memory cost and inefficient scheduling of reusing KV caches across LLM requests, especially in multi-turn and assistant workloads. It introduces a multi-tier DRAM/HBM KV cache system that co-designs request scheduling and cache placement, using pipeline prefetching, asynchronous HBM-to-DRAM offloading, and quality-aware per-layer KV sparsification. Experiments show up to 69% lower TTFT, 3.3× higher prompt prefill throughput, and up to 58% lower end-to-end latency for 4096-token requests.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多轮对话等场景中 LLM 推理 KV 缓存难以跨请求复用、内存开销大且调度与缓存管理割裂的问题，提出 MCaM 多层 KV 缓存系统。其核心方法是将 KV 缓存分层存放在 GPU HBM 与 DRAM 中，并协同请求调度与缓存放置，结合流水线预取、逐层质量感知稀疏化压缩和异步卸载来降低数据搬运开销。实验表明，MCaM 最高可将 TTFT 降低 69%、提示预填充吞吐提升 3.3 倍，并在 4096 token 请求下将端到端延迟降低 58%。

papers.title: Frontier: Simulating the Next Generation of LLM Inference Systems
papers.authors: Yicheng Feng, Xin Tan, Kin Hang Sew, Yimin Jiang, Yibo Zhu
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) inference is growing increasingly complex with the rise of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models and disaggregated architectures that decouple components like prefill/decode (PD) or attention/FFN (AF) for heterogeneous scaling. Existing simulators, however, fall short in modeling the system-level complexities of distributed serving, and thus are unable to capture the intricate system dynamics of these emerging paradigms. We present Frontier, a high-fidelity simulator designed from the ground up for this new landscape. Frontier introduces a unified framework to model both co-located and disaggregated systems, providing native support for MoE inference with expert parallelism (EP). It enables the simulation of complex workflows like cross-cluster expert routing and advanced pipelining strategies for latency hiding. To ensure fidelity and usability, Frontier incorporates refined operator models for improved accuracy. Frontier empowers the community to design and optimize the future of LLM inference at scale.
papers.abstract_cn: 随着专家混合（MoE）模型和分解架构的兴起，大型语言模型（LLM）推理变得越来越复杂，分解架构可以解耦预填充/解码（PD）或注意/FFN （AF）等组件，用于异构扩展。然而，现有的模拟器在对分布式服务的系统级复杂性建模方面存在不足，因此无法捕捉这些新兴范例的复杂系统动态。我们将呈现Frontier，这是一款专为这一全新领域而设计的高保真模拟器。Frontier引入了一个统一的框架来建模共定位和分解系统，为具有专家并行性（EP）的MoE推理提供原生支持。它可以模拟复杂的工作流，如跨集群专家路由和用于延迟隐藏的高级流水线策略。为了确保保真度和可用性，Frontier采用了改进的操作员模型来提高精度。Frontier使社区能够大规模地设计和优化LLM推理的未来。
papers.ai_summary_en: Frontier addresses the inability of existing LLM inference simulators to model system-level complexities introduced by Mixture-of-Experts models and disaggregated serving architectures such as prefill/decode and attention/FFN separation. It proposes a unified high-fidelity simulator with native support for expert parallelism, cross-cluster expert routing, advanced pipelining for latency hiding, and refined operator-level performance models. This enables more accurate design, evaluation, and optimization of large-scale distributed LLM inference systems under heterogeneous scaling and complex scheduling constraints.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 MoE 大模型与 prefill/decode、attention/FFN 等解耦架构带来的分布式推理系统难以准确建模的问题，指出现有模拟器无法刻画专家并行、跨集群路由和复杂流水线等系统动态。其核心方法是提出 Frontier 高保真模拟器，以统一框架支持共置与解耦部署，并原生建模 MoE 推理、专家并行、跨集群专家路由及延迟隐藏流水线策略，同时引入更精细的算子模型提升准确性。该工作为下一代大规模 LLM 推理系统的设计、调度优化和架构探索提供了可用仿真基础。

papers.title: Evaluating CXL Memory Pooling for Scalable LLM Inference
papers.authors: Sai Krishna Vemuri, Venkata Ravi Shankar Jonnalagadda, Ajay Joshi, Rohit Sindhu, Vijay Kumar Motagi
papers.abstract_en: Large-context LLM inference increasingly faces bottlenecks in Key-Value (KV) cache capacity and bandwidth rather than raw compute. While on-package HBM delivers exceptional bandwidth, its capacity is limited; when long prompts or multi-tenant workloads exceed the HBM KV cache budget, operators turn to re-computation or offloading to system memory or storage—both with significant performance costs. Compute Express Link (CXL) introduces a flexible, low-latency, load/store memory tier that can be pooled and shared across nodes using PCIe 6.0 PHY, multi-level switching, and fabric features in CXL 3.x. This paper examines when and why CXL memory pooling helps LLM serving: we explain the inference pipeline and KV cache growth dynamics, discuss architectural advantages and deployment considerations for CXL pooling, and present a compact analytical model of per-accelerator throughput vs. context length that compares HBM-only with re-computation, HBM + distributed DDR, and HBM + CXL pooled memory. With realistic parameters from contemporary GPUs, 800 GbE networks, and CXL fabrics, our model shows that CXL pooling sustains substantially higher throughput beyond the HBM-fit regime (e.g., ≥ 100 k tokens) by reducing per-segment residual stalls compared to distributed DDR, while avoiding the severe collapse of re-computation. We close with sensitivity analyses, limitations, and guidance for deploying CXL fabrics in long-context serving stacks.
papers.abstract_cn: 大上下文LLM推理越来越多地面临键值（KV）缓存容量和带宽瓶颈，而不是原始计算瓶颈。虽然封装内HBM提供了出色的带宽，但其容量有限；当长提示或多租户工作负载超过HBM KV缓存预算时，运营商将转向重新计算或卸载到系统内存或存储中，这两种方法都会带来显著的性能成本。CXL （Compute Express Link）引入了一个灵活、低延迟、负载/存储的内存层，可以使用CXL 3.x中的PCIe 6.0 PHY、多级交换和fabric特性在节点之间进行池化和共享。本文研究了CXL内存池何时以及为什么有助于LLM服务：我们解释了推理管道和KV缓存增长动态，讨论了CXL池的架构优势和部署考虑因素，并提出了一个紧凑的每个加速器吞吐量与上下文长度的分析模型，该模型比较了仅HBM与重新计算、HBM +分布式DDR和HBM + CXL池内存。使用来自当代gpu、800 GbE网络和CXL结构的现实参数，我们的模型显示，与分布式DDR相比，通过减少每段剩余延迟，CXL池在超出hbm匹配机制（例如，≥100 k令牌）的情况下保持了更高的吞吐量，同时避免了重新计算的严重崩溃。最后，我们对在长上下文服务堆栈中部署CXL结构进行了敏感性分析、限制和指导。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses the KV-cache capacity and bandwidth bottleneck in long-context, multi-tenant LLM inference, where limited HBM forces costly recomputation or offloading to slower memory tiers. It develops an analytical throughput-versus-context-length model comparing HBM-only execution, recomputation, HBM plus distributed DDR, and HBM plus CXL-pooled memory, emphasizing CXL 3.x low-latency load/store sharing across nodes. With realistic GPU, 800 GbE, and CXL fabric parameters, the model shows that CXL pooling sustains substantially higher throughput beyond the HBM-fit regime (e.g., ≥100k tokens) by reducing stalls relative to distributed DDR and avoiding the severe performance collapse of recomputation.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV cache 受限于 HBM 容量、而重计算或卸载到 DDR/存储会带来显著性能损失的问题，评估了基于 CXL 的池化内存作为低延迟共享内存层的可行性。其核心方法是建立每加速器吞吐随上下文长度变化的分析模型，比较 HBM-only 重计算、HBM+分布式 DDR 与 HBM+CXL 池化内存三种方案。结果显示，在超过约 100k token 的 HBM 不足场景下，CXL 池化可显著降低残留停顿、维持更高吞吐并避免重计算导致的性能崩塌，为长上下文推理的 CXL fabric 部署提供了设计依据。

papers.title: Serving LLM in Distributed GPU Cluster With Fine-Grain Pipeline Constraints
papers.authors: Yanying Lin, Shijie Peng, Shuaipeng Wu, Yanbo Li, Chengzhi Lu
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to advance, their parameter sizes are growing exponentially—far outpacing hardware capabilities. This widening gap necessitates distributed computing through pipeline parallelism for efficient inference. However, the uneven distribution of requests across pipeline stages creates significant performance bottlenecks in real-world deployments. To address this challenge, we present Planck, a performance optimization framework specifically designed for distributed LLM inference. Planck implements fine-grained control through two key mechanisms: a progressive SLO allocation strategy that dynamically adjusts time constraints based on workload patterns, and stage-specific performance controllers that prevent bottlenecks before they cascade through the system. By intelligently balancing resources across pipeline stages, Planck effectively eliminates queue buildup—essentially preventing traffic congestion before it forms. Evaluation using diverse workloads in real cloud environments demonstrates that Planck reduces P99 tail latency by up to 18% and decreases the longest queue lengths by as much as 47.8% across pipeline stages, significantly improving both system responsiveness and resource utilization.
papers.abstract_cn: 随着大型语言模型（llm）的不断发展，它们的参数大小呈指数级增长——远远超过硬件能力。这种不断扩大的差距需要通过管道并行进行分布式计算，以实现有效的推理。然而，跨管道阶段请求的不均匀分布在实际部署中造成了严重的性能瓶颈。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了Planck，这是一个专门为分布式LLM推理设计的性能优化框架。Planck通过两个关键机制实现了细粒度控制：基于工作负载模式动态调整时间约束的渐进式SLO分配策略，以及在系统出现瓶颈之前防止瓶颈的阶段特定性能控制器。通过智能地平衡管道各阶段的资源，Planck有效地消除了队列的形成——从本质上说，在交通拥堵形成之前就阻止了它。在真实云环境中使用不同工作负载的评估表明，Planck将P99尾部延迟减少了18%，并将管道阶段的最长队列长度减少了47.8%，显著提高了系统响应能力和资源利用率。
papers.ai_summary_en: Planck addresses performance bottlenecks in distributed LLM inference caused by uneven request loads across pipeline-parallel stages, which lead to queue buildup and elevated tail latency. It introduces fine-grained pipeline control via progressive SLO allocation that adapts per-stage latency budgets to workload patterns and stage-specific controllers that proactively balance resources to prevent cascading bottlenecks. Evaluations in real cloud environments show up to 18% lower P99 latency and up to 47.8% shorter maximum stage queues, improving responsiveness and resource utilization.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对分布式LLM流水线推理中各阶段请求负载不均导致队列堆积和尾延迟恶化的问题。提出 Planck 框架，通过渐进式 SLO 分配动态设定各阶段时延约束，并结合阶段级性能控制器提前调节资源、防止瓶颈级联。实验表明，其在真实云负载下可将 P99 尾延迟最高降低 18%，最长队列长度减少 47.8%，提升系统响应性与资源利用率。

papers.title: [GitHub] llm-server: Smart launcher for llama.cpp / ik_llama.cpp — auto-detects GPUs, optimizes MoE placement, crash reco
papers.authors: raketenkater
papers.abstract_en: Smart launcher for llama.cpp / ik_llama.cpp — auto-detects GPUs, optimizes MoE placement, crash recovery
papers.abstract_cn: llama.cpp / ik_llama.cpp 智能启动器 — 自动检测 GPU，优化 MoE 布局，崩溃恢复
papers.ai_summary_en: This project addresses the operational challenge of deploying MoE models with llama.cpp/ik_llama.cpp across heterogeneous GPU setups, where manual layer offloading and failure handling are error-prone. Its key method is a smart launcher that auto-detects available GPUs, optimizes MoE layer placement across devices, and adds crash recovery for more robust inference. The main impact is simplified, more reliable local MoE serving with better GPU utilization and reduced manual configuration.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向 llama.cpp / ik_llama.cpp 的 MoE 模型推理部署，解决多 GPU 环境下设备检测、专家层放置和运行崩溃后恢复的问题。其核心方法是提供一个智能启动器，自动探测 GPU 资源并优化 MoE 层的分布，同时加入崩溃恢复机制以提升部署鲁棒性。主要影响是降低 MoE 推理的手工配置成本，并提高多 GPU 本地推理的可用性与稳定性。

papers.title: QIGen: A Kernel Generator for Inference on Nonuniformly Quantized Large Language Models
papers.authors: Tommaso Pegolotti, Dan Alistarh, Markus Püschel
papers.abstract_en: Efficient inference on large language models (LLMs) has become a popular topic in both academia and industry. Roughly speaking, LLMs consist of a collection of weight matrices, and generative inference on these models essentially computes a sequence of matrix-vector products and thus can be heavily memory-bound. Consequently, much work has been devoted to reducing the size of the weights to lower bit-widths through various forms of quantization. In turn, these diverse precision formats complicate both the arithmetic and optimized kernel implementation. So far, the vast majority of implementation work for mixed-precision LLM computation has been done manually. Currently, one of the most powerful and complex scalar LLM compression techniques is nonuniform quantization, in which a matrix is divided unevenly into parts that are quantized with different bit-widths, minimizing the output compression error. In this paper, we present QIGen, the first kernel generator for LLM inference on CPUs to support nonuniform quantization in full generality. Given a nonuniformly quantized LLM and target CPU characteristics, QIGen first generates the diverse set of needed custom matrix-vector product kernels and combines them with a suitable storage format. We benchmark and analyze QIGen-generated code in various experiments. In particular, we show that our code achieves Pareto optimality in terms of performance and accuracy with respect to the most used open-source tool. We show a speedup of up to 1.3× for the matrix-vector and 3.4× for the matrix-matrix computations even when using uniform quantization.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）的高效推理已经成为学术界和工业界的热门话题。粗略地说，llm由一组权重矩阵组成，这些模型上的生成推理本质上是计算一系列矩阵-向量乘积，因此可能有很大的内存限制。因此，很多工作都致力于通过各种形式的量化来减小权重的大小以降低比特宽度。反过来，这些不同的精度格式使算法和优化的内核实现复杂化。到目前为止，混合精度LLM计算的绝大多数实现工作都是手工完成的。目前，最强大和复杂的标量LLM压缩技术之一是非均匀量化，该技术将矩阵不均匀地分成不同位宽量化的部分，以最大限度地减少输出压缩误差。在本文中，我们提出了QIGen，第一个在cpu上支持非均匀量化的核生成器。给定非均匀量化的LLM和目标CPU特性，QIGen首先生成所需的各种定制矩阵-向量积内核集，并将它们与合适的存储格式组合在一起。我们在各种实验中对qigen生成的代码进行基准测试和分析。特别是，我们展示了我们的代码在性能和准确性方面达到了帕累托最优，相对于最常用的开源工具。我们发现，即使使用均匀量化，矩阵-向量计算的加速也高达1.3倍，矩阵-矩阵计算的加速也高达3.4倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: QIGen addresses efficient CPU inference for LLMs under nonuniform mixed-precision quantization, where uneven per-matrix bit-width allocation reduces compression error but complicates high-performance kernel implementation. It is the first CPU kernel generator to support nonuniform quantization in full generality, automatically producing customized matrix-vector kernels and selecting storage formats tailored to the quantized model and target CPU. Experiments show Pareto-optimal performance–accuracy tradeoffs versus common open-source tools, with speedups up to 1.3× for matrix-vector and 3.4× for matrix-matrix computation even under uniform quantization.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对大语言模型推理中非均匀量化带来的混合精度计算复杂、CPU 内核难以手工优化的问题。  
QIGen 可根据非均匀量化模型和目标 CPU 特性，自动生成配套的定制矩阵-向量内核及存储格式，实现通用化内核生成。  
实验表明，其生成代码在性能与精度上达到帕累托最优，即使使用均匀量化也可带来最高 1.3× 矩阵-向量和 3.4× 矩阵-矩阵加速。

papers.title: LP-Spec: Leveraging LPDDR PIM for Efficient LLM Mobile Speculative Inference with Architecture-Dataflow Co-Optimization
papers.authors: Siyuan He, Zhantong Zhu, Yandong He, Tianyu Jia
papers.abstract_en: LLM inference on mobile devices faces extraneous challenges due to limited memory bandwidth and computational resources. To address these issues, speculative inference and processing-in-memory (PIM) techniques have been explored at the algorithmic and hardware levels. However, speculative inference results in more compute-intensive GEMM operations, creating new design trade-offs for existing GEMV-accelerated PIM architectures. Furthermore, there exists a significant amount of redundant draft tokens in tree-based speculative inference, necessitating efficient token management schemes to minimize energy consumption. In this work, we present LP-Spec, an architecture-dataflow co-design leveraging hybrid LPDDR5 performance-enhanced PIM architecture with draft token pruning and dynamic workload scheduling to accelerate LLM speculative inference. A near-data memory controller is proposed to enable data reallocation between DRAM and PIM banks. Furthermore, a data allocation unit based on the hardware-aware draft token pruner is developed to minimize energy consumption and fully exploit parallel execution opportunities. Compared to end-to-end LLM inference on other mobile solutions such as mobile NPUs or GEMV-accelerated PIMs, our LP-Spec achieves 13.21× , 7.56 ×, and 99.87× improvements in performance, energy efficiency, and energy-delay-product (EDP). Compared with prior AttAcc PIM and RTX 3090 GPU, LP-Spec can obtain 12.83× and 415.31× EDP reduction benefits.
papers.abstract_cn: 由于有限的内存带宽和计算资源，移动设备上的LLM推理面临着外来的挑战。为了解决这些问题，已经在算法和硬件级别探索了推测推理和内存中处理（PIM）技术。然而，推测推理导致了更多的计算密集型GEMM操作，为现有的gemv加速PIM架构带来了新的设计权衡。此外，在基于树的投机推理中存在大量冗余的代币草案，需要有效的代币管理方案来最大限度地减少能源消耗。在这项工作中，我们提出了LP-Spec，这是一种架构-数据流协同设计，利用混合LPDDR5性能增强的PIM架构，具有草案令牌修剪和动态工作负载调度，以加速LLM推测推断。提出了一种近数据存储器控制器来实现DRAM和PIM库之间的数据再分配。此外，开发了基于硬件感知草案令牌修剪器的数据分配单元，以最大限度地减少能耗并充分利用并行执行机会。与其他移动解决方案（如移动npu或gemv加速的pim）上的端到端LLM推理相比，我们的LP-Spec在性能、能效和能量延迟积（EDP）方面实现了13.21倍、7.56倍和99.87倍的改进。与之前的AttAcc PIM和RTX 3090 GPU相比，LP-Spec可以获得12.83倍和415.31倍的EDP降低效益。
papers.ai_summary_en: LP-Spec addresses mobile LLM inference bottlenecks from limited memory bandwidth and compute, exacerbated by speculative decoding’s shift toward compute-heavy GEMM verification and redundant tree-based draft tokens. The paper proposes an architecture–dataflow co-design using hybrid LPDDR5 performance-enhanced PIM, a near-data memory controller for DRAM/PIM data reallocation, and hardware-aware draft-token pruning with dynamic workload scheduling to maximize parallelism and minimize energy. Reported results show 13.21× performance, 7.56× energy-efficiency, and 99.87× EDP improvements over mobile NPU/GEMV-PIM baselines, with 12.83× and 415.31× EDP reductions versus AttAcc PIM and RTX 3090.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对移动端大模型推测推理受限于内存带宽和算力、且树状草稿 token 冗余加剧 PIM 上 GEMM/能耗权衡的问题，提出 LP-Spec 架构-数据流协同设计。其核心是在 LPDDR5 增强型 PIM 中引入近数据内存控制器、硬件感知草稿 token 剪枝和动态负载调度，实现 DRAM 与 PIM bank 间的数据重分配与并行执行优化。实验表明，相较移动 NPU 和 GEMV 加速 PIM 等方案，性能、能效和 EDP 分别提升 13.21×、7.56× 和 99.87×，并显著优于 AttAcc PIM 与 RTX 3090 的能效延迟积。

papers.title: FreeKV: Boosting KV Cache Retrieval for Efficient LLM Inference
papers.authors: Guangda Liu, Chengwei Li, Zhenyu Ning, Jing Lin, Yiwu Yao
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are widely deployed with rapidly expanding context windows to support increasingly demanding applications. However, long contexts pose significant deployment challenges, primarily due to the KV cache whose size grows proportionally with context length. While KV cache compression methods have been proposed to address this issue, KV dropping methods incur considerable accuracy loss, and KV retrieval methods suffer from significant efficiency bottlenecks. We propose FreeKV, a training-free algorithm-system co-optimization framework to enhance KV retrieval efficiency while preserving accuracy.
