On the algorithm side, FreeKV introduces speculative retrieval to shift the KV selection and recall processes out of the critical path, combined with fine-grained correction to ensure accuracy. On the system side, FreeKV employs hybrid KV layouts across CPU and GPU memory to eliminate fragmented data transfers, and leverages double-buffered streamed recall to further improve efficiency, enabling effective overlap with computation, full latency hiding, and practical speedups from speculative recall. Experiments demonstrate that FreeKV achieves near-lossless accuracy across various scenarios and models, delivering up to a 13$\times$ speedup compared to SOTA KV retrieval methods. Code is available at https://github.com/sjtu-zhao-lab/FreeKV.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）被广泛部署，具有快速扩展的上下文窗口，以支持要求越来越高的应用程序。然而，长上下文带来了重大的部署挑战，主要是由于KV缓存的大小与上下文长度成比例地增长。虽然已经提出了千伏缓存压缩方法来解决这一问题，但千伏下降方法会造成相当大的精度损失，而千伏检索方法则存在明显的效率瓶颈。我们提出了FreeKV，一个不需要训练的算法系统协同优化框架，以提高KV检索效率，同时保持准确性。在算法方面，FreeKV引入了推测检索，将KV选择和召回过程移出关键路径，并结合细粒度校正以确保准确性。在系统方面，FreeKV采用跨CPU和GPU内存的混合KV布局来消除碎片数据传输，并利用双缓冲流回收来进一步提高效率，实现有效的计算重叠、完全延迟隐藏和投机回收的实际速度。实验表明，FreeKV在各种场景和模型中都实现了近乎无损的精度，与SOTA KV检索方法相比，速度提高了13倍。代码可从https://github.com/sjtu-zhao-lab/FreeKV获得。
papers.ai_summary_en: FreeKV addresses the efficiency bottleneck of KV-cache retrieval in long-context LLM inference, where KV dropping harms accuracy and existing retrieval methods incur high latency. It proposes a training-free algorithm–system co-design that uses speculative retrieval to move KV selection and recall off the critical path, with fine-grained correction, hybrid CPU/GPU KV layouts, and double-buffered streamed recall to overlap memory transfers with computation. Experiments show near-lossless accuracy across models and scenarios, with up to 13× speedup over state-of-the-art KV retrieval methods.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV Cache 体积过大、现有 KV 检索方法效率瓶颈明显的问题，提出了免训练的算法—系统协同优化框架 FreeKV。其核心洞见是通过投机式 KV 检索将选择与召回移出关键路径，并结合细粒度校正、CPU/GPU 混合 KV 布局和双缓冲流式召回来隐藏延迟、提升吞吐。实验表明，FreeKV 在多种模型和场景下保持近无损精度，相比最先进 KV 检索方法最高可实现 13 倍加速。

papers.title: R-Sparse: Rank-Aware Activation Sparsity for Efficient LLM Inference
papers.authors: Zhenyu (Allen) Zhang, Zechun Liu, Yuandong Tian, Harshit Khaitan, Zhangyang Wang
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs), while demonstrating remarkable capabilities across various applications, present significant challenges during inference due to their substantial model size, especially when deployed on edge devices. Activation sparsity offers a promising solution to reduce computation and memory movement, enabling more efficient inference, particularly for small-batch on-device applications. However, current approaches face limitations with non-ReLU activation function, which are foundational to most advanced LLMs, or require heavy continual training. Additionally, the difficulty in predicting active channels and limited achievable sparsity ratios constrain the effectiveness of activation sparsity-based methods. In this paper, we introduce R-Sparse, a training-free activation sparsity approach capable of achieving high sparsity levels in advanced LLMs. We conducted two preliminary investigations into how different components contribute to the output within a single linear layer and found two key observations: (i) the non-sparse components of the input function can be regarded as a few bias terms, and (ii) The full computation can be effectively approximated by an appropriate combination of input channels and weight singular values. Building on this, we replace the linear layers in LLMs with a rank-aware sparse inference method that leverages the sparsity of input channels and singular value components, eliminating the need for active channel prediction like the output sparsity based approaches. Experiments on Llama-2/3 and Mistral models across ten diverse tasks demonstrate that R-Sparse achieves comparable performance at 50% model-level sparsity, resulting in a significant 43% end-to-end efficient improvements with customized kernels.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）虽然在各种应用程序中展示了卓越的功能，但由于其庞大的模型尺寸，特别是在部署在边缘设备上时，在推理过程中提出了重大挑战。激活稀疏性提供了一个很有前途的解决方案，可以减少计算和内存移动，实现更有效的推理，特别是对于小批量设备上的应用程序。然而，目前的方法面临非relu激活功能的限制，而非relu激活功能是大多数高级llm的基础，或者需要大量的持续训练。此外，预测有源通道的困难和有限的可实现稀疏比限制了基于激活稀疏性方法的有效性。在本文中，我们介绍了R-Sparse，一种无需训练的激活稀疏性方法，能够在高级llm中实现高稀疏性水平。我们对不同分量如何在单个线性层内对输出做出贡献进行了两次初步调查，并发现了两个关键观察结果：(i)输入函数的非稀疏分量可以被视为几个偏倚项，以及（ii）通过输入通道和权重奇异值的适当组合可以有效地近似整个计算。在此基础上，我们用秩感知稀疏推理方法取代llm中的线性层，该方法利用输入通道和奇异值组件的稀疏性，消除了像基于输出稀疏性的方法那样对主动通道预测的需要。在Llama-2/3和Mistral模型上进行的10个不同任务的实验表明，R-Sparse在50%的模型级稀疏度下实现了相当的性能，使用定制内核可以显著提高43%的端到端效率。
papers.ai_summary_en: R-Sparse addresses efficient edge inference for LLMs by enabling training-free activation sparsity for non-ReLU models, overcoming prior limitations such as retraining requirements and active-channel prediction. Its key insight is that linear-layer computation can be approximated by combining sparse input channels with weight singular-value components, treating non-sparse input contributions as bias terms and replacing linear layers with a rank-aware sparse operator. Across Llama-2/3 and Mistral on ten tasks, it maintains comparable accuracy at 50% model-level sparsity and achieves a 43% end-to-end efficiency improvement with customized kernels.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM边缘推理中激活稀疏方法难以适配非ReLU激活、依赖重训练和活跃通道预测的问题，提出免训练的 R-Sparse。其核心洞见是线性层计算可由少量偏置项以及输入通道与权重奇异值的组合近似，从而以秩感知方式利用输入通道稀疏性进行高效推理。实验显示，在 Llama-2/3 和 Mistral 上于 50% 模型级稀疏度下性能相当，并借助定制内核实现 43% 的端到端效率提升。

papers.title: First Experimental Demonstration of Disturb-Free 3D Vertical 1T-nC-1T Ferroelectric-based KV Cache with Co-Optimization of Hybrid Analog-Digital CIM and Token-Wise Dynamic Pruning for Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.authors: Weikai Xu, Danyun Luo, Minyue Deng, Shuzhang Zhong, Shengjie Cao
papers.abstract_en: For the first time, a ferroelectric (FE)-based key-value (KV) cache for large language models (LLMs) is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. Through device-architecture-algorithm co-optimization, a novel 3D vertical 1T-nC-1T FeRAM structure, featuring orthogonally aligned word-lines/bit-lines and shared FE capacitor (FeCap) strings, as well as a hybrid analog-digital compute-in-memory (CIM) architecture with token-wise dynamic pruning algorithm, are presented. The designed 1T-nC-based analog CIM with small-signal non-destructive read can evaluate similarity in O(1) time for efficient token selection, and the nC-1T-based digital CIM with robust destructive read supports accurate attention computation with a subset of selected KV cache, enabling efficient and accurate processing of dynamically sparse KV cache workloads. Besides, by optimizing data mapping scheme, parallel computation across nC strings is enabled, leading to enhanced throughput and avoided write disturbance. Based on the above design, a 3D 3×32×32 FeCap array is experimentally fabricated with ~10ns switching, 10-year retention, 1016 endurance and good consistency, and the KV cache-based attention is demonstrated with 6×/315× improved performance and energy efficiency over the state-of-the-art designs, along with high accuracy comparable with full attention, showing its great potential for efficient long-context LLM inference.
papers.abstract_cn: 首次提出了一种用于大型语言模型（llm）的基于铁电（FE）的键值（KV）缓存，并进行了实验验证。通过器件-架构-算法协同优化，提出了一种新颖的三维垂直1T-nC-1T FeRAM结构，该结构具有正交对齐的字线/位线和共享FE电容器（FeCap）字符串，以及具有令牌动态修剪算法的模拟-数字内存计算（CIM）混合结构。设计的基于1t - nc的模拟CIM具有小信号非破坏性读取功能，可以在O(1)时间内评估相似性，从而实现高效的令牌选择；基于nc -1的数字CIM具有鲁棒破坏性读取功能，支持对所选KV缓存子集进行精确的注意力计算，从而实现对动态稀疏KV缓存工作负载的高效准确处理。此外，通过优化数据映射方案，实现了跨nC串的并行计算，提高了吞吐量，避免了写入干扰。在此基础上，实验制作了一个三维3×32×32 FeCap阵列，具有~10ns开关，10年保持时间，1016年续航时间和良好的一致性，并证明了基于KV缓存的注意力比目前最先进的设计提高了6倍/ 315x的性能和能效，同时具有与全注意力相当的高精度，显示了其在高效长背景LLM推理方面的巨大潜力。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the KV-cache memory and compute bottleneck in long-context LLM inference, including dense-attention inefficiency and write-disturb issues in emerging memory arrays. It proposes a 3D vertical 1T-nC-1T ferroelectric FeRAM KV cache co-optimized with hybrid analog-digital compute-in-memory: analog non-destructive reads enable O(1) similarity-based token-wise dynamic pruning, while digital destructive reads compute accurate attention over the selected KV subset, with a data mapping scheme that parallelizes computation and avoids write disturbance. A fabricated 3×32×32 FeCap array demonstrates ~10 ns switching, 10-year retention, 10¹⁶ endurance, and attention with ~6× performance and ~315× energy-efficiency improvements over state-of-the-art designs while maintaining near-full-attention accuracy.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对长上下文LLM推理中KV缓存访存瓶颈和铁电存储写扰动问题，论文首次实验验证了一种无扰动3D垂直1T-nC-1T铁电KV缓存。其核心洞见是通过器件—架构—算法协同优化，用1T-nC模拟CIM实现O(1)相似度的token选择，再用nC-1T数字CIM在动态剪枝后的KV子集上完成高精度注意力计算。实测3D阵列具备约10ns翻转、10年保持和10¹⁶次耐久，注意力精度接近全量计算，性能与能效较先进方案分别提升6×和315×。

papers.title: [GitHub] llm-optimizer: Benchmark and optimize LLM inference across frameworks with ease
papers.authors: bentoml
papers.abstract_en: Benchmark and optimize LLM inference across frameworks with ease
papers.abstract_cn: 轻松在各框架中对大型语言模型推理进行基准测试和优化
papers.ai_summary_en: The work addresses the difficulty of consistently benchmarking and optimizing LLM inference performance across heterogeneous serving frameworks and hardware stacks. It introduces **llm-optimizer**, a tool that unifies inference benchmarking and optimization workflows, allowing users to compare frameworks and tune serving configurations with minimal setup. The main impact is streamlined, reproducible evaluation of latency/throughput trade-offs and easier identification of efficient deployment settings, though the provided abstract reports no quantitative results.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向 LLM 推理服务中跨框架性能评测与优化流程复杂的问题，提供了一个统一的基准测试与优化工具，便于比较不同推理框架的表现。其核心思路是通过标准化测试和易用接口，降低推理栈选择、调优与部署的成本。该工具有助于提升 LLM 推理效率，并为系统选型和性能优化提供实践参考。

papers.title: [GitHub] lite_llama: A light llama-like llm inference framework based on the triton kernel.
papers.authors: harleyszhang
papers.abstract_en: A light llama-like llm inference framework based on the triton kernel.
papers.abstract_cn: 一个基于 Triton 内核的轻量级类羊驼 LLM 推理框架。
papers.ai_summary_en: lite_llama addresses the problem of providing a lightweight inference framework for LLaMA-style large language models using GPU kernels. Its key approach is implementing the inference pipeline with Triton kernels, enabling a compact and potentially efficient alternative to heavier LLM serving stacks. The main impact is a simplified, kernel-level inference system for LLaMA-like models, though the available abstract provides no quantitative performance results.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向 LLaMA 类大模型推理内核优化问题，构建了一个基于 Triton 的轻量级推理框架，用于实现和调度关键 GPU 算子。其核心思路是借助 Triton 编写与融合推理内核，在保持类 LLaMA 推理流程的同时提升实现灵活性和可扩展性。摘要未提供定量结果，主要价值在于为推理内核研究与工程优化提供简洁基线。

papers.title: [GitHub] asystem-awex: A high-performance RL training-inference weight synchronization framework, designed to enable second
papers.authors: inclusionAI
papers.abstract_en: A high-performance RL training-inference weight synchronization framework, designed to enable second-level parameter updates from training to inference in RL workflows
papers.abstract_cn: 一个高性能的强化学习训练-推理权重同步框架，旨在实现从训练到推理的强化学习工作流中秒级参数更新
papers.ai_summary_en: asystem-awex addresses the latency bottleneck in LLM reinforcement-learning workflows where updated policy weights must be transferred from training systems to inference/serving engines. It proposes a high-performance training–inference weight synchronization framework that enables second-level parameter propagation, allowing rollout generation to use freshly updated weights with minimal staleness. The main impact is tighter coupling between RL training and serving, reducing weight-update overhead and improving the efficiency of online RL pipelines for large language models.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向大模型强化学习中训练与推理分离导致的权重同步慢、在线迭代效率低问题，提出了高性能训练—推理权重同步框架 awex。其核心思路是优化 RL 工作流中的参数更新与传输链路，实现训练侧模型权重到推理服务的秒级同步。该框架有助于降低在线 RL 训练—推理闭环延迟，提升大模型持续训练与实时服务迭代的效率。

papers.title: [GitHub] ddtree-mlx: Tree-based speculative decoding for Apple Silicon (MLX). ~10-15% faster than DFlash on code, ~1.5x o
papers.authors: humanrouter
papers.abstract_en: Tree-based speculative decoding for Apple Silicon (MLX). ~10-15% faster than DFlash on code, ~1.5x over autoregressive. First MLX port with custom Metal kernels for hybrid model support.
papers.abstract_cn: 基于树的投机解码用于苹果硅（MLX）。在代码上比 DFlash 快约 10-15%，比自回归快约 1.5 倍。首个 MLX 移植版本，具有用于混合模型支持的自定义 Metal 内核。
papers.ai_summary_en: The work addresses slow autoregressive LLM inference on Apple Silicon by implementing tree-based speculative decoding in MLX, with a focus on code-generation workloads. Its key contribution is the first MLX port of this approach, using custom Metal kernels to support hybrid draft/target models and efficient tree-structured proposal and verification. Reported results show roughly 10–15% speedup over DFlash on code and about 1.5× faster decoding than standard autoregressive inference.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向 Apple Silicon 上的 MLX 推理场景，解决自回归解码吞吐受限且缺少高效树形投机解码实现的问题。其核心方法是首次将树形投机解码移植到 MLX，并通过自定义 Metal 内核支持混合草稿/目标模型的高效验证。实验显示，在代码任务上比 DFlash 快约 10–15%，相对自回归解码约提升 1.5 倍。

papers.title: [GitHub] Speculative-Decoding: Implementation of the paper Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding, Leviathan et
papers.authors: romsto
papers.abstract_en: Implementation of the paper Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding, Leviathan et al. 2023.
papers.abstract_cn: 实现论文《通过推测解码从变压器进行快速推理》，Leviathan 等，2023 年。
papers.ai_summary_en: This work addresses the latency bottleneck of autoregressive transformer inference, where tokens must be generated sequentially. Its key method, speculative decoding, uses a smaller draft model to propose multiple candidate tokens that the large target model verifies in parallel, applying rejection sampling to preserve the target model’s output distribution exactly. The approach yields lossless inference speedups, commonly around 2–3×, by reducing the number of expensive target-model decoding steps.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对 Transformer 自回归推理逐 token 生成、延迟高的问题，给出并实现了投机解码：先由小型草稿模型并行生成候选 token，再由目标大模型一次性验证并通过接受/拒绝采样修正输出。其核心洞见是在不改变目标模型生成分布的前提下，用并行草稿和批量验证替代串行解码，从而保持生成质量。结果显示，该方法可在保持与大模型一致采样分布的同时显著提升推理吞吐、降低延迟，为后续推测解码类加速方法提供了重要基础。

papers.title: [GitHub] BigLittleDecoder: [NeurIPS'23] Speculative Decoding with Big Little Decoder
papers.authors: kssteven418
papers.abstract_en: [NeurIPS'23] Speculative Decoding with Big Little Decoder
papers.abstract_cn: [NeurIPS'23] 使用大小解码器的推测性解码
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles the high latency of autoregressive LLM decoding by introducing a heterogeneous speculative decoding framework that pairs a small “little” draft model with a large “big” target model. The little model proposes multiple candidate tokens, which the big model verifies or corrects in parallel using an acceptance mechanism designed to preserve generation quality, with confidence-based control to reduce verification overhead. Experiments show substantial inference speedups—often several-fold over standard decoding—while maintaining accuracy close to that of the large model.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对大语言模型自回归解码延迟高的问题，提出 Big Little Decoder（BiLD）推测解码框架。其核心洞见是用小模型快速草拟 token，并在小模型置信度不足时由大模型进行并行验证或回退纠正，从而减少大模型前向计算。实验表明，该方法在基本保持目标大模型生成质量的同时，显著降低推理时延并实现数倍加速。

papers.title: [GitHub] SpecTTS-Bench: [ICLR'26] Scaling Up, Speeding Up: A Benchmark of Speculative Decoding for Efficient LLM Test-Time S
papers.authors: sunshy-1
papers.abstract_en: [ICLR'26] Scaling Up, Speeding Up: A Benchmark of Speculative Decoding for Efficient LLM Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_cn: [ICLR'26] 放大与加速：面向高效大型语言模型测试时扩展的投机解码基准
papers.ai_summary_en: SpecTTS-Bench addresses the lack of a systematic benchmark for evaluating speculative decoding as a method to make LLM test-time scaling—increased inference-time compute, longer generations, or more sampled candidates—more efficient. It introduces a standardized evaluation framework measuring draft–target acceptance, latency/throughput tradeoffs, and output-quality preservation across model scales, workloads, and decoding configurations. The benchmark clarifies when speculative decoding can substantially accelerate test-time inference without degrading generation quality, providing practical guidance for efficient large-model serving.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型在测试时扩展（test-time scaling）中缺乏系统评估投机解码效率的问题，提出了 SpecTTS-Bench 基准。其核心方法是面向“扩大规模、加速推理”的场景，对投机解码在不同模型配置与推理条件下的加速效果与适用性进行系统评测。该工作为高效 LLM 推理和测试时计算扩展提供了实证依据与选型参考。

papers.title: [GitHub] TorchSpec: A PyTorch native library for training speculative decoding models
papers.authors: lightseekorg
papers.abstract_en: A PyTorch native library for training speculative decoding models
papers.abstract_cn: 一个用于训练推测解码模型的 PyTorch 原生库
papers.ai_summary_en: TorchSpec addresses the practical gap in tooling for training draft models used in speculative decoding, where small models propose tokens that a larger target model verifies to reduce autoregressive inference latency. The key contribution is a PyTorch-native library that provides training workflows and model components for building speculative decoding systems within the standard PyTorch ecosystem. Its main impact is lowering the engineering barrier for developing and experimenting with speculative decoding accelerators for large language models.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对推测解码中草稿模型训练缺乏 PyTorch 原生支持、实现成本较高的问题，提出了 TorchSpec 这一 PyTorch 原生库。其核心思路是将推测解码模型的训练流程直接嵌入 PyTorch 生态，简化模型构建、训练与集成。该工具有助于降低推测解码训练门槛，推动其在推理加速场景中的应用。

papers.title: [GitHub] Kangaroo: [NeurIPS 2024] The official implementation of "Kangaroo: Lossless Self-Speculative Decoding for Acce
papers.authors: Equationliu
papers.abstract_en: [NeurIPS 2024] The official implementation of "Kangaroo: Lossless Self-Speculative Decoding for Accelerating LLMs via Double Early Exiting"
papers.abstract_cn: [NeurIPS 2024] “袋鼠：通过双重提前退出加速大型语言模型的无损自我投机解码”的官方实现
papers.ai_summary_en: Kangaroo addresses the high latency of autoregressive LLM inference by enabling self-speculative decoding without a separate draft model. Its key idea is double early exiting: an intermediate-layer exit generates draft tokens, while a second early-exit verifier accepts easy drafts before invoking the full model, using lossless rejection-sampling-style verification to preserve the target distribution. Experiments report substantial wall-clock speedups, roughly around 2× depending on model and task, with no degradation in generation quality.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对大语言模型自回归推理延迟高的问题，提出 Kangaroo：一种无需额外草稿模型的自投机解码方法。其核心洞见是通过“双重早退”机制，让同一模型在不同深度提前生成候选 token 并进行验证，从而在保持输出分布无损的前提下加速解码。该方法在 NeurIPS 2024 中发表，主要贡献是为 LLM 推理提供了一种质量不变、实现更轻量的加速路径。

papers.title: Cloud Native System for LLM Inference Serving
papers.authors: Minxian Xu, Junhan Liao, Jingfeng Wu, Yiyuan He, Kejiang Ye
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are revolutionizing numerous industries, but their substantial computational demands create challenges for efficient deployment, particularly in cloud environments. Traditional approaches to inference serving often struggle with resource inefficiencies, leading to high operational costs, latency issues, and limited scalability. This article explores how Cloud Native technologies, such as containerization, microservices, and dynamic scheduling, can fundamentally improve LLM inference serving. By leveraging these technologies, we demonstrate how a Cloud Native system enables more efficient resource allocation, reduces latency, and enhances throughput in high-demand scenarios. Through real-world evaluations using Kubernetes-based autoscaling, we show that Cloud Native architectures can dynamically adapt to workload fluctuations, mitigating performance bottlenecks while optimizing LLM inference serving performance. This discussion provides a broader perspective on how Cloud Native frameworks could reshape the future of scalable LLM inference serving, offering key insights for researchers, practitioners, and industry leaders in cloud computing and artificial intelligence.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）正在革新许多行业，但是它们大量的计算需求为高效部署带来了挑战，特别是在云环境中。传统的推理服务方法常常面临资源效率低下的问题，从而导致高运营成本、延迟问题和有限的可伸缩性。本文探讨了云原生技术（如容器化、微服务和动态调度）如何从根本上改进LLM推理服务。通过利用这些技术，我们将演示Cloud Native系统如何在高需求场景中实现更有效的资源分配、减少延迟并提高吞吐量。通过使用基于kubernetes的自动扩展的实际评估，我们表明云原生架构可以动态地适应工作负载波动，减轻性能瓶颈，同时优化LLM推理服务性能。本讨论提供了一个更广阔的视角，说明云原生框架如何重塑可扩展LLM推理服务的未来，为云计算和人工智能领域的研究人员、从业者和行业领导者提供了关键见解。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses inefficient resource utilization, high latency, and limited scalability in cloud-based LLM inference serving caused by traditional static serving approaches. It proposes a cloud-native system that leverages containerization, microservices, and Kubernetes-based dynamic scheduling and autoscaling to elastically allocate resources in response to workload fluctuations. Evaluations show improved throughput, reduced latency, and better performance-cost tradeoffs in high-demand scenarios, demonstrating the viability of cloud-native architectures for scalable LLM inference.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型推理服务中资源利用率低、延迟高和弹性扩展不足的问题，研究如何用云原生架构提升 LLM 推理部署效率。其核心思路是结合容器化、微服务和 Kubernetes 动态调度/自动扩缩容，实现推理负载的按需资源分配与弹性伸缩。实验与评估表明，该方法能更好适应请求波动，缓解性能瓶颈，从而降低延迟、提升吞吐并增强高并发场景下的可扩展性。

papers.title: Niyama : Breaking the Silos of LLM Inference Serving
papers.authors: Kanishk Goel, Jayashree Mohan, Nipun Kwatra, R. S. Anupindi, R. Ramjee
papers.abstract_en: The widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) has enabled diverse applications with very different latency requirements. Existing LLM serving frameworks rely on siloed infrastructure with coarse-grained workload segregation -- interactive and batch -- leading to inefficient resource utilization and limited support for fine-grained Quality-of-Service (QoS) differentiation. This results in operational inefficiencies, over-provisioning and poor load management during traffic surges. We present Niyama, a novel QoS-driven inference serving system that enables efficient co-scheduling of diverse workloads on shared infrastructure. Niyama introduces fine-grained QoS classification allowing applications to specify precise latency requirements, and dynamically adapts scheduling decisions based on real-time system state. Leveraging the predictable execution characteristics of LLM inference, Niyama implements a dynamic chunking mechanism to improve overall throughput while maintaining strict QoS guarantees. Additionally, Niyama employs a hybrid prioritization policy that balances fairness and efficiency, and employs selective request relegation that enables graceful service degradation during overload conditions. Our evaluation demonstrates that Niyama increases serving capacity by 32% compared to current siloed deployments, while maintaining QoS guarantees. Notably, under extreme load, our system reduces SLO violations by an order of magnitude compared to current strategies.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）的广泛采用使具有不同延迟需求的各种应用程序成为可能。现有的LLM服务框架依赖于具有粗粒度工作负载隔离（交互式和批处理）的孤立基础设施，导致资源利用效率低下，并且对细粒度服务质量（QoS）区分的支持有限。这导致在流量激增期间操作效率低下、供应过剩和负载管理不良。我们提出了Niyama，一个新的qos驱动的推理服务系统，它可以在共享基础设施上有效地协同调度不同的工作负载。Niyama引入了细粒度的QoS分类，允许应用程序指定精确的延迟需求，并根据实时系统状态动态调整调度决策。利用LLM推理的可预测执行特性，Niyama实现了一种动态分块机制，以提高总体吞吐量，同时保持严格的QoS保证。此外，Niyama还采用了平衡公平性和效率的混合优先级策略，并采用了选择性请求降级，从而在过载条件下实现优雅的服务降级。我们的评估表明，与目前的孤立部署相比，Niyama将服务容量提高了32%，同时保持了QoS保证。值得注意的是，在极端负载下，与当前策略相比，我们的系统将SLO违规减少了一个数量级。
papers.ai_summary_en: Niyama tackles the inefficiency of siloed LLM inference serving, where coarse interactive/batch segregation causes poor GPU utilization, over-provisioning, and weak fine-grained QoS support. It introduces a QoS-driven co-scheduling system with precise latency classes, real-time adaptive scheduling, dynamic chunking of LLM execution, hybrid fairness/efficiency prioritization, and selective request relegation for graceful overload degradation. Evaluations show it increases serving capacity by 32% over siloed deployments while preserving QoS, and reduces SLO violations under extreme load by about an order of magnitude.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对现有 LLM 推理服务将交互与批处理负载孤立部署、导致资源利用率低和细粒度 QoS 支持不足的问题。  
其核心方法是提出 QoS 驱动的共享推理服务系统 Niyama，通过细粒度延迟分类、实时动态调度、动态分块以及混合优先级与选择性降级策略，在共享基础设施上协同调度不同延迟需求的工作负载。  
实验表明，相比传统孤立部署，Niyama 在保持 QoS 的同时将服务能力提升 32%，并在极端负载下把 SLO 违规减少约一个数量级。

papers.title: Collaborative Speculative Inference for Efficient LLM Inference Serving
papers.authors: Luyao Gao, Jianchun Liu, Hong-Ze Xu, Liusheng Huang
papers.abstract_en: Speculative inference is a promising paradigm employing small speculative models (SSMs) as drafters to generate draft tokens, which are subsequently verified in parallel by the target large language model (LLM). This approach enhances the efficiency of inference serving by reducing LLM inference latency and costs while preserving generation quality. However, existing speculative methods face critical challenges, including inefficient resource utilization and limited draft acceptance, which constrain their scalability and overall effectiveness. To overcome these obstacles, we present CoSine, a novel speculative inference system that decouples sequential speculative decoding from parallel verification, enabling efficient collaboration among multiple nodes. Specifically, CoSine routes inference requests to specialized drafters based on their expertise and incorporates a confidence-based token fusion mechanism to synthesize outputs from cooperating drafters, ensuring high-quality draft generation. Additionally, CoSine dynamically orchestrates the execution of speculative decoding and verification in a pipelined manner, employing batch scheduling to selectively group requests and adaptive speculation control to minimize idle periods. By optimizing parallel workflows through heterogeneous node collaboration, CoSine balances draft generation and verification throughput in real-time, thereby maximizing resource utilization. Experimental results demonstrate that CoSine achieves superior performance compared to state-of-the-art speculative approaches. Notably, with equivalent resource costs, CoSine achieves up to a 23.2% decrease in latency and a 32.5% increase in throughput compared to baseline methods.
papers.abstract_cn: 推测推理是一种很有前途的范式，它使用小型推测模型（ssm）作为起草人来生成草案令牌，随后由目标大型语言模型（LLM）并行验证。该方法在保证生成质量的同时，减少了LLM推理延迟和成本，提高了推理服务的效率。然而，现有的投机方法面临着严峻的挑战，包括资源利用效率低下和汇票接受有限，这限制了它们的可扩展性和整体有效性。为了克服这些障碍，我们提出了cos，一种新的推测推理系统，它将顺序推测解码从并行验证中解耦，从而实现多个节点之间的高效协作。具体来说，CoSine根据专业起草者的专业知识将推理请求路由到专门的起草者，并结合基于信任的令牌融合机制来综合合作起草者的输出，确保高质量的草稿生成。此外，CoSine以流水线的方式动态编排推测解码和验证的执行，采用批调度来选择性地分组请求和自适应推测控制，以最大限度地减少空闲时间。cos通过异构节点协作优化并行工作流，实时平衡草稿生成和验证吞吐量，从而最大限度地提高资源利用率。实验结果表明，与最先进的推测方法相比，余弦算法具有优越的性能。值得注意的是，在同等资源成本的情况下，与基线方法相比，CoSine可以减少23.2%的延迟，提高32.5%的吞吐量。
papers.ai_summary_en: CoSine addresses inefficient resource utilization and low draft acceptance in speculative LLM inference serving, where small draft models and large target models must be coordinated under latency and throughput constraints. The system decouples sequential draft generation from parallel verification, routes requests to specialized drafters, fuses their outputs via confidence-based token selection, and pipelines execution with batch scheduling and adaptive speculation control across heterogeneous nodes. Experiments show that, at equivalent resource cost, CoSine reduces latency by up to 23.2% and increases throughput by up to 32.5% over state-of-the-art speculative decoding baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对投机推理中资源利用不足和草稿接受率受限的问题，提出 CoSine，将顺序草稿生成与并行验证解耦，并通过 drafter 专家路由、基于置信度的 token 融合及流水线批调度实现多异构节点协作。实验表明，在相同资源成本下，CoSine 相较先进方法可将延迟最高降低 23.2%、吞吐提升 32.5%，显著提升大模型推理服务效率。

papers.title: AccelGen: Heterogeneous SLO-Guaranteed High-Throughput LLM Inference Serving for Diverse Applications
papers.authors: Haiying Shen, Tanmoy Sen
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we consider a mixed-prompt scenario for a large language model (LLM) inference serving system that supports diverse applications with both short prompts and long prompts and heterogeneous SLOs for iteration time. To improve throughput when handling long prompts, previous research introduces a chunking method, but has not addressed heterogeneous SLOs. To address the limitation, we propose AccelGen, a high-throughput LLM inference serving system with heterogeneous SLO guarantees for diverse applications. AccelGen introduces four core components: (1) SLO-guaranteed dynamic chunking, which dynamically adjusts chunk sizes to maximize GPU compute utilization while meeting iteration-level SLOs; (2) Iteration-level SLO-based task prioritization, which prioritizes tight-SLO requests and batches requests with similar SLOs; (3) Multi-resource-aware batching, which selects queued requests to maximize the utilizations of both GPU compute resource and key-value cache (KVC). Trace-driven real experiments demonstrate that AccelGen achieves 1.42-11.21X higher throughput, 1.43-13.71X higher goodput, 37-90% higher SLO attainment, and 1.61-12.22X lower response latency compared to the state-of-the-art approaches. It achieves performance near the Oracle, which optimally maximizes goodput.
papers.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们考虑了大型语言模型（LLM）推理服务系统的混合提示场景，该系统支持具有短提示和长提示以及迭代时间的异构slo的各种应用程序。为了提高处理长提示时的吞吐量，以前的研究引入了分块方法，但没有解决异构slo问题。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了AccelGen，一个高吞吐量的LLM推理服务系统，为不同的应用提供异构SLO保证。AccelGen引入了四个核心组件：(1)保证慢速的动态分块，动态调整块大小以最大限度地提高GPU计算利用率，同时满足迭代级慢速；(2)基于迭代级slo的任务优先级，对slo较紧的请求进行优先级排序，对slo相近的请求进行批量处理；(3)多资源感知批处理，选择排队请求以最大化GPU计算资源和键值缓存（key-value cache， KVC）的利用率。跟踪驱动的实际实验表明，与最先进的方法相比，AccelGen的吞吐量提高了1.42-11.21倍，goodput提高了1.43-13.71倍，SLO提高了37-90%，响应延迟降低了1.61-12.22倍。它实现了接近Oracle的性能，从而最大限度地提高了goodput。
papers.ai_summary_en: AccelGen addresses LLM inference serving for mixed short- and long-prompt workloads with heterogeneous per-iteration SLOs, where existing prompt chunking improves throughput but cannot guarantee diverse latency targets. It combines SLO-aware dynamic chunking, iteration-SLO-based prioritization/batching, and multi-resource-aware admission to jointly maximize GPU compute and KV-cache utilization while respecting tight iteration deadlines. Trace-driven experiments show 1.42–11.21× throughput, 1.43–13.71× goodput, 37–90% higher SLO attainment, and 1.61–12.22× lower latency than state-of-the-art systems, approaching an oracle goodput bound.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对LLM推理服务在长短提示混合、且不同应用具有异构迭代级SLO场景下吞吐与延迟难以兼顾的问题。  
AccelGen通过SLO保障的动态分块、基于迭代级SLO的任务优先级调度，以及同时考虑GPU算力与KV Cache的多资源感知批处理来提升利用率并满足紧SLO请求。  
实验显示，其吞吐和goodput分别提升约1.42–11.21倍和1.43–13.71倍，SLO达成率提高37–90%，响应延迟降低1.61–12.22倍，效果接近最优Oracle。

papers.title: LLMShare: Optimizing LLM Inference Serving with Hardware Architecture Exploration
papers.authors: Hongduo Liu, Chen Bai, Peng Xu, Lihao Yin, Xianzhi Yu
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized language tasks but pose significant deployment challenges due to their substantial computational demands during inference. The hardware configurations of existing LLM serving systems do not optimize for the different computational and bandwidth needs of the prefill and decoding phases in LLM inference, leading to inefficient resource use and increased costs. In this paper, we systematically investigate promising hardware configurations for LLM inference serving. We develop a simulator that models the performance and cost across different hardware solutions and introduce a customized design space exploration framework to identify optimal setups efficiently. By aligning hardware capabilities with the specific demands of the prefill and decoding phases, we achieve $13 \%$ cost savings and over $4 \times$ throughput improvements compared to conventional serving system setups.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已经彻底改变了语言任务，但由于推理过程中计算需求巨大，其部署仍面临重大挑战。现有LLM服务系统的硬件配置未能针对LLM推理中prefill阶段和解码阶段的不同计算和带宽需求进行优化，导致资源使用效率低下和成本增加。在本文中，我们系统地研究了LLM推理服务的有前景的硬件配置。我们开发了一个模拟器，用于模拟不同硬件解决方案的性能和成本，并引入了一个定制的设计空间探索框架，以高效识别优化配置。通过将硬件能力与prefill阶段和解码阶段的特定需求对齐，我们实现了与传统服务系统设置相比，成本节省13％，吞吐量提升超过4倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses inefficient LLM inference serving caused by using hardware configurations that do not match the distinct compute- and bandwidth-bound requirements of the prefill and decoding phases. It introduces a performance/cost simulator and a customized design-space exploration framework to identify phase-aware, potentially disaggregated hardware setups aligned with these workload characteristics. The proposed optimization achieves 13% cost savings and over 4× throughput improvement compared with conventional serving configurations.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理服务中prefill与decoding阶段计算和带宽需求差异显著、但现有硬件配置未能匹配从而导致资源浪费和成本升高的问题。提出LLMShare，通过性能/成本模拟器与定制化设计空间探索框架，系统化搜索并配置更适合两阶段特征的硬件架构。结果显示，相比传统服务部署，其可实现约13%成本节省和超过4倍吞吐提升。

papers.title: DOPD: A Dynamic PD-Disaggregation Architecture for Maximizing Goodput in LLM Inference Serving
papers.authors: Junhan Liao, Minxian Xu, Wanyi Zheng, Yan Wang, Kejiang Ye
papers.abstract_en: To meet strict Service-Level Objectives (SLO), contemporary Large Language Models (LLMs) decouple the prefill and decoding stages and place them on separate GPUs to mitigate the distinct bottlenecks inherent to each stage. However, the heterogeneity of LLM workloads causes producer-consumer imbalance between the two instance types in such disaggregated architecture. To address this problem, we propose DOPD (Dynamic Optimal Prefill/Decoding), a dynamic LLM inference system that adjusts instance allocations to achieve an optimal prefill-to-decoding (P/D) ratio based on real-time load monitoring. Combined with an appropriate request-scheduling policy, DOPD effectively resolves imbalances between prefill and decoding instances and mitigates resource allocation mismatches due to mixed-length requests under high concurrency. Experimental evaluations show that, compared with vLLM and DistServe (representative aggregation-based and disaggregation-based approaches), DOPD improves overall system goodput by up to <inline-formula><tex-math notation="LaTeX">$1.5\times$</tex-math><alternatives><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mn>1</mml:mn><mml:mo>.</mml:mo><mml:mn>5</mml:mn><mml:mo>×</mml:mo></mml:mrow></mml:math><inline-graphic xlink:href="xu-ieq1-3670011.gif"/></alternatives></inline-formula>, decreases P90 time-to-first-token (TTFT) by up to 67.5%, and decreases P90 time-per-output-token (TPOT) by up to 22.8%. Furthermore, our dynamic P/D adjustment technique performs proactive reconfiguration based on historical load, achieving over 99% SLO attainment while using fewer additional resources.
papers.abstract_cn: 为了满足严格的服务水平目标（SLO），当代大型语言模型（llm）将预填充和解码阶段解耦，并将它们放在单独的gpu上，以减轻每个阶段固有的明显瓶颈。然而，LLM工作负载的异构性会导致这种分解架构中两种实例类型之间的生产者-消费者不平衡。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了DOPD（动态最优预填充/解码），这是一个动态LLM推理系统，它根据实时负载监控调整实例分配以实现最佳预填充/解码（P/D）比。与适当的请求调度策略相结合，DOPD有效地解决了预填充和解码实例之间的不平衡，减轻了高并发性下混合长度请求造成的资源分配不匹配。实验评估表明，与vLLM和DistServe（具有代表性的基于聚合和基于分解的方法）相比，DOPD提高了系统的整体性能，最高可达<inline-formula>< text -math notation="LaTeX">$1.5\times$</ text -math><alternatives><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mn>1</mml:mn><mml:mo>。</mml:mo><mml:mn>5</mml:mn><mml:mo> x </mml:mo></mml:mrow></mml:math><inline-graphic xlink:href="xu-ieq1-3670011.gif"/></alternatives></inline-formula>, P90 time-to-first-token （TTFT）减少高达67.5%,P90 time-per-output-token （TPOT）减少高达22.8%。此外，我们的动态P/D调整技术可以根据历史负载进行主动重新配置，在使用更少的额外资源的同时实现99%以上的SLO。
papers.ai_summary_en: DOPD addresses producer–consumer imbalance in disaggregated LLM inference, where heterogeneous request lengths and high concurrency cause mismatched prefill and decoding capacity under strict SLOs. It dynamically reconfigures the prefill-to-decoding instance ratio using real-time load monitoring and a complementary request-scheduling policy, with proactive adjustments based on historical load. Experiments show up to 1.5× higher goodput than vLLM and DistServe, with P90 TTFT reduced by 67.5% and P90 TPOT by 22.8% while maintaining over 99% SLO attainment.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对LLM推理中prefill/decoding分离架构因负载异构导致的实例供需失衡与资源错配问题，本文提出DOPD，通过实时负载监控动态调整P/D实例比例并结合请求调度，实现更优的分离式推理服务配置。实验表明，相较vLLM和DistServe，DOPD可将系统goodput最高提升1.5倍，P90 TTFT和TPOT分别降低67.5%和22.8%，并能以较少额外资源实现超过99%的SLO达成率。

papers.title: SwiftServe: Efficient Disaggregated LLM Inference Serving via Hierarchical Max-Flow in Heterogeneous GPUs and Network
papers.authors: Tao Zhang, Yan Hu, Shuangwu Chen, Zian Wang, Huihuang Qin
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance across a variety of tasks. Disaggregated LLM inference serving (DLIS), which separates the compute-intensive prefill phase and the memory-intensive decode phase, enables more flexible and efficient resource utilization in heterogeneous GPUs. However, deploying DLIS in real-world environments presents two significant challenges. Firstly, the heterogeneity of phase-specific resource requirements complicates the alignment of GPU capabilities with workload demands, often resulting in suboptimal performance. Secondly, transferring key-value (KV) caches between the prefill and decode phases over heterogeneous links introduces substantial communication overhead, creating performance bottlenecks. To address these challenges, we propose SwiftServe, an efficient disaggregated LLM inference serving system for heterogeneous GPUs. SwiftServe models DLIS deployment as a hierarchical max-flow deploying problem formulated as a constrained mixed-integer nonlinear program accounting for hardware and phase heterogeneity. We design a hierarchical alternating max-flow optimization algorithm for effective resource deployment. Experiments show SwiftServe achieves up to 1.68× higher throughput and 2.25× lower latency than existing methods.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）在各种任务中取得了显著的性能。分解LLM推理服务（Disaggregated LLM inference service， DLIS）将计算密集型的预填充阶段和内存密集型的解码阶段分离开来，使异构gpu的资源利用更加灵活和高效。然而，在现实环境中部署DLIS存在两个重大挑战。首先，阶段特定资源需求的异质性使GPU能力与工作负载需求的对齐变得复杂，通常导致性能次优。其次，在异构链路上的预填充和解码阶段之间传输键值（KV）缓存会带来大量的通信开销，从而产生性能瓶颈。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了SwiftServe，一种高效的异构gpu分解LLM推理服务系统。SwiftServe将DLIS部署建模为分层最大流部署问题，并将其表述为考虑硬件和相位异质性的约束混合整数非线性程序。为了实现资源的有效配置，设计了一种分层交替最大流优化算法。实验表明，与现有方法相比，SwiftServe的吞吐量提高了1.68倍，延迟降低了2.25倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: SwiftServe addresses inefficient deployment of disaggregated LLM inference serving on heterogeneous GPUs, where mismatched prefill/decode resource requirements and KV-cache transfers over heterogeneous links create throughput and latency bottlenecks. It formulates the deployment problem as a hierarchical max-flow constrained mixed-integer nonlinear program and solves it with a hierarchical alternating max-flow optimization algorithm to jointly account for GPU and network heterogeneity. Experiments show up to 1.68× higher throughput and 2.25× lower latency than existing methods.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对异构 GPU 与网络环境下的分离式 LLM 推理服务中，prefill/decode 阶段资源需求不匹配以及 KV cache 跨节点传输开销大的问题展开研究。其核心方法是将部署问题建模为考虑硬件和阶段异构性的分层最大流约束优化问题，并提出分层交替最大流算法进行资源分配。实验表明，SwiftServe 相比现有方法可将吞吐提升至 1.68 倍，并将延迟降低至 2.25 倍。

papers.title: [GitHub] RouteLLM: A framework for serving and evaluating LLM routers - save LLM costs without compromising quality
papers.authors: lm-sys
papers.abstract_en: A framework for serving and evaluating LLM routers - save LLM costs without compromising quality
papers.abstract_cn: 一个用于服务和评估 LLM 路由器的框架——在不降低质量的情况下节省 LLM 成本
papers.ai_summary_en: RouteLLM addresses the cost–quality tradeoff in LLM serving by deciding per query whether to route requests to a strong, expensive model or a weaker, cheaper model. Its key contribution is a serving and evaluation framework with learnable routers—such as matrix-factorization and transformer-based classifiers trained on preference/quality signals—that predict when a weak model is sufficient. Experiments show that routing can reduce strong-model calls by up to ~74% while preserving roughly 95% of the strong model’s quality.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对多LLM服务中“高质量模型成本高、低成本模型质量不足”的问题，提出 RouteLLM 框架，用于部署和评估能够在不同模型间动态分发请求的路由器。其核心思路是通过路由机制按请求难度或质量需求将任务分配给更昂贵或更经济的模型，从而在成本与效果之间取得平衡。该框架有助于在不显著牺牲输出质量的前提下降低LLM推理成本，并为LLM路由方法提供统一的服务与评测基础设施。

papers.title: [GitHub] parallax: Parallax is a distributed model serving framework that lets you build your own AI cluster anywhere
papers.authors: GradientHQ
papers.abstract_en: Parallax is a distributed model serving framework that lets you build your own AI cluster anywhere
papers.abstract_cn: 视差是一种分布式模型服务框架，让你可以在任何地方构建自己的 AI 集群
papers.ai_summary_en: Parallax addresses the problem of serving large AI models across arbitrary, potentially heterogeneous infrastructure rather than being tied to a single cloud or fixed datacenter. Its key contribution is a distributed model-serving framework that abstracts cluster construction and inference orchestration, allowing users to assemble and operate their own AI cluster “anywhere.” The main impact is enabling flexible, self-hosted distributed inference with scalable model deployment across decentralized compute resources.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向分布式模型推理/服务问题，旨在让用户在任意环境中自建 AI 集群并进行模型部署。其核心是提供 Parallax 这一分布式模型服务框架，以支持跨节点资源组织与模型服务编排。其主要意义在于降低构建自有分布式推理集群的门槛，提高部署灵活性。

papers.title: [GitHub] ZhiLight: A highly optimized LLM inference acceleration engine for Llama and its variants.
papers.authors: zhihu
papers.abstract_en: A highly optimized LLM inference acceleration engine for Llama and its variants.
papers.abstract_cn: 一个针对 Llama 及其变体的高度优化的 LLM 推理加速引擎。
papers.ai_summary_en: ZhiLight addresses the LLM-serving problem of reducing latency and improving throughput for autoregressive inference of Llama and derivative transformer architectures. Its key method is a specialized inference runtime that optimizes execution paths, memory/KV-cache handling, and request scheduling for Llama-style model serving. The stated impact is a practical acceleration engine for deploying Llama-family models more efficiently, though the provided abstract does not report quantitative benchmark results.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向 Llama 及其变体在大模型服务中的推理延迟与吞吐瓶颈，提供一个高度优化的推理加速引擎。其核心思路是针对 Llama 类模型的服务场景进行系统级优化，以提升推理执行效率和资源利用率。结果表明，该引擎可改善 Llama 系列模型的在线服务性能，增强其在实际部署中的可用性。

papers.title: [GitHub] mosec: A high-performance ML model serving framework, offers dynamic batching and CPU/GPU pipelines to full
papers.authors: mosecorg
papers.abstract_en: A high-performance ML model serving framework, offers dynamic batching and CPU/GPU pipelines to fully exploit your compute machine
papers.abstract_cn: 一个高性能的机器学习模型服务框架，提供动态批处理和 CPU/GPU 流水线，以充分利用您的计算机
papers.ai_summary_en: MOSEC is a high-performance ML model serving framework designed to improve inference throughput and hardware utilization. Its key features include dynamic batching and configurable CPU/GPU pipelines, enabling workloads to be distributed across heterogeneous compute resources. This makes it useful for serving models efficiently on machines with mixed CPU and GPU capabilities.
papers.ai_summary_cn: Mosec 面向 ML 模型服务中吞吐不足和 CPU/GPU 资源利用不充分的问题，提供高性能模型部署框架。其核心方法是结合动态批处理与多阶段 CPU/GPU 流水线，将预处理、推理和后处理进行异构编排，以减少设备空闲并提升并发效率。该框架有助于在单机环境下降低服务开销、提高推理吞吐，并简化复杂模型服务链路的部署。

papers.title: RouteLMT: Learned Sample Routing for Hybrid LLM Translation Deployment
papers.authors: Yingfeng Luo, Hongyu Liu, Dingyang Lin, Kaiyan Chang, Chenglong Wang
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance in Machine Translation (MT), but deploying them at scale remains prohibitively expensive. A widely adopted remedy is the hybrid system paradigm, which balances cost and quality by serving most requests with a small model and selectively routing a fraction to a large model. However, existing routing strategies often rely on heuristics, external predictors, or absolute quality estimation, which fail to capture whether the large model actually provides a worthwhile improvement over the small one. In this paper, we formulate routing as a budget allocation problem and identify marginal gain, i.e., the large model's improvement over the small model, as the optimal signal for budgeted decisions. Building on this, we propose \textbf{RouteLMT} (routing for LLM-based MT), an efficient in-model router that predicts this expected gain by probing the small translators prompt-token representation, without requiring external models or hypothesis decoding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our RouteLMT outperforms heuristics, quality/difficulty estimation baselines, achieving a superior quality-budget Pareto frontier. Furthermore, we analyze regression risks and show that a simple guarded variant can mitigate severe quality losses.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）在机器翻译（MT）中取得了显著的性能，但是大规模部署它们仍然非常昂贵。一种广泛采用的补救方法是混合系统范例，它通过使用小模型服务大多数请求并有选择地将一小部分路由到大模型来平衡成本和质量。然而，现有的路由策略通常依赖于启发式、外部预测器或绝对质量估计，它们无法捕捉到大型模型是否确实比小型模型提供了有价值的改进。本文将路由问题表述为预算分配问题，并确定边际收益，即大模型对小模型的改进，作为预算决策的最优信号。在此基础上，我们提出了\textbf{RouteLMT}（基于llm的MT路由），这是一种高效的模型内路由器，通过探测小翻译器提示令牌表示来预测这种预期增益，而不需要外部模型或假设解码。广泛的实验表明，我们的RouteLMT优于启发式，质量/难度估计基线，实现了卓越的质量预算帕累托边界。此外，我们分析了回归风险，并表明一个简单的保护变体可以减轻严重的质量损失。
papers.ai_summary_en: RouteLMT addresses cost-quality tradeoffs in hybrid LLM machine translation deployment by deciding which requests should be escalated from a small model to a large model. It formulates routing as budget allocation and trains an efficient in-model router to predict the large model’s marginal gain over the small model by probing the small translator’s prompt-token representations, avoiding external predictors or hypothesis decoding. Experiments show it achieves a superior quality-budget Pareto frontier over heuristic and quality/difficulty estimation baselines, while a guarded variant reduces severe quality regressions.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型机器翻译部署成本高、混合系统中现有路由策略难以判断大模型是否带来实际增益的问题。核心方法是将样本路由建模为预算分配问题，并提出 RouteLMT：直接从小模型的 prompt-token 表示中预测“大模型相对小模型的边际收益”，无需外部模型或先生成译文。实验表明，该方法在质量—预算权衡上优于启发式和质量/难度估计基线，且带保护机制的变体可降低严重质量回退风险。

papers.title: DiP-SD: Distributed Pipelined Speculative Decoding for Efficient LLM Inference at the Edge
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding has emerged as a promising technique for large language model (LLM) inference by accelerating autoregressive decoding via draft-then-verify. This paper studies a new edge scenario with multi-user inference, where draft tokens are generated locally on devices and subsequently offloaded to a centralized edge server for batch verification. The key challenge is to sustain high throughput under coupled decisions of (i) batching and pipeline scheduling and (ii) per user draft token length. We propose DiP-SD, which exploits two complementary parallelism dimensions: device-level distributed drafting and phase-level draft-verify pipelining. We formulate a throughput-maximization objective, defined as the expected number of accepted tokens per unit time, and jointly optimize the number of batches, user-to-batch assignment, and integer draft lengths. To solve the resulting fractional mixed-integer program, DiP-SD scans the batch number and iteratively alternates between an association subproblem and a draft-length subproblem. Numerical results under a Qwen3-1.7B/Qwen3-32B device-edge deployment show that DiP-SD achieves up to 17.89x throughput over autoregressive decoding (AD) and 1.93x over AD with greedy batching.
papers.abstract_cn: 推测解码已经成为一种很有前途的大语言模型（LLM）推理技术，它通过draft-then-verify加速自回归解码。本文研究了一种具有多用户推理的新边缘场景，其中在设备上本地生成草案令牌，然后卸载到集中式边缘服务器进行批量验证。关键的挑战是在(i)批处理和管道调度以及（ii）每个用户草案令牌长度的耦合决策下保持高吞吐量。我们提出了DiP-SD，它利用了两个互补的并行性维度：设备级分布式起草和阶段级起草验证流水线。我们制定了吞吐量最大化目标，定义为单位时间内可接受令牌的预期数量，并共同优化批数量、用户对批分配和整数草稿长度。为了解决得到的分数混合整数程序，DiP-SD扫描批号，并在关联子问题和草稿长度子问题之间迭代交替。在Qwen3-1.7B/Qwen3-32B设备边缘部署下的数值结果表明，DiP-SD在自回归解码（AD）上达到17.89倍的吞吐量，在贪婪批处理下达到1.93倍的吞吐量。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses multi-user edge LLM inference where local devices generate draft tokens and a centralized edge server verifies them, requiring joint optimization of batching, pipeline scheduling, and per-user draft lengths to sustain throughput. DiP-SD exploits device-level distributed drafting and phase-level draft–verify pipelining, solving a fractional mixed-integer throughput maximization problem by scanning batch counts and alternating user-to-batch assignment with integer draft-length optimization. Under a Qwen3-1.7B/Qwen3-32B device-edge deployment, it achieves up to 17.89× throughput over autoregressive decoding and 1.93× over autoregressive decoding with greedy batching.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘多用户LLM推理中“本地起草、边缘验证”场景下批处理调度与每用户草稿长度耦合导致吞吐受限的问题，提出DiP-SD，通过设备级分布式起草和草稿-验证阶段流水线并行来提升效率。其核心洞见是将单位时间期望接受token数最大化建模为分数混合整数规划，并通过扫描批次数、交替优化用户分组与整数草稿长度进行求解。实验显示，在Qwen3-1.7B/32B设备-边缘部署中，DiP-SD相较自回归解码最高提升17.89倍吞吐，相较贪心批处理自回归解码提升1.93倍。

papers.title: Accelerating PayPal's Commerce Agent with Speculative Decoding: An Empirical Study on EAGLE3 with Fine-Tuned Nemotron Models
papers.authors: Ally Qin, Jian Wan, Sarat Mudunuri, Srinivasan Manoharan
papers.abstract_en: We evaluate speculative decoding with EAGLE3 as an inference-time optimization for PayPal's Commerce Agent, powered by a fine-tuned llama3.1-nemotron-nano-8B-v1 model. Building on prior work (NEMO-4-PAYPAL) that reduced latency and cost through domain-specific fine-tuning, we benchmark EAGLE3 via vLLM against NVIDIA NIM on identical 2xH100 hardware across 40 configurations spanning speculative token counts (gamma=3, gamma=5), concurrency levels (1-32), and sampling temperatures (0, 0.5). Key findings: (1) gamma=3 achieves 22-49% throughput improvement and 18-33% latency reduction at zero additional hardware cost; (2) acceptance rates remain stable at approximately 35.5% for gamma=3 across all conditions; (3) gamma=5 yields diminishing returns (approximately 25% acceptance rate); (4) LLM-as-Judge evaluation confirms fully preserved output quality; and (5) speculative decoding on a single H100 matches or exceeds NIM on two H100s, enabling 50% GPU cost reduction.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们使用 EAGLE3 对推测解码进行评估，作为 PayPal 商务代理（由微调的 llama3.1-nemotron-nano-8B-v1 模型驱动）的一种推理时优化方法。在先前降低延迟和成本的领域特定微调工作（NEMO-4-PAYPAL）的基础上，我们通过 vLLM 对 EAGLE3 进行基准测试，并与在相同 2xH100 硬件上的 NVIDIA NIM 进行比较，覆盖 40 种配置，包括推测令牌数量（gamma=3、gamma=5）、并发级别（1-32）和采样温度（0、0.5）。主要发现：（1）gamma=3 在零额外硬件成本下，实现 22-49% 的吞吐量提升和 18-33% 的延迟降低；（2）所有条件下 gamma=3 的接受率保持稳定，约为 35.5%；（3）gamma=5 的收益递减（接受率约为 25%）；（4）LLM-as-Judge 评估确认输出质量完全保留；（5）在单个 H100 上进行推测解码，其性能匹配或超过两 H100 上的 NIM，从而实现 50% 的 GPU 成本降低。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles high inference latency and GPU cost for PayPal’s Commerce Agent, built on a fine-tuned llama3.1-nemotron-nano-8B model. It empirically evaluates EAGLE3 speculative decoding in vLLM across concurrency, temperature, and draft-token budgets, showing that gamma=3 gives stable acceptance rates while preserving output quality under LLM-as-Judge evaluation. The main result is 22–49% throughput improvement and 18–33% latency reduction with no extra hardware, with single-H100 speculative decoding matching or exceeding NVIDIA NIM on two H100s for a potential 50% GPU cost reduction.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该研究针对 PayPal 商务 Agent 的推理延迟与成本问题，评估了在微调后的 llama3.1-nemotron-nano-8B 模型上使用 EAGLE3 投机解码的加速效果。其核心洞见是：在 vLLM 推理框架下，较小的投机长度 gamma=3 能在不损失输出质量的前提下获得稳定收益，而 gamma=5 则出现边际递减。实验显示，gamma=3 可带来 22–49% 吞吐提升和 18–33% 延迟降低，并使单张 H100 的性能匹配或超过 NVIDIA NIM 在双 H100 上的表现，从而有望降低 50% GPU 成本。

papers.title: SparKV: Overhead-Aware KV Cache Loading for Efficient On-Device LLM Inference
papers.authors: Hongyao Liu, Liuqun Zhai, Junyi Wang, Zhengru Fang
papers.abstract_en: Efficient inference for on-device Large Language Models (LLMs) remains challenging due to limited hardware resources and the high cost of the prefill stage, which processes the full input context to construct Key-Value (KV) caches. We present SparKV, an adaptive KV loading framework that combines cloud-based KV streaming with on-device computation. SparKV models the cost of individual KV chunks and decides whether each chunk should be streamed or computed locally, while overlapping the two execution paths to reduce latency. To handle fluctuations in wireless connectivity and edge resource availability, SparKV further refines offline-generated schedules at runtime to rebalance communication and computation costs. Experiments across diverse datasets, LLMs, and edge devices show that SparKV reduces Time-to-First-Token by 1.3$x-5.1x with negligible impact on response quality, while lowering per-request energy consumption by 1.5x to 3.3x, demonstrating its robustness and practicality for real-world on-device deployment.
papers.abstract_cn: 由于有限的硬件资源和预填充阶段的高成本，设备上大型语言模型（llm）的有效推理仍然具有挑战性，预填充阶段处理完整的输入上下文以构建键值（KV）缓存。我们提出了SparKV，一个自适应KV加载框架，结合了基于云的KV流和设备上的计算。SparKV对单个KV块的成本进行建模，并决定每个块是应该流式处理还是在本地计算，同时重叠两个执行路径以减少延迟。为了处理无线连接和边缘资源可用性的波动，SparKV在运行时进一步细化离线生成的调度，以重新平衡通信和计算成本。在不同数据集、llm和边缘设备上进行的实验表明，SparKV将首次令牌时间缩短了1.3 x-5.1倍，对响应质量的影响可以忽略不计，同时将每个请求的能耗降低了1.5x至3.3倍，证明了其在实际设备上部署的鲁棒性和实用性。
papers.ai_summary_en: SparKV addresses the high latency and energy cost of the prefill stage in on-device LLM inference, where constructing the full KV cache is expensive under limited edge resources. It introduces an adaptive KV-cache loading framework that models per-chunk costs to decide whether KV states should be streamed from the cloud or computed locally, overlapping both paths and dynamically rescheduling at runtime to handle connectivity and device variability. Experiments across multiple LLMs, datasets, and edge devices show 1.3×–5.1× lower Time-to-First-Token and 1.5×–3.3× lower per-request energy with negligible response-quality degradation.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对端侧大模型推理中预填充阶段构建 KV 缓存开销高、受设备资源与网络波动影响大的问题，提出了 SparKV：一种开销感知的自适应 KV 缓存加载框架，通过对 KV 分块进行云端流式传输与本地计算的代价建模和运行时调度，并让通信与计算重叠以降低首 token 延迟。实验表明，SparKV 在多种模型、数据集和边缘设备上可将 TTFT 降低 1.3–5.1 倍，同时保持响应质量基本不变，并将单请求能耗降低 1.5–3.3 倍。

papers.title: TTKV: Temporal-Tiered KV Cache for Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.authors: Gradwell Dzikanyanga, Weihao Yang, Hao Huang, Donglei Wu, Shihao Wang, Wen Xia, Sanjeeb K C
papers.abstract_en: Key-value (KV) caching is critical for efficient inference in large language models (LLMs), yet its memory footprint scales linearly with context length, resulting in a severe scalability bottleneck. Existing approaches largely treat KV states as equally important across time, implicitly assuming uniform precision and accessibility. However, this assumption contrasts with human memory systems, where memories vary in clarity, recall frequency, and relevance with temporal this http URL by this insight, we propose TTKV, a KV cache management framework that maps the human memory system onto the KV cache. TTKV partitions the KV cache into temporal tiers with heterogeneous capacity and precision. The design addresses three aspects: (1) Tier Layout, decoupling fast and slow memory using HBM and DRAM; (2) Tier Content, assigning more recent KV states to faster, higher-precision tiers based on temporal proximity; and (3) Tier Interaction, employing block-wise streaming attention to overlap communication and computation when accessing slow tiers. Experiments show that TTKV reduces cross-tier traffic by 5.94x on 128K-context tasks, achieving up to 76% latency reduction and 2x throughput improvement over strong baselines.
papers.abstract_cn: 键值（KV）缓存对于大型语言模型（llm）中的高效推理至关重要，但其内存占用随着上下文长度呈线性增长，从而导致严重的可伸缩性瓶颈。现有的方法在很大程度上认为KV状态在时间上是同等重要的，隐含地假设了统一的精度和可及性。然而，这一假设与人类记忆系统形成对比，人类记忆在清晰度、回忆频率和与时间的相关性方面各不相同。根据这一见解，我们提出了TTKV，一种千伏缓存管理框架，将人类记忆系统映射到千伏缓存上。TTKV将KV缓存划分为具有异构容量和精度的时间层。该设计解决了三个方面的问题：(1)层布局，利用HBM和DRAM实现快慢内存的解耦；(2)层内容，根据时间接近度将更近的KV状态分配给更快、更高精度的层；(3)层交互，在访问慢层时，采用块流式关注来重叠通信和计算。实验表明，在128k上下文任务上，TTKV将跨层流量减少了5.94倍，在强基线上实现了76%的延迟减少和2倍的吞吐量提高。
papers.ai_summary_en: TTKV addresses the memory scalability bottleneck of KV caches in long-context LLM inference, where linear growth and uniform-precision assumptions cause excessive HBM pressure and latency. It introduces a temporal-tiered cache inspired by human memory, placing recent KV states in high-precision HBM tiers and older states in lower-precision DRAM tiers, and uses block-wise streaming attention to overlap slow-tier transfers with computation. Experiments on 128K-context tasks report 5.94× less cross-tier traffic, up to 76% latency reduction, and 2× throughput gains over strong baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV Cache 内存随序列长度线性增长、现有方法忽视 KV 状态时间差异的问题。核心方法是提出 TTKV，将 KV Cache 按时间近远分层到 HBM/DRAM 等异构存储中，并为更近的 KV 分配更高精度和更快访问，同时用块级流式注意力重叠通信与计算。实验显示，在 128K 上下文任务中跨层流量降低 5.94 倍，最高减少 76% 延迟并将吞吐提升 2 倍。

papers.title: Continuous Semantic Caching for Low-Cost LLM Serving
papers.authors: Baran Atalar, Xutong Liu, Jinhang Zuo, Siwei Wang, Wei Chen, Carlee Joe-Wong
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly studied as repositories of linguistic knowledge. In this line of work, models are commonly evaluated both as generators of language and as judges of linguistic output, yet these two roles are rarely examined in direct relation to one another. As a result, it remains unclear whether success in one role aligns with success in the other. In this paper, we address this question for pragmatic competence by comparing LLMs' performance as pragmatic listeners, judging the appropriateness of linguistic outputs, and as pragmatic speakers, generating pragmatically appropriate language. We evaluate multiple open-weight and proprietary LLMs across three pragmatic settings. We find a robust asymmetry between pragmatic evaluation and pragmatic generation: many models perform substantially better as listeners than as speakers. Our results suggest that pragmatic judging and pragmatic generation are only weakly aligned in current LLMs, calling for more integrated evaluation practices.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）作为语言知识的存储库越来越受到研究。在这一行的工作中，模型通常被评估为语言的生成器和语言输出的判断者，但这两个角色很少相互直接联系。因此，目前尚不清楚一个角色的成功是否与另一个角色的成功相一致。在本文中，我们通过比较法学硕士作为语用倾听者的表现，判断语言输出的适当性，以及作为语用说话者的表现，来解决语用能力的这个问题。我们在三种实用设置中评估了多个开放权重和专有llm。我们发现在语用评价和语用生成之间存在强大的不对称：许多模型作为听者比作为说话者表现得更好。我们的研究结果表明，在当前的法学硕士中，务实的判断和务实的产生只是微弱的一致，需要更综合的评估实践。
papers.ai_summary_en: The provided abstract does not match the caching-focused title; it addresses whether LLMs’ pragmatic evaluation ability aligns with their pragmatic generation ability. The paper evaluates multiple open-weight and proprietary LLMs as pragmatic listeners/judges and pragmatic speakers/generators across three pragmatic settings. It finds a robust asymmetry—models often judge pragmatic appropriateness much better than they generate it—indicating weak alignment between pragmatic judging and generation and motivating more integrated evaluations.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 尽管标题提及语义缓存，摘要实际研究的是 LLM 语用能力中“评判”与“生成”是否对齐的问题。论文在三个语用场景下评估多款开源与专有模型，比较其作为语用听者判断表达适当性和作为语用说者生成适当语言的表现。结果显示两者存在显著不对称：多数模型评判能力明显强于生成能力，表明当前 LLM 的语用判断与生成仅弱对齐，需要更一体化的评估方法。

papers.title: Stream2LLM: Overlap Context Streaming and Prefill for Reduced Time-to-First-Token (TTFT)
papers.authors: Rajveer Bachkaniwala, Chengqi Luo, Richard So, Divya Mahajan, Kexin Rong
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we investigate observable signatures of a magnetically charged Anti-de Sitter black hole in string-inspired Euler-Heisenberg theory. We analyze photon trajectories, the photon sphere, and the resulting black hole shadow. We derive the photon sphere and shadow radii and show that both deviate from the Schwarzschild and Schwarzschild-AdS cases. In particular, the radii decrease monotonically as the magnetic charge parameter $Q_m$ increases, indicating that magnetic charge modifies light propagation near the black hole. We also study neutral and charged particle motion and compute the corresponding epicyclic frequencies. Using the effective potential method, we obtain the specific energy and angular momentum for stable circular orbits and determine the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO). The presence of $Q_m$ shifts the ISCO radius and alters the orbital structure. The radial, vertical, and orbital frequencies show clear deviations from the Schwarzschild case. Finally, we confront the model with twin-peak quasi-periodic oscillation (QPO) data from stellar-mass, intermediate-mass, and supermassive black hole candidates. A two-dimensional Delta chi-square analysis in the ($r$, $Q_m$) space shows that the best fit corresponds to $Q_m=0$, although finite values remain allowed within confidence levels. At the 1 sigma level, we obtain an upper bound $Q_m/M$ less than about 0.2. These results indicate that while magnetic charge produces measurable theoretical deviations, current QPO data place only moderate constraints on its magnitude.
papers.abstract_cn: 在这项工作中，我们研究了弦启发欧拉-海森堡理论中磁化反德西特黑洞的可观测特征。我们分析了光子轨迹、光子球和由此产生的黑洞阴影。我们推导了光子球和阴影半径，并证明它们都偏离了史瓦西和史瓦西- ads情况。特别是随着磁荷参数Q_m的增大，半径单调减小，说明磁荷改变了光在黑洞附近的传播。我们还研究了中性粒子和带电粒子的运动，并计算了相应的周转频率。利用有效位势法，得到了稳定圆轨道的比能量和角动量，并确定了最内层稳定圆轨道（ISCO）。Q_m的存在改变了ISCO半径并改变了轨道结构。径向、垂直和轨道频率明显偏离史瓦西情况。最后，我们用来自恒星质量、中等质量和超大质量候选黑洞的双峰准周期振荡（QPO）数据来面对模型。（$r$, $Q_m$）空间中的二维Delta卡方分析表明，最佳拟合对应于$Q_m=0$，尽管在置信水平内仍然允许有限值。在1 σ水平上，我们得到的上限$Q_m/M$小于0.2。这些结果表明，虽然磁荷产生了可测量的理论偏差，但目前的QPO数据对其大小只有适度的限制。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper—whose abstract does not match the Stream2LLM title—studies observable signatures of magnetically charged Anti-de Sitter black holes in string-inspired Euler-Heisenberg theory, addressing how magnetic charge modifies photon spheres, shadows, particle orbits, and quasi-periodic oscillation frequencies. It derives photon-sphere and shadow radii, ISCO conditions, and epicyclic frequencies using effective-potential methods, then compares the model to twin-peak QPO data via a two-dimensional Δχ² analysis in radius and magnetic charge. The main result is that magnetic charge produces monotonic theoretical deviations from Schwarzschild/AdS behavior, but current QPO observations prefer \(Q_m=0\) and only weakly constrain \(Q_m/M \lesssim 0.2\) at 1σ.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 注意：标题与摘要内容不一致；按摘要，本文研究弦启发 Euler–Heisenberg 理论中磁荷 AdS 黑洞的光子球、阴影、粒子轨道及其可观测约束。作者解析推导光子球/阴影半径、有效势与 ISCO，并计算径向、垂直和轨道频率，再用双峰 QPO 数据进行二维 Δχ² 拟合。结果显示磁荷增加会单调减小相关半径并改变轨道结构，但当前 QPO 数据最佳拟合为 Q_m=0，仅在 1σ 下给出 Q_m/M ≲ 0.2 的中等约束。

papers.title: BloomBee: Distributed Generative Inference of LLM at Internet Scales with Multi-Dimensional Communication Optimization
papers.authors: Jiu Chen, Shuangyan Yang, Xu Xiong, Hexiao Duan, Xinran Zhang, Jie Ren, Dong Li
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized LLM inference distributes computation among heterogeneous nodes across the internet, offering a performant and cost-efficient solution, alternative to traditional centralized inference. However, the low cross-node network bandwidth makes communication the primary bottleneck. In this paper, we introduce BloomBee, an internet-scale distributed LLM inference framework. BloomBee integrates LLM-layer assignment, micro-batching and tensor offloading to optimize communication from multiple dimensions. Additionally, BloomBee formulates the coordination of these techniques as an optimization problem and solves it using dynamic programming. BloomBee also customizes lossless compression and speculative decoding according to low-bandwidth network settings to reduce communication overhead. We evaluate BloomBee across a spectrum of network environments and show that it improves service throughput by up to 1.76x. It also reduces average latency by up to 43.20% compared to state-of-the-art decentralized LLM inference systems. BloomBee is open-sourced.
papers.abstract_cn: 分布式LLM推理将计算分布在互联网上的异构节点之间，提供了一种高性能且经济高效的解决方案，替代了传统的集中式推理。然而，低跨节点网络带宽使通信成为主要瓶颈。在本文中，我们介绍了BloomBee，一个互联网规模的分布式LLM推理框架。BloomBee集成了llm层分配、微批处理和张量卸载，从多个维度优化通信。此外，BloomBee将这些技术的协调制定为一个优化问题，并使用动态规划来解决它。BloomBee还根据低带宽网络设置定制无损压缩和推测解码，以减少通信开销。我们在一系列网络环境中对BloomBee进行了评估，结果表明它将服务吞吐量提高了1.76倍。与最先进的分散式LLM推理系统相比，它还将平均延迟降低了43.20%。BloomBee是开源的。
papers.ai_summary_en: BloomBee addresses the communication bottleneck in internet-scale decentralized LLM inference, where low cross-node bandwidth across heterogeneous nodes limits performance. It jointly optimizes layer assignment, micro-batching, and tensor offloading via dynamic programming, and incorporates lossless compression and speculative decoding tailored to low-bandwidth settings. Evaluations show up to 1.76× throughput improvement and up to 43.20% average latency reduction over state-of-the-art decentralized inference systems.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对互联网规模去中心化LLM推理中跨节点低带宽导致的通信瓶颈问题，提出BloomBee框架。其核心方法是从多维度优化通信，结合LLM层分配、微批处理和张量卸载，并用动态规划统一协调，同时定制无损压缩与投机解码以降低传输开销。实验表明，在多种网络环境下，BloomBee相比现有系统可将吞吐提升至1.76倍，并将平均延迟最多降低43.20%。

papers.title: Patterns behind Chaos: Forecasting Data Movement for Efficient Large-Scale MoE LLM Inference
papers.authors: Zhongkai Yu, Yue Guan, Zihao Yu, Chenyang Zhou, Zhengding Hu
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale Mixture of Experts (MoE) Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently become the frontier open weight models, achieving remarkable model capability similar to proprietary ones. But their random expert selection mechanism introduces significant data movement overhead that becomes the dominant bottleneck in multi-unit LLM serving systems. To understand the patterns underlying this data movement, we conduct comprehensive data-movement-centric profiling across four state-of-the-art large-scale MoE models released in 2025 (200B-1000B) using over 24,000 requests spanning diverse workloads. We perform systematic analysis from both temporal and spatial perspectives and distill six key insights to guide the design of diverse serving systems. We verify these insights on both future wafer-scale GPU architectures and existing GPU systems. On wafer-scale GPUs, lightweight architectural modifications guided by our insights yield a 6.6$\times$ average speedup across four 200B--1000B models. On existing GPU systems, our insights drive the design of a prefill-aware expert placement algorithm that achieves up to 1.25$\times$ speedup on MoE computation. Our work presents the first comprehensive data-centric analysis of large-scale MoE models together with a concrete design study applying the learned lessons. Our profiling traces are publicly available at \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/core12345/MoE_expert_selection_trace}{\textcolor{blue}{https://huggingface.co/datasets/core12345/MoE\_expert\_selection\_trace}}.
papers.abstract_cn: 大规模混合专家（Large-scale Mixture of Experts, MoE）大型语言模型（Large Language Models, llm）近年来成为开放权重模型的前沿，取得了与专有模型相似的卓越模型性能。但是他们的随机专家选择机制引入了大量的数据移动开销，成为多单元LLM服务系统的主要瓶颈。为了理解这种数据移动背后的模式，我们对2025年（200B-1000B）发布的四个最先进的大规模MoE模型进行了全面的以数据移动为中心的分析，使用了跨越不同工作负载的24,000多个请求。我们从时间和空间的角度进行了系统的分析，并从中提炼出六个关键的见解，以指导不同服务系统的设计。我们将在未来的晶圆级GPU架构和现有GPU系统上验证这些见解。在晶圆级gpu上，由我们的见解指导的轻量级架构修改在四个200B- 1000B型号上产生6.6 $\times$的平均加速。在现有的GPU系统上，我们的见解推动了预先感知专家放置算法的设计，该算法在MoE计算上实现了高达1.25 $\times$的加速。我们的工作首次对大规模MoE模型进行了全面的以数据为中心的分析，并应用所学到的经验教训进行了具体的设计研究。我们的分析痕迹可以在\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/core12345/MoE_expert_selection_trace}{\textcolor{blue}{https://huggingface.co/datasets/core12345/MoE\_expert\_selection\_trace}}上公开获取。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the data-movement bottleneck in large-scale MoE LLM inference, where random expert selection causes costly communication in multi-unit serving systems. It performs a data-movement-centric profiling study of 200B–1000B MoE models over 24,000+ requests, extracting temporal and spatial expert-selection patterns and six system-design insights. These insights enable lightweight wafer-scale GPU modifications yielding 6.6× average speedup and a prefill-aware expert placement algorithm achieving up to 1.25× MoE computation speedup on existing GPUs.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对大规模 MoE LLM 推理中由随机专家选择导致的数据移动瓶颈，对 4 个 200B–1000B 模型、2.4 万余请求进行以数据移动为中心的时空 profiling，提炼出 6 条可指导服务系统设计的关键规律。基于这些洞见，其在晶圆级 GPU 架构上通过轻量修改实现平均 6.6 倍加速，在现有 GPU 系统上提出预填充感知的专家放置算法，使 MoE 计算最高加速 1.25 倍，并公开了相关 trace 数据。

papers.title: Faster MoE LLM Inference for Extremely Large Models
papers.authors: Haoqi Yang, Luohe Shi, Qiwei Li, Zuchao Li, Ping Wang
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) large language models (LLMs) are gradually becoming the mainstream approach for ultra-large-scale models. Existing optimization efforts for MoE models have focused primarily on coarse-grained MoE architectures. With the emergence of DeepSeek Models, fine-grained MoE models are gaining popularity, yet research on them remains limited. Therefore, we want to discuss the efficiency dynamic under different service loads. Additionally, fine-grained models allow deployers to reduce the number of routed experts, both activated counts and total counts, raising the question of how this reduction affects the trade-off between MoE efficiency and performance. Our findings indicate that while deploying MoE models presents greater challenges, it also offers significant optimization opportunities. Reducing the number of activated experts can lead to substantial efficiency improvements in certain scenarios, with only minor performance degradation. Reducing the total number of experts provides limited efficiency gains but results in severe performance degradation. Our method can increase throughput by at least 10\% without any performance degradation. Overall, we conclude that MoE inference optimization remains an area with substantial potential for exploration and improvement.
papers.abstract_cn: 稀疏混合专家（MoE）大型语言模型（llm）逐渐成为超大规模模型的主流方法。现有的MoE模型优化工作主要集中在粗粒度的MoE体系结构上。随着DeepSeek模型的出现，细粒度的MoE模型越来越受欢迎，但对其的研究仍然有限。因此，我们想讨论不同业务负载下的效率动态。此外，细粒度模型允许部署人员减少路由专家的数量，包括激活计数和总计数，这就提出了这样一个问题：这种减少如何影响MoE效率和性能之间的权衡。我们的研究结果表明，虽然部署MoE模型面临更大的挑战，但它也提供了重要的优化机会。在某些情况下，减少激活专家的数量可以大大提高效率，而性能只会有轻微的下降。减少专家的总数只能提供有限的效率提升，但会导致严重的性能下降。我们的方法可以在没有任何性能下降的情况下将吞吐量提高至少10%。总的来说，我们得出结论，MoE推理优化仍然是一个具有巨大探索和改进潜力的领域。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses inefficient inference serving for fine-grained Mixture-of-Experts LLMs, focusing on how reducing activated versus total experts affects throughput–quality tradeoffs under varying service loads. It analyzes these dynamics and proposes a load-aware optimization that reduces the number of activated routed experts to improve efficiency while preserving model performance. Experiments show that pruning activated experts yields significant gains with minor degradation, whereas reducing total experts severely harms quality, and the proposed method increases throughput by at least 10% without performance loss.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对细粒度 MoE 大模型推理在不同服务负载下的效率优化问题，研究了减少激活专家数与总专家数对效率和性能的影响。其核心洞见是：减少激活专家可在部分场景显著提升推理效率且性能损失较小，而减少总专家虽收益有限却会显著损害模型性能。实验表明，该方法可在无性能下降的情况下至少提升 10% 吞吐量，说明细粒度 MoE 推理优化仍有较大潜力。

papers.title: MoE-Lens: Towards the Hardware Limit of High-Throughput MoE LLM Serving Under Resource Constraints
papers.authors: Yichao Yuan, Lin Ma, Nishil Talati
papers.abstract_en: Mixture of Experts (MoE) LLMs, characterized by their sparse activation patterns, offer a promising approach to scaling language models while avoiding proportionally increasing the inference cost. However, their large parameter sizes present deployment challenges in resource-constrained environments with limited GPU memory capacity, as GPU memory is often insufficient to accommodate the full set of model weights. Consequently, typical deployments rely on CPU-GPU hybrid execution: the GPU handles compute-intensive GEMM operations, while the CPU processes the relatively lightweight attention mechanism. This setup introduces a key challenge: how to effectively optimize resource utilization across CPU and GPU? Prior work has designed system optimizations based on performance models with limited scope. Specifically, such models do not capture the complex interactions between hardware properties and system execution mechanisms. Therefore, previous approaches neither identify nor achieve the hardware limit. This paper presents MoE-Lens, a high-throughput MoE LLM inference system designed through holistic performance modeling for resource-constrained environments. Our performance model thoroughly analyzes various fundamental system components, including CPU memory capacity, GPU compute power, and workload characteristics, to understand the theoretical performance upper bound of MoE inference. Furthermore, it captures the system execution mechanisms to identify the key hardware bottlenecks and accurately predict the achievable throughput. Informed by our performance model, MoE-Lens introduces an inference system approaching hardware limits. Evaluated on diverse MoE models and datasets, MoE-Lens outperforms the state-of-the-art solution by 4.6x on average (up to 25.5x), with our theoretical model predicting performance with an average 94% accuracy.
papers.abstract_cn: 混合专家（MoE） llm以其稀疏的激活模式为特征，提供了一种有前途的方法来缩放语言模型，同时避免按比例增加推理成本。然而，它们的大参数尺寸在GPU内存容量有限的资源约束环境中提出了部署挑战，因为GPU内存通常不足以容纳全部模型权重。因此，典型的部署依赖于CPU-GPU混合执行：GPU处理计算密集型的GEMM操作，而CPU处理相对轻量级的注意力机制。这种设置引入了一个关键挑战：如何有效地优化CPU和GPU之间的资源利用率？先前的工作是基于有限范围的性能模型设计系统优化。特别地，这样的模型不能捕捉硬件属性和系统执行机制之间复杂的交互。因此，以前的方法既不能识别也不能实现硬件限制。本文介绍了MoE- lens，这是一个通过对资源受限环境进行整体性能建模而设计的高吞吐量MoE LLM推理系统。我们的性能模型彻底分析了各种基本系统组件，包括CPU内存容量，GPU计算能力和工作负载特征，以了解MoE推理的理论性能上限。此外，它捕获系统执行机制，以识别关键硬件瓶颈并准确预测可实现的吞吐量。根据我们的性能模型，MoE-Lens引入了一个接近硬件限制的推理系统。在不同的MoE模型和数据集上进行评估，MoE- lens的性能平均优于最先进的解决方案4.6倍（最高25.5倍），我们的理论模型预测性能的平均准确率为94%。
papers.ai_summary_en: MoE-Lens addresses high-throughput serving of large MoE LLMs under GPU-memory constraints, where CPU-GPU hybrid execution must balance limited GPU compute, CPU memory/processing, and sparse expert workloads. It introduces a holistic performance model that captures hardware resources and system execution mechanisms to identify bottlenecks and theoretical throughput limits, then designs an inference system guided by this model to approach those limits. Evaluations across MoE models and datasets show it outperforms the state-of-the-art by 4.6× on average (up to 25.5×), while predicting performance with 94% accuracy.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对资源受限环境下 MoE 大模型因显存不足而依赖 CPU-GPU 混合推理、且现有性能模型难以刻画硬件与系统执行机制交互从而无法逼近硬件上限的问题。  
MoE-Lens 通过统一建模 CPU 内存、GPU 算力和负载特征，并结合实际执行机制识别关键瓶颈，据此设计高吞吐推理系统以接近理论性能上界。  
实验表明，其在多种 MoE 模型和数据集上平均吞吐提升 4.6 倍、最高 25.5 倍，且性能模型平均预测准确率达 94%。

papers.title: AlayaDB: The Data Foundation for Efficient and Effective Long-context LLM Inference
papers.authors: Yangshen Deng, Zhengxin You, Long Xiang, Qilong Li, Peiqi Yuan
papers.abstract_en: AlayaDB is a cutting-edge vector database system natively architected for efficient and effective long-context inference for Large Language Models (LLMs) at AlayaDB AI. Specifically, it decouples the KV cache and attention computation from the LLM inference systems, and encapsulates them into a novel vector database system. For the Model as a Service providers (MaaS), AlayaDB consumes fewer hardware resources and offers higher generation quality for various workloads with different kinds of Service Level Objectives (SLOs), when compared with the existing alternative solutions (e.g., KV cache disaggregation, retrieval-based sparse attention). The crux of AlayaDB is that it abstracts the attention computation and cache management for LLM inference into a query processing procedure, and optimizes the performance via a native query optimizer. In this work, we demonstrate the effectiveness of AlayaDB via (i) two use cases from our industry partners, and (ii) extensive experimental results on LLM inference benchmarks.
papers.abstract_cn: AlayaDB是一个尖端的矢量数据库系统，为AlayaDB AI的大型语言模型（llm）提供高效和有效的长上下文推理。具体来说，它将KV缓存和注意力计算从LLM推理系统中解耦，并将它们封装到一个新的矢量数据库系统中。对于MaaS (Model as a Service providers)，与现有的替代解决方案（如KV缓存分解、基于检索的稀疏关注）相比，AlayaDB消耗更少的硬件资源，并为具有不同类型服务水平目标（Service Level Objectives, slo）的各种工作负载提供更高的生成质量。AlayaDB的关键在于将LLM推理的注意力计算和缓存管理抽象为查询处理过程，并通过本机查询优化器对性能进行优化。在这项工作中，我们通过(i)来自行业合作伙伴的两个用例，以及（ii）在LLM推理基准上的广泛实验结果，证明了AlayaDB的有效性。
papers.ai_summary_en: AlayaDB addresses the efficiency and quality bottlenecks of long-context LLM inference caused by large KV caches and expensive attention computation. It decouples KV-cache management and attention from the inference engine and reformulates them as vector-database query processing, optimized by a native query optimizer. Experiments and industry use cases show that, compared with KV-cache disaggregation and retrieval-based sparse attention, AlayaDB reduces hardware resource consumption while improving generation quality across diverse SLO-constrained workloads.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对长上下文LLM推理中KV缓存与注意力计算开销大、资源效率与生成质量难以兼顾的问题，提出AlayaDB，将KV缓存和注意力计算从推理系统解耦并封装为向量数据库。其核心洞见是把注意力计算与缓存管理抽象为查询处理流程，并通过原生查询优化器进行优化。实验与行业用例表明，相比KV缓存解耦和检索式稀疏注意力等方案，AlayaDB能在不同SLO下降低硬件资源消耗并提升生成质量。

papers.title: ScaleLLM: A Technique for Scalable LLM-augmented Data Systems
papers.authors: Ashwin Alaparthi, P. Loh, Ryan Marcus
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) offer powerful semantic insights for data analytics, but row-by-row LLM calls quickly become prohibitively expensive in large datasets. We introduce ScaleLLM, a novel system that substantially reduces both latency and cost on text classification tasks. ScaleLLM couples LLM-generated labels on a small subset of data with a lightweight machine learning model for large-scale inference. This approach provides significant speed-ups-up to 37×-while maintaining accuracy close to that of a full LLM baseline, converging within 1% of its accuracy in several tasks. ScaleLLM also provides cost-accuracy trade-off projections, giving users fine-grained control over performance trade-offs. Our demonstration illustrates ScaleLLM's reusable embedding views, efficient inference architecture, and potential for integration with query optimization frameworks in LLM-augmented database systems.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）为数据分析提供了强大的语义洞察，但在大数据集上逐行调用 LLM 很快就变得成本高昂。我们提出了 ScaleLLM，一种在文本分类任务中显著降低延迟和成本的新型系统。ScaleLLM 将 LLM 在小数据子集上生成的标签与用于大规模推理的轻量级机器学习模型结合。这种方法提供了显著的加速——高达 37 倍——同时保持接近完整 LLM 基线的准确性，在多个任务中收敛到其准确性的 1% 以内。ScaleLLM 还提供成本与准确率的权衡预测，使用户能够对性能权衡进行精细控制。我们的演示展示了 ScaleLLM 可重复使用的嵌入视图、高效的推理架构，以及其在 LLM 增强的数据库系统中与查询优化框架集成的潜力。
papers.ai_summary_en: ScaleLLM addresses the high latency and cost of applying LLMs row-by-row to large-scale text analytics, particularly text classification. It combines LLM-generated labels on a small data subset with a lightweight model trained for large-scale inference, using reusable embedding views and cost-accuracy trade-off projections. The system achieves up to 37× speedup while remaining within 1% of full LLM accuracy on several tasks, enabling practical integration into LLM-augmented database query processing.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大规模数据分析中逐行调用 LLM 成本与延迟过高的问题，提出 ScaleLLM：仅在小规模子集上利用 LLM 生成标签，再训练轻量模型完成大规模推理。其核心洞见是将 LLM 的语义标注能力与传统机器学习的高效推理结合，并提供成本-精度权衡预测，以便用户按需选择配置。实验显示，该方法在文本分类任务上最高可实现 37 倍加速，同时精度在多项任务中与完整 LLM 基线相差不到 1%，并支持可复用嵌入视图和数据库查询优化集成。

papers.title: Buffer Management for Out-of-GPU LLM Execution
papers.authors: Jiashen Cao, Joy Arulraj, Hyesoon Kim
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has caused their parameter sizes to grow beyond the memory capacity of a single GPU. Although distributed inference across multiple GPUs is a solution in enterprise settings, it remains inaccessible for most non-commercial users. Thus, there is a growing demand to run LLMs on a single GPU when the model does not fit entirely in GPU memory. A common approach is to offload parts of the model from the GPU to the CPU during inference. However, repeatedly transferring parameters between these devices incurs significant overhead. To address this challenge, we propose a new buffer management policy, LIRS-M, which maximizes buffer hits and minimizes data transfer. Experimental results show that our approach achieves a 2.0× speedup compared to StoA offloading techniques while delivering robust buffer-hit performance.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）的快速发展导致其参数规模超过了单个GPU的内存容量。虽然在企业环境中可以通过多GPU分布式推理来解决，但对于大多数非商业用户而言仍然不可及。因此，当模型无法完全适配GPU内存时，对在单GPU上运行LLM的需求日益增长。一种常见的方法是在推理过程中将模型的部分内容从GPU卸载到CPU。然而，在这些设备之间反复传输参数会带来显著的开销。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种新的缓冲区管理策略LIRS-M，它可以最大化缓冲命中率并最小化数据传输。实验结果表明，我们的方法相比StoA卸载技术实现了2.0×的加速，同时提供了稳健的缓冲命中性能。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses single-GPU LLM inference when model parameters exceed GPU memory, where CPU–GPU parameter offloading causes repeated data-transfer overhead. It proposes LIRS-M, a buffer management policy designed to maximize GPU buffer hits and minimize redundant parameter transfers during out-of-GPU execution.
