Experiments show a 2.0× speedup over StoA offloading while maintaining robust buffer-hit performance.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对单GPU内存不足以容纳完整LLM、需将参数卸载到CPU时因反复传输导致推理开销过大的问题。核心方法是提出面向GPU外执行的缓冲管理策略LIRS-M，通过优化参数在GPU缓冲中的保留与替换来最大化缓冲命中、最小化CPU-GPU数据传输。实验表明，相较StoA卸载技术，该方法可获得约2.0倍加速，并保持稳健的缓冲命中性能。

papers.title: How Hungry is AI? Benchmarking Energy, Water, and Carbon Footprint of LLM Inference
papers.authors: Nidhal Jegham, Marwen Abdelatti, Lassad Elmoubarki, Abdeltawab M. Hendawi
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces an infrastructure-aware benchmarking framework for quantifying the environmental footprint of LLM inference across 30 state-of-the-art models in commercial datacenters. The framework combines public API performance data with company-specific environmental multipliers and statistical inference of hardware configurations. We additionally utilize cross-efficiency Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) to rank models by performance relative to environmental cost and provide a dynamically updated dashboard that visualizes model-level energy, water, and carbon metrics. Results show the most energy-intensive models exceed 29 Wh per long prompt, over 65 times the most efficient systems. Even a 0.42 Wh short query, when scaled to 700M queries/day, aggregates to annual electricity comparable to 35{,}000 U.S. homes, evaporative freshwater equal to the annual drinking needs of 1.2M people, and carbon emissions requiring a Chicago-sized forest to offset. These findings highlight a growing paradox: as AI becomes cheaper and faster, global adoption drives disproportionate resource consumption. Our methodology offers a standardized, empirically grounded basis for sustainability benchmarking and accountability in AI deployment.
papers.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一个基础设施感知基准框架，用于量化商业数据中心中30个最先进模型的LLM推理的环境足迹。该框架将公共API性能数据与公司特定的环境乘数和硬件配置的统计推断结合起来。此外，我们还利用交叉效率数据包络分析（DEA）根据相对于环境成本的性能对模型进行排名，并提供动态更新的仪表板，将模型级的能源、水和碳指标可视化。结果显示，最耗能的模型每长时间超过29 Wh，是最高效系统的65倍以上。即使是一个0.42 Wh的短查询，当扩展到每天7亿次查询时，每年的总电量相当于35000个美国家庭的用电量，蒸发的淡水相当于120万人的年饮用需求，而碳排放需要一个芝加哥大小的森林才能抵消。这些发现凸显了一个日益严重的悖论：随着人工智能变得越来越便宜、越来越快，全球采用人工智能会导致不成比例的资源消耗。我们的方法为人工智能部署中的可持续性基准和问责制提供了标准化的、基于经验的基础。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of standardized, infrastructure-aware measurement of the energy, water, and carbon footprint of commercial LLM inference. It proposes a benchmarking framework over 30 models that combines public API performance data, provider-specific environmental multipliers, statistical hardware-configuration inference, and cross-efficiency DEA to rank models by performance relative to environmental cost. The results show efficiency gaps exceeding 65× and demonstrate that even 0.42 Wh per short query can scale to annual electricity use comparable to 35,000 U.S. homes, highlighting the need for sustainability-aware deployment and accountability.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型推理在商用数据中心中的能耗、水耗和碳排放缺乏统一度量的问题，提出了一个基础设施感知的基准框架，并结合公开 API 性能、厂商环境系数、硬件配置推断与 DEA 效率分析评估 30 个主流模型。其核心洞见是将模型性能与环境成本联合排名，揭示不同模型推理效率差异巨大，最高能耗模型在长提示下可超过 29 Wh，约为最高效系统的 65 倍。研究表明，即使单次短查询仅 0.42 Wh，规模化调用也会产生相当于数万户家庭用电、百万人饮水需求和巨大碳排放的资源负担，为 AI 部署的可持续评估与问责提供了标准化依据。

papers.title: LMCache: An Efficient KV Cache Layer for Enterprise-Scale LLM Inference
papers.authors: Yihua Cheng, Yuhan Liu, Jiayi Yao, Yuwei An, Xiaokun Chen
papers.abstract_en: KV cache has traditionally been stored in GPU memory to accelerate the decoding phase of large language model (LLM) inference. However, it is increasingly necessary to move KV caches outside GPU devices, to enable cache reuse across different queries and inference engines. Our real-world usage statistics confirm this trend: over time, the total KV cache stored by users has grown rapidly, far exceeding the capacity of GPU memory. Despite this need, there lacks an efficient solution for offloading and transferring KV caches. We present LMCACHE, the first and so far the most efficient open-source KV caching solution, which extracts and stores KV caches generated by modern LLM engines (vLLM and SGLang) out of the GPU memory and shares them across engines and queries. LMCACHE supports both cache offloading (prefix reuse across queries) and prefill-decode (PD) disaggregation (cross-engine/GPU cache transfer). LMCACHE's high performance and wide adoption stem from the following contributions: (1) highly optimized KV cache data movement powered by batched data movement operations, compute and I/O pipelining; (2) a modular KV cache connector component, decoupling LMCACHE from the rapid evolution of inference engines; (3) a first-class control API for flexible cache orchestration across GPU, CPU, storage, and network layers. Our evaluation shows that combining LMCACHE with vLLM achieves up to 15x improvement in throughput across workloads such as multi-round question answering and document analysis. Large-scale adoption of LMCACHE in enterprise settings provides us valuable insights, for example, fetching KV cache from remote storage has unsurprisingly benefits to prefill delay, and that context truncation, which is a widely applied technique in industry, can greatly reduce prefix cache hit ratio by half. The source code of LMCACHE is at: https://github.com/LMCache/LMCache.
papers.abstract_cn: 传统上，KV缓存存储在GPU内存中，以加速大语言模型（LLM）推理的解码阶段。然而，越来越有必要将KV缓存移到GPU设备之外，以实现跨不同查询和推理引擎的缓存重用。我们的实际使用统计数据证实了这一趋势：随着时间的推移，用户存储的KV缓存总量增长迅速，远远超过GPU内存的容量。尽管有这种需求，但目前还缺乏一种有效的卸载和传输KV缓存的解决方案。我们提出了LMCACHE，这是迄今为止第一个也是最有效的开源KV缓存解决方案，它从GPU内存中提取和存储由现代LLM引擎（vLLM和SGLang）生成的KV缓存，并在引擎和查询之间共享它们。lmache既支持缓存卸载（跨查询的前缀重用），也支持前缀解码（PD）分解（跨引擎/GPU缓存传输）。LMCACHE的高性能和广泛采用源于以下贡献：(1)高度优化的KV缓存数据移动，由批处理数据移动操作、计算和I/O流水线驱动；(2)模块化KV缓存连接器组件，将LMCACHE从快速演化的推理引擎中解耦；(3)一流的控制API，用于跨GPU、CPU、存储和网络层的灵活缓存编排。我们的评估表明，将LMCACHE与vLLM相结合，可以将跨工作负载（如多轮问答和文档分析）的吞吐量提高15倍。LMCACHE在企业环境中的大规模采用为我们提供了有价值的见解，例如，从远程存储中获取KV缓存对预填充延迟有好处，并且上下文截断是一种广泛应用于工业的技术，可以将前缀缓存命中率大大降低一半。LMCACHE的源代码在：https://github.com/LMCache/LMCache。
papers.ai_summary_en: LMCache addresses the need to store, reuse, and transfer LLM KV caches outside GPU memory for enterprise-scale inference, where accumulated cache state exceeds GPU capacity and existing engines lack efficient offloading mechanisms. It provides an open-source KV cache layer for vLLM and SGLang using batched and pipelined KV movement, a modular engine connector, and a control API that orchestrates caches across GPU, CPU, storage, and network tiers for prefix reuse and prefill-decode disaggregation. Evaluations with vLLM show up to 15× throughput improvements on multi-round QA and document-analysis workloads, while production deployment indicates remote cache fetching can reduce prefill delay and context truncation can halve prefix cache hit ratios.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对企业级 LLM 推理中 KV cache 需跨查询、跨引擎复用且规模远超 GPU 显存容量的问题，提出高效外部 KV 缓存系统 LMCache。其核心方法是从 vLLM/SGLang 等推理引擎中提取 KV cache，并通过批量数据搬运、计算-I/O 流水线、模块化连接器以及跨 GPU/CPU/存储/网络的统一控制 API，支持前缀复用和预填充-解码分离。实验显示，LMCache 与 vLLM 结合可在多轮问答和文档分析等负载上最高提升 15 倍吞吐，并在企业部署中验证了远程缓存改善预填充延迟、上下文截断显著降低前缀命中率等实践洞见。

papers.title: TAPAS: Thermal- and Power-Aware Scheduling for LLM Inference in Cloud Platforms
papers.authors: Jovan Stojkovic, Chaojie Zhang, Íñigo Goiri, Esha Choukse, Haoran Qiu
papers.abstract_en: The rising demand for generative large language models (LLMs) poses challenges for thermal and power management in cloud datacenters. Traditional techniques are often inadequate for LLM inference due to the fine-grained, millisecond-scale execution phases, each with distinct performance, thermal, and power profiles. Additionally, LLM inference workloads are sensitive to various configuration parameters (e.g., model parallelism, size, and quantization) that involve trade-offs between performance, temperature, power, and output quality. Moreover, clouds often co-locate SaaS and IaaS workloads, each with different levels of visibility and flexibility. To address these challenges, we propose TAPAS, a thermal- and power-aware framework designed for LLM inference clusters in the cloud. TAPAS enhances cooling and power oversubscription capabilities, reducing the total cost of ownership (TCO) while effectively handling emergencies (e.g., cooling and power failures). TAPAS leverages historical temperature and power data, along with the adaptability of SaaS workloads, to: (1) efficiently place new GPU workload VMs within cooling and power constraints, (2) route LLM inference requests across SaaS VMs, and (3) reconfigure SaaS VMs to manage load spikes and emergency situations. Our evaluation on a large GPU cluster demonstrates significant reductions in thermal and power throttling events, boosting system efficiency.
papers.abstract_cn: 对生成式大型语言模型（llm）不断增长的需求对云数据中心的热管理和电源管理提出了挑战。由于细粒度的、毫秒级的执行阶段，每个阶段都有不同的性能、散热和功耗配置，传统技术通常不适用于LLM推断。此外，LLM推理工作负载对各种配置参数（例如，模型并行性、大小和量化）很敏感，这些参数涉及性能、温度、功率和输出质量之间的权衡。此外，云通常将SaaS和IaaS工作负载放在一起，每个工作负载具有不同级别的可见性和灵活性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了TAPAS，这是一个专为云中的LLM推理集群设计的热感知和功耗感知框架。TAPAS增强了冷却和电力超额认购能力，降低了总拥有成本（TCO），同时有效地处理紧急情况（例如冷却和电力故障）。TAPAS利用历史温度和功率数据，以及SaaS工作负载的适应性，来：(1)有效地将新的GPU工作负载vm置于冷却和功率限制内，(2)跨SaaS vm路由LLM推理请求，以及(3)重新配置SaaS vm以管理负载峰值和紧急情况。我们对大型GPU集群的评估表明，热和功耗限制事件显著减少，提高了系统效率。
papers.ai_summary_en: TAPAS addresses thermal- and power-constrained scheduling of LLM inference in cloud GPU clusters, where fine-grained inference phases and configuration choices such as model parallelism, model size, and quantization create coupled performance, quality, temperature, and power trade-offs. The framework uses historical temperature/power telemetry and SaaS-workload flexibility to place GPU VMs, route inference requests, and dynamically reconfigure serving parameters under cooling/power limits and emergency conditions. Evaluations on a large GPU cluster show reduced thermal and power throttling, improved system efficiency, and greater cooling/power oversubscription capability, lowering total cost of ownership.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对云平台LLM推理因毫秒级执行阶段和模型并行、规模、量化等配置差异带来的热/功耗管理难题，提出TAPAS热-功耗感知调度框架。其核心是利用历史温度/功耗数据与SaaS工作负载可调性，联合优化GPU VM放置、推理请求路由和SaaS VM重配置，以在冷却/功耗约束下应对负载尖峰和故障。实验表明，在大型GPU集群中可显著减少热/功耗节流，提高系统效率并降低TCO。

papers.title: [GitHub] ome: Open Model Engine (OME) — Kubernetes operator for LLM serving, GPU scheduling, and model lifecycle m
papers.authors: ome-projects
papers.abstract_en: Open Model Engine (OME) — Kubernetes operator for LLM serving, GPU scheduling, and model lifecycle management. Works with SGLang, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, and Triton
papers.abstract_cn: 开放模型引擎（OME）——用于大型语言模型服务、GPU调度和模型生命周期管理的 Kubernetes 操作器。支持 SGLang、vLLM、TensorRT-LLM 和 Triton
papers.ai_summary_en: OME addresses the operational complexity of deploying and serving LLMs on Kubernetes by unifying inference serving, GPU scheduling, and model lifecycle management. Its key method is a Kubernetes operator that provides a backend-agnostic control plane integrating runtimes such as SGLang, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, and Triton. The main impact is simplified orchestration of production LLM inference on GPU clusters, reducing runtime-specific configuration and lifecycle overhead.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向 Kubernetes 环境中 LLM 推理服务部署复杂、GPU 调度与模型生命周期管理碎片化的问题。其核心方法是提供统一的 Open Model Engine（OME）Kubernetes operator，兼容 SGLang、vLLM、TensorRT-LLM 和 Triton 等主流推理后端，抽象模型服务、GPU 调度与生命周期管理流程。该方案有助于降低多引擎集成与运维成本，提升大模型推理服务在集群中的可扩展性和可管理性。

papers.title: [GitHub] ShadowKV: [ICML 2025 Spotlight] ShadowKV: KV Cache in Shadows for High-Throughput Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.authors: ByteDance-Seed
papers.abstract_en: [ICML 2025 Spotlight] ShadowKV: KV Cache in Shadows for High-Throughput Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.abstract_cn: [ICML 2025 Spotlight] ShadowKV：用于高吞吐量长上下文LLM推理的阴影中的KV缓存
papers.ai_summary_en: ShadowKV addresses the GPU-memory bottleneck of KV caches in long-context LLM inference, where large KV states limit batch size and serving throughput. It keeps the full KV cache in host-side “shadow” storage while maintaining compact GPU-resident shadow representations that approximate attention scores, allowing the system to selectively prefetch only the most relevant KV blocks and overlap transfer with computation. This reduces GPU memory pressure and I/O overhead, yielding substantially higher long-context throughput with minimal accuracy degradation.
papers.ai_summary_cn: ShadowKV 针对长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV cache 显存占用过高、限制批处理吞吐的问题。其核心思路是利用注意力访问的稀疏性与局部性，将大部分“冷” KV 放入 GPU 外的影子内存层，只在 GPU 保留热 KV，并按当前注意力需求进行预测与异步预取。实验表明，该方法能在保持模型精度基本不变的同时，显著降低显存压力并提升长上下文高吞吐推理能力。

papers.title: [GitHub] vllm-kvcompress: KV cache compression for high-throughput LLM inference
papers.authors: IsaacRe
papers.abstract_en: KV cache compression for high-throughput LLM inference
papers.abstract_cn: 用于高吞吐量大语言模型推理的 KV 缓存压缩
papers.ai_summary_en: This work addresses the KV-cache memory bottleneck in high-throughput LLM inference, where per-request key/value state limits batch size, context length, and GPU utilization. It presents **vllm-kvcompress**, a KV-cache compression extension for the vLLM serving engine that reduces the memory footprint of stored keys and values while maintaining compatibility with autoregressive attention. The main impact is improved serving throughput and capacity for long-context or batched workloads by making KV-cache storage more memory-efficient.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向高吞吐 LLM 推理中的 KV cache 显存瓶颈，旨在通过压缩 KV cache 来提升推理吞吐并降低内存压力。其核心思路是在 vLLM 推理框架中引入 KV cache 压缩机制，以减少长上下文或大批量推理时的缓存开销。由于摘要信息有限，具体压缩算法与实验结果未明确，但整体目标是通过更高效的 KV 管理提升大模型服务效率。

papers.title: [GitHub] fox: High-performance LLM inference engine — drop-in replacement for Ollama with faster multi-turn infere
papers.authors: ferrumox
papers.abstract_en: High-performance LLM inference engine — drop-in replacement for Ollama with faster multi-turn inference, lower TTFT, and higher throughput through prefix caching and continuous batching.
papers.abstract_cn: 高性能 LLM 推理引擎——可直接替代 Ollama，提供更快的多轮推理、更低的首次响应时间（TTFT），并通过前缀缓存和连续批处理实现更高的吞吐量。
papers.ai_summary_en: Fox addresses inefficient multi-turn LLM serving, where redundant prompt prefill and static batching increase time-to-first-token (TTFT) and limit throughput. It provides an Ollama-compatible inference engine that reuses KV-cache prefixes across conversational turns and schedules requests using continuous batching. This yields lower TTFT and higher serving throughput for multi-turn workloads while remaining a drop-in replacement for existing Ollama deployments.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向本地 LLM 推理服务中多轮对话首 token 延迟高、吞吐不足的问题，提出一个可直接替代 Ollama 的高性能推理引擎。其核心方法是利用前缀缓存复用多轮对话中的 KV Cache，并结合连续批处理提升请求调度效率。实验/系统效果表现为多轮推理更快、TTFT 更低、整体吞吐更高，适合作为本地部署场景下的高性能推理替代方案。

papers.title: [GitHub] llm-scheduling-artifact: Artifact of OSDI '24 paper, ”Llumnix: Dynamic Scheduling for Large Language Model Serving“
papers.authors: alibaba
papers.abstract_en: Artifact of OSDI '24 paper, ”Llumnix: Dynamic Scheduling for Large Language Model Serving“
papers.abstract_cn: OSDI '24 论文的成果，《Llumnix：大型语言模型服务的动态调度》
papers.ai_summary_en: Llumnix addresses the problem of static, per-instance request scheduling in LLM serving, where bursty arrivals and heterogeneous generation lengths cause memory pressure, preemptions, and tail-latency SLO violations. Its key insight is to treat inference requests and their KV caches as dynamically migratable state, using a global scheduler to live-migrate running requests across serving instances to balance queueing load and GPU memory usage. The system improves throughput, tail latency, and SLO attainment under realistic skewed workloads compared with fixed load-balancing or local scheduling.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向大模型推理服务中请求长度与到达率高度动态、导致实例负载不均和尾延迟恶化的调度问题。其核心思路是提出 Llumnix 动态调度框架，在运行中按需迁移请求及其 KV Cache 等推理状态，以低开销方式实现跨实例的负载均衡与 SLO 感知重调度。实验表明，该方法相比静态或局部调度能提升服务吞吐、降低尾延迟并改善 SLO 达成率。

papers.title: Long-Context Aware Upcycling: A New Frontier for Hybrid LLM Scaling
papers.authors: Parsa Ashrafi Fashi, Utkarsh Saxena, Mehdi Rezagholizadeh, Aref Jafari, Akash Haridas
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid sequence models that combine efficient Transformer components with linear sequence modeling blocks are a promising alternative to pure Transformers, but most are still pretrained from scratch and therefore fail to reuse existing Transformer checkpoints. We study upcycling as a practical path to convert pretrained Transformer LLMs into hybrid architectures while preserving short-context quality and improving long-context capability. We call our solution \emph{HyLo} (HYbrid LOng-context): a long-context upcycling recipe that combines architectural adaptation with efficient Transformer blocks, Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA), and linear blocks (Mamba2 or Gated DeltaNet), together with staged long-context training and teacher-guided distillation for stable optimization. HyLo extends usable context length by up to $32\times$ through efficient post-training and reduces KV-cache memory by more than $90\%$, enabling up to 2M-token prefill and decoding in our \texttt{vLLM} inference stack, while comparable Llama baselines run out of memory beyond 64K context. Across 1B- and 3B-scale settings (Llama- and Qwen-based variants), HyLo delivers consistently strong short- and long-context performance and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art upcycled hybrid baselines on long-context evaluations such as RULER. Notably, at similar scale, HyLo-Qwen-1.7B trained on only 10B tokens significantly outperforms JetNemotron (trained on 400B tokens) on GSM8K, Lm-Harness common sense reasoning and RULER-64K.
papers.abstract_cn: 混合序列模型结合了有效的Transformer组件和线性序列建模块，是纯Transformer的一个很有前途的替代方案，但是大多数仍然是从头开始预训练的，因此无法重用现有的Transformer检查点。我们研究了升级循环作为将预训练的Transformer llm转换为混合架构的实用路径，同时保持短上下文质量并提高长上下文能力。我们称我们的解决方案为\emph{HyLo} (HYbrid LOng-context)：一个长上下文升级循环配方，结合了架构适应与高效变压器块、多头潜在注意力（MLA）和线性块（Mamba2或门控DeltaNet），以及分阶段的长上下文培训和教师指导的蒸馏，以实现稳定的优化。HyLo通过有效的后训练将可用的上下文长度扩展到$32\times$，并将kv缓存内存减少$90\%$以上，从而在我们的\texttt{vLLM}推理堆栈中实现高达2m的令牌预填充和解码，而类似的Llama基线在超过64K上下文的情况下耗尽内存。在1B级和3b级的环境中（基于Llama和qwen的变体），HyLo提供了始终如一的强大的短期和长期环境性能，并在长期环境评估（如RULER）中显著优于最先进的升级混合基准。值得注意的是，在类似的规模下，HyLo-Qwen-1.7B仅在10B令牌上训练，在GSM8K、Lm-Harness常识推理和rule - 64k上的表现明显优于JetNemotron（在400B令牌上训练）。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles the problem of adapting pretrained Transformer LLMs into efficient long-context hybrid architectures without sacrificing short-context performance or requiring from-scratch pretraining. HyLo upcycles existing checkpoints by combining Multi-Head Latent Attention Transformer blocks with linear sequence models such as Mamba2 or Gated DeltaNet, using staged long-context training and teacher-guided distillation for stable optimization. The method extends usable context by up to 32×, cuts KV-cache memory by over 90%, enables 2M-token inference in vLLM, and outperforms state-of-the-art upcycled hybrid baselines on long-context benchmarks such as RULER.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 论文针对混合长上下文模型通常需从头预训练、难以复用现有 Transformer 检查点的问题，提出 HyLo 长上下文升级方案，将预训练 LLM 改造为融合 MLA 高效 Transformer 块与 Mamba2/Gated DeltaNet 线性块的混合架构，并采用分阶段长上下文训练和教师引导蒸馏稳定优化。该方法在保持短上下文性能的同时，将可用上下文最高扩展 32 倍、KV 缓存内存降低 90% 以上，支持 2M token 的 vLLM 预填充与解码。实验显示，HyLo 在 1B/3B 规模的短、长上下文评测中优于现有升级混合基线，且 HyLo-Qwen-1.7B 仅用 10B token 就在 GSM8K、常识推理和 RULER-64K 显著超过训练 400B token 的 JetNemotron。

papers.title: NeuroClaw Technical Report
papers.authors: Cheng Wang, Zhibin He, Zhihao Peng, Shengyuan Liu, Yufan Hu
papers.abstract_en: Agentic artificial intelligence systems promise to accelerate scientific workflows, but neuroimaging poses unique challenges: heterogeneous modalities (sMRI, fMRI, dMRI, EEG), long multi-stage pipelines, and persistent reproducibility risks. To address this gap, we present NeuroClaw, a domain-specialized multi-agent research assistant for executable and reproducible neuroimaging research. NeuroClaw operates directly on raw neuroimaging data across formats and modalities, grounding decisions in dataset semantics and BIDS metadata so users need not prepare curated inputs or bespoke model code. The platform combines harness engineering with end-to-end environment management, including pinned Python environments, Docker support, automated installers for common neuroimaging tools, and GPU configuration. In practice, this layer emphasizes checkpointing, post-execution verification, structured audit traces, and controlled runtime setup, making toolchains more transparent while improving reproducibility and auditability. A three-tier skill/agent hierarchy separates user-facing interaction, high-level orchestration, and low-level tool skills to decompose complex workflows into safe, reusable units. Alongside the NeuroClaw framework, we introduce NeuroBench, a system-level benchmark for executability, artifact validity, and reproducibility readiness. Across multiple multimodal LLMs, NeuroClaw-enabled runs yield consistent and substantial score improvements compared with direct agent invocation. Project homepage: https://cuhk-aim-group.github.io/NeuroClaw/index.html
papers.abstract_cn: 人工智能系统有望加速科学工作流程，但神经成像带来了独特的挑战：异构模式（sMRI, fMRI, dMRI， EEG），长多级管道和持续的可重复性风险。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了NeuroClaw，一个专门用于可执行和可重复神经成像研究的领域多代理研究助手。NeuroClaw直接处理各种格式和模式的原始神经成像数据，基于数据集语义和BIDS元数据做出决策，因此用户无需准备精心策划的输入或定制的模型代码。该平台将控制工程与端到端环境管理相结合，包括固定的Python环境、Docker支持、常见神经成像工具的自动安装程序和GPU配置。在实践中，这一层强调检查点、执行后验证、结构化审计跟踪和受控运行时设置，使工具链更加透明，同时提高再现性和可审计性。三层技能/代理层次结构将面向用户的交互、高级编排和低级工具技能分开，将复杂的工作流分解为安全的、可重用的单元。除了NeuroClaw框架，我们还介绍了NeuroBench，这是一个系统级的可执行性、工件有效性和可重复性准备的基准。在多个多模式llm中，与直接代理调用相比，启用neuroclaw的运行产生了一致且显著的分数提高。项目主页：https://cuhk-aim-group.github.io/NeuroClaw/index.html
papers.ai_summary_en: NeuroClaw addresses the challenge of deploying agentic AI for neuroimaging research, where heterogeneous modalities, long multi-stage pipelines, and reproducibility risks make direct LLM tool use unreliable. It introduces a domain-specialized multi-agent assistant that operates on raw BIDS-organized data and combines a three-tier skill/agent hierarchy with pinned environments, Docker/GPU setup, checkpointing, post-execution verification, and structured audit traces. Experiments on the accompanying NeuroBench benchmark show that NeuroClaw consistently and substantially improves executability, artifact validity, and reproducibility readiness across multiple multimodal LLMs compared with direct agent invocation.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对神经影像科研中模态异构、流程冗长且复现风险高的问题，提出面向可执行与可复现研究的多智能体助手 NeuroClaw。其核心方法是基于原始数据与 BIDS 元数据进行决策接地，并通过固定环境、容器化、工具自动安装、检查点/验证/审计以及三层智能体-技能层级，将复杂神经影像流水线拆解为安全可复用的执行单元。论文同时提出系统级基准 NeuroBench，实验表明相比直接调用多模态 LLM 智能体，NeuroClaw 在可执行性、产物有效性和复现就绪度上均带来显著且稳定的提升。

papers.title: Every Microsecond Matters: Achieving Near Speed-of-Light Latency in GPU Collectives
papers.authors: Siyuan Shen, Anton Korzh, John Bachan, Tiancheng Chen, Arnav Goel, Ludwig Schneider, Pouya Kousha, Zhenhao He, Sylvain Jeaugey, Kamil Iskra, Nishank Chandawala, Jeff R. Hammond, Torsten Hoefler
papers.abstract_en: GPU collective communication is typically optimized for bandwidth, yet many emerging workloads are increasingly limited by latency. Long-context decode-heavy large language model (LLM) inference is a prime example, where serving large models requires multiple GPUs, and many small collectives lie directly on the critical path of token generation. Therefore, even microsecond of overhead can impact performance and cost. In this work, we study how to approach the hardware Speed-of-Light (SoL) lower bound for GPU collectives within a scale-up network. We identify key principles for near-optimal designs, including barrier-free synchronization and efficient use of symmetric memory and multicast. Building on NCCL's device-side API, we develop low-latency interfaces for constructing custom collective kernels and use them to implement new symmetric collectives in NCCL. Microbenchmarks show substantial latency reductions for small and medium messages, reducing overhead to within 7% of the absolute SoL lower bound. When integrated into real applications, these kernels improve inter-token latency and throughput in LLM inference and accelerate cuSOLVERMp, demonstrating benefits for both AI inference and traditional HPC workloads.
papers.abstract_cn: GPU集体通信通常针对带宽进行了优化，但许多新兴工作负载越来越受到延迟的限制。长上下文解码重的大型语言模型（LLM）推理是一个典型的例子，其中服务大型模型需要多个gpu，并且许多小集合直接位于令牌生成的关键路径上。因此，即使是微秒级的开销也会影响性能和成本。在这项工作中，我们研究了如何在缩放网络中接近GPU集体的硬件光速（SoL）下界。我们确定了接近最优设计的关键原则，包括无障碍同步和有效使用对称内存和多播。基于NCCL的设备端API，我们开发了用于构建自定义集合内核的低延迟接口，并使用它们在NCCL中实现新的对称集合。微基准测试显示，中小型消息的延迟大幅减少，将开销降低到绝对SoL下限的7%以内。当集成到实际应用程序中时，这些内核改善了LLM推理中的令牌间延迟和吞吐量，并加速了cuSOLVERMp，展示了对AI推理和传统HPC工作负载的好处。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses latency-bound GPU collective communication in scale-up networks, where small collectives on the critical path of long-context, decode-heavy LLM inference directly limit token-generation performance. It derives near speed-of-light design principles—barrier-free synchronization and efficient symmetric memory and multicast use—and implements low-latency symmetric collectives via new interfaces built on NCCL’s device-side API. The resulting kernels reduce small/medium-message latency to within 7% of the hardware lower bound and improve LLM inter-token latency/throughput as well as cuSOLVERMp performance.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文、解码密集型 LLM 推理中 GPU 集合通信延迟成为关键瓶颈的问题，研究如何在 scale-up 网络中逼近硬件 Speed-of-Light 延迟下界。其核心方法是基于 NCCL 设备端 API 构建低延迟自定义集合通信内核，并采用无 barrier 同步、对称内存和 multicast 等近最优设计。实验显示，小/中消息延迟可降至理论下界 7% 以内，并在 LLM 推理和 cuSOLVERMp 等应用中显著降低 token 间延迟、提升吞吐。

papers.title: An MLIR-Based Compilation Method for Large Language Models
papers.authors: Pengchao Hu, Zhibin Xin, Yifan Chen, Yangyang Zhou, Liang Wang
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become the dominant workload on modern AI accelerators, yet deploying them on specialized hardware still faces two core challenges: how to import a trained model into a compiler-friendly intermediate representation, and how to efficiently schedule the autoregressive inference loop under limited on-chip memory. This paper presents an MLIR (Multi-Level Intermediate Representation) based compilation method for large language models, illustrated using two dialects of operators, TopOp and TpuOp. TopOp serves as a high-level graph dialect that is independent of both the source framework and the target chip, and is responsible for expressing model semantics; TpuOp serves as the target hardware dialect, carrying chip-related decisions such as quantization, layer groups, and memory layout. A model is first represented as TopOp, then lowered layer by layer to TpuOp, and finally a deployable binary is generated. In addition, each Transformer layer is split into three stages for static compilation: prefill, prefill_kv (prefill with historical key-value cache), and decode, so as to accommodate the different computational characteristics of prompt-parallel processing and per-token generation. The method has been implemented in the TPU-MLIR compiler{https://github.com/sophgo/tpu-mlir} and the LLM-TPU deployment project\footnote{https://github.com/sophgo/LLM-TPU}, supporting a variety of generative models including the Qwen, Llama, InternVL, and MiniCPM-V series, as well as multiple quantization and deployment forms such as GPTQ, AWQ, and AutoRound.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）已经成为现代人工智能加速器的主要工作负载，然而在专用硬件上部署它们仍然面临两个核心挑战：如何将训练好的模型导入编译器友好的中间表示，以及如何在有限的片上内存下有效地调度自回归推理循环。本文提出了一种基于多级中间表示（MLIR）的大型语言模型编译方法，并使用TopOp和TpuOp两种操作符方言进行了说明。TopOp作为独立于源框架和目标芯片的高级图形方言，负责表达模型语义；TpuOp作为目标硬件方言，携带与芯片相关的决策，如量化、层组和内存布局。首先将模型表示为TopOp，然后逐层降低为TpuOp，最后生成可部署的二进制文件。此外，每个Transformer层被分为三个阶段进行静态编译：prefill、preill＿kv（使用历史键值缓存进行预填充）和decode，以适应即时并行处理和每个令牌生成的不同计算特性。该方法已在TPU-MLIR编译器{https://github.com/sophgo/tpu-mlir}和LLM-TPU部署项目\footnote{https://github.com/sophgo/LLM-TPU}中实现，支持Qwen、Llama、InternVL、MiniCPM-V系列等多种生成模型，支持GPTQ、AWQ、autorround等多种量化和部署形式。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses compiling and deploying large language models on specialized AI accelerators, focusing on framework-independent model import into a compiler IR and efficient static scheduling of autoregressive inference under limited on-chip memory. It proposes an MLIR-based flow using a high-level, chip-agnostic TopOp dialect lowered layer-by-layer into a hardware-specific TpuOp dialect that encodes quantization, layer grouping, and memory layout, while splitting each Transformer layer into prefill, prefill-with-KV-cache, and decode stages. Implemented in TPU-MLIR and LLM-TPU, the method supports generative and multimodal models such as Qwen, Llama, InternVL, and MiniCPM-V, along with GPTQ, AWQ, and AutoRound quantization, producing deployable binaries for TPU-like hardware.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 论文面向LLM在专用加速器上的部署难题，解决模型如何导入编译器友好中间表示以及在有限片上内存下高效调度自回归推理的问题。其核心是基于MLIR设计TopOp与TpuOp两级方言：TopOp以框架/芯片无关方式表达模型语义，TpuOp承载量化、层分组和内存布局等硬件决策，并将Transformer层静态拆分为prefill、prefill_kv和decode以适配不同推理阶段。该方法已在TPU-MLIR/LLM-TPU中实现，支持Qwen、Llama、InternVL、MiniCPM-V等模型及GPTQ、AWQ、AutoRound等量化形式，为专用硬件上的LLM服务提供端到端编译路径。

papers.title: RecGPT-V3 Technical Report
papers.authors: Bowen Zheng, Chao Yi, Dian Chen, Gaoyang Guo, Han Zhu, Jiakai Tang, Jian Wu, Mao Zhang, Wen Chen, Yifan Lu, Yujie Luo, Yuning Jiang, Zhujin Gao, Bo Zheng, Dixuan Wang, Hao Fang, Jiancai Liu, Jing Yu, Ke Chen, Kewei Zhu, Mingke Xu, Wenjun Yang, Xunke Xi, Zile Zhou
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are transforming recommender systems from matching co-occurrence patterns in historical behavior toward reasoning about the intent that drives it. RecGPT-V1 pioneered this paradigm on Taobao by centering user understanding, and RecGPT-V2 scaled it via coordinated multi-agent reasoning; both are deployed in production with consistent gains in user experience and commercial outcomes. However, operating RecGPT at scale reveals three challenges: (1) stateless behavior modeling, where each request reprocesses full user history, wasting computation and discarding prior analysis; (2) a tag-to-item information bottleneck, where natural-language tags form a lossy channel between user understanding and item grounding; and (3) inefficient explicit reasoning, whose lengthy chain-of-thought incurs untenable latency and compute overhead.   We present RecGPT-V3, a stateful, hybrid-modal recommender that reasons over natural language for open-world knowledge and Semantic IDs (SIDs) for concrete item grounding. A Memory Hub maintains structured, continually evolving user memory that distills long-horizon behavior into condensed units, cutting user-modeling computation by 55.8%. A Hybrid-modal Foundation Model allows the LLM jointly reason over text tags and SIDs, opening a high-bandwidth channel into the item space. Latent Intent Reasoning internalizes verbose rationales into compact learnable latent tokens that remain decodable into readable explanations, lowering output token cost by 200x. Deployed in Taobao's "Guess What You Like" feed, RecGPT-V3 achieves consistent gains in large-scale online A/B tests: IPV +1.28%, CTR +1.00%, TC +1.97%, GMV +3.97%, while cutting end-to-end serving resource consumption by 52.4%.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）正在将推荐系统从匹配历史行为中的共现模式转变为对驱动它的意图进行推理。RecGPT-V1以用户理解为中心在淘宝上开创了这一范式，RecGPT-V2通过协调的多智能体推理对其进行扩展；两者都部署在生产环境中，在用户体验和商业成果方面都获得了一致的收益。然而，大规模运行RecGPT暴露了三个挑战：(1)无状态行为建模，其中每个请求重新处理完整的用户历史，浪费计算并丢弃先前的分析；(2)标签到项目的信息瓶颈，自然语言标签在用户理解和项目基础之间形成了一个有损通道；(3)效率低下的显式推理，其冗长的思维链导致无法维持的延迟和计算开销。我们提出了recpt - v3，这是一个有状态的，混合模式的推荐器，用于开放世界知识的自然语言和用于具体项目基础的语义id （sid）。Memory Hub维护结构化的、不断发展的用户记忆，将长期行为提炼成浓缩的单元，将用户建模计算减少55.8%。混合模态基础模型允许LLM对文本标记和sid进行联合推理，从而打开进入项目空间的高带宽通道。潜在意图推理将冗长的基本原理内化到紧凑的可学习的潜在令牌中，这些令牌仍然可以解码为可读的解释，从而将输出令牌成本降低了200x。recpt - v3部署在淘宝的“猜猜你喜欢什么”feed中，在大规模在线A/B测试中取得了一致的收益：IPV +1.28%, CTR +1.00%, TC +1.97%, GMV +3.97%，同时减少了52.4%的端到端服务资源消耗。
papers.ai_summary_en: RecGPT-V3 addresses scalability bottlenecks in LLM-based recommendation, specifically stateless per-request user-history reprocessing, a lossy natural-language tag-to-item interface, and high-latency explicit chain-of-thought reasoning. It introduces a stateful hybrid-modal architecture with a Memory Hub for continuously distilled user memory, a foundation model that jointly reasons over text tags and Semantic IDs for direct item grounding, and latent intent reasoning that compresses rationales into compact decodable tokens. Deployed in Taobao’s “Guess What You Like” feed, it improves IPV, CTR, TC, and GMV by +1.28%, +1.00%, +1.97%, and +3.97% while reducing user-modeling compute by 55.8%, output token cost by 200×, and end-to-end serving resource consumption by 52.4%.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对大规模LLM推荐服务中无状态用户建模导致重复计算、文本标签到物品映射信息损失以及显式长链推理带来高延迟的问题，提出RecGPT-V3。其核心是有状态混合模态推荐框架：通过Memory Hub持续压缩和更新用户长期记忆，并让模型联合推理自然语言标签与Semantic ID，同时用潜在意图token替代冗长CoT以兼顾效率与可解释性。在淘宝“猜你喜欢”线上实验中，IPV、CTR、TC和GMV分别提升1.28%、1.00%、1.97%和3.97%，同时端到端服务资源消耗降低52.4%。

papers.title: AnovaX: A Local, Multi-Agent Voice Assistant with LLM Planning, Typed Executors, and Adaptive Recovery
papers.authors: Raunak B Sinha
papers.abstract_en: Desktop voice assistants are still dominated by cloud pipelines that ship raw audio off the machine and expose a fixed set of skills. We describe AnovaX, a small local-first assistant that runs entirely on the user's computer and treats the desktop itself as its action surface. A single Python process wires together a wake-word gate, a speech pipeline, an LLM planner (Gemini) that emits a JSON plan of tool calls, a whitelist-and-denylist safety layer, a multi-agent orchestrator that translates each plan into typed child agents on a bounded thread pool, and an adaptive recovery loop that takes over whenever a core step fails. Every tool corresponds to a specialized agent class (AppAgent, TypingAgent, BrowserAgent and six others) with its own timeout, retry policy, and shared-resource locks. A recursive MetaAgent lets the planner delegate a sub-goal back to itself, capped at two levels of nesting. The recovery loop uses a compact ReAct-style prompt and hides Gemini's latency behind speculative execution of read-only tools. A companion Flask server exposes a phone-friendly remote over the local WiFi, mirrors every agent lifecycle event to the phone in real time, and streams the laptop's screen back over MJPEG so the user can watch remote commands land as they run. The point of the project is less to compete with Siri or Alexa than to show that a legible, few-thousand-line assistant is enough to open apps, type into them, run searches, coordinate concurrent actions, recover from single-step failures, and be driven entirely from a phone in another room -- without the LLM ever touching the keyboard.
papers.abstract_cn: 桌面语音助手仍然由云管道主导，这些管道将原始音频从机器上传送出去，并暴露出一套固定的技能。我们描述了AnovaX，这是一个小型的本地优先助手，完全在用户的计算机上运行，并将桌面本身作为其操作界面。单个Python进程将唤醒词门、语音管道、发出工具调用JSON计划的LLM计划器（Gemini）、白名单和拒绝名单安全层、将每个计划转换为有界线程池上的类型子代理的多代理编排器以及在核心步骤失败时接管的自适应恢复循环连接在一起。每个工具都对应于一个专门的代理类（AppAgent、TypingAgent、BrowserAgent和其他6个代理类），具有自己的超时、重试策略和共享资源锁。递归的MetaAgent允许计划器将子目标委托给自己，以两层嵌套为上限。恢复循环使用紧凑的react风格提示，并将Gemini的延迟隐藏在只读工具的推测执行之后。配套的Flask服务器通过本地WiFi公开了一个手机友好的远程，将每个代理生命周期事件实时镜像到手机上，并通过MJPEG将笔记本电脑的屏幕流式传输回来，这样用户就可以在远程命令运行时看到它们。这个项目的重点不是要与Siri或Alexa竞争，而是要展示一个清晰的、只有几千行代码的助手，足以打开应用程序、输入应用程序、运行搜索、协调并发操作、从单步故障中恢复，以及完全由另一个房间的手机驱动——法学硕士根本不用碰键盘。
papers.ai_summary_en: AnovaX addresses the privacy and extensibility limitations of cloud-based desktop voice assistants by proposing a local-first assistant that treats the desktop as an open action surface rather than a fixed skill set. Its key method is an LLM planner that emits JSON tool-call plans, which are executed by typed, sandboxed child agents with safety filtering, timeouts, retries, resource locks, bounded concurrency, recursive sub-goal delegation, and a ReAct-style adaptive recovery loop accelerated by speculative read-only execution. The system demonstrates that a small, legible local pipeline can reliably launch apps, type, browse, coordinate concurrent actions, recover from step failures, and be remotely controlled from a phone without giving the LLM direct low-level device access.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对桌面语音助手依赖云端、技能固定且难以安全操作本地桌面的问题，AnovaX 提出一个本地优先的语音助手系统，由 Gemini 生成 JSON 工具调用计划，并通过安全白/黑名单与多类型代理在受控线程池中执行。其核心洞见是将桌面操作抽象为带超时、重试和资源锁的类型化智能体，并用 ReAct 式自适应恢复及只读工具投机执行来掩盖 LLM 延迟、处理单步失败。系统实现表明，一个几千行、可读性较强的本地助手即可完成启动应用、输入、搜索、并发协调和手机远程监控驱动，且 LLM 不直接控制键盘。

papers.title: D-cut: Adaptive Verification Depth Pruning for Batched Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Tianyu Liu, Yuhao Shen, Rui Cen, Junhan Shi, Jiebin Zhang, Guangshuo Qin, Hong Liu, Song Liu, Guanghua Yu, Jianchen Zhu
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference without compromising output quality. Recent parallel drafting methods further improve single-request performance by decoupling draft length from drafting latency, enabling longer drafts and higher mean accepted tokens (MAT). However, under high request concurrency, long drafts waste substantial computation on rejected tokens, increasing verification cost and potentially making speculative decoding slower than autoregressive decoding. We present D-Cut, an adaptive pruning method that selects draft tokens jointly across the batch and concentrates the verification budget on tokens most likely to be accepted. D-Cut is motivated by two observations. First, acceptance lengths vary considerably across concurrent requests; D-Cut therefore performs cross-request pruning, allocating the verification budget adaptively according to draft confidence. Second, verification cost depends strongly on the deployment environment, including GPU architecture and parallelism strategy; D-Cut incorporates a runtime cost model to adapt its pruning depth to the target environment. Experiments on dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models show that, under high concurrency, D-Cut improves the average speedup from \(1.26\times\) to \(1.65\times\), restores acceleration in dense-model configurations where long-draft baselines are slower than autoregressive decoding, and achieves up to \(3.0\times\) speedup over autoregressive decoding on MoE models.
papers.abstract_cn: 推测解码加速大语言模型（LLM）推理而不影响输出质量。最近的并行起草方法通过将起草长度与起草延迟解耦来进一步提高单请求性能，从而实现更长的草案和更高的平均可接受令牌（MAT）。然而，在高请求并发性下，长草案浪费了被拒绝令牌的大量计算，增加了验证成本，并可能使推测解码比自回归解码慢。我们提出了D-Cut，一种自适应修剪方法，它在批中共同选择草案令牌，并将验证预算集中在最有可能被接受的令牌上。D-Cut的动机有两点。首先，接受长度在并发请求之间差异很大；因此D-Cut执行交叉请求修剪，根据草案置信度自适应分配验证预算。其次，验证成本在很大程度上取决于部署环境，包括GPU架构和并行策略；D-Cut结合了一个运行时成本模型来调整其修剪深度以适应目标环境。在密集和混合专家（MoE）模型上的实验表明，在高并发性下，D-Cut将平均加速从\(1.26\times\)提高到\(1.65\times\)，在长稿基线比自回归解码慢的密集模型配置下恢复加速，并且在MoE模型上实现了比自回归解码高达\(3.0\times\)的加速。
papers.ai_summary_en: D-Cut addresses the inefficiency of batched speculative decoding under high concurrency, where long parallel drafts incur excessive verification cost on rejected tokens and can become slower than autoregressive decoding. It adaptively prunes draft-token verification depth across requests by allocating budget to high-confidence tokens and using a runtime cost model tuned to GPU architecture and parallelism. Experiments on dense and MoE models show improved high-concurrency speedup from 1.26× to 1.65× on average, recovery of gains where long-draft baselines regress, and up to 3.0× over autoregressive decoding on MoE models.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文解决批量推测解码在高并发场景下因长草稿验证开销过大、甚至慢于自回归解码的问题。其核心方法是 D-Cut：跨请求根据草稿置信度自适应剪枝验证深度，并引入运行时成本模型使剪枝适配 GPU 架构与并行策略。实验显示，在稠密和 MoE 模型上高并发平均加速从 1.26× 提升至 1.65×，并在 MoE 模型上相对自回归解码最高实现 3.0× 加速。

papers.title: PolyQ: Codesigning End-to-End Quantization Framework for Scalable Edge CPU LLM Inference
papers.authors: Hyunwoo Oh, Suyeon Jang, Hanning Chen, KyungIn Nam, Sanggeon Yun, Ryozo Masukawa, Mohsen Imani
papers.abstract_en: CPUs are the most universal target for on-device LLM inference, but existing low-bit quantization methods offer either coarse operating points or fine-grained mixed precision that is difficult to execute efficiently on CPUs. We present PolyQ, a CPU-oriented compiler/quantization co-design for activation-aware channel-wise bit allocation under a user-specified average-bit budget. PolyQ assigns per-channel bit-widths from $\{2,3,4,8,16\}$, then uses a compile-time model compiler to permute and cluster channels into bit-homogeneous blocks, generate SIMD- and LUT-compatible kernels, and merge compatible permutations across operators to keep layout regularization off the runtime path. This turns fine-grained budget fitting into a practical fractional-bit deployment method for CPU-only inference. Across Falcon-H1-3B, Llama2-13B, and Qwen3-32B on WikiText-2, PolyQ provides stable quality scaling from 3--6\,b and improves perplexity by 2.4--32.1\% over prior methods at a 3\,b target. End-to-end measurements on three representative CPUs -- workstation, laptop, and mobile -- show that compiler layout regularization reduces activation reorder traffic by up to 70.8\%, prefill latency and decode throughput scale nearly proportionally with the configured bit budget, and energy/token overhead stays below 2\% relative to an optimized LUT-based back-end. These results show that fractional-bit CPU deployment is practical, predictable, and energy-efficient across diverse edge targets.
papers.abstract_cn: cpu是设备上LLM推理最普遍的目标，但现有的低比特量化方法要么提供粗操作点，要么提供细粒度混合精度，难以在cpu上有效执行。我们提出了PolyQ，一个面向cpu的编译器/量化协同设计，用于在用户指定的平均比特预算下进行激活感知通道明智的比特分配。PolyQ从$\{2,3,4,8,16\}$分配每个通道的位宽度，然后使用编译时模型编译器将通道排列和群集为位同质块，生成SIMD和lut兼容的内核，并合并跨操作符的兼容排列，以保持布局正则化在运行时路径之外。这将细粒度预算拟合转变为仅用于cpu推理的实用小数位部署方法。在WikiText-2上的猎鹰h1 - 3b、Llama2-13B和Qwen3-32B上，PolyQ提供了从3- 6\，b的稳定质量缩放，并且在3\，b的目标下，比先前的方法提高了2.4- 32.1%的困惑度。对三个代表性cpu（工作站、笔记本电脑和移动设备）的端到端测量表明，编译器布局正则化将激活重排序流量减少了70.8%，预填充延迟和解码吞吐量几乎与配置的位预算成比例，相对于优化的基于lutt的后端，能量/令牌开销保持在2%以下。这些结果表明，在不同边缘目标上，小数位CPU部署是实用的、可预测的和节能的。
papers.ai_summary_en: PolyQ addresses the inefficiency of fine-grained mixed-precision LLM quantization on edge CPUs, where existing low-bit methods either provide coarse operating points or incur runtime layout overhead. It introduces an activation-aware, channel-wise bit-allocation framework under an average-bit budget, paired with a compiler that permutes and clusters channels into bit-homogeneous blocks, generates SIMD- and LUT-compatible kernels, and merges permutations across operators to keep layout regularization compile-time. Experiments on Falcon-H1-3B, Llama2-13B, and Qwen3-32B show stable 3–6-bit quality scaling, 2.4–32.1% perplexity gains over prior methods at a 3-bit target, up to 70.8% less activation reorder traffic, and near-proportional latency/throughput scaling with under 2% energy/token overhead across CPUs.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对边缘 CPU 上低比特 LLM 量化要么粒度粗、要么细粒度混合精度难以高效执行的问题，PolyQ 提出量化—编译器协同设计，在平均比特预算下进行激活感知的通道级 2/3/4/8/16 位分配，并通过编译期通道排列聚类、生成 SIMD/LUT 兼容内核与跨算子融合布局，将分数比特量化转化为可部署方案。实验显示，该方法在 3–6 比特下质量稳定扩展，3 比特目标较先前方法显著降低困惑度，并在工作站、笔记本和移动 CPU 上减少激活重排流量、实现近比例延迟/吞吐扩展且能耗开销低于 2%。

papers.title: PagedWeight: Efficient MoE LLM Serving with Dynamic Quality-Aware Weight Quantization
papers.authors: Yuchen Yang, Yifan Zhao, Anisha Dasgupta, Sasa Misailovic
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is a popular class of large language models (LLMs), offering high efficiency and accuracy. However, in KV-cache-intensive serving scenarios, MoEs often exhibit a tension between the GPU memory requirements of the model weights and the growing KV cache. We propose PagedWeight, a novel management method for MoE LLM serving that dynamically quantizes MoE model's weights at runtime and balances expert-weight precision with the KV cache sizes. PagedWeight exposes and effectively navigates the complex tradeoff between the model's task accuracy, memory consumption, and throughput/latency. Across several memory-sensitive MoE serving scenarios, PagedWeight improves the quality-memory tradeoff over several existing quantization baselines. PagedWeight achieves FP16-equivalent accuracy with up to 72.0% GPU memory savings and 1.94$\times$ throughput improvement, and improves quality over quantization methods by up to 39.3% at a similar memory budget with at most 4.1% throughput loss.
papers.abstract_cn: 混合专家（MoE）是一类流行的大型语言模型（llm），具有高效率和准确性。然而，在KV缓存密集型服务场景中，moe经常在模型权重的GPU内存需求和不断增长的KV缓存之间表现出紧张关系。我们提出了一种新的MoE LLM服务管理方法PagedWeight，它在运行时动态量化MoE模型的权重，并平衡专家权重精度和KV缓存大小。PagedWeight公开并有效地在模型的任务准确性、内存消耗和吞吐量/延迟之间进行复杂的权衡。在几个对内存敏感的MoE服务场景中，PagedWeight在几个现有量化基线上改进了质量-内存权衡。PagedWeight实现了相当于fp16的精度，节省了高达72.0%的GPU内存和1.94美元的吞吐量提高，并且在类似的内存预算下，比量化方法的质量提高了39.3%，吞吐量损失最多为4.1%。
papers.ai_summary_en: PagedWeight addresses the GPU memory contention in MoE LLM serving between storing expert weights and accommodating large, growing KV caches. It introduces runtime dynamic weight quantization for MoE models, explicitly balancing expert-weight precision against KV-cache size to navigate accuracy–memory–throughput/latency tradeoffs. Experiments show FP16-equivalent accuracy with up to 72.0% GPU memory savings and 1.94× throughput improvement, or up to 39.3% better quality than quantization baselines at similar memory with at most 4.1% throughput loss.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 MoE 大模型服务中模型权重与 KV cache 竞争 GPU 显存的问题，提出 PagedWeight，在运行时根据质量感知动态量化专家权重，以平衡权重精度、KV cache 占用、吞吐和延迟。其主要洞见是将 MoE 权重精度与 KV cache 容量作为可联合调控的资源，在任务精度、显存消耗和服务性能之间进行动态权衡。实验表明，PagedWeight 可在保持 FP16 等效精度下最高节省 72.0% 显存并提升 1.94 倍吞吐；在相近显存预算下，质量较现有量化方法最高提升 39.3%，吞吐损失不超过 4.1%。

papers.title: ContinuityBench: A Benchmark and Systems Study of Stateful Failover in Multi-Provider LLM Routing
papers.authors: Vishal Pandey, Gopal Singh
papers.abstract_en: In production large language model (LLM) deployments, high API availability guarantees do not equate to conversational continuity. When a primary provider experiences an outage or strict rate-limiting, naive stateless failover mechanisms successfully maintain uptime but silently discard conversation history, severely disrupting the user experience. To rigorously quantify and resolve this failure mode, we introduce two novel metrics: Continuity Preservation Rate (CPR) and Continuity Latency Overhead (CLO). We propose a stateful, multi-provider proxy architecture utilizing a History-Forwarding strategy to seamlessly reconstruct conversational state across heterogeneous LLM endpoints during failover events. Furthermore, we release continuity-bench, https://github.com/Vishal-sys-code/continuity-bench, an open evaluation harness designed to stress-test context preservation under high-concurrency provider failure conditions. Our empirical evaluation ($N=750$ failover events) demonstrates that our stateful proxy achieves a 99.20\% CPR [95\% CI: 98.27\%, 99.63\%], cleanly transferring deep conversational context to fallback providers, compared to a near-0\% preservation rate for standard stateless architectures. Finally, we characterize failover latency distributions, identifying the critical necessity of asynchronous exponential backoff with jitter to prevent cascading retry storms against strict-limit fallback APIs. Our results provide a principled foundation for building robust, state-preserving multi-model inference systems.
papers.abstract_cn: 在生产大型语言模型（LLM）部署中，高API可用性保证并不等同于会话连续性。当主提供者遇到中断或严格的速率限制时，幼稚的无状态故障转移机制可以成功地维持正常运行时间，但会静默地丢弃会话历史记录，从而严重破坏用户体验。为了严格量化和解决这种故障模式，我们引入了两个新的指标：连续性保存率（CPR）和连续性延迟开销（CLO）。我们提出了一种有状态的多提供者代理体系结构，利用历史转发策略在故障转移事件期间无缝地重建跨异构LLM端点的会话状态。此外，我们发布了continuous -bench https://github.com/Vishal-sys-code/continuity-bench，这是一个开放的评估工具，用于在高并发提供程序故障条件下对上下文保存进行压力测试。我们的经验评估（$N=750$故障转移事件）表明，我们的有状态代理实现了99.20%的CPR [95% CI: 98.27%, 99.63%]，干净地将深度会话上下文传递给回退提供者，而标准无状态架构的保留率接近0%。最后，我们描述了故障转移延迟分布，确定了带抖动的异步指数回退的关键必要性，以防止针对严格限制的回退api的级联重试风暴。我们的研究结果为构建鲁棒的、保持状态的多模型推理系统提供了原则性的基础。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles the gap between LLM API availability and conversational continuity, showing that stateless multi-provider failover preserves uptime but drops dialogue history. It introduces Continuity Preservation Rate (CPR) and Continuity Latency Overhead (CLO), a stateful proxy using History-Forwarding to reconstruct context across heterogeneous fallback endpoints, and the open-source ContinuityBench harness for high-concurrency failover evaluation. Across 750 failover events, the system achieves 99.20% CPR versus near-0% for stateless baselines, while latency analysis highlights asynchronous exponential backoff with jitter as essential to avoid cascading retry storms.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多提供商 LLM 服务在故障切换时虽保持可用但会丢失对话历史、破坏会话连续性的问题，提出了衡量连续性的 CPR/CLO 指标及开源评测基准 ContinuityBench。其核心方法是构建有状态的多提供商代理，通过 History-Forwarding 在异构模型端点间转发并重建上下文，实现故障时的状态保持切换。实验在 750 次故障切换中达到 99.20% 的连续性保持率，远优于无状态方案的近 0%，并指出需采用带抖动的异步指数退避以避免重试风暴。

papers.title: Modularized Dynamic-Granularity Video LLM for Multi-Event Long Video Understanding
papers.authors: Wei Feng, Xin Wang, Yu-Wei Zhan, Yuwei Zhou, Wenwu Zhu
papers.abstract_en: Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) have made significant advancements in various video understanding tasks. However, long-video scenarios remain challenging due to the tension between limited visual token budgets and the need to capture multiple key events. Existing approaches typically process long videos in two stages, i.e., i) select keyframes and ii) perform detailed perception, which exhibit limitations: they lack a modular mechanism for adaptive capacity allocation and self-correction, resulting in unreliable modeling. To tackle these challenges, we propose MoD-VLLM, a novel Modularized Dynamic-Granularity Video LLM framework for multi-event long video understanding, which unifies temporal grounding and semantic understanding iteratively and self-reflectively. Specifically, we propose a Positive-Negative Video Segments Grounding module and a Modularized Dynamic-Granularity Reflection module, which form a closed loop to progressively localize the question-related video segments. The grounding module instructs a Video LLM to distinguish relevant from irrelevant video segments based on the video question. The reflection module employs a modularized scheduler that dynamically selects fine-grained encoding for relevant positive segments to capture detailed perception and coarse-grained encoding for negative segments to maintain global context. We further propose a dynamic-granularity reinforcement learning strategy, allowing MoD-VLLM to learn optimal grounding policies and dynamic granularity visual representation jointly. Moreover, we propose MEventBench, a challenging Multi-Event Long Video Benchmark for complex long video reasoning. Extensive experiments on several long video understanding benchmarks and our MEventBench demonstrate that MoD-VLLM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.abstract_cn: 视频大型语言模型（Video llm）在各种视频理解任务中取得了重大进展。然而，由于有限的视觉令牌预算和捕获多个关键事件的需求之间的紧张关系，长视频场景仍然具有挑战性。现有的方法通常分两个阶段处理长视频，即i)选择关键帧和ii)执行详细感知，这表现出局限性：它们缺乏自适应容量分配和自我校正的模块化机制，导致建模不可靠。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了MoD-VLLM，一种新的模块化动态粒度视频LLM框架，用于多事件长视频理解，它将时间基础和语义理解迭代地和自反射地统一起来。具体来说，我们提出了一个正负视频片段接地模块和一个模块化的动态粒度反射模块，它们形成一个闭环，逐步定位与问题相关的视频片段。接地模块指导视频法学硕士根据视频问题区分相关和不相关的视频片段。反射模块采用模块化调度器，动态地为相关的正段选择细粒度编码以捕获详细的感知，并为负段选择粗粒度编码以维护全局上下文。我们进一步提出了一种动态粒度强化学习策略，使MoD-VLLM能够共同学习最优接地策略和动态粒度可视化表示。此外，我们提出了MEventBench，一个具有挑战性的多事件长视频基准，用于复杂的长视频推理。在几个长视频理解基准测试和我们的MEventBench上进行的大量实验表明，MoD-VLLM显著优于最先进的基线。
papers.comment: Accepted by 2026 IEEE International Conference on Multimedia and Expo (ICME 2026)
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles multi-event long-video understanding in Video LLMs, where limited visual-token budgets make it difficult to capture multiple relevant events reliably. MoD-VLLM introduces an iterative closed-loop framework with positive–negative segment grounding and a modular dynamic-granularity reflection scheduler that assigns fine-grained encoding to question-relevant segments and coarse-grained encoding to irrelevant ones, jointly optimized via dynamic-granularity reinforcement learning. Experiments on long-video benchmarks and the new MEventBench show significant gains over state-of-the-art baselines for complex multi-event reasoning.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长视频多事件理解中视觉 token 预算有限、难以兼顾关键事件细节与全局上下文的问题，指出现有“关键帧选择+精细感知”两阶段方法缺乏自适应容量分配和自纠正能力。其提出 MoD-VLLM，通过正负片段定位与模块化动态粒度反思形成闭环，对相关片段细粒度编码、对无关片段粗粒度编码，并用强化学习联合优化定位策略和视觉表示。实验在多个长视频基准及新提出的 MEventBench 上显著优于现有方法，提升了复杂长视频推理的可靠性。

papers.title: EduGuard: A Safe RAG-Based LLM Tutor for Programming Education
papers.authors: S M Asif Hossain, Ruksat Khan Shayoni, M. F. Mridha, Jungpil Shin
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI (GenAI) is increasingly used by students for programming explanation, debugging, and assignment support. Yet unrestricted large language model (LLM) tutors can hallucinate, contradict course policy, reveal complete solutions, and foster passive dependence. This paper presents EduGuard, a safe retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) tutoring framework for introductory programming. EduGuard integrates query understanding, instructor-approved course retrieval, pedagogical strategy selection, rubric-aware generation, claim-level verification, and overreliance control. To make evaluation provenance explicit, we construct BILearn-CS, a 600-query instructor-authored, TA-validated benchmark spanning concept questions, debugging cases, misconceptions, assignment-support requests, code-mixed Bangla-English queries, and adversarial direct-answer prompts. Moving beyond a synthetic-only benchmark, we further evaluate on a 150-query public CS50-style course-forum set and run a small controlled pilot with 10 undergraduates using a counterbalanced pre-test/post-test design. Using Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct as the primary generator, hybrid FAISS/BM25 retrieval, and DeBERTa-v3-large-MNLI as an architecturally separate verifier, EduGuard is compared against strong baselines: GPT-4o-mini Tutor, Llama Socratic Tutor, LPITutor-style RAG, RAG with rubric prompting, and RAG with same-model self-checking. On BILearn-CS, EduGuard attains the best correctness (90.1%), grounding (89.4%), and rubric alignment (90.8%), with the lowest hallucination (4.9%) and direct-answer leakage (9.8%). In the pilot, it raises immediate post-test accuracy from 68.4% to 81.2% and cuts overreliance from 38.0% to 17.0% relative to GPT-4o-mini Tutor. These results suggest safe GenAI tutoring requires not only retrieval or strong prompting, but explicit pedagogical control, evidence verification, and deployment safeguards.
papers.abstract_cn: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）越来越多地被学生用于编程解释、调试和作业支持。然而，不受限制的大语言模型（LLM）导师可能产生幻觉，与课程政策相矛盾，揭示完整的解决方案，并培养被动依赖。本文介绍了EduGuard，一个安全的检索增强生成（RAG）入门编程辅导框架。EduGuard集成了查询理解、教师批准的课程检索、教学策略选择、规则感知生成、索赔级验证和过度依赖控制。为了明确评估来源，我们构建了billearn - cs，这是一个由讲师编写的600个查询，经过ta验证的基准测试，涵盖概念问题，调试案例，误解，作业支持请求，代码混合的孟加拉语-英语查询和对抗性直接回答提示。在综合基准之外，我们进一步评估了150个问题的公共cs50式课程论坛集，并使用平衡的前测/后测设计运行了一个由10名本科生组成的小型对照试点。EduGuard使用Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct作为主生成器，FAISS/BM25混合检索，DeBERTa-v3-large-MNLI作为架构上独立的验证器，与强大的基线进行比较：gpt - 40 -mini Tutor， Llama Socratic Tutor， lpitutor风格的RAG，带有标题提示的RAG和具有同模型自检的RAG。在billearn - cs上，EduGuard获得了最佳的正确性（90.1%），接地（89.4%）和标题对齐（90.8%），最低的幻觉（4.9%）和直接回答泄漏（9.8%）。在试验中，它将即时测试后的准确率从68.4%提高到81.2%，并将相对于gpt - 40 -mini Tutor的过度依赖从38.0%降低到17.0%。这些结果表明，安全的GenAI辅导不仅需要检索或强烈的提示，还需要明确的教学控制、证据验证和部署保障。
papers.ai_summary_en: EduGuard addresses unsafe behavior in LLM programming tutors, including hallucination, course-policy violations, full-solution leakage, and student overreliance. It proposes a safe RAG tutoring pipeline that combines query understanding, instructor-approved hybrid FAISS/BM25 retrieval, pedagogical strategy selection, rubric-aware generation, claim-level verification with a separate DeBERTa NLI model, and explicit overreliance controls. Evaluated on the instructor-validated BILearn-CS benchmark, a CS50-style forum set, and a 10-student pilot, EduGuard using Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct achieves the best correctness, grounding, and rubric alignment while reducing hallucination, direct-answer leakage, and overreliance relative to strong GPT-4o-mini and RAG tutoring baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对编程教育中无约束 LLM 导师易产生幻觉、违背课程规则、直接泄露答案并诱发学生依赖的问题，提出 EduGuard：一个面向入门编程的安全 RAG 辅导框架。其核心方法是将查询理解、教师审核课程材料检索、教学策略选择、评分规则感知生成、claim 级外部验证和防过度依赖控制结合起来，并构建/使用 BILearn-CS 等基准进行评估。实验显示，EduGuard 在正确性、证据接地和课程规则对齐上优于多个强基线，同时显著降低幻觉与直接答案泄露，并在小规模学生试点中提升后测成绩、减少过度依赖。

papers.title: IoUPD: IoU-Aware Privileged Distillation for Visual Grounding with Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.authors: Xiuyuan Zhu, Ke Lu, Hao Wu, Zijin Du, Dongming Zhang, Jian Xue
papers.abstract_en: Visual grounding with multimodal large language models is commonly formulated as autoregressive coordinate generation, where a model outputs bounding-box coordinates as text given an image and a referring-expression prompt. While this interface is simple and compatible with instruction following, it introduces a mismatch between training and evaluation: training optimizes token-level likelihood over coordinate strings, whereas grounding quality is measured by geometric overlap. We propose IoUPD, an IoU-aware privileged distillation method for coordinate-generating multimodal large language models. IoUPD uses ground-truth boxes not only as coordinate targets, but also as privileged training-time guidance. During training, the student receives the original image and prompt, while a frozen teacher receives a box-marked image and an augmented prompt that indicates the marked region. The student is trained with a supervised fine-tuning anchor and a privileged distillation loss whose token weights reflect both geometric importance and teacher reliability. At inference time, IoUPD requires no box overlay, privileged hint, teacher branch, or additional prediction module. Experiments on standard referring-expression grounding benchmarks show consistent region-level improvements over strong coordinate-generating baselines, demonstrating that ground-truth boxes can provide useful privileged guidance beyond serving as coordinate labels.
papers.abstract_cn: 多模态大型语言模型的视觉基础通常被表述为自回归坐标生成，其中模型将边界框坐标作为给定图像和参考表达式提示的文本输出。虽然该接口简单且与指令遵循兼容，但它引入了训练和评估之间的不匹配：训练优化了坐标字符串上的令牌级似然，而接地质量是通过几何重叠来衡量的。提出了一种基于IoUPD的多模态大语言模型坐标生成的特权蒸馏方法。IoUPD不仅使用地面真相盒作为坐标目标，而且还将其作为特殊的训练时间指导。在训练过程中，学生接收原始图像和提示，而冻结的教师接收框标记图像和表示标记区域的增强提示。学生接受监督微调锚和特权蒸馏损失的训练，其令牌权重反映几何重要性和教师可靠性。在推理时，IoUPD不需要框覆盖、特权提示、教师分支或额外的预测模块。在标准参考表达式接地基准上的实验表明，与强坐标生成基线相比，区域级的改进是一致的，这表明除了作为坐标标签之外，接地真值框还可以提供有用的特权指导。
papers.ai_summary_en: IoUPD addresses the training–evaluation mismatch in coordinate-generating multimodal LLMs for visual grounding, where token-level likelihood optimization over bounding-box strings does not directly optimize geometric IoU. The method introduces IoU-aware privileged distillation: a frozen teacher receives a privileged box-marked image and augmented prompt, while a student trained on the original inputs learns from teacher logits weighted by geometric importance and teacher reliability, alongside supervised fine-tuning. Without requiring overlays, teachers, or extra modules at inference, IoUPD yields consistent region-level gains on referring-expression grounding benchmarks.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型以文本坐标生成视觉定位时，训练优化 token 似然而评估关注 IoU 所造成的训练-评估不匹配问题，本文提出 IoUPD。该方法将真实框作为训练期特权信息，让学生模型输入原图、教师模型输入框标注图，并通过 IoU 感知的加权蒸馏损失结合几何重要性与教师可靠性进行训练，推理时无需额外框标注或教师分支。实验表明，IoUPD 在多个指代表达定位基准上稳定提升区域级定位性能，证明真实框可提供超越坐标标签本身的有效监督。

papers.title: A Generative Partially Specified Finite State Machine Approach to Complex Behaviour Planning
papers.authors: Kalana Ratnayake, Michael Pritchard, David Hinwood, Maleen Jayasuriya, Damith Herath
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous robots operating in dynamic environments require behaviour planning systems that combine reactivity, interpretability, and adaptability. While Large Language Models have been successfully integrated with Behaviour Trees for dynamic replanning, Finite State Machines, despite their widespread adoption and computational efficiency, remain unexplored for generative approaches. We propose a Generative Partially Specified Finite State Machine (GPSFSM) neurosymbolic architecture that utilises the symbolic and semantic structure of FSMs, including states and event-triggered transitions, to implement Behaviour Planning. This paper introduces the first GPSFSM framework for robotics, featuring Fabric, an FSM engine that parses, validates, and executes behaviour plans that contain Sequential, Recovery, Parallel-Any, and Parallel-All control structures. We extend the Capabilities2 package in ROS2 with an asynchronous event system for behaviour chaining and runtime parameter injection for configurable execution, addressing the ad-hoc function representations that limit current generative systems. PromptTools provides a unified ROS 2 interface to local and cloud LLMs, with prompt buffering, enabling dynamic asynchronous composition of task and context information. Together, these components enable standardised semantic capability descriptions for robot-agnostic development. Experimental evaluation on navigation tasks demonstrates that our GPSFSM approach achieves consistently higher plan-generation success rates than the state-of-the-art BTGenBot system, particularly excelling in zero-shot scenarios where BTs typically struggle, while maintaining comparable or lower planning latency to frontier LLMs. We also demonstrate that our system can generate complex behaviours. We release an open-source ROS2 stack that makes generative FSM planning practical and reproducible for robotic systems.
papers.abstract_cn: 在动态环境中工作的自主机器人需要结合反应性、可解释性和适应性的行为规划系统。虽然大型语言模型已经成功地与行为树集成在一起，用于动态重新规划，但有限状态机尽管被广泛采用且计算效率高，但仍未被用于生成方法。我们提出了一种生成部分指定有限状态机（GPSFSM）神经符号架构，它利用fsm的符号和语义结构，包括状态和事件触发转换，来实现行为规划。本文介绍了第一个用于机器人的GPSFSM框架，其特点是Fabric，一个FSM引擎，用于解析、验证和执行包含顺序、恢复、任意并行和所有并行控制结构的行为计划。我们用异步事件系统扩展了ROS2中的abilties2包，用于行为链接和运行时参数注入，用于可配置的执行，解决了限制当前生成系统的特殊函数表示。PromptTools为本地和云llm提供了统一的ROS 2接口，具有提示缓冲，支持任务和上下文信息的动态异步组合。总之，这些组件为与机器人无关的开发提供了标准化的语义功能描述。导航任务的实验评估表明，我们的GPSFSM方法比最先进的BTGenBot系统始终实现更高的计划生成成功率，特别是在bt通常挣扎的零射击场景中表现出色，同时保持与前沿llm相当或更低的计划延迟。我们也证明了我们的系统可以产生复杂的行为。我们发布了一个开源的ROS2堆栈，它使生成式FSM规划在机器人系统中变得实用和可复制。
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS). 9 pages, 10 figures, 1 table
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles the problem of generative behavior planning for autonomous robots, where finite state machines (FSMs) remain underexplored relative to behavior trees despite their efficiency and interpretability. It proposes a Generative Partially Specified FSM (GPSFSM) neurosymbolic framework that uses LLMs to generate FSM-based plans and executes them via Fabric, a ROS 2-integrated FSM engine supporting sequential, recovery, and parallel control structures with asynchronous event chaining and runtime parameter injection. Experiments on navigation tasks show higher plan-generation success than BTGenBot, especially in zero-shot settings, with comparable or lower planning latency and an open-source ROS 2 stack for reproducible generative FSM planning.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对自主机器人在动态环境中行为规划难以兼顾反应性、可解释性与适应性，且有限状态机（FSM）尚未被生成式方法充分探索的问题。  
提出生成式部分指定有限状态机（GPSFSM）神经符号架构，通过 Fabric FSM 引擎、ROS2 异步事件链、运行时参数注入和统一 LLM 接口 PromptTools，将 LLM 生成的语义化能力描述转化为可解析、验证和执行的行为计划。  
实验表明，该方法在导航任务中的计划生成成功率优于 BTGenBot，尤其在零样本场景优势明显，同时保持相当或更低的规划延迟，并开源了可复现的 ROS2 系统栈。

papers.title: VarRate: Training-Free Variable-Rate KV Cache Compression for Long-Context LLMs
papers.authors: Shahrzad Esmat, Dhawal Shah, Ali Jannesari
papers.abstract_en: The key-value (KV) cache is the main memory bottleneck in long-context large language model (LLM) inference. Two leading training-free families are both structurally limited: token-selection methods (SnapKV, Ada-KV) score importance from an observation window and evict low-scoring tokens, but eviction is irreversible -- so when the importance signal degrades under query-agnostic reuse, accuracy collapses by 11-15 points; uniform low-rank coding keeps every token but spends equal rank everywhere, wasting budget. We observe that both failures share one cure: rank should be allocated, not evicted. We present VarRate, a training-free KV codec that assigns each token a variable low-rank budget by its query salience, keeping every token at a nonzero rank. Comparable adaptive-rank codecs reach this allocation only through training; VarRate requires none. Because no token is dropped, it degrades by only 3.5-5.5 points where query-aware selection collapses. At a matched 20% budget on LongBench (16 tasks), VarRate stays within 0.8 points of the uncompressed model on both Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B. Averaged over the two, it is the strongest matched-memory compressor. It significantly beats its uniform-rank ablation on both models. Against KVzip, a method purpose-built for query-agnostic reuse, it is accuracy-equivalent in three of four settings and within a point overall, at about one-eighth the prefill overhead.
papers.abstract_cn: 键值（KV）缓存是长上下文大语言模型（LLM）推理中的主要内存瓶颈。两种主要的无训练家族在结构上都是有限的：标记选择方法（SnapKV, Ada-KV）从观察窗口中对重要性进行评分，并剔除得分较低的标记，但剔除是不可逆的——因此，当重要性信号在查询不可知的重用下降级时，准确率会下降11-15分；统一的低等级编码保留了每个代币，但在每个地方都花费了相同的等级，浪费了预算。我们观察到这两个失败有一个共同点：应该分配等级，而不是驱逐。我们提出了VarRate，一个无需训练的KV编解码器，它通过查询显著性为每个令牌分配一个可变的低秩预算，使每个令牌保持非零秩。可比较的自适应等级编解码器只有通过训练才能达到这个分配；VarRate不需要。因为没有令牌被丢弃，所以当查询感知选择崩溃时，它的性能只会下降3.5-5.5分。在LongBench上匹配20%的预算（16个任务），VarRate在Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B上保持在未压缩模型的0.8点以内。在两者的平均值上，它是最强的匹配内存压缩器。在这两种模型上都明显优于均阶烧蚀。与KVzip（一种专门为查询无关的重用而构建的方法）相比，它在四种设置中的三种设置中具有相同的准确性，并且总体上在一个点内，大约是预填充开销的八分之一。
papers.comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 24 tables. Includes appendix with additional experiments and analyses
papers.ai_summary_en: VarRate addresses the KV-cache memory bottleneck in long-context LLM inference, where training-free token-eviction methods suffer irreversible accuracy loss under query-agnostic reuse and uniform low-rank compression wastes budget by allocating equal rank to all tokens. Its key insight is to allocate rank rather than evict tokens: VarRate is a training-free KV codec that assigns every token a nonzero variable low-rank budget based on query salience. At a 20% cache budget on LongBench, it remains within 0.8 points of the uncompressed model on Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, outperforms uniform-rank compression, and matches KVzip with roughly one-eighth the prefill overhead.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV Cache 的内存瓶颈，指出现有无训练压缩方法要么因不可逆丢弃 token 而在查询无关复用下严重掉点，要么因均匀低秩分配浪费预算。VarRate 的核心洞见是“应按查询显著性为每个 token 分配可变低秩预算，而非驱逐 token”，从而以无训练方式实现所有 token 均保留但秩不同的 KV 编码。实验显示，在 20% 预算下其性能仅比无压缩模型低约 0.8 分，显著优于均匀低秩方法，并可在精度上媲美 KVzip 的同时将预填充开销降至约 1/8。

papers.title: QUADS: Stabilizing NVFP4 Reinforcement Learning for MoE via QUantization-error Alignment across Dual Sides
papers.authors: Zhengyang Zhuge, Hao Yu, Xin Wang, Zheng Li, Yizhong Cao, Dayiheng Liu, Jianwei Zhang
papers.abstract_en: Rollout generation is a major bottleneck in Reinforcement Learning (RL) for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Large Language Models, motivating low-precision rollout acceleration such as FP8. As an emerging low-precision format, NVFP4 combines fine-grained scaling for accuracy preservation with native W4A4 FP4 GEMMs for higher throughput than FP8. However, we find that directly applying NVFP4 to MoE RL rollout is impractical. NVFP4 rollout with BF16 training collapses after roughly 150 steps, accompanied by rapidly growing rollout-trainer log-probability gaps. Through training-inference error analysis and controlled ablations, we identify activation error, rather than weight error, as the dominant source of FP4 RL instability: weights can be synchronized and aligned by a shared quantization-dequantization path, whereas activations are recomputed online and error is amplified by the coarse E2M1 grid. Therefore, to stabilize NVFP4 RL for MoE, we propose QUantization-error Alignment across Dual Sides (QUADS). On the trainer side, we introduce Asymmetric Quantization-Aware Training fake-quantizing weights while keeping activations unquantized for better alignment. On the rollout side, Residual Activation Compensation corrects high-error activation channels while preserving native W4A4 GEMMs. In our MoE RL experiments on several benchmarks, QUADS achieves BF16-level accuracy, improves average pass@1 by 21.49 points over naive NVFP4 RL, and delivers ~16% higher rollout throughput than FP8.
papers.abstract_cn: 推出生成是针对混合专家（MoE）大型语言模型的强化学习（RL）的主要瓶颈，它会导致FP8等低精度的推出加速。作为一种新兴的低精度格式，NVFP4将细粒度缩放与原生W4A4 FP4 gem相结合，以保持精度，从而获得比FP8更高的吞吐量。然而，我们发现直接将NVFP4应用于MoE RL部署是不切实际的。使用BF16训练的NVFP4在大约150步后就会崩溃，同时伴随着快速增长的部署-训练器对数概率差距。通过训练-推理误差分析和控制消隐，我们确定激活误差，而不是权重误差，是FP4 RL不稳定的主要来源：权重可以通过共享量化-去量化路径同步和对齐，而激活是在线重新计算的，误差被粗糙的E2M1网格放大。因此，为了稳定用于MoE的NVFP4 RL，我们提出了跨双侧量化误差校准（QUADS）。在训练器方面，我们引入了非对称量化感知训练，在保持激活非量化的同时，对权重进行了伪量化，以获得更好的一致性。在部署端，残余激活补偿在保留原生W4A4 gem的同时纠正高错误激活通道。在多个基准的MoE RL实验中，QUADS达到了bf16级别的精度，比原始NVFP4 RL平均提高了21.49分pass@1，并且比FP8提高了约16%的吞吐量。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses instability when using NVFP4 W4A4 inference to accelerate rollout generation in MoE LLM reinforcement learning, where naive NVFP4 causes rapidly growing trainer–rollout log-probability gaps and training collapse. Through error analysis, it identifies activation quantization as the dominant instability source and proposes QUADS, which aligns quantization error via trainer-side asymmetric quantization-aware weight fake-quantization and rollout-side residual activation compensation while preserving native FP4 GEMMs. QUADS recovers BF16-level RL accuracy, improves average pass@1 by 21.49 points over naive NVFP4 RL, and achieves about 16% higher rollout throughput than FP8.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对 MoE 大模型强化学习中 NVFP4 rollout 因训练-推理误差失配而快速崩溃的问题，发现主要不稳定源是激活量化误差而非权重量化误差。  
QUADS 通过训练侧非对称量化感知训练对齐权重误差、推理侧残差激活补偿修正高误差激活通道，在保留原生 W4A4 FP4 GEMM 的同时稳定 NVFP4 RL。  
实验显示其达到 BF16 级精度，平均 pass@1 较朴素 NVFP4 RL 提升 21.49 个点，并使 rollout 吞吐较 FP8 提高约 16%。

papers.title: Scalable LLM Agent Tool Access in the Cloud
papers.authors: Mingxin Li, Enge Song, Yueshang Zuo, Xiaodong Liu, Rong Wen, Qiang Fu, Gianni Antichi, Jian He, Jing Tie, Zhou Shao, Xiaobo Xue, Xiong Xiao, Luyao Zhong, Shaokai Zhang, Jiangu Zhao, Jianyuan Lu, Shize Zhang, Xiaoqing Sun, Changgang Zheng, Zihao Fan, Haonan Li, Tian Pan, Xiaomin Wu, Yang Song, Xing Li, Biao Lyu, Meng Li, Haipeng Dai, Guihai Chen, Shunmin Zhu
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly rely on tool calling to act on external systems, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) has quickly become its de facto interface. Operating MCP at cloud scale, however, becomes difficult. On the tool provider side, legacy services are not directly callable through MCP; the rapid protocol development also creates ongoing compatibility cost. On the agent side, the number of accessible tool is limited by the LLM context window and inference overhead; mounting a large tool set increases token usage and inference latency and can reduce task success rate. Moreover, for stateful MCP backends with multiple replicas, preserving session affinity increases client-side complexity.   We present a cloud-scale gateway system for MCP service. It breaks the direct-connect model on the data plane and offloads legacy service integration, consolidating incompatible MCP variants, access control, tool recommendation, and session-aware routing to the gateway. Hybrid retrieval sustains 98% Top-15 recall; it scales agent tool access to 3,000+ with high tool selection accuracy, and reduces tool selection time by $8.9\times$ and token usage by $23.8\times$, with low per-call overhead, stable under scale-out. Finally, we share the lessons learned from deploying the gateway system in production.
papers.abstract_cn: LLM代理越来越依赖于工具调用来对外部系统进行操作，而模型上下文协议（MCP）已迅速成为其事实上的接口。然而，在云规模上操作MCP变得很困难。在工具提供方，遗留服务不能通过MCP直接调用；协议的快速发展也带来了持续的兼容性成本。在代理端，可访问工具的数量受到LLM上下文窗口和推理开销的限制；安装大型工具集会增加令牌的使用和推理延迟，并可能降低任务成功率。此外，对于具有多个副本的有状态MCP后端，保留会话关联会增加客户端复杂性。提出了一种云规模的MCP服务网关系统。它打破了数据平面上的直接连接模型，卸载了遗留服务集成，将不兼容的MCP变体、访问控制、工具推荐和会话感知路由整合到网关。混合检索保持98%的前15名查全率；它将代理工具访问扩展到3,000+，具有高工具选择准确性，并将工具选择时间减少8.9美元，令牌使用减少23.8美元，每次呼叫开销低，在横向扩展下稳定。最后，我们将分享在生产环境中部署网关系统的经验教训。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses the systems challenge of operating Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool access for LLM agents at cloud scale, including legacy service integration, protocol compatibility, context-window-limited tool selection, and stateful session routing. It proposes an MCP gateway that decouples agents from direct tool connections and centralizes integration, compatibility handling, access control, hybrid tool retrieval/recommendation, and session-aware routing. The system scales agent access to 3,000+ tools while maintaining 98% Top-15 retrieval recall, reducing tool selection time by 8.9× and token usage by 23.8× with low per-call overhead and stable scale-out behavior.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对云端大规模 MCP 工具调用中旧服务适配难、协议兼容成本高、大工具集导致上下文与推理开销增加，以及有状态会话路由复杂等问题，论文提出一个云规模 MCP 网关，将协议转换、访问控制、工具推荐和会话感知路由从直连数据面集中卸载。系统采用混合检索进行工具选择，在保持 98% Top-15 召回的同时，将可访问工具扩展到 3000+，并使工具选择时间降低 8.9 倍、token 消耗降低 23.8 倍，在低单次调用开销下实现稳定横向扩展。

papers.title: From Feasibility to Desirability: Plan, Learn, Adapt (PLA) Framework for Personalized On-Device Itinerary Generation
papers.authors: Himel Dev, Tanmoy Sen, Madhusudan Basak, Bashima Islam
papers.abstract_en: Generating personalized trip itineraries is a complex planning task and involves a tension between hard combinatorial feasibility and soft latent desirability. Classical optimization enforces constraints but fails to capture subjective traveler preferences. While learning-based approaches model preferences, they cannot guarantee feasibility. Mobile deployment imposes additional resource constraints on both. To address this, we propose Plan, Learn, Adapt (PLA), a three-stage framework for personalized on-device itinerary generation. The Plan stage builds a heterogeneous ensemble of lightweight planners that produces structurally diverse feasible candidates. From pairwise itinerary comparisons, Learn fits a compact Bradley-Terry reward model that captures emergent schedule properties such as pacing, geographic coherence, and day balance, which per-POI signals miss. Finally, Adapt applies feasibility-preserving local refinement within a device-aware compute budget; every intermediate state is feasible by construction. On 2,519 pairwise human comparisons across more than 100 U.S. cities, the reward-guided ensemble achieves a 67.8% win rate, 11.2 percentage points above the best single planner, with 100% feasibility. Three frontier LLMs, GPT-5, Claude Opus 4.5, and Gemini 3 Pro, achieve 0% feasibility under the same constraints. The reward model generalizes across held-out cities, with a 67.6% mean leave-one-city-out accuracy. In production deployment within FlyEnJoy, PLA increased itinerary completion rates by 91%, with 109.9 ms average on-device latency.
papers.abstract_cn: 个性化旅游行程的生成是一项复杂的规划任务，涉及到硬组合可行性和软潜在期望之间的紧张关系。经典优化强化了约束，但未能捕捉到旅行者的主观偏好。虽然基于学习的方法建模偏好，但它们不能保证可行性。移动部署对两者都施加了额外的资源限制。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了计划、学习、适应（PLA），这是一个用于个性化设备上行程生成的三阶段框架。计划阶段构建轻量级计划者的异构集合，产生结构多样化的可行候选。从两两行程比较来看，Learn符合紧凑的Bradley-Terry奖励模型，该模型捕获了紧急行程属性，如节奏、地理一致性和日平衡，这些都是每个poi信号的缺失。最后，Adapt在设备感知的计算预算中应用了保留可行性的局部优化。每个中间态都是可行的。在美国100多个城市进行的2519次双人比较中，奖励引导的组合达到了67.8%的胜率，比最佳单个规划师高出11.2个百分点，可行性为100%。三个前沿llm， GPT-5, Claude Opus 4.5和Gemini 3 Pro，在相同的约束下实现了0%的可行性。这个奖励模型适用于所有被封锁的城市，平均漏掉一个城市的准确率为67.6%。在FlyEnJoy的生产部署中，PLA将行程完成率提高了91%，平均设备上延迟为109.9毫秒。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses personalized on-device itinerary generation, where plans must satisfy hard combinatorial constraints while also capturing latent traveler preferences under tight mobile compute limits. PLA proposes a three-stage framework: a heterogeneous ensemble of lightweight planners generates diverse feasible candidates, a compact Bradley-Terry reward model learns schedule-level desirability from pairwise comparisons, and feasibility-preserving local refinement adapts outputs within a device-aware budget. The method achieves a 67.8% human-preference win rate with 100% feasibility—versus 0% feasibility for frontier LLMs under the same constraints—and improved production itinerary completion by 91% at 109.9 ms average on-device latency.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对个性化行程生成中“硬约束可行性”与“软偏好可取性”难以兼顾、且移动端资源受限的问题，提出 Plan-Learn-Adapt（PLA）端侧框架。其核心思路是先用轻量异构规划器集成生成多样且可行的候选行程，再通过成对比较训练紧凑的 Bradley-Terry 奖励模型捕捉节奏、地理连贯性和日程平衡等整体偏好，最后在设备算力预算内进行保持可行性的局部精调。实验显示，该方法在人工评测中以 67.8% 胜率超过最佳单一规划器 11.2 个百分点并保持 100% 可行性，而多个前沿大模型在相同约束下可行性为 0%；线上部署使行程完成率提升 91%，平均端侧延迟仅 109.9 ms。

papers.title: Cache-Aware Prompt Compression:A Two-Tier Cost Model for LLM API Caching
papers.authors: Yan Song
papers.abstract_en: Production LLM deployments combine two cost-reduction primitives: prompt caching (a discounted rate for re-used token prefixes) and prompt compression (fewer tokens sent). The compression literature has standardized on query-aware methods that produce a different compressed prefix per query, mechanically invalidating the prefix-strict cache on every call. We characterize this cost empirically on Anthropic's Sonnet 4.6 API and find caching is far from the rho=1.0 ideal the literature assumes: Sonnet's cache has a two-tier architecture with a sharp threshold near 3,500 tokens, below which the hit rate plateaus at rho~0.83 across 30-call sessions. Our cost model predicts, and experiments confirm, that under realistic rho, query-aware compression beats naive caching at high compression ratios (r>=6). We propose Cache-Aware Prompt Compression (CAPC), pairing query-agnostic compression with explicit cache_control plus a tier-preserving ratio bound that prevents over-compression from pushing the cached prefix into the hot tier. CAPC is the cheapest strategy in 16/16 configurations on LongBench-v2, with mean savings of 49% over cache-only, 64% over query-aware compression, and 90% over vanilla, at quality within 0.05 of the uncompressed baseline. We validate CAPC on three production workloads: an enterprise tool-using assistant with a 94k-token schema prefix (51.7% cost reduction at r=3); a graphify knowledge-graph RAG pipeline across two codebases (9.3x vs cache-all on FastAPI, 2.4x on httpx); and the public tau-bench retail benchmark (50 tasks), where CAPC is the cheapest of four strategies with reward exactly equal to vanilla (both 36/50, p=1.00) while query-aware compression is the most expensive at +40.1% over vanilla -- the first production confirmation of the crossover model's negative-ROI prediction on a public benchmark.
papers.abstract_cn: 生产LLM部署结合了两个降低成本的原语：提示缓存（重用令牌前缀的折扣率）和提示压缩（发送的令牌更少）。压缩文献已经对查询感知方法进行了标准化，这些方法每次查询都会产生不同的压缩前缀，从而在每次调用时机械地使前缀严格缓存失效。我们在Anthropic的Sonnet 4.6 API上对这一成本进行了经验表征，发现缓存远没有达到文献假设的rho=1.0理想值：Sonnet的缓存具有两层架构，其阈值接近3500个令牌，低于该阈值，30个调用会话的命中率稳定在rho~0.83。我们的成本模型预测，并且实验证实，在实际的rho下，在高压缩比（r>=6）下，查询感知的压缩优于单纯的缓存。我们提出了缓存感知提示压缩（CAPC），将查询无关压缩与显式cache_control结合起来，加上一个层保留比率绑定，以防止过度压缩将缓存的前缀推入热层。CAPC是LongBench-v2上16/16配置中最便宜的策略，平均比纯缓存节省49%，比查询感知压缩节省64%，比普通压缩节省90%，质量在未压缩基线的0.05以内。我们在三个生产工作负载上验证CAPC：具有94k令牌模式前缀的企业工具使用助手（r=3时成本降低51.7%）；跨两个代码库的图形化知识图RAG管道（FastAPI上9.3倍vs cache-all， httpx上2.4倍）；在公共的头台零售基准（50个任务）中，CAPC是四种策略中最便宜的，其回报与vanilla完全相等（均为36/50，p=1.00），而查询感知压缩是最昂贵的，比vanilla高出40.1%——这是交叉模型在公共基准上的负投资回报率预测的首次生产确认。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the cost inefficiency of combining LLM API prompt caching with query-aware prompt compression, showing that per-query compressed prefixes invalidate prefix caches and that real API caches exhibit a two-tier hit-rate structure rather than ideal reuse. It introduces a cost model and Cache-Aware Prompt Compression (CAPC), which uses query-agnostic compression, explicit `cache_control` markers, and a tier-preserving compression bound to keep cached prefixes in the high-hit tier. Experiments on LongBench-v2 and production workloads show CAPC is consistently cheapest, cutting costs by up to 90% versus vanilla while preserving quality, and confirming that query-aware compression can have negative ROI under realistic caching.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM API 中“查询感知提示压缩会破坏严格前缀缓存”这一问题，实测发现 Anthropic Sonnet 的缓存并非理想全命中，而是具有约 3,500 token 阈值的两层结构。作者提出两层成本模型与 CAPC 方法，通过查询无关压缩、显式 cache_control 和保持缓存层级的压缩比约束，使压缩与 API 缓存机制协同优化成本。实验显示 CAPC 在 LongBench-v2 及多个生产负载中均为最低成本策略，可大幅降本且质量基本无损，并验证了查询感知压缩在真实缓存条件下可能产生负收益。

papers.title: LLM-Driven AutoML for Cross-Lingual Handwritten OCR: Closed-Loop Neural Architecture Search with GPT-5, GPT-4o, and Claude Sonnet 4
papers.authors: Mobina Kashaniyan, Amirhossein Ghassemi, Nasser Mozayani
