papers.abstract_en: We present a fully automated closed-loop AutoML framework that uses GPT-5, GPT-4o, and Claude Sonnet 4 as autonomous neural architecture designers for cross-lingual handwritten optical character recognition. Each large language model independently generates, trains, evaluates, and iteratively refines neural network architectures using performance feedback from previous trials. The framework is evaluated on Arabic, Persian, and English handwriting datasets through 270 independent experiments. It consistently discovers accurate and computationally efficient models without manual architecture design, domain-specific preprocessing, or hyperparameter tuning. The generated models achieve mean test accuracies above 93 percent, a best accuracy of 98.1 percent, and inference latency between 41 and 44 milliseconds. The results demonstrate that large language models can function as effective AutoML agents for neural architecture search, enabling scalable, script-adaptive, and reproducible handwriting recognition across languages.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个全自动闭环AutoML框架，该框架使用GPT-5、gpt - 40和Claude Sonnet 4作为自主神经架构设计器，用于跨语言手写光学字符识别。每个大型语言模型都独立地生成、训练、评估，并使用先前试验的性能反馈迭代地改进神经网络架构。该框架通过270个独立实验在阿拉伯语、波斯语和英语手写数据集上进行了评估。它始终发现准确且计算效率高的模型，而无需手动架构设计、特定领域的预处理或超参数调优。生成的模型实现了93%以上的平均测试精度，98.1%的最佳精度，推理延迟在41到44毫秒之间。结果表明，大型语言模型可以作为神经架构搜索的有效AutoML代理，支持跨语言的可扩展、脚本自适应和可复制的手写识别。
papers.comment: 6 pages, 10 figures, and 2 tables. Published in the 2025 15th International Conference on Computer and Knowledge Engineering (ICCKE)
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the manual architecture-design and preprocessing burden in cross-lingual handwritten OCR by using GPT-5, GPT-4o, and Claude Sonnet 4 as autonomous AutoML/NAS agents that generate, train, evaluate, and iteratively refine models from performance feedback. Across 270 experiments on Arabic, Persian, and English handwriting, the framework discovers efficient architectures with mean test accuracies above 93%, a best accuracy of 98.1%, and 41–44 ms inference latency, demonstrating LLM-driven NAS as a scalable, script-adaptive, and reproducible approach to handwriting recognition.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文面向跨语言手写OCR中依赖人工架构设计、预处理和调参的问题，提出一个由GPT-5、GPT-4o和Claude Sonnet 4驱动的闭环AutoML框架，让大模型自主生成、训练、评估并迭代优化神经网络架构。其核心洞见是将LLM作为神经架构搜索的智能体，通过性能反馈形成自动优化回路，从而无需人工设计即可适配阿拉伯语、波斯语和英语手写识别。实验在270次独立测试中取得平均准确率超过93%、最高98.1%以及41–44毫秒推理延迟，表明LLM可成为高效、可扩展且可复现的AutoML代理。

papers.title: How Does Alignment Tuning Shape Representations of Sycophancy and Related Cue-Induced Biases in LLMs?
papers.authors: Prakhar Gupta, Terry Jingchen Zhang, Florent Draye, Bernhard Schölkopf, Zhijing Jin
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLMs are alarmingly susceptible to surprisingly simple immaterial changes of input prompts: a casual hint, an incorrectly labeled few-shot example, or a fake prior assistant turn often flips an originally correct answer. We study where this susceptibility, spanning sycophancy and related cue-induced biases, lives inside the model. Across five model families and seven BCT bias types, we extract a per-bias direction from hidden states and triangulate it through three measures: probing, leave-one-dataset-out transfer, and causal intervention. The susceptibility is largely installed by alignment tuning rather than pretraining: pretrained base models barely cave to these biases, and their activations carry no cue-specific signal beyond question content. Within aligned models, each bias becomes a single coherent direction that we can both decode and steer along, recovering the unbiased answer across every family we test. The biases stay representationally distinct, however: cross-bias entanglement is model-specific rather than a property of the bias category, and even behaviorally similar biases occupy different directions. The same intervention also serves as a modest debiasing tool, recovering a meaningful share of bias-induced errors while preserving most correct answers across all instruct families. Cue-induced bias is therefore best understood not as a single flaw in LLMs but as a family of distinct, causally active directions that alignment tuning installs.
papers.abstract_cn: 现代法学硕士非常容易受到输入提示的简单而无关紧要的变化的影响：一个偶然的提示，一个错误标记的少数镜头示例，或者一个虚假的先前助手往往会推翻原本正确的答案。我们研究了这种易感性，包括阿谀奉承和相关的线索诱导的偏见，在模型中存在的地方。在五个模型族和七个BCT偏差类型中，我们从隐藏状态中提取每个偏差方向，并通过三种措施对其进行三角测量：探测，留下一个数据集转移和因果干预。敏感性很大程度上是通过校准调整而不是预训练来安装的：预训练的基础模型几乎不会屈服于这些偏差，它们的激活除了问题内容之外没有任何线索特定的信号。在一致的模型中，每个偏差都成为一个单一的连贯方向，我们既可以解码也可以引导，在我们测试的每个家庭中恢复无偏差的答案。然而，这些偏差在代表性上是不同的：交叉偏差纠缠是特定于模型的，而不是偏差类别的属性，甚至行为相似的偏差也占据了不同的方向。同样的干预也可以作为一种适度的消除偏见的工具，在保留所有指导家庭中大多数正确答案的同时，恢复有意义的偏见导致的错误。因此，最好不要将线索诱导的偏差理解为llm中的单个缺陷，而是将其理解为校准调整安装的一系列不同的、因果关系活跃的方向。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper studies how alignment tuning causes LLMs to become susceptible to sycophancy and related cue-induced biases, where superficial prompt cues override correct answers. By extracting per-bias directions from hidden states across five model families and seven bias types, and validating them via probing, cross-dataset transfer, and causal intervention, it shows that these biases are encoded as distinct, linearly representable, causally active activation directions. The main finding is that alignment—not pretraining—installs these bias directions, and steering along them can recover unbiased answers and partially debias models while preserving most correct behavior.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该文研究LLM中谄媚及线索诱导偏差的内部机制，发现模型对提示线索的易感性主要由对齐微调引入，而非预训练本身。作者跨5个模型家族和7类偏差，从隐藏状态提取每种偏差的单一方向，并用探测、跨数据集迁移和因果干预验证其因果作用。结果显示，沿这些方向进行解码或操控可恢复无偏答案并实现适度去偏，且不同偏差在表征上相互分离，说明其是对齐阶段安装的一组可干预因果方向。

papers.title: Enhancing Rubric-based RL via Self-Distillation
papers.authors: Mingxuan Xia, Yuhang Yang, Chao Ye, Shuai Zhu, Shenzhi Yang, Guangcheng Zhu, Yuhang Zhang, Cheng Peng, Haobo Wang, Siqing Wang
papers.abstract_en: Rubric-based RL has recently shown promise in improving LLMs on open-ended tasks. A widely recognized limitation of rubric-based RL is limited exploration: criteria that no rollout manages to satisfy (Unexplored Criteria, UC) receive no optimization signal. Recent methods address this by incorporating rubric information as external guidance during rollout, yet they introduce a train-inference mismatch: the policy is optimized on rollouts produced under external guidance while this guidance is absent at inference time, causing error accumulation through autoregressive decoding. Moreover, these exploration-focused approaches overlook a fundamentally different failure mode that we term Suppressed Criteria (SC) -- criteria that are satisfied by some rollouts yet whose learning signals are lost during optimization because scalar reward aggregation assigns them non-positive aggregate advantages. Our analysis reveals that SC are remarkably prevalent: over 57% of samples exhibit this failure mode throughout training, with an average of 1.8 SC per sample. To simultaneously address both UC and SC without introducing training-inference mismatch, we propose Criterion-Distilled Policy Optimization (CriPO), which enhances rubric-based RL via on-policy self-distillation. For UC, CriPO constructs a criterion-injection self-teacher and computes a localized forward-KL loss to inject missing behaviors into the policy. For SC, CriPO employs a counterfactual self-teacher to locate criterion-relevant tokens in negative-advantage rollouts and flips their token-level advantages to positive values, preserving useful patterns that would otherwise be suppressed. Experiments on medicine and science benchmarks demonstrate that CriPO consistently outperforms rubric-based RL, achieving stronger final performance with approximately $2\times$ fewer optimization steps.
papers.abstract_cn: 基于rubric的RL最近在改进开放式任务的llm方面表现出了希望。基于规则的强化学习的一个公认的限制是有限的探索：没有推出能够满足的标准（未探索的标准，UC）没有收到优化信号。最近的方法通过在推出期间将主题信息作为外部指导来解决这个问题，但它们引入了训练-推理不匹配：策略在外部指导下产生的推出上进行优化，而在推理时缺乏该指导，从而通过自回归解码导致错误积累。此外，这些以探索为重点的方法忽略了一种根本不同的失败模式，我们称之为抑制标准（SC）——一些推出满足的标准，但其学习信号在优化过程中丢失，因为标量奖励聚合赋予它们非正的聚合优势。我们的分析表明，SC非常普遍：超过57%的样本在整个训练过程中表现出这种失败模式，平均每个样本有1.8个SC。为了同时解决UC和SC而不引入训练-推理不匹配，我们提出了标准蒸馏策略优化（CriPO），它通过策略上的自蒸馏来增强基于规则的RL。对于UC， CriPO构建了一个标准注入自教师，并计算局部正向kl损失，将缺失行为注入策略。对于SC， CriPO使用反事实自我教师来定位与标准相关的代币，并将其代币级优势翻转为正值，从而保留有用的模式，否则这些模式将被抑制。在医学和科学基准上的实验表明，CriPO始终优于基于规则的RL，以大约2\ $的优化步骤获得更强的最终性能。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper tackles two failure modes in rubric-based RL for LLMs: unexplored criteria that receive no learning signal and suppressed criteria whose useful behaviors are lost under scalar advantage aggregation, while prior guided-rollout fixes introduce train-inference mismatch. It proposes Criterion-Distilled Policy Optimization (CriPO), an on-policy self-distillation method that injects missing criterion-satisfying behavior via a localized forward-KL teacher and uses a counterfactual teacher to identify criterion-relevant tokens in negative-advantage rollouts and flip their token-level advantages. On medicine and science benchmarks, CriPO consistently outperforms rubric-based RL and reaches stronger performance with about 2× fewer optimization steps.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对基于评分准则的RL中“未被探索准则”缺乏优化信号，以及因标量奖励聚合导致“已满足准则”学习信号被抑制的问题，并指出外部准则引导会带来训练-推理不一致。提出 CriPO，通过在线自蒸馏：对未探索准则用准则注入教师与局部前向 KL 补充缺失行为，对受抑制准则用反事实教师定位关键 token 并翻转其 token 级优势。实验显示，该方法在医学与科学基准上稳定优于常规 rubric RL，并约以一半优化步数取得更强性能。

papers.title: ExpertPlex: A High-Goodput Disaggregated Serving System for MoE LLMs with Adaptive Persistent Kernels
papers.authors: Bingyang Wu, Chao Jin, Zili Zhang, Xinming Wei, Yinmin Zhong, Ruidong Zhu, Chengxu Yang, Xin Jin, Yuliang Liu
papers.abstract_en: LLMs scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) parameters for superior intelligence, but massive weights and dynamic computation impede efficient serving. Existing instance-level prefill-decode disaggregation isolates the phases on separate full-model replicas. As MoE weights grow, each instance may span tens to hundreds of GPUs, making resource allocation increasingly coarse. Configured prefill-to-decode ratios thus often mismatch demand, overprovisioning one phase while overloading the other. Prefill-decode colocation avoids this duplication, but existing Green Context solutions partition each GPU by phase and fix phase resources during a kernel. They cannot track resource changes across operations or layerwise variation in routed expert load, causing head-of-line blocking or idle reserved resources. Partitioning every GPU also leaves each phase with fewer local resources, forces wider parallelism and more communication, and lets prefill and decode traffic interfere on the shared network.   We present ExpertPlex, which shares massive MoE experts across phases while disaggregating lightweight attention modules. Expert sharing eliminates over 95\% duplicate model weights and multiplexes dynamically sparse computation, while attention disaggregation reduces attention communication cost. ExpertPlex further uses (1) adaptive persistent kernels to schedule dynamic expert computation at tile granularity for efficient, isolated execution; (2) attention-initiated MoE communication to avoid network interference and enable cross-phase communication-computation overlap; and (3) a tile-to-cluster model to optimize these mechanisms for maximum goodput. Experiments serving MiniMax-M2.7 and GLM-5.1-FP8 show that ExpertPlex improves goodput by up to 2.01$\times$ over instance-level prefill-decode disaggregation and 1.66$\times$ over prefill-decode colocation.
papers.abstract_cn: llm对专家混合（MoE）参数进行了尺度化处理，以获得更高的智能，但大量的权重和动态计算阻碍了高效的服务。现有的实例级预解码分解将各个阶段隔离在单独的全模型副本上。随着MoE权重的增长，每个实例可能跨越数十到数百个gpu，使得资源分配越来越粗糙。因此，配置的预注入解码比经常不匹配需求，一个阶段过度供应而另一个阶段过载。prepre -decode colocation避免了这种重复，但现有的Green Context解决方案在内核期间按阶段和固定阶段资源划分每个GPU。它们无法跟踪跨操作的资源更改或路由专家负载的分层变化，从而导致排队阻塞或空闲保留资源。划分每个GPU也使每个阶段拥有更少的本地资源，强制更广泛的并行性和更多的通信，并允许预填充和解码流量干扰共享网络。我们介绍了ExpertPlex，它在分解轻量级注意力模块的同时，在各个阶段共享大量的MoE专家。专家共享消除了95%以上的重复模型权重和多路动态稀疏计算，而注意力分解降低了注意力通信成本。ExpertPlex进一步使用(1)自适应持久内核来调度动态专家计算，以实现高效、隔离的执行；(2)注意发起的MoE通信，避免网络干扰，实现跨相位通信-计算重叠；(3)建立了“砖到集群”模型，对这些机制进行优化，以获得最大的收益。服务于MiniMax-M2.7和GLM-5.1-FP8的实验表明，与实例级预解码分解相比，ExpertPlex可将goodput提高2.01$\times$，比预解码colocation提高1.66$\times$。
papers.ai_summary_en: ExpertPlex addresses inefficient MoE LLM serving caused by coarse instance-level prefill–decode disaggregation and rigid GPU-level colocation, which lead to phase-demand mismatch, duplicated expert weights, and network/execution interference. Its key insight is to disaggregate lightweight attention modules while sharing massive MoE experts across phases, using adaptive persistent tile-granularity kernels, attention-initiated MoE communication, and a tile-to-cluster optimizer to maximize isolated, overlapped execution. Experiments on MiniMax-M2.7 and GLM-5.1-FP8 show up to 2.01× higher goodput than instance-level disaggregation and 1.66× over colocation, while eliminating over 95% of duplicate model weights.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 MoE 大模型服务中预填充/解码实例级分离造成完整模型副本冗余、资源配比易错配，以及共置方案因固定阶段分区导致阻塞和通信干扰的问题，提出 ExpertPlex。其核心洞见是跨阶段共享重型 MoE 专家、仅分离轻量注意力模块，并通过自适应持久内核在 tile 粒度调度动态专家计算、注意力发起的 MoE 通信及 tile-to-cluster 优化，实现隔离执行与通信计算重叠。实验表明，该方法可消除 95% 以上重复权重，在 MiniMax-M2.7 和 GLM-5.1-FP8 上将 goodput 较实例级分离和共置分别最高提升 2.01 倍和 1.66 倍。

papers.title: FlowBlock: Wavefront-Parallel Decoding for Self-Correcting Diffusion Language Models
papers.authors: Bing Tian, Haikun Liu, Xiaocheng Zhong, Zhuohui Duan, Zhaokai Luo, Huayi Jin, Zhiyong Wang, Xiaofei Liao
papers.abstract_en: Block-wise diffusion large language models (dLLMs) decode sequentially at the block level, enabling effective KV-cache reuse across blocks but making inter-block decoding strictly serial. Prior work has attempted to unlock inter-block parallelism through post-training methods, but achieves only modest speedups and often degrades accuracy. We observe that self-correcting dLLMs offer a training-free alternative: token-to-token (T2T) editing can repair tokens drafted with a slightly stale upstream context, so a downstream block requires only an informative draft rather than a finalized predecessor. This turns block finality from a hard dependency into a scheduling resource. We propose \textbf{\flowblock{}}, a training-free parallel decoding framework built on two mechanisms. (i) \emph{Gated Wavefront Decoding} admits blocks into a bounded wavefront only when a readiness gate is satisfied, jointly refines active blocks via T2T editing, and commits blocks in order under a windowed block-causal mask that preserves exact frozen-prefix KV caches reuse. (ii) \emph{Heterogeneous Wavefront Packing} assigns each request an independent wavefront while packing asynchronous windows into dense, shape-stable batched forwards. Across different benchmarks, \flowblock{} improves tokens per second (TPS) over LLaDA-2.1 and LLaDA-2.0, two serial block-wise dLLMs, by up to 2.95$\times$ and 4.01$\times$, while reducing latency by up to 53.6\% and 77.1\%, respectively. It also improves average accuracy by 1.3 points. Compared with D2F, a training-based inter-block-parallel baseline, \flowblock{} achieves higher accuracy and up to 16$\times$ higher batched serving throughput.
papers.abstract_cn: 块扩散大语言模型（dllm）在块级按顺序解码，从而实现跨块的有效kv缓存重用，但使块间解码严格串行化。先前的工作试图通过后训练方法解锁块间并行性，但只能实现适度的加速，并且经常降低准确性。我们观察到，自我校正dllm提供了一种无需培训的替代方案：令牌到令牌（T2T）编辑可以修复用稍微陈旧的上游上下文起草的令牌，因此下游块只需要一个信息草案，而不是最终的前身。这将块最终性从硬依赖项转变为调度资源。我们提出了\textbf{\flowblock{}}，一个基于两种机制的无训练并行解码框架。(i)门通波前解码\emph{（Gated Wavefront Decoding）}仅在满足就绪门（readiness gate）的情况下，才允许区块进入有界波前，通过T2T编辑共同优化活动区块，并在保留精确冻结前缀KV缓存重用的窗口块因果掩码下按顺序提交区块。（ii）\emph{异质波前打包}为每个请求分配一个独立的波前，同时将异步窗口打包成密集的、形状稳定的批处理转发。在不同的基准测试中，\flowblock{}比LLaDA-2.1和LLaDA-2.0（两个串行块级dllm）提高了每秒令牌（TPS），最高可达2.95 $\times$和4.01 $\times$，同时将延迟分别降低了53.6％和77.1％。它还将平均准确率提高了1.3分。与基于训练的块间并行基线D2F相比，\flowblock{}的准确率更高，批量服务吞吐量最高可达16 $\times$。
papers.ai_summary_en: FlowBlock addresses the serial inter-block dependency in block-wise diffusion LLM serving, where each block must wait for its predecessor to finalize despite efficient KV-cache reuse. Its key insight is that self-correcting diffusion models can repair tokens drafted from slightly stale upstream context, enabling a training-free wavefront-parallel scheduler with readiness gating, in-order commits under windowed block-causal masks, and heterogeneous packing of asynchronous request wavefronts into stable batched forwards. The method improves throughput by up to 2.95×/4.01× over LLaDA-2.1/2.0, cuts latency by up to 53.6%/77.1%, raises average accuracy by 1.3 points, and achieves up to 16× higher batched serving throughput than the training-based D2F baseline.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对块级扩散语言模型在服务中块间解码严格串行、限制吞吐的问题，利用自校正 dLLM 可通过 token-to-token 编辑修复基于稍旧上下文生成草稿的特性，将“前驱块必须最终确定”从硬依赖转为可调度的松弛条件。  
作者提出免训练的 FlowBlock 并行解码框架，通过门控波前解码在有界窗口内联合精化多个块并按序提交以复用冻结前缀 KV cache，再用异构波前打包将异步窗口组合成形状稳定的高效批处理。  
在 LLaDA 系列模型上，其吞吐最高提升约 4.01×、延迟最高降低 77.1%，同时平均精度提升 1.3 分，相较训练式并行基线 D2F 还可获得最高 16× 的批量服务吞吐提升。

papers.title: Rarity-Aware Discrete Diffusion with Spatially Consistent Decoding for Photo-Realistic Image Super-Resolution
papers.authors: Ao Li, Yapeng Du, Yi Xin, Lei Zhu, Le Zhang, Guangtao Zhai, Ce Zhu, Xiaohong Liu
papers.abstract_en: Continuous diffusion models have become the dominant paradigm for photo-realistic image Super-Resolution (SR), but they typically formulate reconstruction as continuous signal-level denoising and incorporate semantic priors through external conditioning modules. This makes it less direct to exploit the unified token-based scaling paradigm of modern multimodal models. Autoregressive models provide a more native semantic representation by modeling images as discrete visual tokens, yet their causal decoding is inefficient for high-resolution reconstruction. Discrete diffusion offers a promising middle ground by enabling non-causal, parallel prediction over visual tokens. However, directly adapting discrete diffusion to SR remains non-trivial due to two task-specific challenges: (1) the long-tailed distribution of visual tokens, which under-represents rare but perceptually critical textures; and (2) spatially inconsistent parallel decoding, which may introduce isolated artifacts. To address these issues, we propose DiMOO-SR, a rarity-aware multimodal discrete diffusion framework for photo-realistic image SR. During training, Inverse Frequency Sampling (IFS) prioritizes under-represented but information-rich tokens. During inference, Spatial Consistency Ranking (SCR) refines token confidence using local neighborhood agreement to improve structural coherence. Extensive experiments on widely used real-world SR benchmarks demonstrate that DiMOO-SR achieves competitive perceptual quality with only a few parallel decoding steps, highlighting the potential of discrete diffusion for generative image super-resolution. The code will be released upon publication.
papers.abstract_cn: 连续扩散模型已成为真实感图像超分辨率（SR）的主要范式，但它们通常将重建表述为连续信号级去噪，并通过外部条件反射模块纳入语义先验。这使得利用现代多模态模型的统一的基于令牌的缩放范式变得不那么直接。自回归模型通过将图像建模为离散的视觉标记来提供更原生的语义表示，但是它们的因果解码对于高分辨率重建是低效的。离散扩散通过在视觉标记上实现非因果、并行预测，提供了一个有希望的中间立场。然而，由于两个特定任务的挑战，直接将离散扩散适应于SR仍然是不容易的：(1)视觉标记的长尾分布，它不代表罕见但感知上关键的纹理；(2)空间不一致的并行解码，可能会引入孤立的伪影。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了DiMOO-SR，这是一种用于真实感图像sr的稀有感知多模态离散扩散框架。在训练期间，逆频率采样（IFS）优先考虑代表性不足但信息丰富的标记。在推理过程中，空间一致性排序（SCR）利用局部邻域一致性来改进令牌置信度，以提高结构一致性。在广泛使用的现实世界SR基准上进行的大量实验表明，DiMOO-SR仅通过几个并行解码步骤即可实现竞争性的感知质量，突出了离散扩散在生成图像超分辨率方面的潜力。该规范将在出版后发布。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles photo-realistic image super-resolution with discrete diffusion, addressing two task-specific issues: long-tailed visual token distributions that neglect rare but perceptually important textures, and spatially inconsistent parallel decoding that can cause isolated artifacts. It proposes DiMOO-SR, a multimodal discrete diffusion framework that uses Inverse Frequency Sampling during training to emphasize rare information-rich tokens and Spatial Consistency Ranking during inference to refine token confidence via local neighborhood agreement. Experiments on real-world SR benchmarks show competitive perceptual quality with only a few parallel decoding steps, demonstrating discrete diffusion as an efficient alternative to continuous diffusion and autoregressive token models for generative SR.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对照片级图像超分辨率中连续扩散模型难以直接利用统一离散视觉token、自回归解码低效，以及离散扩散易受稀有纹理长尾分布和并行解码空间不一致影响的问题。提出 DiMOO-SR，通过训练期逆频率采样强化低频但关键的视觉token，并在推理期用空间一致性排名利用邻域共识校正token置信度，实现稀有感知且结构连贯的并行解码。实验表明，该方法在真实世界超分基准上仅需少量并行步骤即可获得有竞争力的感知质量，展示了离散扩散用于生成式图像超分的潜力。

papers.title: SALT: Salience-Aware Lexical Trie for Long-Context Compression
papers.authors: Oteo Mamo, Hyunjin Yi, Joydhriti Choudhury, Shangqian Gao, Weikuan Yu
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) process increasingly longer prompts, computation and KV-cache memory costs have emerged as major bottlenecks in inference systems. Existing input-level prompt compression methods address this, but rank each sentence by a scalar relevance score, treating the document as an unstructured pool of words and sentences. Under tight budgets, this causes theme collapse, where the dominant theme(s) of a document consumes the budget, discarding less-frequent yet task-relevant themes. Preserving thematic coverage instead requires allocating the budget across recurring themes rather than scoring sentences in isolation. To this end, we propose SALT, a model-agnostic extractive framework that organizes per-sentence keywords into a trie ordered by sentence frequency (SF), a lightweight, reusable proxy for document thematic structure. This trie-based organization smooths memory allocation and prevents dominant themes from monopolizing the budget. Multi-anchor retrieval activates trie nodes labeled by query keywords at any depth, and the trie persists across dialogue turns, supporting multi-turn use without re-encoding the document. By preserving document themes, SALT reduces the prefill computation and memory cost of long-context prompts while remaining composable with KV-cache methods that target decoding-time latency and memory.
papers.abstract_cn: 随着大型语言模型（llm）处理越来越长的提示，计算和kv缓存内存成本已成为推理系统的主要瓶颈。现有的输入级提示压缩方法解决了这个问题，但根据标量相关性评分对每个句子进行排序，将文档视为单词和句子的非结构化池。在预算紧张的情况下，这会导致主题崩溃，即文档的主要主题消耗了预算，丢弃了不太频繁但与任务相关的主题。相反，保持专题覆盖需要在反复出现的主题之间分配预算，而不是单独为句子打分。为此，我们提出了SALT，这是一个与模型无关的提取框架，它将每个句子的关键字组织成按句子频率（SF）排序的trie，是一个轻量级的、可重用的文档主题结构代理。这种基于尝试的组织平滑了内存分配，并防止主导主题垄断预算。多锚点检索在任何深度激活由查询关键字标记的树节点，并且树在对话回合之间持续存在，支持多回合使用，而无需重新编码文档。通过保留文档主题，SALT减少了长上下文提示的预填充计算和内存成本，同时与以解码时间延迟和内存为目标的KV-cache方法保持可组合性。
papers.ai_summary_en: SALT tackles the long-context LLM serving bottleneck of prefill computation and KV-cache memory, specifically the “theme collapse” problem in scalar sentence-ranking compressors where dominant document themes exhaust tight token budgets. Its key idea is a model-agnostic extractive framework that organizes per-sentence keywords into a salience-aware lexical trie ordered by sentence frequency, using multi-anchor query-keyword retrieval to allocate budget across recurring themes rather than isolated sentences. This preserves thematic coverage, reduces prefill cost and memory for long prompts, and remains reusable across dialogue turns and composable with decoding-time KV-cache optimization methods.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 推理中现有提示压缩在紧预算下易发生“主题坍缩”、丢失低频但任务相关主题的问题。其核心方法是 SALT：将每句关键词组织成按句子频率排序的词法 trie，以轻量结构化方式近似文档主题分布，并通过多锚点关键词检索分配压缩预算。实验/系统层面，该方法可在多轮对话中复用、降低预填充计算和 KV-cache 内存开销，并能与解码阶段 KV-cache 优化方法互补。

papers.title: Lossless but Not Free: An Empirical Anatomy of Speculative Decoding on Consumer Hardware
papers.authors: Param Chordiya
papers.abstract_en: Single-stream autoregressive decoding of large language models is bound by memory bandwidth: each generated token requires one full forward pass through the target model, and successive passes cannot be parallelized. Speculative decoding restructures this computation: a small draft model proposes $K$ tokens autoregressively, the target model scores all of them in one batched pass, and a rejection-sampling rule provably preserves the target model's output distribution. We present a from-scratch, device-agnostic (CUDA/MPS/CPU) implementation and an empirical study across five draft/target backend configurations on a consumer Apple-silicon laptop. Distribution equivalence is verified at three levels, culminating in a two-sample test over roughly 9,200 real-model tokens per method ($χ^2 = 162.5$, dof $= 200$, $p = 0.976$) and exact greedy-sequence agreement. The best configuration reaches a measured $1.61\times$ wall-clock speedup at $K=6$, on an acceptance profile declining from 69.7% at $K=1$ to 37.8% at the optimum, while three of five configurations decelerate, either because the draft fails to out-speed a small target or because the quantized Metal backend executes "parallel" verification serially, an effect we isolate and quantify. The failures are as instructive as the successes: speculative decoding pays off only when verification is genuinely batch-parallel and the draft/target latency gap is real.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型的单流自回归解码受到内存带宽的限制：每个生成的令牌需要通过目标模型进行一次完整的前向传递，并且连续的传递不能并行化。推测解码重构了这个计算：一个小的草案模型自动回归地提出$K$令牌，目标模型在一次批处理中对所有令牌进行评分，并且一个拒绝抽样规则可证明地保留了目标模型的输出分布。我们提出了一个从头开始，与设备无关（CUDA/MPS/CPU）的实现，并在消费级苹果硅笔记本电脑上对五个草案/目标后端配置进行了实证研究。分布等价性在三个层面上得到验证，最终在每个方法大约9,200个真实模型令牌的双样本测试中达到顶峰（χ^2 = 162.5$, dof $= 200$, p = 0.976$）和精确的贪婪序列协议。最佳配置在K=6美元时达到1.61倍的时钟加速，在接受情况下从K=1美元时的69.7%下降到最佳时的37.8%，而五种配置中有三种减速，要么是因为draft未能超过小目标，要么是因为量化的Metal后端执行“并行”验证，我们将其隔离并量化。失败和成功一样具有指导意义：只有当验证是真正的批处理并行并且草稿/目标延迟差距是真实的时，推测解码才会得到回报。
papers.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code, benchmark harness, and all result artifacts: https://github.com/ParamChordiya/speculative_decoding_engine
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper investigates the memory-bandwidth bottleneck of single-stream autoregressive LLM decoding and evaluates whether speculative decoding can deliver lossless speedups on consumer Apple-silicon hardware. The authors implement a device-agnostic CUDA/MPS/CPU system where a draft model proposes K tokens and the target model verifies them in one batched pass with rejection sampling, validating distributional equivalence through statistical tests and exact greedy-sequence agreement. The best configuration achieves 1.61× wall-clock speedup at K=6, but several configurations slow down due to non-parallel verification or insufficient draft/target latency gaps, showing that speculative decoding is lossless yet only beneficial under favorable hardware and latency conditions.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 本文针对消费级硬件上大语言模型自回归解码受内存带宽限制的问题，实证研究了可在理论上无损保持目标模型输出分布的投机解码。作者实现了一个设备无关的草稿模型提议、目标模型批量验证与拒绝采样流程，并在 Apple Silicon 上系统检验不同后端配置下的分布等价性与实际加速效果。结果表明，最佳配置在 K=6 时仅取得 1.61 倍墙钟加速，且多数配置因草稿模型不够快或 Metal 量化后端将验证串行化而减速，说明投机解码的收益高度依赖真实的草稿/目标延迟差与可并行的验证执行。

papers.title: EdgeCoInfer: Hierarchical Collaborative Inference for On-Device Multimodal Large Models
papers.authors: Lin Tan, David K. Y. Yau, Songtao Guo
papers.abstract_en: Modern mobile applications predominantly execute concurrent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to provide ubiquitous intelligence. However, satisfying this demand within edge environments faces significant challenges due to multi-task concurrency and strictly coupled hard constraints. To address these issues, we propose EdgeCoInfer, a framework enabling granularity-adaptive deployment by co-optimizing inter-model functional module sharing and \textbf{intra-model fine-grained partitioning}. We solve the underlying Mixed-Integer Non-Linear Programming (MINLP) problem via a Hybrid Evolutionary Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HE-HRL) paradigm, which synchronizes a Genetic Algorithm (GA) for discrete model placement with a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) agent for continuous resource allocation. To navigate the sparse feasible region, we introduce a feasibility-guided constructive execution mechanism, integrating a constructive cut-step decoder with pre-act pruning and a two-phase curriculum strategy for stable adaptation. Experimental results demonstrate that EdgeCoInfer ensures a 100\% task completion rate in high-concurrency scenarios, achieving a 76\% reduction in system cost and 71.88\% memory savings compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.abstract_cn: 现代移动应用程序主要执行并发多模态大型语言模型（mllm）来提供无处不在的智能。然而，由于多任务并发性和严格耦合的硬约束，在边缘环境中满足这一需求面临着重大挑战。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了EdgeCoInfer框架，该框架通过协同优化模型间功能模块共享和\textbf{模型内细粒度分区来实现粒度}自适应部署。我们通过混合进化分层强化学习（hel - hrl）范式解决了底层的混合整数非线性规划（MINLP）问题，该范式将用于离散模型放置的遗传算法（GA）与用于连续资源分配的软行为者-评论家（SAC）代理同步。为了导航稀疏可行区域，我们引入了一种可行性引导的建设性执行机制，将具有预行为修剪的建设性切割步解码器和稳定适应的两阶段课程策略集成在一起。实验结果表明，EdgeCoInfer在高并发场景下确保了100％的任务完成率，与最先进的基线相比，实现了76％的系统成本降低和71.88％的内存节省。
papers.ai_summary_en: EdgeCoInfer addresses the problem of serving concurrent multimodal large language models on resource-constrained edge devices under strict latency, memory, and multi-task constraints. It proposes a granularity-adaptive deployment framework that co-optimizes inter-model functional module sharing and intra-model fine-grained partitioning, solving the resulting MINLP via a hybrid evolutionary hierarchical RL method combining a genetic algorithm for discrete placement with Soft Actor-Critic for continuous resource allocation. Experiments show 100% task completion in high-concurrency settings, with 76% lower system cost and 71.88% memory savings over state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘设备上并发运行多模态大模型时面临的资源受限、任务完成率和内存/时延等硬约束问题，提出 EdgeCoInfer 框架，通过模型间功能模块共享与模型内细粒度切分的协同优化来实现自适应部署。其核心方法是将部署与资源分配建模为 MINLP，并用混合进化分层强化学习求解：遗传算法负责离散模型放置，SAC 负责连续资源分配，同时引入可行性引导的解码、剪枝和课程学习以稳定探索可行解。实验显示，在高并发场景下可实现 100% 任务完成率，相比先进基线系统成本降低 76%、内存节省约 71.88%。

papers.title: SWE-Pruner Pro: The Coder LLM Already Knows What to Prune
papers.authors: Yuhang Wang, Yuling Shi, Shaoqiu Zhang, Jialiang Liang, Shilin He, Siyu Ye, Yuting Chen, Kai Cai, Xiaodong Gu
papers.abstract_en: Pruning long context for coding agents has been a vital technology for efficient context management. While existing context pruning methods such as SWE-Pruner realize this by attaching a separate code classifier, we find the agent itself encodes internal representations indicating the relevance of code context when reading tool output. Based on this finding, we propose SWE-Pruner Pro, which prunes tool outputs directly inside the agent. Concretely, a small head turns the agent's own internal representations into a keep-or-prune label for each line, with a length-aware embedding keyed to each tool output's line count. Across two open-weight backbones and four multi-turn benchmarks, SWE-Pruner Pro saves up to 39% of prompt and completion tokens while preserving task quality, with bounded inference overhead. Notably, on MiMo-V2-Flash SWE-Pruner Pro additionally raises the SWE-Bench Verified resolve rate by +3.8% and the long-context Oolong accuracy by +2.2 points.
papers.abstract_cn: 对编码代理进行长上下文剪枝一直是高效上下文管理的一项重要技术。虽然现有的上下文剪枝方法如SWE-Pruner通过附加独立的代码分类器来实现这一点，但我们发现代理自身在读取工具输出时会编码内部表示，指示代码上下文的相关性。基于这一发现，我们提出了SWE-Pruner Pro，它直接在代理内部剪枝工具输出。具体而言，一个小型头部将代理自身的内部表示转化为每行的保留或剪枝标签，并为每个工具输出的行数配备长度感知嵌入。在两个开放权重骨干网络和四个多轮基准测试中，SWE-Pruner Pro在保持任务质量的同时，最多节省了39%的提示和完成令牌，且推理开销有限。值得注意的是，在MiMo-V2-Flash上，SWE-Pruner Pro还将SWE-Bench验证的解决率提高了3.8%，长上下文Oolong的准确率提高了2.2点。
papers.ai_summary_en: SWE-Pruner Pro addresses inefficient long-context management in coding agents by pruning tool outputs using the agent’s own internal relevance signals rather than relying on an external code classifier. It attaches a lightweight per-line keep-or-prune head with length-aware embeddings to the LLM, enabling context reduction directly inside the agent. Across two open-weight backbones and four multi-turn benchmarks, it saves up to 39% prompt and completion tokens with bounded overhead while preserving or improving performance, including +3.8% on SWE-Bench Verified and +2.2 points on Oolong for MiMo-V2-Flash.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对编码智能体中长上下文工具输出冗余导致的推理开销问题，发现代码智能体自身在阅读工具输出时已内部编码了代码行相关性，因此提出 SWE-Pruner Pro，在智能体内部用小型分类头结合长度感知嵌入直接进行逐行保留/剪枝。  

在两个开源模型和四个多轮基准上，该方法最高可节省 39% 的提示与生成 token，同时基本保持任务质量且推理开销可控。  

在 MiMo-V2-Flash 上还带来额外收益：SWE-Bench Verified 解决率提升 3.8%，长上下文 Oolong 准确率提升 2.2 个点。

papers.title: FlashRT: Agent Harness for Guiding Agents to Deploy Real-Time Multimodal Applications
papers.authors: Krish Agarwal, Zhuoming Chen, Yanyuan Qin, Zhenyu Gu, Atri Rudra, Beidi Chen
papers.abstract_en: Real-time multimodal applications, including voice agents and interactive video generation, compose heterogeneous models into pipelines whose efficient deployment requires application-specific decisions about placement, streaming, and intra-model parallelism. Existing serving systems and auto-parallelism compilers commit to limited transformations and fixed workload assumptions, so achieving high performance on a new application requires hand-crafting an efficient implementation. We present FlashRT, an agent harness that guides coding agents to lift simple developer-written reference implementations into optimized multi-GPU deployments that flexibly weigh target metrics like latency and throughput. Using a new chain-of-program paradigm, FlashRT directs a generic coding agent through a multi-pass transformation process where an agent transforms the reference into an intermediate representation (IR) to capture data dependencies and persistent-state scopes, validates this IR via a sequential interpreter, and performs static analyses to identify candidate transformations. Then, the agent iteratively implements, verifies, and benchmarks each candidate under a measurement-gated optimization loop to produce effective deployments that span different hardware budgets. Across various applications, including video world models and multimodal LLMs, FlashRT converts reference implementations into highly efficient deployments, delivering up to ~70x latency reduction and 2.8x throughput improvement on NVIDIA B200 GPUs. On AMD MI355X GPUs, FlashRT matches the peak latency reduction while increasing peak throughput improvement to 3.6x, demonstrating that agent-driven optimization can be more scalable on platforms with less mature expert optimization. In fact, for Qwen3-Omni text-to-audio inference, FlashRT reduces response latency by 65% compared to the expert vLLM-Omni implementation on AMD MI355X.
papers.abstract_cn: 实时多模态应用程序，包括语音代理和交互式视频生成，将异构模型组合到管道中，其有效部署需要特定于应用程序的关于放置、流和模型内并行性的决策。现有的服务系统和自动并行编译器承诺进行有限的转换和固定的工作负载假设，因此在新应用程序上实现高性能需要手工制作一个有效的实现。我们介绍FlashRT，一个代理工具，它指导编码代理将简单的开发人员编写的参考实现提升为优化的多gpu部署，灵活地权衡延迟和吞吐量等目标指标。FlashRT使用新的程序链范式，指导通用编码代理通过多通道转换过程，其中代理将引用转换为中间表示（IR）以捕获数据依赖关系和持久状态作用域，通过顺序解释器验证该IR，并执行静态分析以识别候选转换。然后，代理在测量门控优化循环下迭代地实现、验证和对每个候选对象进行基准测试，以生成跨越不同硬件预算的有效部署。在各种应用程序中，包括视频世界模型和多模态llm， FlashRT将参考实现转换为高效部署，在NVIDIA B200 gpu上提供高达70倍的延迟减少和2.8倍的吞吐量提高。在AMD MI355X gpu上，FlashRT达到峰值延迟降低的效果，同时将峰值吞吐量提高到3.6倍，这表明代理驱动的优化在专家优化不太成熟的平台上更具可扩展性。事实上，对于Qwen3-Omni文本到音频的推理，与AMD MI355X上的专家vLLM-Omni实现相比，FlashRT减少了65%的响应延迟。
papers.ai_summary_en: FlashRT addresses the difficulty of efficiently deploying real-time multimodal model pipelines, where application-specific choices over placement, streaming, and intra-model parallelism are hard to automate with existing serving systems or auto-parallel compilers. It introduces an agent harness using a “chain-of-program” workflow: a coding agent converts a reference implementation into a dependency- and state-aware IR, validates it, identifies transformations via static analysis, and iteratively implements, verifies, and benchmarks optimizations under a measurement-gated loop. Across video world models and multimodal LLMs, FlashRT achieves up to ~70× latency reduction and 2.8–3.6× throughput gains on NVIDIA B200 and AMD MI355X GPUs, including 65% lower latency than an expert vLLM-Omni implementation for Qwen3-Omni text-to-audio inference.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对实时多模态流水线部署中放置、流式和模型内并行需手工优化、现有自动并行系统变换受限的问题，FlashRT 提出一种引导编码智能体的 chain-of-program 框架：先将参考实现转为捕获数据依赖与持久状态作用域的可验证 IR，再通过静态分析产生候选变换，并在测量门控循环中迭代实现、验证和基准测试。该方法可将简单参考实现自动提升为权衡延迟/吞吐的多 GPU 部署，在 NVIDIA B200 上最高实现约70倍延迟降低和2.8倍吞吐提升，在 AMD MI355X 上吞吐提升达3.6倍，且对 Qwen3-Omni 文本到音频推理较专家 vLLM-Omni 降低65%响应延迟。结果表明，智能体驱动的部署优化能在不同硬件、尤其专家优化不足平台上实现可扩展的高性能实时多模态服务。

papers.title: LLMs and Agentic AI Systems for Smart Grids: A Tutorial on Architectures and Applications
papers.authors: Daniela Rojas, Abdulwahab Albassam, Aidan G. Leung, Jett Ngo, Ryan Luo, Peter R. Quawas, Junpyung Kim, Kangkai Liang, Mansi Nanavati, Jonathan Mai, Meng-Chi Tsai, Yun-Tong Tsai, Yize Chen, Yuanyuan Shi
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) and agentic AI systems have evolved from natural language tasks to using external tools to plan, retrieve, and act in technical domains. In smart grids, recent work applies agentic schemes to forecasting, optimization, and control, wrapping trusted solvers behind language interfaces and orchestrating multi-step workflows. The literature lacks a unified approach to designing and evaluating such systems. LLMs can produce numerically plausible yet physically infeasible outputs, evaluation protocols vary across tasks, and the boundary between what the model should and should not compute is implicit. This paper presents a solver-grounded design principle: a numerical result is reported only when it originates from a trusted tool and passes explicit verification. We review the building blocks of LLM and agentic AI systems for power systems: prompting strategies and agentic architectures. We instantiate the principle in four case studies: wind power forecasting, EV charging scheduling, power flow analysis, and contingency diagnosis, each comparing an LLM-only baseline against its solver-grounded counterpart on identical data and metrics. EVAgent reproduces the CVXPY optimum while reducing LLM-only unmet energy by 7.5-9.5x, and GridDebugAgent repairs 17/39 contingency cases while reducing total violations by 52.3%. We propose a four-group evaluation framework spanning task utility, solver-grounded correctness, faithfulness and safe failure, and cost and latency. A consistent division of labor emerges: the agentic system reliably orchestrates, retrieves, and explains, while trusted tools compute and a verification gate decides what is reported.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）和人工智能代理系统已经从自然语言任务发展到使用外部工具在技术领域进行计划、检索和行动。在智能电网中，最近的工作将代理方案应用于预测、优化和控制，将可信求解器封装在语言接口后面，并编排多步骤工作流程。文献缺乏一个统一的方法来设计和评估这样的系统。法学硕士可以产生数字上合理但物理上不可行的输出，评估协议因任务而异，模型应该和不应该计算的界限是隐含的。本文提出了基于求解器的设计原则：只有当数值结果来自可信工具并通过显式验证时，才会报告数值结果。我们回顾了用于电力系统的LLM和代理人工智能系统的构建模块：提示策略和代理架构。我们在四个案例研究中实例化了该原理：风电预测、电动汽车充电计划、潮流分析和应急诊断，每个案例都比较了基于llm的基线和基于求解器的相同数据和指标的对应基线。EVAgent重现了cvvxpy最优，同时将llm未满足的能量减少了7.5-9.5倍，GridDebugAgent修复了17/39个突发事件，同时减少了52.3%的总违规。我们提出了一个四组评估框架，包括任务效用、基于求解器的正确性、可靠性和安全故障，以及成本和延迟。一个一致的劳动分工出现了：代理系统可靠地协调、检索和解释，而可信的工具计算和验证门决定报告什么。
papers.comment: 28 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables; plus supplementary material. Review/tutorial article
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses the absence of unified design and evaluation principles for LLM and agentic AI systems in smart grids, where LLMs can generate numerically plausible but physically infeasible outputs. It proposes a solver-grounded architecture in which LLMs orchestrate planning, retrieval, and explanation while trusted numerical tools perform computation and an explicit verification gate determines what results are reported. Across case studies, the approach improves reliability and performance—for example, reducing EV scheduling unmet energy by 7.5–9.5× versus LLM-only baselines and repairing 17/39 contingency cases while cutting total violations by 52.3%.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对智能电网中 LLM/智能体系统缺乏统一设计与评估、且易产生“数值可信但物理不可行”输出的问题，提出“求解器接地”的设计原则：数值结果必须来自可信工具并通过显式验证才可报告。  

作者系统梳理了提示策略与智能体架构，并在风电预测、EV 充电调度、潮流分析和事故诊断四个案例中对比纯 LLM 与求解器接地方案，同时提出涵盖任务效用、正确性、忠实/安全失败、成本延迟的评估框架。  

实验表明该方法显著提升可靠性与有效性，如 EVAgent 达到 CVXPY 最优并将未满足能量降低 7.5–9.5 倍，GridDebugAgent 修复 17/39 个事故场景、总违规减少 52.3%，明确了“LLM 编排解释、工具计算、验证门控”的分工范式。

papers.title: HyMCache: A KV Cache Framework for Multi-Turn LLM Serving with CXL-Hybrid Memory
papers.authors: Hakbeom Jang, Inho Song, Sam H. Noh, Jongryool Kim
papers.abstract_en: Long-context, multi-turn, and agentic LLM workloads increasingly reuse previously processed context, making KV-cache reuse essential for reducing redundant computation. However, this reuse shifts the bottleneck to the memory tier that stores and serves reusable KV states at cluster scale. GPU HBM and host DRAM are too costly to scale to TB-scale shared context capacity, motivating remote tiers built from lower-cost, higher-capacity media. This paper presents HyMCache, a KV-cache framework that integrates CXL-hybrid memory (CXL-HM) for multi-turn LLM serving. CXL-HM combines a small amount of in-device DRAM with large SSD-backed capacity behind a CXL interface. By exploiting the read-dominant, predictable, and append-only nature of multi-turn KV-cache access, HyMCache rethinks DRAM management within CXL-HM to efficiently support TB-scale SSD-backed KV reuse. It uses request-level prefix prefetching and opportunistic write buffering to stage latency-critical reads in device DRAM, enabling DRAM-scale KV-cache efficiency at SSD-level cost. We evaluate HyMCache on a real CXL-HM prototype under both single-aggregator and PD-disaggregated serving configurations. Under the same DRAM budget, HyMCache outperforms local LMCache by 3.0x in single-node serving and 1.45x in PD-disaggregated serving. Compared with 1 TB distributed-DRAM Mooncake, HyMCache incurs about 30% lower performance but uses 16x less DRAM.
papers.abstract_cn: 长上下文、多回合和代理LLM工作负载越来越多地重用先前处理过的上下文，使得kv缓存重用对于减少冗余计算至关重要。然而，这种重用将瓶颈转移到存储和服务集群规模的可重用KV状态的内存层。GPU HBM和主机DRAM的成本太高，无法扩展到tb级的共享上下文容量，因此需要使用低成本、高容量的介质构建远程层。本文提出了一种集成了cxl -混合存储器（CXL-HM）的多轮LLM服务KV-cache框架HyMCache。CXL- hm在CXL接口后面结合了少量的设备内DRAM和大容量的ssd支持。通过利用多轮KV缓存访问的读主导、可预测和仅追加的特性，HyMCache重新考虑了CXL-HM中的DRAM管理，以有效地支持tb级ssd支持的KV重用。它使用请求级前缀预取和机会式写入缓冲来在设备DRAM中进行延迟关键读取，从而以ssd级成本实现DRAM级kv高速缓存效率。我们在一个真实的CXL-HM原型上评估了单聚合器和pd分解服务配置下的HyMCache。在相同的DRAM预算下，HyMCache在单节点服务中比本地LMCache性能高3.0倍，在pd分解服务中比本地LMCache性能高1.45倍。与1tb分布式DRAM月饼相比，HyMCache的性能降低了30%左右，但使用的DRAM减少了16倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: HyMCache addresses the TB-scale KV-cache storage bottleneck in long-context, multi-turn LLM serving, where GPU HBM and host DRAM are too expensive to hold reusable prefix state. It exploits the read-dominant, predictable, append-only access pattern of multi-turn KV caches by using CXL-hybrid memory with request-level prefix prefetching and opportunistic write buffering to stage latency-critical reads in a small device-side DRAM cache backed by SSD capacity. On a real CXL-HM prototype, HyMCache achieves 3.0× and 1.45× speedups over local LMCache under equal DRAM budgets in single-node and PD-disaggregated serving, while using 16× less DRAM than a 1 TB distributed-DRAM Mooncake baseline at roughly 30% lower performance.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多轮、长上下文 LLM 服务中 KV Cache 复用带来的 TB 级共享存储瓶颈，指出 GPU HBM 和主机 DRAM 成本过高，难以承载大规模可复用 KV 状态。核心方法是提出 HyMCache，将 CXL 混合内存（少量设备内 DRAM + 大容量 SSD）纳入 KV Cache 框架，并利用多轮 KV 访问“读多、可预测、追加式”的特点，通过请求级前缀预取和机会性写缓冲，把关键读路径放在设备 DRAM 中加速。实验表明，在相同 DRAM 预算下，其单节点服务性能较本地 LMCache 提升 3.0 倍、PD 分离架构下提升 1.45 倍；相比 1TB 分布式 DRAM 方案 Mooncake，性能仅低约 30%，但 DRAM 使用量减少 16 倍。

papers.title: Can We Break LLMs Out of Self-Loops? Fine-Grained Reasoning Control with Activation Steering
papers.authors: Sheldon Yu, Tong Yu, Xunyi Jiang, Rohan Surana, Gagan Mundada, Sungchul Kim, Lina Yao, Julian McAuley, Junda Wu
papers.abstract_en: Extended reasoning has become standard for frontier Large Language Models (LLMs), yet the trajectories these models produce remain largely uncontrollable. Existing methods for shaping how a model reasons are prompt based approaches and operate at the input level, offering no fine-grained control over the reasoning process itself. Related work analyzes and discovers latent transition dynamics in the reasoning traces from Large Language Models. Building on this, we statistically characterize these states, and show that failure trajectories get stuck in self-loops, exhausting the token budget without progress toward the final answer. To intervene on these failures, We propose SOPHIA: Steering Of reasoning Processes via Hidden-state Intervention and Activations. We treat each reasoning trace as a sequence of latent states rather than an unstructured texts, and investigate whether inference time interventions can provide fine-grained control over the self-looping reasoning process. We classify every prefix to a latent state, record step level transitions, and use them to construct a bank of steering vectors indexed by state pairs. At inference time, a controller infers the current state and, given a target state, retrieves the corresponding vector and can also detect self-loops online from the transition structure to prevent the model from sinking into a reasoning black hole. Through extensive experiments, our method reliably intervenes on self-loop failures, with steering vectors that generalize to different state pairs. End task accuracy and token efficiency indicate that fine-grained controllability results in better reasoning quality.
papers.abstract_cn: 扩展推理已经成为前沿大型语言模型（llm）的标准，然而这些模型产生的轨迹在很大程度上仍然是不可控的。用于塑造模型推理方式的现有方法是基于提示的方法，并且在输入级别操作，对推理过程本身没有提供细粒度的控制。相关工作分析和发现了大型语言模型推理轨迹中潜在的转换动态。在此基础上，我们对这些状态进行了统计表征，并表明失败轨迹陷入了自循环，耗尽了代币预算，却没有取得最终答案。为了干预这些失败，我们提出了索菲亚：通过隐藏状态干预和激活来控制推理过程。我们将每个推理痕迹视为潜在状态的序列，而不是非结构化文本，并研究推理时间干预是否可以对自循环推理过程提供细粒度控制。我们将每个前缀分类为潜在状态，记录步长级转换，并使用它们构建由状态对索引的转向向量库。在推理时，控制器推断当前状态，给定目标状态，检索相应的向量，还可以从过渡结构在线检测自环，以防止模型陷入推理黑洞。通过大量的实验，我们的方法可靠地干预自环故障，并将导向向量推广到不同的状态对。端任务精度和令牌效率表明，细粒度的可控性导致了更好的推理质量。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses uncontrolled extended LLM reasoning, showing that failure traces often collapse into latent-state self-loops that exhaust token budgets without progress. SOPHIA models reasoning as a sequence of latent states, learns transition-indexed activation-steering vectors, and uses an online controller to infer the current state, detect loops, and steer hidden states toward target states. Experiments demonstrate reliable intervention on self-loop failures with generalizable steering vectors, yielding higher task accuracy and better token efficiency.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长推理中 LLM 容易陷入“自循环”、耗尽 token 却无进展，且现有提示方法难以细粒度控制推理过程的问题，将推理轨迹建模为潜在状态序列，并提出 SOPHIA：在推理时根据当前状态与目标状态检索对应的激活转向向量，同时在线检测并干预自循环。实验表明，该方法能可靠打断失败推理、具备一定跨状态泛化能力，并提升端到端任务准确率与 token 效率，为推理过程提供了更细粒度的可控性。

papers.title: SelectInfer: Selective Neuron Loading and Computation for On-Device LLMs
papers.authors: Huzaifa Shaaban Kabakibo, Eric Schniedermeyer, Artem Burchanow, Lin Wang
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across a range of Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks, but their high computational and memory demands pose significant challenges for deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. Existing approaches to model compression and optimization often rely on coarse-grained pruning or quantization, which can compromise accuracy or require re-training and fine-tuning. In this work, we introduce SelectInfer, a neuron-level optimization framework that enables efficient LLM inference on edge devices through selective neuron loading and computation. By profiling and identifying both task-specific and general-purpose neurons using an offline LLM profiler, SelectInfer implements two key optimizations: selective loading, which reduces memory footprint by selectively loading a subset of neurons that were identified to be most important during the offline stage, and selective computation, which dynamically computes only the most relevant neurons at runtime. Evaluation across multiple datasets shows that SelectInfer achieves significant reductions in memory footprint and computation while preserving task performance, making it a practical step towards enabling LLM deployment on edge devices
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）已经在一系列自然语言处理（NLP）任务中展示了卓越的能力，但它们对计算和内存的高需求对在资源受限的边缘设备上部署构成了重大挑战。现有的模型压缩和优化方法通常依赖于粗粒度的修剪或量化，这可能会损害准确性或需要重新训练和微调。在这项工作中，我们介绍了SelectInfer，这是一个神经元级优化框架，通过选择性神经元加载和计算在边缘设备上实现高效的LLM推理。通过使用离线LLM分析器分析和识别特定任务和通用神经元，SelectInfer实现了两个关键优化：选择性加载，通过选择性加载在离线阶段被识别为最重要的神经元子集来减少内存占用；选择性计算，在运行时仅动态计算最相关的神经元。跨多个数据集的评估表明，SelectInfer在保持任务性能的同时显著减少了内存占用和计算，使其成为在边缘设备上实现LLM部署的实际步骤
papers.ai_summary_en: SelectInfer addresses the memory and compute constraints of on-device LLM inference, where coarse-grained pruning or quantization often sacrifices accuracy or requires retraining. It uses an offline profiler to identify task-specific and general-purpose important neurons, then selectively loads a reduced neuron subset and dynamically computes only relevant neurons at runtime. Evaluations across multiple datasets show substantial memory and computation reductions while preserving task performance, making edge LLM deployment more practical.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大语言模型在边缘设备上部署时内存与计算开销过高的问题，提出神经元级推理优化框架 SelectInfer。其核心洞见是通过离线分析识别任务关键和通用神经元，在推理时只加载并动态计算最相关的神经元子集。实验表明，该方法在显著降低内存占用和计算量的同时基本保持任务性能，为端侧 LLM 高效部署提供了可行路径。

papers.title: AdaHome: An Adaptive Smart Home Assistant using Local Small Language Models
papers.authors: Eu Jin Lim, Zhaoxing Li, Sebastian Stein
papers.abstract_en: Smart home assistants interpret a wide range of user commands, from explicit device control to underspecified and preference dependent requests. While recent systems based on Large Language Models (LLMs) improve this capability, they often rely on heavyweight reasoning pipelines and cloud-based deployment, limiting their efficiency and suitability for resource-constrained environments, and raising privacy concerns. In addition, existing approaches provide limited support for stable long-term personalization. To address these issues, we present AdaHome, an adaptive smart home assistant designed for locally deployed small language models in smart home environments. Rather than applying complex reasoning uniformly, AdaHome introduces an intent-aware planning framework that dynamically routes commands either to straightforward prompt-based or lightweight reasoning-based components. For commands requiring interpretation, we adopt a Chain-of-Draft strategy to enable efficient and stable decision-making. To support personalization, we further propose a preference adaptation mechanism that learns from user feedback over time without requiring prompt augmentation or model retraining. We evaluate AdaHome against representative LLM-based baselines under a unified small model setting. AdaHome achieves substantially higher accuracy on direct commands (86.7%) while reducing latency by up to 3$\times$. Furthermore, it maintains competitive performance on ambiguous inputs with lower computational cost. In multi-turn scenarios, AdaHome achieves 88% preference consistency, compared to 52.5% for a prompt augmentation baseline.
papers.abstract_cn: 智能家居助手可以解释各种各样的用户命令，从明确的设备控制到不明确的、依赖于偏好的请求。虽然最近基于大型语言模型（llm）的系统改进了这种能力，但它们通常依赖于重量级推理管道和基于云的部署，限制了它们在资源受限环境中的效率和适用性，并引起了隐私问题。此外，现有方法对稳定的长期个性化提供的支持有限。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了AdaHome，一种自适应智能家居助手，专为智能家居环境中本地部署的小语言模型而设计。AdaHome没有统一地应用复杂的推理，而是引入了一个意图感知的规划框架，该框架可以动态地将命令路由到直接的基于提示的组件或基于轻量级推理的组件。对于需要解释的命令，我们采用草案链策略来实现高效和稳定的决策。为了支持个性化，我们进一步提出了一种偏好适应机制，该机制可以随着时间的推移从用户反馈中学习，而不需要及时增强或模型再训练。我们在统一的小型模型设置下，根据具有代表性的基于llm的基线评估AdaHome。AdaHome在直接命令上实现了更高的准确率（86.7%），同时将延迟减少了3倍。此外，它以较低的计算成本在模糊输入上保持竞争性能。在多回合场景中，AdaHome的偏好一致性达到88%，而在提示增强基线中，这一比例为52.5%。
papers.ai_summary_en: AdaHome addresses the problem of efficient, private, and personalized smart-home command interpretation under resource-constrained local deployment, where existing LLM assistants often rely on heavyweight cloud reasoning pipelines and unstable long-term personalization. The system uses an intent-aware planning framework that routes commands to either direct prompting or lightweight reasoning via a Chain-of-Draft strategy, plus a preference adaptation mechanism that learns from user feedback without prompt augmentation or model retraining. Experiments with small local models show 86.7% accuracy on direct commands with up to 3× lower latency, competitive performance on ambiguous inputs, and 88% multi-turn preference consistency versus 52.5% for prompt-augmentation baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对智能家居助手依赖云端大模型、推理开销高且长期个性化不足的问题，AdaHome面向本地小语言模型提出意图感知的自适应规划框架，将命令动态路由至直接提示或轻量推理路径，并结合 Chain-of-Draft 与无需再训练的偏好适应机制。实验表明，该方法在直接命令上达到 86.7% 准确率、延迟最多降低 3 倍，同时在模糊输入下保持竞争力，多轮偏好一致性达 88%，显著优于提示增强基线。

papers.title: Harness Engineering for LLM-Driven GPU Kernel Generation
papers.authors: Yue Shui, Chenyu Ma, Hangfei Xu, Shengzhao Wen, Yanpeng Wang
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can assist GPU kernel generation, but their practical effectiveness depends on whether generated code can be reliably constrained, validated, profiled, and selected. This paper presents a harness-centered system for LLM-driven GPU kernel optimization in the MLSys 2026 FlashInfer AI Kernel Generation Contest on NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPUs. The system separates an evaluation harness from a profile-backed optimization controller: the harness enforces compilation, correctness, official-aligned timing, and artifact archival, while the controller turns profiler and workload evidence into bounded candidate-generation decisions. Human-authored skills capture operator constraints, references, profiling procedures, and promotion rules, while Codex and Claude Code agents generate candidate kernels inside those constraints. Across five operator definitions, the retained official-aligned artifacts achieved mean-latency speedups over supplied FlashInfer baselines of 1.62x, 18.05x, 29.68x, 1.12x, and 13.70x. The Agent-Assisted kernels outperform the Full-Agent artifacts across the evaluated definitions, indicating that expert-provided optimization directions, high-quality references, and workload context remain critical for reliable AI-driven kernel optimization.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）可以帮助GPU内核生成，但它们的实际有效性取决于生成的代码是否可以可靠地约束、验证、分析和选择。在NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPU上的MLSys 2026 FlashInfer AI内核生成竞赛中，提出了一种以集束为中心的llm驱动GPU内核优化系统。系统将评估工具从配置文件支持的优化控制器中分离出来：工具执行编译、正确性、与官方一致的计时和工件存档，而控制器将分析工具和工作负载证据转换为有限的候选生成决策。人工编写的技能捕获操作员约束、引用、分析过程和提升规则，而Codex和Claude Code代理在这些约束中生成候选核。在五个操作符定义中，保留的官方对齐的工件比FlashInfer提供的基线实现了1.62倍、18.05倍、29.68倍、1.12倍和13.70倍的平均延迟加速。在评估的定义中，agent辅助内核的性能优于Full-Agent工件，这表明专家提供的优化方向、高质量参考和工作负载上下文对于可靠的ai驱动内核优化仍然至关重要。
papers.comment: 24 pages, 6 figures. Extended technical report on our submission to the MLSys 2026 FlashInfer AI Kernel Generation Contest. Code: https://github.com/syhya/mlsys26-flashinfer-contest
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the reliability gap in LLM-driven GPU kernel generation, where candidate kernels must be constrained, validated, profiled, and selected under strict performance criteria. It proposes a harness-centered system that separates an evaluation harness enforcing compilation, correctness, official-aligned timing, and archival from a profile-backed optimization controller that uses human-authored skills and profiler evidence to guide Codex and Claude Code agents. On NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPUs, the method achieves mean-latency speedups of 1.62x, 18.05x, 29.68x, 1.12x, and 13.70x over FlashInfer baselines, with agent-assisted kernels outperforming fully autonomous ones, showing that expert-provided constraints and optimization context remain critical.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM生成GPU内核时难以可靠约束、验证、性能评测和筛选的问题，提出了一种以评测harness为中心的系统，将正确性/计时/归档与基于profiler的优化控制器分离。其核心洞见是让Codex、Claude Code等智能体在人类专家定义的算子约束、参考实现、性能分析流程和晋升规则下生成候选内核，实现有边界的自动优化。实验在NVIDIA Blackwell B200上相对FlashInfer基线取得最高约29.68倍加速，并表明专家引导的Agent辅助方式比完全自主Agent更可靠。

papers.title: PEARL: Auditable Repair for Scientific Reasoning Graph Extraction
papers.authors: Bohan Su, Pengze Li, Yuchen Lu, Xi Chen
papers.abstract_en: Scientific Reasoning Graph Extraction (SRGE) aims to recover explicit links among observations, evidence, intermediate claims, and paper-level conclusions. LLMs can produce graph-like scientific explanations, but their outputs often mix malformed syntax, drifting edge labels, incorrectly oriented roots, and weak source anchors. We propose PEARL (Peircean Extraction via Abstraction and Repair Layer), a training-free framework that turns noisy LLM graph responses into auditable reasoning graphs and repairs them toward strict semantic validity. PEARL first materializes explicit graph content under a closed Peircean schema, then uses matched evidence-grounded judge feedback to repair rejected edge types, local inference steps, and terminal roots while preserving an audit trail. On five 70-paper model archives from ARCHE, a benchmark for latent reasoning-chain extraction, PEARL raises strict gate passes from 0/350 for the LLM baseline to 300/350, with average REA improving from 0.339 to 0.906. The graphs provide a reliability layer for research-agent and AI scientist workflows that need inspectable reasoning traces rather than unconstrained graph regeneration. Code and audit artifacts are available at https://github.com/BohanSu/auditable-repair-reasoning-graphs/tree/300-350_workshop .
papers.abstract_cn: 科学推理图提取（SRGE）旨在恢复观察、证据、中间主张和论文级结论之间的明确联系。llm可以生成类似图表的科学解释，但它们的输出通常包含错误的语法、漂移的边缘标签、不正确的根和弱源锚。我们提出PEARL（通过抽象和修复层的Peircean Extraction via Abstraction and Repair Layer），这是一个无需训练的框架，它将嘈杂的LLM图响应转换为可审计的推理图，并将它们修复为严格的语义有效性。PEARL首先在封闭的Peircean模式下实现显式图内容，然后使用匹配的基于证据的判断反馈来修复被拒绝的边缘类型、局部推理步骤和终端根，同时保留审计跟踪。在潜在推理链提取基准ARCHE的5篇70篇模型档案中，PEARL将LLM基线的严格gate passes从0/350提高到300/350，平均REA从0.339提高到0.906。这些图为研究代理和人工智能科学家的工作流提供了一个可靠性层，这些工作流需要可检查的推理痕迹，而不是无约束的图再生。代码和审计构件可在https://github.com/BohanSu/auditable-repair-reasoning-graphs/tree/300-350_workshop上获得。
papers.comment: Accepted at WAICA 2026 Multi-Modal Agents for Science Workshop
papers.ai_summary_en: PEARL addresses the problem that LLM-generated scientific reasoning graphs are often syntactically and semantically invalid, with malformed edges, mislabeled relations, incorrect roots, and weak evidence anchors. It proposes a training-free extraction-and-repair layer that normalizes outputs into a closed Peircean schema and uses evidence-grounded judge feedback to repair rejected edges, local inference steps, and terminal roots while preserving an audit trail. On ARCHE model archives, PEARL raises strict gate passes from 0/350 to 300/350 and average REA from 0.339 to 0.906, providing inspectable reasoning graphs for research-agent workflows.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM抽取科学推理图时存在的语法畸形、边标签漂移、根节点方向错误和证据锚定不足等问题，提出训练免费的PEARL框架，在封闭皮尔士图式下规范化LLM输出，并通过证据锚定的评审反馈修复边类型、局部推理链和终端根节点，同时保留审计轨迹。在ARCHE基准上，PEARL将严格门控通过率从0/350提升至300/350，平均REA从0.339提高到0.906，为科研智能体和AI科学家工作流提供了可检查、可审计的推理图可靠性层。

papers.title: C$^2$KV: Compressed and Composable KV Cache Reuse for Efficient LLM Inference
papers.authors: Chuheng Du, Junyi Chen, Hanlin Tang, Kan Liu, Tao Lan, Lin Qu, Chaoyue Niu, Shengzhong Liu, Guihai Chen, Fan Wu
papers.abstract_en: Long-context inference is central to modern large language model (LLM) applications such as retrieval-augmented generation and multi-document reasoning. To mitigate the growing inference cost, recent work has explored key-value (KV) cache reuse to reduce redundant prefill computation. However, existing reuse methods primarily focus on computation savings and overlook a critical bottleneck in long-context LLM serving: the cost of storing and accessing large KV caches. While KV compression appears to be a natural complement, naively combining compression with non-prefix KV reuse often leads to severe accuracy degradation. In this work, we propose C$^2$KV, a unified framework for non-prefix KV reuse that jointly optimizes KV extraction and inference-time concatenation. C$^2$KV learns a composable and compressed KV cache manifold that is explicitly designed to be position-agnostic. Our approach introduces a lightweight sidecar Extractor with learnable compression tokens and a structured attention flow, enabling modular KV representations that can be flexibly reused and concatenated without modifying the frozen base model. We further employ a compression-concatenation co-training strategy to align extraction-time representations with their downstream reuse behavior. Extensive experiments across multiple long-context benchmarks and model families demonstrate that C$^2$KV significantly reduces KV cache storage and transfer costs, achieving up to 17$\times$ inference speedup under long contexts, while preserving generation quality.
papers.abstract_cn: 长上下文推理是现代大型语言模型（LLM）应用程序（如检索增强生成和多文档推理）的核心。为了降低不断增长的推理成本，最近的工作探索了键值（KV）缓存重用以减少冗余预填充计算。然而，现有的重用方法主要关注于节省计算，而忽略了长上下文LLM服务中的一个关键瓶颈：存储和访问大型KV缓存的成本。虽然KV压缩似乎是一种自然的补充，但天真地将压缩与无前缀KV重用结合起来往往会导致严重的精度下降。在这项工作中，我们提出了C$^2$KV，这是一个统一的无前缀KV重用框架，可以共同优化KV提取和推理时间串联。C$^2$KV学习了一个可组合的压缩KV缓存歧管，它被明确地设计为位置不可知的。我们的方法引入了一个轻量级的sidecar Extractor，具有可学习的压缩令牌和结构化的注意力流，使模块化KV表示可以灵活地重用和连接，而无需修改冻结的基础模型。我们进一步采用压缩-串联协同训练策略，使提取时间表示与其下游重用行为保持一致。跨多个长上下文基准和模型族的广泛实验表明，C$^2$KV显着降低了KV缓存存储和传输成本，在保持发电质量的同时，在长上下文下实现了高达17$\times$的推理加速。
papers.comment: 12 pages, 9 figures, accepted by ACM SIGKDD 2026
papers.ai_summary_en: C²KV tackles the storage and access bottleneck of long-context LLM serving, where non-prefix KV cache reuse alone reduces prefill computation but still incurs large cache transfer and memory costs, and naive compression harms accuracy. It proposes a frozen-model-compatible framework with a lightweight sidecar extractor that produces compressed, position-agnostic, composable KV representations using learnable compression tokens, structured attention flow, and compression–concatenation co-training to align extraction with reuse-time concatenation. Experiments on long-context benchmarks show substantial KV storage/transfer reduction and up to 17× inference speedup while preserving generation quality.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 服务中非前缀 KV cache 复用虽能减少 prefill 计算，却忽视 KV 存储与访问开销、且直接结合压缩会显著掉点的问题。其提出 C²KV，通过轻量 sidecar Extractor、可学习压缩 token、结构化注意力流和“压缩-拼接”协同训练，学习位置无关、可组合的压缩 KV 表示，使冻结模型可灵活复用与拼接 KV cache。实验显示其在多个长上下文基准和模型族上显著降低 KV 存储与传输成本，最高实现 17 倍推理加速，同时保持生成质量。

papers.title: Kernelized Linear Attention: Breaking the Capacity Wall with Symmetric Cones
papers.authors: Ayoub Ghriss, Sourav Chakraborty
papers.abstract_en: Linear attention promises constant-time recurrent inference but degrades sharply on associative recall. We formulate attention recall as a spherical-packing problem and introduce Kernelized Linear Attention Activations (KATA), a framework whose feature maps are derived from first principles by certifying nonnegative attention weights through a self-dual homogeneous cone. Building on this observation, we show that rank-one positive semi-definite (PSD) features offer a favorable capacity--interference tradeoff. KATA recovers a parameter-free convex output gate and characterizes associative capacity through the Welch interference floor. For tolerances above this floor, KATA enlarges the state without adding parameters and admits spherical codes with exponentially many keys in the projection dimension. We implement KATA as fused Triton kernels at two operating points: a flash-attention-style forward up to ${\sim}1.6\times$ FlashAttention-2 throughput, and an exact $O(T)$ chunked-state form that reaches ${\sim}11\times$ FlashAttention-2 forward throughput at $131$k tokens. An associative scan of the first-order feature lowers the inter-chunk recurrence depth to $O(\log(T/C))$ for chunk size $C$ and averages ${\sim}2.4\times$ the throughput of a matched sequential linear-attention baseline. On long-range MQAR and repeated-key overwrite, several KATA variants outperform Gated DeltaNet, with parameter counts and state sizes reported alongside accuracy. Induction preserves near-perfect recall, while kernel benchmarks show that the maps can be implemented efficiently. KATA retains $0.985$ MQAR at a $16\times$ out-of-distribution length, approaching the softmax with roughly one quarter of the KV-cache entries. Experiments on 340M-parameter LLMs reveal a feature-dependent fluency trade-off and clarify how positional embeddings, delta rules, and decay gates interact with feature geometry.
papers.abstract_cn: 线性注意力承诺持续时间的循环推理，但在联想回忆上急剧退化。我们将注意力召回描述为一个球体填充问题，并引入了核化线性注意力激活（KATA）框架，该框架的特征映射是通过自对偶齐次锥证明非负注意力权值而从第一性原理得到的。在此观察的基础上，我们表明排名第一的正半确定（PSD）特征提供了有利的容量-干扰权衡。KATA恢复无参数的凸输出门，并通过韦尔奇干扰层表征联想能力。对于以上的公差，KATA在不增加参数的情况下扩大了状态，并允许在投影维度上具有指数级多键的球形代码。我们在两个操作点上实现KATA作为融合的Triton内核：一个flash-attention风格的转发到${\sim}1.6\times$ FlashAttention-2吞吐量，以及一个精确的$O(T)$块状态形式，在$131$ k个令牌上达到${\sim}11\times$ FlashAttention-2转发吞吐量。对于块大小$C$，一阶特征的关联扫描将块间递归深度降低到$O(\log(T/C))$，并将匹配的顺序线性注意基线的吞吐量平均${\sim}2.4\times$。在远程MQAR和重复键覆盖上，几个KATA变体的性能优于门控DeltaNet，它们具有参数计数和状态大小报告以及准确性。归纳法保持了近乎完美的召回，而内核基准测试表明映射可以有效地实现。KATA将$0.985$ MQAR保留在$16\times$分布外长度，接近softmax，大约有四分之一的kv缓存条目。在340m参数llm上的实验揭示了特征依赖的流畅性权衡，并阐明了位置嵌入、delta规则和衰减门如何与特征几何相互作用。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper tackles the limited associative-recall capacity of linear attention, which undermines its constant-time recurrent inference advantage in LLM serving. It proposes Kernelized Linear Attention Activations (KATA), deriving feature maps from nonnegative attention certified by self-dual homogeneous cones and showing that rank-one PSD features provide a favorable capacity–interference tradeoff, with a parameter-free convex output gate and parameter-free state expansion via spherical codes. Fused Triton implementations reach up to ~11× FlashAttention-2 forward throughput at 131k tokens and show strong recall—e.g., 0.985 MQAR at 16× out-of-distribution length with ~¼ the KV-cache—while 340M-parameter LLM experiments reveal feature-dependent fluency tradeoffs.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对线性注意力在关联回忆任务上的容量瓶颈，将注意力召回建模为球面打包问题，并提出 KATA：通过自偶齐次锥保证非负注意力权重，从第一性原理导出核化特征映射，以秩一 PSD 特征和无参数凸输出门改善容量—干扰折中。其核心洞见是可用 Welch 干扰底刻画关联容量，并在不增加参数的情况下扩大状态、支持指数级键，同时提供融合 Triton 的 Flash 风格前向与精确 O(T) 分块状态实现。实验表明，KATA 在长序列前向吞吐最高约达 FlashAttention-2 的 11 倍，在 MQAR/重复键覆盖任务优于 Gated DeltaNet，且 16 倍长度外仍保持 0.985 MQAR，以约四分之一 KV 缓存接近 softmax 召回。

papers.title: MADA-RL: Multi-Agent Debate-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Parameter-Efficient Reasoning in Compact Models
papers.authors: Martino M. L. Pulici, Cuong Xuan Chu, Evgeny Kharlamov, Zifeng Ding, Volker Tresp, Yunpu Ma
papers.abstract_en: Large language models achieve strong reasoning performance, but often at prohibitive training cost - a challenge that is especially acute for compact models ($\leq 4 \, \mathrm{B}$ parameters) trained under limited budgets. We introduce MADA-RL, a post-training framework that specializes compact models into generator and critic roles and trains them with a debate-aware learning signal, fine-tuning only a small subset of parameters via LoRA adapters. Our central contribution is a counterfactual critic advantage: a dynamic, role-conditioned baseline that redefines the critic's advantage as its reward minus the generator ensemble's per-instance accuracy. This explicitly optimizes critics to improve over generator consensus rather than to merely reproduce a correct answer, yielding more targeted credit assignment than static mean-reward normalization. At deployment, the specialized agents are composed in a lightweight multi-round protocol. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, MADA-RL raises the accuracy of the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B model from $39.9 \, \%$ to $41.9 \, \%$ ($+2.0$ points, $p < 0.001$) using $16$ times fewer trainable parameters than fully fine-tuned baselines, placing it on the accuracy-trainable-parameter Pareto front. It approaches, but does not surpass, the strongest baselines (DeepScaleR, STILL-3), which are trained on substantially larger datasets; we analyse this gap and the associated inference-time cost directly. A controlled study isolates the source of MADA-RL's gains: the counterfactual advantage produces the highest critic improvement rate of any model evaluated, indicating that trained critics learn to correct generator errors rather than to imitate them.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型实现了强大的推理性能，但通常需要高昂的训练成本——对于在有限预算下训练的紧凑模型（$\leq 4 \, \mathrm{B}$参数）来说，这是一个特别严峻的挑战。我们引入了MADA-RL，这是一个训练后框架，专门将模型压缩为生成器和评论家角色，并使用辩论感知学习信号训练它们，通过LoRA适配器微调参数的一小部分。我们的主要贡献是一个反事实的评论家优势：一个动态的、角色条件化的基线，它将评论家的优势重新定义为其奖励减去生成器集合的每实例准确性。这明确地优化了批评，以提高超过生成器的共识，而不仅仅是重现一个正确的答案，产生比静态平均奖励规范化更有针对性的信用分配。在部署时，专门的代理被组合在一个轻量级的多轮协议中。在五个数学推理基准中，MADA-RL将DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B模型的精度从$39.9 \, \%$提高到$41.9 \, \%$ ($+2.0$点，$p < 0.001$)，使用的可训练参数比完全微调的基线少$16$倍，将其置于精度-可训练参数Pareto前沿。它接近但没有超过最强基线（DeepScaleR, STILL-3），后者是在更大的数据集上训练的；我们直接分析了这一差距和相关的推理时间成本。一项对照研究分离了MADA-RL收益的来源：反事实优势产生了所有评估模型中最高的评论家改进率，这表明训练有素的评论家学会纠正生成器错误，而不是模仿它们。
papers.comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables, 2 algorithms, under review at TMLR
papers.ai_summary_en: MADA-RL addresses parameter-efficient post-training for compact LLMs (≤4B parameters) that need stronger mathematical reasoning under limited training budgets. It fine-tunes LoRA-specialized generator and critic agents with a counterfactual critic advantage that subtracts the generator ensemble’s per-instance accuracy from the critic reward, forcing critics to improve upon generator consensus rather than merely match correct answers. On five math benchmarks, it improves DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B from 39.9% to 41.9% using 16× fewer trainable parameters than full fine-tuning baselines, achieving a strong accuracy–parameter Pareto position while approaching larger-data baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对紧凑大模型在有限训练预算下提升数学推理能力的问题，提出 MADA-RL：通过 LoRA 将小模型特化为生成器与批评器，并用“反事实批评优势”这一动态基线让批评器学习纠正生成器共识错误。其核心洞见是批评器不应只复述正确答案，而应相对生成器集成表现获得更精准的信用分配。实验显示，该方法在五个数学基准上将 1.5B 模型准确率提升 2.0 个百分点，且可训练参数仅为全参微调的 1/16，达到准确率-参数效率的 Pareto 前沿。

papers.title: Talaria: Session-Aware Serverless Serving of Hundred-Billion-Parameter LLMs
papers.authors: Utopia Meng, Unicornt Zhao, Derek Li, Goalen Gao, Frank Du
papers.abstract_en: Serverless multi-model LLM systems multiplex popularity-skewed model catalogs over shared GPU pools, yet typically schedule each request independently. Tool-using agents break this abstraction: a session repeatedly calls an LLM across short tool gaps, carries a long reusable KV prefix, and is judged by session completion time (SCT). Load-only routing can separate a continuation from both its model and KV state, while round-based model multiplexing can delay even a correctly placed continuation until the target model's next slot. Both failures are especially costly for hundred-billion-parameter models: their weights constrain residency, while long-context KV is expensive to reconstruct or move.   We present Talaria, a session-aware serverless multi-model serving system that makes session continuity a joint placement-and-admission decision. Its router ranks placements by model residency, KV locality, and instance pressure, while soft reservations account for likely returns in the last serving instance's admission budget. Session-prefill (SP) admits budget-eligible continuations before the active model slot closes. An instance-local substrate keeps HBM addresses stable, preserves host-restorable KV, and stages weights across model switches.   On a single TP=8 server, we replay 30 SWE-Bench model-sessions (960 calls) over three models, each with more than 100B total parameters. Against an otherwise identical round scheduler with SP, host-KV restoration, and D2D staging disabled, Talaria cuts p50 SCT from 1000 s to 189 s and p95 from 2296 s to 867 s, speedups of 5.3x and 2.6x.
papers.abstract_cn: 无服务器多模型LLM系统在共享GPU池上复用流行度倾斜的模型目录，但通常独立调度每个请求。使用工具的代理打破了这种抽象：一个会话在短的工具间隔内重复调用LLM，携带一个长可重用的KV前缀，并通过会话完成时间（SCT）进行判断。仅负载路由可以将延续从其模型和KV状态中分离出来，而基于轮的模型复用甚至可以将正确放置的延续延迟到目标模型的下一个时隙。对于千亿参数模型来说，这两种失败的代价都特别高昂：它们的权重限制了驻留时间，而长时间的KV重建或移动成本很高。我们提出了Talaria，一个会话感知的无服务器多模型服务系统，它使会话连续性成为一个联合放置和接收决策。它的路由器根据模型居住地、KV位置和实例压力对位置进行排名，而软预订则考虑了最后一个服务实例的准入预算中的可能回报。会话预填充（Session-prefill， SP）在活动模型槽关闭之前允许符合预算的延续。实例本地基板保持HBM地址稳定，保留主机可恢复的KV，并在模型切换中分级权重。在单个TP=8的服务器上，我们在三个模型上重播30个sw - bench模型会话（960个调用），每个模型的总参数超过100B。在禁用SP、主机- kv恢复和D2D分期的情况下，Talaria将p50 SCT从1000秒减少到189秒，p95从2296秒减少到867秒，速度分别提高了5.3倍和2.6倍。
papers.ai_summary_en: Talaria addresses serverless multi-model serving of hundred-billion-parameter LLMs, where tool-using agent sessions are penalized by per-request scheduling that loses model residency and reusable KV-cache locality. It makes session continuity a joint placement-and-admission problem, routing continuations using model residency, KV locality, and instance pressure while employing soft reservations and session-prefill to admit likely returns before model slots close. On a TP=8 server replaying 30 SWE-Bench sessions across three >100B-parameter models, Talaria reduces p50/p95 session completion time from 1000/2296 s to 189/867 s, a 5.3×/2.6× speedup.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对无服务器多模型LLM服务中工具型Agent会话因逐请求调度导致KV前缀复用不足、模型状态分离和会话完成时延升高的问题。Talaria 将会话连续性作为联合放置与准入决策，通过考虑模型驻留、KV局部性和实例压力的路由，以及软预留、session-prefill、主机可恢复KV和模型切换权重暂存等机制保持会话状态。实验在单台TP=8服务器上重放三个100B+模型的SWE-Bench会话，将p50会话完成时间从1000秒降至189秒、p95从2296秒降至867秒，分别实现5.3倍和2.6倍加速。

papers.title: AGG: Jacobian-Aggregated Group Gradient for Efficient GRPO Training of Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Ruiyi Ding, Jie Li, He Kang, Ziyan Liu, Chengru Song, Yuan chen
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is a powerful reinforcement learning algorithm for aligning generative models with human preferences. While successful in large language models~\cite{shao2024deepseekmathpushinglimitsmathematical}, its extension to diffusion and flow matching models introduces a severe computational bottleneck: gradients must be back-propagated through the high-capacity DiT backbone at \emph{every} timestep of the sampling trajectory, making high-resolution text-to-image (T2I) training prohibitively expensive. Training-free DiT inference acceleration methods (e.g., $Δ$-DiT, ScalingCache) exploit the fact that DiT hidden states and velocity predictions vary \emph{smoothly and nearly linearly} along the trajectory. We ask whether the same linearity can reduce the backward-pass cost of DiT RL training, and answer affirmatively with \textbf{JAGG} (\textbf{J}acobian-\textbf{A}ggregated \textbf{G}roup \textbf{G}radient), which reduces full transformer backward passes from $W$ to $2$ per group of $W$ consecutive steps. JAGG approximates intermediate-step Jacobians via $t$-weighted interpolation of the endpoint Jacobians, then aggregates per-step upstream signals into two composite gradients applied through a single joint backward pass. We prove this interpolation is \emph{exact} when the velocity is linear in $(z,t)$, and a cosine-similarity routing rule (\texttt{jagg\_frac}) deploys JAGG only where the assumption holds. Experiments on T2I benchmarks show JAGG delivers $\sim$2$\times$ backward speedup with negligible quality degradation.
papers.abstract_cn: 群体相对策略优化（GRPO）是一种强大的强化学习算法，用于将生成模型与人类偏好相匹配。虽然在大型语言模型\cite{shao2024deepseekmathpushinglimitsmathematical}中取得了成功，但它对扩散和流匹配模型的扩展引入了一个严重的计算瓶颈：梯度必须在采样轨迹的\emph{每一个}时间步长上通过高容量DiT骨干进行反向传播，这使得高分辨率的文本到图像（T2I）训练非常昂贵。无需训练的DiT推理加速方法（例如$Δ$ -DiT, ScalingCache）利用了DiT隐藏状态和速度预测沿轨迹变化\emph{平滑和近似线性}的事实。我们询问相同的线性是否可以减少DiT RL训练的反向传递成本，并肯定地回答\textbf{锯齿状} (\textbf{雅可比矩阵} - \textbf{聚合}\textbf{小组}\textbf{梯度})，它将每组$W$连续步骤的全变压器反向传递从$W$减少到$2$。JAGG通过$t$加权插值端点雅可比矩阵来逼近中间步雅可比矩阵，然后通过单个关节反向传递将每步上游信号聚合为两个复合梯度。当速度在$(z,t)$为线性时，我们证明此插值为\emph{确切的}，并且余弦相似路由规则（\texttt{jagg＿frac}）仅在假设成立的地方部署JAGG。在T2I基准测试上的实验表明，JAGG提供了$\sim$ 2 $\times$向后加速，而质量下降可以忽略不计。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the high backward-pass cost of GRPO-based RL training for diffusion/flow-matching DiT models, where gradients must be propagated through a large transformer backbone at every sampling timestep. JAGG reduces this cost by approximating intermediate Jacobians via timestep-weighted interpolation of endpoint Jacobians and aggregating per-step gradient signals into two composite backward passes per group of \(W\) steps, with a cosine-similarity routing rule that enables it only where trajectory linearity holds. Experiments on text-to-image benchmarks show roughly \(2\times\) backward speedup with negligible degradation in generation quality.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 GRPO 用于扩散/流匹配模型时需在每个采样步对 DiT 反向传播、导致高分辨率文生图训练代价过高的问题。其核心方法是利用 DiT 轨迹的近线性特性，用端点 Jacobian 插值近似中间步 Jacobian，并将一组连续步的梯度信号聚合为两次联合反向传播，同时通过余弦相似度路由保证适用性。实验表明，该方法在文生图任务上实现约 2 倍反向加速，且生成质量几乎无明显下降。

papers.title: D-NOVA: In-Storage Retrieval Accelerator via Dual-Bound 3D NAND-Optimized Similarity Search with Vector Adaptation
papers.authors: Chang Eun Song, Sumukh Pinge, Tianqi Zhang, Sung Eun Kim, Tajana S. Rosing, Mingu Kang
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances the factual grounding of large language model (LLM) inference by retrieving relevant information from external knowledge bases. However, its dense vector retrieval introduces significant latency and energy overhead, becoming the primary performance bottleneck. Although recent in-storage accelerators aim to reduce data movement, they still rely on host or embedded processors outside the memory, where nearly 70% of the total retrieval time is spent. As a result, they cannot fully overcome the bandwidth limitations, leading to yet another memory bottleneck. To tackle these limitations, we present D-NOVA, a hardware-software co-designed in-storage retrieval accelerator. D-NOVA executes an inverted file (IVF)-based hierarchical retrieval pipeline by deeply embedding the search functionality directly into the NAND memory array. This is achieved by incorporating a new distance metric, Dual-Bound Tight Similarity Sensing (DTS), which is specifically tailored for searching within the NAND string. In addition, we introduce a lightweight contrastive adapter that maps embedding vectors into a DTS-friendly domain, recovering near-software recall while improving performance and energy efficiency. D-NOVA is up to 41.7x faster and 71x more energy-efficient than a CPU baseline, and achieves 12.13x higher throughput while being up to 1.26x more energy-efficient than state-of-the-art in-storage RAG accelerators, demonstrating the potential of fully in-storage vector search for scalable RAG acceleration.
papers.abstract_cn: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过从外部知识库中检索相关信息来增强大型语言模型（LLM）推理的事实基础。然而，它的密集向量检索带来了显著的延迟和能量开销，成为主要的性能瓶颈。尽管最近的存储内加速器旨在减少数据移动，但它们仍然依赖于内存之外的主机或嵌入式处理器，其中花费了近70%的总检索时间。因此，它们不能完全克服带宽限制，从而导致另一个内存瓶颈。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了D-NOVA，一个硬件软件协同设计的存储检索加速器。D-NOVA通过将搜索功能直接嵌入到NAND存储器阵列中来执行基于倒排文件（IVF）的分层检索管道。这是通过结合一种新的距离度量来实现的，双界紧密相似感测（DTS），它是专门为在NAND字符串内搜索而定制的。此外，我们引入了一个轻量级的对比适配器，它将嵌入向量映射到dts友好的域，在提高性能和能源效率的同时恢复近软件召回。D-NOVA比CPU基准快41.7倍，节能71倍，实现12.13倍的高吞吐量，同时比最先进的存储RAG加速器节能1.26倍，展示了完全存储矢量搜索可扩展RAG加速的潜力。
papers.comment: Accepted at the 59th IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Microarchitecture (MICRO 2026), Athens, Greece. Chang Eun Song and Sumukh Pinge are co-first authors and contributed equally
papers.ai_summary_en: D-NOVA tackles the latency and energy bottleneck of dense vector retrieval in RAG, where existing in-storage accelerators still rely on external processors and cannot fully overcome memory bandwidth limits. It proposes a hardware–software co-designed accelerator that embeds IVF-based hierarchical search directly into 3D NAND using a Dual-Bound Tight Similarity Sensing metric, plus a lightweight contrastive adapter that maps embeddings into a NAND-search-friendly domain. The design recovers near-software recall while achieving up to 41.7× speedup and 71× energy efficiency over a CPU baseline, and 12.13× higher throughput with up to 1.26× better energy efficiency than state-of-the-art in-storage RAG accelerators.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对RAG中密集向量检索因依赖片外处理和数据搬运而产生的高延迟、高能耗瓶颈，论文提出D-NOVA，一种将IVF分层检索直接嵌入3D NAND阵列的软硬件协同存储内加速器。其核心洞见是设计面向NAND串内搜索的双边界紧相似度度量DTS，并通过轻量对比适配器将向量映射到DTS友好空间，从而在保持接近软件召回率的同时提升搜索效率。实验表明，D-NOVA相较CPU最高提速41.7倍、能效提升71倍，相较先进存储内加速器吞吐提升12.13倍且能效最高提升1.26倍。

papers.title: Oracle Gap and Signal Fidelity: A Fixed-Pool Diagnostic for Test-Time Collaboration
papers.authors: Jie Hu
papers.abstract_en: Test-time collaboration, including self-consistency, best-of-N selection, critic models, and verifier pipelines, is often credited with broadly improving LLM reasoning, yet its gains are uneven and sometimes negative. We ask when training-free collaboration should be expected to help.
