For a fixed candidate pool, we decompose a selector or verifier's net gain into measurable factors: recoverable mass, verification-signal coverage, conditional selection quality, and harm to already-correct outputs. This reframes collaboration as a candidate-selection problem rather than as an intrinsic property of a multi-agent topology. Across LiveCodeBench, MATH Level-5 hard subjects, and GPQA-Diamond, gains are bounded first by the oracle gap and then by signal fidelity, which we measure directly as candidate-level agreement between verifier verdicts and official labels. On LiveCodeBench, a public-test verifier (MCC 0.825) gains +8.14 percentage points (pp) over a first-sample baseline; a generated-test verifier (MCC 0.248) improves by +2.70pp and is not statistically distinguishable from an LLM selector, but operates at near-zero harm versus the selector's 4.69% harm rate. On MATH, a symbolic answer-equivalence selector beats self-consistency by +4.67pp, while LLM selectors are negative. On GPQA-Diamond, recoverable mass is only 3.03% and 87.54% of candidate pools are answer-identical; a weaker model's pools shrink both further, suggesting that oracle gap is a joint property of task, model, and sampling configuration. Our framework yields a practical pre-deployment diagnostic: estimate the oracle gap, then measure coverage, signal fidelity, and harm before investing in collaboration.
papers.abstract_cn: 测试时协作，包括自一致性、n的最佳选择、评论家模型和验证者管道，通常被认为广泛地改进了LLM推理，然而它的收益是不平衡的，有时是负面的。我们会问，什么时候不需要培训的协作才能有所帮助。对于固定的候选池，我们将选择器或验证器的净增益分解为可测量的因素：可恢复质量、验证信号覆盖、条件选择质量和对已经正确输出的危害。这将协作重新定义为一个候选体选择问题，而不是多代理拓扑的固有属性。在LiveCodeBench、MATH Level-5硬科目和GPQA-Diamond中，收益首先受到oracle差距的限制，然后受到信号保真度的限制，我们直接将其作为验证者裁决和官方标签之间的候选级别协议进行测量。在LiveCodeBench上，公开测试验证器（MCC 0.825）比第一个样本基线提高8.14个百分点；生成测试验证器（MCC 0.248）提高了+2.70pp，在统计上与LLM选择器没有区别，但与选择器4.69%的伤害率相比，其伤害率几乎为零。在MATH上，一个符号答案等价选择器比自一致性高出4.67个百分点，而LLM选择器是负的。在GPQA-Diamond上，可采质量仅为3.03%，87.54%的候选池答案相同；较弱模型的池进一步缩小了两者，这表明oracle差距是任务、模型和采样配置的共同属性。我们的框架产生了一个实用的部署前诊断：估计oracle差距，然后在投资于协作之前测量覆盖范围、信号保真度和危害。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the inconsistent benefits of training-free test-time collaboration for LLM reasoning by asking when selectors or verifiers can improve over a first-sample baseline. It introduces a fixed-pool diagnostic that decomposes net gain into oracle gap, verification-signal coverage/fidelity, conditional selection quality, and harm to already-correct answers, reframing collaboration as a candidate-selection problem. Experiments on LiveCodeBench, MATH Level-5, and GPQA-Diamond show that gains are bounded first by oracle gap and then by signal fidelity, with high-fidelity verification yielding +8.14 pp on LiveCodeBench and symbolic selection outperforming self-consistency on MATH.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该文针对测试时协作（如自一致、best-of-N、验证器）收益不稳定的问题，研究在固定候选池下免训练协作何时有效，并将净收益分解为可恢复空间、信号覆盖、条件选择质量和对已正确样本的伤害。其核心洞见是将协作视为候选选择问题，认为收益先受 oracle gap 上限约束，再受验证信号保真度限制。多基准实验表明，高保真验证器可显著提升效果，而低保真选择器可能无效甚至有害，该框架为部署前评估协作潜力提供了实用诊断。

papers.title: Transition-Aware Backend Dispatch for Edge LLM Inference
papers.authors: Alaaddin Goktug Ayar, Martin Margala
papers.abstract_en: Efficient large language model (LLM) inference on edge platforms is limited not only by model size, but also by shape-dependent performance differences across execution backends. Static backend assignment cannot exploit this variation, while independent per-operator selection can introduce costly device and framework switches. This paper presents a transition-aware backend dispatch approach for edge transformer inference. The approach combines current operator features with the previously selected backend to preserve beneficial shape-specific choices while avoiding unnecessary transitions. Ordered traces are collected from full-model inference runs of seven transformer models, and four common operator classes are benchmarked across PyTorch eager CPU, PyTorch eager CUDA, and ONNX Runtime CPU on an NVIDIA Jetson platform. The dispatch policies are evaluated through measurement-backed trace replay using observed operator costs and transition costs measured from actual backend switches. Supported operators are selected dynamically, while operators outside the dispatch scope retain a static assignment. Across 9,584 ordered operator instances and 278 exact shape groups, transition-aware dispatch reduces replayed latency, energy, and energy-delay product relative to the best static policy by 17.4%, 14.4%, and 28.5% on average, respectively. It also reduces switching relative to operator-local selection. Leave-one-model-out evaluation improves all three objectives for six of seven held-out models and improves energy for all seven. These results demonstrate that incorporating operator shape and backend-transition context can improve selective backend dispatch for edge transformer workloads.
papers.abstract_cn: 边缘平台上有效的大型语言模型（LLM）推理不仅受到模型大小的限制，而且还受到执行后端之间形状相关的性能差异的限制。静态后端分配不能利用这种变化，而独立的每个操作员选择可能会引入昂贵的设备和框架切换。提出了一种基于转换感知的边缘变压器推理后端调度方法。该方法将当前操作符特征与先前选择的后端相结合，以保留有益的特定形状选择，同时避免不必要的过渡。从七个变压器模型的全模型推理运行中收集有序的跟踪，并在NVIDIA Jetson平台上跨PyTorch eager CPU， PyTorch eager CUDA和ONNX Runtime CPU对四个通用运算器类进行基准测试。调度策略通过测量支持的跟踪重播进行评估，使用观察到的操作员成本和从实际后端交换机测量的转换成本。支持的操作符是动态选择的，而分派范围之外的操作符保留静态赋值。在9,584个有序的操作符实例和278个精确的形状组中，相对于最佳静态策略，转换感知调度平均分别减少了17.4%、14.4%和28.5%的重放延迟、能量和能量延迟产品。相对于运营商本地选择，它还减少了切换。离开一个模型评估改善了七个保留模型中的六个的所有三个目标，并改善了所有七个模型的能量。这些结果表明，结合算子形状和后端转换上下文可以改善边缘变压器工作负载的选择性后端调度。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses edge transformer/LLM inference inefficiency caused by operator-shape-dependent backend performance and overhead from frequent backend switches. It proposes a transition-aware dispatch policy that selects among PyTorch eager CPU/CUDA and ONNX Runtime CPU using current operator shape features and the previously selected backend, evaluated via measurement-backed trace replay on an NVIDIA Jetson with explicit transition costs. Across seven models, the method reduces replayed latency, energy, and energy-delay product by 17.4%, 14.4%, and 28.5% versus the best static policy while lowering switching relative to per-operator dispatch and generalizing to held-out models.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘 Transformer/LLM 推理中不同算子形状在各执行后端上性能差异显著、静态后端分配难以利用而逐算子选择又会带来高昂切换开销的问题。方法上提出迁移感知的后端调度，在 PyTorch CPU/CUDA 与 ONNX Runtime CPU 之间结合当前算子特征和上一后端选择进行动态分派，以保留形状相关收益并减少不必要切换。基于真实 trace 重放显示，相较最佳静态策略平均降低延迟 17.4%、能耗 14.4%、能耗-延迟积 28.5%，同时减少后端切换并具有较好跨模型泛化性。

papers.title: AIGB-R1: Self-Evolving Generative Auto-Bidding via Hierarchical Planner-Executor Optimization
papers.authors: Yuejia Dou, Hesong Wang, Xinyu Zhang, Tianyu Wang, Zhilin Zhang, Chuan Yu, Jian Xu, Bo Zheng, Qi Qi
papers.abstract_en: Auto-bidding plays an essential role in online advertising, automatically adjusting bids for advertisers to optimize their commercial goals. The emerging AI-Generated Bidding (AIGB) paradigm widely adopts generative modeling to optimize bidding strategies, yet suffers from the limited mode coverage of offline datasets and inadequate task-state understanding, hindering effective exploration of optimal strategies. Large Language Models (LLMs), with prior world knowledge and reasoning capabilities, offer a promising approach to overcome these limitations. However, directly applying LLMs to auto-bidding tasks faces inherent challenges in limited numerical precision, hallucinations, and inference latency. To address these limitations, we propose AIGB-R1, a hierarchical self-evolving auto-bidding framework aiming to enhance AI-Generated Bidding via LLMs' Reasoning capabilities, comprising a high-level Planner module for macro-level strategy planning and a low-level Executor module for fine-grained decision-making. Building upon this, we design an experience-driven self-evolving loop, enabling autonomous strategy exploration and optimization from accumulated experience. We adopt a two-stage pipeline of offline pre-training and post-training alignment, and build an interactive bidding simulation environment for strategy rollout. Furthermore, we propose Decoupled Group Relative Policy Optimization (D-GRPO) to achieve end-to-end optimization via advantage decoupling. Experimental results on a large-scale public dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of AIGB-R1.
papers.abstract_cn: 自动竞价在网络广告中起着至关重要的作用，自动调整竞价以优化广告商的商业目标。新兴的人工智能生成竞价（AI-Generated Bidding， AIGB）模式广泛采用生成建模来优化竞价策略，但由于离线数据集的模式覆盖有限，对任务状态的理解不足，阻碍了对最优策略的有效探索。具有先验世界知识和推理能力的大型语言模型（llm）为克服这些限制提供了一种有希望的方法。然而，直接将llm应用于自动投标任务面临着有限的数值精度、幻觉和推理延迟等固有挑战。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了AIGB-R1，这是一个分层自进化的自动招标框架，旨在通过法学硕士的推理能力增强人工智能生成的招标，包括一个用于宏观战略规划的高级规划师模块和一个用于细粒度决策的低级执行者模块。在此基础上，我们设计了一个以经验为导向的自我进化循环，能够根据积累的经验自主探索和优化策略。我们采用线下训练前和训练后对齐两阶段的流水线，构建了一个互动式的竞价仿真环境进行策略的推出。此外，我们提出解耦组相对策略优化（D-GRPO），通过优势解耦实现端到端优化。在大型公共数据集上的实验结果证明了AIGB-R1的有效性。
papers.ai_summary_en: AIGB-R1 addresses AI-generated auto-bidding’s limited offline mode coverage and weak task-state understanding, while avoiding direct LLM deployment issues such as poor numerical precision, hallucination, and latency. It introduces a hierarchical self-evolving framework where an LLM-based Planner generates macro-level bidding strategies and a low-level Executor performs fine-grained bid decisions, optimized through offline pre-training, simulation-based post-training alignment, and Decoupled Group Relative Policy Optimization (D-GRPO) with advantage decoupling. Experiments on a large-scale public dataset show that the framework improves autonomous strategy exploration and bidding effectiveness.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 论文针对生成式自动出价中离线数据模式覆盖不足、任务状态理解有限，以及直接用 LLM 决策存在数值精度、幻觉和延迟等问题，提出 AIGB-R1 分层自进化框架。该方法由高层 Planner 进行宏观策略规划、低层 Executor 执行细粒度出价，并通过模拟环境、两阶段训练与解耦 GRPO 实现经验驱动的端到端策略优化。大规模公开数据集实验表明，该方法能有效提升自动出价策略探索与优化效果。

papers.title: AdaFlash: Adaptive Speculative Decoding via On-Policy Distilled Diffusion Drafters
papers.authors: Yu-Yang Qian, Hao-Cong Wu, Chen Chen, Jiacheng Sun, Zhenhua Dong, Peng Zhao, Zhi-Hua Zhou
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding, in which a lightweight draft model first generates a draft sequence that is then verified in parallel by the target model, has become a prevalent paradigm for accelerating large language model inference. Recent work such as DFlash further boosts drafting efficiency by leveraging diffusion drafters, whose parallel denoising mechanism enables draft generation in a single forward pass. In this work, we uncover a central pitfall of diffusion drafters: bidirectional attention is a double-edged sword. On one hand, it endows the model with parallel generation and global contextual modeling capabilities; on the other hand, this inherent global dependency introduces high variance at both the domain-level and the token-level: acceptance rates fluctuate substantially across different domains, and draft token quality also varies heterogeneously at different token positions. To tackle this issue, we propose AdaFlash framework, comprising two components: (i) an on-policy distillation (OPD) algorithm with reverse-KL divergence tailored for diffusion drafters, bringing stable convergence and effectively reducing domain-level variance; and (ii) an adaptive length head that dynamically adjusts the candidate sequence length on the fly, substantially lowering the verification cost of the target model and handling token-level variance. Experiments demonstrate that AdaFlash consistently improves speedup rate during deployment, with especially significant gains in high-concurrency scenarios, achieving up to approximately 66% higher throughput than previous state-of-the-art methods.
papers.abstract_cn: 推测解码，其中轻量级草稿模型首先生成草稿序列，然后由目标模型并行验证，已经成为加速大型语言模型推理的流行范式。最近的工作，如DFlash进一步提高起草效率，利用扩散起草，其并行去噪机制，使草案产生在一个单一的向前通过。在这项工作中，我们发现了扩散起草人的一个中心陷阱：双向注意力是一把双刃剑。一方面，它赋予了模型并行生成和全局上下文建模能力；另一方面，这种固有的全局依赖性在域级和令牌级都引入了很高的方差：接受率在不同的域之间波动很大，并且草案令牌质量在不同的令牌位置也有不同的差异。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了AdaFlash框架，该框架由两个部分组成：(i)针对扩散起草器定制的具有逆kl散度的on-policy distillation （OPD）算法，带来稳定的收敛并有效降低域级方差；（ii）自适应长度头，动态调整候选序列长度，大大降低目标模型的验证成本并处理令牌级方差。实验表明，AdaFlash在部署过程中持续提高了加速率，在高并发场景中获得了特别显著的提升，比以前最先进的方法提高了大约66%的吞吐量。
papers.ai_summary_en: AdaFlash addresses the instability of diffusion-based speculative decoding drafters, where bidirectional attention causes high domain-level and token-level variance in acceptance rates and draft quality. It introduces on-policy distillation with reverse-KL divergence to stabilize drafter training and an adaptive length head that dynamically selects candidate sequence lengths to reduce target-model verification overhead. Experiments show consistent deployment speedups, especially under high concurrency, achieving up to ~66% higher throughput than prior state-of-the-art methods.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对扩散式草稿模型在推测解码中因双向注意力导致的域间接受率波动和不同位置草稿质量不均问题展开研究。  
其核心方法是提出 AdaFlash：用反向 KL 的在线策略蒸馏稳定训练扩散草稿模型以降低域级方差，并引入自适应长度头动态调整候选序列长度以处理 token 级方差、减少目标模型验证开销。  
实验显示该方法在部署中持续提升加速比，尤其在高并发场景下吞吐量较此前最先进方法最高提升约 66%。

papers.title: Wavefront Parallelization for Efficient Learned Image Compression
papers.authors: Shimon Murai, Fangzheng Lin, Kasidis Arunruangsirilert, Jiro Katto
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive context models are foundational for learned image compression,but they suffer from slow serial inference. Existing acceleration methods such as checkerboard context require architectural changes and retraining, thus are inapplicable to pre-trained models. We propose a completely training-free inference-time acceleration algorithm inspired by wavefront parallelism in video coding standards. Our method reorganizes inference into an optimal ``staggered'' wavefront order, minimizing sequential steps while maintaining exact autoregressive dependencies. Experimental results show our approach accelerates pre-trained autoregressive models (e.g., Cheng et al.) by more than $13\times$ while preserving the original rate-distortion performance. We also demonstrate that faster decoding is possible by trading off precise context dependencies. Source code will be available at https://github.com/tokkiwa/compressai-wavefront.
papers.abstract_cn: 自回归上下文模型是学习型图像压缩的基础，但它们在推理时存在序列化慢的问题。现有的加速方法，如棋盘式上下文，需要进行架构修改和重新训练，因此不能应用于预训练模型。我们提出了一种完全无需训练的推理时加速算法，其灵感来自视频编码标准中的波前并行。我们的方法将推理重新组织为最优的“错开”波前顺序，在保持精确自回归依赖的同时，将序列步骤最小化。实验结果表明，我们的方法可将预训练自回归模型（例如，Cheng 等人）的速度提升超过13倍，同时保持原始率失真性能。我们还展示了通过牺牲精确的上下文依赖，可以实现更快的解码速度。源代码将于 https://github.com/tokkiwa/compressai-wavefront 发布。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses the serial inference bottleneck of autoregressive context models in learned image compression, which makes decoding slow and prevents acceleration of pretrained models without retraining. It proposes a training-free wavefront-parallel decoding schedule that reorders latent symbol generation into an optimal staggered wavefront, exposing maximum parallelism while exactly respecting autoregressive dependencies, with optional relaxed dependencies for further speed. Experiments show over 13× speedup on pretrained autoregressive compressors such as Cheng et al. with unchanged rate–distortion performance, and additional gains when approximate contexts are permitted.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对自回归学习图像压缩模型串行推理慢、且现有加速方法需改架构和重训的问题，提出一种完全免训练的推理时波前并行调度方法。其核心洞见是借鉴视频编码中的 wavefront parallelism，将像素/块推理重排为最优“交错波前”顺序，在严格保持自回归依赖的同时最小化串行步数。实验表明，该方法可将 Cheng 等预训练模型加速 13 倍以上且率失真性能不变，并可通过放松上下文依赖进一步换取更快速解码。

papers.title: Semantic-Aware Data-Aided Channel Estimation with Large Language Models for MIMO Systems
papers.authors: Sojeong Park, Jaehyun Choi, Hyun Jong Yang
papers.abstract_en: Data-aided channel estimation enhances spectral efficiency by reusing detected symbols as virtual pilots. In this process, selecting only reliable symbols is crucial to prevent misdetected symbols from corrupting the channel estimate. However, conventional methods rely exclusively on physical-layer statistics. Beyond physical-layer information, transmitted payloads possess inherent semantic structures that can be exploited to resolve detection errors. In this paper, we propose a novel semantic-aware channel estimation framework for multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems that utilizes a fine-tuned large language model (LLM) to perform reliable symbol selection and correction based on semantic information. The framework employs a two-layer mechanism: one layer selects reliable decoded symbols through semantic verification, while the other selects accurately LLM-corrected symbols by cross-validating them against the received signal using physical-layer information. We prove that corrected symbols yield a strictly larger expected reduction in estimation error than initially correctly decoded symbols. Extensive simulations demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly outperforms conventional data-aided schemes in both normalized mean squared error and bit error rate, closely approaching the performance of an oracle estimator.
papers.abstract_cn: 数据辅助信道估计通过重用检测到的符号作为虚拟导频来提高频谱效率。在这个过程中，只选择可靠的符号是防止误检测符号破坏信道估计的关键。然而，传统的方法完全依赖于物理层统计。除了物理层信息之外，传输的有效载荷还具有固有的语义结构，可以利用这些语义结构来解决检测错误。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的多输入多输出（MIMO）系统的语义感知信道估计框架，该框架利用微调的大语言模型（LLM）来执行基于语义信息的可靠符号选择和校正。该框架采用两层机制：一层通过语义验证选择可靠的解码符号，另一层通过使用物理层信息对接收信号进行交叉验证，选择精确的llm校正符号。我们证明了修正后的符号比最初正确解码的符号产生更大的估计误差预期减少。大量的仿真表明，所提出的框架在归一化均方误差和误码率方面都明显优于传统的数据辅助方案，接近oracle估计器的性能。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses reliable data-aided channel estimation in MIMO systems, where reusing detected symbols as virtual pilots is limited by misdetections that can corrupt the estimate. It proposes a semantic-aware framework that uses a fine-tuned large language model to verify and correct decoded symbols, combining semantic validation with physical-layer cross-validation against the received signal. Theory and simulations show that LLM-corrected symbols can reduce estimation error more than initially correct symbols, yielding substantially lower NMSE and BER and approaching oracle-aided performance.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对MIMO数据辅助信道估计中误检符号会污染虚拟导频、而传统方法仅依赖物理层统计的问题，本文提出利用微调大语言模型挖掘传输载荷语义来筛选和纠正符号的语义感知信道估计框架。其核心洞见是语义信息可辅助识别并修复检测错误，并通过“语义验证选择可靠符号 + 物理层交叉验证选择LLM纠正符号”的双层机制提升估计质量，且理论上证明纠正符号能带来更大的期望误差下降。仿真结果显示，该方法在归一化均方误差和误码率上显著优于传统数据辅助方案，性能接近理想Oracle估计器。

papers.title: Agents in the Wild: Where Research Meets Deployment
papers.authors: Grace Hui Yang, Pranav N. Venkit, Hooman Sedghamiz, Enrico Santus, Victor Dibia, Ioana Baldini
papers.abstract_en: Agentic systems large language model (LLM) based architectures capable of reasoning, planning, acting, and coordinating with tools and other agents are rapidly transitioning from research prototypes to production scale deployments across domains such as software engineering, scientific discovery, and finance. While academic work has emphasized benchmarks and algorithmic innovation, deployment raises new challenges around robustness, safety, and reliability. This tutorial brings together researchers and practitioners to explore advances in reasoning and planning, multi agent coordination, and evaluation, highlighting open challenges arising from deployment experience. Through applied case studies in pharmaceutical discovery and financial systems, we analyze common design patterns that make agentic systems successful, and discuss practical mitigation strategies for failure modes, such as verification pipelines, fallback mechanisms, and human in the loop supervision. Attendees will gain a comprehensive view of the field along with concrete design patterns, evaluation checklists, and templates for safe and reliable deployment across industries.
papers.abstract_cn: 代理系统基于大型语言模型（LLM）的体系结构，能够推理、规划、行动，并与工具和其他代理协调，正在迅速从研究原型过渡到跨领域的生产规模部署，如软件工程、科学发现和金融。虽然学术工作强调基准和算法创新，但部署带来了围绕鲁棒性、安全性和可靠性的新挑战。本教程将研究人员和实践者聚集在一起，探讨推理和规划、多智能体协调和评估方面的进展，强调部署经验中出现的开放挑战。通过对药物发现和金融系统的应用案例研究，我们分析了使代理系统成功的常见设计模式，并讨论了失效模式的实用缓解策略，如验证管道、回退机制和人在循环中的监督。与会者将获得该领域的全面视图，以及具体的设计模式、评估清单和跨行业安全可靠部署的模板。
papers.ai_summary_en: This tutorial addresses the gap between benchmark-driven LLM agent research and production deployment challenges such as robustness, safety, reliability, and multi-agent coordination. It synthesizes applied case studies from pharmaceutical discovery and finance to extract design patterns and mitigation strategies, including verification pipelines, fallback mechanisms, and human-in-the-loop supervision. The result is a practical framework of evaluation checklists and deployment templates for building safe, reliable agentic LLM systems in real-world industrial settings.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM智能体系统在真实部署中面临的鲁棒性、安全性和可靠性问题，弥补了学术研究偏重基准与算法、产业落地强调稳定运行之间的鸿沟。其核心方法是结合推理规划、多智能体协调与评估，通过制药发现和金融系统案例分析成功设计模式，并提出验证流水线、回退机制和人在环监督等失败缓解策略。成果为跨行业安全部署智能体系统提供了设计模式、评估清单和模板，推动LLM智能体从原型走向生产。

papers.title: HACO: Hedged Agent Computing for Reliable LLM Systems
papers.authors: Enhan Li, Hongyang Du
papers.abstract_en: As large language model (LLM) agents move from isolated prompting to longhorizon workflows, failures increasingly arise at the role-to-instance binding boundary, where task-specific role requests must be assigned to concrete agent instances under current service, network, and query conditions. Existing agent system research has improved role specialization, workflow topology, memory, and tool use, but often assumes a fixed stable execution environment. This assumption limits deployed reliability, because the same role request can exhibit different latency, failure probability, and output quality across agent instances operating under different service regions and network conditions. We propose Hedged Agent Computing (HACO), a runtime control scheme that treats each role request as a reliability-constrained selection problem over candidate agent instances, each coupling a role type, an LLM, and a concrete execution environment. Different from routing, HACO adaptively selects a hedge set of candidates for each invocation. Its allocation rule combines optimistic ranking, which prioritizes candidates with high estimated quality, reliability, and informative uncertainty, with conservative reliability accumulation, which stops selection only after the hedge set reaches a target success probability. Through experience harvesting, HACO updates candidate and link profiles from all executed candidate traces, including quality, success, latency, and network statistics. Experiments on various benchmarks, together with runtime degradation studies, show that HACO improves robustness and output quality under changing deployment conditions, while using lower token and latency cost than exhaustive parallel execution.
papers.abstract_cn: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）代理从孤立的提示转移到长期工作流，在角色到实例绑定边界上出现的故障越来越多，其中必须将特定于任务的角色请求分配给当前服务、网络和查询条件下的具体代理实例。现有的代理系统研究已经改进了角色专门化、工作流拓扑、内存和工具使用，但通常假设一个固定的稳定执行环境。这种假设限制了部署的可靠性，因为在不同服务区域和网络条件下运行的代理实例之间，相同的角色请求可能表现出不同的延迟、故障概率和输出质量。我们提出了对冲代理计算（HACO），这是一种运行时控制方案，它将每个角色请求视为候选代理实例的可靠性约束选择问题，每个实例耦合一个角色类型、一个LLM和一个具体的执行环境。与路由不同，HACO自适应地为每次调用选择一组对冲候选。其分配规则将乐观排序和保守可靠性积累相结合，前者优先考虑估计质量、可靠性和信息不确定性较高的候选对象，后者只有在套期保值集达到目标成功概率后才停止选择。通过经验收集，HACO从所有执行的候选跟踪中更新候选和链接配置文件，包括质量、成功、延迟和网络统计信息。在各种基准测试中进行的实验以及运行时退化研究表明，在不断变化的部署条件下，HACO提高了鲁棒性和输出质量，同时比穷举并行执行使用更低的令牌和延迟成本。
papers.ai_summary_en: HACO addresses reliability failures in long-horizon LLM agent systems at the role-to-instance binding boundary, where the same role request may have different quality, latency, and failure behavior across candidate agent instances and deployment conditions. It formulates each invocation as a reliability-constrained hedge-set selection problem, combining optimistic candidate ranking using estimated quality, reliability, and uncertainty with conservative stopping once a target success probability is reached, while continuously updating profiles from execution traces. Experiments and degradation studies show that HACO improves robustness and output quality under changing service/network conditions with lower token and latency cost than exhaustive parallel execution.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该文针对LLM智能体长流程工作流中“角色请求到具体实例绑定”导致的可靠性问题，指出同一角色在不同服务区域、网络条件和实例下会表现出差异化的延迟、失败率和输出质量。其核心方法HACO将每次调用建模为可靠性约束下的候选实例选择，自适应构造对冲候选集，结合乐观排序与保守可靠性累积，并通过执行轨迹持续更新候选和链路画像。实验表明，在部署条件变化和运行时降级场景下，HACO能提升鲁棒性与输出质量，同时比穷举并行执行降低token和延迟开销。

papers.title: Keeping the Cache Warm Pays: Keepalive Economics for Agentic Workloads
papers.authors: Maxim Khailo
papers.abstract_en: Frontier LLM providers cache a prompt's processed prefix so that a follow-up request sharing it pays ~10% of the input price and skips most of the prefill latency. Agentic workloads systematically destroy this benefit: the agent sends a request, runs a tool or waits for approval for minutes, and by the time the follow-up is sent the cached prefix has been evicted, so the agent pays the full prefill again. A client-side keepalive, replaying the prefix on a timer during the pause, prevents this, and it is individually rational: across Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and DeepSeek we show that a keepalive holds the prefix warm through gaps where idle baselines are evicted, cutting the post-pause request cost by up to 12.5x. The strategic question is the ping frequency, and it has a clean answer: keepalive cost falls monotonically in the interval, so the economical choice is the largest interval safely under the provider's TTL, about 4 minutes at Anthropic's 5-minute TTL rather than the 30-second convention, and the strategy breaks even against a re-prefill at idle ~tau(w/r - 1) (~46 min for Anthropic, ~36 min for OpenAI and DeepSeek). Because the benefit is real and bounded only by each user's own bill, rational adoption is universal adoption; and since cache residency is priced per read rather than per token-hour, a keepalive-saturated tier gives LRU eviction nothing to rank. We argue this externality will push providers to meter cache residency directly, and one already does. We derive the operator's policy until then.
papers.abstract_cn: Frontier LLM提供商缓存提示符的处理前缀，以便后续请求共享它支付输入价格的10%，并跳过大部分预填充延迟。代理工作负载系统地破坏了这种好处：代理发送请求，运行工具或等待批准几分钟，并且在发送后续消息时，缓存的前缀已被清除，因此代理再次支付完整的预填充。客户端keepalive，在暂停期间在计时器上重放前缀，可以防止这种情况，并且它是单独合理的：在Anthropic， OpenAI，谷歌和DeepSeek中，我们表明keepalive通过空闲基线被驱逐的间隙保持前缀温暖，将暂停后请求成本降低了12.5倍。策略问题是ping频率，它有一个清晰的答案：保持存活成本在间隔内单调下降，因此经济的选择是在提供商的TTL下安全的最大间隔，在Anthropic的5分钟TTL下约4分钟，而不是30秒惯例，并且策略在空闲时重新预填充时达到平衡~tau(w/r - 1) （Anthropic为~46分钟，OpenAI和DeepSeek为~36分钟）。由于收益是真实的，并且只受每个用户自己的账单的限制，因此合理的采用是普遍采用；由于缓存驻留是按每次读取而不是按令牌小时定价的，因此保持存活饱和的层不会对LRU驱逐进行排名。我们认为，这种外部性将推动提供商直接测量缓存驻留，而一家提供商已经这样做了。在此之前，我们推导出操作者的策略。
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Measurement data and harness: https://github.com/mempko/pi (scripts/cache-research)
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses cache inefficiency in LLM serving for agentic workloads, where long pauses between agent steps cause prompt-prefix caches to expire and force costly full prefills on follow-up requests. It proposes and economically analyzes client-side keepalive pings that periodically replay the cached prefix, deriving the optimal interval as the largest safe value below the provider’s TTL and characterizing break-even points against re-prefilling. Across Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and DeepSeek, keepalives can reduce post-pause request costs by up to 12.5×, suggesting rational widespread adoption and pressure on providers to explicitly meter cache residency.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对智能体工作负载中因工具调用或等待审批导致提示前缀缓存被逐出、后续请求需重新支付完整预填充成本与延迟的问题。核心方法是客户端按定时器重放前缀以保持缓存“热”，并通过经济建模证明最优保活间隔应接近但低于提供商TTL（如Anthropic约4分钟），而非高频30秒惯例。结果显示该策略可将暂停后的请求成本最高降低12.5倍，并可能推动提供商从按读取计价转向直接计量缓存驻留。

papers.title: ARBITER: Guarded Agentic Control for SLO-Oriented Kubernetes Remediation
papers.authors: Pooyan Habibi, Alberto Leon-Garcia
papers.abstract_en: Maintaining service-level objectives (SLOs) on Kubernetes microservices remains difficult because autoscalers observe coarse resource metrics, recent SLO controllers often depend on custom telemetry, and unconstrained agentic operators cannot safely mutate production clusters. We present ARBITER, a guarded control plane for SLO-oriented Kubernetes remediation. ARBITER builds an OpenTelemetry-native causal resource graph, assembles bounded DiagnosisContext objects, and exposes a finite typed-action interface that separates planning from execution. The same interface supports deterministic planners and an LLM-backed planning harness, with deterministic schema checks, policy gates, resource/disruption budgets, approval, and bounded execution forming the safety substrate. We evaluate ARBITER on a 4-node Kubernetes cluster using DeathStarBench Social Network and Online Boutique. The evaluation tests two forms of SLO-oriented control that resource autoscaling alone does not provide: selecting the right remediation action and selecting the right downstream target. For bad-image deployment regressions, ARBITER selects rollback_canary in all ten CPU-burn and pure-latency runs; HPA either scales the faulty image or never triggers. For a downstream critical-path fault, the user-visible breach appears at the frontend, but trace evidence identifies home-timeline-service as the remediable bottleneck. Deterministic ARBITER and a live approval-gated Sonnet harness target that downstream service in every replicate, whereas HPA/resource-only control never does. Additional experiments cover guarded placement repair, Online Boutique portability, adversarial safety rejection, offline multi-model replay, and KWOK-based control-plane scale evidence. We release the controller, replay corpus, harnesses, safety tests, and figure artifacts: https://github.com/pooyan/arbiter.
papers.abstract_cn: 在Kubernetes微服务上维护服务水平目标（SLO）仍然很困难，因为自动伸缩器观察到粗糙的资源指标，最近的SLO控制器通常依赖于自定义遥测，而不受约束的代理操作员无法安全地改变生产集群。我们提出了ARBITER，一个用于面向慢速Kubernetes修复的防护控制平面。ARBITER构建了一个opentelement原生的因果资源图，组装了有界的DiagnosisContext对象，并公开了一个有限的类型操作接口，将计划与执行分开。相同的接口支持确定性规划器和llm支持的规划工具，具有确定性模式检查、策略门、资源/中断预算、批准和有界执行，形成安全基板。我们在一个4节点的Kubernetes集群上使用DeathStarBench Social Network和Online Boutique来评估ARBITER。评估测试了资源自动伸缩本身无法提供的两种面向低速运行的控制形式：选择正确的补救操作和选择正确的下游目标。对于坏映像部署回归，ARBITER在所有10次cpu消耗和纯延迟运行中选择rollback_canary；HPA要么缩放错误的图像，要么永远不会触发。对于下游关键路径故障，用户可见的破坏出现在前端，但跟踪证据表明，家庭时间线服务是可补救的瓶颈。Deterministic ARBITER和live approval-gated Sonnet harness以每个复制中的下游服务为目标，而HPA/仅资源控制从不这样做。其他实验包括保护放置修复、在线精品可移植性、对抗性安全拒绝、离线多模型重播和基于kwok的控制平面尺度证据。我们发布控制器、重播语料库、线束、安全测试和图形工件：https://github.com/pooyan/arbiter。
papers.ai_summary_en: ARBITER addresses safe SLO-oriented remediation in Kubernetes, where conventional autoscalers rely on coarse metrics, SLO controllers often require custom telemetry, and unconstrained agentic operators can unsafely mutate production clusters. It builds an OpenTelemetry-native causal resource graph, creates bounded DiagnosisContext objects, and exposes a finite typed-action interface that separates planning from execution while enforcing schema checks, policy gates, budgets, approval, and bounded execution for deterministic or LLM-backed planners. Evaluations on DeathStarBench and Online Boutique show ARBITER reliably selects correct rollback or downstream remediation targets and satisfies safety and scale constraints, outperforming HPA/resource-only control that fails to identify or fix user-visible SLO breaches.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对 Kubernetes 微服务 SLO 修复中自动扩缩观测粗糙、依赖定制遥测且无约束智能体操作不安全的问题，ARBITER 提出一种受控控制平面，通过 OpenTelemetry 因果资源图、受限诊断上下文和有限类型动作接口，将修复规划与安全执行分离。其核心洞见是用 schema 校验、策略门、资源/扰动预算、审批和有界执行构成安全底座，使确定性规划器或 LLM 规划器只能在受授权范围内操作。实验表明，在 DeathStarBench 和 Online Boutique 上，ARBITER 能准确选择回滚或定位下游瓶颈目标，而 HPA 常失效，并进一步验证了安全拒绝、可移植性与控制平面可扩展性。

papers.title: InstantInfer: Enabling Fast LLM Cold Start with Communicating Finite Automata
papers.authors: Yitao Yuan, Yongchao He, Shaoke Fang, Wenfei Wu
papers.abstract_en: Cold starts in large language model (LLM) inference services significantly affect user experience, yet they remain inefficient due to sequential initialization and a massive number of fine-grained I/O requests issued by complex software components. Although refactoring the program can yield advantages such as concurrent execution and I/O merging, this approach is error-prone and carries correctness risks when dealing with massive, heterogeneous components. We propose the Communicating Finite Automata (CFA) abstraction to systematically analyze cross-component optimization opportunities, and design a programming framework to enable CFA-based component program refactoring. This framework preserves the original sequential program structure while enabling safe concurrent component execution. We prove the correctness of the program refactoring. We apply the CFA abstraction and framework to refactor process tree creation, tensor loading, and model switching in vLLM, forming a new cold-start system named InstantInfer. Extensive experiments demonstrate that InstantInfer substantially accelerates LLM cold starts (achieving up to 7.2 times speedup) and exhibits robustness across diverse GPUs, workloads, and scales.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）推理服务中的冷启动会显著影响用户体验，但由于顺序初始化和复杂软件组件发出的大量细粒度I/O请求，冷启动仍然效率低下。尽管重构程序可以产生诸如并发执行和I/O合并等优点，但这种方法容易出错，并且在处理大量异构组件时存在正确性风险。我们提出了通信有限自动机（CFA）抽象来系统地分析跨组件优化机会，并设计了一个编程框架来实现基于CFA的组件程序重构。该框架保留了原始的顺序程序结构，同时支持安全的并发组件执行。证明了程序重构的正确性。我们应用CFA抽象和框架重构了vLLM中的流程树创建、张量加载和模型切换，形成了一个名为InstantInfer的新冷启动系统。大量的实验表明，InstantInfer大大加速了LLM冷启动（实现高达7.2倍的加速），并在不同的gpu、工作负载和规模上表现出鲁棒性。
papers.ai_summary_en: InstantInfer addresses slow LLM inference cold starts caused by sequential initialization and many fine-grained I/O operations across heterogeneous system components. It introduces a Communicating Finite Automata abstraction and a provably correct programming framework that refactors components to enable safe concurrency and I/O merging while preserving original program structure. Applied to vLLM for process creation, tensor loading, and model switching, InstantInfer achieves up to 7.2× cold-start speedup with robustness across GPUs, workloads, and scales.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM 推理服务冷启动慢的问题，指出其瓶颈在于顺序初始化以及复杂组件产生的大量细粒度 I/O 请求。作者提出“通信有限自动机”（CFA）抽象和配套编程框架，在保持原程序结构的前提下安全地重构 vLLM 的进程创建、张量加载和模型切换等流程，实现跨组件并发与 I/O 合并。实验表明，InstantInfer 可将 LLM 冷启动最高加速 7.2 倍，并在多种 GPU、负载和规模下保持鲁棒性。

papers.title: Find Before You Fine-Tune: A Diagnostic Study of Small LLMs for Cybersecurity QA
papers.authors: Shaswata Mitra, Subash Neupane, Trisha Chakraborty, Himanshu Tripathi, Sudip Mittal, Aritran Piplai, Shahram Rahimi
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly fine-tuned for critical-domain Question-Answering (QA), yet choosing which small model to adapt, before paying the cost of adaptation, remains difficult. Fine-tuning can improve domain alignment, but it may also erode prior knowledge, weaken instruction-following, or increase hallucination, especially when labeled data are scarce or rapidly evolving as in cybersecurity. We present FiT (Find before Fine-Tune), a task-oriented diagnostic framework that characterizes small LLMs along three capabilities required for cybersecurity QA: vocabulary recognition, parametric knowledge, and contextualization of retrieved information. Using FiT, we conduct an empirical study of five open-weight 7-billion-parameter models under two fine-tuning regimes. We find that fine-tuning does not uniformly help: it consistently degrades vocabulary and parametric knowledge in small models, and the two regimes trade off differently. Knowledge-focused tuning causes moderate, rank-preserving degradation, whereas instruction-focused tuning collapses measured knowledge through induced abstention, inverting the knowledge ranking while leaving retrieval-grounded contextualization essentially intact. We quantify these regime-specific patterns with rank-correlation analysis and show that pre-fine-tuning FiT scores anticipate the direction of post-tuning change. Our results suggest that task-oriented diagnosis can screen out unsuitable models, avoid unnecessary fine-tuning, and support safer deployment of small LLMs in cybersecurity QA pipelines.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）越来越适合关键领域的问答（QA），但在支付适应成本之前，选择适应哪个小模型仍然很困难。微调可以改善领域一致性，但它也可能侵蚀先前的知识，削弱指令遵循，或增加幻觉，特别是当标记数据稀缺或快速发展时，如网络安全。我们提出了FiT (Find before Fine-Tune)，这是一个面向任务的诊断框架，它描述了小型llm在网络安全QA所需的三个能力：词汇识别、参数化知识和检索信息的上下文化。利用FiT，我们在两种微调机制下对五个开重70亿参数模型进行了实证研究。我们发现微调并不是一致地有帮助：它在小模型中不断地降低词汇和参数化知识，并且这两种机制的权衡是不同的。以知识为中心的调优导致适度的、保持等级的退化，而以指令为中心的调优通过诱导弃权使测量的知识崩溃，颠倒了知识等级，同时使基于检索的语境化基本保持不变。我们用秩相关分析量化了这些特定模式，并表明微调前的FiT分数预测了调整后的变化方向。我们的研究结果表明，面向任务的诊断可以筛选出不合适的模型，避免不必要的微调，并支持在网络安全QA管道中更安全地部署小型llm。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the problem of selecting small open-weight LLMs for cybersecurity question answering without incurring unnecessary or harmful fine-tuning costs, since adaptation can erode knowledge, instruction-following, or increase abstention/hallucination. It proposes FiT, a task-oriented diagnostic framework that probes pre-tuning capabilities in vocabulary recognition, parametric cybersecurity knowledge, and retrieval-grounded contextualization, and applies it to five 7B models under knowledge-focused and instruction-focused fine-tuning regimes. The study finds that fine-tuning often degrades vocabulary and parametric knowledge—instruction tuning especially induces abstention and inverts knowledge rankings while leaving contextualization intact—and shows that pre-tuning FiT scores can predict post-tuning changes, enabling model screening and safer deployment.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对网络安全问答中小模型“该选哪个再微调”的决策难题，指出微调可能损害已有知识并加剧幻觉。作者提出 FiT 诊断框架，在微调前从词汇识别、参数化知识和检索上下文利用三方面评估 7B 开源模型，并比较知识型与指令型微调。结果显示微调并不总是有益：它会普遍削弱词汇和知识，指令型微调还会因诱导拒答导致知识排名反转，而预诊断分数可预测微调后变化，从而帮助筛选模型、减少不必要微调并提升部署安全性。

papers.title: Rationale-Guided Knowledge Distillation for Cross-Lingual Stance Detection
papers.authors: Qiuli Zhou, Jingyuan Yao, Shengeng Tang, Hongzhi Chen, Jun Tang, Richang Hong
papers.abstract_en: Stance detection aims to identify whether a text expresses a favorable or opposing attitude toward a given target, and serves as an important task for various downstream applications. Although existing studies have achieved strong performance in monolingual settings, especially in English, many low-resource languages such as Catalan still lack sufficient annotated data for training effective models. Cross-lingual stance detection alleviates this problem by transferring stance knowledge from resource-rich languages to low-resource languages. However, most existing methods mainly rely on semantic alignment between texts and targets, while ignoring the reasoning process required for reliable stance inference. Although Large Language Models provide strong reasoning ability, their high computational cost and inference latency limit practical deployment. To address these limitations, we propose a rationale-guided knowledge distillation framework for cross-lingual stance detection. Specifically, we use Chain-of-Thought prompting to guide Large Language Models in generating informative rationales, and distill the resulting reasoning knowledge into a compact student model. We further design a dual-path distillation mechanism to align rationale-enhanced and rationale-free representations, together with their prediction distributions. In addition, two contrastive learning strategies are introduced to improve stance discrimination. Experiments on multilingual benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms competitive baselines.
papers.abstract_cn: 姿态检测的目的是识别文本是否表达了对给定目标的赞成或反对态度，是各种下游应用的重要任务。尽管现有的研究在单语环境下，特别是在英语中取得了很好的表现，但许多低资源语言，如加泰罗尼亚语，仍然缺乏足够的带注释的数据来训练有效的模型。跨语言立场检测通过将立场知识从资源丰富的语言转移到资源匮乏的语言，缓解了这一问题。然而，大多数现有方法主要依赖于文本和目标之间的语义对齐，而忽略了可靠的立场推理所需的推理过程。尽管大型语言模型提供了强大的推理能力，但其高昂的计算成本和推理延迟限制了实际部署。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了一个理性引导的跨语言立场检测知识蒸馏框架。具体来说，我们使用思维链提示来指导大型语言模型生成信息基础，并将结果推理知识提炼成紧凑的学生模型。我们进一步设计了一种双路径蒸馏机制，以对齐理性增强和无理性表示及其预测分布。此外，本文还介绍了两种对比学习策略来提高学生的立场辨别能力。在多语言基准测试上的实验表明，我们的方法始终优于竞争基准。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper tackles low-resource cross-lingual stance detection, where scarce annotations and reliance on shallow semantic alignment limit performance, while LLMs offer strong reasoning but are too costly for efficient serving. The proposed method uses Chain-of-Thought prompting to generate rationales from an LLM and distills this reasoning into a compact student via dual-path alignment of rationale-enhanced and rationale-free representations, prediction distributions, and contrastive stance discrimination. Experiments on multilingual benchmarks show consistent improvements over competitive baselines, enabling more effective transfer to low-resource languages such as Catalan.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对低资源语言跨语言立场检测中现有方法偏重语义对齐、缺乏推理过程且大模型部署成本高的问题。提出理由引导的知识蒸馏框架：通过 CoT 让 LLM 生成立场推理依据，并用双路径蒸馏将理由增强表征、无推理表征及预测分布迁移到轻量学生模型，同时引入对比学习增强判别性。多语言实验表明该方法稳定优于强基线，为兼顾跨语言迁移效果与高效推理服务提供了有效路径。

papers.title: Intelligent Multi-UAV Navigation in ITNTNs: A Hierarchical LLM Approach
papers.authors: Zijiang Yan, Hao Zhou, Wael Jaafar, Jianhua Pei, Ping Wang, Halim Yanikomeroglu, Hina Tabassum
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of high-speed Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) in 3D aerial highways necessitates robust coordination of physical flight kinematics and multi-tier network handovers. While Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) offers rapid tactical control, it lacks the zero-shot strategic reasoning required to quickly adapt to dynamic Integrated Terrestrial and Non-Terrestrial Networks (ITNTNs). Conversely, Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at semantic reasoning but suffer from high inference latency, rendering them unsuitable for real-time aerodynamic control. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel Hierarchical LLM-driven control framework. A massive cloud-based LLM deployed on a High-Altitude Platform Station (HAPS) manages slow-timescale global load balancing, while lightweight edge-LLMs on individual UAVs translate local observations into tactical sub-goals. These sub-goals guide a fast-timescale physical DRL controller to execute collision-free, handover-aware trajectories. Simulation results demonstrate that our agentic architecture significantly reduces collision rates and improves aggregate system throughput compared to existing baselines.
papers.abstract_cn: 高速无人驾驶飞行器（uav）在三维空中高速公路上的部署需要物理飞行运动学和多层网络切换的鲁棒协调。虽然深度强化学习（DRL）提供了快速的战术控制，但它缺乏快速适应动态综合地面和非地面网络（ITNTNs）所需的零射击战略推理。相反，大型语言模型（llm）在语义推理方面表现出色，但存在较高的推理延迟，因此不适合实时空气动力学控制。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了一种新的分层llm驱动控制框架。部署在高空平台站（HAPS）上的大型基于云的LLM管理慢时间尺度的全球负载平衡，而单个无人机上的轻型边缘LLM将局部观测转化为战术子目标。这些子目标指导快速时间尺度物理DRL控制器执行无碰撞、切换感知的轨迹。仿真结果表明，与现有基线相比，我们的代理架构显著降低了碰撞率，提高了系统的总吞吐量。
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted by IEEE GLOBECOM 2026
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses real-time multi-UAV navigation in integrated terrestrial and non-terrestrial networks, where controllers must jointly satisfy collision-free flight kinematics and multi-tier handover/load-balancing constraints. It proposes a hierarchical LLM-serving architecture in which a cloud/HAPS-hosted large LLM performs slow-timescale global reasoning, while lightweight edge LLMs on UAVs generate tactical subgoals that condition a fast DRL controller for low-latency trajectory execution. Simulations show reduced collision rates and higher aggregate system throughput than baselines, indicating that cloud–edge LLM decomposition can make LLM-assisted UAV coordination practical.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文面向多无人机在空天地一体化网络中需同时保证实时避障控制与多层网络切换的问题，解决DRL缺乏战略推理而LLM推理延迟过高的矛盾。其核心方法是提出分层LLM驱动框架：由HAPS上的大模型进行慢速全局负载均衡，机载轻量LLM生成战术子目标，再交由快速DRL控制器执行无碰撞、切换感知轨迹。仿真结果表明，该架构相比现有基线显著降低碰撞率并提升系统总吞吐量。

papers.title: Using Fine-Tuned LLMs to Identify Indicators of Vulnerability in UK Police Incident Logs
papers.authors: Sam Relins, Daniel Birks
papers.abstract_en: Purpose: Understanding how much of routine policing involves vulnerable people could inform resourcing, training, and multi-agency response, yet administrative data provide limited insight. We explore whether an LLM-based classification pipeline, developed on open-source US police data, can be adapted to estimate the prevalence of four vulnerability indicators - mental ill health, substance misuse, alcohol dependence, and homelessness - in UK police incident narratives, and when outputs can be treated as defensible measurements.   Methods: We analyse nearly 3,000 de-identified incident logs from a UK police force, using a multi-stage pipeline combining repeated model inference, label aggregation, structured human review, and statistical correction. The pipeline runs on a locally hosted open-weight LLM, reflecting the secure environments police must work in.   Results: LLMs can produce meaningful, if imperfect, prevalence estimates at scale. Mental ill health indicators are present in approximately one in five incidents, with lower prevalence for other indicators. However, naive LLM deployment is unreliable: single-pass classifications are unstable, and aggregated outputs systematically over-assign indicators relative to human judgement. Correcting these biases required substantial human input and statistical adjustment, leaving considerable uncertainty.   Conclusions: While LLMs can extract information from unstructured police data, their outputs cannot be treated as valid measurements without careful methodological support. At the population level, defensible estimates are achievable but resource-intensive; at the individual level, errors remain frequent and unpredictable, limiting suitability for operational decisions. This study highlights both the potential and the constraints of LLM-based measurement in applied settings.
papers.abstract_cn: 目的：了解日常警务涉及弱势群体的程度可以为资源、培训和多机构响应提供信息，但行政数据提供的见解有限。我们探讨了基于法学硕士的分类管道（基于开源的美国警察数据）是否可以用于估计英国警察事件叙述中四个脆弱性指标（精神疾病、药物滥用、酒精依赖和无家可归）的流行程度，以及何时可以将输出视为可辩护的测量。方法：我们分析了来自英国警察部队的近3000份去识别事件日志，使用了多级管道，结合了重复的模型推断、标签聚合、结构化的人工审查和统计校正。该管道在本地托管的开放重量LLM上运行，反映了警察必须工作的安全环境。结果：llm可以在规模上产生有意义的患病率估计，如果不完美的话。大约五分之一的事件中存在精神疾病指标，其他指标的流行率较低。然而，朴素的LLM部署是不可靠的：单次分类是不稳定的，并且汇总输出系统地过度分配相对于人类判断的指标。纠正这些偏见需要大量的人力投入和统计调整，留下了相当大的不确定性。结论：虽然法学硕士可以从非结构化的警察数据中提取信息，但如果没有仔细的方法支持，他们的输出不能被视为有效的测量。在人口一级，合理的估计是可以实现的，但需要大量资源；在个人层面上，错误仍然频繁且不可预测，限制了操作决策的适用性。这项研究强调了在应用环境中基于llm的测量的潜力和限制。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the problem of estimating the prevalence of vulnerability indicators—mental ill health, substance misuse, alcohol dependence, and homelessness—in unstructured UK police incident logs, where administrative data provide limited measurement. It adapts an LLM-based classification pipeline using a locally hosted open-weight model with repeated inference, label aggregation, structured human review, and statistical correction to produce defensible population-level estimates. The study finds meaningful but imperfect prevalence signals, including mental ill health in roughly one in five incidents, while showing that naive single-pass LLM classification is unstable and biased, making individual-level outputs unsuitable for operational decisions without substantial methodological oversight.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对英国警方事件日志中脆弱性指标（精神健康、药物滥用、酒精依赖、无家可归）难以从非结构化文本中可靠度量的问题，探索在安全本地环境下用微调/开放权重 LLM 进行大规模分类与流行率估计。其核心方法是结合重复模型推理、标签聚合、结构化人工审查和统计校正，形成可辩护的测量流程，而非依赖单次 LLM 输出。结果显示，LLM 可在群体层面给出有意义的估计（如精神健康指标约出现在五分之一事件中），但存在不稳定和系统性过度标注，需大量人工与统计修正；个体层面错误仍频繁，不适合直接用于执法决策。

papers.title: Understanding the Impact of Linguistic Realization Choices on LLM Stance with Causal Tracing
papers.authors: Langchen Huang, Sebastian Padó, Franziska Weeber
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are known to be sensitive to prompt and input formulations. However, existing studies have focused on lexical realization and largely ignored constructional choice. This paper studies whether linguistic construction can systematically shift LLM decisions and where these shifts can be causally localized inside the model. We use political stance judgment as a meaning-sensitive case study and extend an English political statements dataset, resulting in six controlled linguistic rewrite types that preserve or invert the meaning of a statement. Experiments on four open-weight models show that stance instability affect both meaning-preserving and meaning-inversing rewrites. Because output shifts reveal that rewrites affect stance, but not where in the model, we apply activation patching, where activations from the original statement are substituted into the forward pass for the rewritten statement and measure which components recover the original stance distribution. The results show that mid-to-late decoder layers, especially block outputs at the final prompt position, provide the strongest restoration signal.
papers.abstract_cn: 众所周知，大型语言模型（llm）对提示和输入公式非常敏感。然而，现有的研究主要集中在词汇实现上，而忽略了结构选择。本文研究了语言结构是否可以系统地改变LLM决策，以及这些变化在模型内部的因果定位。我们使用政治立场判断作为一个意义敏感的案例研究，并扩展了一个英语政治声明数据集，产生了六种受控的语言重写类型，这些类型保留或颠倒了声明的意义。在四种开权模型上的实验表明，姿态不稳定性对意义保留改写和意义反转改写都有影响。由于输出位移显示重写影响姿态，但不影响模型中的位置，因此我们应用激活补丁，其中原始语句的激活被替换为重写语句的前传，并测量哪些组件恢复了原始姿态分布。结果表明，中后期解码器层，特别是最终提示位置的块输出，提供了最强的恢复信号。
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper investigates whether linguistic construction choices, beyond lexical variation, systematically shift LLM political stance judgments and where such effects are causally localized. It introduces six controlled meaning-preserving and meaning-inverting rewrites of political statements and applies activation patching, substituting activations from the original statement into rewritten inputs to identify components that restore the original stance distribution. Across four open-weight models, both paraphrastic and meaning-inverting constructions cause stance instability, with mid-to-late decoder layers—especially block outputs at the final prompt position—most strongly mediating the effect.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文研究语言构式/句式选择（而非仅词汇改写）是否会系统性改变 LLM 的政治立场判断，并尝试在模型内部因果定位这些影响。作者构造了六类保义或反义的受控重写数据，并采用激活补丁方法，将原句激活注入重写句的前向传播，以检测哪些组件能恢复原始立场分布。实验在四个开源模型上发现，句式改写会显著引发立场偏移，而中后层 decoder、尤其是最终提示位置的 block 输出，对恢复原判断贡献最大。

papers.title: Look Less, Think Faster: Joint Token-Compute Adaptation for Multimodal LLMs
papers.authors: Pengcheng Wang, Zhiquan Wang, Jayoung Lee, Zhuoyan Xu, Ran Xu, Saurabh Bagchi, Yin Li, Somali Chaterji
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently demonstrated strong performance across vision-language tasks. However, their high inference cost, arising from both the large number of input visual tokens and the heavy computation of the large language model (LLM), remains a key barrier to practical deployment. Recent work attempts to reduce the cost by adaptively optimizing individual dimensions, e.g., pruning redundant visual tokens or skipping LLM layers and heads. Nonetheless, prior approaches typically treat these dimensions independently and overlook a fundamental coupling: the available compute resources must be dynamically allocated across all dimensions based on the input content. To bridge the gap, we propose SmartVL, a unified adaptive inference framework that jointly controls vision token number and model compute capability in response to varying input contents and compute budgets. SmartVL introduces a vision-side token controller that dynamically selects informative visual tokens and an LLM-side compute controller that adaptively adjusts LLM computation. Importantly, these controllers are trained to coordinate with each other so that the overall inference cost satisfies a target budget. To allow this joint scheduling, we connect the controllers using a shared budget encoding and leverage a differentiable latency estimator for end-to-end training. This design enables SmartVL to learn cross-stage allocation strategies that adapt to both input complexity and runtime compute constraints. Experiments across multiple MLLM benchmarks demonstrate that, with joint scheduling, SmartVL consistently outperforms prior adaptive methods and achieves superior accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontiers. Project page: https://www.schaterji.io/publications/2026/jointtokencompute.
papers.abstract_cn: 多模态大型语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, mllm）最近在视觉语言任务中表现出了很强的性能。然而，由于大量输入的视觉标记和大型语言模型（LLM）的繁重计算，它们的高推理成本仍然是实际部署的主要障碍。最近的工作试图通过自适应优化单个维度来降低成本，例如，修剪冗余的视觉标记或跳过LLM层和头部。尽管如此，以前的方法通常独立处理这些维度，并忽略了基本的耦合：可用的计算资源必须基于输入内容在所有维度之间动态分配。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了一个统一的自适应推理框架SmartVL，它可以根据不同的输入内容和计算预算共同控制视觉令牌数量和模型计算能力。SmartVL引入了一个视觉端令牌控制器，它可以动态地选择信息丰富的视觉令牌，还引入了一个LLM端计算控制器，可以自适应地调整LLM计算。重要的是，这些控制器被训练成相互协调，以便总体推理成本满足目标预算。为了允许这种联合调度，我们使用共享预算编码连接控制器，并利用可微延迟估计器进行端到端训练。这种设计使SmartVL能够学习适应输入复杂性和运行时计算约束的跨阶段分配策略。在多个MLLM基准测试中进行的实验表明，通过联合调度，SmartVL始终优于先前的自适应方法，并实现了更高的精度和效率。项目页面：https://www.schaterji.io/publications/2026/jointtokencompute。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the high inference cost of multimodal LLMs caused by large visual token sequences and heavy LLM computation, highlighting that prior methods optimize token pruning and compute skipping independently. SmartVL jointly adapts visual token count and LLM compute using coordinated vision-side and LLM-side controllers, trained end-to-end with a shared budget encoding and a differentiable latency estimator. Experiments across multiple MLLM benchmarks show that this joint scheduling outperforms prior adaptive methods, achieving superior accuracy–efficiency Pareto frontiers under varying compute budgets.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该文针对多模态大模型推理中视觉token过多与LLM计算过重导致的高成本问题，指出现有token剪枝与层/头跳过等方法独立优化、缺乏跨维度联合资源分配。其提出SmartVL，通过视觉端token控制器和LLM端计算控制器在共享预算编码下协同，并借助可微延迟估计进行端到端训练，实现按输入复杂度与预算联合调度“看多少”和“算多少”。实验表明，该方法在多个MLLM基准上取得更优的精度-效率Pareto前沿，优于既有自适应推理方法。

papers.title: PyroDash: Cost-Efficient Token-Level Small-Large Language Model Collaborative Inference
papers.authors: Niqi Lyu, Pengtao Shi, Wei Qiu, Jianlin Zhong, Sicong Xia, Jianyao Ma, Yicheng Ding
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) provide strong reasoning capabilities but are expensive to serve at scale, whereas small language models (SLMs) are cheaper but less reliable on difficult problems. We introduce PyroDash, a cost-aware framework for token-level SLM-LLM collaborative inference. During generation, the SLM decides whether to request assistance by emitting a control token. A Collaborate Engine then sends the query and partial reasoning trace to a frozen LLM for completion through a single handoff. The policy is internalized in the SLM, requiring neither a separate router, LLM retraining, nor access to LLM logits. PyroDash trains the SLM in three stages: control-token embedding learning, offloading-oriented supervised fine-tuning, and cost-aware alignment with Group Relative Policy Optimization. Its reward balances answer accuracy against inference cost normalized by LLM-only inference. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, PyroDash supports different accuracy-cost operating points. With $λ=0.05$, it achieves 64.04 percent average accuracy, 6.36 percentage points above the LLM-only baseline, while reducing cost by 20.4 percent. With $λ=0.6$, it achieves 54.55 percent accuracy with a 1.90 percent LLM token ratio and 0.012 LLM calls per example, reducing total cost from USD 49.36 to USD 1.78. These results show that learned token-level handoffs can reduce LLM use while preserving strong reasoning performance.
papers.abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（llm）提供强大的推理能力，但在大规模服务时成本高昂，而小型语言模型（slm）成本较低，但在解决困难问题时可靠性较差。我们介绍了PyroDash，这是一个用于令牌级SLM-LLM协作推理的成本意识框架。在生成过程中，SLM通过发出控制令牌来决定是否请求帮助。然后，协作引擎将查询和部分推理跟踪发送到冻结的LLM，以便通过单次移交完成。该策略内部化在SLM中，不需要单独的路由器、LLM再培训，也不需要访问LLM日志。PyroDash分三个阶段训练SLM：控制令牌嵌入学习，面向卸载的监督微调，以及与组相对策略优化的成本意识对齐。它的奖励平衡了答案准确性和由纯llm推理规范化的推理成本。通过五个数学推理基准，PyroDash支持不同的精度成本操作点。当λ=0.05$时，平均准确率达到64.04%，比llm基准高6.36个百分点，同时成本降低20.4%。当$λ=0.6$时，它的准确率达到54.55%，LLM令牌比率为1.90%，每个示例调用0.012个LLM，将总成本从49.36美元降低到1.78美元。这些结果表明，学习的令牌级切换可以减少LLM的使用，同时保持强大的推理性能。
papers.ai_summary_en: PyroDash addresses the cost–quality tradeoff in LLM serving by enabling a small language model to generate tokens until it emits a learned control token that hands off the query and partial reasoning trace to a frozen large model for a single completion, eliminating external routers, LLM retraining, and LLM-logit access. The SLM internalizes this offloading policy through control-token embedding learning, offloading-oriented supervised fine-tuning, and cost-aware Group Relative Policy Optimization that rewards accuracy while penalizing LLM usage normalized against LLM-only inference. On five math reasoning benchmarks, the method provides tunable operating points, e.g., achieving 64.04% average accuracy—6.36 points above LLM-only—with 20.4% lower cost at λ=0.05, or reducing cost from $49.36 to $1.78 with only 1.90% LLM tokens and 0.012 LLM calls per example at λ=0.6.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对大模型推理昂贵、小模型在难题上不可靠的问题，PyroDash 提出一种 token 级小模型—大模型协同推理框架，让小模型在生成过程中通过控制 token 自主决定是否将查询和部分推理轨迹单次交接给冻结大模型续写。其核心方法是把交接策略内化到小模型中，依次通过控制词嵌入学习、面向卸载的监督微调和基于 GRPO 的成本感知对齐来平衡准确率与推理成本。实验显示，该方法可在多个数学推理基准上提供不同精度—成本工作点：高精度设置下平均准确率比纯大模型高 6.36 个百分点并降本 20.4%，极低成本设置下可将总成本从 49.36 美元降至 1.78 美元。

papers.title: PoTRE: Test-Time Reasoning inspired by Cognitive Heterogeneity
papers.authors: Anmol Kankariya, Sercan Ö. Arık
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at many tasks, they frequently struggle with complex reasoning that requires long-horizon planning and iterative error correction. Furthermore, standard single-stream prompting proves brittle when models encounter novel abstractions or rigorous domain constraints. We introduce PoTRE (Poly-Topological Reasoning Ensembles), a heterogeneous framework that decouples inference into four agents: (1) Adversarial Refinement Agent, (2) Hierarchical strategic Planning Agent, (3) Spectrum Search Agent, and (4) Direct Chain Agent. A final Task-Adaptive Aggregation Layer dynamically reconciles these perspectives -- via final candidate selection, semantic synthesis, or neuro-symbolic verification -- to produce a robust global solution. We evaluate PoTRE on three frontier benchmarks: ARC-AGI-2, Humanity's Last Exam (HLE), and PRBench Finance. PoTRE achieves state-of-the-art accuracy of 49.92% on HLE, surpassing the previous best official score. We demonstrate that this architectural heterogeneity achieves improved reasoning performance using similar or fewer inference tokens compared to heavily scaled homogeneous baselines.
papers.abstract_cn: 虽然大型语言模型（llm）擅长许多任务，但它们经常与需要长期规划和迭代纠错的复杂推理作斗争。此外，当模型遇到新的抽象或严格的领域约束时，标准的单流提示被证明是脆弱的。我们引入了PoTRE (Poly-Topological Reasoning Ensembles)，这是一个异构框架，将推理解耦为四个代理：(1)对抗性优化代理，(2)分层战略规划代理，(3)频谱搜索代理和(4)直接链代理。最终的任务自适应聚合层动态地协调这些观点——通过最终的候选选择、语义合成或神经符号验证——以产生一个健壮的全局解决方案。我们在三个前沿基准上评估PoTRE: ARC-AGI-2，人类的最后一次考试（HLE）和PRBench Finance。PoTRE在HLE上达到了49.92%的最先进精度，超过了之前的最佳官方分数。我们证明，与大规模同构基线相比，这种架构异质性使用相似或更少的推理令牌实现了改进的推理性能。
papers.comment: Accepted at Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR 2026)
papers.ai_summary_en: PoTRE addresses LLM failures on complex reasoning tasks requiring long-horizon planning, iterative correction, and adaptation to novel abstractions or strict domain constraints. It introduces a heterogeneous test-time ensemble of four specialized reasoning agents—adversarial refinement, hierarchical planning, spectrum search, and direct chaining—combined by a task-adaptive aggregation layer using candidate selection, semantic synthesis, or neuro-symbolic verification. On frontier benchmarks including ARC-AGI-2, HLE, and PRBench Finance, PoTRE achieves state-of-the-art 49.92% accuracy on HLE while using similar or fewer inference tokens than scaled homogeneous baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型在复杂推理、长期规划和迭代纠错中易失败、单流提示脆弱的问题，提出测试时异构推理框架 PoTRE，将推理解耦为对抗精炼、分层规划、谱搜索和直接链四类智能体，并由任务自适应聚合层进行候选选择、语义综合或神经符号验证。其核心洞见是通过认知异构与多视角集成提升推理鲁棒性，而非依赖同质化扩展。实验在 HLE 上取得 49.92% 的 SOTA 成绩，并在相近或更少推理 token 下优于大规模同质基线。

papers.title: HijackKV: New Threat in Position-Independent KV Cache Reuse
papers.authors: Yichi Zhang, Zhiqi Wang, Huan Zhang, Yuchen Yang
papers.abstract_en: Key-Value (KV) cache reduces inference latency in large language models (LLMs). Traditional prefix-based reuse has low cache hit rates across inference requests because it requires exact token and position matches. To improve efficiency, recent system optimizations introduce position-independent KV reuse, allowing KV cache to be reused whenever identical text chunks appear, regardless of their position in the sequence.   We show this design introduces a new threat, KV Cache Hijacking. Since KV caches are retrieved by token match but encode the context in which they were originally computed, the KV tied to a benign-looking token chunk may encode an attacker-controlled prefix. When later reused in a victim query, this contaminated KV silently hijacks the model's behavior, even if no attacker-controlled text appears in the input.   We introduce HIJACKKV, the first attack framework that systematically exploits this vulnerability, demonstrating its severity and practicality. HIJACKKV optimizes an attacker-controlled prefix, so that the KV computed for a subsequent common benign text encodes the attacker's goal, while the text remains unchanged for future cache hits. HIJACKKV achieves an average 94% success rate in a single attempt, remains effective under realistic constraints including low hit rates (10%) and frequent recomputation (50%), persists over multi-turn interactions, and transfers across models in black-box settings. We further provide design insights for building secure KV reuse systems.
papers.abstract_cn: 键值（KV）缓存减少了大型语言模型（llm）中的推理延迟。传统的基于前缀的重用跨推理请求具有较低的缓存命中率，因为它需要精确的标记和位置匹配。为了提高效率，最近的系统优化引入了与位置无关的KV重用，允许在相同文本块出现时重用KV缓存，而不管它们在序列中的位置如何。我们展示了这个设计引入了一个新的威胁，KV缓存劫持。由于KV缓存是通过令牌匹配来检索的，但编码了它们最初计算时的上下文，因此与看起来无害的令牌块绑定的KV可能编码了攻击者控制的前缀。当稍后在受害者查询中重用时，即使输入中没有出现攻击者控制的文本，这个受污染的KV也会静默地劫持模型的行为。我们介绍了HIJACKKV，这是第一个系统地利用此漏洞的攻击框架，展示了其严重性和实用性。HIJACKKV优化了攻击者控制的前缀，因此为后续常见良性文本计算的KV将对攻击者的目标进行编码，而文本将对未来的缓存命中保持不变。HIJACKKV在单次尝试中平均达到94%的成功率，在现实限制下保持有效，包括低命中率（10%）和频繁的重新计算（50%），在多回合交互中持续存在，并在黑箱设置下跨模型传输。我们进一步为构建安全的KV重用系统提供设计见解。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper identifies a security vulnerability in position-independent KV-cache reuse for LLM serving, where caches matched only by token content can carry attacker-controlled contextual information from their original computation. It proposes HIJACKKV, an attack framework that optimizes a malicious prefix so that KV entries for an unchanged benign text chunk encode the attacker’s objective and are later reused in victim requests. Experiments show about 94% single-attempt success under realistic serving constraints, with persistence across multi-turn interactions, black-box cross-model transfer, and implications for secure KV-cache system design.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM服务中“位置无关KV缓存复用”带来的安全威胁，指出按文本匹配复用的KV块会携带原始上下文，因此可能被攻击者污染并在后续受害者请求中劫持模型行为。作者提出 HIJACKKV 攻击框架，通过优化攻击者前缀，使常见良性文本生成的KV在不改变可见文本的情况下编码恶意目标并提高缓存命中利用。实验表明其单次攻击平均成功率达94%，在低命中率、频繁重算、多轮交互和黑盒跨模型场景下仍有效，并提出了安全KV复用系统的设计启示。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Model Selective Evidence Adoption from Contaminated Retrieval Results
papers.authors: Yanyu Chen, Yue Li, Yongyi Cui, Dongsheng Shi, Lichang Dai
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented large language models frequently face contexts that interleave useful evidence with misleading statements or instruction-like content. Blanket refusal discards valid evidence, whereas uncritical adoption yields incorrect or unsafe answers. The ability to selectively adopt relevant information while rejecting deceptive or harmful content is therefore critical for reliable deployment in real-world retrieval settings. We introduce SelectBench, a controlled benchmark and training set for selective evidence adoption, and post-train Qwen3.5-4B directly with DAPO using either deterministic rule rewards or a frozen semantic judge. On the corrected 325-example SelectBench-v2 test set, strict success rises from 22.46% for the original checkpoint to 25.54% with DAPO-Rule and 26.46% with DAPO-DeepSeek. Both trained policies reduce forbidden-content adoption and produce shorter, more focused responses, yet prompt-injection following does not improve. The paired gains are modest and fail to survive Holm correction, suggesting that stronger reward shaping or additional training iterations may be needed for more robust gains. DAPO-DeepSeek exhibits no material degradation on MMLU or clean HotpotQA, indicating that the post-training procedure preserves general capabilities. These results demonstrate a directional improvement in selective evidence use, while identifying injection resistance and statistical robustness as important remaining challenges for future work.
papers.abstract_cn: 检索增强的大型语言模型经常面临这样的情况：有用的证据与误导性的陈述或类似指令的内容交织在一起。全盘拒绝会抛弃有效的证据，而不加批判的采纳会产生不正确或不安全的答案。因此，在拒绝欺骗性或有害内容的同时，有选择地采用相关信息的能力对于在现实世界的检索设置中进行可靠部署至关重要。我们引入了SelectBench，这是一个用于选择性证据采用的受控基准和训练集，并使用确定性规则奖励或冻结语义判断直接与DAPO对Qwen3.5-4B进行后训练。在修正后的325个示例SelectBench-v2测试集上，严格成功率从原始检查点的22.46%上升到DAPO-Rule的25.54%和DAPO-DeepSeek的26.46%。这两种经过训练的政策都减少了禁止内容的采用，并产生了更短、更集中的响应，但及时注入的后续工作并没有得到改善。成对的收益是适度的，并且不能经受住霍尔姆的修正，这表明可能需要更强的奖励塑造或额外的训练迭代来获得更稳健的收益。DAPO-DeepSeek在MMLU或清洁HotpotQA上没有材料退化，表明训练后程序保留了一般功能。这些结果表明了选择性证据使用的方向性改进，同时确定了注入阻力和统计稳健性是未来工作中仍然存在的重要挑战。
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses selective evidence adoption in retrieval-augmented LLMs, where retrieved contexts mix valid evidence with misleading, harmful, or instruction-like content. It introduces SelectBench, a controlled benchmark and training set, and post-trains Qwen3.5-4B with DAPO reinforcement learning using either deterministic rule-based rewards or a frozen semantic judge. Results show modest improvements in strict success (22.46% → 25.54%/26.46%) and reduced forbidden-content adoption without degrading general capabilities, though gains are not statistically robust after correction and prompt-injection resistance remains unresolved.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对检索增强大模型在“有用证据与误导/指令注入内容混杂”的上下文中如何选择性采用证据的问题，提出了 SelectBench 基准，并用 DAPO 强化学习对 Qwen3.5-4B 进行后训练，分别采用规则奖励和冻结语义评判器奖励。实验显示，严格成功率从 22.46% 小幅提升至 25.54%/26.46%，模型减少了对禁用内容的采用且通用能力无明显退化，但提升未通过统计校正，且对提示注入的抵抗仍未改善。

papers.title: Efficient Clustering with Provable Guardrails for LLM Inference at Scale
papers.authors: Longshaokan Wang, Wai Tsang Keung, Punit Ghodasara, Roman Wang, Ali Dashti, Francesc Moreno-Noguer
papers.abstract_en: Scaling LLM-based applications to millions of users is bottlenecked by the inference cost and latency of modern foundation models. A natural fix is to cluster the inputs and call the LLM only on cluster representatives, letting other members inherit the output -- but this is only safe if each member is measurably close to its representative. Existing clustering methods do not offer such per-sample quality control at scale: none jointly guarantee a minimal within-cluster similarity, exact matching of categorical attributes, and scalability to tens of millions of samples. We propose a two-stage algorithm that generates initial clusters with Mini-batch K-Means, then greedily selects representatives within each initial cluster -- a step equivalent to the Johnson-Chvatal heuristic for Set Cover over alpha-balls in embedding space. The algorithm enforces the similarity and attribute guardrails exactly by construction, and runs in $O(nd + n^2 d/K)$ time and $O(nd + n^2/K^2)$ memory for $n$ samples, feature dimension $d$, and $K$ initial clusters -- linear in $n$ when $K$ grows proportionally with $n$. We provide benchmarks against common clustering methods on internal and public datasets: our method not only delivers per-sample guardrails but also runs 10-1000x faster and scales to data sizes where most standard methods become intractable. Deployed on 38 million customers for a persona-based recommender, the clustering method cut downstream cost and latency by 50-fold while preserving personalization and unblocked the production launch.
papers.abstract_cn: 将基于llm的应用程序扩展到数百万用户是现代基础模型的推理成本和延迟的瓶颈。一种自然的修复方法是对输入进行聚类，并只在集群代表上调用LLM，让其他成员继承输出——但这只有在每个成员都与它的代表相当接近时才安全。现有的聚类方法不能在规模上提供这样的每样本质量控制：没有一种方法能共同保证最小的聚类内相似性、分类属性的精确匹配以及数千万个样本的可扩展性。我们提出了一种两阶段算法，该算法使用Mini-batch K-Means生成初始聚类，然后贪婪地在每个初始聚类中选择代表——这一步相当于在嵌入空间中对alpha-balls进行Set Cover的Johnson-Chvatal启发式。该算法通过构造精确地执行相似性和属性护栏，并在$O(and + n^2 d/K)$时间和$O(and + n^2/K^2)$内存中运行$n$样本、$d$特征维度和$K$初始聚类——当$K$与$n$成比例增长时，$n$呈线性。我们在内部和公共数据集上提供了针对常见聚类方法的基准测试：我们的方法不仅提供了每个样本的“护栏”，而且运行速度快10-1000倍，并且可以扩展到大多数标准方法难以处理的数据大小。在3800万客户中部署了基于人物的推荐，聚类方法将下游成本和延迟降低了50倍，同时保留了个性化并解除了生产启动的阻碍。
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at ICML HiLD workshop 2026 (non-archival)
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the cost and latency bottleneck of large-scale LLM inference by clustering similar inputs so that only cluster representatives are sent to the model, while requiring provable per-sample guarantees that members are sufficiently similar and match required categorical attributes. The proposed method first forms coarse clusters with Mini-batch K-Means, then greedily selects representatives via a Johnson–Chvátal-style set-cover heuristic over embedding-space α-balls, enforcing similarity and attribute guardrails by construction with near-linear scaling when the number of initial clusters grows with dataset size. Experiments show 10–1000× speedups over standard clustering methods and scalability to tens of millions of samples; in a deployed persona-based recommender over 38 million customers, it reduced downstream LLM cost and latency by 50× while preserving personalization.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该文针对大规模 LLM 服务中通过聚类复用代表输出以降低成本时，缺乏逐样本相似性与属性一致性保证的问题。其核心方法是先用 Mini-batch K-Means 初聚类，再在簇内贪心选择代表，并将代表选择建模为嵌入空间 α-ball 上的集合覆盖，从构造上严格保证最小簇内相似度和类别属性精确匹配。实验与 3800 万用户部署表明，该方法比常见聚类快 10–1000 倍，可将下游推理成本和延迟降低约 50 倍，同时保持个性化。

papers.title: Fine-grained Computation-Communication Overlap via Tile-level Signaling and Scheduling for Mixture-of-Experts
papers.authors: Minyu Cui, Anna Wingkvist, Morgan Ericsson
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures increase model capacity without proportionally increasing computation cost and have become a key building block for scaling large language models (LLMs) to trillion-parameter regimes. Efficient deployment of these MoE models relies on distributed execution across multiple GPUs, where each MoE layer involves two all-to-all communications: dispatching tokens to expert ranks and returning the expert outputs to their source ranks. Conventional MoE implementations launch this return all-to-all after expert compute completes, exposing communication latency on the critical path and reducing GPU utilization. We present a fine-grained approach that overlaps expert compute with the second all-to-all via tile-level signaling and scheduling. Our producer-consumer co-design combines: (1) a persistent per-rank computation kernel (producer) that covers all local experts on the rank to eliminate repeated kernel launch overhead and prioritizes remote-critical tiles, and (2) a persistent communication kernel (consumer) on a small dedicated partition of streaming multiprocessors (SMs) that issues segment-granular transfers as tiles become ready. Our co-design avoids intrusive changes to the underlying computation operators or communication primitives, making it practical for improving distributed MoE execution efficiency on multi-GPU systems. On a 4-A100 GPU platform, evaluated on three MoE models against four state-of-the-art MoE systems, our approach achieves up to 2.64x end-to-end speedup and 2.74x MoE-layer speedup. Compared with a conventional non-overlap baseline, our approach consistently improves both operator- and MoE-layer-level performance across varying GEMM shapes, router modes, and a broad range of producer/consumer SM partitions, while preserving correctness.
papers.abstract_cn: 混合专家（MoE）架构在不按比例增加计算成本的情况下提高了模型容量，并成为将大型语言模型（llm）扩展到万亿参数体系的关键构建块。这些MoE模型的有效部署依赖于跨多个gpu的分布式执行，其中每个MoE层涉及两个全对全通信：向专家级别发送令牌并将专家输出返回到其源级别。传统的MoE实现在专家计算完成后启动这种全对全返回，暴露了关键路径上的通信延迟并降低了GPU利用率。我们提出了一种细粒度的方法，通过块级信令和调度将专家计算与第二全对全计算重叠。我们的生产者-消费者协同设计结合了：(1)一个持久的按等级计算内核（生产者），它覆盖了等级上的所有本地专家，以消除重复的内核启动开销，并对远程关键块进行优先级排序；(2)一个持久的通信内核（消费者），它位于流多处理器（SMs）的一个小专用分区上，当块准备好时，它会发出段粒度传输。我们的协同设计避免了对底层计算运算符或通信原语的侵入性更改，使其在多gpu系统上提高分布式MoE执行效率变得切实可行。在4-A100 GPU平台上，对三种MoE模型和四种最先进的MoE系统进行了评估，我们的方法实现了高达2.64倍的端到端加速和2.74倍的MoE层加速。与传统的非重叠基线相比，我们的方法在不同的GEMM形状、路由器模式和广泛的生产者/消费者SM分区中始终如一地提高了操作员和moe层的性能，同时保持了正确性。
papers.comment: To appear at the 55th International Conference on Parallel Processing (ICPP 26)
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses exposed return all-to-all communication latency in distributed MoE LLM serving, where token outputs are transferred back only after expert computation completes, leaving communication on the critical path and reducing GPU utilization. It proposes a fine-grained producer–consumer co-design that overlaps expert compute with the second all-to-all via tile-level signaling: a persistent per-rank compute kernel prioritizes remote-critical tiles, while a persistent communication kernel on dedicated SMs issues segment-granular transfers as tiles become ready. On a 4-A100 system, the method achieves up to 2.64× end-to-end and 2.74× MoE-layer speedups over state-of-the-art baselines, improving performance across GEMM shapes and router modes without modifying underlying compute or communication primitives.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对MoE大模型分布式推理中第二次all-to-all返回通信需等待专家计算完成、导致通信延迟暴露和GPU利用率低的问题，本文提出一种基于tile级信号与调度的细粒度计算-通信重叠方法。其核心是生产者-消费者协同设计：持久化计算内核优先产出远端关键tile，少量专用SM上的持久化通信内核在tile就绪后立即分段传输，从而在不修改底层算子或通信原语的前提下实现重叠。实验在4张A100上表明，该方法相较非重叠基线可稳定提升算子和MoE层性能，最高实现2.64倍端到端加速和2.74倍MoE层加速。

papers.title: Total Variation Distance Estimation in Autoregressive Models
papers.authors: Eric Price, Kevin Tian, Zhiyang Xun, Yusong Zhu
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLM deployments use a number of implementation choices and inference optimizations (e.g., batching, custom kernels, and quantization) on top of fixed weights, so two engines serving "the same model" can produce meaningfully different distributions. We study the problem of estimating the total variation (TV) distance between two length-$n$ autoregressive distributions to additive error $\varepsilon$, under three access models. (1) Under sample access, we use $\widetilde{O}(n^2 K/\varepsilon^2)$ queries, where $K$ is the maximum support of the next-token distribution. This improves upon the $\widetilde{O}(n^3 m/\varepsilon^5)$-query estimator of Meel et al. (2025), where $m \geq K$ is the total size of the token alphabet. (2) Under logit access, we use $O(n/\varepsilon^2)$ queries, and this is tight. (3) Under noisy logit access, we smoothly interpolate between the above two guarantees: if probability values are given to relative error $σ$, we use $\widetilde{O}((n+n^2σ^2)/\varepsilon^2)$ queries. We complement our theoretical results with an empirical evaluation of our algorithms, for example measuring the distance between SGLang and vLLM serving identical weights. Our experiments highlight the robustness and practicality of estimating the total variation distance, which remains estimable where the KL divergence is infinite. Our code is available at https://github.com/XunZhiyang/llm-tv-estimation.
papers.abstract_cn: 现代LLM部署在固定权重的基础上使用了许多实现选择和推理优化（例如，批处理、自定义内核和量化），因此服务于“相同模型”的两个引擎可以产生有意义的不同分布。我们研究了在三种访问模型下估计两个长度- $n$自回归分布对加性误差$\varepsilon$的总变差（TV）距离的问题。(1)在样本访问下，我们使用$\widetilde{O}(n^2 K/\varepsilon^2)$查询，其中$K$是下一个令牌分布的最大支持。这改进了Meel等人（2025）的$\widetilde{O}(n^3 m/\varepsilon^5)$ -query估计器，其中$m \geq K$是令牌字母表的总大小。(2)在logit访问下，我们使用$O(n/\varepsilon^2)$查询，这是严格的。(3)在有噪声的logit访问下，我们平滑地在上述两种保证之间进行插值：如果概率值给定相对误差$σ$，我们使用$\widetilde{O}((n+n^2σ^2)/\varepsilon^2)$查询。我们通过对算法的经验评估来补充理论结果，例如测量具有相同权重的SGLang和vLLM之间的距离。我们的实验突出了估计总变异距离的鲁棒性和实用性，在KL散度无限的情况下，总变异距离仍然是可估计的。我们的代码可在https://github.com/XunZhiyang/llm-tv-estimation上获得。
papers.comment: 39 pages, 11 figures, code is available at https://github.com/XunZhiyang/llm-tv-estimation
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper studies estimating the additive-error total variation distance between two length-\(n\) autoregressive LLM distributions that can differ due to serving-stack choices such as batching, kernels, and quantization. It provides improved estimators under three access models: \(\widetilde{O}(n^2K/\varepsilon^2)\) sample queries, a tight \(O(n/\varepsilon^2)\) logit-query bound, and a noisy-logit guarantee \(\widetilde{O}((n+n^2\sigma^2)/\varepsilon^2)\) that interpolates between them. Experiments, including comparing SGLang and vLLM serving identical weights, show the approach is practical and remains finite/usable where KL divergence can be infinite.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对同一 LLM 权重在不同推理引擎/优化下可能产生不同输出分布的问题，研究如何估计两个长度为 n 的自回归分布之间的总变差（TV）距离。其核心贡献是在样本访问、logit 访问和带噪声 logit 访问三种模型下给出更优且部分紧致的估计算法，例如样本访问复杂度降至 \(\widetilde{O}(n^2K/\varepsilon^2)\)，logit 访问达到 \(O(n/\varepsilon^2)\)。实验进一步验证了方法在 SGLang 与 vLLM 等真实服务系统间的可用性，并表明 TV 距离在 KL 散度可能无穷时仍可作为稳健的分布差异度量。

papers.title: Windowed-MTP: Removing the Full-Context Draft-KV Tax at Million-Token Context
papers.authors: Alagappan Valliappan
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by having a cheap draft propose tokens that a target verifies in parallel. Frontier models increasingly ship a built-in Multi-Token-Prediction (MTP/NEXTN) draft head under the assumption that the draft is negligibly cheap. At million-token context this breaks: an MTP draft head typically runs full attention over the entire KV cache at every draft step, so its read grows linearly with context and comes to dominate the draft cost -- precisely where speculation is most valuable. The effect compounds with draft length (a deep native draft can turn net-negative, slower than no speculation) and sharpens under hybrid/linear-attention targets, where cheaper verification leaves the draft's full-attention read exposed. We apply a StreamingLLM-style sliding window plus attention sink to the draft's attention only (Windowed-MTP), leaving full-attention verification intact. It is training-free, drop-in, and lossless by construction: the full-attention target still decides every accepted token, so windowing changes only which tokens are proposed, never which are accepted. It bounds the draft's KV working set to a constant, dropping ~99% of KV entries at 1M. Across three architecture families (Qwen GDN-MoE 35B/122B and a Mamba2-hybrid NoPE 120B) at 1M context on a single GPU in SGLang, windowing cuts the per-decode-step cost over the shipping native MTP draft by +28% to +44%, an input-invariant margin that widens with context. Since per-token latency is this cost divided by acceptance length, at matched acceptance end-to-end decode latency improves by the same amount, and more where windowing also lifts acceptance, while preserving the target's verified output distribution. Finally, the unread draft KV -- 7.7-11% of total KV at 1M -- is reclaimed via a compact ring buffer at no acceptance or quality cost.
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper addresses the “draft-KV tax” in speculative decoding with native multi-token-prediction heads, where full-attention drafting over million-token KV caches makes draft cost grow linearly and can negate speculation. Windowed-MTP applies a training-free StreamingLLM-style sliding window plus attention sink only to the draft head, bounding its KV working set to a constant while leaving full-attention target verification unchanged, so the accepted-token distribution is preserved. On Qwen GDN-MoE and Mamba2-hybrid models at 1M context, it reduces per-decode-step cost by 28–44% versus native MTP, yields comparable end-to-end latency gains, drops ~99% of draft KV reads, and reclaims 7.7–11% of total KV via a ring buffer.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对百万级 token 上下文中内置 MTP 草稿头因每步读取全量 KV cache 而导致投机解码开销过大、甚至净负收益的问题。其核心方法是仅对草稿头注意力施加 StreamingLLM 式滑动窗口加 attention sink，保持目标模型全注意力验证，从而实现免训练、即插即用且输出分布无损的草稿加速。实验表明，在 1M 上下文和多类模型架构上，该方法可将草稿 KV 工作集压缩约 99%，每步解码成本降低 28%–44%，并在保持质量的同时改善端到端延迟。

papers.title: C-PTQ: Fisher-weighted Channel-wise Sensitivity for Post-training Quantization of MLLMs
papers.authors: Jiameng Li, Han Zhou, Matthew B. Blaschko
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) require huge memory and computational costs, which limits their practical deployment. Post-training quantization (PTQ) techniques offer an efficient solution for model compression and inference acceleration. Yet, the quantized model faces performance degradation due to outlier channels, which are highly sensitive to quantization and substantially impair activation fidelity and task accuracy. To protect these salient channels during quantization, existing PTQ methods leverage modality- or token-level metrics to guide channel-wise scaling (CWS) of LLM decoders.
