However, these orthogonal measurements fail to capture channel-wise impacts on task-specific loss, and the misalignment between importance and scaling factors ultimately leads to suboptimal performance. To address this issue, we propose C-PTQ, a unified channel-wise PTQ method that harmonizes task-specific loss perturbation and quantization error. Motivated by second-order derivatives, we design a Fisher-weighted objective as a tractable Hessian approximation, seamlessly injecting task sensitivity into the scaling process. Notably, we achieve state-of-the-art performance without auxiliary modules like LoRA, thereby maintaining high efficiency. Experiments on Qwen2.5VL, InternVL2 and LLaVA-OV across 8 benchmarks demonstrate our effectiveness in both weight-only and weight-activation settings.
papers.ai_summary_en: C-PTQ addresses post-training quantization of multimodal LLMs, where outlier/salient channels cause significant accuracy loss and existing modality- or token-level scaling metrics are misaligned with task-specific loss. It introduces a Fisher-weighted channel-wise objective that uses a tractable Hessian approximation to inject task sensitivity into channel scaling, jointly reducing quantization error and loss perturbation. Without auxiliary modules such as LoRA, C-PTQ achieves state-of-the-art performance on Qwen2.5-VL, InternVL2, and LLaVA-OV across eight benchmarks in both weight-only and weight-activation settings.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态大模型训练后量化中异常/显著通道导致精度下降、且现有通道缩放指标与任务损失不对齐的问题展开研究。核心方法是提出 C-PTQ，用 Fisher 加权目标近似二阶 Hessian 敏感度，将任务损失扰动与量化误差统一到通道级缩放优化中，无需 LoRA 等额外模块。实验在 Qwen2.5VL、InternVL2 和 LLaVA-OV 等模型的 8 个基准上验证，在仅权重量化和权重-激活量化设置下均取得领先效果。

papers.title: Refusal-Gated Decoding: Preserving Refusal Behavior Under High-Temperature Sampling
papers.authors: Phillip Howard, Xin Su, Allen Roush, Manikandan Ravikiran, Amir Abdullah
papers.abstract_en: High-temperature sampling is one of the primary mechanisms for increasing diversity in LLMs. Recent advances in truncation-based sampling techniques have helped mitigate drawbacks of high-temperature sampling such as neural text degeneration, thereby enabling greater diversity in LLM outputs without sacrificing coherence. However, increasing the entropy of the token probability distribution via high temperatures has also been shown to weaken model guardrails by reducing the model's refusal response in the presence of harmful prompts. Despite the potential benefits of high-temperature sampling and the importance of maintaining model safety, there is a lack of existing solutions for maintaining the refusal behavior of LLMs under a higher entropy regime. To address this gap, we systematically study how temperature influences refusal behavior in LLMs and propose an efficient sequential decoding approach which preserves a model's greedy decoding refusal response at high temperatures while incurring minimal additional latency. Through extensive experiments, we show that our approach preserves 91-99% of the greedy decoding refusal behavior across three benchmark datasets without compromising the model's high-temperature response for safe prompts. Our work demonstrates how refusal behavior can be maintained in an efficient manner for applications which require high-temperature sampling.
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the safety degradation caused by high-temperature sampling in LLM serving, where increased entropy weakens refusal behavior on harmful prompts even when truncation-based methods preserve coherence. It proposes Refusal-Gated Decoding, an efficient sequential decoding approach that leverages the model’s greedy-decoding refusal response to preserve refusals under high-temperature sampling with minimal added latency. Experiments on three benchmarks show the method retains 91–99% of greedy refusal behavior on harmful prompts while largely preserving high-temperature outputs for safe prompts.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对高温采样会提高输出熵、从而削弱大模型在有害提示下拒绝行为的问题，提出了一种“拒绝门控”的顺序解码方法，以最小额外延迟在高温采样中保留贪心解码时的安全拒绝响应。其核心洞见是将模型的贪心拒绝行为作为安全约束，在高风险场景下约束解码路径，同时不限制安全提示下的高温多样性。实验表明，该方法在三个基准上保留了91%–99%的贪心拒绝表现，并且基本不损害安全请求下的高温生成效果。

papers.title: PATS: Policy-Aware Training Scaffolding for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Yipeng Shi, Zhipeng Ma, Yue Wang, Qitai Tan, Yang Li, Peng Chen, Zhengzhou Zhu
papers.abstract_en: In long-horizon LLM agent reinforcement learning, weak policies often repeat similar failures, producing uninformative rollout trajectories and limiting effective policy optimization. Existing skill-centric methods improve exploration by optimizing, filtering, or internalizing reusable skills. However, they remain centered on the skills themselves rather than being designed as adaptive training-time support for the evolving policy. To address this, we propose a policy-centric training paradigm that reframes skills as a dynamic training scaffold. Our framework, Pats, converts rollout groups from the latest policy into evidence cards and uses task-specific evaluation to adjust the context used in subsequent rollouts. Concrete guidance helps weak policies to complete challenging tasks. As policy improves, redundant context is revised or removed to reduce reliance on explicit guidance while preserving useful rollout variation. The policy is optimized with environmental rewards using standard RLVR, and the training scaffold is discarded at deployment. On ALFWorld and WebShop, Pats improves over strong baselines by up to 18.6%. Across seven search-augmented QA benchmarks, it remains competitive while using 32.1% fewer prompt tokens than the baseline.
papers.ai_summary_en: PATS addresses the problem of uninformative rollouts and limited policy optimization in long-horizon LLM agent reinforcement learning, where weak policies repeatedly fail on similar tasks. It introduces a policy-aware training scaffold that converts rollout groups into evidence cards and dynamically adjusts task-specific contextual guidance—adding support when needed and pruning it as the policy improves—while training with standard environmental RLVR and discarding the scaffold at deployment. The method improves performance by up to 18.6% on ALFWorld and WebShop and remains competitive on seven search-augmented QA benchmarks while using 32.1% fewer prompt tokens.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对长周期 LLM 智能体强化学习中弱策略反复失败、导致 rollout 缺乏信息量并限制策略优化的问题。  
其核心方法是提出以策略为中心的训练脚手架 PATS，将技能转化为动态上下文支持：根据最新策略的 rollout 生成证据卡，并依据任务评估调整后续提示，在策略变强后逐步删减冗余指导，部署时完全丢弃脚手架。  
实验显示，PATS 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上较强基线最高提升 18.6%，在七个搜索增强问答基准上保持竞争力的同时减少 32.1% 的提示 token。

papers.title: Euclid-MCP: A Model Context Protocol Server for Deterministic Logical Reasoning via Prolog
papers.authors: Bartolomeo Bogliolo
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at natural language understanding and generation but remain unreliable for multi-step logical reasoning, especially in safety-critical or compliance-sensitive domains. Recent neuro-symbolic approaches address this gap by coupling neural models with external symbolic engines, yet most integrations are bespoke and lack a standardized interface for tool-augmented agents. This paper presents Euclid-MCP, an open-source MCP server that provides deterministic logical reasoning via SWI-Prolog. Euclid-MCP introduces Euclid-IR, an engine-agnostic intermediate representation for Horn-clause logic that is human-readable, easy for LLMs to generate, and straightforward to compile into Prolog or alternative backends. The server exposes a compact tool interface that supports a translate-run-inspect-repair loop, enabling LLM clients to delegate inference while retaining full access to proof traces and derivation logs. We evaluate Euclid-MCP on a realistic IT security and compliance use case. Results show that while LLMs alone are sufficient on small knowledge bases, they hallucinate systematically on larger problems, whereas Euclid-MCP delivers exact answers with lower latency and more compact outputs. We argue that semantic RAG is fundamentally unsuited for rule enforcement, and that Euclid-MCP can serve as a stable, shared reasoning substrate for both RAG-based assistants and agentic systems.
papers.ai_summary_en: Euclid-MCP addresses LLM unreliability in multi-step logical reasoning and rule enforcement by providing a standardized Model Context Protocol server that delegates deterministic inference to SWI-Prolog. It introduces Euclid-IR, an engine-agnostic Horn-clause intermediate representation designed for LLM generation, plus a translate-run-inspect-repair tool interface that exposes proof traces and derivation logs. Evaluations on IT security and compliance tasks show that LLMs hallucinate on larger knowledge bases, while Euclid-MCP produces exact answers with lower latency and more compact outputs.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对LLM在多步逻辑推理和合规场景中不可靠、现有神经符号集成缺乏标准接口的问题，论文提出 Euclid-MCP：一个基于 SWI-Prolog 的开源 MCP 推理服务器，并设计引擎无关的 Horn 子句中间表示 Euclid-IR，支持“翻译-执行-检查-修复”的工具化推理闭环与证明轨迹回溯。其核心洞见是将确定性符号推理作为可共享的外部推理基底，让LLM负责生成和修复逻辑表示，而非直接进行推断。实验表明，在大规模 IT 安全合规知识库上，该方法相比纯LLM可提供精确答案、更低延迟和更紧凑输出，并指出语义 RAG 不适合规则执行。

papers.title: Adaptive Depth Sparse Framework: Similarity-Driven Resource Allocation for Pre-Trained LLMs
papers.authors: Yidu Wu, Xiang Wang, Kejie Zhao, Zhangchi Wang, Qinghai Guo, Xiaoying Tang
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong generation and reasoning performance, but the Transformer architecture incurs high inference cost. Existing acceleration methods often rely on task-specific fine-tuning or training from scratch, increasing adaptation cost and limiting cross-task usability. We present an Adaptive Depth Sparse Framework (AdaDSF) that converts off-the-shelf pre-trained LLMs into depth-sparse models without full retraining. Our key insight is that layers contribute unequally to representation transformation, characterized by the cosine similarity between layer input and output hidden states. Based on this, AdaDSF assigns layer-wise token retention ratios from similarity statistics, uses a lightweight router to select informative tokens at each layer, and introduces a feature-preserving alignment objective to match intermediate and final representations between sparse and dense models. On GPT-NeoX and Qwen2.5 over language modeling and commonsense reasoning, AdaDSF substantially reduces inference FLOPs while preserving performance close to dense counterparts. Under comparable sparsity, AdaDSF consistently yields smaller accuracy degradation than strong baselines including MoD, D-LLM, and DLO.
papers.comment: Accepted by ICIC 2026. 12 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the high inference cost of dense Transformer LLMs and the limited cross-task usability of acceleration methods that require task-specific fine-tuning or training from scratch. AdaDSF converts off-the-shelf pretrained LLMs into depth-sparse models without full retraining by using cosine similarity between layer input and output hidden states to set layer-wise token retention ratios, routing informative tokens through each layer, and aligning sparse and dense intermediate/final representations with a feature-preserving objective. Experiments on GPT-NeoX and Qwen2.5 show substantial FLOPs reduction with performance close to dense models and smaller accuracy degradation than MoD, D-LLM, and DLO at comparable sparsity.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对预训练LLM推理成本高、现有加速方法依赖任务微调或重训练的问题，提出无需全量重训的自适应深度稀疏框架AdaDSF。其核心洞见是不同Transformer层对表征变换贡献不均，可用层输入/输出隐藏状态的余弦相似度指导每层token保留率，并结合轻量路由与特征对齐损失保持稀疏模型表征。实验表明，在GPT-NeoX和Qwen2.5上可显著降低FLOPs且性能接近稠密模型，同等稀疏度下精度损失小于MoD、D-LLM和DLO等方法。

papers.title: HiKV: Hierarchical Importance-Aware KV Cache with Hardware Acceleration for LLM Decoding
papers.authors: Chao Fang, Jun Yin, Man Shi, Marian Verhelst
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid adoption of long-context large language models (LLMs), the continuously growing KV cache during decoding has become the critical memory bottleneck. To tackle this challenge, we propose HiKV, a novel algorithm-hardware co-design that exploits KV cache redundancy through hierarchical importance awareness. Algorithmically, HiKV compresses the KV cache at two granularities: Stage I evicts unimportant tokens within a fixed budget, and Stage II further loads only the significant elements of each retained token, reaching compression ratios unattainable at a single granularity. Architecturally, we develop a dedicated accelerator centered on a reconfigurable importance sorter that switches between the distinct sorting datapaths each stage requires, unifying the two-stage acceleration in one circuit with minimal overhead. Evaluated on representative LLMs, HiKV achieves up to 7.95x speedup and 90% energy reduction in the attention computation over the vanilla KV cache baseline within negligible 1% accuracy loss. Under iso-accuracy constraints, HiKV outperforms state-of-the-art importance-based methods by achieving an additional 1.82~4.87x reduction in external memory accesses. These benefits are enabled by specialized hardware components that add only 8% to the system area.
papers.comment: To appear in the IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems I: Regular Papers (TCAS-I)
papers.ai_summary_en: HiKV addresses the memory bottleneck of expanding KV caches during long-context LLM decoding by exploiting hierarchical importance-aware cache redundancy through an algorithm–hardware co-design. Its two-stage method first evicts unimportant tokens under a fixed budget, then loads only significant elements of retained tokens, accelerated by a reconfigurable importance sorter that unifies both sorting datapaths with low overhead. Experiments show up to 7.95× attention speedup and 90% energy reduction with about 1% accuracy loss, plus 1.82–4.87× fewer external memory accesses than state-of-the-art importance-based methods under iso-accuracy constraints.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 解码中 KV cache 持续膨胀导致的内存带宽与能耗瓶颈，提出算法-硬件协同的 HiKV。其核心洞见是按层级重要性压缩 KV cache：先在 token 级淘汰不重要 token，再在保留 token 内只加载关键元素，并用可重构重要性排序加速器统一支持两阶段处理。实验显示，在约 1% 精度损失下，注意力计算最高加速 7.95 倍、能耗降低 90%，且等精度下外部内存访问较现有方法再降 1.82–4.87 倍。

papers.title: A Roadmap to Impactful Pluralistic Alignment Research
papers.authors: Elinor Poole-Dayan, Jillian Fisher, Atoosa Kasirzadeh, Jacob Andreas, Mitchell Gordon, Michiel A. Bakker
papers.abstract_en: Pluralistic value alignment---the goal of building AI systems that represent and serve diverse human values and perspectives---has emerged as an active research agenda. Yet, there's no public evidence that it has shaped the training or evaluation of the AI systems people actually use. We audit the public behavior documents and evaluations of frontier labs, finding none name pluralism as a goal, and as of this writing, no clear indication that production models are explicitly trained or tested for it. This goes against the primary motivations and goals of pluralistic alignment, which revolve around making a positive difference in the models serving billions of users worldwide. We argue that the pluralistic alignment research community should focus on supporting impact and adoption in deployed, widely-used AI systems. We provide evidence for the adoption problem, present three main reasons behind it, and discuss three corresponding areas for future research to address it: 1. The primary justifications for pluralistic alignment so far have been normative or speculative. We need studies showing empirically how pluralistic AI benefits users or society. 2. The pluralistic alignment research community has not settled when pluralistic behavior is warranted or what pluralism ideally looks like in practice. We need to establish a concrete goal for developers to operationalize. 3. Current methods trade off against other desiderata of LLMs in ways that are largely unmeasured, and existing metrics are not "hill-climbable." We need trade-off-aware evaluations and methods that meet the requirements of production systems. This paper serves as a collective call to action for the pluralistic alignment researchers: progress requires moving beyond normative justification toward empirical foundations, a concrete account of ideal pluralistic behavior, and practical methods and evaluations built for adoption.
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the adoption gap in pluralistic value alignment: despite research aiming to make LLMs represent diverse human values, public documentation and evaluations of frontier deployed models show no explicit training or testing for pluralism. Its key contribution is a roadmap arguing that the field must move from normative justifications to empirical user/societal benefit studies, concrete operational definitions of pluralistic behavior, and production-compatible methods with trade-off-aware, optimizable metrics. The main impact is framing pluralistic alignment as a deployment and evaluation problem, urging research that can be adopted in widely served LLM systems rather than remaining speculative.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该文针对“多元价值对齐”研究未能影响实际部署的大模型训练与评估这一问题，审计前沿实验室公开文档后发现生产系统并未明确以多元主义为目标。论文提出应转向可落地的研究路线：提供多元对齐益处的实证证据、定义可操作化的理想多元行为，并开发权衡感知、可优化的评估与方法。其核心影响是呼吁该领域从规范性论证走向面向生产系统采纳的实证基础与工程可行方案。

papers.title: Unified Static-Dynamic Pruning for Efficient LLM Inference
papers.authors: Jinhyeok Kim, Yejoon Lee, Jaeyoung Do
papers.abstract_en: The increasing deployment of large language models (LLMs) has magnified the computational and memory bottlenecks of autoregressive decoding, where low compute intensity and bandwidth-bound kernels dominate inference cost. Weight pruning offers a promising remedy,   but existing methods remain confined to either static pruning (SP), which permanently removes redundant weights but lacks adaptivity, or dynamic pruning (DP), which adapts to input sparsity but introduces runtime irregularity. This paper presents SPDP, a unified   sparse-inference framework that integrates unstructured SP with input-adaptive DP for efficient LLM inference on GPUs. SPDP co-designs a new Tiled-Column-wise Bitmap Compressed (Tiled-CBC) format and two complementary GPU kernels: (1) a CUDA-core spMspV kernel   featuring Hybrid Activation-aware Dynamic Shared-Memory Bitmap Decoding (HAD-SMBD) for fine-grained, runtime activation skipping, and (2) a Tensor-Core SpMM kernel optimized for prefill computation. This joint format-kernel design harmonizes static and dynamic   sparsity, maintaining bandwidth-efficient memory access and high compute intensity under both phases of LLM inference. Comprehensive evaluations on inference-optimized GPUs demonstrate that SPDP achieves 1.24x-1.37x average speedup (up to 2.51x) over state-of-the-   art sparse frameworks such as SpInfer, while matching. perplexity with up to 25% higher sparsity. SPDP advances the inference efficiency-quality Pareto frontier, showing that unified static-dynamic pruning can deliver substantial throughput and performance-per-watt   improvements in large-scale LLM serving
papers.comment: 14 pages, 13 figures. Accepted for publication in Proceedings of the VLDB Endowment (PVLDB), Volume 19, Issue 11, 2026. Code: https://github.com/AIDASLab/SPDP
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the memory-bandwidth bottleneck of autoregressive LLM decoding and the tradeoff between static pruning’s efficiency and dynamic pruning’s adaptivity. It proposes SPDP, a unified GPU sparse-inference framework that combines unstructured static weight pruning with input-adaptive dynamic pruning using a Tiled-Column-wise Bitmap Compressed format, a CUDA-core spMspV kernel for fine-grained activation skipping, and a Tensor-Core SpMM kernel for prefill. SPDP achieves 1.24×–1.37× average speedup (up to 2.51×) over state-of-the-art sparse frameworks such as SpInfer while matching perplexity at up to 25% higher sparsity, improving LLM serving throughput and performance-per-watt.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM推理中自回归解码带宽受限、现有静态剪枝缺乏自适应性而动态剪枝又带来不规则开销的问题，提出SPDP统一静态-动态稀疏推理框架。其核心洞见是通过Tiled-CBC压缩格式与配套GPU kernel（面向解码的spMspV和面向prefill的Tensor-Core SpMM）协同设计，在保持内存访问与计算效率的同时融合固定权重稀疏和输入自适应稀疏。实验显示，相较SpInfer等先进稀疏框架平均加速1.24–1.37倍、最高2.51倍，并可在提高最多25%稀疏度的情况下保持相近困惑度，推进了LLM服务的效率-质量权衡前沿。

papers.title: Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills
papers.authors: Siyuan Huang, Pengyu Cheng, Haotian Liu, Tao Chen, Yihao Liu, Jingwei Ni, Shijie Zhou, Ziyi Yang, Gangwei Jiang, Mengyu Zhou, Yu Cheng, Xiaoxi Jiang, Guanjun Jiang
papers.abstract_en: LLM training is shifting from manual design and annotation to interaction-driven self-evolution. However, existing self-evolutionary methods face a fundamental dilemma between task diversity and verification reliability: environment-bound methods obtain precise feedback but confine learning to narrow domains, while open-ended self-generation broadens the task space but lacks reliable verification, allowing misleading rewards to pollute the training loop. We identify agent skills as a powerful middle ground to reconcile this tension: each skill ensures deep, verifiable execution in a specific scenario, while dynamic routing across skills maintains open-ended task variety. Leveraging this insight, we introduce Skill Self-Play (Skill-SP), a co-evolutionary framework comprising a proposer, a solver, and a dynamic skill controller. Orchestrated via a reinforcement learning loop, these components co-evolve in a continuous self-play loop: the proposer generates challenging tasks conditioned on dynamically sampled skills; the solver explores candidate solutions to push its capability boundaries; and the skill controller collects execution feedback to update and expand the skill library. This interactive co-evolution effectively bridges the gap between structured verification and open-ended exploration. Empirical evaluations on tool-use and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that Skill-SP, serving as a robust evolution engine, consistently pushes the performance ceiling of competent backbones while catalyzing striking turnarounds for initially misaligned models. Our code is available at https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/skill-self-play.
papers.ai_summary_en: Skill Self-Play addresses the core tension in LLM self-evolution between environment-bound methods that provide reliable verification but limited task diversity and open-ended self-generation that broadens tasks but suffers from unreliable reward signals. The paper proposes Skill-SP, an RL-orchestrated co-evolutionary framework in which a proposer generates skill-conditioned tasks, a solver attempts them, and a dynamic skill controller updates and expands a verifiable skill library through execution feedback. Experiments on tool-use and reasoning benchmarks show that the method consistently improves strong backbone models and can substantially recover initially misaligned models, bridging structured verification with open-ended exploration.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对大模型自演化训练中“任务多样性”和“反馈可验证性”难以兼顾的问题，提出以智能体技能作为中间载体来平衡开放探索与可靠验证。其核心方法是 Skill Self-Play（Skill-SP），通过提议器、求解器和动态技能控制器在强化学习自博弈中共同演化，持续生成、求解并扩展可验证技能任务。实验显示，该方法在工具使用和推理基准上能进一步提升强模型能力上限，并显著改善初始不对齐模型的表现。

papers.title: CausalForge: A Formally Grounded, Self-Improving Agentic Framework for Automated Research in Causal Inference
papers.authors: Jiyuan Tan, Vasilis Syrgkanis
papers.abstract_en: Automating theoretical research is constrained not only by the generation of candidate results, but also by their reliable evaluation. A common approach is to close the research loop with a large language model (LLM) reviewer. However, such reviewers remain empirically unreliable: they may accept fabricated papers and detect them at rates close to chance (Bad Scientist, 2025). We present CausalForge, a framework for automated theoretical research in causal inference grounded in the Lean proof assistant. CausalForge combines Causalean, a foundational Lean library for causal inference containing 7,035 machine-checked declarations developed with language-model assistance under human design and review, with CausalSmith, a self-improving agentic pipeline that selects research topics, proposes results, formalizes statements, constructs proofs, and presents the resulting artifacts for human inspection. Because a machine-checked proof establishes only that a formal statement follows from its assumptions, not that the statement faithfully captures the intended scientific claim, the pipeline augments kernel verification with a statement audit that compares each formal theorem against the informal claim it is intended to express. We evaluate the system using artifacts produced by completed autonomous research runs. The source code, formal library, and run records are available at https://github.com/Jiyuan-Tan/CausalForge.
papers.ai_summary_en: CausalForge addresses the unreliable evaluation problem in LLM-driven automated theoretical research, where LLM reviewers may accept invalid results and kernel-checked proofs alone do not guarantee that formal statements capture intended scientific claims. The framework combines Causalean, a 7,035-declaration Lean library for causal inference, with CausalSmith, a self-improving agentic pipeline that selects topics, proposes results, formalizes theorems, constructs proofs, and audits formal statements against informal claims. Its main contribution is a formally grounded, human-inspectable autonomous research loop, evaluated via completed run artifacts and released with source code, formal library, and run records.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作针对自动化理论研究中 LLM 评审不可靠、生成结论难以可信验证的问题，聚焦因果推断领域的自动研究与证明。其核心方法是构建基于 Lean 的形式化框架 CausalForge：一方面建立包含 7,035 个机器检查声明的 Causalean 库，另一方面用自改进智能体 CausalSmith 完成选题、命题、形式化、证明，并通过“陈述审计”校验形式定理是否忠实表达原始科学主张。主要结果是形成了一套可验证、可审查的自主因果研究流程与开源制品，提升了 LLM 驱动理论研究的可靠性。

papers.title: TRACE-ROUTER: Task-Consistent and Adaptive Online Routing for Agentic AI
papers.authors: Ritik Raj, Souvik Kundu, Sarbartha Banerjee, Dheemanth Joshi, Ishita Vohra, Tushar Krishna
papers.abstract_en: Routing to select large language models (LLMs) with different cost-quality trade-offs has become a fundamental deployment feature of enterprise AI. Existing routers, primarily make independent routing decisions for each LLM call. However, agentic applications execute as long-horizon workflows whose quality is determined only by a delayed, task-level outcome. This mismatch prevents per-call routers from correctly attributing feedback to individual routing decisions. Towards mitigating this, we present TRACE-Router, a task-level routing framework that aligns routing with the unit of supervision. TRACE-Router assigns each task to a model once at admission using a contextual bandit, pins all subsequent LLM calls to the selected backend, and updates its policy using the task's terminal reward, jointly accounting for accuracy and latency. By leveraging delayed task feedback, TRACE-Router learns routing policies that adapt to the workload while avoiding explicit task-complexity estimation. Across three agentic benchmarks, TRACE-Router consistently improves the accuracy-latency trade-off, achieving non-dominated Pareto frontier points. On tau2-Bench, it outperforms latency-matched interpolation between individual models by 7-8 accuracy points, while on Terminal-Bench it achieves 7.1 higher accuracy points than the strongest single model baseline with 36% lower latency.
papers.ai_summary_en: TRACE-Router addresses the mismatch between per-call LLM routing and delayed task-level supervision in long-horizon agentic workflows, where independent routing decisions make feedback attribution difficult. It proposes a task-level online routing framework that assigns an entire task to a single backend model at admission using a contextual bandit, pins all subsequent calls to that model, and updates the policy from terminal task rewards that jointly capture accuracy and latency. Across three agentic benchmarks, TRACE-Router yields non-dominated accuracy–latency Pareto improvements, including 7–8 accuracy points over latency-matched model interpolation on tau2-Bench and 7.1 higher accuracy than the strongest single model on Terminal-Bench with 36% lower latency.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对智能体工作流中逐次LLM路由难以利用延迟任务反馈的问题，TRACE-Router将路由决策提升到任务级：在任务接入时用上下文多臂赌博机选择模型并固定整个工作流，再以任务最终的准确率-延迟奖励在线更新策略。该方法无需显式估计任务复杂度即可自适应工作负载，在三个智能体基准上取得更优的准确率-延迟Pareto前沿。例如在tau2-Bench上较延迟匹配的模型插值提升7-8个准确率点，在Terminal-Bench上较最强单模型提升7.1个准确率点并降低36%延迟。

papers.title: Where FactsGo Missing: A LayerwiseTaxonomy and Per-Layer Attribution of Information Omissionin Air-Gapped LLM Agent Pipelines
papers.authors: Santhiya Rajan
papers.abstract_en: Air-gapped and on-premises deployments in regulated settings (clinical FHIR services, legal review, sovereign infrastructure) cannot call frontier APIs; they run quantized 4-8B models via llama.cpp or vLLM behind tool servers. The dominant reliability failure is omission: the silent absence of a decision-critical fact, such as an agent reading 20 of 400 records and reporting "no anomalies." We argue omission is a pipeline phenomenon, not a model phenomenon, and make four contributions. First, a nine-layer taxonomy (L0-L8) locating every omission mechanism from ingestion through the agent loop. Second, an attribution methodology separating deterministic layers (L0-L3) from behavioral layers (L4-L8) via controlled ablation and logit decomposition, quantifying each with an omission waterfall. Third, an open cross-architecture harness comparing sliding-window-hybrid, full-attention, and SSM-hybrid models across engines and frameworks. Fourth, a runtime-detection framework for air-gapped settings where you own the logits. Results from a 75,476-trial sweep across five models and two engines show a pooled omission rate of 0.62; 68% originates in deterministic middleware (L0-L3), relocating where operators should intervene. Server-side profile factors (weight quantization, KV-cache type, RoPE scaling) were fixed and left for future work.
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses silent information omission in air-gapped/on-premises LLM agent pipelines, where quantized 4–8B models served via llama.cpp or vLLM can fail to surface decision-critical facts. It proposes a nine-layer pipeline taxonomy and an attribution methodology using controlled ablations and logit decomposition to separate deterministic middleware layers from behavioral model/agent layers, alongside a cross-architecture evaluation harness and runtime detection framework. Across 75,476 trials, it reports a pooled omission rate of 0.62, with 68% of omissions originating in deterministic middleware layers (L0–L3), shifting the reliability focus from model capability to serving and tooling infrastructure.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对离网/本地部署的 LLM Agent 管道中“关键事实被静默遗漏”的可靠性问题，提出从数据摄入到代理循环的九层分类，并用受控消融与 logit 分解进行逐层归因。其核心洞见是信息遗漏主要不是模型能力问题，而是管道问题，尤其集中在确定性中间件层。基于 5 个模型、2 个推理引擎的 75,476 次实验，论文发现总体遗漏率为 0.62，其中 68% 来自 L0–L3 层，为离网场景的故障定位和运行时检测提供了明确干预方向。

papers.title: TileSight: A First-Principles Tile-Centric Analytical GPU Performance Model from Cores to Clusters
papers.authors: Zhiwen Mo, Yu Cheng, Lei Wang, Zhengju Tang, Lei Xu, Guoyu Li, Yuqi Dong, Lingxiao Ma, Yuqing Xia, Jilong Xue, Fan Yang, Luo Mai, Zhi Yang, Wayne Luk, Hongxiang Fan
papers.abstract_en: Recent GPU programming frameworks such as Triton, TileLang, and CUDA Tile adopt tiles as first-class primitives, making tile-centric programming the prevailing approach for high-performance GPU kernels. Performance-analysis tooling has not followed: programmers still rely on coarse roofline bounds, opaque ML predictors, or post-hoc profilers to understand kernel execution. This gap is acute for modern AI workloads, where kernel fusion and distributed inference depend on tensor cores, CUDA cores, cache hierarchies, memory pipelines, and inter-GPU networks. We present TileSight, a tile-centric performance-modeling tool that elevates the tile from a programming primitive to an analysis primitive. Within a GPU core, TileSight models compute-memory pipeline overlap; across cores, it models the cache hierarchy; across GPUs, it models inter-node communication. All layers share the tile abstraction: the intra-tile layer expresses work as a resource vector spanning network, memory, and compute pipelines; the inter-tile layer schedules dependent and ordered actions to expose legal overlap and infers multi-level cache hit rates from tile reuse distance; and the cross-device layer maps remote tensor accesses to placements and routes them through an alpha-beta stage cost. On A100, H200, B200, and B6000, TileSight predicts single-GPU kernel latency with 12.35% pooled mean absolute percentage error (MAPE), outperforming state-of-the-art baselines and transferring better across architectures. Its L2 cache-hit-rate predictions are within roughly one percentage point of measurements on every GPU. At up to 32 GPUs, TileSight achieves 16.18% weighted MAPE (wMAPE) on fused distributed kernels and 13.52% wMAPE on end-to-end vLLM serving. In optimization, TileSight selects tile configurations competitive with strong vendor and expert baselines. TileSight will be open-sourced upon publication.
papers.ai_summary_en: TileSight addresses the lack of accurate performance-analysis tooling for modern tile-centric GPU kernels in AI and LLM serving, where programmers currently rely on coarse rooflines, opaque ML predictors, or post-hoc profilers. It introduces a first-principles analytical model that treats tiles as the core analysis primitive, modeling intra-tile compute/memory/network pipeline overlap, inter-tile scheduling and multi-level cache reuse, and cross-GPU communication using an alpha-beta cost model. Evaluated on A100, H200, B200, and B6000, TileSight predicts single-GPU kernel latency with 12.35% pooled MAPE, L2 hit rates within ~1 percentage point, and distributed fused-kernel/end-to-end vLLM serving latency up to 32 GPUs with 16.18%/13.52% weighted MAPE, while selecting tile configurations competitive with strong baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 针对GPU内核性能分析工具难以适配tile编程、且无法统一刻画计算/缓存/跨GPU通信的问题，TileSight将tile提升为核心分析原语，分层建模核内计算-内存流水线重叠、核间多级缓存复用与跨设备远程张量访问成本。该方法通过资源向量和tile调度推断合法并行及缓存命中率，并用alpha-beta模型刻画分布式通信。实验显示其在多代GPU上单内核延迟MAPE约12.35%、L2命中率误差约1个百分点，并在32 GPU融合内核和vLLM端到端服务上分别取得16.18%和13.52%加权MAPE，可有效指导tile配置优化。

papers.title: SMEFT-Pheno-Agent: a natural-language-driven AI agent for machine-learning-assisted Standard Model Effective Field Theory phenomenology
papers.authors: Yu-Chen Guo, Jie Wang, Ji-Chong Yang
papers.abstract_en: We present SMEFT-Pheno-Agent, a Python workflow guided by a natural-language AI agent to perform machine-learning-assisted Standard Model Effective Field Theory (SMEFT) phenomenology at high-energy colliders. The software coordinates twelve automated execution phases spanning configuration intake, environment validation, event generation, machine-learning selection, statistical inference, and final audit. At each phase boundary, the agent interprets natural-language intent to generate runnable parameter files and adapter invocations required for subsequent execution. Once the detector-level events are written, the agent automatically proposes key kinematic observables alongside candidate machine-learning algorithms suited to the specific data structure and analysis objectives. All numerical calculations are delegated strictly to validated domain tools, with MadGraph5_aMC@NLO, Pythia, Delphes generating collider simulations, and MLAnalysis extracting features. The agent cannot modify physical parameters outside the locked configuration, and all LLM-produced artifacts, including parameter files, observable choices, algorithm selections, and prose drafts, are documented in machine-readable phase manifests prior to execution. These manifests establish complete reproducibility and audit traceability for SMEFT phenomenology studies.
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the complexity and reproducibility burden of Standard Model Effective Field Theory phenomenology at high-energy colliders by enabling natural-language-driven automation of simulation and machine-learning analysis workflows. It introduces SMEFT-Pheno-Agent, a Python-based LLM agent that converts user intent into locked configuration files and auditable phase manifests, orchestrating MadGraph5_aMC@NLO, Pythia, Delphes, and MLAnalysis across twelve validated execution phases. The main impact is an end-to-end, reproducible, and auditable SMEFT analysis pipeline in which the agent proposes observables and ML methods while all numerical computation remains delegated to domain-specific tools.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该工作面向高能对撞机SMEFT现象学分析流程复杂、可复现性要求高的问题，提出一个由自然语言驱动的AI代理工作流。其核心方法是让LLM代理解析用户意图并协调配置、事件生成、ML选择、统计推断等12个阶段，同时严格调用MadGraph、Pythia、Delphes等验证工具执行数值计算，并将所有生成产物记录到机器可读清单中。该方案实现了端到端自动化与审计追踪，提升了SMEFT分析的可复现性和易用性。

papers.title: Agentic CPU-GPU Scheduling for Heterogeneous AI Workloads
papers.authors: Tianxi Lu, Sherief Reda
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems compose heterogeneous tool workloads on shared GPU/CPU infrastructure, yet existing frameworks assign all GPU-capable tools to the GPU by default. We profile 19 AI tools across GPU and CPU and find that 11 are GPU-preferred, 4 are ambiguous, 1 is CPU-preferred due to PCIe transfer dominance, and 3 are device-neutral, establishing that blanket GPU-first scheduling is suboptimal. We formulate device scheduling as assigning each tool to one of three options: immediate GPU execution, queued GPU execution, or CPU offload, under a VRAM budget, and identify two runtime factors that cause end-to-end latency to diverge from static profiles: GPU utilization contention and VRAM capacity contention. We present an agentic scheduler that pairs an LLM agent with an algorithmic runtime monitor, where the monitor expands what the LLM can observe via running averages, symmetric reprobing, swap reprobing, and exploration hints, without ever prescribing which mapping to adopt. Across 13 scenarios spanning serial execution, parallel contention, and memory-constrained execution, the agentic scheduler reaches the brute-force optimal mapping in all 13 scenarios, matching the best classical baseline on mapping accuracy while avoiding bandit-style exploration over complete mappings, and outperforming HEFT, StarPU, and the all-GPU policy while requiring zero offline training.
papers.ai_summary_en: This paper tackles suboptimal GPU-first scheduling for heterogeneous agentic AI tool workloads on shared CPU/GPU systems, where PCIe transfer costs, GPU contention, and VRAM limits can make CPU offloading or queued GPU execution preferable. It formulates tool placement as choosing among immediate GPU, queued GPU, or CPU execution under a VRAM budget, and introduces an agentic scheduler where an LLM agent is guided by an algorithmic runtime monitor that expands observability via running averages, reprobing, and exploration hints without directly prescribing mappings. Across 13 serial, parallel, and memory-constrained scenarios, the scheduler reaches the brute-force optimal mapping in all cases and outperforms HEFT, StarPU, and all-GPU baselines while requiring no offline training.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对智能体系统中异构 AI 工具在共享 CPU/GPU 上被默认全量调度到 GPU 导致次优的问题，指出现有策略忽略了 PCIe 传输、GPU 利用率和显存容量等运行时竞争。其核心方法是将工具映射为立即 GPU、排队 GPU 或 CPU 卸载三类决策，并用 LLM 智能体结合算法化运行时监控器扩展观测信息，但不直接替智能体做映射选择。实验在 13 个串行、并行和显存受限场景中均达到暴力搜索最优映射，优于 HEFT、StarPU 和全 GPU 策略，且无需离线训练。

papers.title: HarnessLLM: Rust Verification Harness Generation with Large Language Models
papers.authors: Minghua Wang, Yuwei Liu, Lin Huang
papers.abstract_en: Rust's ownership model and type system offer strong memory safety guarantees, but unsafe code and runtime panics still present significant risks. Formal verification is essential to ensure memory safety, but developing verification harnesses remains a challenging and manual task. Although large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in various code analysis tasks, directly applying them to harness generation often results in inaccurate API invocations, inefficient nondeterministic data generation, and fabricated fixes.   In this paper, we present HarnessLLM, an automated workflow that leverages LLMs to generate verification harnesses for Rust code directly from existing test suites. HarnessLLM automatically extracts calling scenarios from test cases, generates nondeterministic arguments based on dependency analysis, and incrementally synthesizes harnesses. It then iteratively refines the harnesses, preserving critical code regions and reporting fabricated types or functions to LLMs for correction. In our evaluation on 9 real-world Rust codebases, HarnessLLM extracted 294 calling scenarios from 494 test cases with 94.66% precision and generated harnesses for all scenarios in an average of 145 seconds each. It outperformed the existing approach, Autoharness, which succeeded on only 41% of those scenarios. Finally, 6 real-world memory safety bugs were detected using the generated harnesses, demonstrating the practical utility of our approach in verification. To our knowledge, this is the first work to use LLMs for generating harnesses aimed at memory safety verification in real-world Rust projects.
papers.ai_summary_en: HarnessLLM addresses the manual and error-prone problem of generating formal verification harnesses for Rust, where direct LLM use often produces incorrect API calls, poor nondeterministic input generation, and hallucinated fixes. Its key method is an automated workflow that mines calling scenarios from existing test suites, uses dependency analysis to synthesize nondeterministic arguments, incrementally constructs harnesses, and iteratively repairs them by preserving valid code regions and flagging fabricated types or functions for LLM correction. Evaluated on nine real-world Rust projects, it extracted 294 scenarios with 94.66% precision, generated harnesses for all scenarios in ~145 seconds each, outperformed Autoharness (41% success), and detected six real memory-safety bugs.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 Rust 内存安全验证中验证 harness 手工构建困难、直接用 LLM 生成易出现错误 API 调用和虚构代码的问题。HarnessLLM 从现有测试用例提取调用场景，结合依赖分析生成非确定性参数并增量合成 harness，再通过保留关键代码区域和反馈虚构类型/函数进行迭代修正。在 9 个真实 Rust 项目上，它以 94.66% 精度提取 294 个场景，显著优于 Autoharness，并发现 6 个真实内存安全缺陷。

papers.title: Visual Saliency Steering Distillation for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.authors: Hao Yang, Jin Wang, Xuejie Zhang
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning integrates visual and textual cues through step-by-step inference. In small models with limited token budgets, modality-interaction fusion often suppresses tiny cross-modal differences. In particular, multimodal CoT often struggles when different images pair with identical text or different texts pair with an identical image, making such inputs nearly indistinguishable after fusion. This study proposes Visual Saliency Steering Distillation (VSSD). VSSD leverages the attention maps of multimodal large language models to generate perturbed images that capture task-sensitive feature directions, and then applies singular value decomposition to extract dominant steering vectors to guide inter-layer distillation. Experiments on ScienceQA and M$^3$CoT demonstrate that VSSD improves rationale generation and answer inference. The code is available at https://github.com/BGWH123/VSSD.
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses multimodal chain-of-thought reasoning in small models, where modality fusion can suppress subtle cross-modal differences and make distinct image–text pairs nearly indistinguishable. VSSD leverages multimodal LLM attention maps to generate task-sensitive perturbed images, extracts dominant steering vectors via singular value decomposition, and uses inter-layer distillation to guide smaller models toward salient visual features. Experiments on ScienceQA and M³CoT show improved rationale generation and answer inference, indicating better preservation of cross-modal discriminability under limited token budgets.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对小模型在多模态思维链推理中因模态融合抑制细微跨模态差异，导致“同文异图”或“同图异文”输入难以区分的问题。提出视觉显著性引导蒸馏（VSSD），利用多模态大模型的注意力图生成任务敏感扰动图像，并通过奇异值分解提取主导引导向量来指导层间蒸馏。实验在 ScienceQA 和 M³CoT 上表明，该方法能同时提升推理依据生成与答案推断效果。

papers.title: Semiotic logical hexagon theory for LLM logical reasoning
papers.authors: Yunyao Zhang, Xinglang Zhang, Zeliang Chen, Junqing Yu, Zikai Song
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have become powerful tools for language understanding and logical reasoning. However, they still make mistakes when a problem requires both understanding meaning and following logic. A key reason is that natural-language statements often carry implicit semantic relations before any formal reasoning begins. If these hidden meanings are not properly organized, the model may reach incorrect conclusions even when the subsequent reasoning process appears logically valid. Existing methods improve reasoning through decomposition, symbolic translation, external solvers, or self-verification, but pay comparatively less attention to the semantic structure on which reasoning depends. In this paper, we further investigate how semantic organization influences logical reasoning in LLMs. To this end, we propose HexLogicAgent, a framework that first organizes the meaning of natural-language statements and then guides logical reasoning through structured verification. In our investigation, we also make two observations. First, incomplete semantic representations, rather than deductive inference itself, are a major source of logical reasoning failures in LLMs. Second, explicitly modeling the complete structure of semantic opposition substantially delays the degradation of reasoning performance as logical complexity increases. Experiments on challenging logical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that HexLogicAgent consistently improves reasoning reliability across multiple LLMs. The core idea is supported by a logical hexagon theory, which explains why a complete structure of opposing meanings is necessary for reliable reasoning.
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses LLM logical-reasoning failures arising from implicit and incomplete semantic relations in natural-language premises, arguing that missing semantic structure—not only flawed deduction—is a primary error source. It proposes HexLogicAgent, a framework that explicitly organizes statement meanings using a logical-hexagon model of semantic opposition and then guides reasoning through structured verification. Experiments on challenging benchmarks show consistent reliability improvements across multiple LLMs, with complete semantic-opposition modeling delaying performance degradation as logical complexity increases.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM在逻辑推理中因自然语言隐含语义关系未被充分组织而导致错误的问题，提出 HexLogicAgent 框架，先构建语句的语义对立结构，再通过结构化验证引导推理。其核心洞见是推理失败主要源于语义表示不完整，而非演绎推理本身不足，并借助“逻辑六边形”理论说明完整对立语义结构对可靠推理的必要性。实验表明，该方法在多个高难度逻辑推理基准上稳定提升了不同LLM的推理可靠性，并能延缓复杂度增加带来的性能退化。

papers.title: RIS-Kernel: A Model-Agnostic Architecture for Long-Context LLM Inference via Sparse Attention
papers.authors: Anderson R. Santos
papers.abstract_en: Full self-attention in large language models scales as O(N^2), which limits long-context document analysis to 65,536 tokens and requires costly GPU clusters. The Reduced Interaction Sampling (RIS) inference engine addresses this constraint as a model-agnostic architecture. Without modifying weights, RIS reduces self-attention complexity to O(N log N) using sparse stochastic geometry that fits within commodity memory limits. We validate RIS on Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct across two regimes. In controlled evaluations at 32,768 tokens (where native dense attention serves as the upper bound), RIS-Stochastic at 1% density and 70 ensemble seeds achieves 75.00% accuracy, outperforming the native dense baseline (71.88%), while RIS-Stochastic at 5% density and 10 seeds matches it (71.88%). This demonstrates that sparse attention acts as a regularizer: low density (1%) over multiple seeds filters out sequence-level noise, whereas higher density (5%) reintroduces distractor noise. Under the tightest budget, RIS-Structural reaches 68.75% accuracy at 1% density with just 10 seeds, recovering 75% of the contextual gap relative to the zero-context floor (59.38%). At 65,536 tokens, where dense attention triggers out-of-memory faults, RIS yields retrieval gains of up to 14.06 percentage points over the zero-context floor (51.56%), which is confirmed as marginally significant under McNemar's paired test (p = 0.078 < 0.10). All evaluations run on commodity, unaccelerated CPU servers (16-128 GB of RAM), demonstrating that long-context LLM inference is feasible on standard academic hardware without GPU acceleration.
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the quadratic memory and compute bottleneck of full self-attention in long-context LLM inference, which restricts dense attention on commodity hardware. It proposes RIS-Kernel, a model-agnostic sparse attention engine that uses reduced interaction sampling and stochastic sparse geometry to lower attention complexity to O(N log N) without modifying model weights, with multi-seed ensembling acting as a regularizer. Experiments on Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct show that 1% sparse density with 70 seeds outperforms dense attention at 32,768 tokens, and RIS enables 65,536-token CPU-only inference where dense attention fails, achieving up to 14.06 percentage-point gains over zero-context baselines.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 中全自注意力 O(N²) 复杂度高、易受显存限制的问题，提出模型无关的 RIS 稀疏注意力推理架构，在不修改模型权重的情况下将注意力复杂度降至 O(N log N)。其核心洞见是低密度、多种子的随机稀疏注意力可起到正则化作用，能够过滤序列噪声，在 32K token 上匹配甚至超过稠密注意力，并在 65K token 稠密注意力 OOM 时仍带来最高 14.06 个百分点的边际显著提升。该工作表明，长上下文 LLM 推理可在普通 CPU 服务器上实现，降低了对高端 GPU 集群的依赖。

papers.title: RED-PIM: Reducing Data Movement for Transformers using Processing-in-Memory
papers.authors: Zahra Yousefijamarani, Alaa Alameldeen
papers.abstract_en: Transformers are widely used across many domains, including natural language processing, computer vision, web search, and DNA sequence analysis. Given their broad applicability, improving the performance of transformer models is critical. However, the high volume of data movement between processing units and memory during attention operations significantly limits their efficiency. Processing-In-Memory (PIM) mitigates this issue by performing computations directly inside memory. While prior work has proposed PIM-based transformer implementations, they suffer from costly inter-bank communication, and struggle to scale due to the limited capacity of memory banks. As a result, attention-related data must be split across banks, diminishing the potential benefits of PIM.   In this work, we propose RED-PIM, an algorithm-architecture co-design that reduces attention latency by minimizing inter-bank data movement from O(N^2) to O(N) and shrinking intermediate attention matrices from N x N to d x d. By reorganizing matrix operations, performing computations locally, and employing an optimized data transfer strategy, RED-PIM significantly reduces computation cost and interconnect traffic. Compared to baseline PIM implementation, RED-PIM achieves inference time reductions ranging from 16.05% to 99.99% (geometric mean of 66.42%), with the largest gains on longer sequences. On real-world datasets, RED-PIM improves performance by 99.60% for long documents and 13.44% for shorter ones, while maintaining or improving accuracy. These results demonstrate RED-PIM's effectiveness for scalable and efficient transformer inference.
papers.ai_summary_en: RED-PIM addresses the data-movement bottleneck in transformer attention under processing-in-memory architectures, where prior PIM designs suffer from costly inter-bank communication and limited scalability due to splitting large attention matrices across banks. It proposes an algorithm–architecture co-design that reorganizes attention operations for local in-bank computation, reducing inter-bank traffic from O(N²) to O(N) and shrinking intermediate attention matrices from N×N to d×d with an optimized transfer strategy. Experiments show substantial inference-latency reductions over baseline PIM—geometric mean 66.42%, up to 99.99%—with the largest gains on long sequences while maintaining or improving accuracy.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 Transformer 注意力计算中内存与计算单元间数据搬运过多、且现有 PIM 方案受跨 bank 通信和容量限制影响的问题，提出算法-架构协同设计的 RED-PIM。其核心洞见是通过重组矩阵运算、在内存内本地计算和优化传输策略，将跨 bank 数据移动从 O(N²) 降至 O(N)，并把中间注意力矩阵从 N×N 压缩为 d×d。实验显示，相比基线 PIM，推理时延平均降低约 66.42%，在长序列上最高可降低 99.99%，同时保持或提升精度。

papers.title: Agentic Root Cause Analysis through Evidence-Grounded Reasoning
papers.authors: Amaury Wei, Olga Fink
papers.abstract_en: Diagnosing the root cause of anomalies is essential for safe industrial operation. Despite extensive sensor instrumentation, formulating hypotheses and gathering evidence remains a manual process, creating a major operational bottleneck. While existing data-driven approaches aim to automate this, two critical limitations restrict their deployment: their operate as black boxes unable to justify their diagnosis, and they require scarce labeled examples of faulty operation. To address this gap, we introduce AgentRCA, a zero-shot agentic framework for evidence-grounded root cause analysis. Rather than learning fault-specific mappings, AgentRCA performs inference-time reasoning by combining a data-driven digital twin (modeling normal system dynamics) with a tool-augmented large language model. The agent iteratively gathers statistical evidence, evaluates competing hypotheses, and identifies the physical fault that best explains the observed behavior. Evaluated on a real-world multiphase-flow facility and a large-scale chemical plant, AgentRCA achieves diagnostic performance competitive with fully supervised baselines without relying on fault-specific training. Crucially, it produces transparent reasoning traces that explicitly link observed symptoms to their underlying physical causes. These results establish autonomous hypothesis-driven reasoning as a practical foundation for scalable industrial root cause analysis.
papers.ai_summary_en: AgentRCA addresses industrial root-cause analysis under scarce fault labels and opaque data-driven diagnostics by formulating diagnosis as zero-shot, evidence-grounded hypothesis testing. It couples a data-driven digital twin of normal system dynamics with a tool-augmented LLM agent that iteratively collects statistical evidence, evaluates competing physical fault hypotheses, and selects the best explanation. On real multiphase-flow and chemical-plant benchmarks, it achieves performance competitive with supervised baselines without fault-specific training while producing transparent reasoning traces linking symptoms to causes.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对工业异常根因分析中现有方法多为黑箱且依赖稀缺故障标签的问题，提出零样本智能体框架 AgentRCA。其核心是将建模正常系统动态的数据驱动数字孪生与工具增强的大语言模型结合，在推理时迭代收集统计证据、评估竞争假设并定位最符合观测行为的物理故障。实验在真实多相流设施和大型化工厂上显示，该方法无需故障专用训练即可达到与全监督基线相当的性能，并能生成将症状与物理原因显式关联的透明推理链。

papers.title: Fewer Paths, Better Performance: Understanding the ZCube Topology through Braess's Paradox
papers.authors: Li Chen
papers.abstract_en: Datacenter networks follow a multipath doctrine: provision many paths between endpoints, hash flows across them, and let redundancy absorb both failures and load imbalance. The ZCube topology violates this doctrine. It removes the Spine layer, eliminates path multiplicity, and cuts one third of switching hardware, yet delivers better performance for both large model training and inference. We explain this anomaly through a structural connection to Braess's paradox, first observed in 1968: both phenomena trace to congestion-oblivious routing over competing paths. Braess showed that adding paths under this condition can hurt; ZCube shows that removing paths under the same condition can help. First, we show that multipath fabrics under structured LLM traffic operate in Braess's shadow: static ECMP hashing is strictly more fragile than greedy routing. Greedy routing reaches an equilibrium within 4/3 of optimal for affine latencies; static hashing admits unbounded imbalance in the worst case. Second, we prove that ZCube is immune to Braess's paradox and that its orthogonal dual partition provably balances load for arbitrary traffic matrices; AllReduce in training and KV cache transfers in disaggregated inference fall out as two corollaries. Third, we quantify the price of this immunity: ZCube trades microsecond hash recovery for millisecond control plane recovery, a trade that upper-layer resilience in LLM serving makes favorable. Production measurements from a cluster serving GLM-5.1 coding inference report 33% lower network cost, 15% higher GPU throughput, and 40.6% lower P99 time to first token. Our analysis suggests that for workloads driven by model structure, matching topology to traffic matters more than path multiplicity.
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses why conventional multipath datacenter fabrics with static ECMP hashing can underperform for structured LLM training and serving traffic, showing they are vulnerable to Braess’s-paradox-style congestion. It proves that ZCube’s spine-reduced, low-path topology is immune to this paradox and can provably balance load for arbitrary traffic matrices via an orthogonal dual partition, with AllReduce and KV-cache transfers as corollaries. Production measurements on GLM-5.1 inference show 33% lower network cost, 15% higher GPU throughput, and 40.6% lower P99 time-to-first-token, indicating that traffic-matched topology can outperform path multiplicity.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该文针对LLM训练/推理中“多路径数据中心网络反而不如少路径ZCube”的反常现象，从Braess悖论角度解释其机理。作者证明在结构化LLM流量下，静态ECMP多路径哈希可能产生无界负载失衡，而ZCube通过去除Spine层和正交对偶划分实现可证明的负载均衡并免疫Braess悖论。生产测试显示其以更低网络成本获得更高GPU吞吐和显著更低的P99首token时延，表明面向模型流量设计拓扑比盲目增加路径更有效。

papers.title: Data Quality over Capacity: Internalizing Documents into LoRA Adapters for Closed-Book QA
papers.authors: Joan Figuerola Hurtado
papers.abstract_en: We study baking documents directly into the weights of a 4-bit Gemma-4-e4b model via LoRA, so a system can answer questions about a corpus closed-book: no retrieval and no context-window budget. Across roughly 100 training runs from single documents to a 99-document corpus, we find that once adapter capacity is adequate, training-data quality is the dominant lever on closed-book accuracy, outweighing LoRA rank, learning rate, and two alternative architectures combined; capacity itself is a hard gate below which no data intervention helps. A single curation pass (shortening gold answers to canonical 1-6 word spans and dropping trivia) moved closed-book accuracy from 57.7% to 85.7% on a 15-document corpus, a larger jump than any architectural change. We confirm a capacity trend (rank must grow with corpus size) entangled with a coupling between rank and learning rate that we initially misdiagnosed. On a 15-document slice we add a real retrieval baseline: the internalized adapter (84.2% recall) beats a BM25-RAG pipeline with a base reader (58.9%) and even a realistic gold-chunk oracle (65.6%) at lower latency. We report the full arc, including three misdiagnoses, as a case study in debugging LLM training empirically.
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses closed-book question answering over a private corpus by internalizing documents directly into the weights of a quantized LLM via LoRA, eliminating retrieval and context-window constraints. Through ~100 training runs, it shows that adapter capacity is a hard prerequisite, but once sufficient, training-data quality—especially concise canonical answer spans and trivia removal—dominates accuracy over LoRA rank, learning rate, and architecture choices. A single curation pass improves 15-document accuracy from 57.7% to 85.7%, and the internalized adapter outperforms BM25-RAG and even a gold-chunk retrieval oracle at lower latency.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 本文针对无需检索和上下文窗口的闭卷问答，研究通过 LoRA 将文档知识直接内化到 4-bit Gemma 模型权重中，并系统比较容量、超参与数据质量的影响。实验表明适配器容量是硬门槛，但一旦足够，答案规范化与去噪等数据质量改进比 rank、学习率或架构选择更关键，可将 15 文档准确率从 57.7% 提升至 85.7%，并在低延迟下超过 BM25-RAG 及 gold-chunk 检索基线。

papers.title: LOCKS: Page-Local Compact Key Summaries for Efficient Long-Context Decoding
papers.authors: Junsung Hwang
papers.abstract_en: Serving large language models at long context is bottlenecked by the key-value (KV) cache, which is read in full at every decode step. Attention keys are locally low-rank though globally high-rank: shared low-rank bases discard page-specific directions that a page's own compact basis retains. LOCKS gives every page its own spectral summary (resident, about a tenth the cache's size), reconstructs within-page logits, estimates each page's attention mass by log-sum-exp, and attends only the top pages; selection itself reads no candidate keys or values. Selecting on this summary alone stays within about a point of the full cache on long-document QA (LongBench-v1), tracks the read-every-key oracle on retrieval-dense RULER down to the smallest budgets, and shows its largest margins on long-form reasoning (AIME26, MATH-500), where baseline selectors collapse. At its shipped $2048$-token budget LOCKS matches FullKV aggregate quality at $100$K$+$ context while attending about $2\%$ of the tokens, and halves per-token decode latency ($2.0\times$ at $1$M tokens) against dense attention. LOCKS ships as a drop-in plugin for unmodified vLLM, with batched decode running in full CUDA graphs.
papers.ai_summary_en: LOCKS addresses the long-context LLM serving bottleneck caused by reading the full KV cache at every decode step. It assigns each KV page a compact page-local spectral key summary, uses these summaries to reconstruct within-page logits and estimate page-level attention mass via log-sum-exp, and then attends only the top pages without reading candidate keys or values. With a 2048-token summary budget, LOCKS matches full-cache aggregate quality on 100K+ contexts while attending about 2% of tokens and achieves roughly 2× decode latency reduction at 1M tokens, with a drop-in vLLM/CUDA-graph-compatible implementation.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对长上下文 LLM 解码中每步需读取完整 KV 缓存导致的带宽与延迟瓶颈，利用注意力键“页内低秩、全局高秩”的特性，为每个 KV 页维护一个常驻的紧凑谱摘要。LOCKS 通过页内摘要重建 logit，并用 log-sum-exp 估计每页注意力质量，在不读取候选键值的情况下选择 Top 页进行稀疏注意力。实验表明，其在 LongBench、RULER 和数学推理任务上接近全缓存效果，在 100K+ 上下文仅需关注约 2% token 即可匹配 FullKV，并将解码延迟降低约 2 倍，且可作为 vLLM 插件直接部署。

papers.title: KAP: Bridging the Knowledge Selection-Runtime Consumption Gap in LLM Systems
papers.authors: Shuo Wang, Fang Xi, Wenyuan Huang, Qing Wang, Junming Su
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLM systems increasingly rely on knowledge-selection processes that produce high-value structured priors, such as ranked evidence, graph topology, multimodal alignment, and confidence signals. Yet LLM serving remains fundamentally oblivious to this rich structure: once such signals are serialized into a prompt, the backend observes only a flat token sequence, forcing dense and uniform consumption of the full key-value (KV) state during decoding. We term this architectural mismatch the Knowledge Selection-Runtime Consumption (KSRC) gap: richer contexts enlarge the full-prompt KV footprint and decode-time memory traffic, increasing latency and degrading throughput even when reasoning depends on only a small fraction of the context. To bridge the gap, we propose Knowledge Access Planning (KAP), a paradigm-shifting execution abstraction that elevates structured knowledge priors from passive prompt-construction hints into first-class physical execution artifacts. KAP establishes a universal intermediate representation (IR)-the runtime access plan-which compiles structured knowledge signals to govern physical KV access without altering logical prompt semantics, model weights, or training procedures. Through this IR, KAP shifts LLM serving from token-aware context consumption to plan-driven, knowledge-aware runtime consumption. We instantiate KAP with GraphSpec, a compiler-executor realization connecting structured knowledge selection to an LLM serving backend. We derive a phase-boundary model for the positive-speedup regime of plan-guided execution. Across 4K-128K long-context QA workloads, GraphSpec maintains answer quality comparable to full-context decoding while decoupling physical KV consumption from prompt length, reducing proposal-time KV access to 5.5% of source KV state at 128K, and fundamentally shifting the scaling trajectory of long-context generation.
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the Knowledge Selection–Runtime Consumption (KSRC) gap in LLM serving, where structured knowledge priors are flattened into prompts and force dense, uniform KV-state access despite only a small fraction of context being needed. It proposes Knowledge Access Planning (KAP), an intermediate representation that compiles knowledge-selection signals into runtime access plans governing physical KV access without changing prompt semantics, model weights, or training. Implemented as GraphSpec, the system preserves full-context answer quality on 4K–128K QA workloads while reducing KV access to 5.5% of the source KV state at 128K, decoupling serving cost from prompt length and improving long-context scalability.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对LLM服务中“知识选择产生的结构化先验”与“运行时仍将提示视为扁平token并全量访问KV”的不匹配问题，指出这会在长上下文下显著增加内存访问、延迟和吞吐压力。其核心方法是提出Knowledge Access Planning（KAP），将排序证据、图结构、置信度等知识信号编译为运行时访问计划这一中间表示，在不改变提示语义、模型权重和训练流程的前提下指导物理KV访问。GraphSpec实例在4K–128K长上下文QA中保持接近全上下文的答案质量，并将128K时规划阶段KV访问降至原始KV状态的5.5%，从而解耦生成开销与上下文长度。

papers.title: UniGen-AR: Unifying Visual Generation with Auto-Regressive Modeling
papers.authors: Zhipeng Bao, Zhen Zhu, Nupur Kumari, Anurag Bagchi, Yu-Xiong Wang, Pavel Tokmakov, Martial Hebert
papers.abstract_en: Modern computer vision pipelines remain fragmented, with tasks such as text-to-image generation, editing, restoration, and classical perception handled by separate models. We study Unified Visual Generation (UVG), where a single model produces diverse image-valued outputs through a unified multimodal interface. While diffusion-based systems dominate UVG due to strong quality and controllability, their iterative sampling incurs substantial inference latency, limiting practical deployment. To address these limitations, we propose UniGen-AR, a framework that pairs a general-purpose multi-modal language model (MLLM) with an efficient next-scale visual auto-regressive (VAR) decoder. This design retains the flexibility of MLLM-based conditioning while leveraging the sampling efficiency and latent unification properties of VAR models. In our framework, the MLLM encodes free-form instructions and control signals into a unified sequence, which guides the VAR decoder to generate image-valued outputs for over 15 tasks spanning four families. Empirically, UniGen-AR achieves up to $19 \times$ lower inference latency than diffusion-based baselines while maintaining or improving output quality. Our ablations further reveal that VQ-VAE tokenizer design, particularly codebook size and hierarchy, is a critical factor for VAR scalability in UVG. These results establish visual auto-regressive modeling as a compelling and efficient backbone for unified visual generation. Our project page is at https://zpbao.github.io/projects/unigenar.
papers.ai_summary_en: UniGen-AR addresses the fragmentation and high inference latency of unified visual generation systems, where a single model must handle text-to-image synthesis, editing, restoration, and perception tasks but diffusion-based approaches are slow due to iterative sampling. The paper proposes pairing a general-purpose multimodal language model that encodes free-form instructions and control signals with an efficient next-scale visual auto-regressive decoder, enabling latent-unified image generation across diverse tasks. Experiments show up to 19× lower latency than diffusion baselines while maintaining or improving quality over 15+ tasks, and ablations identify VQ-VAE codebook size and hierarchy as key to VAR scalability.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对统一视觉生成中扩散模型因迭代采样导致推理延迟高的问题，提出 UniGen-AR，将通用多模态语言模型与 next-scale 视觉自回归解码器结合，以统一序列条件驱动文本生成图像、编辑、修复等 15+ 任务。其核心洞见是利用 VAR 的高效采样与潜在统一性，并发现 VQ-VAE 的码本大小与层级设计是 VAR 可扩展性的关键因素。实验表明，该方法在保持或提升输出质量的同时，较扩散基线最高降低 19 倍推理延迟，为统一视觉生成提供了高效的自回归方案。

papers.title: SpecBox: Speculative Sandbox Scheduling for Efficient LLM Agent Serving
papers.authors: Yihui Zhang, Tianyu Wo, Jinghao Wang, Xiaoyang Sun, Menghao Zhang, Cangzhou Yuan, Li Li, Chunming Hu, Albert Y. Zomaya, Renyu Yang
papers.abstract_en: As LLM agents increasingly rely on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to invoke isolated external sandboxes, disaggregated sandbox deployment introduces a fundamental tension between resource utilization and interactive tail latency. Persistent long-lived sandbox reservations incur excessive memory overhead at scale, while lazy on-demand instantiation generates severe cold-start penalties that degrade response performance under multi-tenant, multi-turn agent workloads. To resolve this dilemma, we present SpecBox, a runtime built around speculative sandbox preallocation tailored for dynamic LLM agent execution pipelines.   At its core, SpecBox implements keyword matching and streaming semantic embedding to enable intent-driven sandbox prewarming, which identifies pending tool execution demands mid-LLM token generation and fully overlaps sandbox bootstrapping with model inference. To extend prewarming windows across sequential agent steps, the framework leverages context-aware stochastic prefetching atop a sandbox dependency graph to probabilistically forecast future sandbox switches ahead of execution. We complement these speculative mechanisms with two orthogonal optimizations: a semantic result cache that prunes redundant repeated sandbox invocations, and a dedicated out-of-band shared-memory transport plane that bypasses conventional network serialization to deliver zero-copy artifact transfers. Evaluated on high-concurrency multi-turn agent traces, our prototype demonstrates that SpecBox cuts P99 end-to-end latency by up to $2.9\times$ relative to the on-demand sandbox baseline, while slashing peak memory consumption by $45.9\%$ compared to permanently reserved sandbox deployments.
papers.ai_summary_en: SpecBox addresses the resource–latency tradeoff in LLM agent serving with external MCP sandboxes, where persistent sandbox reservations waste memory while on-demand instantiation causes cold-start tail latency. Its key insight is speculative sandbox preallocation: it uses keyword matching and streaming semantic embeddings to infer pending tool calls during token generation, overlaps sandbox bootstrapping with inference, and applies context-aware stochastic prefetching over a sandbox dependency graph, complemented by semantic result caching and zero-copy shared-memory transfers. On multi-turn agent workloads, SpecBox reduces P99 end-to-end latency by up to 2.9× versus on-demand sandboxes and cuts peak memory by 45.9% versus permanently reserved deployments.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对 LLM Agent 通过 MCP 调用外部沙箱时，长期预留沙箱导致内存浪费、按需启动又带来冷启动尾延迟的问题。核心方法是 SpecBox 提出投机式沙箱预分配，通过关键词匹配、流式语义嵌入和依赖图上的上下文感知预取，在模型生成阶段提前预热沙箱，并配合语义缓存与共享内存零拷贝传输。实验显示，其相比按需启动可将 P99 端到端延迟最高降低 2.9 倍，相比永久预留可将峰值内存消耗降低 45.9%。

papers.title: MemVLN: Episodic and Procedural Memory for Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.authors: Yuqi Liu, Shengju Qian, Tianyuan Qu, Mingxian Lin, Zixuan Wang, Xin Wang, Bei Yu, Jiaya Jia
papers.abstract_en: Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires agents to maintain long-horizon visual history for trajectory consistency while executing actions with low latency. Existing video-based VLN approaches typically struggle to satisfy both demands simultaneously. To address these challenges, we propose MemVLN, a novel VLN framework that achieves state-of-the-art performance with real-time inference efficiency (14 FPS). MemVLN utilizes a visual encoder to process continuous observations and a Large Language Model (LLM) to interpret instructions and generate actions. Central to our approach is an Episodic Memory management that applies pyramidal resolutions. This mechanism concentrates computation on immediate percepts while retaining compressed long-term history. Complementing to this design, we introduce Procedural Memory for fast action with a compact vocabulary of atomic mid-level actions to bypass auto-regressive decoding latency. Experiments on VLN-CE show that MemVLN-4B surpasses the baseline Qwen3-VL-4B architecture by 5.8\% SR in R2R and 9.7\% SR in RxR, while achieving a 7$\times$ speedup in inference latency.
papers.ai_summary_en: MemVLN addresses Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE), where agents must retain long-horizon visual history for trajectory consistency while executing actions with low latency. It introduces an episodic memory mechanism with pyramidal-resolution compression to prioritize recent observations while preserving long-term context, plus a procedural memory over atomic mid-level actions that bypasses slow autoregressive LLM decoding. MemVLN-4B improves success rate over Qwen3-VL-4B by 5.8% on R2R and 9.7% on RxR while achieving 14 FPS and about 7× lower inference latency.
papers.ai_summary_cn:
该论文针对连续环境视觉-语言导航中既要保留长时视觉轨迹历史、又要低延迟执行动作的矛盾，提出了 MemVLN 框架。  
其核心是结合情景记忆与程序记忆：情景记忆采用金字塔式分辨率管理，对近期观测精细处理、对长期历史压缩保留；程序记忆通过紧凑的原子中层动作词表绕过自回归解码延迟。  
在 VLN-CE 上，MemVLN-4B 相比 Qwen3-VL-4B 在 R2R 和 RxR 的成功率分别提升 5.8% 和 9.7%，并将推理延迟加速约 7 倍，达到 14 FPS 的实时效率。

papers.title: Robust Interpretation of Historical Documents in Knowledge Graphs Through Query Inference and Execution
papers.authors: Sebastià Nicolau, Adrià Molina, Oriol Ramos Terrades, Josep Lladós
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) has redefined how users interact with information in digital environments. However, their widespread and often indiscriminate integration has raised significant concerns regarding reliability and trustworthiness issues that are particularly critical when accessing digital libraries and historical archives. How can one leverage the generalization capacity of an LLM without losing the level of accountability required for an archival institution? In this paper, we present an agentic retrieval system designed to deliver more accurate and verifiable access to historical data while preserving much of the flexibility associated with unconstrained LLMs. As a contribution to historical document analysis, we compare traditional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with an agentic GraphRAG architecture in their ability to deliver historical information under realistic conditions, including the presence of OCR and transcription errors.   We introduce a semi-symbolic framework that integrates word-spotting techniques for post-OCR correction with a knowledge graph representation that enables the agent to access information through synthesized queries. The interleaved collaboration between word spotting and code generation allows the agent to construct strong retrieval queries that are robust to misinterpretation and hallucination, while still leveraging approximate search when noise and uncertainty, common in historical document analysis, would otherwise hinder precise retrieval.
papers.ai_summary_en: The paper addresses the problem of providing reliable, accountable LLM-based access to historical archives, where OCR/transcription errors and hallucination can undermine trust. It proposes a semi-symbolic agentic GraphRAG framework that combines word-spotting-based post-OCR correction, knowledge-graph representation, and LLM-synthesized query execution, allowing approximate retrieval under noise while preserving verifiability. Compared with traditional RAG, the approach yields more robust and interpretable historical document retrieval under realistic noisy conditions.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对历史档案检索中 OCR/转录错误导致 LLM 易幻觉、且缺乏可验证性的问题，研究如何在保持 LLM灵活性的同时实现可问责的历史文档访问。其核心方法是提出一种半符号代理式 GraphRAG 框架，将 word-spotting 的 OCR 后校正与知识图谱表示结合，并通过代码生成合成和执行检索查询。结果显示，相较传统 RAG，该方法在噪声环境下能构建更鲁棒的查询，降低误解与幻觉，提高历史数据访问的准确性和可验证性。

papers.title: MAViE: A Multi-scale Adaptive Vision Encoder for Fine-grained Visual Perception and Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
papers.authors: Shaofei Lei
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models commonly project all tokens produced by a pretrained vision encoder into a large language model. However, final-layer features can discard text, local attributes, and spatial relationships, while high-resolution inputs substantially increase context length and inference latency. We introduce \method, a Multi-scale Adaptive Vision Encoder. \method uses position-dependent gates to fuse shallow, intermediate, and deep features from a vision Transformer, preserving global semantics while enhancing edges, text, and local structure. It then performs question-conditioned token routing according to question relevance, local information content, global semantics, and spatial coverage, with a token budget that adapts to image complexity. To mitigate compression loss, we further introduce full-to-compressed representation distillation and a spatial diversity regularizer. In an illustrative simulation under a unified 7B language-model framework, \method reduces the average number of SigLIP-SO400M visual tokens from 729 to 146 (approximately 80.0\%) and improves the mean score on VQAv2, GQA, TextVQA, ScienceQA-IMG, and MMBench by 2.2 percentage points, while reducing single-image time to first token from 228\,ms to 129\,ms. We provide the full model design and evaluation protocol. All reported numbers currently serve only as placeholders for paper organization and experimental design; formal claims require real training runs, independent replications, and official benchmark evaluation.
papers.ai_summary_en: MAViE addresses the inefficiency and information loss in vision-language models that project all final-layer visual tokens into the LLM, which can discard local attributes, text, and spatial detail while inflating context length and latency. Its key method is a multi-scale adaptive vision encoder that gates and fuses shallow, intermediate, and deep ViT features, then performs question-conditioned token routing under an adaptive budget using relevance, local information, global semantics, and spatial coverage, with full-to-compressed distillation and spatial-diversity regularization. In an illustrative 7B-model simulation, it reports reducing SigLIP-SO400M tokens from 729 to 146 (~80%), improving mean VQA/MMBench score by 2.2 points, and lowering time-to-first-token from 228 ms to 129 ms, though the authors note these numbers are placeholders pending formal evaluation.
papers.ai_summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉语言模型将全部视觉 token 输入 LLM 所造成的细粒度信息丢失、上下文过长和推理延迟高等问题，提出 MAViE：通过位置相关门控融合浅、中、深层视觉特征，并基于问题相关性、局部信息量、全局语义与空间覆盖进行自适应 token 路由，同时用表示蒸馏和空间多样性正则缓解压缩损失。示意性结果显示，在 7B 模型框架下可将 SigLIP 视觉 token 从 729 降至 146，在多个多模态基准上平均提升约 2.2 个百分点，并将单图首 token 延迟从 228ms 降至 129ms；但作者强调当前数值仅为占位，需正式实验验证。

papers.title: Failures Reveal What Metrics Miss: An Evidence-Driven Agent for Recursive Refinement of ECG Classifiers
papers.authors: Jinliang Deng, Yiming Niu, Yibo Pan, Zhiqi Shao, Qin Luo, Yongxin Tong
papers.abstract_en: Deep models have substantially advanced 12-lead ECG classification, yet their refinement still relies heavily on human experts to inspect failures and iteratively revise classifier designs. Recent LLM-based agents have demonstrated the potential for automated model design, but when guided only by aggregate performance metrics, they lack insight into why individual cases fail and how the classifier should be revised. We present RecursiveECG, an evidence-driven LLM-as-Designer framework in which an LLM serves as an offline model designer that refines ECG classifiers based on concrete failures and objective ECG evidence.
